idea-plugin.name: Protobuf Generator
idea-plugin.description:
generate code from .proto files (they must have a .proto extension).
GenProtobuf adds two right click menu entries "quick gen protobuf here" and "quick gen protobuf rules" to the project area and "Configure GenProtobuf" and "Generate all Protobufs" to the tools menu.
quick gen protobuf here will quickly generate code for selected protobuf files in a single selected langauge as configured under "Configure GenProtobuf" in the tools menu placing the output in the same directory as the selected protobuf files.
quick gen protobuf rules will generate code for selected protobuf files according to the rules set with "Configure GenProtobuf" in the tools menu and place the output in the configured output location.
Finally you can use Generate all Protobufs under the tools menu and it will apply the rules set in Configure Genprotobuf (again under the tools menu,) to all the protobuf files it finds in your project.
As stated in the descriptions above you can configure this plugin from the Configure GenProtobuf menu that gets added to the tools menu. You are able to set what programming language to use for the quick gen options and toggle different languages to be generated for protobuf files as well as different directories for the various language outputs.
Whenever you generate code from a .proto file a tool window is created to display the resulting textual output.

idea-plugin.name: Ligatures Limited
idea-plugin.description:
Code ligatures only where you want them, not where you don't.


README page for Ligatures Limited, with full documentation.


Ligatures Limited allows code ligatures, like those found in Fira Code and other fonts, to be rendered only where they make the most sense — typically as operators and punctuation, for example, <= and !=. Everywhere else (using configurable rules) ligatures are suppressed, so they don't do weird things inside strings and comments and the like.


Ligatures are also suppressed at the current insert cursor position, making it easier to see what you're doing as you type. Optionally this can be done for all ligatures on the currently-edited line.


This plugin works automatically as soon as it is installed and enabled. See the control panel in Settings/Preferences → Editor → Ligatures Limited to change options and configuration. Also make sure in Settings/Preferences → Editor → Font that a ligature font has been selected, and “Enable font ligatures” is checked.

json2dart

Description

It's a flutter plugin that use for parsing json to dart class with safe type convert.

What it do

It will generate a dart file named "safe_convert.dart" to ensure dart object can be converted to correct type, if failed, it will get a default value.

For example, when you need a int type, but the server offer you a String type. It will auto convert String to int and make sure that, when convert failed, it has a default value such as '0'.

safe_convert.dart

int toInt(value, {int defaultValue = 0}) {
  if (value == null) return defaultValue;
  if (value is int) return value;
  if (value is double) return value.toInt();
  if (value is bool) return value ? 1 : 0;
  if (value is String) {
    return int.tryParse(value) ??
        double.tryParse(value)?.toInt() ??
        defaultValue;
  }
  return defaultValue;
}

double toDouble(value, {double defaultValue = 0.0}) {
  if (value == null) return defaultValue;
  if (value is double) return value;
  if (value is int) return value.toDouble();
  if (value is bool) return value ? 1.0 : 0.0;
  if (value is String) return double.tryParse(value) ?? defaultValue;
  return defaultValue;
}

bool toBool(value, {bool defaultValue = false}) {
  if (value == null) return defaultValue;
  if (value is bool) return value;
  if (value is int) return value == 0 ? false : true;
  if (value is double) return value == 0 ? false : true;
  if (value is String) {
    if (value == "1" || value.totoLowerCase() == "true") return true;
    if (value == "0" || value.totoLowerCase() == "false") return false;
  }
  return defaultValue;
}

String toString(value, {String defaultValue = ""}) {
  if (value == null) return defaultValue;
  if (value is String) return value;
  if (value is int) return value.toString();
  if (value is double) return value.toString();
  if (value is bool) return value ? "true" : "false";
  return defaultValue;
}

Map<String, dynamic> toMap(value, {Map<String, dynamic>? defaultValue}) {
  if (value == null) return defaultValue ?? <String, dynamic>{};
  if (value is Map<String, dynamic>) return value;
  return defaultValue ?? <String, dynamic>{};
}

List toList(value, {List? defaultValue}) {
  if (value == null) return defaultValue ?? [];
  if (value is List) return value;
  return defaultValue ?? [];
}

int asInt(Map<String, dynamic>? json, String key, {int defaultValue = 0}) {
  if (json == null || !json.containsKey(key)) return defaultValue;
  return toInt(json[key]);
}

double asDouble(Map<String, dynamic>? json, String key,
    {double defaultValue = 0.0}) {
  if (json == null || !json.containsKey(key)) return defaultValue;
  return toDouble(json[key]);
}

bool asBool(Map<String, dynamic>? json, String key,
    {bool defaultValue = false}) {
  if (json == null || !json.containsKey(key)) return defaultValue;
  return toBool(json[key]);
}

String asString(Map<String, dynamic>? json, String key,
    {String defaultValue = ""}) {
  if (json == null || !json.containsKey(key)) return defaultValue;
  return toString(json[key]);
}

Map<String, dynamic> asMap(Map<String, dynamic>? json, String key,
    {Map<String, dynamic>? defaultValue}) {
  if (json == null || !json.containsKey(key)) {
    return defaultValue ?? <String, dynamic>{};
  }
  return toMap(json[key]);
}

List asList(Map<String, dynamic>? json, String key, {List? defaultValue}) {
  if (json == null || !json.containsKey(key)) return defaultValue ?? [];
  return toList(json[key]);
}

List<int> asListInt(Map<String, dynamic>? json, String key,
    {List? defaultValue}) {
  return asList(json, key, defaultValue: defaultValue)
      .map((e) => toInt(e))
      .toList();
}

List<String> asListString(Map<String, dynamic>? json, String key,
    {List? defaultValue}) {
  return asList(json, key, defaultValue: defaultValue)
      .map((e) => toString(e))
      .toList();
}

T asT<T>(Map<String, dynamic>? json, String key, {T? defaultValue}) {
  if (json == null || !json.containsKey(key)) {
    if (defaultValue != null) return defaultValue;
    if (0 is T) return 0 as T;
    if (0.0 is T) return 0.0 as T;
    if ('' is T) return '' as T;
    if (false is T) return false as T;
    if ([] is T) return [] as T;
    if (<String, dynamic>{} is T) return <String, dynamic>{} as T;
    return '' as T;
  }
  dynamic value = json[key];
  if (value is T) return value;

  if (0 is T) {
    return toInt(value, defaultValue: (defaultValue ?? 0) as int) as T;
  } else if (0.0 is T) {
    return toDouble(value, defaultValue: (defaultValue ?? 0.0) as double) as T;
  } else if ('' is T) {
    return toString(value, defaultValue: (defaultValue ?? '') as String) as T;
  } else if (false is T) {
    return toBool(value, defaultValue: (defaultValue ?? false) as bool) as T;
  } else if ([] is T) {
    return toList(value, defaultValue: (defaultValue ?? []) as List) as T;
  } else if (<String, dynamic>{} is T) {
    Object defaultV = defaultValue ?? <String, dynamic>{};
    return toMap(value, defaultValue: defaultV as Map<String, dynamic>) as T;
  }
  return '' as T;
}

Features

  • final property
  • null safety
  • fromJson and toJson method
  • copyWith method
  • use generic

Example

Example 1: without using generic

class Response {
  final int intValue;
  final double doubleValue;
  final bool boolValue;
  final String stringValue;
  final KeyData keyData;
  final List<String> stringData;

  Response({
    this.intValue = 0,
    this.doubleValue = 0.0,
    this.boolValue = false,
    this.stringValue = "",
    required this.keyData,
    required this.stringData,
  });

  factory Response.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic>? json) => Response(
    intValue: asInt(json, 'int_value'),
    doubleValue: asDouble(json, 'double_value'),
    boolValue: asBool(json, 'bool_value'),
    stringValue: asString(json, 'string_value'),
    keyData: KeyData.fromJson(asMap(json, 'key_data')),
    stringData: asList(json, 'string_data').map((e) => e.toString()).toList(),
  );

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {
    'int_value': intValue,
    'double_value': doubleValue,
    'bool_value': boolValue,
    'string_value': stringValue,
    'key_data': keyData.toJson(),
    'string_data': stringData.map((e) => e).toList(),
  };
}

Example 2: using generic

class Response {
  final int intValue;
  final double doubleValue;
  final bool boolValue;
  final String stringValue;
  final KeyData keyData;
  final List<String> stringData;

  Response({
    this.intValue = 0,
    this.doubleValue = 0.0,
    this.boolValue = false,
    this.stringValue = "",
    required this.keyData,
    required this.stringData,
  });

  factory Response.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic>? json) => Response(
    intValue: asT<int>(json, 'int_value'),
    doubleValue: asT<double>(json, 'double_value'),
    boolValue: asT<bool>(json, 'bool_value'),
    stringValue: asT<String>(json, 'string_value'),
    keyData: KeyData.fromJson(asT<Map<String, dynamic>>(json, 'key_data')),
    stringData: asT<List>(json, 'string_data').map((e) => e.toString()).toList(),
  );

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {
    'int_value': intValue,
    'double_value': doubleValue,
    'bool_value': boolValue,
    'string_value': stringValue,
    'key_data': keyData.toJson(),
    'string_data': stringData.map((e) => e).toList(),
  };
}

Example 3: generate copyWith method

class Response {

  ......

  Response copyWith({
    int? intValue,
    double? doubleValue,
    bool? boolValue,
    String? stringValue,
    KeyData? keyData,
    List<String>? stringData,
  }) {
    return Response(
      intValue: intValue ?? this.intValue,
      doubleValue: doubleValue ?? this.doubleValue,
      boolValue: boolValue ?? this.boolValue,
      stringValue: stringValue ?? this.stringValue,
      keyData: keyData ?? this.keyData,
      stringData: stringData ?? this.stringData,
    );
  }
}

idea-plugin.name: JSON Key Finder
idea-plugin.description:
What it does

JSON Key Finder is a lightweight JetBrains plugin designed to speed up your workflow when working with complex JSON structures and localization files. It allows you to search, locate, and navigate to any nested JSON key, i18n translation string, or configuration property across your entire project in seconds.

Whether you are managing multi-language web applications (en.json, locales/), handling complex API payloads, or navigating app configs, JSON Key Finder eliminates manual file searching and tedious scrolling.

Key Features

  • Instant Key Search & Autocomplete: Search through nested JSON objects and arrays with real-time suggestions matching your query.
  • Contextual Code Preview: Preview surrounding lines of code and values for all key occurrences before jumping to the file.
  • NEW: Code-to-JSON Navigation (Ctrl+Click / Cmd+Click): Click any string literal in your code that matches a JSON key (e.g., react-i18next or vue-i18n keys) to navigate directly to its definition.
  • NEW: Default Source File (Pinning): Pin your primary translation or configuration file (e.g., en.json) using the star icon. Pinned files remain at the top of search results for ultra-fast access.

How to use it

You can locate any JSON key using three convenient methods:

  1. Direct Navigation: Press Ctrl+Click (Windows/Linux) or Cmd+Click (macOS) on any string literal matching a JSON key to jump straight to its definition.
  2. Global Search Shortcut: Press Ctrl + Alt + Shift + F (Windows/Linux) or Cmd + Shift + Option + F (macOS) to open the search popup.
  3. Context Menu: Select any text, right-click, and choose Find Key in JSON.
idea-plugin.change-notes:

  • Add bidirectional navigation with Find Usages in Project on JSON property names.
  • Find exact full-path, descendant, and array references across project code and JSON string values, including unsaved edits.
  • Respect project exclusions and language-recognized comments, with navigable results in the native Find tool window.
  • Add illustrated usage-search and rename walkthroughs, step-by-step documentation, and accessible animation controls.

    • My expectation: It is not easy to insists on open source about 8 versions, but there are only a few 🌟 for this project, so I ask for your help: Give me a star🌟, and share it with more friends about the funny from one-click!
      • Basic grammar 1: '+' for estimating the future time, the current time will add the input data when calculating; '-'(default: non '+' nor '-') for estimating the past time, the current time will subtract the input data when calculating
      • Basic grammar 2: Time unit definition: 'Y'=Year, 'M'=Month, 'd'=day, 'h'=hour, 'm'=minute, 's'=second, millisecond(default) with no time unit mark
      • Basic grammar 3: Support any combination of time units, which is no order between 'YMdhms'(but I recommended maintain order), besides, it doesn't need to appear all the time utils, just use what you need
      • For example 1: +10Y9M8d7h6m54s321, means the current time should execute: +10years+9months+8days+7hours+6minutes+54seconds+321milliseconds
      • For example 2: -34h67m89s999999, means the current time should execute: -34hours-67minutes-89seconds-999999milliseconds
      • For example 3: -5s1Y321000, means the current time should execute:-1year-5seconds-321000milliseconds
      • Attention 1: The millisecond data must be put to the end if you need it
      • Attention 2: The parsing rules limit the first input of the same time unit as a valid value, and the later data input will be ignored, for example: '2d3m4d5d9m' will only be parsed as '2d3m'

      • 基础语法3: 支持时间单位任意组合, 即YMdhms之间是没有顺序的(但是建议顺序), 此外也不需要都出现
      • 示例1: +10Y9M8d7h6m54s321, 代表当前时间加上10年9月8天7小时6分钟54秒321毫秒

idea-plugin.name: MybatisSqlLogJoiner
idea-plugin.description:
This is a plugin for splicing the Sql log output by Mybatis, which can easily and automatically replace the parameter placeholders in the Sql log

usage:
1.Ctrl+C the Sql log containing Mybatis output to the pasteboard (can contain multiple sql)
2.Click Tool->SqlLogJoiner, or click the last button SqlLogJoiner on the Toolbar
3.There is already a parsed complete Sql in the pasteboard, just copy Ctrl+V to the desired location



Principles and techniques:
Each time Mybatis executes Sql, it will output three lines of logs, and the keywords in each line of logs are in order: Preparing, Parameters, and Total.
At least one Preparing log must be included in the original log copied in step 1.
This plug-in reads the string in the pasteboard line by line, reads the Preparation log and the Parameters log, two or two groups, parsing parameters, splicing SQL, and copying to the pasteboard in turn.


这是一个用于拼接Mybatis输出的Sql日志的插件,可以便捷的自动替换Sql日志中的参数占位符

用法:
1.将包含Mybatis输出的Sql日志Ctrl+C到粘贴板(可包含多条sql)
2.点击Tool->SqlLogJoiner、或点击Toolbar上最后一个按钮SqlLogJoiner
3.粘贴板中已经有解析好的完整Sql,Ctrl+V复制到需要的位置即可



原理和技巧:
Mybatis每次执行Sql会输出三行日志,各行日志中关键字按顺序为:Preparing、Parameters、Total。
第1步中复制原始日志中至少要包含一条Preparing日志。
本插件按行读取粘贴板中的字符串,依次循环读取Preparing日志和Parameters日志、两两组队、解析参数、拼接Sql、复制到粘贴板。

idea-plugin.name: FlutterAssetsGenerator
idea-plugin.description:
A powerful Android Studio / IntelliJ plugin that automatically generates a type-safe, hierarchical asset index for your Flutter projects.

Support

  • Found a bug or unexpected behavior? Please report it at GitHub Issues.
  • Release notes for each version are listed in the Changelog.

Core Features

  • Hierarchical Generation: Generates classes that mirror your directory structure (e.g., Assets.images.logo).
  • Multi-Module Support: Seamlessly supports nested Flutter modules and monorepos (e.g. example/ or packages/).
  • Legacy Compatibility: Supports style: legacy to generate flat variable names (e.g. Assets.imagesLogo) for easy migration.
  • Smart Type Support: Automatically detects SVG, Lottie and Rive files.
  • Widget Integration: Generates .svg(), .lottie() and .rive() methods directly on asset objects.
  • Auto Dependency Management: Automatically checks and adds flutter_svg, lottie or rive dependencies.
  • YAML as Source of Truth: In 3.x, behavior is driven by pubspec.yaml. Modules without flutter_assets_generator config are not watched or generated automatically.
  • Disable Cleanup: Setting enable: false stops generation for that module and removes the previously generated Dart file.
  • Smart Auto Update:
    • Assets: Watch for image additions/deletions and regenerate automatically.
    • Config: Triggered on File Save (Cmd+S) in pubspec.yaml. Smart diffing ensures builds only run when necessary.
    • Performance: Setup and generation run asynchronously in the background, module configs are cached per project, and generated-file formatting is skipped to keep EDT writes minimal even in large monorepos.

Usage

1. Quick Setup (Recommended)

For first-time users, use the one-click setup:

  • Menu: Click Tools -> Flutter Assets Generator -> Setup Project Configuration.
  • Project View: Right-click the root directory of a Flutter module, then click Flutter: Setup Current Module to configure only that module.

Project activation and module setup follow these rules:

  • The plugin treats a project as available when it can find at least one valid Flutter module in the current workspace.
  • A valid Flutter module must be rooted at its own pubspec.yaml directory and contain Flutter configuration (flutter: or Flutter SDK dependency).
  • Temporary generated directories such as .dart_tool, build, .symlinks, .plugin_symlinks, and ephemeral are excluded from module detection.
  • The Project View setup entry is shown only when the selected directory exactly matches a Flutter module root. Child folders such as lib/ or assets/ do not show the entry.
  • package_parameter_enabled defaults to false for Flutter apps and add-to-app Flutter modules, and defaults to true for other Flutter packages.
  • Both project-level setup and current-module setup use the same automatic defaults.

This will automatically add the default configuration to your pubspec.yaml:

flutter_assets_generator:
  enable: true
  output_dir: generated/
  output_filename: assets
  class_name: Assets
  auto_detection: true
  auto_add_dependencies: true
  style: robust # Options: robust (default), legacy (legacy)
  leaf_type: class # Options: class (default for robust), string (default for legacy)
  name_style: camel # Options: camel (default), snake
  package_parameter_enabled: false # Flutter packages default to true
  path_ignore: []

2. Manual Configuration (Optional)

flutter_assets_generator:
  # Enable/Disable this plugin for the current module. Default: true when the block exists
  enable: true
  # When set to false, generation stops and the previous generated Dart file is removed
  # Sets the directory of generated files. Default: generated/
  output_dir: generated/
  # Sets the name for the generated file. Default: assets
  output_filename: assets
  # Enable package parameter generation (package: 'your_package_name'). Default: false
  package_parameter_enabled: false
  # Sets the name for the root class. Default: Assets
  class_name: Assets
  # Enable/Disable auto monitoring and dependency management. Default: true
  auto_detection: true
  # Add dependencies to pubspec.yaml automatically. Default: true
  auto_add_dependencies: true
  # Generation style: robust (Hierarchical) or legacy (Flat legacy). Default: robust
  style: robust
  # Leaf type: class (typed wrappers) or string (raw asset path). Default: class for robust, string for legacy
  leaf_type: class
  # Name style for generated identifiers. Default: camel
  name_style: camel
  # For legacy style: Prefix variable names with parent directory names. Default: true
  named_with_parent: true
  # Ignore specific paths. Default: []
  path_ignore: ["assets/fonts"]

When leaf_type: string, asset references return raw String paths (e.g., Assets.icons.user returns a string). In this mode the plugin will not auto-add flutter_svg, lottie, or rive.

When style: legacy and leaf_type: class, the generator keeps flat access paths but wraps known asset types with typed helpers:

// legacy + leaf_type: class
static const AssetGenImage imagesLogo = AssetGenImage('assets/images/logo.png');
static const SvgGenImage iconsHome = SvgGenImage('assets/icons/home.svg');
// Unknown types (e.g. mp4, json) still fall back to String
static const String videosIntro = 'assets/videos/intro.mp4';

Modules without a flutter_assets_generator block are not monitored automatically. If you run Generate Assets before initialization, the plugin will ask you to run Setup Project Configuration first.

3. Generate File

  • Menu: Click Tools -> Flutter Assets Generator -> Generate Assets.
  • Shortcut: Press Option(Mac) / Alt(Win) + G.
  • Generated File Writes: Generated Dart files are written directly without an additional IDE reformat pass, reducing EDT stalls in large monorepos.

4. Access Assets in Code

The plugin generates a strict, type-safe hierarchy:

// Standard Image
Assets.images.logo.image(width: 24, height: 24);

// SVG (Requires flutter_svg dependency)
Assets.icons.home.svg(color: Colors.blue);

// Lottie (Requires lottie dependency)
Assets.anim.loading.lottie(repeat: true);

// Rive (Requires rive dependency)
Assets.anims.input.rive(fit: BoxFit.contain);

// Custom widget builder - allows you to build any widget with the asset path
Assets.images.logo.custom(
  builder: (context, assetPath) {
    return YourCustomWidget(assetPath: assetPath);
  },
);
    
// Get raw path string
String path = Assets.images.logo.path;
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Fixed / 修复

  • IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2 crash: Removed all usages of Kotlin plugin internal APIs (ProjectStructureUtilKt, toPsiFile, findModule). The plugin no longer depends on the Kotlin plugin at all. Fixes #42 and #44.
    • IDEA 2026.2 崩溃: 移除对 Kotlin 插件内部 API 的全部引用，插件不再依赖 Kotlin 插件。修复 #42、#44。
  • Editor lag: The gutter icon provider used to rescan every pubspec.yaml in the project for every string literal in every Dart file. Module configs are now cached per project and only recomputed when a pubspec.yaml, the VFS structure, or project roots change. Fixes #28.
    • 编辑器卡顿: 行标记以前对每个 Dart 字符串都全量扫描 pubspec。现改为项目级缓存，仅在 pubspec / 目录结构 / 项目根变化时重新计算。修复 #28。
  • Asset watcher: Irrelevant VFS events (.dart edits, build/, .dart_tool/, etc.) no longer trigger module scans; scans wait for indexing to finish instead of throwing IndexNotReadyException; all affected modules in one batch are regenerated instead of only the first.
    • 资源监听: 无关的 VFS 事件不再触发扫描；索引期间等待就绪而不是抛异常；同一批事件涉及多个模块时全部重新生成。
  • enable: false cleanup: Deleting the generated file now runs inside a write action; previously it threw an assertion on every code path.
    • 禁用清理: 删除生成文件改为在 write action 中执行，修复此前必然抛异常的问题。
  • flutter_svg template (#43): The SVG template is now chosen by the flutter_svg version in pubspec.yaml (falling back to the Flutter SDK version, then 2.x), the 2.x template gains colorFilter, and the Flutter version is read from bin/cache/flutter.version.json (new SDKs no longer ship a root version file). The flutter --version fallback now has a timeout and works on Windows.
    • flutter_svg 模板 (#43): 按 pubspec 里 flutter_svg 的实际版本选择模板（兜底 Flutter SDK 版本，再兜底 2.x），2.x 模板补充 colorFilter；Flutter 版本改从 flutter.version.json 读取；flutter --version 兜底增加超时并支持 Windows。
  • Generated Dart code: Asset paths are now escaped ($, ', ), unknown file types use the package-prefixed path consistently in both styles, and the generated file no longer imports package:lottie/src/... internals.
    • 生成代码: 资源路径转义 $、'、；未知类型在两种风格下统一使用带 package 前缀的路径；不再引用 lottie 的 src/ 内部文件。
  • "Configuring Paths" action: No longer mutates the cached config, resolves existing entries against the pub package root (not the IntelliJ module), and handles paths with / on Windows.
    • 右键配置路径: 不再污染缓存；已有条目相对 pub 包根目录校验；Windows 下路径处理修复。
  • Config consistency: auto_detection now defaults to true on both trigger paths when the key is omitted; changing named_with_parent triggers regeneration.
    • 配置一致性: 省略 auto_detection 时两条触发路径都默认开启；修改 named_with_parent 会触发重新生成。
  • Module detection: Cache-directory exclusion (build, .dart_tool, ...) is now matched relative to the project root, so a project located under a folder named build is no longer ignored.
    • 模块识别: 缓存目录排除改为相对项目根目录匹配，项目本身放在 build 目录下不再被整体忽略。

Changed / 变更

  • Minimum supported IDE build is now 213 (2021.3), matching the compile target.
    • 最低支持 IDE 版本提升到 213 (2021.3)，与编译目标一致。
  • kotlin-stdlib is no longer bundled in the plugin zip; the platform provides it.
    • 不再把 kotlin-stdlib 打进发布包。
  • Per-file / per-node logging downgraded from INFO to DEBUG to keep idea.log quiet.
    • 逐文件 / 逐节点日志从 INFO 降为 DEBUG。
  • Deprecated platform APIs replaced (projectOpened, AppTopics.FILE_DOCUMENT_SYNC, FilenameIndex.processFilesByName, Runtime.exec).
    • 替换已废弃的平台 API。

idea-plugin.name: Regex Tool
idea-plugin.description:
A powerful regular expression development toolkit built into your IDE.

Features

  • Real-time Tester — Live regex matching with syntax highlighting, capture group details, execution time, and search history.
  • Replace & Extract — Template-based replacement and extraction with $0 $1 $2... group references. Switch between Replace and Extract modes instantly.
  • Regex Explainer — Human-readable breakdown of any regex pattern in a tree structure.
  • Railroad Diagram — Visual regex diagram powered by Regulex (embedded JCEF browser).
  • Replace Rules — Save named regex rules, apply them via right-click menu, and bind custom keyboard shortcuts in Settings → Keymap.
  • Pattern Reference — Searchable cheat sheet with 100+ common patterns (email, URL, date, IP, UUID, etc.). Click to copy.

Level up: ★ Toolset ★ = Regex Tool + JSON, Timestamp, Encoding, Text tools & 100 more.

All Plugins | Issues | Email

idea-plugin.name: Python Bytecode
idea-plugin.description:
View Python bytecode directly in your editor with a split view, similar to Markdown preview. Understand what Python compiles your code into — explore opcodes, optimize performance, and learn CPython internals.

Features

  • Split Editor View - See bytecode side-by-side with your Python code
  • Bidirectional Synchronization - Click on source code to highlight corresponding bytecode and vice versa
  • Syntax Highlighting - Colorized bytecode output for better readability
  • Opcode Documentation - Hover over any opcode to see its description, category, and link to Python docs (Ctrl+Q)
  • Scope Selection - View bytecode for entire file, specific function, or class
  • Auto-update - Bytecode updates automatically as you type (configurable debounce delay)
  • Performance Optimized - Content-based caching, large file protection, and process cancellation
  • Keyboard Shortcuts - Alt+Shift+B to refresh, Alt+Shift+E to export
  • Export - Copy to clipboard or export to TXT/HTML files
  • Settings - Configure auto-update behavior and debounce delay in Settings > Tools > Python Bytecode
  • Python 3.4+ - Supports Python 3.4 through 3.14 with 170+ opcode descriptions

Links

  • meanmail.dev
  • GitHub

Your ratings and feedback are very important!
idea-plugin.change-notes:
2026.1 (March 15, 2026)

  • Opcode Documentation - Hover over any opcode to see description, category, and Python docs link (Ctrl+Q). Covers 170+ opcodes from Python 3.0 to 3.14
  • Settings Page - Configure auto-update and debounce delay in Settings > Tools > Python Bytecode
  • Keyboard Shortcuts - Alt+Shift+B to refresh bytecode, Alt+Shift+E to export
  • Performance - Content-based caching avoids redundant Python process calls. Large files (>10K lines) skip auto-update. Previous generation process is cancelled on new request

idea-plugin.name: Auto-Reviewer
idea-plugin.description:
Idea is an easy to use code review plugin designed to record, track, and analyze problems in a low cost way.
it's for internal usage and probably not be useful for general public
Main function:
1. Use the Alt+D shortcut key or [Code- Add Review Comments] to evoke the Code review plug-in. Review comments can be marked in the Code, and the plug-in will automatically extract project information, selected lines of Code, selected Code content and other information to generate review records;
2. For the newly added review comments, the system will automatically extract the most recent submitter of the problem code and send a reminder notice to them to facilitate timely follow-up and modification;
3. Automatically record the last submission and classification information to reduce repeated input work;
4. After code modification, reviewers can be informed to verify the modification information in time to form a review closed loop;
5. Support statistical analysis of review records according to time and project.

  • 3. 选中方法名，然后右键"Doc" 或者使用快捷键"ctrl alt C", 如果这个方法带有"cap"和"web"类型的注解则这个方法会生成对应的文档,否则将给你一个原因提示

idea-plugin.name: FlutterTools
idea-plugin.description:
FlutterTools can help you get things done quickly in development

Usage

Menu > FlutterTools > AssetsSync

Please configure FlutterTools in flutter_tools.yaml or pubspec.yaml first.

if flutter_tools.yaml and pubspec.yaml exist, flutter_tools.yaml will be used.

flutter_tools:                  # FlutterTools Config node
  assets_sync:                  # assets sync node
    excluded:
      - '*.DS_Store'            # excluded path node
      - '*.png'                 # excluded path node
      - assets/hide/            # excluded path node
      - assets/images/logo.png  # excluded path node
    sync_path:                  # assets sync path node
      - assets/images           # sync images path demo
      - assets/fonts            # sync fonts path demo
    out_path:                   # class output path
      lib/r.dart                # output class file path, you can change it, default lib/r.dart
    out_class:                  # class name node
      R                         # output class name, default R
    watch: false                # watch assets sync and generate class, default false

When there is a multi-power folder in the configuration directory, the multi-power resource paths will be merged, such as:

assets/images/app_logo.png
assets/images/2.0x/app_logo.png

class R {
  static const String assetsImageAppLogo = "assets/images/app_logo.png";
}

idea-plugin.name: leetcode-editor-pro
idea-plugin.description:
Solve LeetCode problems without leaving your IDE. LeetCode Editor supports leetcode.com and leetcode.cn for problem browsing, local debugging, and submissions. See the project documentation for the complete guide.

无需离开 IDE 即可完成 LeetCode 刷题。LeetCode Editor 支持 leetcode.com 与 leetcode.cn，覆盖题目浏览、 本地调试和提交等常用流程。 更多使用说明请查看 中文文档。

Getting Started

Local Debugging

Configuration

  • Configuration path: File -> Settings -> Tools -> LeetCode Plugin
    • URL options: Choose leetcode.com or leetcode.cn.
    • Code Type: Java, Python, C++, Python 3, C, C#, JavaScript, Ruby, Swift, Go, Scala, Kotlin, Rust, PHP, Bash, or SQL.
    • LoginName / Password: Credentials for the selected site.
    • Temp File Path: Directory for generated temporary files.
    • HTTP Proxy: Configure it in File -> Settings -> Appearance & Behavior -> System Settings -> HTTP Proxy.
    • Custom code template: Customize generated code (details, example).
    • LevelColour: Customize problem-difficulty colors; restart the IDE after changing it.

Problem Navigator

  • Toolbar:
    • Sign in: Configure an account for the selected website. Accounts for the two sites are independent.
    • Sign out: Exit the current account. If sign-in fails, try signing out first.
    • Refresh: Load problems without signing in; submitting still requires an account.
    • Pick: Open a random problem.
    • Find: Open the panel for searching, filtering, and sorting.
    • Session: View or switch sessions.
    • Toggle List: Switch between All Problem List, Paginated Problem List, and CodeTop Problem List.
    • Settings: Open the configuration page.
    • Clear: Remove files from the cache directory for the current website. Use it carefully when work has not been submitted.

Context Menu

  • Menu (right-click on the questions):
    • Open question: Open the problem; double-clicking a problem does the same.
    • Open content: Show the description and images (requires Markdown support).
    • Open solution: Show the official solution.
    • Open in web: Open the problem in a browser.
    • Submit: Submit the current solution.
    • Submissions: View submission records and select Show detail in the pop-up window.
    • Run Code: Run the default test case for the problem.
    • Testcase: Create custom test cases.
    • Favorite: Add or remove the problem from favorites.
    • Note: Open notes for the problem.
    • Timer: Track solving time in the status bar.
    • Clear cache: Remove cached files for the current problem.

Editor menu: Right-click in the editor to access the same actions.

Question editor tabs: Content shows the description and images, Solution shows the solution, Submissions shows submission records, and Note shows notes.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Added

  • add a redesigned Pro result console with structured run and submission entries / 新增重新设计的 Pro 结果控制台，以结构化方式展示运行和提交结果
  • add side-by-side Expected and Actual output comparison, with a detailed comparison view for failed cases / 新增 Expected 与 Actual 并排对比，并可在失败用例中查看完整差异
  • show complete compiler diagnostics for failed code execution and provide direct code-location links where available / 运行编译失败时展示完整诊断信息，并在可用时提供代码位置跳转链接

Changed

  • require IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2 (build 262) or later and upgrade the runtime baseline to Java 25 / 最低兼容版本调整为 IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2（build 262），运行和构建基线升级至 Java 25
  • move network requests, question loading, preview rendering, and cache cleanup away from the IDE UI thread to reduce freezes (#767) / 将网络请求、题目加载、预览渲染和缓存清理移出 IDE UI 线程，减少界面卡顿
  • reorganize editor actions into a clearer View submenu and refresh action names and descriptions / 将编辑器操作重新组织到更清晰的 View 子菜单，并更新操作名称和说明
  • refresh the question navigator, difficulty colors, and plugin icons / 更新题目导航、默认难度颜色和插件图标
  • show update information as an IDE notification with a link to the changelog / 版本升级后通过 IDE 通知展示更新提示，并提供更新日志链接
  • automatically open and scroll the result console to the latest run, submission, and error message / 运行、提交或发生错误时自动打开结果控制台并滚动到最新消息

Fixed

  • prevent an error dialog when a submission failure omits optional result fields, and show the failure in the console instead / 修复提交失败结果缺少可选字段时弹出异常的问题，改为在控制台正常展示失败信息
  • show the complete compiler diagnostic returned by Run Code instead of only the summary message / 修复 Run Code 仅显示编译错误摘要的问题，改为展示完整编译诊断信息

idea-plugin.name: PHP Data Object Generator
idea-plugin.description:
PHP Data Object Generator

Description

Code generator plugin for PHP Data Objects (Value Object, DTO/Data Transfer Object, etc...) and Builder pattern objects for creating them.

Cost

The basic code generator for Data Objects and Builders are free and require no license. Just install the plugin. Advanced in-place refactoring of previously generated classes to add/remove class properties require a nominal one time fee to use after the 30-day trial.

Features

Free

  • Generate new Data Objects by defining class properties.
  • Generate Builder classes for your Data Objects.
  • Modify templates used in generation.

Paid

  • Ability to in-place refactor the Data Object and their Builders to add and remove properties.

Usage

To generate a new Data Object:

  • Select "Php Data Object" from the New File menu.
    • Right Click > New > Php Data Object
  • Fill in the dialog supplying classname and property definitions.
  • Optionally select to make the class immutable (no "setter" methods will be generated).
  • Optionally enable generating a Builder for the class.

To generate a Builder from an existing PHP class:

  • Select "Builder..." from the Generate menu
    • Right Click in Editor view on PHP class > Generate > Builder...
  • Define Builder classname and select which properties to include in the Builder.

Modify Templates used to Generate Code

  • Open Project Preferences
    • alt-. or command-.
  • Within Preferences: Editor > File and Code Templates > "Other" tab > PHP Data Object Plugin
  • Select "PHP DataObject Plugin"
    • Edit templates as needed.

To In-Place Refactor existing Data Object:

  • Select "Update Data Object" from the Refactor menu
    • Right Click in Editor view on PHP class > Refactor > Update Data Object
  • Unselect any properties you wish to remove from the Existing Properties table.
  • Define any properties you wish to add to the New Properties table.

Note: In-place refactoring will only function on data classes previously generated using this plugin.

Note: Making significant modifications to the included templates may cause the automatic refactoring to fail or produce otherwise unsatisfactory results. If you run into issues please submit a bug report with your template and example code.

Submit BugReports or Feature Requests: https://github.com/SourceLabOrg/PhpDataObjectGeneratorPlugin/issues

idea-plugin.name: JavaFX Tools
idea-plugin.description:
All-in-one JavaFX development toolkit for IntelliJ IDEA (Community & Ultimate).

  • CSS Intelligence — 210+ -fx-* property completion, type-aware value suggestions, -fx-icon-code literal completion with dependency detection, cross-file variable resolution, Quick Documentation (F1). Auto-detects ControlsFX, GemsFX, JFoenix, Ikonli from classpath.
  • Gutter Previews & Click-to-Edit — color, gradient, SVG path, effect, and Ikonli icon previews in CSS / Java / FXML. Click to open PaintPicker, Effect Editor, or SVG preview with real-time write-back.
  • Icon Browser — 100+ icon packs, 63,000+ icons. Search, filter, preview, and one-click copy (SVG path / Java / CSS / Maven / Gradle). FXML iconLiteral completion and preview.
  • SVG Path Extractor — ToolWindow panel for extracting, merging, and normalizing SVG path data. Converts shapes to paths, configurable precision and target size. Right-click .svg files to copy path data or open in the extractor.
  • FXML Assistance — 13 inspections with quick fixes (missing files, type mismatch, unused fields/methods), fx:id and event handler generation, resource path navigation, i18n %key completion.
  • JavaFX Property Workflow — generate JavaFX property fields for 10 common types with ReadOnly, Lazy, and CSS Styleable (CssMetaData boilerplate) options. Create missing getter, setter, and xxxProperty() accessors from existing JavaFX property fields via Alt+Enter or Generate menu multi-select.
  • Font Actions — Right-click .ttf/.otf to copy font family name or @font-face CSS. Smart paste resolves relative paths automatically.

Sponsors

DLSC · JFXCentral
idea-plugin.change-notes:
2.2.5

Fixes

  • Cleared several IntelliJ Platform compatibility warnings from JetBrains plugin verification: replaced an internal API used for CSS language detection, migrated the FxmlKit dev-mode version warning dialog off two scheduled-for-removal dialog APIs, and reduced deprecated API usage. No change to existing behavior.

2.2.4

Fixes

  • Replaced an internal IntelliJ Platform API call with its public equivalent to clear a compatibility issue reported by JetBrains plugin verification. No change to existing behavior.

2.2.3

Improvements

  • ReadOnly property generation now matches the JavaFX style with a private setter and lazy propertyImpl() helper.
  • Styleable ObjectProperty<T> auto-picks a matching StyleConverter when one exists.

2.2.2

Fixes

  • fxp*** live template: with Lazy initialization unchecked, the generated property now uses eager initialization (private final XxxProperty name = new SimpleXxxProperty(this, "name")) with direct getter/setter/property accessor — previously emitted the lazy form regardless of the option.
  • JavaFX Property Accessor placement: Alt+Enter accessor generation no longer inserts methods between unrelated field declarations.

Improvements

  • Alt+Enter Create JavaFX accessors intention now follows Code Style → Java → Arrangement rules, matching IDEA's built-in Create getter and setter behavior. Configure Arrangement to place accessors next to their fields if you prefer the JavaFX Control source style.
  • JavaFX Property Accessors... batch action is now caret-based — place the cursor where you want the accessor block before triggering, matching IDEA's built-in Generate menu convention.

2.2.1

Fixes

  • HiDPI / display scaling: Generate JavaFX Property dialog no longer truncates input fields or the CSS Styleable (CssMetaData + StyleableProperty) label on lower-resolution or HiDPI displays. Dialog, borders, and segmented controls now scale consistently with the IDE.
  • The code preview font inside the property dialog now follows the IDE editor font instead of a fixed monospace size.
  • Minor scaling fixes in the gradient picker track padding and the SVG Path Tool drop zones.

2.2.0

New Features

  • JavaFX property accessor generation — create missing getter, setter, and xxxProperty() methods from existing JavaFX property fields.
  • Alt+Enter intention — use Create JavaFX accessors for 'propertyName' directly on a JavaFX property field.
  • Generate menu batch action — new JavaFX Property Accessors... action supports selecting multiple JavaFX property fields and generating their missing accessors at once.
  • Read-only property support — supports ReadOnlyXxxWrapper and bare ReadOnlyXxxProperty fields, generating read-only getter/property accessors without exposing setters.

Improvements

  • Accessor generation reuses one analyzer/generator path for both Alt+Enter and Generate menu actions, keeping behavior consistent.
  • Batch generation now preserves stable insertion placement and avoids interfering with constructor/member layout.
  • JavaFX Generate menu actions are grouped together with a visual separator from IDEA built-in generation actions.

2.1.1

Compatibility

  • Lowered minimum IDE version from IntelliJ IDEA 2024.2 to 2023.3. All editions (Community and Ultimate) from 2023.3 onwards are now supported.

2.1.0

New Features

  • FxmlKit Dev Mode Executor — two new toolbar buttons ("FxmlKit Dev Mode" and "FxmlKit Dev Mode Debug") visible in FxmlKit projects. One-click hot-reload launch by auto-injecting -Dfxmlkit.devmode=true. Requires FxmlKit 1.5.1+ (older versions show an upgrade dialog).
  • Add FxmlKit Dependency dialog — after creating a FxmlKit view, offers to auto-add com.dlsc.fxmlkit:fxmlkit to your Maven/Gradle build and module-info.java. Detects existing JavaFX configuration to avoid duplicates.
  • Icon Pack Aggregation — 58 aggregated icon packs, 64,800+ icons (FontAwesome 6 added). Related Ikonli distributions merged into single pack views for easier browsing; FA5/FA6 literal disambiguation in completion and gutter.
  • Tool Window Links — quick-access dropdown for JavaFX API docs, FXML/CSS references, OpenJFX, Gluon, JFXCentral.

Improvements

  • Multi-module FxmlKit detection (isFxmlKitModule)
  • Unified CSS library manifest (libraries.txt) with per-library property loading
  • SVG Path Tool redesigned with drag-and-drop zones

Fixes

  • IDE 2025.x compatibility: replaced deprecated Project.getBaseDir() with ProjectUtil.guessProjectDir()

2.0.0 — Complete Rewrite

This is a ground-up rewrite of JavaFX Tools. New build system (Gradle 8 + Kotlin DSL), new package structure, zero JavaFX runtime dependency.

New Features

  • CSS intelligence — 210+ property completion, type-aware value suggestions, cross-file variable resolution, Quick Documentation (F1)
  • Third-party CSS — ControlsFX, GemsFX, JFoenix properties auto-detected from classpath
  • Gutter previews — color, gradient, SVG path, effect, Ikonli icon previews in CSS, Java, and FXML
  • Click-to-edit — embedded PaintPicker (color & gradient), Effect Editor (dropshadow/innershadow), SVG preview with size controls
  • Multi-value paint — -fx-background-color and -fx-border-color show per-segment icons
  • Inline CSS support — full preview, editing, completion, and variable navigation in setStyle() and FXML style=""
  • Icon Browser ToolWindow — 114 Ikonli packs, 63,000+ icons with search, filter, and copy
  • Ikonli code assistance — -fx-icon-code / iconLiteral completion, Java enum gutter icons
  • 14 code inspections — missing files, type mismatch, unused fields/methods, i18n keys, unused CSS selectors, with quick fixes
  • FxmlKit wizard — New → FxmlKit View with i18n resource bundle support
  • Property generation — 10 types, ReadOnly, Lazy, CSS Styleable with CssMetaData boilerplate
  • Font actions — Copy Font Family Name, Copy @font-face CSS, smart paste with relative path resolution
  • SVG actions — Right-click .svg files: Copy SVG Path Data, Open in SVG Path Extractor
  • CSS transition properties — transition, transition-property, transition-duration, etc.

Compatibility

  • IntelliJ IDEA 2023.3+ (Community and Ultimate)
  • Java 17+
  • No JavaFX SDK required — plugin uses Swing/IntelliJ Platform UI

idea-plugin.description:
Source Code | Report Issues

A Jetbrains IDE code remark plug-in, it can be applied to read-only source code files.

  1. Open the source code file with IDEA.
  2. Wherever you need it, choose one of the following three ways to trigger the Popup pop-up layer and add content
    1. Alt + ENTER -> [MARK] Add/Edit remark[RECOMMEND]
    2. EditorPopupMenu / Tools -> Add remark
  3. In the editor, use the right-click menu Remark Navigation to preview all the remarks added in the current file.
  4. View all the remarks of the current project in the View -> Tool Windows -> Bookmarks -> Remarks view.

一款Jetbrains系IDE代码备注插件，不同于代码注释，它可被应用于只读的源码文件，让你在阅读源码时如虎添翼。

    2. EditorPopupMenu / Tools -> Add remark

idea-plugin.name: Yapi QuickType
idea-plugin.description:
YApi QuickType Plugin Introduction

1. Description of the plugin

In daily development, we will use the tool YApi. YApi is a local deployable, front-end and back-end and QA, visual interface management platform, which can perform some operations of interface definition and interface simulation.

For more YApi usage tutorials, you can refer to the YApi official website, and I won't go into too much detail here.

This plug-in is a coding tool plug-in based on the YApi open source interface. It is mainly used for the rapid generation of the interface definition entity code. As long as a simple configuration is performed in the plug-in settings options, you can quickly generate a variety of items you want with one click. The language interface defines entity codes.

Currently supported languages ​​are: Kotlin, Java, TypeScript, Dart, Swift, Objective-C, Go, C++, C#, Rust, Python, PHP

2. Plug-in configuration and use

Plugin configuration

Open the IDE settings page--YApi code generation plug-in, and set the plug-in. The plug-in is set to the following steps:

  • Fill in the self-built address for the YApi root path
  • Configure the Id and Token of the project you need

    These can be found in the YApi project configuration, find and copy and fill in, and the project name can be filled in at will.

  • Restart the IDE for the configuration to take effect

Plugin usage

After the plug-in configuration is correct, the use of the plug-in is also very simple, just right-click on the directory where you want to generate code to call up the plug-in

  • Click the right-click menu to create a new directory -- YApi code generation plugin
  • Select the corresponding interface of the project you configured and the language you want to generate
  • Enter the generated entity name and click OK to generate the code
  • Click the right-click menu to create a new directory - Json to entity plugin
  • Paste the copied JSON string
  • Enter the generated entity name, select the language you want to generate, and click OK to generate the code

QuickType service source code：

https://github.com/RmondJone/QuickTypeNode

YApi QuickType插件介绍

一、插件描述

日常开发中，我们会用到YApi这个工具，YApi 是一个可本地部署的、打通前后端及QA的、可视化的接口管理平台，可以进行接口定义以及接口模拟的一些操作。

有关更多的YApi使用教程，可以参考 YApi官网，这里就不再过多的赘述。

本插件是一个基于YApi开源接口之上的一个编码工具插件，主要用于接口定义实体代码的快速生成，只要在插件设置选项中进行简单的配置，即可一键快速生成多种你想要的语言接口定义实体代码。

目前支持生成的语言有：Kotlin、Java、TypeScript、Dart、Swift、Objective-C、Go、C++

二、插件配置以及使用

插件配置

打开IDE设置页面--YApi代码生成插件，进行插件的设置，插件设置为以下几个步骤：

  • YApi根路径填入自建的地址
  • 配置你需要的项目的Id、Token

    这些都可以在YApi项目配置里找到，找到复制填入即可，项目名称可以随意填写。

  • 重启IDE使配置生效

插件使用

插件配置无误后，插件的使用也非常简单，只需在想要生成代码的目录上右键即可调起插件

  • 点击右键菜单目录新建-YApi代码生成插件
  • 选择你配置的项目的对应接口和想要生成的语言
  • 输入生成的实体名称点击OK生成代码
  • 点击右键菜单目录新建-Json转实体插件
  • 粘贴复制的JSON字符串
  • 输入生成的实体名称、选择想要生成的语言点击OK生成代码

QuickType服务源码：

https://github.com/RmondJone/QuickTypeNode

idea-plugin.name: Bean Combiner
idea-plugin.description:
• This plugin can combine other bean fields to this bean easily. This plugin is wrote for java bean, but also you can use it in all class types, so it is recommended to use with lombok.
  • 这个插件可以通过tool window，方便的从其他 java bean 选取字段合并到当前类。这个插件虽然是针对java bean而编写，但没有任何限制，只要是java类都可以使用，所以推荐与lombok配合使用。


Install

  1. Install a IntelliJ IDEA
  2. Launch the IDE and open plugin settings
  3. Search for "BeanCombiner" and click install

Usage

  1. Open an editor of a java class
  2. Open the BeanCombiner tool window, click Add button, pick a Class
  3. Check your prefered fields and click Commit button
  4. Enjoy the updated class

Scenarios

  1. When you have to combine some entity fields from db into a dto class, and return to the web app or transfer to another interface
  2. When you have to pick up some fields from a global configuration property, and easily keep the same type
  3. When you want to pick up some fields from a constructor parameter of class type

dbfound-helper a idea plugin for dbfound framework
dbfound-Helper is a plug-in that enhances IDEA support for DbFound framework,here is the main functions:
  • Support from Java, XML, JSP file to jump model file
  • Support model file to Java, XML and JSP file references
  • Support SQL language injection to model file
  • Support Generate the Model File、 entity file、jsp file and Model template

dbfound-helper是一款增强idea对dbfound框架支持的插件，主要功能如下：
  • 支持从java、xml、js和jsp文件跳转至model文件
  • 支持model文件跳转至java、xml、js和jsp文件引用
  • 支持对model文件插入SQL语法检测
  • 支持生成model file、entity file、jsp file与model模板

idea-plugin.name: BeanUtils.copyProperties
idea-plugin.description:
Generate the code of target object's setter method(s) according to source object.

How to use?

  1. Put the caret in the variable name of target object.
  2. Press Alt+Ins/CMD+N and select the menu "Copy Properties".
  3. Choose the fields that you want to copy.
  4. Enter the variable name of source object and click OK.

idea-plugin.name: Kotlinter
idea-plugin.description:
Google has recently introduced a brand-new Kotlin DSL for Protocol Buffers. But if you are migrating your legacy Java code with old style, you will likely choose to keep the old Java-style protos since it's a pain to migrate them all at once. That's where this plugin will come in handy.

It will automatically detect and suggest fixes which can be applied to multiple non-nesting protos at once. However, it won't help you with the imports yet, meaning that you will still need to make sure that the generated Kotlin dependencies are available. Right now, there is no way to support automatic importing. Of course, we will add more features in the future, so please keep yourself updated.

You can explore and customize features by searching for Kotlinter in Settings.

idea-plugin.name: ApifoxHelper
idea-plugin.description:
Apifox Helper

Apifox Helper is a plugin launched by Apifox for the IntelliJ IDEA. It can parse the source code of Java or Kotlin projects, automatically generate API documentations and sync them to Apifox projects.

帮助文档

Apifox Helper 是 Apifox 团队针对 IntelliJ IDEA 所推出的插件，可以在 IDE 中识别本地 Java、Kotlin 后端项目的源代码，直接在 IDE 侧边栏调试接口，自动生成 API 文档并同步到 Apifox 的项目中。

对于常见的开发框架，Apifox Helper 插件能够做到开箱即用，实现真正的代码零侵入。仅通过识别最基本的业务代码，即可生成一份详尽的 API 文档。

功能特性

  • 自动生成 API 文档并一键同步到 Apifox 的项目中
  • 直接在 IDE 侧边栏调试接口，自动填写请求参数和 URL
  • 导出 OpenAPI 文件

支持的框架和库

类型名称注解示例
服务端框架Spring, Quarkus, Jakarta RESTful Web Services (JAX-RS)@RestController, @GetMapping, @Path, @Get
校验库Jakarta Bean Validation, Java Bean Validation@NotNull
序列化库FASTJSON, Jackson, GSON@JSONField, @JsonProperty, @SerializedName
API 规格库Swagger 2.x, Swagger/OpenAPI 3.x@ApiOperation, @ApiParam, @Operation, @Parameter
持久化框架MyBatis
客户端库Spring Cloud OpenFeign
性能指标库Spring Boot Actuator
语言与注释Java: Javadoc, Kotlin: KDoc

本插件基于 easy-api 定制开发，感谢 easy-api 作者。

idea-plugin.name: EasyCode-Community
idea-plugin.description:
Generate Code From velocity template for Intellij community version

English:

  • The code generation plug-in based on IntelliJ IDEA is developed to support custom templates (Java, HTML, JS, XML).
  • As long as database related code can be generated through custom templates. Support database type and Java type mapping relationship configuration.
  • The code that supports generating multiple tables at the same time. Each table has a separate configuration information. Full personalization definition, the rules are set by you.
  • Support kotlin code generate
  • Support Generate by project easyCode folder template files

中文：

  • Intellij Idea社区版可以用的模板生成代码插件
  • 只要是与数据库相关的代码都可以通过自定义模板来生成。支持数据库类型与java类型映射关系配置。
  • 支持同时生成生成多张表的代码。每张表有独立的配置信息。完全的个性化定义，规则由你设置。
  • 插件fork于easy code插件，该版本用于兼容MybatisCodeHelper插件，方便MybatisCodeHelper插件做代码生成补全检测等
  • 支持从项目的easyCode目录里面的模版文件来生成代码 表上右键GenerateFromEasyCodeFolderFile即可
  • 社区版交流qq群:516959916

idea-plugin.name: AI Coding Assistant
idea-plugin.description:
🌟 Empowering Developers with Open Source AI Tools

AI Coding Assistant is an open source IntelliJ plugin designed by developers, for developers. Unlike closed-source automated coding agents, our mission is to empower you with transparent, customizable, and extensible generative and agentic tools. Seamlessly integrated into your IDE, AI Coding Assistant enhances your workflow, boosts productivity, and unlocks your creativity.

🚀 Why Choose AI Coding Assistant?

idea-plugin.name: SQLChange
idea-plugin.description:
• SQL Change Tool,will change SQL to DTO.
and to judge the attributes of the fields in the entity class simply according to the names of the fields in SQL,
and add the common annotations,
which is convenient for the following development work.
It's also very easy to use.

Add the SQL you want to convert in the left-most field,
(note that the SQL must be a working SQL that does not contain an IF function, so use case when instead.)
Enter a Chinese comment in the middle input box and use a carriage return to split it,
if (note 1 Note 2 Note 3) click on the immediate conversion button below,
you can view the preview results in the right box,
click on the confirmation button, you can directly generate the preview results to the entity class,
if you encounter a build failure,
you can simply copy the results in the preview box to the entity class.

This plug-in is mainly used to convert fields in SQL into fields in DTO, one by one, to reduce the duplication of effort

  • 用来将sql快捷转换成实体类.
并根据sql中字段的命名,来简易判断实体类中字段的属性
并添加了常用的注解,方便后续开发工作.

使用方式也非常简便,
在最左边的输入框中添加你需要转换的sql,
(注意,该sql必须是可以正常运行的sql,并且不包含IF函数,
如有请使用case when 代替)

在中间的输入框中输入中文备注,并使用回车进行分割,如
(注释1
注释2
注释3)

点击下方立即转换按钮,
即可在右边的框中查看预览结果,

点击确认按钮,可以将预览中的结果直接生成至实体类,

该插件主要用于将sql中的字段逐一转换成DTO中的字段,减少重复工作量

idea-plugin.name: Rabbit SQL
idea-plugin.description:
Rabbit SQL Framework Support

Provides support for rabbit-sql to JetBrains IDEA.

Easily to use rabbit-sql and XQL file.

Features

  • The identification of xql(.xql) file type.
  • Dynamic sql expression script live templates(e.g: xql:if).
  • Intention action Execute Dynamic SQL and Copy SQL definition by SQL name(e.g: &my.users).
  • Quick look SQL definition by SQL name(e.g: &my.users).
  • Generate mapper interface by registered xql file.
  • Java and xql file references to navigate each other.
  • SQL name suggestions auto complete in java string literal where start with "&".
  • Toolwindow:
    • Structured xql tree view.
    • Manage multiple xql-file-manager.yml.
    • Some more useful actions.
  • Toolbar menu:
    • File > New > Xql File | Xql File Manager
    • Tools > XQL File Manager

Getting Started

Springboot

  1. Create a new maven project;
  2. Add dependency rabbit-sql-spring-boot-starter 5.3.23 (recommended) to your project;
  3. Create xql-file-manager.yml in resources root: .../src/main/resources/;
    ( Toolwindow > XQL File Manager > Module(Mouse Right click) > New )
  4. Register xql files on property: files;

Other Java Projects

  1. Create a new maven project.
  2. Add dependency rabbit-sql 10.3.22 (recommended) to your project;
  3. Create xql-file-manager.yml in resources root: .../src/main/resources/;
    ( Toolwindow > XQL File Manager > Module(Mouse Right click) > New )
  4. Register xql files on property: files;
  5. Configure XQLFileManager;
  6. Configure BakiDao#setXqlFileManager;

Other IDEs

  1. Create root dirs src/main/resources ;
  2. Create xql-file-manager.yml in resources root: .../src/main/resources/;
    ( Toolwindow > XQL File Manager > Module(Mouse Right click) > New )
  3. Register xql files on property: files;

Get Best Practice document or a Demo to quick start.

Get more information from Rabbit-sql homepage and Springboot support document.

idea-plugin.name: Tabnine for Enterprise
idea-plugin.description:
Once you install Tabnine Enterprise, restart the IDE.


Once you restart the IDE and the plugin is initialized, you’ll be prompted to set the URL of your Tabnine Enterprise Server.


If for some reason you are not prompted, you can set the server URL by clicking on Settings (⚙), then select Settings in the dropdown menu.


Search for “Tabnine,” then navigate to Tools on the left-side menu. Select Tabnine.


In the settings, under Engine, type/paste your Tabnine Enterprise URL in the adjacent bar. Then press OK.


In order to sign in to your Tabnine account, navigate to the bottom menu and press the prompt that reads “Tabnine Enterprise: Sign in using your Tabnine account.”:


A menu will appear. On it, select Sign in to Tabnine.


Once you have successfully signed in, you will see a message confirming “You are now authenticated with Tabnine plugin!”
idea-plugin.change-notes: Tabnine is always evolving. Most updates are in the binary sidecar.

idea-plugin.name: JumpToController
idea-plugin.description:
Development Auxiliary Tool
JumpToController is a powerful IntelliJ IDEA plugin designed to assist developers in effortlessly exploring and navigating controller interfaces within Spring projects. The plugin automatically scans all controller classes in your Spring project and extracts their path information. Through an intuitive interface, you can quickly view and search for all controller interface paths in your project without the need for manual code browsing. Additionally, it supports searching by path and annotations, allowing you to efficiently locate the desired interfaces. Furthermore, Spring Controller Explorer seamlessly integrates with Feign invocations. When clicking on the provided icon in a Feign interface, it intelligently jumps to the corresponding controller code, facilitating a better understanding and debugging of the entire request flow. With its user-friendly interface, efficient path scanning, and comprehensive search capabilities, Spring Controller Explorer is an invaluable tool for developers seeking to streamline their exploration and management of controller interfaces in Spring projects. Whether you need to quickly find paths, search for annotations, or navigate to the corresponding code, this plugin enhances your development workflow with convenience and efficiency.

idea-plugin.name: Concept Cloud
idea-plugin.description:
Generate a multiple modules project based on Gradle that supports both Spring Cloud and Spring Boot.

Usage: File -> New -> Project -> Concept Cloud

Generate Domain Code: Select package under "domain" module -> Right click -> Concept Cloud -> Generate Domain Code...

Generate Module Code: Select package under "module" module -> Right click -> Concept Cloud -> Generate Module Code...

If u have 3 modules: A, B, C
1. A(as a service) + B(as a service) + C(as a service) = Microservices
2. AB(compose as a service) + C(as a service) = Microservices
3. AC(compose as a service) + B(as a service) = Microservices
4. BC(compose as a service) + A(as a service) = Microservices
5. ABC(compose as a service) = Single service

idea-plugin.name: iFlyCode
idea-plugin.description:
iFlyCode

iFlyCode is an intelligent programming assistant based on the Spark large model, designed to provide developers with efficient, accurate, and intelligent programming assistance.

iFlyCode是一款基于星火大模型的智能编程助手，旨在为开发者提供高效、准确和智能的编程帮助。

Environmental Requirements 环境要求

JetBrains IDE or Android Studio requires version 20.3 or above.

JetBrains IDE或Android Studio要求版本20.3及以上。

Language Support 语言支持

It supports multiple mainstream programming languages including Java, Python, JavaScript, C++, etc.

已支持Java、Python、JavaScript、C++等多种主流编程语言。

Shortcut Keys 快捷键说明

  • Tab key: Accept recommended code

    Tab键：接受推荐代码

  • Esc key: Cancel recommended code

    Esc键：取消推荐代码

  • Alt+\ or Alt+C: Actively trigger code suggestions

    Alt+\或Alt+C：主动触发代码提示

  • ↑ or ↓ keys: Search for historical questions within the dialogue input box

    ↑或↓键：对话输入框内可以查找历史提问

  • Shift+Enter key (configurable): Enter a new line in the dialogue input box

    Shift+Enter键（可配置）：对话输入框内输入换行

Support Capabilities 支持能力

  • 1.Code Generation/Completion 代码生成/补齐

    In the editor, generate code based on comments or function names.

    For example, after writing comments,press Enter to trigger code suggestions,use the Tab key to accept suggestions, and Esc to reject them.

    在编辑器内根据注释、函数名生成代码，以注释生成代码为例，编写完成注释后，回车触发代码建议，

    使用Tab键采纳建议、Esc拒绝建议。

    • Single-line mode: The single-line model only generates one line of code suggestions,with better recommendation effects and response speed.

      单行模式：单行模型仅生成一行代码建议，推荐效果和响应速度更好

    • Intelligent mode: Support real-time analysis of code context, intelligently generating single or multiple lines of code.

      智能模式：支持实时分析代码的上下文，智能生成单行或多行代码

  • 2.Function Comments 函数注释

    Generate documentation comments for selected code functions, and by clicking to accept,directly place the comments on the function.

    为选中代码方法生成函数注释，点击采纳可直接将注释置入函数上。

  • 3.Inline Comments 行间注释

    Provide explanations for single lines of code, to clarify the purpose or special circumstances of that line of code,suitable for brief explanations.

    针对单行代码进行解释说明，用于解释该行代码的作用或特殊情况，适用于短小的解释。

  • 4.Function splitting 函数拆分

    Function splitting is primarily used to break down a larger function into multiple smaller, more manageable,and comprehensible short functions. This feature helps to enhance the readability, maintainability, and testability of the code.The feature will be provided when the function is greater than or equal to 20 lines and less than 12,000 characters.

    用于将一个较大的函数分解成多个更小、更易于管理和理解的短函数。这个功能有助于提高代码的可读性、可维护性和可测试性。

    当函数大于等于20行，且少于12000个字符时将提供该功能。

  • 5.Code Explanation 代码解释

    Support generating code explanations for selected code, describing the function and purpose of the code.

    支持为选中的代码生成代码解释，描述代码的功能、用途。

  • 6.Code optimization 代码优化

    By conducting an in-depth analysis of the code and its context throughout the entire document,accurately identify spelling, grammatical, and logical errors in the code, and provide optimization suggestions.

    通过深度分析全文件中的代码及其上下文，准确识别代码中的拼写、语法和逻辑错误，并提供优化建议。

  • 7.Unit Testing 单元测试

    Automatically create corresponding unit test codes for code methods and classes, supporting test framework selection.

    为代码方法及代码类自动创建相应的单元测试代码，支持测试框架选择。

  • 8.Code Search 代码搜索

    Support users to import their own internal code repository.

    Search related code based on natural language or code semantics, making it easier for developers to find and reuse code assets within the enterprise.

    支持用户自行导入企业内部的代码仓库。

    根据自然语言或代码的语义搜索相关代码，使研发人员能够更轻松地查找和复用企业内部的代码资产。

  • 9.Code Review 代码评审

    Support users importing their own corporate code repositories.

    Commit Message is automatically generated for files selected for modification.

    在已暂存的文件列表中右键，点击代码预评审按钮，对待提交的代码进行评审。

    选中修改的文件自动生成提交信息Commit Message。

  • 10.SQL Generation/Optimization SQL生成/优化

    By configuring the SQL address, directly link to the specified database,

    generate corresponding SQL through natural language or optimize the input SQL.

    通过配置SQL地址，直接链接到指定的数据库，通过自然语言生成对应的SQL或对输入的SQL进行优化。

前往官网获取更多信息：

https://iflycode.xfyun.cn/

关注微信公众号获取更多福利活动：

idea-plugin.name: hot-edit
idea-plugin.description:
This plugin can help you change the server-side Java code without repackaging and restarting the Java service.
In certain scenarios, this plugin can help you save a lot of unnecessary time.
  • Quickly adding logs to locate issues
  • Modifying certain code to achieved certain goals
  • ...

use instruction:
  • Define configuration of the target server's IP and Java process PID in Preferences -> Other Settings -> hot-edit, port is 10916(default)
  • When you want to synchronize a modified Java file in real-time to the server,
    you can right-click in the corresponding file's edit box and click the 'Reconfile xxxx. java' option.
    When you see the 'hot edit success' notification in the bottom right corner, it means that the code has been successfully synchronized to the server in real-time.
tips:
You need to start up hot-edit-web server on your target ip machine and copy the hot-edit-agent to /tmp/zxs directory. To achieve this, you can execute this command on the machine.(sh https://gitee.com/zhangxusheng0916/my-downloads/raw/master/src/start.sh && start.sh) see more:https://gitee.com/zhangxusheng0916/my-downloads/wikis.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• support inner class
  • Config IP and PID configuration items of hot edit using ; Separate to achieve simultaneous configuration of multiple IPs and PID.
  • Dealing with compatibility issues with higher versions.
  • 1.6
    Add a wiki with usage guidelines to the description.

idea-plugin.name: JavaCopyProperties
idea-plugin.description:
In the Generate menu, there is a CopyProperties function item that provides the ability to copy generated properties
The mouse needs to select the generated method name
Using static factory methods will generate a copy attribute object with parameters
Using object conversion methods will generate a copy attribute with this
The following is a code example:
            public class UserVo {
                private String name;
                private String sex;

                public static UserVo newInstance(User user) {
                if (user == null) {
                return null;
                }
                UserVo ret = new UserVo();
                ret.setName(user.getName());
                ret.setSex(user.getSex());
                return ret;
                }

                public User converToUser() {
                User ret = new User();
                ret.setName(this.getName());
                ret.setSex(this.getSex());
                return ret;
                }
            }

idea-plugin.name: dhcoder
idea-plugin.description:
DHcoder

[DHcoder] enables developers to create, share, and use custom AI code assistants with our open-source JetBrains extension

Chat

Chat makes it easy to ask for help from an LLM without needing to leave the IDE.

You send it a task, including any relevant information, and it replies with the text / code most likely to complete the task. If it does not give you what you want, then you can send follow up messages to clarify and adjust its approach until the task is completed.

Autocomplete

Autocomplete provides inline code suggestions as you type.

To enable it, simply click the "DHcoder" button in the status bar at the bottom right of your IDE or ensure the "Enable Tab Autocomplete" option is checked in your IDE settings.

Edit

Edit is a convenient way to modify code without leaving your current file.

Highlight a block of code, describe your code changes, and a diff will be streamed inline to your file which you can accept or reject.

Agent

Agent enables you to make more substantial changes to your codebase

Agent equips the Chat model with the tools needed to handle a wide range of coding tasks, allowing the model to make decisions and save you the work of manually finding context and performing actions.

License

Apache 2.0 © 2026 DHcoder Dev, Inc.

idea-plugin.name: Baidu Comate (Gitee版)
idea-plugin.description:
Baidu Comate (Gitee版)
Coding Mate Powered by AI
This AI-based intelligent code generation tool makes your coding faster, better, and simpler!
Comate is powered by the ERNIE-Code, a model which has been trained on non-sensitive code data accumulated by Baidu over many years and top-tier public code data from Github. It automatically generates complete and more scenario-specific lines of code or blocks of code, helping every developer accomplish development tasks with ease.

Quick start


Before you can start using Comate, you need to set up a free trial or subscription for your personal account and obtain your personal license number from the official website or Baidu AI Cloud platform After you sign up, you'll need to install an extension for your preferred environment. Then you will need to fill up your license number and user's name in settings （*The license applied through the official website will be automatically generated and filled in, and you need to manually enter the license when purchasing on Baidu AI Cloud）

Product features


  • Single-line code suggestions

    • Just pause briefly while coding, and Comate will write the rest of the line for you based on your code context.
  • Multi-line code suggestions

    • When you have a clear and complete logic (such as a new method, function, condition, loop, etc.), a full code block will be suggested automatically.
  • Switch between Multiple Suggestions Easily

    • You can view more suggestions by using shortcuts or opening multiple panels. Then, pick and use the one you prefer.
  • Generate Code from Natural Language

    • Just type what you want to code and Comate will provide suggestions for you.
  • Generate function comments

    • It can analyze a function and write doc comments in a standard format.
  • Write line comments

    • It can generate line comments on the complex logic of a function.
  • Write unit tests

    • It can generate an appropriate unit test code for the function you entered.

Key Shortcuts

  • Accept code Suggestion: Tab
  • Next Suggestion: alt/option+]
  • Previous Suggestion: alt/option+[
  • Close Current Suggestion: Esc
  • To see all previous suggestions: hover over the suggested content and click the Comate toolbar, previous suggestions will be listed in the sidebar.

Supported Languages


Compatible with various popular languages, including C, C++, Python, Java, Go, PHP, JavaScript, and more.

idea-plugin.name: QuickRun
idea-plugin.description:
In the development process, being able to run code or methods directly without needing to write a code entry point can greatly improve work efficiency. Now, with the QuickRun plugin, you can easily achieve this goal!

在开发过程中，如果不需要写代码入口情况下直接运行代码或方法，可以大大提高工作效率。现在，有了 QuickRun 插件，您可以轻松实现这一目标！

使用方式：

1. 运行项目

2. 代码一键运行：右键任何地方，选择“Run Code”

3. 方法一键运行：右键java方法，选择“Run Method”

功能适用的区域：

1. 项目内的java文件

2. 项目依赖的源码

idea-plugin.name: File Description
idea-plugin.description:
This is a plugin that adds header comments to files and automatically updates the last editor and editing time

Currently supports java, kt, css, scss, less, ts, tsx, js, jsx, html, vue, dart, php, env, yml, python, go, C language files to automatically add and update file header comment information

The header annotation configuration of the VsCode plug-in koroFileHeader is supported

Support for randomly generating interesting comments

这是一个自动给文件添加头部注释的插件，并自动更新最后编辑时间和编辑时间

目前支持java, kt, css, scss, less, ts, tsx, js, jsx, html, vue, dart, php, env, yml, python, go, C语言文件自动添加和更新文件头部注释信息

支持VsCode插件koroFileHeader的头部注释配置

{
    // Author字段是文件的创建者 可以在specialOptions中更改特殊属性
    // 公司项目和个人项目可以配置不同的用户名与邮箱 搜索: gitconfig includeIf  比如: https://ayase.moe/2021/03/09/customized-git-config/
    // 自动提取当前git config中的: 用户名、邮箱
    "Author": "git config user.name && git config user.email", // 同时获取用户名与邮箱
    // "Author": "git config user.name", // 仅获取用户名
    // "Author": "git config user.email", // 仅获取邮箱
    // "Author": "OBKoro1", // 写死的固定值 不从git config中获取
    "Date": "Do not edit", // 文件创建时间(不变)
    // LastEditors、LastEditTime、FilePath将会自动更新 如果觉得时间更新的太频繁可以使用throttleTime(默认为1分钟)配置更改更新时间。
    "LastEditors": "git config user.name && git config user.email", // 文件最后编辑者 与Author字段一致
    // 由于编辑文件就会变更最后编辑时间，多人协作中合并的时候会导致merge
    // 可以将时间颗粒度改为周、或者月，这样冲突就减少很多。搜索变更时间格式: dateFormat
    "LastEditTime": "Do not edit", // 文件最后编辑时间
    // 输出相对路径，类似: /文件夹名称/src/index.js
    "FilePath": "Do not edit", // 文件在项目中的相对路径 自动更新
    // 插件会自动将光标移动到Description选项中 方便输入 Description字段可以在specialOptions更改
    "Description": "", // 介绍文件的作用、文件的入参、出参。
    // custom_string_obkoro1~custom_string_obkoro100都可以输出自定义信息
    // 可以设置多条自定义信息 设置个性签名、留下QQ、微信联系方式、输入空行等
    "custom_string_obkoro1": "", 
    // 版权声明 保留文件所有权利 自动替换年份 获取git配置的用户名和邮箱
    // 版权声明获取git配置, 与Author字段一致: ${git_name} ${git_email} ${git_name_email}
    "custom_string_obkoro1_copyright": "Copyright (c) ${now_year} by ${git_name_email}, All Rights Reserved. "
    // "custom_string_obkoro1_copyright": "Copyright (c) ${now_year} by 写死的公司名/用户名, All Rights Reserved. "
}

idea-plugin.name: XCodeMap
idea-plugin.description:
XCodeMap records real Java runtime behavior for AI analysis and human replay.
让 AI 看见程序如何运行，让人类随时回放
XCodeMap 自动采集 Java 程序一次真实执行的调用、参数、堆栈与数据流。AI 获得事实上下文，人类获得可视化证据。
Local-first · Java · IntelliJ IDEA

B 站视频教程：https://space.bilibili.com/3546573562710135

XCodeMap 官网：https://xcodemap.tech

记录事实，而不是推断
XCodeMap 将一次真实运行重建为时间线、调用树、鱼骨图与数据流，并映射回实际执行过的源码行号。

适用场景
1. 第一次接手一个陌生项目: 不需要先读完整套代码，直接看一次真实执行，理解核心流程。
2. Bug 行为无法稳定复现：开启XCodeMap，一旦复现，即被完整录制，之后可以慢慢回放查看。
3. 复杂大循环/递归/状态机：这些结构在代码中很难理解，但在执行图中一目了然。
4. "逻辑看起来没问题，但结果不对"：代码逻辑和实际执行，往往有差距，回放一次，真相大白。
5. AI 编程助手缺少运行时上下文：把真实执行提供给 AI，让结论从推测变成基于证据的判断。

看见代码真实的轨迹
1. 鱼骨图：可视化从请求到结果的完整执行路径
2. 代码行号映射：执行过的行被高亮，未执行的自动沉默

还原参数与堆栈
1. 参数值还原：每一次方法调用，都记录当时真实的出入参值
2. 堆栈关联：每一次方法调用，都记录当时真实的调用栈

数据标记与搜索
1. 数据标记：给对象、参数或返回值打上标记
2. 跨路径搜索：一键定位数据出现、修改的位置

供 AI 直接消费
1. xcodemap-observe Skill：让 Cursor、Claude Code 等 AI 编程助手基于运行时数据回答问题
2. Runtime HTTP API：向 AI 提供结构化的调用、参数、堆栈与数据流事实上下文
3. Local-first：执行数据默认保存在本机，不上传、不出机器

XCodeMap 表面在帮你 Debug，实质在帮助你理解代码的执行过程。
当你真正看见代码的行为，一切都会简单下来，不再需要猜测，不再需要拼凑，直接看到真相。

遇到问题，B 站私信 XCodeMap 总工。

idea-plugin.name: zTools
idea-plugin.description:
A Java / Spring toolbox: API docs, JSON / cURL from source, Restful navigation, YApi upload, Jasypt encrypt/decrypt, database docs, inner Builder generation, and convert method body fill.

面向 Java / Spring 的开发工具：生成接口文档、类转 JSON、Restful 跳转、复制 cURL、上传 YApi、Jasypt 加解密、库表文档、内部 Builder、填充 Bean 转换方法体。

Minimum supported IDEA version: 2022.1.1 (Java plugin required)

Documentation:

  • GitHub README
  • Gitee README

Features:

  • API documentation — Generate Html / MarkDown / Word from Spring Controllers (OpenAPI / Swagger / validation / JavaDoc). 从 Controller 生成 Html、MarkDown、Word 接口文档。
  • Copy JSON — Class to commented example JSON (nesting, generics, inheritance, enums). 类转带注释的示例 JSON。
  • Copy cURL — Mapping method to a runnable curl (port and context-path from application.*). Mapping 方法复制为可执行 curl。
  • Go to Restful — Search Spring MVC / Feign APIs by path, shortcut Ctrl+\. 按路径搜索并跳转接口。
  • Upload YApi — Push one method or a whole Controller / Feign type to YApi. 上传接口到 YApi。
  • Jasypt Crypto — Encrypt / decrypt ENC(...) in the editor; decrypt a whole file. 编辑器内 Jasypt 加解密，支持整文件解密。
  • Database documentation — MySQL table docs (Html / MarkDown / Word) from zTools.yaml. 从 zTools.yaml 读数据源生成库表文档。
  • Inner Builder — Generate Builder (lite or generic, record, inheritance). 生成内部 Builder 类。
  • Fill convert body — Alt+Enter on a DTO/DO convert method to fill getters/setters or builder(). 在转换方法上 Alt+Enter 填充 getter/setter 或 Builder 方法体。

Configure under Settings → z-tools (project-level, stored in .idea/zTools.xml).
