idea-plugin.name: Hud
idea-plugin.description:
Hud streams real-time, function-level runtime data into your IDE - powering production-aware development for engineers and code-generating agents.

What Hud Does

Hud is the first Runtime Code Sensor designed to make AI-generated code production-safe by default. Installed in under a minute, it captures structured, real-time, function-level runtime data from your live systems and streams it directly into your IDE.

Once deployed, Hud overlays each function in your codebase with live production context. You can map execution patterns, capture behavioral changes, and pinpoint performance regressions - all without dashboards, manual instrumentation, or context switching.

Hud's extension allows you to:

  • See execution behavior in context as you write or review code
  • Investigate post-deploy changes and performance regressions
  • Receive Heads-Up alerts tied to the exact function responsible

[Coming soon for JetBrains] Through Hud's MCP server, supported code-generating agents like Cursor, Copilot, and Windsurf gain visibility into how your code actually behaves in production-enabling them to generate safer, system-aligned code.

Hud is read-only, requires no config, and adapts automatically as your application evolves.

See Hud Docs at docs.hud.io

Platform Compatibility

  • Languages Supported: Node.js, Python (Java and Kotlin coming soon)
  • Environments: Containers, VMs, Kubernetes, serverless
  • IDEs: Visual Studio Code, Cursor, JetBrains IDEs (IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, GoLand, WebStorm)

Who It's For

Hud is built for engineering teams integrating code-generating agents or shipping mission-critical services into production. It's especially valuable for:

  • Backend developers validating live service behavior
  • Teams scaling agentic workflows or AI-assisted development
  • Platform and infrastructure engineers
  • DevOps/SRE teams

Use Cases

Identify Failing Behavior in Production

Coding agents use Hud's MCP server to detect and investigate production failures, surfacing relevant functions, error sources, and execution patterns-without relying on manual logging or tracing.

→ Issues are surfaced with root cause attached

→ Responses include contextual details: behavior trends, exception types, and code flow impact

→ Coding agents successfully solve elaborate issues automatically using the context Hud provided

Fix Code Based on Runtime Evidence

When proposing a fix, the agent queries Hud to retrieve production behavior for affected functions: error propagation, caller relationships, and performance data. This context enables safer and more accurate modifications-grounded in real system behavior.

Validate Code Changes Before They Ship

Before applying changes, the agent queries Hud to assess implications against current runtime context-including execution flow, load impact, and behavioral sensitivity. This ensures that edits won't introduce regressions.

Drive End-to-End, Production-Aware Workflows

Hud allows agents to operate with continuous access to production context-through structured, queryable signals captured by the Runtime Code Sensor. Every step-issue detection, resolution, validation - is backed by live data, transforming speculative AI output into production-safe code.

Core Benefits & Value Proposition

  • Runtime Code Sensor: Streams real-time, function-level behavior into your IDE
  • Zero Overhead Setup: Install in under a minute - no config, no manual instrumentation
  • Hudders: See runtime performance and error signals above every function
  • Live Call Graphs: Visualize execution paths and find root causes fast
  • Heads-Up Alerts: Get notified about production-impacting changes without manual configuration
  • Hud's MCP Server: Enables production-aware code generation by agents
  • No source code access: Only anonymized metadata is transmitted

Quickstart

  1. Install the Hud IDE extension
  2. Add the SDK to your backend service:
    • npm install hud-sdk or pip install hud-sdk
  3. Initialize the SDK in your app's entry point
  4. Authenticate via Google SSO or your SAML provider

Once setup is complete:

  • You'll see Hudders above each function showing live execution signals
  • Click a Hudder to open a call graph and trace execution paths
  • Resolve issues using real-time production context-no logs, no guesswork

Security & Compliance

  • Read-only by design-Hud never accesses source code or payload data
  • Only anonymized metadata is streamed
  • Fully compliant with SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and GDPR
  • Supports SAML and SCIM for enterprise-grade access control

idea-plugin.name: Mianshiya
idea-plugin.description:
Plugin Introduction

This is a plug-in version of mianshiya system, which provides a more convenient and flexible way to practice questions.

面试鸭 是一个帮助程序员在 JetBrains 系列产品中刷面试题的插件。插件题目全面、题解优质、支持多种筛选条件，是一款摸鱼刷题必备神器。

特性

  • 题目丰富：拥有 20+ 题库分类，近 200 题库，1w+ 题目，涵盖了几乎所有主流编程方向的面试题。
  • 高质量题解：许多题解来自大厂面试官原创，抓住核心要点，通俗易懂，配有图片辅助理解。
  • 快捷键支持：支持自定义快捷键，轻松一键打开或收起插件。
  • 多条件筛选：可通过题库、标签、难度等条件筛选，快速找到自己想要的题目。
  • 讨论互动：题目详情页面分为题目、推荐答案、讨论区三个子 tab，方便交流讨论。
  • 多端同步：支持 IDEA 及 JetBrains 系列其他产品，如 WebStorm、PyCharm 等。同时支持小程序和 Web 端，数据三端同步。
  • 开源：插件完全开源，代码托管在 GitHub，欢迎贡献和 Star 支持。

安装与使用

  1. 打开 IntelliJ IDEA，进入 Settings > Plugins。
  2. 搜索 mianshiya，点击安装。

三端兼容

  • JetBrains 系列产品：支持 IDEA、WebStorm、PyCharm 等 2021.3 及以上版本。
  • 小程序端：随时随地刷题。
  • Web 端：面试鸭 Web 端

开源项目

插件代码完全开源，欢迎大家 Star 和贡献代码！

GitHub 地址：https://github.com/yuyuanweb/mianshiya-plugin

反馈与支持

如有问题或建议，欢迎通过 GitHub issue 提交反馈，或者直接联系我们。

idea-plugin.name: Swag Import Apifox
idea-plugin.description:
Swag Import Apifox - Go API Documentation Sync Tool

Automatically generate Swagger documentation from Go code comments and sync to Apifox with one click, improving API documentation management efficiency!

Key Features

  • 🎯 Auto Generation: Generate Swagger docs from Go code comments automatically
  • 📤 One-Click Upload: Sync generated docs directly to Apifox projects
  • 🔄 Smart Merge: Support multiple interface merge strategies to avoid duplicates
  • ⚙️ Flexible Configuration: Customize upload directories and merge rules
  • 📊 Real-time Feedback: Detailed operation logs and result statistics

Quick Start

1. Environment Setup

  • ✅ Go Environment: Go 1.16 or higher
  • ✅ GoLand/IntelliJ IDEA: 2023.1 or higher
  • ✅ Swag Tool: Auto-install or manual install go install github.com/swaggo/swag/cmd/swag@latest
  • ✅ Apifox Account: Need API Token and Project ID

2. Code Comment Example

// @title My API
// @version 1.0
// @description API service description
// @host localhost:8080
// @BasePath /api/v1

// @Summary Get user information
// @Description Get detailed information by user ID
// @Tags User Management
// @Accept json
// @Produce json
// @Param id path int true "User ID"
// @Success 200 {object} User
// @Router /users/{id} [get]
func getUser(c *gin.Context) {
    // Implementation code
}

3. Plugin Configuration

Open Settings/Preferences → Tools → Swag2Apifox

Configuration Guide

Apifox Configuration

  • API Secret Key: Apifox API Token, get from Personal Settings
  • Project ID: Target project ID, view in project settings (Required)
  • Parent Folder ID: Parent directory ID, sync to root if empty
  • Endpoint Overwrite Behavior: Interface merge strategy
    • 🔄 Overwrite Existing: Overwrite existing interfaces
    • 🔗 Auto Merge: Auto merge (Recommended)
    • 💾 Keep Existing: Keep existing interfaces
    • ➕ Create New: Create new interfaces
  • Add Base Path: Whether to add base path to interface paths

Swag Configuration

  • Parse Dependency: Whether to scan entities in dependency packages (default off, slower scanning)

Usage Steps

  1. Add Swagger comments to Go project
  2. Configure Apifox connection information
  3. Open right tool window Swag2Apifox
  4. Click Generate & Upload button
  5. View operation logs and confirm successful upload

Common Issues

  • Q: "swag command not found" error
    A: Run go install github.com/swaggo/swag/cmd/swag@latest to install
  • Q: "No swagger file found" error
    A: Check if Swagger comments in Go code are correct, view detailed logs to locate issues
  • Q: Upload failed
    A: Check if API Token and Project ID are correct, confirm network connection

Related Resources

  • 📖 Swag Official Documentation
  • 📖 Apifox Help Documentation
  • 🐛 Issue Feedback

Use Cases

  • Go microservice API documentation management
  • Interface synchronization in team collaboration
  • API documentation version control
  • Frontend-backend interface integration

Make API documentation management simple and efficient! 🎉

Swag Import Apifox - Go API 文档同步工具

一键从 Go 代码注释自动生成 Swagger 文档并同步到 Apifox，提升 API 文档管理效率！

核心功能

  • 🎯 自动生成：从 Go 代码注释自动生成 Swagger 文档
  • 📤 一键上传：将生成的文档直接同步到 Apifox 项目
  • 🔄 智能合并：支持多种接口合并策略，避免重复
  • ⚙️ 灵活配置：自定义上传目录和合并规则
  • 📊 实时反馈：详细的操作日志和结果统计

快速开始

1. 环境准备

  • ✅ Go 环境：Go 1.16 或更高版本
  • ✅ GoLand/IntelliJ IDEA：2023.1 或更高版本
  • ✅ Swag 工具：自动安装或手动安装 go install github.com/swaggo/swag/cmd/swag@latest
  • ✅ Apifox 账号：需要 API Token 和项目 ID

2. 代码注释示例

// @title 我的 API
// @version 1.0
// @description API 服务描述
// @host localhost:8080
// @BasePath /api/v1

// @Summary 获取用户信息
// @Description 根据用户 ID 获取详细信息
// @Tags 用户管理
// @Accept json
// @Produce json
// @Param id path int true "用户 ID"
// @Success 200 {object} User
// @Router /users/{id} [get]
func getUser(c *gin.Context) {
    // 实现代码
}

3. 插件配置

打开 设置/偏好设置 → 工具 → Swag2Apifox

配置指南

Apifox 配置

  • API 密钥：Apifox API Token，从个人设置获取
  • 项目 ID：目标项目 ID，在项目设置中查看（必填）
  • 父文件夹 ID：父目录 ID，为空则同步到根目录
  • 接口覆盖行为：接口合并策略
    • 🔄 覆盖现有：覆盖现有接口
    • 🔗 自动合并：自动合并（推荐）
    • 💾 保留现有：保留现有接口
    • ➕ 创建新接口：创建新接口
  • 添加基础路径：是否在接口路径前添加基础路径

Swag 配置

  • 解析依赖：是否扫描依赖包中的实体（默认关闭，扫描较慢）

使用步骤

  1. 在 Go 项目中添加 Swagger 注释
  2. 配置 Apifox 连接信息
  3. 打开右侧工具窗口 Swag2Apifox
  4. 点击 生成并上传 按钮
  5. 查看操作日志并确认上传成功

常见问题

  • Q: "swag command not found" 错误
    A: 运行 go install github.com/swaggo/swag/cmd/swag@latest 安装
  • Q: "No swagger file found" 错误
    A: 检查 Go 代码中的 Swagger 注释是否正确，查看详细日志定位问题
  • Q: 上传失败
    A: 检查 API Token 和项目 ID 是否正确，确认网络连接

相关资源

  • 📖 Swag 官方文档
  • 📖 Apifox 帮助文档
  • 🐛 问题反馈

使用场景

  • Go 微服务 API 文档管理
  • 团队协作中的接口同步
  • API 文档版本控制
  • 前后端接口对接

让 API 文档管理变得简单高效！🎉

idea-plugin.name: CodeGraph
idea-plugin.description:
This IntelliJ plugin generates an interactive dependency graph for selected Java or Kotlin files, allowing users to filter dependencies based on a specified package and concatenate selected files into the clipboard. The plugin provides a visual representation of the dependencies, enabling users to explore and manipulate them interactively.

Usage

  1. Select one or multiple Java or Kotlin files in the IntelliJ IDEA project side panel.
  2. Invoke the plugin using the configured shortcut (default Ctrl + Alt + G).
    • Or use the Command Palette (Find Action, Ctrl + Shift + A) then type CodeGraph - Show Dependencies.
  3. Enter an optional package filter in the prompt.
  4. The dependency graph is displayed in a floating window.
  5. Interact with the graph:
    • Click nodes to enable/disable them to include/exclude files from concatenation.
  6. Choose how to share selected files:
    • If your AI agent (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot Agent, Cursor, etc.) already has access to your files:
      • Click “Copy AI Agent Context Prompt” to copy a list of the selected files' paths. Paste this list into your AI tool to provide context.
    • If your AI agent does NOT have access to your files:
      • Click “Concatenate to Clipboard” to copy the full content of the selected files. Paste this content into your AI tool to provide full context.
  7. Paste the concatenated content or prompt where needed (ChatGPT, Claude, Ollama, etc.).

idea-plugin.name: Acooly Coder
idea-plugin.description:
The Acooly Coder plugin is a specialized code generation tool designed for the Acooly framework. It quickly generates high-quality skeleton code to reduce repetitive work for developers and ensure consistent code style and standards.


Key Features:

  • End-to-end entity-based code generation from database tables.
  • Generates: Entities, DAO (MyBatis/JPA), service layer, controller, management page (multi-condition sorting query, add/edit/delete/move/export/etc.).
  • Supports JSP and Freemarker template views for the interface.
  • Batch generate multiple tables into a single module.
  • Remove table prefixes or add custom entity prefixes.
  • Generates form elements, including dropdown selections, form type validation, and mask inputs.
  • Generate Dubbo(SOA) or Feign(SpringCloud) remote services.
  • Generate OpenAPI service for open-platform.

idea-plugin.name: Quicknote
idea-plugin.description:
Quicknote is a simple yet effective tool designed for developers who frequently switch tasks and need to capture quick notes within IntelliJ IDEA.

"Leave it to the notes—your brain has better things to do."

Why use Quicknote?
- Reduce STM (Short-Term Memory) Load: Writing down key information reduces cognitive strain, allowing you to focus on problem-solving instead of retaining unnecessary details.
- Minimize Context Switching Overhead: Studies show that resuming work after an interruption takes an average of 10 minutes. By storing the current code context before stepping away (e.g., before answering a colleague’s question or leaving your desk), you can significantly cut down recovery time.
- Capture Ideas Instantly: Great ideas often strike at unexpected moments. Whether it's a sudden solution to a bug or an innovative feature idea, Quicknote ensures you never lose a spark of inspiration.
- Instant Access for Collaboration: Need to explain something to a teammate? Instead of scrambling to open a separate note-taking app, just bring up Quicknote and jot it down immediately.

🚀 Quicknote Hotkeys
- Open Quicknote Window:
- Mac: Command + Shift + P
- Windows/Linux: Ctrl + Shift + P

- Move Cursor to Quicknote Text Area:
- Mac: Command + Shift + L
- Windows/Linux: Ctrl + Shift + L

Integrated directly into IntelliJ IDEA, Quicknote provides a lightweight, persistent, and distraction-free way to keep track of important thoughts without leaving your development environment.

idea-plugin.name: Kotlin into Typescript
idea-plugin.description:
This IntelliJ plugin, written in Kotlin, is designed to convert Kotlin controller methods into TypeScript interfaces. When a user right - clicks on a Kotlin method within a `RestController` or `Controller` class, the plugin parses the Kotlin method, including HTTP mapping annotations, method paths, and parameter types. It then generates corresponding TypeScript code, which includes interface definitions for input and output parameters, as well as a function definition for the HTTP request. The generated TypeScript code is automatically copied to the clipboard, and the plugin can handle dynamic path placeholders and basic Kotlin type conversions to TypeScript types.
It provides a convenient way for developers to convert Kotlin - based backend controller methods into TypeScript - based front - end code, enhancing development efficiency and reducing the risk of errors. 这个用 Kotlin 编写的 IntelliJ 插件旨在将 Kotlin 控制器方法转换为 TypeScript 接口。当用户在 `RestController` 或 `Controller` 类中的 Kotlin 方法上右键点击时，插件会解析该 Kotlin 方法，包括 HTTP 映射注解、方法路径和参数类型。然后生成相应的 TypeScript 代码，其中包含输入和输出参数的接口定义，以及 HTTP 请求的函数定义。生成的 TypeScript 代码会自动复制到剪贴板，并且该插件可以处理动态路径占位符以及将基本的 Kotlin 类型转换为 TypeScript 类型。
它为开发者提供了一种便捷的方式，将基于 Kotlin 的后端控制器方法转换为基于 TypeScript 的前端代码，提高了开发效率并降低了出错的风险。

idea-plugin.name: JsonSql
idea-plugin.description:
Json Sql
Retrieve the desired data from JSON using SQL
And convert SQL to JSON again
The supported SQL statements are：
  • select *、name、name as alias、name.surname(Multi layer query)
  • where =、!=、in、not in、>、>=、<、<=、between
  • like(_ and% escape with \\_ and \\%)、not like、is null、is not null
  • and、or、Nesting 'and' and 'or'
  • left、right、length、concat、if、ifnull、nullif、substr、substring、upper、lower、isnull、round functions
  • group by；sum、avg、max、min、count、group_concat、any_value、group_array functions
  • having
  • order by asc、desc、distinct
  • limit 1,2
Unsupported SQL statements include：
  • update、insert、delete
  • join
  • union
  • Special keywords such as 'result' and 'date' (should be accompanied by ``)
  • The key in JSON cannot contain '.' If there is, it will be converted to _NaN_ (SQL query only)
Some Examples：
  • select level.type.name t from arr where level.type.name in ('hello') order by t
  • select distinct name from a where name = 'hello' and (age >= 11 or level like '%\\%lin%')
  • select left(right(left(id,3),2), 1) a, count( left(right(left(id,3),2), 1)) b from t_user group by a


将json通过sql查出想要的数据
并把sql再转成json
支持的sql语句有：
  • select *、name、name as alias、name.surname（多层查询）
  • where =、!=、in、not in、>、>=、<、<=、between
  • like（_和%转义用\\_和\\%）、not like、is null、is not null
  • and、or、嵌套and和or
  • left、right、length、concat、if、ifnull、nullif、substr、substring、upper、lower、isnull、round等函数
  • group by；sum、avg、max、min、count、group_concat、any_value、group_array 等函数
  • having
  • order by asc、desc、distinct
  • limit 1,2
不支持的sql语句有：
  • update、insert、delete
  • 连表
  • union
  • 特殊的关键词如：result、date（要带上``）
  • json里的key不能含有'.'，有则会转成_NaN_（仅sql查询）
一些例子：
  • select level.type.name t from arr where level.type.name in ('hello') order by t
  • select distinct name from a where name = 'hello' and (age >= 11 or level like '%\\%lin%')
  • select left(right(left(id,3),2), 1) a, count( left(right(left(id,3),2), 1)) b from t_user group by a

idea-plugin.name: Kratos Generator
idea-plugin.description:
Kratos Generator Plugin

A code generator plugin for the Kratos microservices framework in GoLand. Provides quick code generation for Kratos projects, including proto client/server, config, and wire injection.

Features

  • Generate Proto Client Code: Right-click on a non-conf.proto .proto file to run kratos proto client <relative_path> and generate client code.
  • Generate Service Server Code: Right-click on a non-conf.proto .proto file to run kratos proto server <relative_path> -t internal/service and generate server code.
  • Generate Config Files: Right-click on conf.proto to run make config and generate/update config files.
  • Run Wire Injection: Right-click on a cmd/xxx directory to run wire . and generate dependency injection code.

Requirements

  • Kratos CLI: go install github.com/go-kratos/kratos/cmd/kratos/v2@latest
  • Wire: go install github.com/google/wire/cmd/wire@latest

Usage

  • Right-click the target file or directory in GoLand project view
  • Select the desired action from the context menu
  • Results are shown in the "Kratos Generator" tool window

适用于 GoLand 的 Kratos 微服务框架代码生成器插件，为 Kratos 项目提供快捷的代码生成功能。

功能特性

插件在项目视图中提供以下右键菜单选项：

  1. 生成 Proto 客户端代码
    • 触发对象：非 conf.proto 的 .proto 文件
    • 功能：在项目根目录下执行 kratos proto client <相对路径>，自动生成该 proto 文件对应的客户端代码
  2. 生成 Service 服务端代码
    • 触发对象：非 conf.proto 的 .proto 文件
    • 功能：在项目根目录下执行 kratos proto server <相对路径> -t internal/service，自动生成该 proto 文件对应的服务端代码
  3. 生成配置文件
    • 触发对象：conf.proto 文件
    • 功能：在项目根目录下执行 make config，自动生成或更新配置文件
  4. 执行 wire 依赖注入
    • 触发对象：cmd/xxx 目录
    • 功能：在当前右键点击的 cmd/xxx 目录下执行 wire .，自动生成依赖注入代码

使用前提

确保已正确安装以下工具：

  1. Kratos CLI 工具： 
    go install github.com/go-kratos/kratos/cmd/kratos/v2@latest
  2. Wire 工具： 
    go install github.com/google/wire/cmd/wire@latest

使用方法

  1. 在 GoLand 的项目视图中，右键点击相应的文件或目录
  2. 在弹出的上下文菜单中选择对应的功能
  3. 执行结果将在底部的 "Kratos Generator" 工具窗口中显示

idea-plugin.name: Code Marker
idea-plugin.description:
Code Marker puts an icon in the editor gutter next to Java method calls that match rules you define, so the calls that matter in your project, such as database access, remote calls or transactional services, stand out while you read the code.

Features

  • Rules by class, annotation and method: match calls by the class that declares the method, by an annotation on the method or its class, by the method name, or any combination of them.
  • Inheritance aware: super classes, interfaces and overridden methods are checked as well, so a rule on an interface also marks calls through its implementations.
  • Simple or fully qualified names: write Service or org.springframework.stereotype.Service, with or without the leading @.
  • Built-in icon set: pick an icon for each rule from the bundled icons.
  • Documentation on hover: hovering a gutter icon shows the documentation of the called method.
  • Ordered rules: rules are checked from top to bottom and the first match wins. Reorder them by dragging a row or with the toolbar buttons.
  • Import and export: save the rule list to an XML file and share it with your team.

Getting Started

  1. Open Settings | Tools | Code Marker.
  2. Add a rule and fill in a class name, an annotation, or both. The method name is optional; leaving it empty matches every method.
  3. Choose an icon and apply. Open editors are updated right away.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
v1.0.5

  • Fix the Apply button staying disabled after editing a rule a second time, or while still typing in a cell

    • v1.0.4

  • Rewrite the plugin description and README to match how the plugin works

    • v1.0.3

  • Add annotation based rules: mark calls by the annotations on the called method or its class
  • Class names can now be written as a simple name instead of a fully qualified one
  • Cache rule lookups per method and render tooltips lazily, so large projects highlight faster
  • Apply settings immediately instead of after reopening the editor
  • Add buttons to reorder rules, next to the existing drag and drop

idea-plugin.name: InterfaceX
idea-plugin.description:
InterfaceX turns a large IntelliJ IDEA project into a clear, searchable map of service entry points. Instead of jumping between controllers, Feign clients, message listeners, scheduled jobs, and scattered configuration classes, you can open one tool window and quickly find the interface, message consumer, producer, or job handler you need.

It is designed for backend projects where navigation cost grows with the codebase:

  • Discover HTTP Controller, OpenFeign, RabbitMQ, RocketMQ, Mission Client, and XXL-JOB entry points in one interface tree
  • Search and jump to source from the tool window or Search Everywhere
  • Organize interfaces with tags and quickly filter large service lists
  • Export interface data for documentation, review, and cross-team alignment
  • Copy request parameters as JSON to speed up local debugging
  • Send RocketMQ messages and execute XXL-JOB tasks directly from the IDE
  • Load cached scan results first and refresh in the background, keeping the IDE responsive on large projects

InterfaceX helps teams inspect service boundaries, trace integration points, and debug distributed workflows without leaving IntelliJ IDEA.

InterfaceX 可以把大型 IntelliJ IDEA 项目中的接口入口整理成一张清晰、可搜索的服务地图。 当项目里同时存在 Controller、Feign、消息监听、消息生产、定时任务和各种配置类时，不必再在代码中反复跳转查找，只需要打开一个工具窗口，就能快速定位目标接口、消费者、生产者或任务入口。

它适合接口数量多、模块复杂、排查链路成本高的后端项目：

  • 统一扫描 HTTP Controller、OpenFeign、RabbitMQ、RocketMQ、Mission Client、XXL-JOB 等入口
  • 支持从工具窗口和 Search Everywhere 快速搜索并跳转源码
  • 支持标签管理和过滤，方便按业务线、负责人、状态或场景组织接口
  • 支持导出接口数据，便于文档整理、接口评审和团队协作
  • 支持复制请求参数 JSON，减少本地调试准备成本
  • 支持在 IDE 内发送 RocketMQ 消息、执行 XXL-JOB 任务
  • 优先加载缓存并后台刷新，减少大型项目打开工具窗口时的卡顿

InterfaceX 帮助团队更快看清服务边界、定位集成入口、调试分布式调用链路，让接口治理和日常排查都留在 IntelliJ IDEA 里完成。

HTTP

方便查找HTTP接口代码

扫描规则

Spring-MVC注解

OpenFeign

当微服务较多时，一个接口可能被多个服务调用，此插件功能方便查找HTTP接口被依赖服务调用处

扫描规则

Spring OpenFeign包装注解

RabbitMQ 生产者

规则

自动扫描当前工程下方法中调用org.springframework.amqp.rabbit.core.RabbitTemplate#convertAndSend的方法 建议方法名称为队列名称，每个工程创建一个类即可，这样搜索可以按队列名称进行搜索，示例

public void fileNotifyQueue() {
    rabbitTemplate.convertAndSend(exchange,routingKey,body);
}

RabbitMQ 消费者

扫描规则

自动扫描Spring Bean方法有 org.springframework.amqp.rabbit.annotation.RabbitListener的方法

RocketMQ生产者

规则

自动扫描当前工程下方法中调用org.apache.rocketmq.spring.core.RocketMQTemplate#convertAndSend的方法 建议方法名称为tag名称，每个工程创建一个类即可，这样搜索可以按Tag名称进行搜索,示例

public void fileNotifyQueue() {
  rocketMQTemplate.convertAndSend();
}

RocketMQ消费者

扫描规则

自动扫描类上有此注解的类 org.apache.rocketmq.spring.annotation.RocketMQMessageListener

XXL-JOB

扫描规则

自动扫描类上有此注解的类com.xxl.job.core.handler.annotation.JobHandler

idea-plugin.name: SmartEnv
idea-plugin.description:
SmartEnv injects profile-driven environment variables right before launching run configurations.

  • Compose values from .env, .properties, YAML, JSON (flattened or blob), and plain key=value.
  • Profiles per run configuration plus a Quick Settings popup to switch without reopening settings.
  • Preview merged values before they are applied.
  • Unknown file extensions default to JSON blob mode so content is always injectable.

Quick start

  1. Open Settings | Tools | SmartEnv, enable the plugin, and add a profile.
  2. Add files with Format = Auto-detect; use JSON blob mode when you want the whole file under one key.
  3. Assign the profile to a run configuration; run or debug and inspect the preview.
  4. Use the status bar widget or Quick Settings action to switch profiles on the fly.

Sample files live in docs/samples/ (env, properties, yaml, json, and json-blob examples).

idea-plugin.name: Go Module Finder
idea-plugin.description:
English

Go Module Finder searches Go modules with the official pkg.go.dev API. No account or API key is required.

  • Module search and optional remote auto-completion (off by default), with package results grouped by module path
  • Author / owner text is an additional search keyword, not a verified author filter
  • Click a version cell to load available versions for that exact module path
  • The optional download version overrides the selected version and does not affect search
  • Download with go get module@version using the official Go proxy, goproxy.io, goproxy.cn, or a custom proxy
  • Project settings for the default download source, go command path, and custom proxy

Open Go Module Finder, enter a module name or keyword, and click Search. Select a module, optionally choose a version, and click Download.

Privacy: Search sends module-name and author / owner keywords to public pkg.go.dev; version lookup sends the selected module path. Remote typing completion is off by default, including after upgrading, and must be explicitly enabled in Settings. If enabled, module-name text is sent as you type. Do not submit private module paths or confidential information. Disabling completion cancels pending work and ignores stale results; already-sent requests cannot be recalled. This setting does not disable explicit searches or version lookup.

中文

Go Module Finder 使用官方 pkg.go.dev API 搜索 Go 模块，无需注册或 API Key。

  • 模块搜索与可选的远程自动补全（默认关闭），将包搜索结果按模块路径合并
  • 作者 / 所有者文本作为附加搜索关键词，不是经过验证的作者筛选
  • 点击版本单元格，加载该模块路径对应的可用版本
  • 可选的下载版本优先于所选版本，仅用于下载，不参与搜索
  • 通过 go get module@version 下载，支持官方 Go 代理、goproxy.io、goproxy.cn 或自定义代理
  • 项目设置包括默认下载来源、go 命令路径和自定义代理

打开 Go Module Finder，输入模块名称或关键词并点击搜索。选择模块，按需选择版本，然后点击下载。

隐私：搜索会将模块名称和作者 / 所有者关键词发送给公共服务 pkg.go.dev，版本查询会发送所选模块路径。输入时的远程补全默认关闭，升级旧配置也不会自动启用；在设置中明确启用后，输入中的模块名称才会发送。请勿提交私有模块路径或机密信息。关闭补全会取消排队任务并忽略过期结果；已发送的请求无法撤回。该开关不影响主动搜索和版本查询。

Homepage & feedback: ryanduan.dev/gomodulefinder
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.1.0

  • Use the official, keyless pkg.go.dev v1 API for public module search and version lookup.
  • Keep version results tied to the exact module path, excluding retracted versions, with bounded pagination and cancellation.
  • Remote typing completion is off by default, including after upgrading. Enable it explicitly in Settings to send typed module names to public pkg.go.dev.
  • Download proxy selection only affects go get; explicit search and version lookup use public pkg.go.dev.
  • Remove deprecated platform API usage and verify compatibility with GoLand 2025.1, GoLand 2026.2.3, and IntelliJ IDEA 2026.3 EAP 263.5153.40.

Validation: 50 automated tests passed. Native IDE interactions and a real go get download have not been verified end to end.

idea-plugin.name: Code Sentinel
idea-plugin.description:
Code Sentinel - Intelligent coding assistant and pre-commit guard for IntelliJ IDEA. Ensures code quality through real-time inspections, pre-commit checks, and smart quick fixes.

Code Sentinel: Your Intelligent Coding and Commit Guard

Code Sentinel is a developer assistant plugin designed for IntelliJ IDEA, providing real-time code analysis and pre-commit checks to ensure code quality, maintain team coding standards, and significantly improve development workflow efficiency.

Core Features

Real-time Inspection and Quick Fixes:
  • Code Standards Sentinel: Instantly catches code that doesn't comply with predefined standards (e.g., API MsgID format, missing Javadoc).
  • Smart Fixes: Provides context-aware quick fix suggestions (via Alt+Enter / Option+Enter).
Pre-commit Guard (Optional):
  • Git Branch Check: Prevents commits based on outdated branches.
  • Code Quality Gate: Scans pending changes for compliance.
  • Issue Dashboard: Lists all detected issues clearly.
  • Batch Fix ("Fix All"): One-click fix for all issues.
Smart Assistance:
  • Javadoc Generator: Auto-generates complete or minimal Javadoc.
  • API Search: Search APIs via Search Everywhere (Shift+Shift).
  • API Copy: Copy complete API code with dependencies.

Highly Configurable

Enable/disable Git checks, code inspections, choose Javadoc style, and define target branches in Settings.

Let Code Sentinel be your reliable assistant and quality guardian!

idea-plugin.change-notes:
v1.0.7 (2026-05-21)

  • 🛡️ Code Quality Governance: Standardized project Javadocs for classes, public methods, constructors, and key configuration files
  • 🧩 Project-Level Cache: Replaced static PSI request cache with project-scoped cache and request index to avoid cross-project pollution
  • ♻️ Incremental Update Fix: Improved file-level cache merge strategy to remove stale endpoints after file deletion, movement, or endpoint removal
  • 🌐 HTTP Client Stability: Enhanced redirect handling for 301/302/303/307/308 and ensured HTTP responses are closed correctly
  • ⚙️ Build Compatibility: Removed Gradle 9 deprecated Java compatibility usage and enabled Java deprecation lint output

中文说明：

  • 🛡️ 代码质量治理：为项目类、公开方法、构造方法和核心配置补充标准化注释，提升后续维护效率
  • 🧩 项目级缓存：移除静态 PSI 请求缓存，改为项目级缓存和请求索引，降低多项目缓存污染风险
  • ♻️ 增量更新修复：优化文件级缓存合并策略，删除、移动文件或移除接口后不再残留旧节点
  • 🌐 HTTP 调试稳定性：增强 301/302/303/307/308 重定向处理，并确保 HTTP 响应资源正确关闭
  • ⚙️ 构建兼容性：清理 Gradle 9 过时 Java compatibility 写法，并开启 Java 过时 API 明细扫描

v1.0.6 (2026-05-20)

  • 🚀 Quick Navigation Enhancement: Added REST API gutter icons for Controller methods, allowing one-click opening of the RestfulTool-Plus tool window
  • 🎯 API Location Optimization: Support locating the corresponding URL in the service tree directly from endpoint methods in the editor
  • 🐞 Context Path Fix: Fixed contextPath retrieval failures in non-module scope scenarios to avoid incorrect API path resolution
  • 🎨 Icon Resource: Added a dedicated REST API method entry icon for editor gutter display

中文说明：

  • 🚀 快捷导航增强：新增 REST API 方法行标记图标，支持在 Controller 方法左侧直接点击图标打开 RestfulTool-Plus 工具窗口
  • 🎯 接口定位优化：支持从代码编辑器中的接口方法一键定位到服务树中的具体 URL，减少手动搜索和定位成本

特别感谢：感谢 https://gitee.com/lvlivejp 提交 PR，贡献了 contextPath 修复与接口图标快捷跳转能力。

idea-plugin.name: ReviewBridge
idea-plugin.description:
Convert local review edits into structured GitHub and GitLab PR/MR inline suggestions with a single action — then let your teammates accept the change with one click.

How it works

  1. Check out the PR branch and edit files as you see fit.
  2. Run ReviewBridge → Convert local edits to PR suggestions from the Tools menu or the Find Action dialog (⇧⌘A / Ctrl+Shift+A).
  3. A preview dialog shows every suggestion with a before/after diff view. Select the ones you want to post and click Post Suggestions.

Features

  • Exact and fuzzy hunk matching (configurable window) to locate changed lines in the PR diff even after rebases.
  • SHA revalidation gate — aborts if the PR head changed since the diff was computed.
  • Deduplication — already-posted suggestions are skipped automatically.
  • GitHub (PAT or OAuth via built-in IDE authentication) and GitLab (PAT, OAuth PKCE, or GitLab Workflow extension session).
  • Multi-project workspaces — automatically discovers all git roots under the open project and lets you select the target repo.

idea-plugin.name: MyDict
idea-plugin.description:
IntelliJ IDEA support for MyDict Spring Boot Starter.
Provides real-time recognition of generated xxxDesc fields and getter/setter methods without requiring compilation, similar to the Lombok plugin experience.

Requirements
  • IntelliJ IDEA 2024.1 or later（Ultimate / Community）
  • Java plugin enabled（bundled by default）
  • Lombok plugin installed and enabled（if your project uses @Data / @Getter）
  • JDK 17+
Usage
Annotate your fields with @MyDict and the plugin will automatically provide code completion and type checking for the generated description fields and accessors — no compilation needed.

Note

idea-plugin.name: CertView X.509
idea-plugin.description:
Inspect X.509 certificates and Java keystores directly inside IntelliJ-based IDEs.

CertView X.509 keeps local certificate inspection close to Java, PKI, digital identity, signing, and secure backend work. Open certificate and keystore files from the Project view and review the metadata developers usually need before reaching for terminal commands.

Supported inputs include PEM, DER, CRT, CER, PKCS#12, JKS, and JCEKS files.

What it shows:
  • Inspect subject, issuer, serial number, and validity dates.
  • Open PEM, DER, CRT, and CER certificate files in a dedicated viewer.
  • Inspect PKCS#12, JKS, and JCEKS keystores with password prompts when required.
  • Keep supported local inputs inside the IDE instead of temporary OpenSSL or keytool dumps.

This is an inspection tool. It does not replace certificate path validation, revocation checks, WebPKI policy validation, or organizational PKI review.

idea-plugin.name: EasyFK Generator
idea-plugin.description:
EasyFK Generator

EasyFK Generator helps you generate project structure, model code, business layers, and configuration inside IntelliJ IDEA.

EasyFK Generator 是一款面向 Java / Spring Boot 技术栈的高效代码生成插件，聚焦“配置驱动 + 数据库感知 + 全栈生成”，可直接在 IntelliJ IDEA 中完成项目骨架搭建、模型生成、业务层代码生成与自动装配配置生成。

它不仅能从数据库表一键推导 Entity、Mapper、DTO、Param、Repository、Service、API、Remote、Controller 等核心代码，还支持增量生成、模型刷新、仅 Repository 生成等精细化控制，让新项目启动更快、老项目扩展更稳。

插件与 CLI 共用 generator.yml 配置文件，既适合个人在 IDEA 中可视化操作，也适合团队统一配置、统一流程、统一输出结果，显著减少重复样板代码与手工维护成本。

使用文档

核心能力

  • 项目初始化：生成完整的Java/Spring Boot项目骨架、模块结构与基础配置文件。
  • 模型生成：支持从数据库表或手动定义模型生成 Entity、Mapper、DTO、Param 等代码。
  • 业务代码生成：可一键生成 Repository、Service、API、Remote、Controller 等业务层代码。
  • 增量生成：新增模块或表结构时可继续生成，不影响已有业务代码。
  • 模型刷新：表结构变化后可重新生成模型相关代码，尽量保持手写业务逻辑不受影响。
  • 数据库导入：支持连接数据库并直接导入表名进入生成流程。

支持范围

  • 项目类型：Single / Micro-PRD / Microservice / Smart
  • 构建方式：Maven / Gradle
  • ORM 框架：MyBatis / MyBatis-Flex / Hibernate
  • RPC 类型：OpenFeign / Dubbo
  • 应用类型：BMS / CLIENT
  • 数据库导入：支持 MySQL / PostgreSQL 及对应生成流程

典型场景

  • 在 IDEA 中快速创建全新的 EasyFK 项目。
  • 对已有项目新增表后继续生成模型与业务代码。
  • 数据库字段变化后刷新 DTO、Param、Entity、Mapper 等模型相关代码。
  • 通过共享 generator.yml 在 CLI 与 IDEA 插件之间无缝切换使用。

补充说明

插件与 CLI 共用 generator.yml 配置文件，便于团队统一配置、统一流程、统一输出结果。

如果你希望进一步了解安装、配置和使用方式，可查看上方使用文档链接。
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.9 — Smart-ORM 支持与数据库连接错误提示优化
  • 新增 Smart-ORM 项目类型（多栈微服务 + ORM 抽离），支持多选 ORM 模块（MyBatis-Plus / MyBatis-Flex / Hibernate），配置写入 generator.yml 的 orm-modules，与 CLI 完全通用
  • Smart-ORM 类型下自动禁用“ORM 框架”单选并显示“ORM 模块”多选，至少需选择一个 ORM 模块
  • 修复 PostgreSQL 连接失败时错误消息乱码（U+FFFD）问题：PostgreSQL 连接串自动追加 characterEncoding=UTF-8&allowEncodingChanges=true
  • 数据库连接错误提示优化：展示 SQLState 与原始错误消息，自动尝试修复可逆乱码；仅当错误消息确实无法解码时才附加编码修复建议，不再整段替换为通用提示
  • 数据库表导入失败提示同步优化，展示更具体的错误信息
1.0.8 — 模型确认流程增强与数据库导入体验优化
  • 模型配置页将“从数据库导入 / 手动创建模型”调整为“选择表 / 确认模型”，使数据库选表与模型详细控制形成连续流程
  • 切换到“确认模型”时会自动根据当前 db-tables 生成模型列表，并与已有模型配置叠加合并，不再互斥
  • 数据库导入的表现在支持直接配置 仅 Repository，可实现某些关系表只生成到 Repository 层，不再继续生成 Service / API / Remote / Controller
  • 移除无效的 create-repository 项目级配置，统一以 Model 级别的 only-repository 控制生成范围
  • “表前缀”调整为“忽略表前缀”，支持多个前缀使用英文逗号分隔，插件预览模型名与生成器实际模型名保持一致
  • 优化模型配置页数据库连接区域布局，将连接地址、用户名、密码放在同一行，并固定用户名和密码输入框宽度，减少无效空白
  • 移除数据库表选择弹窗中无意义的“加载完成”提示框，避免打断选表操作
1.0.7 — 配置文件互通与加载逻辑完善
  • 插件自动读取项目根目录下的 generator.yml，与 CLI 配置文件保持完全通用
  • 保留对旧版 .easyfk-generator.json 的兼容读取，便于历史项目平滑迁移
  • 当根目录同时存在 generator.yml 和 .easyfk-generator.json 时，优先读取 generator.yml
  • 保存插件配置时继续保留 YAML 中插件界面暂未覆盖的其他 CLI 参数，避免覆盖遗漏
  • 移除对 CLI 初始化模板的特殊跳过判断，只要 generator.yml 合法即可直接自动加载
  • 修复 YAML 写入时的缩进配置问题，避免生成流程出现配置保存报错
1.0.6 — 项目配置体验优化与 Dubbo 提供者配置调整
  • 插件本地生成配置文件改为 generator.yml，与 CLI 配置文件完全通用，并兼容读取旧版 .easyfk-generator.json
  • 项目配置页将“项目类型”改为下拉选择，便于后续继续扩展更多项目类型

idea-plugin.name: ScalaBPE Navigator
idea-plugin.description:
ScalaBPE Navigator - An IntelliJ IDEA plugin for ScalaBPE framework development, providing efficient navigation and tooling between XML service contracts and Scala/Flow implementation files.

Features

  • .flow Syntax Highlighting - Automatic Scala syntax highlighting for .flow files (requires Scala plugin)
  • XML to Implementation - Click gutter icon on XML message tags to jump to .scala/.flow files; Ctrl+Click <service name> to list all implementations for that service
  • XML to Call Sites - Ctrl+Click message name to navigate to invoke() call locations
  • Reverse Navigation - Ctrl+Click class names or comments in Scala/Flow files to jump back to XML definitions
  • Invoke to XML - Ctrl+Click invoke("svcName.msgName") strings to jump to XML contracts
  • Hover Documentation - Ctrl+Hover or Ctrl+Q to view request/response parameter info
  • Smart Completion - Auto-complete serviceName.messageName in invoke() calls with editable parameter templates
  • XML Type References - Ctrl+Click field type="TypeName" to jump to <type name="TypeName"/> in the same XML file (avenue_conf)

Prerequisites

  • Project must contain standard ScalaBPE directory structure: avenue_conf/ (XML contracts) and compose_conf/ (implementation files)
  • Scala plugin recommended for .flow file syntax highlighting

Image

Special Notes

  • The Beetl plugin automatically finds beetl.properties, retrieves delimiters, placeholders, and registered functions. On the current 1.0 version, use with caution
  • The plugin currently does not support Beetl's HTML extension tag functionality or automatic formatting function hints
  • Beetl plugin development is implemented in a language Inject manner, meaning the Beetl template language can be injected into other languages, such as html/xml/markdown
    • Just as Java comments and Java regular expressions have their own syntax forms and can be registered within Java code, theoretically, Beetl can be injected into all host languages, as long as the host language supports Inject
  • Since development is done using the Inject method, in the Idea plugin, Beetl can only implement code coloring and property hints for injectable parts. Taking xml as an example, the Beetl plugin can only colorize Beetl syntax in tag bodies, comments, and attribute values, providing property hints, which is sufficient for most template application scenarios.
  • When using xml/html as the main language, if "<" is used in Beetl or the type symbol "var " is used, a space must be kept after the "<" symbol, otherwise, Idea will consider it an HTML symbol.
    • Unless, you configure Beetl's delimiter symbols as "", which are xml/html comment symbols, and this is also the delimiter symbol I recommend
Detailed usage instructions refer to Beetl Idea Plugin Usage Instructions. Or readme.md

idea-plugin.name: Codex CLI
idea-plugin.description:
Codex CLI keeps the OpenAI Codex command-line agent one shortcut away inside your IDE.

Open a dedicated Codex terminal tab, send the current editor file or selected line range as an @path reference, and keep the conversation grounded in the exact code you are looking at.

This extension is intentionally terminal-first: it launches the Codex CLI you install or configure, then focuses on fast editor-to-terminal handoff.


Features

  • Dedicated Codex terminal tab: open or focus Codex from the tool window strip, Tools menu, or keyboard shortcut.
  • Editor file references: insert @path with no selection, or @path#L12-L34 when code is selected.
  • Working-directory-aware paths: references are relative to the configured Codex working directory, with absolute paths for files outside it.
  • Smart terminal recovery: if the Codex tab is still open but the process stopped, the launch action reruns your configured command in that same tab.
  • Configurable launch command: use codex, npx @openai/codex, a custom binary, or a WSL wrapper.

Usage

  • Click the Codex icon in the right-hand tool window strip, or press Ctrl+Alt+Shift+C / Cmd+Alt+Shift+C.
  • The integrated terminal opens a dedicated Codex tab and runs the configured command automatically.
  • In the editor, select code if needed and press Ctrl+Alt+K / Cmd+Alt+K to insert the reference into Codex, then type your question and submit.

Configuration

Open Settings → Tools → Codex CLI to set the launch command and working directory.


Requirements

  • IDE based on platform build 253 (2025.3) or later
  • OpenAI Codex CLI installed and available in your system PATH, or launched through npx / a custom command

Note: Codex also has an official IDE integration. This extension remains a lightweight terminal-first alternative for developers who prefer the CLI workflow.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.4 — Marketplace name update

  • Renamed the extension: the Marketplace-visible name is now Codex CLI, avoiding restricted platform/vendor terms.
  • Focused the extension on the CLI workflow: removed the experimental Codex notification feature and its background terminal-output monitor.
  • Simplified settings: Settings → Tools → Codex CLI now contains only the launch command and working directory.
  • Fixed first shortcut exception: checking whether the Codex process is still running now happens outside the IDE read action, so the first file-reference shortcut no longer trips terminal threading assertions.
  • Kept terminal workflow intact: launch/focus behavior and editor file reference insertion are unchanged.

idea-plugin.name: Tests Links
idea-plugin.description:
Links PHP Service and Controller classes to their PHPUnit tests, scaffolds new test files on demand, and shows project-wide coverage in the status bar.

Gutter icon

  • Green — at least one test file with ≥ 1 test method.
  • Yellow — test file exists but no test methods detected.
  • Grey + — no test file. Click to scaffold one.
  • Tooltip shows the test method count, counting function test*, #[Test] attributes, and @test docblock tags.

Click actions

  • Open test — single test file opens directly.
  • Picker popup — multiple test files (e.g. both tests/Services/... and tests/Feature/Services/...) show in a list.
  • Create test — grey + scaffolds {ClassName}Test.php at the mirrored path. Stub follows project conventions: declare(strict_types=1), extends TestCase, DatabaseTransactions trait, AAA placeholder method.

Reverse navigation

  • Gutter icon on a test class jumps to the subject Service/Controller (uses PhpIndex).

Status bar widget

  • Shows Tests 48% (72/150) for Service + Controller coverage.
  • Click for a breakdown, a rebuild action, and the first 30 uncovered class names.

Performance

  • Async index build at project open — typically 10–50 ms for 150 test files.
  • Gutter rendering is a ConcurrentHashMap lookup with no disk I/O.
  • VFS listener incrementally refreshes individual test and source files on save.

Scope

  • Classes under app/Services/** and app/Http/Controllers/**.
  • Test files named {ClassName}Test.php anywhere inside {projectRoot}/tests/.

idea-plugin.name: DiffLink
idea-plugin.description:
DiffLink opens file comparisons directly from inline @DiffLink markers.

Add @DiffLink:path/to/file or @DiffLink:source, destination in a comment or plain-text line, then click the gutter icon to launch IntelliJ IDEA's built-in diff viewer.

DiffLink is designed for refactoring and migration workflows where you frequently compare old and new implementations.

Highlights

  • One-click diff from editor gutter markers
  • Single-target and explicit two-file compare formats
  • Git history compare via git://ref:path syntax — compare any branch, tag, or commit SHA
  • Works across common text-based files (Java, Kotlin, Python, JavaScript, Markdown, XML, shell, config)
  • Clear error markers for missing or invalid paths
  • Local-only behavior: no source upload, no remote diff processing

Marker examples

@DiffLink:src/main/java/legacy/OldImplementation.java
@DiffLink:/Users/me/project/v1/File.kt, /Users/me/project/v2/File.kt
@DiffLink: git://HEAD~1:src/main/kotlin/Foo.kt
@DiffLink: git://main:src/Foo.kt, git://dev:src/Foo.kt

Screenshots

Compatibility: IntelliJ IDEA Community and Ultimate, build 232+ (2023.2.1 and later).

Privacy: local-only processing. DiffLink does not upload source code or diff content.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Added

  • Added shorthand git-history comparison for the current file with `@DiffLink: git://ref`.

DiffLink now expands the marker to the current file's repository-relative path automatically,

so `@DiffLink: git://HEAD~1` compares the open file against its historical revision.

idea-plugin.name: Git Heatmap
idea-plugin.description:
Git Heatmap analyzes Git history inside IntelliJ IDEA and visualizes repository activity as a file heatmap. It helps developers identify hotspot files, inspect commit and author activity, estimate engineering effort, compare branches, review code statistics, and track local Claude/Codex token usage without leaving the IDE.

Main features

  • Automatic Git history loading for the selected repository and branch.
  • File heatmap with per-file heat scores and interactive drill-down.
  • Sortable Files, Commits, and Authors views with added, deleted, net, effort, and message details.
  • Author and commit filters that scope Files, Commits, Heatmap, and summary together.
  • Optional date range filtering and PR Overlay branch comparison.
  • Multi-repository discovery with aggregate All repositories analysis.
  • Code Statistics with file format distribution, contribution calendar and trends, plus hourly commit/effort analysis.
  • Token Usage reads local Claude and Codex usage files without API keys or external uploads.
  • Global/repository scope, monthly/daily grouping, token/price views, model-aware estimates, fallback notices, and background loading.

Effort values are heuristic estimates for relative engineering effort visibility; they are not actual tracked time.

idea-plugin.name: Unicornvert
idea-plugin.description:
Unicornvert

Instantly convert selected text between readable characters and Unicode escape sequences — without leaving the editor.

How to use

  1. Select any text in the editor.
  2. Press Ctrl+Alt+U (or right-click → Convert Unicode/Character).
  3. The selection is converted in-place. Run it again to reverse.

Direction is detected automatically: if the selection contains a known escape sequence, it decodes; otherwise it encodes.

Supported formats

  • \uXXXX — Java / Kotlin unicode escape
  • U+XXXX — Unicode code point notation
  • \u{XXXX} — JavaScript ES6 brace syntax
  • &#xXXXX; — HTML hex entity
  • &#DDDDD; — HTML decimal entity
  • 0xXXXX — Hex literal
  • \XXXX — CSS unicode escape
  • Decimal number

Options

Go to Settings → Tools → Unicornvert to configure:

  • Encoding format — choose which format to encode into
  • Uppercase hex — toggle between U+AC00 and U+ac00
  • Convert whitespace — also encode spaces, tabs, and newlines
  • Add separator — insert a space between consecutive encoded tokens for readability

idea-plugin.name: svn-maven-build
idea-plugin.description:
Generate incremental Class update packages based on SVN commit history. Copies compiled .class files from target/classes/ to target/dist/, with inner classes (Foo$Bar.class) automatically included.

基于 SVN 提交记录，从 target/classes/ 目录生成增量 class 更新包，自动包含内部类文件。


Requirements / 依赖

  • SVN must be installed and configured in PATH
  • Project must be compiled before use (mvn compile or IDE Build)

Usage / 使用方法

  • Right-click project → Subversion → Show History → select revisions → Svn Maven build
  • Select files in the dialog, then click OK
  • The update package will be generated under target/dist/

idea-plugin.name: Typecek
idea-plugin.description: JetBrains IDE support for Typecek typed templates. Provides .tc file recognition, syntax highlighting, tag completions, hover documentation, Typecek language-server diagnostics, type-aware completions, and navigation for template and TypeScript references.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.3.2

  • Removed the hard dependency on the JavaScript plugin (com.intellij.modules.javascript), which no longer resolves in 2026.2 IDEs. The plugin now installs in any IntelliJ-based IDE; TypeScript/HTML/SCSS host highlighting inside .tc files is used when the corresponding plugins are present.
  • Migrated to the renamed LSP API (LspIntegrationProvider / ProjectWideLspClientDescriptor) to drop deprecated API usages. Minimum supported IDE version is now 2026.2.

0.3.1

  • LSP support is now an optional dependency, so the plugin installs on IntelliJ IDEA Community and other IDEs without the LSP module (LSP features only activate where the module is present).
  • Replaced deprecated TextAttributesKey.createTextAttributesKey(name, TextAttributes) calls with platform color-key fallbacks; replaced deprecated file-chooser APIs in the Settings panel.

0.3.0

  • Real PSI parser: every Typecek tag becomes a typed PSI node, blocks (#if/#for/#with/#switch/#layout/#raw) wrap as BLOCK_STATEMENT.
  • Tag completion (previously implemented but never registered) now actually fires inside {{ }}.
  • Cmd-/Ctrl-click on partial, layout, and import paths now navigates to the referenced file (previously dead code).
  • Annotator: detects unmatched openers/closers, mismatched pairs (e.g. {{#if}} closed with {{/for}}), duplicate #layout, and unknown directives.
  • Brace matcher for {{ }} and {{{ }}}; commenter for {{! ... }}.
  • Folding for blocks and multi-line comments; structure view (Cmd-7) shows imports + nested blocks.
  • Color settings page under Settings | Editor | Color Scheme | Typecek.
  • Settings UI for Node.js path and LSP options under Settings | Languages & Frameworks | Typecek.
  • Balloon notification when Node.js cannot be found, with action to open the new settings panel.
  • Multi-import support: templates with multiple {{#import T from "..."}} directives now resolve all of them.
  • Lexer recognizes triple-brace raw output {{{ ... }}} and per-prefix tag tokens (#, /, >, !, @).
  • Completion list updated to upstream syntax: #for (was #each), #switch/#case/#default, #raw, #empty, @content/@index/@first/@last/@length.
  • Removed dead code: duplicate goto-declaration handler and standalone documentation provider.
  • Added lexer + parser test suites with golden PSI dumps.

0.2.0

  • Delegate host-code highlighting to native WebStorm TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and SCSS highlighters, while highlighting Typecek tags separately.

idea-plugin.name: JSON Tools pro max
idea-plugin.description:
JSON Tools pro max — English

A side-tool-window plugin for IntelliJ-based IDEs: format JSON safely and compare two JSON payloads semantically (object key order and array element order are ignored). Optimized for very large JSON: parsing and diff run off the EDT with staged rendering so huge payloads remain usable without freezing the IDE.

  • Huge JSON, responsive UI: asynchronous compute plus minimized incremental DOM/editor churn when painting diff highlights and formatting large outputs.
  • Strict formatting: catches common non-RFC issues early (trailing commas, comments, single-quoted strings, etc.) plus Gson RFC 8259 strict parsing; errors point to line/column where possible.
  • Semantic diff: side-by-side highlighted results; sensible array pairing (exact match, stable id when present, structure fingerprint when only volatile ids differ, similarity fallback).
  • Workflow: after compare, opens the result view automatically and jumps to the first difference; use Prev/Next to walk highlights; primary button toggles between result and edit.
  • Tree view: optional tree explorer inside the Format tab (expand/collapse controls).
  • UI & i18n: heavy work runs off the UI thread; interface strings support multiple languages with an optional manual language override (persisted across restarts).

JSON Tools pro max — 简体中文

适用于 IntelliJ 系列 IDE 的侧栏工具窗口插件：安全格式化 JSON，并对两份 JSON 做语义对比（忽略对象键顺序与数组元素顺序）。面向超大 JSON：耗时解析与对比在后台执行，渲染侧避免细碎频繁的增量更新，尽量做到大体量文档仍流畅、IDE 不易卡顿。

  • 超大 JSON、流畅优先：异步计算；格式化与差异高亮采用「先装入全文再分段着色」等策略，减轻界面抖动与长时间冻结。
  • 严格格式化：先用扫描层拦截尾逗号、注释、单引号等非标准写法，再结合 Gson 的 RFC 8259 严格解析；错误信息尽量包含行列提示。
  • 语义 Diff：左右分栏高亮；数组元素采用精确匹配、稳定 id（若有）、仅易变 id 变化时的结构指纹配对，以及相似度兜底，减少整块误标。
  • 使用流程：对比完成后自动进入结果视图并定位到第一处差异；可用上一处/下一处浏览；主按钮在「对比」与「返回编辑」之间切换。
  • 树形视图：在「格式化」标签内可切换到树形结构浏览（支持展开/折叠工具条）。
  • 界面与多语言：解析与对比在后台线程执行；界面支持多语言，并可手动选择语言（重启后仍保留手动设置）。

JSON Tools pro max — Deutsch

Seitenbereich für IntelliJ-basierte IDEs: JSON sicher formatieren und zwei Dokumente semantisch vergleichen (Reihenfolge von Objektschlüsseln und Arrayelementen wird ignoriert). Für sehr große JSON optimiert: Parsing und Diff laufen nicht auf dem EDT; gestuftes Rendering, damit große Daten nutzbar bleiben ohne die IDE einzufrieren.

  • Riesiges JSON, flüssige UI: asynchrone Berechnung und weniger feinkörnige DOM-/Editor-Updates bei Diff-Hervorhebung und Formatierung großer Ausgaben.
  • Strikte Formatierung: frühe Erkennung gängiger Nicht-RFC-Probleme (Schlusskommas, Kommentare, einfache Anführungszeichen usw.) plus Gson RFC-8259-Striktmodus; Fehler mit Zeile/Spalte wo möglich.
  • Semantischer Diff: nebeneinander mit Hervorhebung; sinnvolle Array-Zuordnung (exakte Übereinstimmung, stabile ID falls vorhanden, Struktur-Fingerprint wenn nur volatile IDs wechseln, Ähnlichkeits-Fallback).
  • Ablauf: nach dem Vergleich automatisch Ergebnisansicht und Sprung zur ersten Differenz; Vor/Zurück durch Hervorhebungen; Hauptbutton zwischen Ergebnis und Bearbeitung.
  • Baumansicht: optionaler Baum im Register „Formatieren“ (Ein-/Ausklappen).
  • Oberfläche & i18n: schwere Arbeit im Hintergrund; viele Sprachen, optionale manuelle Sprachwahl (über Neustarts gespeichert).

JSON Tools pro max — Français

Fenêtre d’outil latérale pour les IDE IntelliJ : formater le JSON en toute sécurité et comparer deux documents sémantiquement (ordre des clés d’objet et des éléments de tableau ignoré). Optimisé pour les très gros JSON : analyse et diff hors fil d’interface, rendu par étapes pour éviter de figer l’IDE.

  • Gros JSON, interface fluide : calcul asynchrone et moins de mises à jour DOM/éditeur fines lors du surlignage des diffs et du formatage de gros résultats.
  • Formatage strict : détection précoce des écarts non RFC (virgules finales, commentaires, guillemets simples, etc.) plus Gson en mode strict RFC 8259 ; erreurs avec ligne/colonne si possible.
  • Diff sémantique : résultats côte à côte colorés ; appariement raisonnable des tableaux (égalité exacte, id stable, empreinte structurelle si seuls les ids volatiles changent, repli par similarité).
  • Flux de travail : après comparaison, ouverture automatique de la vue résultat et saut à la première différence ; Préc./Suiv. ; bouton principal pour basculer résultat / édition.
  • Vue arborescente : explorateur optionnel dans l’onglet Format (déplier/replier).
  • IU & i18n : tâches lourdes hors thread UI ; plusieurs langues et langue manuelle persistante après redémarrage.

JSON Tools pro max — Русский

Боковая панель для IDE на платформе IntelliJ: безопасное форматирование JSON и семантическое сравнение двух документов (порядок ключей объектов и элементов массивов не учитывается). Оптимизация под очень большие JSON: разбор и diff не на EDT, поэтапная отрисовка — большие файлы остаются пригодными без зависания IDE.

  • Большие JSON, отзывчивый интерфейс: фоновые вычисления и минимизация частых инкрементальных обновлений DOM/редактора при подсветке diff и форматировании.
  • Строгое форматирование: раннее выявление типичных отступлений от RFC (лишние запятые, комментарии, одинарные кавычки и т.д.) плюс Gson STRICT RFC 8259; по возможности строка/столбец в ошибках.
  • Семантический diff: две колонки с подсветкой; разумное сопоставление элементов массивов (точное совпадение, стабильный id, структурный отпечаток при смене только volatile id, запасной вариант по сходству).
  • Сценарий: после сравнения автоматически открывается результат и переход к первому отличию; Назад/Вперёд по подсветкам; основная кнопка переключает результат и редактирование.
  • Дерево: необязательное дерево во вкладке «Формат» (развернуть/свернуть).
  • Интерфейс и языки: тяжёлая работа вне EDT; несколько языков и ручной выбор языка (сохраняется после перезапуска).

JSON Tools pro max — 日本語

IntelliJ 系 IDE 向けサイドツールウィンドウ。セマンティックに JSON を整形・比較（オブジェクトのキー順と配列要素の順序は無視）。超大規模 JSON 向け：解析と diff は EDT 外で実行し、段階的レンダリングにより IDE をフリーズさせずに大きなデータを扱えます。

  • 巨大 JSON と応答性：非同期処理と、diff 強調・大出力フォーマット時の細かすぎる DOM/エディタ更新の抑制。
  • 厳密な整形：RFC でない記法（末尾カンマ、コメント、シングルクォートなど）の早期検出に加え Gson の RFC 8259 厳密モード；エラーは可能なら行/列を表示。
  • セマンティック diff：左右並べて強調表示；配列要素の妥当な対応付け（完全一致、安定 id、volatile id のみ変化時の構造フィンガープリント、類似度フォールバック）。
  • 操作フロー：比較後は結果ビューを自動表示し最初の差分へジャンプ；前へ/次へで強調を巡回；メインボタンで結果と編集を切り替え。
  • ツリー表示：フォーマットタブ内のオプションのツリー（展開/折りたたみ）。
  • UI と多言語：重い処理は UI スレッド外；多言語 UI と手動の言語上書き（再起動後も保持）。

JSON Tools pro max — 한국어

IntelliJ 계열 IDE용 사이드 도구 창입니다. JSON을 안전하게 포맷하고 두 문서를 의미상 비교합니다(객체 키 순서와 배열 요소 순서 무시). 초대형 JSON 최적화: 파싱과 diff는 EDT 밖에서 실행하고 단계적 렌더링으로 IDE 멈춤 없이 큰 페이로드를 다룹니다.

  • 대용량 JSON과 반응성: 비동기 처리와 diff 강조·대용량 출력 포맷 시 DOM/편집기의 잦은 증분 업데이트 최소화.
  • 엄격한 포맷: 비표준 패턴(후행 쉼표, 주석, 작은따옴표 문자열 등) 조기 차단 및 Gson RFC 8259 STRICT 파싱; 가능하면 행/열 안내.
  • 의미론적 diff: 좌우 나란히 강조; 배열 요소 현명한 매칭(정확 일치, 안정적 id, volatile id만 바뀔 때 구조 지문, 유사도 폴백).
  • 워크플로: 비교 후 결과 보기 자동 전환 및 첫 차이로 이동; 이전/다음으로 강조 탐색; 주 버튼으로 결과와 편집 전환.
  • 트리 뷰: 포맷 탭 내 선택적 트리(펼치기/접기).
  • UI 및 다국어: 무거운 작업은 UI 스레드 밖; 여러 언어 및 수동 언어 선택(재시작 후 유지).

JSON Tools pro max — العربية

نافذة أدوات جانبية لبيئات IntelliJ: تنسيق JSON بأمان ومقارنة مستندين دلاليًا (تُتجاهل ترتيب مفاتيح الكائنات وترتيب عناصر المصفوفات). محسّنة لملفات JSON الضخمة جدًا: التحليل والفرق خارج EDT مع عرض تدريجي لتقليل تجمّد IDE.

  • JSON كبير وواجهة سلسة: حساب غير متزامن وتقليل تحديثات DOM/المحرّر الدقيقة عند تمييز الفروق وتنسيق المخرجات الكبيرة.
  • تنسيق صارم: اعتراض مبكر لمخالفات شائعة لـ RFC (فواصل زائدة، تعليقات، سلاسل بعلامات اقتباس مفردة، إلخ) مع Gson بدقة RFC 8259؛ رسائل تشير إلى السطر/العمود إن أمكن.
  • فرق دلالي: عرضان ملونان جنبًا إلى جنب؛ مطابقة ذكية لعناصر المصفوفات (تطابق تام، معرّف ثابت، بصمة بنيوية عند تغيّر المعرفات المتقلبة فقط، احتياط بالتشابه).
  • سير العمل: بعد المقارنة يُفتح عرض النتيجة والانتقال تلقائيًا إلى أول فرق؛ سابق/تالي؛ زر رئيسي للتبديل بين النتيجة والتحرير.
  • عرض شجري: مستكشف اختياري في تبويب التنسيق (توسيع/طي).
  • واجهة وتعدد لغات: العمل الثقيل خارج خيط الواجهة؛ دعم لغات متعددة واختيار يدوي يبقى بعد إعادة التشغيل.

JSON Tools pro max — Türkçe

IntelliJ tabanlı IDE’ler için yan araç penceresi: JSON’u güvenle biçimlendirin ve iki yükü anlamsal olarak karşılaştırın (nesne anahtarı ve dizi öğesi sırası yok sayılır). Çok büyük JSON için optimize: ayrıştırma ve diff EDT dışında; aşamalı çizim ile IDE’nin donması engellenir.

  • Dev JSON, akıcı arayüz: eşzamansız işlem ve diff vurgusu ile büyük çıktı biçimlendirmede gereksiz artımlı DOM/düzenleyici güncellemelerinin azaltılması.
  • Sıkı biçimlendirme: RFC dışı yaygın sorunlar (sondaki virgüller, yorumlar, tek tırnaklı dizeler vb.) için erken yakalama ve Gson RFC 8259 sıkı ayrıştırma; mümkünse satır/sütun.
  • Anlamsal diff: yan yana vurgulu sonuçlar; dizi eşlemesi (tam eşleşme, varsa sabit kimlik, yalnızca uçucu kimlikler değişince yapı parmak izi, benzerlik yedeği).
  • İş akışı: karşılaştırma sonrası sonuç görünümü ve ilk farka atlama; Önceki/Sonraki; ana düğme sonuç ile düzenleme arasında geçiş.
  • Ağaç görünümü: Biçim sekmesinde isteğe bağlı ağaç (genişlet/daralt).
  • Arayüz ve çok dillilik: ağır iş UI iş parçacığı dışında; çoklu dil ve elle seçilen dil (yeniden başlatmada kalır).

JSON Tools pro max — Español

Complemento de ventana lateral para IDE basados en IntelliJ: formatea JSON de forma segura y compara dos cargas en el sentido semántico (se ignora el orden de claves de objeto y de elementos en arrays). Optimizado para JSON muy grandes: el análisis y el diff se ejecutan fuera del EDT, con renderizado por fases para que cargas enormes sigan siendo útiles sin congelar el IDE.

  • JSON enorme, interfaz fluida: cómputo asíncrono y menos actualizaciones incrementales finas del DOM/editor al resaltar diferencias y formatear salidas grandes.
  • Formateo estricto: detecta pronto problemas habituales fuera de RFC (comas finales, comentarios, cadenas con comillas simples, etc.) más análisis estricto Gson RFC 8259; los errores indican línea/columna cuando es posible.
  • Diff semántico: resultados lado a lado resaltados; emparejamiento razonable de arrays (coincidencia exacta, id estable si existe, huella estructural cuando solo cambian ids volátiles, respaldo por similitud).
  • Flujo de trabajo: tras comparar, abre la vista de resultados y salta al primer cambio; Anterior/Siguiente recorre resaltados; el botón principal alterna resultado y edición.
  • Vista en árbol: explorador opcional en la pestaña Formato (expandir/contraer).
  • IU e i18n: el trabajo pesado va fuera del hilo de interfaz; varios idiomas y anulación manual de idioma (persiste tras reiniciar).

JSON Tools pro max — Português

Plugin de janela lateral para IDEs IntelliJ: formate JSON com segurança e compare duas cargas semanticamente (ordem de chaves de objeto e de elementos em arrays é ignorada). Otimizado para JSON muito grande: análise e diff fora da EDT, renderização em etapas para que o IDE não trave.

  • JSON grande, IU responsiva: processamento assíncrono e menos atualizações incrementais ao pintar destaques de diff e formatar saídas grandes.
  • Formatação rigorosa: intercepta cedo problemas fora da RFC (vírgulas finais, comentários, strings com aspas simples etc.) mais Gson STRICT RFC 8259; erros com linha/coluna quando possível.
  • Diff semântico: resultados lado a lado destacados; pareamento sensato de arrays (match exato, id estável, impressão estrutural quando só ids voláteis mudam, fallback por similaridade).
  • Fluxo: após comparar, abre o resultado e vai à primeira diferença; Ant./Próx.; botão principal alterna resultado e edição.
  • Vista em árvore: explorador opcional na aba Formatar (expandir/recolher).
  • IU e idiomas: trabalho pesado fora da thread da IU; vários idiomas e idioma manual persistente após reinício.

JSON Tools pro max — हिन्दी

IntelliJ आधारित IDE के लिए साइड टूल विंडो: JSON को सुरक्षित रूप से फ़ॉर्मेट करें और दो दस्तावेज़ों का अर्थगत अंतर देखें (ऑब्जेक्ट कुंजी और ऐरे तत्वों का क्रम नज़रअंदाज़)। बहुत बड़े JSON के लिए अनुकूलित: पार्सिंग और diff EDT से अलग; चरणबद्ध रेंडरिंग से IDE जमना कम होता है।

  • विशाल JSON, चिकना UI: असिंक्रोनस गणना और diff हाइलाइटिंग तथा बड़े आउटपुट फ़ॉर्मेटिंग पर बार‑बार छोटे DOM/संपादक अपडेट कम करना।
  • सख्त फ़ॉर्मेटिंग: गैर‑RFC समस्याएँ (अंतिम अल्पविराम, टिप्पणियाँ, एकल‑उद्धरण स्ट्रिंग आदि) जल्द पकड़ना और Gson RFC 8259 सख्त पार्सिंग; संभव हो तो पंक्ति/स्तंभ।
  • अर्थगत diff: दोहरे रंगीन परिणाम; स्मार्ट ऐरे मिलान (सटीक मेल, स्थिर id, केवल अस्थिर id बदलने पर संरचना फिंगरप्रिंट, समानता फ़ॉलबैक)।
  • कार्यप्रवाह: तुलना के बाद स्वचालित परिणाम दृश्य और पहले अंतर पर जाना; पिछला/अगला; मुख्य बटन परिणाम और संपादन के बीच।
  • ट्री दृश्य: फ़ॉर्मेट टैब में वैकल्पिक ट्री (फैलाना/संकुचित करना)।
  • UI और बहुभाषी: भारी कार्य UI थ्रेड के बाहर; कई भाषाएँ और मैन्युअल भाषा चयन (रीस्टार्ट के बाद भी)।

idea-plugin.name: ROS Interface Syntax Highlighter
idea-plugin.description:
ROS Interface Syntax Highlighting for CLion

Provides syntax highlighting for ROS Interface definition files:

  • .msg - ROS Message definitions
  • .srv - ROS Service definitions
  • .action - ROS Action definitions

Features

  • Syntax highlighting for built-in types (bool, int32, float64, string, etc.)
  • Highlighting of package/type references (std_msgs/Header)
  • Field name and constant highlighting
  • Number, float, and boolean literal highlighting
  • Quoted and unquoted string highlighting
  • Comment highlighting (# line comments)
  • Separator highlighting (---, ===, MSG:)
  • @optional attribute highlighting
  • Array bracket matching

Uses the ROS Interface TextMate grammar via the IntelliJ TextMate Bundles plugin for reliable, high-quality syntax highlighting.

idea-plugin.name: SqlToy Navigator
idea-plugin.description:
SqlToy Navigator helps developers jump between Java sqlId strings and XML SQL definitions.

SqlToy Navigator 是一款面向 SqlToy ORM 项目的 IntelliJ IDEA 插件， 用于在 Java 代码中的 sqlId 字符串与 XML 文件中的 SQL 定义之间快速跳转。

在 SqlToy 项目中，SQL 通常定义在 XML 文件中，Java 代码通过字符串形式引用对应的 sqlId。当项目规模变大后，开发者经常需要在 Java 类、XML 文件和搜索结果之间反复切换， 不仅效率较低，也容易出现定位错误。

SqlToy Navigator 可以减少手动搜索成本，让 sqlId 定位、SQL 查看和代码维护更加直观高效。是最贴近于日常开发的跳转插件，覆盖场景多。

核心功能

  • 支持从 Java sqlId 字符串跳转到 XML 中对应的 SQL 定义。
  • 支持从 XML SQL 定义跳转回 Java 使用位置。
  • 在 Java 字符串和 XML id 属性旁显示双向导航行标记。
  • 添加 include 函数跳转支持。

idea-plugin.name: Python Role Lens
idea-plugin.description:
Adds IDE awareness for the Role / delegation pattern in Python, where a class subclasses Role[SomeTaker] and forwards attribute access to a wrapped instance through __getattr__.

The members of the taker class — together with everything it inherits, and any nested roles — become available on the role instance for code completion, type inference, and Go to Declaration (Ctrl/Cmd+Click), without using inheritance.

Getting started

Install the plugin and restart — there is nothing to configure. It activates automatically for any class that takes on a role by subclassing a Role[Taker] base that delegates through __getattr__. 

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from krrood.patterns.role import Role

@dataclass
class Person:
    name: str
    age: int
    def greet(self) -> str:
        return f"Hi, I'm {self.name}"

@dataclass
class Teacher(Role[Person]):                    # the taker type is the generic argument
    courses: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)

teacher = Teacher(role_taker=Person("Ahmed", 20))
teacher.name       # completes, inferred as str
teacher.greet()    # completes; Ctrl/Cmd-Click jumps to Person.greet
teacher.courses    # the role's own field

What you get

  • Code completion after . on a role instance — the taker's attributes and methods appear.
  • Type inference — a delegated attribute is typed from its real declaration.
  • Go to Declaration (Ctrl/Cmd+Click), Find Usages, and Rename all resolve to the real member in the taker class.

It also handles transitive roles (a subclass of a role), inherited taker members (the taker's own base classes), and nested roles (a taker that is itself a role).

Requirements

Works out of the box with krrood's Role, and with any Role[...] base that delegates via __getattr__. The role taker is read from the Role[...] generic argument.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.2.0 — The role taker is now resolved solely from the Role[Taker] generic argument, matching krrood's move to an inherited keyword-only role_taker field (the role_taker_field() declaration was removed). Roles must declare Role[Taker] for their taker's members to be injected.
0.1.0 — Initial release. Completion, type inference, and Go to Declaration for the Role / delegation pattern: the taker's members (plus everything it inherits and any nested roles) are injected onto a role declared with Role[Taker]. A Role[T] parameterised by a bounded TypeVar resolves to its bound.

使用方法

idea-plugin.name: ApiHelper
idea-plugin.description:
ApiHelper

A lightweight API assistant for Spring MVC, Spring Cloud OpenFeign, and Spring 6 @HttpExchange, built for endpoint navigation, endpoint browsing, and API debugging directly inside IntelliJ IDEA.

Features

  • Bidirectional gutter navigation between @FeignClient / @HttpExchange interfaces and @RestController methods.
  • Controller gutter actions — right-click Controller gutter arrows to debug the endpoint or copy the resolved URL.
  • Endpoint explorer — browse Controller and Feign / HttpExchange endpoints from the ApiHelper tool window.
  • Markdown API docs — copy endpoint documentation with request parameters, request body fields, response fields, and descriptions from Javadocs or Swagger annotations.
  • API debugging — send HTTP requests with query, path, header, cookie, and body parameters.
  • Body modes — supports none, form-data, x-www-form-urlencoded, JSON, XML, raw, and binary requests.
  • Large payload friendly — streams file uploads and limits response preview size to reduce memory usage.
  • Spring configuration aware — automatically resolves server.servlet.context-path, spring.mvc.servlet.path, application-{profile}.yml and ${var:default} placeholders.
  • Java & Kotlin sources, courtesy of UAST.
  • Project-level caching with incremental refresh on PSI and Spring configuration changes.
  • Bilingual UI — English & Simplified Chinese bundle.

Compatibility

IntelliJ IDEA 2024.3+ (build 243+). Requires the bundled Java and Kotlin plugins.

Links

  • Source on GitHub
  • Changelog
  • Report an issue
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.3

  • Fixed counterpart matching failing entirely in projects with a configured server.servlet.context-path; matching now uses the relative path without the context-path.
  • Fixed matching failures when path variable names differ between the two sides, e.g. {id} vs {userId}.
  • Fixed a brief empty-cache window during full cache rebuilds that caused gutter icon flicker; caches are now replaced atomically.
  • Debug requests can now be cancelled while sending, and honor the IDE global HTTP proxy settings.
  • Debug connect and request timeouts are now configurable under Settings → Tools → ApiHelper.
  • Counterpart matching queries now use an inverted index for O(1) lookups, and PSI-driven cache rebuilds are debounced.

1.0.2

  • Added a native IDE-style endpoint context menu with "Copy API Docs".
  • API docs now generate standard Markdown and include endpoint metadata, descriptions, Path / Query / Header / Cookie parameters, request body fields, and response fields.
  • API docs extract field and parameter descriptions from Javadocs, @param, and Swagger annotations.
  • DTO parameters are expanded for Query and request body sections, including @SpringQueryMap / @QueryMap.
  • Generic response wrappers such as DllResult<T>, DllPageResult<T>, and List<T> are expanded into fields such as data[].field and records[].field.
  • Improved multi-keyword endpoint search and manual endpoint refresh behavior.
  • Optimized large file debug requests by streaming binary and form-data uploads.
  • Limited debug response body preview to the first 5 MB to reduce memory usage.
  • Fixed transient IntelliJ index and PSI-change issues during endpoint refresh.

1.0.1

  • Removed debugger entry from Feign / HttpExchange endpoint list context menus.
  • Automatically prefill Path, Query, Header, Cookie, and JSON Body draft parameters when opening the debugger from an endpoint.
  • Controller gutter context menus now support both debugging the endpoint and copying the resolved URL.
  • Feign / HttpExchange gutter icons keep left-click navigation only, with no context-menu actions.

1.0.0

  • Initial ApiHelper release.
  • Added Spring MVC Controller, OpenFeign, and @HttpExchange endpoint navigation.
  • Added endpoint explorer and lightweight API debugger in the ApiHelper tool window.
  • Added Query, Path, Header, Cookie, form-data, x-www-form-urlencoded, JSON, XML, raw, and binary request support.
  • Added Spring configuration resolution for context path, servlet path, profile, server port, and placeholders.
  • Added Java and Kotlin source support via UAST.
  • English & Simplified Chinese bundle.

idea-plugin.name: OpenCode Web Panel
idea-plugin.description:
OpenCode Web Panel brings the official OpenCode web UI into JetBrains IDEs. Use it in a right-side tool window or move the live panel into an editor tab. It stays focused on the project you are working on and adds small IDE conveniences on top of the normal OpenCode experience. Host CLI and Docker Sandbox work with OpenCode 1.18 and CLI 2.x.

Note: This is an unofficial community plugin for OpenCode and is not affiliated with OpenCode.

Why use it

  • OpenCode where you code - Use OpenCode beside your editor instead of switching to the terminal, desktop app, or standalone web app.
  • Official web UI - The embedded panel loads OpenCode's own web app, so the core experience stays familiar.
  • Project-aware sessions - OpenCode starts on the directory configured for the current IDE project.
  • Optional Docker Sandboxes - Run OpenCode inside a per-project Docker Sandbox (sbx) instead of a host opencode serve. Native CLI remains the default.
  • IDE file navigation - Click local file links and code references from chat to open them in the IDE.
  • Chat file drop and paste - Drag or paste project files into chat as @relative/path references, or attach dropped files.
  • Send code to chat - Add files or the current selection to the OpenCode chat from the editor and project view context menus.
  • External links stay outside - HTTP links open in your system browser instead of taking over the panel.
  • IDE notifications - OpenCode browser notifications can appear as JetBrains IDE notifications, including Allow/Deny actions for agent permission requests.
  • Agent status at a glance - The tool window icon shows when the agent is working or waiting for your input.
  • Optional workspace warning - Opt in to an IDE warning when a selected conversation belongs to a different directory than this project.
  • Tool window or editor tab - Move the same live panel between hosts without reloading or losing an unsent draft. Zoom, restart, and other controls are available in both.
  • Recovery built in - Failed or crashed servers surface a clear error panel with recent logs, retry, and settings shortcuts, and the panel recovers automatically where possible.
  • Configurable safeguards - Browser-side convenience features can be disabled if an OpenCode update conflicts with them.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Changed

  • Refactor configuration, settings, server, and browser internals into explicit, acyclic layers enforced by ArchUnit tests.
  • Expand live browser and JCEF regression coverage for OpenCode 1.18 and 2.x, including OpenCode 2.0.25.
  • Replace Python with Node.js for persisted-storage contract checks and enforce consistent Kotlin formatting with ktfmt.

Fixed

  • Compatibility checks follow statically imported OpenCode assets and classify new origin-owned storage keys, avoiding false failures with OpenCode 2.0.25.
