idea-plugin.name: Nest Switch
idea-plugin.description:
Jumping around a NestJS module means hunting through the project tree: the controller is next to the service, but the DTOs are in dto/, the entity is in entities/, and the spec is wherever it landed. Nest Switch puts the whole module one keystroke away.

Press Ctrl+Alt+Home (⌃⌘↑ on macOS), or Navigate → Related Symbol…, from any file in a Nest module, and the standard platform popup lists every file of that module, grouped by role. Type to filter, Enter to open, Shift+Enter to open in a split.

What counts as "the module"

The nearest folder above the current file that declares a *.module.ts. Every .ts/.tsx/.js/.jsx file beneath it is listed — sub-folders included — so dto/create-user.dto.ts and entities/user.entity.ts show up alongside the controller and service. Nested modules keep their own scope: a sub-folder with its own *.module.ts is left out, so a parent module never swallows its children.

Grouped by role, not dumped in a list

Items are sorted into sections — Module, Controllers, Services, Resolvers, Gateways, Providers, Repositories, Entities, Schemas, DTOs, Interfaces, Guards, Strategies, Interceptors, Pipes, Middleware, Filters, Decorators, Mappers, Listeners, Tasks, Events, Tests, and more. The role comes from the file name (create-user.dto.ts → DTOs); when the name carries no role, the sub-folder names the section (entities/ → Entities). Files in sub-folders are labelled with their path, so dto/create-user.dto.ts is never ambiguous.

Quiet by design

  • No icons, no gutter markers, no inlay hints — nothing is added to your editor.
  • Inert outside Nest — silent unless the project actually depends on @nestjs/*.
  • Nothing to configure — no settings page, no setup.
  • Every JetBrains IDE, 2023.3+ — core platform APIs only, so Community editions work too, with no dependency on the JavaScript/TypeScript plugin.

idea-plugin.name: Worktree Sync
idea-plugin.description:
Sync IDEA and Maven project settings, plus Claude Code sessions, across Git worktrees.

面向 AI Agent 并行 vibe coding 的 worktree 配置同步：打开新 worktree 时弹窗选一次来源， 自动继承 IDEA 与 Maven 设置，并同步 Agent 的配置与会话记录。

「一个仓库开多个 git worktree、每个 worktree 跑一个 agent」是常见的并行开发姿势， 但每开一个新 worktree 都要重踩两遍同样的坑：

  • IDEA 项目设置不会跟过来 — worktree 的 .idea 由 IDE 重新生成， 主仓库里调好的编译进程堆、Maven home、settings.xml、本地仓库都不会复制过去。 少设一次构建堆就可能编译 OOM，少设一次 Maven 就找不到私有仓库。
  • Agent 会话对不上 — 会话按工作目录绝对路径分目录存放，换 worktree 路径就是全新 project， 历史对话看不到，agent 失去上下文。

本插件把它变成打开项目时的一次选择。

同步内容（IDEA 与 Maven 两组走官方 API 写入、即时生效， 无需重启，也不会在 IDE 退出时被内存里的旧值覆盖）：

  • 编译进程堆大小、构建 VM options、全局编码
  • Maven home、user settings.xml、本地仓库、离线模式、线程数、远程仓库列表
  • Agent 项目配置：.claude/settings.json、.mcp.json、CLAUDE.md（当前支持 Claude Code）
  • Agent 会话记录：按 cwd slug 迁移，并把会话内的 cwd 改写成新路径

怎么用：打开 worktree 时弹窗选来源（继承某个 worktree / 使用 IDEA 默认）与同步项； 勾上「记住本次选择」后，同一项目之后静默应用。来源通过解析 .git 里的 gitdir 自动探测， 零外部 git 命令依赖。非 worktree 的普通项目不会被弹窗打扰； 需要时也可以从 Tools → Sync Worktree Settings... 手动触发。

English

Sync IDEA and Maven project settings, plus Claude Code sessions, across Git worktrees.

A new worktree gets a regenerated .idea directory, so the compiler heap, Maven home, settings.xml and local repository from your main checkout are lost — miss the heap once and the build fails with GC overhead limit exceeded. Agent sessions are keyed by the working directory's absolute path, so a new path also means an empty history.

This plugin turns both into one choice at project open. IDEA and Maven settings are written through official APIs and apply immediately, with no restart; Claude Code project config and session transcripts are copied over with the stored cwd rewritten. Sibling worktrees are found from the gitdir pointer inside .git, and plain non-worktree projects are never prompted.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.1

  • 修复 Marketplace 校验未通过的问题：去掉全部 @ApiStatus.Internal 用法。 Maven home 改用公开的 setMavenHome；本地仓库与 toolchains 路径改为「只写不读」 （它们的 getter 是 internal）；不再显式设置 Maven home 类型 —— 交由 IDEA 自行解析。
  • 插件目标 Java 版本由 21 升到 25，与 IntelliJ Platform 2026.2 的要求一致。
  • 在主仓库（.git 是目录）里打开配置弹窗时，候选 worktree 列表不再为空。
  • 修复弹窗里「当前项目编译堆」提示行被分组边框裁切的问题。

English: Removed all @ApiStatus.Internal usages that made the Marketplace verifier reject the plugin; raised the target Java level to 25; fixed an empty worktree list when the dialog is opened from the main repository; fixed a clipped hint row in the dialog.

1.0.0 首次发布

  • 打开 worktree 时弹窗选一次来源，自动继承 IDEA 构建设置（编译进程堆、构建 VM options、全局编码） 与 Maven 设置（Maven home、settings.xml、本地仓库、离线模式、线程数、远程仓库列表）， 全部走官方 API、即时生效，并对关键项读回校验。
  • 同步 Agent 项目级配置（.claude/settings.json、.mcp.json、CLAUDE.md） 与 Claude Code 会话记录，并改写会话内的 cwd；目标已存在的文件默认不覆盖。
  • 解析 .git 里的 gitdir 自动发现同仓库 worktree（主仓库与 worktree 两种形态都支持）， 零外部 git 命令依赖。
  • 每个项目只询问一次并记住选择；非 worktree 的普通项目不会被弹窗打扰。

English: First release. Syncs IDEA build settings and Maven settings through official APIs (immediate effect, verified by reading back), syncs Claude Code project config and session transcripts with cwd rewritten, discovers sibling worktrees from the gitdir pointer, asks once per project.

idea-plugin.name: ModuleLoom
idea-plugin.description:
ModuleLoom - Python Architecture & Automated Documentation Engine

ModuleLoom brings real-time Python module dependency graph visualization, architectural diagnostics, and an automated manual documentation engine with local AI integration directly into your PyCharm environment.

🌟 Key Features

  • 🔍 Real-time Dependency & Cycle Detection: Visualize complex package structures, trace circular import paths, and navigate directly to source files with one click.
  • 📖 Documentation Engine: Manage screenshot instructions and register PNG images of the target application, generate Mermaid architecture diagrams from AST, and publish Markdown and API references as MkDocs sites.
  • 🚨 Code Quality & Architecture Diagnostics: Multi-angle inspection of bloat, duplicate code (bundled jscpd v5), cyclomatic complexity (Lizard/AST), and missing type annotations. Automatically installs diagnostics skills to detected coding agents (Codex, Claude Code, Cursor).
  • 🤖 Local AI Integration: Connects to Codex, Claude Code, Grok, or Agy CLI using your local authentication without requiring extra API keys.
  • ⚙️ Centralized Settings: Easy configuration popup for HTML output destination, Markdown source directory, and AI CLI/model selection.
  • 🌐 Dual Language: Full support for English and Japanese (switchable in View → Language).

🇯🇵 日本語での特徴

  • 🔍 依存関係 & 循環インポートのリアルタイム可視化: 複雑なモジュール関係や循環インポート経路を可視化し、エディタと連携して即座に修正可能。
  • 📖 ドキュメント生成エンジン: 対象アプリの撮影指示とPNGの登録、Mermaid依存図、DocstringからのAPIリファレンスを原稿で管理し、MkDocsサイトをビルド。
  • 🚨 コード品質 & アーキテクチャ診断: 肥大化、重複コード（jscpd同梱）、循環、型チェックを多角的に診断し、コーディングエージェントへ診断スキルを自動導入。
  • 🤖 ローカル認証済み AI CLI 連携: Codex、Claude Code、Grok、Agy とAPIキー不要で連携。

idea-plugin.name: DevCraft
idea-plugin.description:
DevCraft is an extensible developer toolkit for IntelliJ IDEA. Its first tool generates Java 21, Spring Boot 4 and MyBatis-Flex CRUD code from a table selected in the Database tool window.

idea-plugin.name: Oracle JDK to Temurin Fixer
idea-plugin.description:
Moving off the Oracle JDK to Eclipse Temurin (Adoptium) or another OpenJDK build? This finds every place your project pulls an Oracle-licensed Java build and rewrites it to the free Temurin line — GitHub Actions setup-java, Dockerfile base images, Gradle toolchains (JvmVendorSpec.ORACLE), dev containers, Homebrew and winget — and tells you exactly what to do for the lines that need a human choice (SDKMAN, asdf / mise, Maven toolchains, Oracle Linux rpm installs, download URLs).

Why the date matters: Oracle's No-Fee Terms (NFTC) cover a Java LTS release until one year after the next LTS ships. The free window for JDK 21 closed on 2026-09-16 and for JDK 17 on 2024-09-19; Oracle JDK 8 and 11 builds are under the Oracle Technology Network license (development and test only). After that, Oracle prices Java SE on total headcount, contractors included.

  • Java map (free): Tools → Oracle JDK to Temurin Fixer: Java Map. Every place this project chooses a Java build, the JDKs this IDE runs it on (read from each JDK's own release file), and the Temurin / Corretto line for each place.
  • Inline check (free): 18 rules on Dockerfiles, CI workflows, Gradle and Maven files, SDKMAN, asdf and shell scripts, as you open them. Each finding names the license and the free line that replaces it.
  • Fix This File (free): rewrites the Oracle lines in the file you have open to Temurin, in one undo step.
  • Fix All in Project + migration record (Pro, JetBrains Marketplace licence): rewrites every Oracle line across the whole project in one step and writes a dated record next to the project — every line changed (before / after), every line that still needs a choice, the JDKs the IDE knows and the SHA-256 of every file read — for your team lead, an auditor or CI.

Runs inside the IDE: no Node.js, nothing leaves your machine. If usage statistics sharing is on in the IDE, one anonymous count per action (tool name and action only, never file content); set READYSTACK_NO_TELEMETRY=1 to turn it off. This plugin states what your files say on a date; it is not legal advice.
idea-plugin.change-notes: 1.1.0: Java map (which Java each part of the project pulls, and the free Temurin / Corretto line for each). The checks now run inside the IDE with no Node.js. 18 rules (was 9): SDKMAN and asdf vendor pins, Gradle and Maven toolchains, dev containers, Homebrew, winget, Chocolatey, oracle-actions/setup-java. Dated project report with file hashes.

idea-plugin.name: Streamlord
idea-plugin.description:
Datastar 1.0.4 as a language in IntelliJ IDEA (Community and Ultimate), 2026.1 and newer. Half of the Streamlord toolchain, and the half that needs no part of the other: it reads your HTML and template files whatever answers them, and your Kotlin strings alongside the Streamlord SDK.

Inspections in Kotlin strings, whether passed to a Streamlord call or free-standing (a function that returns HTML, a val holding a fragment), and in HTML and template files:

  • Kotlin interpolation of signals: "$count++" becomes "++" at runtime. An error with the fix spelled out. In HTML strings, $name inside a data-* expression is a warning; $name in text is a weak warning, since there it is usually meant.
  • Datastar expression syntax, checked with a real JavaScript parser, with the error at the right column.
  • Unknown actions (@Post), Pro actions and Pro attributes (they need the Pro bundle).
  • Markup in patchElements(...): unclosed or stray tags, text outside elements, a missing id on a top-level element when no selector is given, a mode that needs a selector.
  • data-* attributes: unknown names with "did you mean", unknown modifiers, wrong modifier arguments (__debounce without a duration, __threshold.150), missing or unexpected keys.
  • Casing: a capital letter in a key (data-signals:fooBar), which the browser lowercases so the signal becomes $foobar, and a hyphen after a signal in an expression ($foo-bar, $count-1), which Datastar swallows into one signal name. Both come with the fix. In the DSL the SDK writes a camelCase key correctly on its own, and a weak warning on the call shows what goes on the wire.

A string counts as HTML when it opens with a tag, a comment or a doctype, or when it carries @Language("HTML") or a // language=HTML comment. Multi-dollar literals ($$"""...""", Kotlin 2.2+) are read as Kotlin reads them: a single $ is text, so $count there is a signal. A call the Kotlin plugin resolves to something other than Streamlord is left alone.

Quick fixes on Alt+Enter: $count becomes increment("count"), signal("count"), toggle("open"), a $$ literal or an escaped ${'$'}count; __debunce becomes __debounce; @Post becomes @post; data-signal becomes data-signals; a missing duration, id or selector is added. Every message links to the matching page of the Datastar reference.

Completion: $ offers every signal name declared anywhere in the project (Kotlin DSL calls, @Serializable classes, HTML strings and templates), this file's first; @ offers actions; data- offers attributes; __ offers modifiers and their values; # and . in any selector argument offer the ids and classes declared in the project. When the official Datastar plugin is installed, the attribute names in HTML files are left to it, so nothing is listed twice.

Documentation on hover (Ctrl+Q) for every attribute, modifier and action, in HTML files, templates and HTML strings in Kotlin alike, and for the DSL functions where the Kotlin plugin has no KDoc to show.

Highlighting of Datastar expressions inside DSL strings and HTML strings, and of data-* attributes in HTML: prefix, plugin, key, modifiers and modifier arguments each get their own colour, and the attribute value is coloured as a Datastar expression. Only the Datastar tokens are coloured; your theme keeps everything else. Settings | Editor | Color Scheme | Streamlord.

HTML injection into Kotlin strings that open with a tag but carry no @Language("HTML"), so tags complete and close as in an HTML file. Streamlord's own parameters carry the annotation already.

Live templates for Ktor and Spring routes and the DSL calls in Kotlin, for a function that returns HTML as a $$"""...""" string (htmlFunction), and for every data-* attribute in HTML (data-on Tab).

Template languages: the HTML side runs wherever IntelliJ shows an HTML tree: .html (Thymeleaf), and with their plugins FreeMarker, Velocity, JTE, Mustache, Pebble and the rest. The engine's own syntax (${...}, !{...}, {{...}}, @if, #if, <#if>, [#if]) is left alone: an attribute value that contains it cannot be judged before rendering.

Stream Inspector (the Streamlord tool window): connect to a running endpoint with a method, signals and headers; every SSE event arrives decoded, and the signal store is kept exactly as the client would keep it. Non-SSE Datastar responses are shown with their datastar-* headers.

  • Saved requests live in .streamlord/inspector.json in the project, the same file the VS Code extension uses (commit it to share with the team, or ignore it). Save one with Save, and pick it again from the Request list, which also holds the recent ones and says how many of each it has. Delete removes the selected one.
  • Recent requests are remembered automatically, and the last one is prefilled on open.
  • Variables live in .streamlord/env.json in the project: three with a field of their own, and the params of your routes:

``json { "baseUrl": "http://127.0.0.1:8081", "signals": { "search": "ash" }, "headers": { "Authorization": "Bearer dev-token" }, "params": { "partsnummer": "3000507723", "instans": "m1" } } ``

| Variable | Use it in | Becomes | |---|---|---| | {{baseUrl}} | the URL | the text, without a trailing slash | | {{signals}} | the signals field | the object, as written in the file | | {{headers}} | the headers field | one Name: value line per entry | | {{partsnummer}}, any name in params | the URL or the headers | the text, encoded in the URL |

Type {{ in a field to pick from the ones that are set. Without baseUrl in the file, {{baseUrl}} is where the server you started from a run configuration said it listens, read from its own log (Tomcat started on port 9102 (http) with context path '/', or Ktor's Responding at …), so the port and context path are right wherever they were set. With nothing running, it is the Default base URL setting, http://localhost:8080 unless you change it.

The Variables box in the panel lists each value, and says when baseUrl is the default or which run configuration it came from. Edit variables opens the file, creating it with baseUrl filled in, and the panel picks up the file as you save it. Any other key, or a value of the wrong kind, is reported by name and stops the request until it is fixed; the file also has a JSON schema, so the editor marks it as you type. The file is the place for local hosts, tokens and test values, so keep it out of version control. A server that cannot be reached is reported together with the {{baseUrl}} it was reached through; when the file's baseUrl is not where a running server said it started, a link sets the file's value to that one, changing nothing else. localhost is tried as ::1 too, as curl and the browser do. An error response is shown with the warnings and errors the server logged while answering it, such as Spring's Required request parameter 'partsnummer' … is not present.

  • Gutter icons on every Ktor route (route("/api") { get("/feed") }) and Spring mapping (@GetMapping("/feed") under a class @RequestMapping): "Open in Stream Inspector" prefills the method and the whole URL the handler needs: each path parameter and each required @RequestParam as a {{name}}, and each required @RequestHeader("X-Id") as a line in the headers. A value that is not in params yet is reported with a link that adds it, empty, for you to fill in; the icon names the optional ones, such as required = false, which it leaves out.
  • Copy as curl puts an equivalent curl -N ... command on the clipboard.

Everything the plugin knows comes from catalog/datastar-1.0.4.json, which the SDK's own tests bind to the DSL, through streamlord-analysis, the same checks the VS Code extension makes.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• A signal no file in the project defines is a warning: data-on:click="$telefon++" on a page whose data-signals:teller declares $teller is underlined, where only the spell checker had something to say before. A defined name that is close, such as $count for $coutn, is the quick fix. Definitions are read from every Kotlin and markup file, as completion reads its names; a signal the index cannot see, set from a script, is reported too, and the inspection (Streamlord › Signal no file defines) can be turned off.
  • Signal completion honours __case (data-signals:my-value__case.snake offers $my_value), and reads template files across the project, not only the ones that are open: every extension in Settings › Tools › Streamlord's template list, .njk and .vue included.

idea-plugin.name: Commit Hike
idea-plugin.description:
Every commit you make moves you along a hiking trail, right inside your IDE. A day of steady work takes you about ten kilometers along a real mountain ridge, a desert crossing or a folk tale, with a scene that changes as you go, a map, stories, facts and achievements.

  • Real trails. Ten routes: the Chornohora ridge over Hoverla, the Tongariro Alpine Crossing, the Tour du Mont Blanc and the Camino Francés on their real GPS tracks, Santiago's road from The Alchemist, folk tales and original stories, in two series you can walk one after another.
  • A hike you can watch. A side-on scene that follows the real elevation, the weather, the season and your clock, a minimap and a topographic map you zoom like paper. Look back at the way you came; what lies ahead stays hidden until you get there.
  • Real distances, your difficulty. A typical day of commits is about 10 km on medium (12.5 on easy, 8 on hard).
  • Stories, facts and achievements at every stop, streaks, days off, your year in a calendar and a passport with a stamp for every stop.
  • Share it. A postcard of where you are, saved, copied or posted to X, Bluesky, Mastodon, Threads, LinkedIn, Facebook, Telegram or Reddit with the text ready, and an SVG badge for your GitHub profile.
  • Walk together. Everyone committing to a project on the same trail, with a leaderboard, the team's week and a team goal: a route you walk together, everyone's commits adding up.
  • Five languages. English, Ukrainian, Polish, German and Spanish.
  • Routes from the site: Tools → Commit Hike → Routes from the Site… finds routes other walkers made on commit-hike.dev; install them with one click, and update them when their authors publish new versions.

Private by design. Nothing is written to your projects (no git hooks, no files): Commit Hike only reads git history. No accounts, no telemetry: the plugin connects only to commit-hike.dev, and only when you open Routes from the site or install a route (reading the public catalogue, sending nothing about you); Share opens a network's page in your browser only when you pick it. Lock files, generated code, whitespace-only changes and other people's commits don't count.

Open the Commit Hike tool window to see your trail; the status bar shows how far you've walked, and Tools | Commit Hike has everything else. The same progress also shows in your shell prompt and in Neovim: docs/terminal.md.

Read about it in English, Українською, po polsku, auf Deutsch or en español.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Changed

  • Rain looks like rain: on a rainy day the sky turns grey, the sun hides behind the clouds, there are more clouds, the drops are denser and longer and splash on the ground. A snowy day is grey too (holiday snow still falls from a fair sky), and on a wet night the stars and the northern lights hide.

Fixed

  • Snow fell on the tundra on any rainy day, in summer and autumn too (on Frodo's way, right after Tom Bombadil's house). Snow, glaciers and sea ice still get snow; the tundra only at the edges of winter (November and March) or above 1,800 m, and rain otherwise.
  • Rain and snow fell inside tunnels: underground nothing falls now.
  • At Christmas south of the equator, rain and the holiday snow fell together: it's snow now.
  • Extras: the Barrow-downs on Frodo's journey are heath, not alpine tundra.

idea-plugin.name: CX Composer for Liferay
idea-plugin.description:
CX Composer for Liferay

The developer workbench for Liferay Client Extensions — inside your JetBrains IDE.

Scaffolding for all 28 Liferay Client Extension types. IntelliSense on client-extension.yaml. Full IntelliSense + validation for 309 Liferay batch schemas in batch/*.batch-engine-data.json (registered batch-engine entity types — Object Definitions, User Accounts, Sites, Taxonomies, Commerce, and 300 more). Per-extension build. Free validators for client-extension.yaml, LCP.json, and Dockerfile. AI-drafted scaffolding (Preview).

cxcomposer.dev · Extension reference · hello@cxcomposer.dev

Why CX Composer

Authoring a Liferay Client Extension means writing client-extension.yaml from memory, wiring up assets and Gradle tasks by hand, and hoping the schema you copied from learn.liferay.com is up to date. CX Composer collapses all of that into an editor-first workflow.

  • Scaffold once, ship often — pick a target folder, pick a type, answer the required prompts. You get a full project — manifest, README, assets — that builds on first try.
  • Never write yaml from memory — completions and Markdown hover for every field on every type, driven by a schema pulled straight from Liferay's public YAML reference and cross-checked against 131 real production client-extension.yaml files.
  • Batch imports that don't fail — full schema IntelliSense inside batch/*.batch-engine-data.json for all 309 registered Liferay batch-engine entity types. Extracted from Liferay's public OpenAPI schemas, enriched with 169 hand-verified runtime FK patches. No more "No Country exists with primary key 0" deploy errors.
  • Catch typos before deploy fails — instanceableq when you meant instanceable? Squiggle on the exact line with a did-you-mean suggestion.
  • Per-extension build — blade gw buildClientExtensionZip runs inside the specific client-extension folder. Monorepo-aware, right-click friendly.

Features

Scaffold every type. One wizard.

Multi-step wizard for all 28 Liferay Client Extension types: Custom Element, IFrame, Global CSS, Global JS, Theme CSS, Theme Favicon, Theme Sprite Map, JS Import Map Entry, Editor Config Contributor, FDS Cell Renderer, FDS Filter, Static Content, OAuth Application (Headless Server / User Agent), Instance Settings, Notification Type, Object Action, Object Validation Rule, Object Entry Manager, Workflow Action, CAPTCHA, Batch, Site Initializer, Commerce Payment Integration, Commerce Checkout Step, Commerce Shipping Engine, Commerce Tax Engine, Audiences Custom Attributes.

Each type gets type-appropriate assets and required prompts.

IntelliSense that reads Liferay's docs

Completions and Markdown hover for every field on client-extension.yaml (all 28 types) and on batch/*.batch-engine-data.json (all 309 registered batch-engine entities). Unknown-field detection with did-you-mean suggestions. Missing-required-field diagnostics.

Batch data authoring — all 309 Liferay entities

Right-click any folder that contains a type: batch client-extension.yaml → Add Batch File… wizard → pick from 309 registered entity types (grouped by category: Objects, Users, Sites, Roles, Content, Taxonomies, Workflow, Commerce, and more) → generates a schema-correct batch/<entity>.batch-engine-data.json skeleton with the correct configuration.className, envelope shape, and required fields prepopulated.

Inside the file:

  • className autocomplete — all 309 entities, filterable, described
  • Field-name autocomplete inside items[] — driven by the file's specific className
  • Hover shows each field's type + Liferay's own description from the OpenAPI YAML
  • Diagnostics catch missing required fields — including runtime parent-FK requirements OpenAPI omits (169 hand-verified patches for things like Region.countryId, TaxonomyCategory.parentVocabulary)

Schemas extracted from Liferay's public OpenAPI schemas — the same source Liferay's batch importer validates against at deploy time.

Six validator types

  • client-extension.yaml — full schema, all 28 types
  • LCP.json — Liferay Cloud service configuration
  • Dockerfile — instruction ordering, deprecation warnings
  • Folder-level companion checks — Dockerfile / assemble source / referenced JSON
  • frontend-token-definition.json — walks up from the JSON to its themeCSS block, enforces the full frontendTokenCategories → sets → tokens → mappings schema
  • batch/*.batch-engine-data.json — schema-aware validation for all 309 batch-engine entity types

Auto-runs on save and open. Explicit Validate File command surfaces every diagnostic in the Problems panel plus a summary toast. Validate Whole CX (folder) scans the entire CX folder tree, including every batch data file.

AI-drafted scaffolding (Preview)

Describe what you need in one sentence — Draft with AI picks the CX type, drafts the yaml + handler code, and scaffolds a working project. Explain with AI provides schema-grounded hover explanations on any yaml block. Bring your own API key: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Groq, Azure, or run models locally with Ollama — no per-call cost from CX Composer, no data sent to our servers.

Per-extension build

Runs blade gw buildClientExtensionZip inside the specific client-extension folder — not the whole workspace. In monorepos, right-click any client-extension.yaml and the build targets exactly that project.

Right-click integrations

  • Right-click any folder → Scaffold New Project or Add Client Extension
  • Right-click a client-extension.yaml → Add Extension, Validate, Build
  • Right-click any batch CX folder → Add Batch File (only appears when the CX declares type: batch)

Tool window

Dedicated CX Composer tool window with a grouped Actions tab (Project / AI / License with live status rows: plan, account, start date, renewal date) and an Extensions in Workspace tab that lists every client-extension.yaml with a toolbar for per-extension build + validate + add-batch-file.

Free vs. Pro

Free (everyone)

  • Validation for LCP.json and Dockerfile
  • Yaml validation for four static-asset CX types: globalJS, globalCSS, themeSpritemap, jsImportMapsEntry
  • Auto-runs on save + open
  • Did-you-mean suggestions for typos and unknown fields
  • Problems-panel integration

Pro — $5 / month · $15 / 6 months · $25 / year

  • Yaml validation for the other 24 CX types (all microservice / backend types, themeCSS, Site Initializer, Batch, Commerce)
  • Batch data IntelliSense + validation for all 309 registered Liferay entity types inside batch/*.batch-engine-data.json
  • Add Batch File wizard — right-click a batch CX folder, pick from 309 entities, get a schema-correct skeleton
  • Folder-level companion checks — Dockerfile / assemble source / referenced JSON
  • Deep frontend-token-definition.json validation
  • Scaffold new projects — all 28 CX types
  • Add Client Extension — append blocks or drop new manifests
  • Per-extension Build — blade gw buildClientExtensionZip
  • IntelliSense on client-extension.yaml — completions + Markdown hover
  • AI-drafted scaffolding (Preview) — Draft with AI, Explain with AI, and BYOK provider setup (Anthropic / OpenAI / Google / Groq / Azure OpenAI / local Ollama). CX Composer never proxies your prompts.

Same feature set on every Pro plan — pick the billing cadence that suits you.

Get a Pro license: store.cxcomposer.dev

Run Activate License from the CX Composer tool window and paste your key. Keys are stored securely in the OS keychain (macOS Keychain / Windows Credential Manager / Linux Secret Service) and re-verified on a 7-day cadence with an additional 7-day offline grace period. One machine per key.

Requirements

  • Any JetBrains IDE on the IntelliJ Platform 2024.2+ — IntelliJ IDEA Community/Ultimate, WebStorm, PhpStorm, PyCharm, RubyMine, GoLand, RustRover, DataGrip.
  • Blade CLI on your PATH — only if you use the Build command
  • Liferay Workspace with the workspace Gradle plugin — only if you build

IntelliSense, hover, validation, and scaffolding need nothing else — no additional IDE plugins required beyond the bundled YAML + JSON support.

FAQ

Q. What is a Liferay Client Extension?
A declarative package defined by a client-extension.yaml manifest. There are 28 supported types — frontend widgets (Custom Element, IFrame), theming (Theme CSS, Global CSS/JS), configuration (OAuth apps, Instance Settings), microservices (Object Action, Workflow Action, Notification Type, CAPTCHA), batch (Batch, Site Initializer), and Liferay Commerce integrations. Extensions are built into a .zip with blade gw buildClientExtensionZip and deployed to a Liferay DXP server.

Q. Does CX Composer replace Blade?
No — it complements Blade. CX Composer invokes Blade for build, but adds editor-first IntelliSense, validation, and a wizard-driven scaffold that Blade doesn't provide.

Q. Can I use CX Composer without paying?
Yes. LCP.json and Dockerfile validation plus yaml validation for four static-asset CX types is free forever. Pro extends validation to the other 24 CX types and unlocks scaffolding, IntelliSense, and per-extension build.

Q. What Liferay DXP versions are supported?
CX Composer's schema targets Liferay DXP 2024.Q1+ and Liferay Portal GA100+. The Client Extension format has been stable since DXP 2023.Q4.

Q. Is CX Composer affiliated with Liferay?
No. CX Composer is an independent third-party product. See cxcomposer.dev/legal for the trademark notice.

Q. How is my license key stored?
In the OS keychain via IntelliJ's PasswordSafe. Re-verification happens every 7 days with an additional 7-day offline grace period.

Support

  • Email: hello@cxcomposer.dev — usually a reply within 24h
  • Docs: cxcomposer.dev/extensions
  • Buy: store.cxcomposer.dev

Trademark notice

Liferay® and Liferay DXP® are registered trademarks of Liferay, Inc. CX Composer for Liferay is an independent third-party product and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Liferay, Inc.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.6.6 — CX Companion enhancements

  • More resilient chat sessions. CX Companion keeps every multi-turn conversation in a valid state end-to-end, so long sessions with lots of tool use continue to flow smoothly across pauses, cancels, and reviews — including when you accept or reject edits mid-conversation and come back later to ask a follow-up.

1.6.5 — CX Companion, Website Migration, and AI graduates to Preview

  • CX Companion (Preview, Pro). New dedicated panel: describe what you want in plain English and CX Companion builds it against your actual workspace. It reads your open files, picks the right Client Extension type, scaffolds new extensions, edits existing yaml, auto-pairs OAuth blocks, and runs the full preflight validator on every file it touches. Every write lands in a pending-edits review queue — nothing is saved until you click Accept.
  • Migrate Website to Batch CX (Preview, Pro). Paste any URL — CX Composer crawls the site, uses AI to infer an Object Definition schema from the extracted content, pulls out records as Object Entries, and produces a ready-to-deploy batch Client Extension folder. Includes SPA detection, locale inference, and a preflight so you can see what will be imported before anything is written to disk.
  • AI moves from Beta to Preview. Every AI-generated yaml is validated by the full preflight before you see it. Cross-block OAuth pairing is checked automatically — a scaffolded microservice always ships with its paired oAuthApplicationUserAgent or oAuthApplicationHeadlessServer. Chat scope is restricted to Liferay Client Extensions, with a polite redirect for off-topic asks.
  • Broader yaml coverage. IntelliSense + validation now cover additional fields observed in Liferay's own reference workspaces: paymentMethodKey on commerceCheckoutStep; builtInTemplateType, membershipType, parentSiteKey, and siteName_i18n on siteInitializer.
  • BYO AI providers, expanded. On top of Anthropic / OpenAI / Google / Groq / Azure / Ollama, you can now point CX Composer at any OpenAI-compatible endpoint — OpenRouter, Together, LM Studio, your own gateway. Keys stay in the OS keychain (macOS Keychain / Windows Credential Manager / Linux Secret Service); calls go straight from your IDE to the provider — never through cxcomposer.dev.

idea-plugin.name: Big O Lens
idea-plugin.description:
Shows the estimated Big O time complexity above every function and method, with a color indicator: 🟢 good · 🟡 acceptable · 🔴 expensive.

Click the hint to see why: which loops, recursive calls or library calls (sort, indexOf, contains…) dominate the cost.

Supported languages: Java, Kotlin, TypeScript and JavaScript.

Requirements: Node.js 18+ available on the PATH seen by the IDE. The analysis runs locally in a bundled language server over stdin/stdout; nothing is downloaded and no network ports are opened.

This is a heuristic (nested loops, recursion, known costs of standard library calls), not a proof. Memoization, early exits and amortized costs can mislead the estimate.

idea-plugin.name: Rust Portable
idea-plugin.description:
Write & run Rust in IntelliJ IDEA Community — for free. Rust Portable adds lightweight Rust support to the free IDE, with no RustRover license and no system-wide Rust install required. IntelliJ IDEA Community doesn't bundle the official Rust plugin (that's Ultimate / RustRover / CLion only), so this fills the gap.

  • Portable Rust toolchain — download a toolchain from inside the IDE (like the JDK downloader) using the official rustup. Stored under ~/.rust-portable with its own RUSTUP_HOME and CARGO_HOME, so nothing touches your shell profile or an existing system Rust. Pick stable, beta, nightly or a pinned release, and switch anytime.
  • Run with one click — a green ▶ gutter marker on fn main(), plus right-click ▸ Run. Inside a Cargo project it runs cargo run from the crate root, so relative paths resolve just like they do in a terminal. A loose .rs file with no Cargo.toml is compiled with rustc and executed, so scratch files stay runnable.
  • Code intelligence (optional) — completion, go-to-definition, hover docs and error highlighting via rust-analyzer, the same language server RustRover runs underneath, bridged with the free LSP4IJ plugin. One click adds it to your portable toolchain as an official rustup component. Fully offline; no Node.js.
  • Syntax highlighting — for .rs files (keywords, strings including raw and byte literals, lifetimes, attributes, macros, doc comments), even without the language server.
  • Run cargo tools — build / check / test / add / fmt / clippy in a console.

Active on IDEs without built-in Rust (IDEA Community, PyCharm Community, WebStorm, …). On RustRover / IDEA Ultimate / CLion the native Rust support is used instead — this plugin steps aside.

idea-plugin.name: Ruby Portable
idea-plugin.description:
Write & run Ruby in IntelliJ IDEA Community — for free. Ruby Portable adds lightweight Ruby support to the free IDE, with no RubyMine license and no system-wide Ruby install required. IntelliJ IDEA Community doesn't bundle the official Ruby plugin (that's Ultimate / RubyMine only), so this fills the gap.

  • Portable Ruby — download a self-contained interpreter from inside the IDE (like the JDK downloader). Stored under ~/.ruby-portable with its own isolated GEM_HOME, so nothing touches a system Ruby, rbenv, rvm or your shell profile. Pick a version and switch anytime.
  • Run with one click — a green ▶ gutter marker and right-click ▸ Run. In a project with a Gemfile the script runs under bundle exec from the Gemfile's directory, so gems and relative paths resolve the way they do in a terminal; elsewhere it's a plain ruby script.rb.
  • Code intelligence (optional) — completion, go-to-definition, hover docs and diagnostics via ruby-lsp, Shopify's Ruby language server, bridged with the free LSP4IJ plugin. One click installs it as a gem into your portable interpreter. Fully offline; no Node.js.
  • Syntax highlighting — for .rb files (keywords, symbols, string and %w literals, string interpolation, instance/class/global variables, regexes, heredocs and comments), even without the language server.
  • Run gem & bundler — bundle install / update / exec, gem install / list, and rake in a console.

macOS and Linux can download an interpreter in-IDE. On Windows, point the plugin at an existing Ruby with Add from Disk… — a bundled download is not offered yet because no relocatable Windows build is published in a format the IDE can unpack.

Active on IDEs without built-in Ruby (IDEA Community, PyCharm Community, WebStorm, …). On RubyMine / IDEA Ultimate the native Ruby support is used instead — this plugin steps aside.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.0
  • Initial release.
  • Download a self-contained portable Ruby from inside the IDE (macOS / Linux), isolated under ~/.ruby-portable with its own GEM_HOME.
  • Run a .rb file: ▶ gutter marker, bundle exec ruby from the Gemfile's directory when there is one, plain ruby otherwise.
  • Optional ruby-lsp code intelligence via LSP4IJ (one-click setup), lexer-based syntax highlighting, and a bundler / gem / rake runner.

Streams the console output of your Run/Debug configurations to a Graylog GELF input (TCP, UDP or HTTP).
  • JSON log lines (Logstash/Logback, ECS, pino…) become Graylog fields: nested objects are flattened (http.status → http_status), strings containing JSON stay plain strings.
  • Plain-text logs: the level is detected and stack traces are grouped into one message.
  • Every message carries the project, run configuration, executor and session, plus your own static fields, so you can route it to a dedicated stream.

idea-plugin.name: GitToolBoxFree
idea-plugin.description:
GitToolBoxFree is a lightweight, high-performance, and bilingual (English / 简体中文) Git productivity enhancement plugin for IntelliJ IDEA and Android Studio.

Features

  • Inline Blame: Non-blocking inline line blame displaying author, relative time (3 days ago / 3天前), and commit message.
  • Typing Suppression: Automatically hides annotations while typing for a buttery-smooth 120fps native typing experience.
  • Status Bar Indicator: Shows branch name and ahead/behind counts (↑ahead | ↓behind) with smart multi-repository tracking.
  • Silent Auto-Fetch: Periodically fetches changes in the background with rebase/merge safe evasion.
  • Bilingual Settings: One-click switch between English and 简体中文 under Settings -> Version Control -> GitToolBoxFree.

中文说明

GitToolBoxFree 是一款专为 Android Studio 与 IntelliJ 打造的完全免费、轻量级、极致流畅、中英双语的 Git 效率增强插件。

  • 行内代码责任人 (Inline Blame)：光标所在行末即时浅灰显示提交人、相对时间（“3天前”、“昨天” / "3 days ago"）及提交信息。高性能防抖渲染，编码丝滑不卡顿。
  • 状态栏仓库指示器 (Status Bar)：右下角实时展示当前分支、领先/落后提交数（↑超前 | ↓落后），支持悬浮气泡提示与快捷菜单。
  • 后台自动拉取 (Auto Fetch)：静默定时执行 git fetch，保持远程提交计数实时准确。
  • 双语设置面板 (Multi-Language Settings)：在“设置 -> Version Control (版本控制) / Other Settings -> GitToolBoxFree”中自由切换中英文界面、定制显示模板与防抖时间。
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0

  • Initial release of GitToolBoxFree.
  • High-performance debounced Inline Blame with typing suppression.
  • Status bar branch indicator with ahead/behind commit counters.
  • Silent background Auto Fetch service with rebase evasion.
  • Bilingual support for English and 简体中文.

idea-plugin.name: Java Portable
idea-plugin.description:
Open and run Java files without installing another IDE. PhpStorm, WebStorm, PyCharm, GoLand, RubyMine, CLion and Rider ship no Java support at all — a single .java file today means downloading IntelliJ IDEA just to read it. Java Portable fills that gap in the IDE you already have.

  • Portable JDK — download an Eclipse Temurin LTS build from inside the IDE (like the JDK downloader in IDEA). Stored under ~/.java-portable, self-contained, and it touches nothing else on your machine — no JAVA_HOME to set, no system install, no conflict with an existing JDK.
  • Run with one click — a green ▶ gutter marker next to main, plus right-click ▸ Run. Uses single-file source launch (java Hello.java), so there is no compile step, no output folder and no project setup — the file just runs.
  • Code intelligence (optional) — completion, go-to-definition, hover docs and diagnostics via Eclipse JDT LS, the same server VS Code's Java extension uses, bridged with the free LSP4IJ plugin. It runs on the JDK you already downloaded. Fully offline.
  • Syntax highlighting — for .java files (keywords, strings and text blocks, numbers, annotations, Javadoc), even without the language server.
  • Run JDK tools — javac, jshell, javap and jar in a console.

Ideal for the one-off: a snippet you're learning from, an interview exercise, a class file from a colleague, or the one Java service in an otherwise PHP/Python/Go codebase.

In IntelliJ IDEA and Android Studio the real Java support is far better than anything this plugin offers, so it deliberately does not load there at all.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.0
  • Initial release.
  • Download a self-contained Temurin LTS JDK from inside the IDE (macOS, Linux and Windows), isolated under ~/.java-portable.
  • Run a .java file with single-file source launch — ▶ gutter marker next to main, no compile step.
  • Optional Eclipse JDT LS code intelligence via LSP4IJ (one-click setup), lexer-based syntax highlighting, and a javac / jshell / javap / jar runner.

idea-plugin.name: Dilbert Daily Strip
idea-plugin.description:
Used to display the cartoon strip of the day from the dilbert.com website but no longer works and will be removed from the marketplace soon.

Updated only to inform existing users that changes to the dilbert.com website in March 2023 will not be addressed.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Version 2.0.0
  • Notice: The plug-in no longer works due to changes to how the Dilbert Daily Strip is published.
Version 1.10.0
  • Fix: An exception preventing the strip from being fetched in 2022.3 EAP versions of IntelliJ Platform products has been resolved.
  • Fix: Plug-in tool window keyboard actions now work again.
There is additionally one non-visible change:
  • The plug-in no longer uses any deprecated IntelliJ Platform APIs (components, persistence etc.).
Version 1.9.0
  • Fix: An exception thrown when closing a project in versions of IntelliJ Platform products from around 2020.1 onwards has been resolved.
Version 1.8.0
  • Fix: Yet another update to the dilbert.com website broke the plug-in by removing the scheme from the strip image URL. This update accommodates no scheme, http or https in case of future changes.
  • New: Ctrl-<mouse-button-1-click> (on Linux or Windows) or Cmd-<mouse-button-1-click> (on macOS) opens dilbert.com in the system's default web browser.
Version 1.7.1
  • Fix: An(other!) update to the dilbert.com website broke the plug-in by switching from https to http for the strip image URL. This update accommodates both schemes in case of future changes...
Version 1.7.0
  • Fix: An update to the dilbert.com website broke the plug-in by switching from an <img> tag with a src attribute to a <div> tag with a data-image attribute for identifying the strip image URL.
Version 1.6.1
  • Fix: The idea-version element in the plug-in's plugin.xml should no longer be rejected by the JetBrains plugin repository.
Version 1.6.0
  • Fix: The plug-in should once again successfully fetch strips if the IntelliJ Platform application is configured to use an HTTP proxy with authentication.
  • Fix: The plug-in toolwindow no longer shows a close button on products built on IntelliJ Platform 2018.1 and later.
  • Removed: The plug-in's custom error handler has been removed as the server-side CGI script is no longer deployed.
There are some non-visible changes:
  • The plug-in is now built using the JetBrains gradle-intellij-plugin.
  • Source code has been brought up to date (Java 5 -> Java 8).
  • Source code is no longer bundled with the plug-in but is now available on GitHub.
Version 1.5.0
  • Fix: The plug-in's settings are now editable in IntelliJ IDEA 16 EAP (and in other products built on the same branch of IntelliJ Platform).
  • Fix: The tooltip on the current cartoon strip now shows the correct date once more (instead of "The strip couldn't be retrieved").
Version 1.4.1
  • Fix: The plug-in is now compatible with CLion.
Version 1.4.0
  • Fix: An update to the dilbert.com website broke the plug-in by removing the 'fast' URL.
  • Change: The helpset documentation has been removed as it no longer works (presumably due to changes in the IntelliJ Platform help system).
Version 1.3.3
  • Fix: The toolwindow background colour is no longer explicitly set to white.
  • Fix: The toolwindow button icon is now the preferred 13x13 size.
  • Fix: The plug-in is now compatible with any product built on IntelliJ Platform.
  • Fix: The toolwindow title is now just "Dilbert" rather than "Dilbert Dilbert".
Version 1.3.2
  • Fix: Updated for IDEA 10.5 EAP (no longer bundles commons-httpclient, commons-codec or commons-logging).
Version 1.3.1
  • Fix: The toolbar action buttons are now available in IDEA's "dumb" mode e.g. when indexes are being rebuilt.
  • Fix: The keyboard shortcuts for the toolbar actions now work once more.
Version 1.3.0
  • Fix: A change to IDEA prior to the IDEA 10.0 final release resulted in the plug-in's toolbar often painting incorrectly.
  • Fix: Prevented the circumstances in which the error "Access to realized (ever shown) UI components should be done only from the AWT event dispatch thread, revalidate(), invalidate() & repaint() is ok from any thread" is logged.
  • New: The plug-in's toolwindow is now available in IDEA's "dumb" mode e.g. when indexes are being rebuilt.
Version 1.2.1
  • Fix: A change to the IDEA OpenAPI during the IDEA 8.x EAP phase resulted in the plug-in generating the error "Access is allowed from event dispatch thread only.".
Version 1.2.0
  • Fix: An update to the dilbert.com website broke the plug-in by changing URL formats and no longer sending the HTTP Last-Modified header with replies.
Version 1.1.0
  • Fix: If IDEA is configured to send authentication information to an HTTP proxy then the authentication information is sent pre-emptively, avoiding problems with proxy servers that fail to respond with HTTP status code 407.
  • Fix: The strip is fetched asynchronously rather than synchronously in the AWT event dispatch thread.
  • New: Strips may be scheduled for automatic daily download.
Version 1.0.1
  • Fix: Any anticipated exception caught when downloading the strip results in an 'error' image being displayed rather than the exception being reported to IDEA's log.
  • Fix: Help system typos corrected.
  • New: The 'About' window can now be dismissed with the Esc key, removing any dependency at all on the mouse.
  • New: IDEA's HTTP proxy settings are honoured.
Version 1.0.0
  • Initial release

idea-plugin.name: AtSoundtrack
idea-plugin.description:
AtSoundtrack


GitHub | Issues

Plugin that provides @soundtrack using iTunes and Spotify. This plugin works only if you use a Mac. @soundtrack can be used either with code completion or as variable in the file templates.

To setup @soundtrack in your templates: Open Preferences go to Editor -> File and Code Templates -> Includes and select "File Header"
Add the following code: 


#if (${soundtrack} && ${soundtrack} != "")
 *  @soundtrack ${soundtrack}
#end

Language support

  • CoffeeScript
  • CSS
  • HTML
  • Java
  • JavaScript
  • Kotlin
  • PHP
  • Python
  • Ruby
  • Scala (and ScalaScript)
  • SQL
  • XML
Compiled with Java 1.8.

idea-plugin.name: Power Mode - Zeranthium
idea-plugin.description:
Power Mode - Zeranthium



Get Into your Zone...

See the Docs page for more info

Featuring:

  • - Basic Particle Effects
  • - Vines
  • - 'Lizards' (swarms to anchors)
  • - MultiLayer w/ spawn chance
  • - Editor Shake
  • - Weird square effect (MOMA)
  • - Anchor type effects where your code structure influences particle behaviour
  • - Customizable Anchor Types (Bracket/Brace/Parenthesis/Colon)
  • - MultiLayer w/ caret tracking
  • - Linker Chains w/ caret tracking
  • - Sound panel (Tabbed Panel) (MP3)
  • - Play 2x Song w/ 2 Hotkeys to trigger each one (MP3)
  • - Droste effect
  • - CopyPasteVoid effect (pasting in displays a customizable image & color fade behind the paste shape)
  • - Background Loading of Assets
  • - Max 500 *.png or 1.0GB of data per Image Collection
  • - LOAD Custom Config packs -- Support DROSTE/LIZARD/SOUND/MULTI_LAYER/LOCKED_LAYER
  • - clone zeranthium-extras repo and select config pack to load
  • - Action Key Sound Options (Copy/Paste/Backspace/Del/Enter)
  • - Locked layer that stretches or pins to corner
  • - Supports multiple editors
  • - 'Lantern' Particles
  • - 'Tap Animation' -- keypress controls how fast it animates
  • - ON/OFF hotkey to quickly toggle Zeranthium

Getting Started:

  1. Settings can be found in Preferences > Appearance > Power Mode - Zeranthium
  2. Everything is pretty much customizable -- just point your table paths to your own custom images/sounds (PNG/MP3) and eventually build up a nice visual package with multiple effects/layering.
  3. To install pre-configured themes clone the zeranthium-extras repo. You can also make your own (see docs site)
  4. You may need to increase memory heap size if your custom assets are large in size.

Based on Power Mode from Baptiste Mesta on Github.

Inspired by Power Mode II by axaluss.

License types
— Extra ToolWindow Colorful Icons offers monthly and yearly licenses. Freemium: if not using a license, you can still get colored icons when using the Classic UI.
— Extra ToolWindow Colorful Icons Lifetime (new!) offers lifetime licenses: pay once, use it and get updates forever.

idea-plugin.name: Star Wars Progress Bar
idea-plugin.description:
Take your development experience to a galaxy far, far away with the Star Wars Progress Bar! This plugin replaces the ordinary progress bar with thrilling visuals from the Star Wars universe. As you code, watch as iconic vehicles like the Millennium Falcon, X-Wing, and AT-AT march across your screen. But that's not all — Star Wars Progress Bar also includes dynamic lightsaber animations, bringing the energy and excitement of the Force into your workflow. Whether you're piloting a starship or wielding a lightsaber, this plugin adds an epic touch to every coding session. May the code be with you!

Features

  • Support of over 150 vehicles and more than 20 lightsabers from the Star Wars movies, TV series, books and comics from the canon and legends
  • Configurable via the settings (Settings/Preferences > Appearance & Behavior > Star Wars Progress Bar)
    • Selection of specific vehicles and lightsabers
    • Selection of entire factions
    • Show/hide icon in progress bar
    • Display name in progress bar tooltip
    • Display name in progress bar
    • Display faction crest in progress bar
    • Display solid or semi-transparent progress bar
    • Display only the silhouette of the icon in progress bar
    • Automatically change icon after a custom defined number of passes for indeterminate progress bars
    • Different velocities for different vehicles and lightsabers
    • Preview vehicles and lightsabers by clicking on their icon
  • Lightsaber icons are only displayed if there is enough space inside the progress bar. Otherwise, only the blade is drawn.

Additional information

I do not own the Star Wars trademark nor do I intend any copyright infringement regarding the Star Wars trademark. This plugin was created for fun and is meant to be a homage to Star Wars and its creators, contributors and awesome fans.

idea-plugin.change-notes:
Unreleased

Added

  • GitHub Actions build/release automation with Marketplace signing, release guards, and publishing documentation.
  • Application-wide forum URL validation and discreet window preferences.
  • Persistent login sessions in local IDE settings, browser Cookie import, ordinary topics/replies and BBCode quotes.

Changed

  • Migrate to IntelliJ Platform Gradle Plugin 2.13.1 and Gradle 9.8.0; require IDEA 2022.3 (223) or newer and Java 17.
  • Remove the IDE version upper bound and verify compatibility against IDEA 2022.3 and 2025.2.6.3 Community.
  • Replace legacy service/content factory APIs and remove Java 11 and manual instrumentation workarounds.
  • Pin the Gradle daemon to automatically provisioned Temurin 17 to avoid Ant's legacy Microsoft JVM detection.

Fixed

  • Update HTTP Client and remove the unused Kotlin JVM plugin.
  • Use Discuz tpp/ppp metadata for pagination and report API permission/maintenance errors.
  • Isolate site/account cookies, prevent stale requests from repopulating switched views, and release project readers.
  • Preserve links and image references when rendering posts as plain text.
  • Initial scaffold created from IntelliJ Platform Plugin Template

idea-plugin.name: Cyclone
idea-plugin.description:
The Cyclone plugin for IntelliJ allows you to customize the progress bar during project indexing to your liking with Cyclone!.

Important: It is recommended to avoid having other plugins that change the progress bar in order to prevent conflicts.

Features:

  • You can customize both the forward and backward progress bar images.
  • You can change the progress bar using popular image formats such as .gif, .png, .jpg, and .jpeg.
  • You can see which image you have selected, on the current forward or backward image preview.
  • Cyclone brings 2 default images ready to use.
  • Reset buttons to quickly return to default cyclone images.
  • To ensure a better appearance of the progress bar, the image size should be 32x32 or smaller.

How to use:

  • Go to File > Settings > Editor > Cyclone
  • Click "Browse..." next to "Forward Image" to select the image for rightward progress movement.
  • Click "Browse..." next to "Backward Image" to select the image for leftward progress movement.
  • Use "Reset to Default" buttons to restore original cyclone images.
  • Click "Apply" button to save changes.
  • Click "OK" button - changes apply instantly!

Bug or Suggestions:

  • You can report a bug by creating an issue on the repository.
  • You can suggest a feature by creating an issue on the repository.

idea-plugin.name: PacManProgressBar
idea-plugin.description:
PacManProgressBar

Introducing PacManProgressBar, the dynamic replacement for your IntelliJ progress bar that injects a playful twist into your coding journey. Say goodbye to mundane progress bars and hello to a delightful Pac-Man adventure right in your IDE.

Deterministic Mode:

In this mode, your progress is depicted by Pac-Man voraciously chomping through a path, relentlessly pursued by four menacing ghosts. As Pac-Man traverses the bar, inching closer to the end, your task progresses. Once Pac-Man reaches the end, your work is done.

Indeterministic Mode:

Overflow Mode:

Choose this mode for a simple yet captivating display. Pac-Man is chased by ghosts along a looped path. When Pac-Man reaches the end, it seamlessly overflows to the other side, creating a continuous loop symbolizing ongoing progress.

Game Simulation Mode:

Experience a nostalgic nod to the classic arcade game with this mode. As Pac-Man nears the end, a tantalizing cherry appears. If Pac-Man devours the cherry, the ghosts turn blue, symbolizing a momentary reversal of roles. Now, the ghosts are chased by Pac-Man until they reach the start point, at which they revert to their default color, resuming their pursuit of Pac-Man.

PacMan Styles

Choose from three exciting Pac-Man styles: the classic Original Pac-Man, the adventurous Ms. Pac-Man, or the stealthy Pac-Man Ninja.

With PacManProgressBar, your progress is not only tracked but also transformed into an engaging and visually stimulating experience. Embrace a new level of productivity and enjoyment in your coding endeavors with this unique IntelliJ plugin.

idea-plugin.name: Advent of Code Submit
idea-plugin.description:
This project is a JetBrains IntelliJ plugin designed to streamline the Advent of Code experience for Kotlin and Java enthusiasts.

With this plugin, you can:

  • automatically build and run your solution for any day of the event.
  • submit your answers directly to Advent of Code without leaving your IDE.

Whether you're a competitive solver or just enjoying the holiday coding fun, this plugin saves you time and lets you focus on solving puzzles.

To submit your solutions, you need to log in into your Advent of Code account using the AOC tool window. The plugin will store your session cookie in the IDE's secure storage, so you don't have to log in every time you want to submit an answer.

At the moment, the plugin can only submit Java or Kotlin solutions. If you're using another language, you can still use the plugin to view the puzzles and download the inputs, but you'll need to submit your answers manually.

The inputs are downloaded into the .aoc folder in your project root. The plugin will automatically create this folder if it doesn't exist.

idea-plugin.name: Private Reader
idea-plugin.description:
Introduction

A lightweight novel reading plugin for JetBrains IDEs that supports content extraction from various novel websites.

Key Features

  • Smart Content Extraction
    • Universal website content parsing
    • Automatic chapter structure recognition
    • Intelligent ad filtering
  • Dual Reading Modes
    • Reader Mode: Immersive reading experience
    • Notification Mode: Lightweight reading option
  • Progress Management
    • Real-time progress synchronization
    • Automatic reading position tracking
    • Multi-dimensional progress display
  • Performance Optimization
    • Smart caching system
    • Background chapter preloading
    • Asynchronous loading

Usage

  1. Find "Private Reader" options in the Tools menu
  2. Click "Add Book" to add a new book
  3. Open books in the right tool window
  4. Use keyboard shortcuts:
    • Ctrl+1: Clear screen
    • Ctrl+2: Previous page
    • Ctrl+3: Next page
    • Ctrl+4: Refresh chapter content
  5. Customize fonts, reading mode and cache options in settings

简介

一款轻量级的 JetBrains IDE 小说阅读插件，支持各类小说网站内容提取。

主要功能

  • 智能内容提取
    • 通用网站内容解析
    • 自动章节结构识别
    • 智能广告过滤
  • 双模式阅读
    • 阅读器模式：沉浸式阅读体验
    • 通知栏模式：轻量级阅读选项
  • 进度管理
    • 实时进度同步
    • 自动位置追踪
    • 多维度进度显示
  • 性能优化
    • 智能缓存系统
    • 后台章节预加载
    • 异步加载

使用方法

  1. 在工具菜单中找到"Private Reader"选项
  2. 点击"添加书籍"添加新书
  3. 在右侧工具窗口中打开书籍
  4. 使用快捷键：
    • Ctrl+1：清屏
    • Ctrl+2：上一页
    • Ctrl+3：下一页
    • Ctrl+4：刷新章节内容
  5. 在设置中自定义字体、阅读模式和缓存选项

  • UUID Generator: One-click generation of standard UUID strings.
  • JSON Formatter: Supports formatting and compressing JSON strings.
  • Radix Converter: Supports conversion between binary, octal, decimal, and hexadecimal numbers.
  • Image to Base64: Quickly convert image files into Base64 encoded strings.
  • Druid Encryption/Decryption: Supports encryption and decryption functions for Druid database connection pool.
  • Properties Difference Comparison: Quickly compare differences between two Properties configuration files.
  • YAML Difference Comparison: Quickly compare differences between two YAML configuration files.

中文描述

Earth Develop Tool是earth系列插件之一，开发小助手，收录一些开发过程需要用到的一些工具。

快捷键：alt + F2 (Windows/Linux) 或 option + F2 (macOS)，可在IDEA设置中搜索“打开工具箱”进行调整。

  • Mybatis控制台日志转Sql：将MyBatis输出的日志快速转换为可执行的SQL语句。
  • 文本加解密：支持常见文本的加密与解密功能，如Base64、AES等。
  • 时间戳转换：方便地在时间戳和标准时间之间进行相互转换。
  • UUID生成器：一键生成标准UUID字符串。
  • JSON格式化：支持JSON字符串的格式化和压缩功能。
  • 进制转换：支持二进制、八进制、十进制、十六进制之间的相互转换。
  • 图片转Base64：将图片文件快速转换为Base64编码字符串。
  • Druid加解密：支持Druid数据库连接池的加密与解密功能。
  • Properties差异对比：快速对比两个Properties配置文件的差异。
  • YAML差异对比：快速对比两个YAML配置文件的差异。
idea-plugin.change-notes:
版本更新: 1.9

  • 新增：Maven、Gradle互转
  • 新增：SQL 复制
  • 优化：最大化样式、json 支持字符串比较
  • 修复：2026.2不支持问题

idea-plugin.name: Merge Hell Runner
idea-plugin.description:
The build is red. The deadline is tonight. Your only escape is to run.

Merge Hell Runner is a full-blown, side-scrolling action game that lives inside your IntelliJ IDEA tool window. Stop fixing merge conflicts — outrun them. Turn every NullPointerException, every 3am on-call page, and every 800-line legacy class into a boss you can finally shoot back at.


🔥 Escape the Merge Hell 🔥

A complete 5-level campaign of industrial ruins, suspended construction, geothermal warfare, and an alien infestation — playable in the time it takes your CI pipeline to fail again.


🚀 What's inside:

  • 🗺️ 5 Distinct Missions: Run from Repository City to the Heap District, Aerial Citadel, Geothermal Foundry, and the reality-bending Alien Hive.
  • 👹 5 Unique Bosses: Break the dependency graph of the Legacy Code Monstrosity, then face the Memory Leak Daemon, Aerial Gantry Architect, Geothermal Siege Engine, and the Alien Rootheart.
  • 🧬 Level-Specific Enemies: Fight heap leaks, rail sentinels, shield wardens, cable wasps, welding drones, thermal drillers, slag crawlers, resin spitters, spore drifters, and alien pouncers.
  • 🌊 Arena Battle Zones: Clear authored squads of chapter-specific enemies while navigating suspended platforms, foundry machinery and living defenses.
  • 🔫 6-Weapon Arsenal: Choose Commit Cannon, Force Push, Rapid CI, Garbage Collector, Firewall, or Refactor Beam, with dedicated upgrades and evolutions.
  • 4 Operatives & 3 Difficulties: Pick your character and starting weapon independently, unlock the Night-shift engineer, and choose Relaxed, Standard, or Challenge.
  • Directional Combat: Eight-way aiming, crouch fire, airborne downward shots, stationary aim, and independent drone companions.
  • ⚡ Sudo Overclock & Defense: Kills and reflections charge a brief boosted barrage. Shield pickups grant temporary damage immunity; Shield Reboot can prevent a fatal hit, and health drops restore HP.
  • 🪙 Coins & Local Leaderboard: Collect coins mid-run and chase your Top 5 high scores, saved right in your IDE.
  • 🏃 Tight Platforming: Double-jump, dash through danger with i-frames, and rack up a combo multiplier for style points.
  • 🎨 Illustrated worlds: Volumetric 2D characters, dedicated painted panoramas, articulated mechanical and alien bosses, breakable scenery, moving lifts, conveyors and hazardous terrain.
  • 🔇 IDE-friendly: Muted by default, optional music and sound, unified English and Simplified Chinese, pause and safe-segment checkpoints.

"The only plugin where rm -rf / is a valid survival strategy."


Crafted with ❤️, ☕ and a lot of git merge --abort by Phil Zhang.
Check out my portfolio: phil-the-guy.netlify.app
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Merge Hell Runner 2.0.0

A major upgrade to the campaign, combat, and visual experience.

  • Rebuilt worlds with richer scenery, distinct enemies, and multipart bosses.
  • Four playable characters, including the unlockable Night-shift Engineer.
  • Eight-way aiming, crouch fire, and deeper weapon and drone upgrades.
  • Three difficulty levels, longer routes, interactive terrain, and hidden secrets.
  • Improved character animation, enemy navigation, combat feedback, and HUD clarity.
  • English and Simplified Chinese support, improved checkpoints, and optional music and sound—muted by default.

Plus fixes for running-shot range, drone behavior, collisions, and input handling.

idea-plugin.name: Achievements
idea-plugin.description:
This Achievements IntelliJ Platform Plugin adds some fun when coding.

It rewards everyday work in the IDE, like opening files and juggling tabs, with achievements you can browse under Tools | Achievements.

Current Achievements:

NameDescription
Code NecromancerOpen a file that hasn't been changed in over 2 years.
Millennium FileOpen a file with 1,000 or more lines.
Tab AvalancheHave 10, 25, 50 or 100 tabs opened simultaneously.
Clean SweepClose 10, 25, 50 or 100 tabs with a single click.
File VoyagerOpen 5, 10, 20, 50 or 100 different file types.
Easter EggFind the Easter Egg.
Super Easter EggFind the Super Easter Egg.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
QOL improvements.

Added

  • A general progress bar to show the progress of achievements.
  • A "SECRET" badge next to hidden achievements, kept after they are unlocked.
  • A "File Voyager" achievement for opening different file types; extensions are case-insensitive and files without one do not count.
  • Live updates of the achievements dialog while it is open.
  • A collapsible log of unlocked achievement steps with their dates.

Changed

  • Improved the UI of the achievements' progress bars.
  • Progress bars use the IDE's native look.
  • Easter Egg, Super Easter Egg and Millennium File are unlocked once instead of counting every trigger.
  • The achievements dialog remembers its size and position, and opening it again brings the open one to the front.
  • Renamed "Millenium File" to "Millennium File".

Fixed

  • The UI on light themes.
  • Code Necromancer read the file's VCS history on every file open, even after being unlocked.
  • Rare errors when an action closed a project or when progress was saved while being updated.

idea-plugin.name: GifSprite
idea-plugin.description:
GifSprite - A fun animated sprite for your IDE!

What it does:

  • Drag & Drop - Move the sprite anywhere you want
  • Resize - Make it bigger or smaller (0-512)
  • Two Modes - Auto Play (always moving) or Type Mode (moves when you type)
  • Speed Control - Make it faster or slower
  • Custom GIFs - Use your own GIF files
  • Any Language - Name your GIFs in Chinese, Japanese, etc.

How to use:

  1. After install, you'll see it in the bottom-right corner
  2. Drag it to move it around
  3. Go to Settings → Appearance → GifSprite to change options
  4. Use View → Toggle GifSprite to show/hide
idea-plugin.change-notes:

  • Cross-Project Sync - Settings now sync across all open project windows via MessageBus
  • Improved URL Import - Progress bar shows download and frame processing progress
  • Global Settings - Plugin settings persist globally instead of per-project

  • Two Animation Modes - Auto Play (always moving) or Type Triggered (moves when you type)
  • Speed Control - Make it faster or slower (10-500)
  • GIF Import - Use your own GIF files
  • Any Language Names - Chinese, Japanese, and more
  • Drag & Drop - Move it anywhere you want

idea-plugin.name: NamingX
idea-plugin.description:
NamingX: The Art of Naming

NamingX is your intelligent coding co-pilot that transforms the mundane task of variable naming into an art form.

It provides elegant, context-aware naming suggestions accompanied by humorous and insightful explanations, making your coding journey not just productive but also enjoyable.

我们不只是在给变量命名，我们是在创造艺术。

计算机科学界有两大难题：缓存失效和命名。现在，我们可以划掉其中一个了。

NamingX 不是一个简单的插件，它是你编码旅程中的智能副驾驶。它优雅、直观，并且充满魔力。


为什么选择 NamingX？

  • 极致的智能：基于先进的 AI 模型，它不仅仅是猜测，通过理解你的意图，给出最精准、最优雅的命名建议。
  • 不仅仅是名字：每一个建议都附带了幽默而深刻的解释（支持简体中文），让枯燥的编码瞬间变得有趣。
  • 无缝集成：它就在那里，当你需要它时，它随时待命。从 CamelCase 到 snake_case，一切尽在掌握。
  • 完全掌控：你可以配置自己的模型、API 端点。这是你的工具，应该由你来定义。

再一次，让代码不仅仅是代码，而是诗篇。

NamingX - Stay hungry, stay foolish.

idea-plugin.name: ImageEdit Pro
idea-plugin.description:
ImageEdit Pro is a comprehensive image annotation and editing tool built directly into your IDE.

Key features:

  • Annotation tools: Arrows, curved arrows, lines, rectangles, ellipses, and text labels
  • Drawing tools: Freehand drawing and highlighter
  • Step counter: Numbered annotations for tutorials and documentation
  • Privacy tools: Blur, pixelate, and spotlight to hide sensitive information
  • Color picker: Eyedropper tool to sample colors from your images
  • Image operations: Crop, resize, rotate, and flip
  • Backdrop: Add gradient backgrounds and drop shadows
  • Guides: Ruler guides with snap-to-guide functionality
  • Multi-select: Select and manipulate multiple objects at once
  • Infinite workspace: Pan and zoom beyond the source image while keeping the opened image as the initial frame
  • Structured layers: Rename, reorder, lock, hide, group, align, and distribute layers
  • Broad format support: Open common IDE image formats plus PSD, ICO, TIFF, TGA, DDS, HDR, HEIC, AVIF, JXL, and WebP when the required codecs are available
  • Safe save behavior: Save back to PNG, JPEG, and WebP, with an export prompt for read-only input formats to avoid corrupting originals
  • Export: Export the source frame, current selection, or all content to PNG, JPEG, WebP, or SVG
  • Editable project files: Save annotations to .imageedit.json project files so edits can be reopened without baking them into the image
  • Clipboard: Copy annotated images directly to clipboard
  • Paid-plugin licensing: Unlicensed users see an in-editor purchase prompt that opens the IDE subscription settings for purchase, activation, or refresh

Perfect for creating documentation, annotating screenshots, and building visual guides without leaving your IDE.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Improved

  • Polished a few behind-the-scenes details for a steadier editing experience.

idea-plugin.name: IDE Survivors
idea-plugin.description:
IDE Survivors is a game built inside IntelliJ IDEA.

Hey there, human. I’m Runzo. Yes, your IDE’s Run button.
I’ve been living inside IntelliJ IDEA for 25 years, watching devs build incredible things and occasionally rage-clicking me when their code won't compile.
My mission? Make your ideas real, or to put it simply – run your code.
This game lets you follow my journey, all 25 years of it – the upgrades, the chaos, the bugs, the breakthroughs.

Stick around, help me survive it all… and maybe, just maybe, give me a chance to escape for a birthday party.

idea-plugin.name: Scrolling Novel Reader
idea-plugin.description:
Novel Reader is an IntelliJ IDEA plugin that allows you to read local TXT novels directly inside the IDE with a smooth scrolling experience and automatic chapter loading.

Novel Reader（IDEA 小说阅读器）

在 IntelliJ IDEA 内的工具窗口中阅读本地 TXT 小说，支持章节目录、滚轮阅读、 上下持续滚动自动加载相邻章节，并自动记忆阅读进度。

Key Features

  • Tool Window based novel reader inside IntelliJ IDEA
  • Automatic chapter detection and chapter list navigation
  • Continuous reading by scrolling up and down
  • Sliding window mechanism to prevent performance degradation
  • Reading progress persistence (chapter + position)
  • Configurable font size and novel file selection

Usage

  1. Open the Novel Reader tool window
  2. Select a local TXT novel file in Settings
  3. Scroll to read, chapters load automatically

  • Initial release of IDEA Novel Reader

idea-plugin.name: More Star Trek Progress Bars
idea-plugin.description:
Replaces IntelliJ's progress bars with Star Trek starships. The ship flies across the bar with a warp trail streaming behind it.

Ships:

  • USS Enterprise (NCC-1701)
  • USS Voyager (NCC-74656)
  • USS Defiant (NX-74205)

Settings (Settings → Appearance → Star Trek Progress Bar):

  • Choose the ship
  • Set the warp trail colour
  • Set the warp trail fade length

Both determinate and indeterminate progress bars are supported. A live preview is shown in the settings panel.

  • Supports both determinate and indeterminate progress bars

idea-plugin.name: MoFish Tool
idea-plugin.description:
MoFish Tool is a lightweight IntelliJ IDEA market assistant for viewing selected quotes, portfolio profit, and price reminders without leaving the IDE.

It provides a dedicated mofish tool window, rotating status bar snippets, watchlists, holdings profit, price/change reminders, and in-IDE detail or trend pages for stocks, indexes, funds, cryptocurrencies, and foreign exchange rates.

  • View watchlists, grouped stocks, holdings, and profit without leaving the editor.
  • Configure modules, card/table views, stock columns, and auto-refresh preferences.
  • Get IDE notifications when a price or percentage-change reminder is hit.
  • Show profit summaries and selected market snippets in the status bar.
  • Stay usable with fallback data when live quote providers are temporarily unavailable.

mofish 是一个运行在 IntelliJ IDEA 内的行情助手插件，用于在开发过程中查看自选行情、持仓收益和价格提醒，减少在 IDE 与行情页面之间切换。

  • 自选行情：支持股票、指数、基金、虚拟币和外汇。
  • 持仓收益：汇总股票、基金和虚拟币持仓收益。
  • 状态栏展示：轮播收益摘要和已选行情信息。
  • 行情提醒：价格或涨跌幅达到条件时通过 IDE 通知提醒。
  • 数据兜底：远程行情暂时不可用时使用静态或占位数据保持界面可用。
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• Added a configurable rise/fall color under Settings > mofish > 界面. Rise and fall are chosen independently from red, green, and black, so 红涨绿跌, 绿涨红跌, and a single monochrome color are all possible. Defaults stay red for rise and green for fall. The setting applies to the quote tables, the stock card view, K-line candles, the intraday chart, and the stock detail badges.
  • 新增“涨跌颜色”配置（设置 > mofish > 界面）。上涨和下跌各自独立选择红/绿/黑，因此可组合出红涨绿跌、绿涨红跌或统一单色， 默认仍为红涨绿跌。该配置作用于行情表格、股票卡片视图、K 线蜡烛、分时图和股票详情页涨跌标签。
  • Fixed funds showing 暂无数据 after being added: the legacy East Money JSONP valuation endpoint (fundgz.1234567.com.cn) was retired and now returns a 404 page with HTTP 200, so every quote silently fell back to the placeholder row. Funds now resolve through the East Money mobile API, falling back to the most recent confirmed net value when no intraday valuation is published.
  • Fund quotes are fetched in a single batched request instead of one request per fund.
  • Fixed the misaligned hover tooltip on the fund trend charts: the axis label pass left the canvas in center/top text alignment, so tooltip text was drawn offset from its frame. The tooltip is also now clamped inside the canvas on both edges.
  • Fixed NoClassDefFoundError: com/intellij/ui/jcef/JBCefApp when opening trend or detail pages on IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2. JCEF is now a separate bundled plugin there and is no longer visible to plugins through the core platform, so an explicit optional dependency on com.intellij.modules.jcef is declared.
  • JCEF usage is isolated behind a single wrapper class, so a missing or user-disabled JCEF plugin now falls back to the informational panel instead of failing editor creation.
  • 修复基金添加后列表显示 暂无数据 的问题：天天基金旧 JSONP 估值接口已下线，且以 HTTP 200 返回 404 页面，导致所有行情静默回退为占位数据。 现改用天天基金移动端接口，且在没有盘中估值时回退展示最近一个确认净值。
  • 基金行情改为单次批量请求，不再按基金逐个请求。
  • 修复基金走势图悬浮提示框文字与边框错位的问题：绘制坐标轴刻度后遗留了居中/顶部对齐的画布状态，导致提示文字偏离边框。 同时提示框在左右边缘都会被限制在画布内。
  • 修复在 IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2 上打开走势页或详情页时报 NoClassDefFoundError: com/intellij/ui/jcef/JBCefApp 的问题： 2026.2 起 JCEF 被拆分为独立插件，不再通过核心平台对插件可见，因此显式声明了对 com.intellij.modules.jcef 的可选依赖。
  • JCEF 相关调用收敛到单独的封装类，JCEF 插件缺失或被用户禁用时会回退到提示面板，而不再导致编辑器创建失败。
