idea-plugin.name: XIMCloud Tools
idea-plugin.description:
XIMCloud Tools Collection.
Help you work-- life++
idea-plugin.change-notes:
v2.31.6

  • New internal plugin — CASMOD Data Sync: adds a CASMOD-specific DataWorks operations plugin with IDE-native Settings + Action + ToolWindow surfaces. It ports the original business workflow into XIMCloud Tools, including single/workflow-batch/all/owner-batch/resume execution planning, CSV-like report persistence, failed/unfinished rerun flows, JWT token refresh, API throttling backoff, and 4-stage execution tracking.
  • Security / configuration model: the new plugin no longer relies on plaintext external YAML at runtime. Non-secret environment/workflow/table/owner configuration is plugin-managed in store-backed JSON, while JWT client secrets and DB passwords are moved into the IDEA credential vault.
  • DB verification parity: the release includes PostgreSQL JDBC-backed count and SystemModTime verification so CASMOD report and resume flows keep the same core validation shape as the source tool.

v2.31.5

  • Runtime / Bridge hardening: bridge callers now require explicit success=true, unwrap wrapped async failures, and fall back to stable non-empty error messages instead of silently accepting malformed responses or surfacing literal null texts.
  • ToolWindow / Startup / External plugin UX: hosted ToolWindow registration now rebuilds more defensively, startup listeners reject invalid registrations and log listener failures, icon loading is normalized, and external-plugin reload/load failures now surface readable fallback reasons.
  • Permission Switch / Settings polish: export now stops when any environment secret cannot be read safely, and related settings/toolwindow/icon regressions gained focused coverage.
  • Internal plugin scope change: AI Commit, Clipboard History, and Mouse Controller are removed from the shipped runtime in this release scope.

v2.31.4

  • Permission Switch / client_secret safety: editing an environment no longer converts a vault-read failure into a blank client_secret overwrite. When the current secret cannot be read safely, the settings dialog now stops the edit and leaves the stored secret unchanged.
  • Permission Switch / vault durability: ClientSecretVault.save/delete now persist synchronously before warming the in-memory cache, and save failures are surfaced immediately instead of being masked by async cache-first success.
  • Regression coverage / engineering memory: added focused tests for failed secret prefill, synchronous vault persistence, and factory-reset compatibility; recorded the recurring failure pattern in repository engineering memory.

v2.31.3

  • IDE 2026.2 compatibility: removed all 3 deprecated/internal PluginManager.getPlugin(PluginId) usages. Host-plugin descriptor/version lookup now resolves from the plugin-aware classloader, with packaged META-INF/plugin.xml as a version fallback for non-plugin-aware paths such as tests and error-report text generation.
  • Log Management / Runtime logging: runtime logs now become visible in the in-memory recent buffer immediately and are written to XIMCloudTools.log asynchronously by the background worker. The store/log append route now reaches the same file sink, each file line carries ximVersion=<pluginVersion>, and file-size overflow rebuilds the newest retained tail directly instead of append-then-read-trim loops.
  • Store Management / Startup cleanup: plugin snapshot detail JSON now scopes businessSettings to the selected plugin’s owned settings key(s) instead of dumping the whole table. Retired the unused plugin-auth-state.bin runtime persistence side-path; the shared authState store token remains only as a deprecated compatibility stub that now returns an explicit unsupported response.
  • License / Docs / Skills: new and re-signed licenses continue to use SHA-256, while v2.31.3 keeps MD5 read-compat for legacy pre-2.28.7 licenses to avoid silent downgrade on patch upgrade. The AssertJ/Awaitility and DEP-EVAL-001 evaluation docs were distilled into repository skill/memory guidance and removed from docs.

v2.31.2

  • Bugfix — Permission Switch "IdeaCredentialVault unavailable": loading current roles always failed with "Failed to read client_secret for environment X: IdeaCredentialVault unavailable" even though the secret was saved. Root cause: IdeaCredentialVault is a Spring @Service but was never registered as an IDEA <applicationService>; ClientSecretVault (a static-only facade) resolved it via Application.getService(...) which always returned null. Fix: added IdeaCredentialVaultBootstrap Spring component that publishes the bean to a static facade IdeaCredentialVault.getInstance(); ClientSecretVault.loadResult/persist now reads from this facade. Added INFO/DEBUG logs along the chain (vault publish, cache hit/miss, raw vs normalized load result, persist outcome) for future diagnosis.

v2.31.1

  • Bugfix — Settings Apply误报： applying any settings tab triggered "日志管理 日志文件大小必须是1到512之间的整数" error even when Log Management tab was never opened. Root cause: SettingsManagementPlugin.applySettings() iterated every child SettingsPanelService unconditionally; LogManagementSettingsPanel.applySettings() then parsed an empty/null maxFileSizeField and surfaced the validation dialog. Fix: host now skips services whose isSettingsModified() returns false; panel also defensively early-returns when not initialized.

v2.31.0

  • Store Management — Snapshot dialog (item 1): plugin data snapshot now renders three sections — metadata / sandboxStore / businessSettings. The businessSettings section reads the entire businessSettings table so Permission Switch env/app/role/user (and AI-Commit settings, etc.) are now visible. Secret-like fields (secret/password/token/credential, case-insensitive) are masked as ***.
  • Store Management — Action buttons (item 2): removed “Copy storage snapshot” button; relocated “Rebuild plugin store” into the plugin data snapshot panel so the destructive action sits next to the table it affects; renamed “Clear global config” → “Reset global config” with new semantics — clear current values, then re-seed from application.yml ximcloud.tools.store.global-defaults via GlobalDefaultsRegistry.writeAll.
  • Store Management — Global config dialog (item 3): in edit mode the key field is now read-only (Add mode keeps it editable) to prevent accidental key drift; value editor area expanded from 6 to 8 rows so the dialog grows ~25% taller for long JSON values.

v2.30.0

  • AOP Expansion (non-logging): introduced three new cross-cutting aspects in addition to the v2.29.0 tracing infra:
    • @RequireLicense(level, onDenied) — declarative license-level gating via LicenseGateAspect (Order=-100, runs first). Strategies: THROW / RETURN_NULL / RETURN_DEFAULT / LOG_DENY.
    • @OnEdt / @OffEdt — declarative thread placement via ThreadDispatchAspect (Order=-50). Auto-dispatches to EDT or background pool when called from the wrong thread; strict mode throws.
    • @Timed(name, warnThresholdMs) — declarative timing via TimedAspect (Order=-30) + lock-free MetricsCollector aggregating invocations / total / max / errors per metric.
  • Timing applied: PluginBridgeBus.request() now records bridge.request metric with 1000ms warn threshold for slow RPC visibility.
  • Handwritten log coverage for non-Spring extension points: added entry/exit logs to AnAction.actionPerformed for ShowPluginStatus / RestartPlugins / OpenPermissionSwitch / ReloadExternalPlugins; added apply() / reset() / isModified() logs in XIMCloudToolsSettingsPanel (IDEA Configurable); added LicenseUtil.getPrivateKey / getPublicKey / verifyAndDecodeLicenseKey success/failure logs.
  • Plugin Firmware: License Management 1.0.10 → 1.0.11 (LicenseUtil log additions trigger the bundle re-stamp).

v2.29.0

  • Observability (AOP Tracing): introduced a single-annotation tracing system via Spring AOP + AspectJ — all Spring-managed beans under cn.ximcloud.tools now emit method enter/exit at TRACE and catch warnings at WARN/ERROR, gated by isTraceEnabled() for zero overhead in default DEBUG mode. New annotations: @LogTrace (opt-in), @NoLogTrace (opt-out), @LogLifecycle (INFO entry/exit for @PostConstruct/@PreDestroy).
  • Sensitive masking: shared TraceMaskingSupport redacts license/secret/email/serial/token/PEM/JWT fields to *** at depth=3, collection-cap=5, with cycle detection.
  • Settings UX (gated): "插件目录" / "数据目录" / "业务数据目录" / "插件数据快照" in System Status, Plugin Management and Store Management are now visible only when license level ≥ Developer, matching the existing developer-mode gating elsewhere.
  • Store Management UX: added horizontal separators between 存储概览 / 全局配置 / 插件数据快照, wrapped the settings panel in a vertical scroll pane so taller content no longer clips, and the Plugin Data Snapshot list now opens a detail dialog on double-click that renders the persisted JSON in plaintext for inspection.
  • Catch-block hygiene: 6 silent catch (Throwable ignored) sites in platform/reporting and core/dynamic|lifecycle|runtime now log at DEBUG with contextual prefix, keeping graceful-fallback semantics but recoverable in XIMCloudTools.log.
  • Plugin Firmware: TouchFish 1.0.11→1.0.12; Plugin Management 1.0.12→1.0.13; Store Management 1.0.9→1.0.10; System Status 1.0.9→1.0.10.

v2.28.9

  • Bugfix (ToolWindow Visibility): ToolWindowVisibilityService no longer eagerly hydrates in @PostConstruct (which raced ahead of PluginRegistryService registering the toolwindow_management plugin and printed "Source plugin not found: 11"). Now hydrates lazily on first isEnabled() call, matching the on-demand pattern used by SystemStatusStoreClient.

v2.28.8

  • Settings UX: XIMCloud Tools settings panels moved from "Other Settings" to a child node under Tools for better discoverability.
  • Log Management: recent-log level filter changed from exact match to "greater-than-or-equal" — selecting INFO now shows INFO/WARN/ERROR, matching standard logging semantics.
  • Plugin Management: recent events panel now shows only plugin-lifecycle events (registration, install, uninstall, enable/disable, reload, override). Unified lifecycle logs into a single plugin.lifecycle category with the concrete event name kept in details.event.
  • ToolWindow Visibility: added a global toggle to show/hide the XIMCloud Tools ToolWindow. Default is enabled; switching off via System Status global settings hides all hosted tool windows immediately.
  • System Status: renamed "Notification Settings" to "Global Settings" and added the ToolWindow visibility checkbox alongside the existing global notification toggle.

v2.28.7

  • Dependencies (DEP-EVAL-001): introduced Caffeine 3.2.0 and Resilience4j 2.2.0; replaced hand-rolled caching/retry/hex implementations with mainstream libraries to remove duplicated infrastructure.
  • Permission Switch: ClientSecretVault now uses Caffeine for in-process secret caching (TTL 15m, max 256 entries, stats enabled); added explicit invalidate(envId) for targeted eviction.
  • Plugin Startup: AsyncPluginStartupService retry/back-off rewritten on Resilience4j Retry with event-driven attempt observation; removed redundant scheduler and manual sleep loop.
  • License: license payload hash migrated MD5 → SHA-256 with dual-read window — existing MD5 licenses continue to verify with an INFO log; MD5 fallback will be removed in 2.31.x. License-key signing now uses SHA-256 by default.
  • TouchFish / Storage: shared JsonMappers.shared() rolled out to plugin settings blob store; TouchFish key-combo binding serialization simplified (record-based, on-disk shape unchanged, backward compatible).
  • Core utils: hex encoding extracted into HexUtil shared by MD5/SHA utilities; removed unused imports in license tooling.
  • Docs: DEP-EVAL-001 dependency scan report finalized — Group A/B/D delivered; DEP-05/06/08/09/10 evaluated and explicitly retained as-is with rationale.

v2.28.6

  • Architecture (HAP-024 Phase B): synchronized 5 safe accessory setters from CompletableFuture<Void> to void: ToggleAccessory.setEnabled, ModeAccessory.setMode, PerformanceAccessory.setEnabled/setIntensity, NotificationAccessory.sendNotification, UsageAccessory.setEnabled. Exceptions now propagate directly via throws Exception.
  • Architecture (HAP-030 Pilot-1): ServiceControlService.startService()/stopService() now route through StartServiceCharacteristic/StopServiceCharacteristic.setValue(true) as a true facade — the characteristic write callback is the unique invocation path to accessory.startService()/stopService(), ensuring service public methods and direct characteristic writes share one execution path.
  • Docs: HAP-024 closed with Phase B implementation archive; HAP-031 closed with identify()/serialNumber marked N/A for IDE context.
  • Skills: consolidated repository skills to .github/skills/ (single source of truth, no junctions); dropped 17 generic skills unrelated to Java/IntelliJ plugin development.

idea-plugin.name: DX Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Dx-Companion

Overview

DX Companion is an IntelliJ IDEA plugin designed to enhance developer experience by providing a customizable, configuration-driven interface for common development actions. The plugin creates a dedicated tool window that allows developers to execute terminal commands, toggle environment variables, and trigger IntelliJ actions through a tree-based UI with keyboard shortcuts support.

{
  "toolbarButtons": [
     {
        "type": "action",
        "label": "Build Project",
        "command": "mvn install"
     }
  ],
  "nodes": [
    {
       "type": "observedFile",
       "label": "Debug Mode",
       "filePath": ".env",
       "variableName": "DEBUG_MODE",
       "postToggle": {
          "type": "action",
          "command": "make reload-debug-mode",
          "cwd": "/home"
       }
    },
    {
       "type": "action",
       "label": "Build clean Project",
       "command": "mvn clean install"
    },
    {
       "type": "script",
       "label": "Display a message",
       "source": "import static com.intellij.openapi.ui.Messages.showInfoMessage\n\nshowInfoMessage((3+2).toString(),\"test\")"
    }
  ]
}

Features

File Observation System

  • Monitors specific configuration files defined in .dx-companion.json/.dx-companion.yaml
  • Visually indicates whether specific variables are active or commented out
  • Allows one-click toggling between active and inactive states
  • Handles different comment prefixes for various file types

Action System

  • Creates custom buttons with configurable labels and icons
  • Executes defined shell commands in the terminal, executes registered intellij action or execute a script through IdeScriptEngine
  • Supports specifying working directories for command execution

Configuration

The plugin uses a JSON/YAML configuration file (.dx-companion.json/.dx-companion.yaml) in the project root directory, which defines:

  • Files to observe with their paths and variable names
  • Custom shell commands with labels and icons

Auto-Refresh

  • Automatically checks for configuration changes every 2 seconds
  • Provides a manual refresh button for immediate updates

Use Cases

The plugin is particularly useful for:

  1. Managing feature flags in configuration files (enabling/disabling features)
  2. Running common development tasks with a single click (build, deploy, test)
  3. Switching between development environments (toggling environment variables)
  4. Executing project-specific commands without memorizing syntax

Integration

The plugin integrates with:

  • IntelliJ Platform APIs
  • Terminal plugin for command execution
  • Project file system for configuration management

This tool serves as a companion for developers to streamline common tasks and reduce cognitive load when working with complex project configurations.

DxCompanion Configuration File Documentation

Overview

The .dx-companion.json/.dx-companion.yaml file is the core configuration file for the DxCompanion IntelliJ plugin. It defines the files to observe for toggling and the shell commands that can be executed from the plugin's tool window.

Configuration

The plugin is driven by JSON configuration files located in the project root:

  • Primary configuration file: .dx-companion.json/.dx-companion.yaml
  • Local override configuration: .dx-companion.local.json/.dx-companion.local.yaml

If both files are found, their configurations are merged.

Schema

The plugin supports following main node types:

  1. Action Nodes

    Actions execute terminal commands or trigger built-in IDE actions:

    {
    "type": "action",
    "label": "Start Application",
    "command": "npm start",
    "cwd": "./app",
    "shortcut": "ctrl alt s",
    "icon": "debugger/threadRunning.svg"
}

    Built-in IDE actions can be called using the action: prefix:

    {
    "type": "action",
    "label": "Open Terminal",
    "command": "action:ActivateTerminalToolWindow"
}

    To help writing of action:xxx command, an autocompletion is available when editing .dx-companion.json

  2. Script Nodes

    Script execute script source throught IdeScriptEngine:

    {
    "type": "script",
    "label": "Start Application",
    "source": "import static com.intellij.openapi.ui.Messages.showInfoMessage\n\nshowInfoMessage((3+2).toString(),\"test\")",
    "icon": "debugger/threadRunning.svg"
}

  3. Observed File Nodes

    These nodes monitor configuration files (like .env) and allow toggling variables on/off by commenting/uncommenting:

    {
   "type": "observedFile",
   "label": "Enable Debug Mode",
   "filePath": ".env",
   "variableName": "DEBUG_MODE",
   "commentPrefix": "#",
   "shortcut": "ctrl shift d"
}

  4. Path Nodes

    Organizational nodes that create folders in the tree structure:

    {
   "type": "path",
   "label": "Database Tools",
   "nodes": [ {
      "type": "action",
      "label": "Migrate Database",
      "command": "npm run migrate"
   }]
}

Configuration Properties

Root Properties

PropertyTypeDescription
nodesArrayList action Nodes,ObservedFile or Path
toolbarButtonsArrayList of action nodes

ObservedFile Properties

PropertyTypeRequiredDefaultDescription
labelStringYes-The display name for the toggle button
filePathStringYes-Path to the file, relative to project root
variableNameStringYes-Name of the variable to toggle
commentPrefixStringNo#Character(s) used to comment out variables
shortcutStringNo-Keyboard shortcut (currently not implemented)
activeIconStringNoactions/inlayRenameInComments.svgIcon path when variable is active
inactiveIconStringNoactions/inlayRenameInCommentsActive.svgIcon path when variable is commented out
unknownIconStringNoexpui/fileTypes/unknown.svgIcon path when file is not found
postToggleStructureNo-a post toggle command (action or script) executed once toggle is executed

Action Properties

PropertyTypeRequiredDefaultDescription
labelStringNoActionThe display name for the action button
commandStringYes-Shell command to execute or registered action if started with action:
cwdStringNoProject rootWorking directory for the command
shortcutStringNo-Keyboard shortcut (currently not implemented)
iconStringNodebugger/threadRunning.svgIcon path for the action button

Script Properties

PropertyTypeRequiredDefaultDescription
labelStringNoActionThe display name for the action button
sourceStringYes-Script source
extensionStringYes-Use to determinate script engine, default in "groovy" to use builtin groovy script engine
shortcutStringNo-Keyboard shortcut (currently not implemented)
iconStringNodebugger/threadRunning.svgIcon path for the action button

Icon System

DxCompanion uses IntelliJ's built-in icon system. You can specify icons from the IntelliJ icon library by using their path. Some common icon paths include:

  • actions/inlayRenameInComments.svg
  • actions/inlayRenameInCommentsActive.svg
  • expui/fileTypes/unknown.svg
  • debugger/threadRunning.svg
  • expui/actions/buildAutoReloadChanges.svg

Comprehensive Example

{
  "toolbarButtons": [
     {
        "label": "Build",
        "command": "mvn clean install",
        "icon": "actions/compile.svg"
     }
  ],
  "nodes": [
    {
      "label": "Debug Mode",
      "filePath": ".env",
      "variableName": "DEBUG_MODE",
      "commentPrefix": "#",
      "postToggle": {
          "type": "script",
          "source": "import static com.intellij.openapi.ui.Messages.showInfoMessage\n\nshowInfoMessage(\"DEBUG MODE CHANGED\",\"test\")"
      }
    },
    {
      "label": "Feature Flag",
      "filePath": "config/settings.properties",
      "variableName": "FEATURE_ENABLED",
      "commentPrefix": "#",
      "activeIcon": "actions/execute.svg",
      "inactiveIcon": "actions/suspend.svg",
      "postToggle": {
          "type": "action",
          "command": "make reload-reload",
          "cwd": "/home"
      }
    },
    {
      "type": "script",
      "label": "Display a message",
      "source": "import static com.intellij.openapi.ui.Messages.showInfoMessage\n\nshowInfoMessage((3+2).toString(),\"test\")"
    },
    {
      "label": "Docker Compose",
      "filePath": "docker-compose.yml",
      "variableName": "LOCAL_DATABASE",
      "commentPrefix": "#"
    },
    {
      "label": "Build",
      "command": "mvn clean install",
      "icon": "actions/compile.svg"
    },
    {
      "type": "path",
      "label": "section1",
      "nodes": [
        {
          "type": "path",
          "label": "section1.1",
          "nodes": [
            {
              "label": "Open IdeScriptingConsole",
              "command": "action:IdeScriptingConsole",
              "icon": "actions/compile.svg"
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "label": "Run Tests",
      "command": "mvn test",
      "cwd": "./tests",
      "icon": "runConfigurations/testState.svg"
    },
    {
      "label": "Deploy",
      "command": "./scripts/deploy.sh",
      "icon": "actions/upload.svg"
    }
  ]
}

How It Works

File Observation

The plugin monitors the specified files for variables that are either active or commented out. For example, in an .env file:

# This is a commented out variable
# DEBUG_MODE=true

Clicking the toggle button would change it to:

# This is a commented out variable
DEBUG_MODE=true

The plugin detects the difference between active variables and commented ones using the commentPrefix and variableName configuration.

Actions

When you click an action button, the plugin:

  1. Opens a terminal session in the IntelliJ Terminal tool window
  2. Changes to the specified working directory (if provided)
  3. Executes the specified command nb: if command starts with action:, as in action:IdeScriptingConsole, then the registered action will be executed (list of actions https://centic9.github.io/IntelliJ-Action-IDs/)

This allows for quick execution of common development tasks directly from the IDE.

Troubleshooting

If the plugin encounters issues with your configuration file, it will display an error message in the tool window. Common issues include:

  • Missing .dx-companion.json/.dx-companion.yaml file in project root
  • Invalid JSON/YAML syntax
  • Missing required properties

The plugin automatically reloads the configuration every 2 seconds, so changes to the configuration file will be reflected without restarting the IDE.

idea-plugin.name: OpenTelemetry
idea-plugin.description:
The OpenTelemetry plugin brings application logs, metrics, and traces into JetBrains IDEs. Inspect runtime data next to your code without setting up a separate observability backend! See the documentation for more details.

Features

  • Logs: Search and filter log records, then open any record to inspect its attributes.
  • Metrics: Browse the metric tree and select a metric to visualize it.
  • Traces: Open a trace in the built-in viewer to follow its span hierarchy across services and inspect the timing and attributes of each span.
  • Service Map: Open the Service Map to see how services, endpoints, databases, and message queues connect based on collected traces.
  • MCP: Use the MCP Server integration to let AI agents query logs, services, the Service Map, and spans.
  • Run Configurations: Run your already instrumented Java, Python, Go, Node.js, or .NET application using an IDE run configuration, and its telemetry will appear in the plugin automatically.
  • Integrated Terminal: Run an instrumented application in a new IDE terminal session, and its telemetry will appear in the plugin automatically.

idea-plugin.name: Main Menu Craft
idea-plugin.description:
Overview:

This plugin allows you to add customizable menu items to the "Tools" section of the main menu.

Features:

  • Add up to 3 customizable menus under the "Tools" menu
  • Menu structure is managed using a JSON file, which can be placed in the project and shared with your team via Git
  • File paths can be specified as relative or absolute
  • Icons can be set for each menu item
  • Independent settings management per project
  • Share menu settings with your team by managing .idea/MainMenuCraft.xml in Git

Menu Functions:

  • Open files
    • Open at a specific line
    • Open at a specific method (planned feature)
  • Open URLs (browser can be specified)
  • Open Explorer / Finder
  • Launch built-in terminal (commands can be preset)
    • Run scripts and make commands from the menu
  • Separators
  • Grouped submenus (icon support)

How to Use:

  • 1. Create a JSON file to define your custom menu
  • 2. Specify the file path in the plugin settings
  • 3. The custom menu will be applied to the "Tools" menu

JSON Structure:

  • See the documentation here for configurable parameters
  • If not configured, a sample JSON file like the following will be generated
{
  "label": "MainMenuCraft",
  "icon": "AllIcons.Actions.Minimap",
  "children": [
    {
      "label": "Open Settings",
      "actionId": "ShowSettings",
      "icon": "AllIcons.Actions.InlayGear"
    },
    {
      "label": "Open MainMenuCraft Setting",
      "actionId": "MainMenuCraft.OpenSettings",
      "icon": "AllIcons.Actions.InlayGear"
    },
    {
      "label": "Open built in icons site",
      "value": "https://intellij-icons.jetbrains.design/",
      "icon": "AllIcons.Actions.InlayGlobe"
    },
    {
      "label": "Menu config json description",
      "value": "https://bitbucket.org/masa0038/mainmenucraft/src/master/",
      "icon": "AllIcons.Actions.InlayGlobe"
    },
    {
      "type": "separator",
      "label": "Setting"
    },
    {
      "type": "group",
      "label": "Open Setting",
      "children": [
        {
          "label": "Open Settings",
          "actionId": "ShowSettings",
          "icon": "AllIcons.Actions.InlayGear"
        },
        {
          "label": "Open MainMenuCraft Setting",
          "actionId": "MainMenuCraft.OpenSettings",
          "icon": "AllIcons.Actions.InlayGear"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}

✨ New Features

  • Browser selection (browserName field): You can now specify which browser to use when opening a URL with the browser type. Set the browserName field to the name of a browser registered in your IDE (e.g. "Chrome", "Firefox", "Edge"). ✨ 新機能

  • ブラウザ指定起動（browserName フィールド）: browser タイプのメニューアイテムに browserName フィールドを追加し、URLを開くブラウザを指定できるようになりました。IDEに登録されているブラウザ名（例: "Chrome"・"Firefox"・"Edge"）を指定できます。カンマ区切りで複数指定（例: "Chrome,Edge"）すると、指定した全ブラウザで同時に開きます。"default" を指定するとIDEのデフォルトブラウザで開きます。未指定の場合はこれまで通りデフォルトブラウザを使用します。
  • グループメニューへのアイコン設定（group タイプの icon フィールド）: group タイプのメニューアイテムに icon フィールドを指定できるようになりました。GitLabやGitHubなどの組み込みメニューと同様に、グループ名の横にアイコンを表示できます。

ver 16.2.2

✨ New Features

  • Open Explorer / Finder (explorer type): Launch the OS file manager (Windows: Explorer / macOS: Finder / Linux: file manager) from the menu. Use the {projectDir} placeholder to open your project folder directly. An error dialog is shown if the specified folder does not exist.
  • Launch Built-in Terminal (terminal type): Open the IDE's built-in terminal in any working directory from the menu. You can preset commands to pre-fill input or auto-execute them. Tab names can be customized (defaults to the menu label).
  • Japanese Default Menu: When the IDE locale is set to Japanese, the default menu is now displayed in Japanese.

✨ 新機能

  • エクスプローラー/Finder を開く（explorer タイプ）: メニューから OS のファイルマネージャー（Windows: エクスプローラー / macOS: Finder / Linux: ファイルマネージャー）を起動できるようになりました。{projectDir} プレースホルダーでプロジェクトフォルダを直接開けます。指定したフォルダが存在しない場合はエラーダイアログを表示します。
  • 組み込みターミナルを起動（terminal タイプ）: メニューから IDE の組み込みターミナルを任意の作業ディレクトリで開けるようになりました。コマンドをプリセットして「入力済み状態」や「自動実行」もできます。タブ名をカスタマイズできます（省略時はメニューラベルを使用）。
  • 日本語デフォルトメニュー: IDE のロケールが日本語の場合、初期デフォルトメニューが日本語で表示されます。

ver 16.2.0

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • Fixed a bug where menus from other projects were displayed when multiple projects were opened simultaneously.
  • Settings are now managed per project, allowing independent menu configurations for each project.

⚠️ Breaking Changes

  • Important: Settings are now project-specific. You need to reconfigure the menu settings for each project.
  • Settings are now saved in .idea/MainMenuCraft.xml for each project.
  • Previous application-level settings will not be migrated automatically.

✨ Benefits

  • Each project can have different menu configurations.
  • Proper operation when multiple projects are opened simultaneously.
  • Settings can be shared with your team by managing .idea/MainMenuCraft.xml in Git.

🐛 不具合修正

  • 複数のプロジェクトを同時に開いている場合に、別プロジェクトのメニューが表示される不具合を修正しました。
  • 設定をプロジェクト単位で管理するように変更し、各プロジェクトで独立したメニュー設定が可能になりました。

⚠️ 重要な変更

  • 重要: 設定がプロジェクト単位に変更されました。各プロジェクトでメニュー設定を再設定する必要があります。
  • 設定は各プロジェクトの .idea/MainMenuCraft.xml に保存されます。
  • 以前のアプリケーションレベルの設定は自動的には引き継がれません。

✨ メリット

  • プロジェクトごとに異なるメニュー設定が可能になります。
  • 複数プロジェクト同時起動時に正しく動作します。
  • .idea/MainMenuCraft.xml をGit管理すれば、チームで設定を共有できます。

ver 16.1.0

  • Expanded the number of customizable menus from 1 to 3.

  • カスタマイズ可能なメニュー数を1つから3つに拡張しました。

ver 0.0.7

  • Support for opening PHP files at a given location by specifying the method or function name. (Works in IDEs with PhpStorm or php plugins installed.)

  • PHPファイルをメソッド名または関数名を指定して、その位置で開けるように対応しました。（PhpStormやphpプラグインをインストールしたIDEで機能します。）

ver 0.0.6

  • document update.

ver 0.0.1

  • Initial version

idea-plugin.name: Apero Translate strings
idea-plugin.description:
A powerful string translation plugin for IntelliJ-based IDEs (including Android Studio) that helps developers translate string resources using Google Generative AI.
Features: - Translate entire XML files to multiple languages using Google Generative AI (Gemini 2.5 Flash) - Add and translate individual strings with real-time AI translation - Batch translation with intelligent API usage and retry logic - Support for 25+ languages including Vietnamese, Chinese, Korean, Japanese, and more - Automatic XML formatting and escaping with proper entity handling - Integration with project resource structure and auto-detection - Smart rate limiting and API key rotation for reliability - Configurable API keys with secure storage - Auto-filtering of qualifier folders (night, v29, land, hdpi...)
Perfect for developers who need to quickly localize their applications, especially Android developers working with string resources.
Author: Thanh Nguyen (thanhnguyen6702@gmail.com)
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Version 0.0.5 - Enhanced XML Compatibility & Escape Characters

  • 🔧 Enhanced XML Escape Handling - Comprehensive support for all Android XML special characters
  • 📝 Improved Prompt Examples - Added examples for &, <, >, quotes, apostrophes, and backslashes
  • 🎯 Perfect XmlProcessor Compatibility - Server handles all escaping, client only processes newlines/tabs
  • 🛡️ Robust Character Support - Handle file paths, commands, comparison operators, and special symbols
  • 📚 Comprehensive Documentation - Clear explanation of escape character handling responsibilities
  • ✅ Android XML Standards - Full compliance with Android string resource requirements

Version 0.0.4 - Ultra Parallel & Dynamic Model

  • 🚀 Ultra Parallel Translation - Multi-threaded translation using all available API keys simultaneously
  • ⚡ Simultaneous Language Processing - Calculate and translate multiple languages at once based on rate limits
  • 🧠 Dynamic Model Loading - Fetch model name from remote URL, no hardcoded models
  • 🔄 429 Rate Limit Auto-Retry - Automatic 60-second wait and retry for rate limit errors
  • 📊 Smart Batch Sizing - Optimal 100-string batches for maximum API efficiency
  • 🛡️ Robust Cancellation - Proper thread interruption and cleanup on user cancel
  • 🔧 Clean Code Architecture - Removed unnecessary logic, focus on essential multi-threading
  • 📈 Performance - Up to 6x faster translation with 2 API keys (6 languages simultaneously)

Version 0.0.3 - Major Module Update

  • 🚀 Module-based Translation - Auto-detect Android modules, no manual file selection needed
  • 🌐 KMM Support - Full Kotlin Multiplatform Mobile support (shared, androidMain, commonMain)
  • 🔍 Smart Project Scanner - Automatically find all translatable modules in project
  • ⚡ Dynamic Timeout - Smart timeout scaling (30s + 5s per string, max 300s)
  • 🔧 Refactored Architecture - Split services for better maintainability
  • 🐛 Better Error Handling - Fixed silent fallback bugs, proper exception propagation

idea-plugin.name: RequestMan
idea-plugin.description:
RequestMan - A powerful API testing and documentation generation tool integrated into IntelliJ IDEA. Supports both automatic API scanning and custom API management with multilingual support (English/Chinese).

RequestMan - 一款集成于 IntelliJ IDEA 的接口调试与文档生成工具，支持"接口扫描模式"与"自定义接口模式"自由切换，助力高效开发与接口管理。

Key Features / 核心功能：
  • Smart API Scanning / 智能接口扫描： Automatically scan Spring APIs (@RestController, @RequestMapping), generate API lists and parameter structures with documentation preview / 一键扫描项目中的 Spring 接口，自动生成接口列表、参数结构，支持文档预览与 JSON 示例生成
  • Custom API Management / 自定义接口管理： Manually add, edit, and save custom APIs with support for various request body types, authentication, and post-operations / 手动添加、编辑、保存自定义 API，支持多种请求体类型、认证、后置操作等高级功能
  • Environment & Variable Management / 环境与变量管理： Support multi-environment configuration and global variable management with {{variable}} syntax / 支持多环境配置，全局变量管理，使用 {{变量名}} 动态引用
  • Global Headers & Authentication / 全局请求头与认证： Support configurable global authentication headers with custom key-value pairs, automatically added to all requests / 支持可配置的全局认证请求头，可自定义键值对，自动添加到所有请求中
  • Quick Search & Location / 高效搜索定位： Use Ctrl+Alt+/ for instant API search by URL, method name, or third-party packages / 快捷键 Ctrl+Alt+/ 一键搜索，支持按 URL、方法名、三方包等多维度检索
  • Reverse API Location / 反向接口定位： Use Ctrl+Alt+Shift+F to find all API endpoints that call the current method with intelligent search, real-time filtering, and highlighted results / 快捷键 Ctrl+Alt+Shift+F 从任意方法反向查找调用它的所有接口端点，支持智能搜索、实时过滤和高亮显示
  • Panel Quick Access / 面板快速访问： Use Ctrl+Alt+Shift+Z to quickly show/hide the RequestMan tool window / 快捷键 Ctrl+Alt+Shift+Z 快速显示/隐藏 RequestMan 工具窗口
  • Response Processing / 响应处理与文档： Response folding, JSON formatting, documentation preview, and built-in JSONPath extractor / 响应折叠、JSON 格式化、文档预览、内置 JSONPath 提取器

Keyboard Shortcuts / 快捷键：
Shortcut / 快捷键Function / 功能Description / 描述
Ctrl+Alt+/API Search / API 搜索Instantly pop up API search window for quick navigation / 快速弹出 API 搜索窗口进行导航
Ctrl+Alt+Shift+ZShow/Hide Panel / 显示/隐藏面板Quickly show or hide the RequestMan tool window / 快速显示或隐藏 RequestMan 工具窗口
Ctrl+Alt+Shift+FLocate API / 定位 APIFind all API endpoints that call the current method / 查找所有调用当前方法的 API 端点
  • Import/Export / 接口导入导出： Support API collection import/export using standard JSON format / 支持接口集合的导入导出，使用标准 JSON 格式进行数据交换
  • Multilingual Support / 多语言支持： Full internationalization support for English and Chinese interfaces / 完整的英文和中文界面本地化支持
  • Performance Optimization / 性能优化： Configurable scanning timeout, caching, and performance monitoring / 可配置的扫描超时、缓存和性能监控

Quick Start / 快速开始：
  1. Settings / 插件设置： Go to Settings > RequestMan Settings to configure environments, global variables, and authentication headers / 在 IDEA 设置中选择 RequestMan Settings，配置环境管理、全局变量和认证请求头
  2. API Scanning / 接口扫描： Open the tool window, click "Refresh APIs" to automatically scan Spring APIs / 打开工具窗口，点击"刷新接口"自动扫描 Spring 接口，选择接口进行调试
  3. Custom APIs / 自定义接口： Switch mode and click "Add API" to create custom APIs with various body types / 切换模式，点击"新增接口"创建自定义 API，支持多种 Body 类型和后置操作
  4. API Search / 接口搜索： Press Ctrl+Alt+/ for quick API search and navigation / 按 Ctrl+Alt+/ 快速搜索和定位接口
  5. API Location / 接口定位： Press Ctrl+Alt+Shift+F to locate APIs from current method / 按 Ctrl+Alt+Shift+F 从当前方法定位相关接口
  6. Panel Access / 面板访问： Press Ctrl+Alt+Shift+Z to quickly show/hide the RequestMan tool window / 按 Ctrl+Alt+Shift+Z 快速显示/隐藏 RequestMan 工具窗口
  7. Variable Usage / 变量引用： Use {{variable}} syntax in parameters to reference global variables / 在参数中使用 {{变量名}} 动态引用全局变量

idea-plugin.name: HelloRead
idea-plugin.description:
HelloRead

HelloRead is a comprehensive novel reading plugin designed specifically for IntelliJ IDEA, providing a seamless reading experience for Chinese web novels directly within your development environment.

Key Features:

  • 📚 Bookshelf Management - Organize and manage your novel collection with ease
  • 📖 Advanced Reader - Clean, distraction-free reading interface with navigation controls
  • 🔍 Chapter Parsing - Automatically detects and parses various Chinese novel chapter formats
  • ⚙️ Customizable Settings - Adjust font family, size, line spacing, and paragraph spacing
  • 💾 Local Data Storage - All reading progress and settings saved locally using Properties files
  • ⌨️ Rich Keyboard Shortcuts - Quick access to all features with customizable hotkeys

Supported Formats:

  • UTF-8 encoded .txt files
  • Various Chinese chapter title patterns (第X章, 第X节, 第X回, etc.)
  • Pure numeric and Chinese numeric chapters

Quick Start (numeric keypad):

Open reader Ctrl+Alt+Numpad 1 to start reading.

Previous Chapter: Alt+Numpad 4

Next Chapter: Alt+Numpad 6

Close Reader: Ctrl+Alt+Numpad 0

Scroll Up/Previous Line: Alt+Numpad 8

Scroll Down/Next Line: Alt+Numpad 2

Hide or show the top bar: Alt+Numpad 5

HelloRead

HelloRead 是一款专为 IntelliJ IDEA 设计的本地小说阅读插件，为中文网络小说提供完整的阅读解决方案，让您在开发环境中享受舒适的阅读体验。

核心功能：

idea-plugin.name: yqExpress
idea-plugin.description:
YqExpress is a powerful plugin for IntelliJ IDEA that brings seamless YAML, JSON, XML, CSV, TOML and properties querying and transformation capabilities to your development workflow.
Whether you're parsing complex YAML, JSON, XML, CSV, TOML or properties structures or refining data with yq filters, yqExpress empowers you with a robust set of tools right within your IDE.

  • Interactive Filtering: Execute yq filters interactively within your IntelliJ IDEA environment. Visualize the results instantly with the built-in result panel.
  • Native yq Integration: Harness the full potential of yq by seamlessly integrating it into your workflow. Enable native yq filtering with configurable settings.
  • Settings Customization: Tailor yqExpress to match your preferences with customizable settings. Fine-tune filter execution delays and indentation sizes for optimal performance.
  • User-Friendly UI: Intuitive and user-friendly interface with a dedicated Query tab for efficient filtering. Settings tab for configuring native yq integration and other preferences.
  • Real-time Feedback: Instantly see the impact of your yq filters on YAML data. Efficiently debug and refine queries with real-time feedback.
  • Flexible Output Options: Choose between compact or human-readable output with a single click. Tailor the output to match your specific requirements effortlessly.


YqExpress provides a dedicated Settings tab allowing you to customize various aspects of your yq filtering experience.

  • Filter Execution Delay: Set the delay (in milliseconds) for yq filter execution to optimize responsiveness.
  • Indentation Size: Configure the indentation size in the yq filter input field for better readability.
  • Native yq Integration: Configure path to your yq executable.
  • Extended yq feature: using "eval-all" under Settings enables multiple YAML file processing at once by defining a file pattern (e.g. /**/*.yaml, /src/**/data-*.yaml, /**/test/**/*.yaml)

Explore the world of YAML manipulation with the yqExpress plugin - your go-to companion for yq in IntelliJ IDEA!

idea-plugin.name: Sciak Flow for Gitlab
idea-plugin.description:
Sciak Flow Plugin for Gitlab

Simple plugin for interacting with Gitlab, the plugin functionality are about:
  • Pipeline management
  • Merge request

This plugin is not affiliated, endorsed, sponsored, or approved with or by GitLab Inc.

Token Management

Api Token is stored in Idea `Passwords` wallet for security and safety reason, in this way will not be pushed in a repository by mistake. To verify if password are stored please check: File | Settings | Appearance & Behavior | System Settings | Passwords
Please ensure that the passwords are saved and not just stored in memory.

Shortcuts

The following shortcut are configured in the MR description/comments/MR Title:
  • CTRL+ALT+i Issue list
  • CTRL+ALT+u User list

Pipeline management

  • Display pipeline
  • Display jobs
  • Display job log
  • Cancel/restart job

Merge request

  • Visualization of Open merge request
  • Visualization of all the file impacted by the MR
  • Diff on files
  • Comment on MR
  • Comment on files
  • Create/Update/Approve/Merge/Close Merge requests
  • Show comments in diff
The feature of showing comment in the diff is pretty new so some strange behaviour can happen, please report any bug

Multi Repo project

This plugin doesn't support multi-repo project, each project must be a single Gitlab repository, there are a lot of reasons why should be a single repository and from the plugin perspective will be really difficult to define on which repo a merge request should be open, if had to open more than one, etc.

In addition, a lot of features (like jump to source, diff, etc.) will have to do some guessing on which repo will go and not work really properly. The same will apply to Git subproject.

Requirements

Gitlab Personal Access Token with full API access is required

idea-plugin.name: IntelliAI Tracer
idea-plugin.description:
An IntelliJ IDEA plugin that uses AI to automatically analyze code method call chains and business workflows.

GitHub | Issues | Homepage | Docs

Powered by IntelliAI Engine: Seamlessly integrates with IntelliAI Engine to provide unified, pluggable, and high-performance AI capabilities ⚡

IntelliAI Tracer

Features

  • 🔍 Call Chain Analysis: Automatically analyze method call chains (upstream and downstream)
  • 📊 Context Extraction: Extract method context information (class, annotations, comments, etc.)
  • 🤖 AI-Generated Explanations: Generate visual call sequence diagrams and business logic explanations using AI
  • 🎯 Smart Positioning: Select method calls in code editor to analyze
  • 🤖 Multiple AI Provider Support: Support for various AI services including Qwen, Ollama, OpenAI, and more
  • 🌍 Internationalization Support: Full support for Chinese and English

Use Cases

  • Code Understanding: Quickly understand call relationships and business logic of complex methods
  • Code Review: Analyze code call chains to discover potential issues
  • Documentation Generation: Automatically generate call sequence diagrams and business explanations for methods

Quick Start

  1. Install the plugin (requires IntelliAI Engine plugin to be installed first)
  2. Configure AI providers and API keys in Settings → Tools → IntelliAI Engine
  3. Select method calls in code editor and right-click to choose "Explain Workflow with AI"

Configuration

  • AI Provider Configuration: Configure and test AI providers in Settings → Tools → IntelliAI Engine

Technology Stack

  • Based on IntelliJ Platform SDK 2.1.0
  • Depends on IntelliAI Engine plugin for unified AI service interface
  • Uses PSI (Program Structure Interface) for code analysis
  • Full internationalization support (Chinese and English)

⚡ 由 IntelliAI Engine 驱动：深度集成 IntelliAI Engine，提供统一、可扩展、高性能的 AI 能力支持

IntelliAI Tracer

使用 AI 自动分析代码方法调用链和业务流程的 IntelliJ IDEA 插件。

功能特性

  • 🔍 调用链分析：自动分析方法的调用链（上行和下行）
  • 📊 上下文提取：提取方法的上下文信息（类、注解、注释等）
  • 🤖 AI 生成说明：通过 AI 生成可视化的调用时序图和业务逻辑说明
  • 🎯 智能定位：在代码编辑器中选中方法调用即可分析
  • 🤖 多种 AI 提供商支持：支持通义千问、Ollama、OpenAI 等多种 AI 服务
  • 🌍 国际化支持：完整的中英文多语言支持

使用场景

  • 代码理解：快速理解复杂方法的调用关系和业务逻辑
  • 代码审查：分析代码的调用链，发现潜在问题
  • 文档生成：自动生成方法的调用时序图和业务说明

快速开始

  1. 安装插件（需要先安装 IntelliAI Engine 插件）
  2. 在 Settings → Tools → IntelliAI Engine 中配置 AI 提供商和 API Key
  3. 在代码编辑器中选中方法调用，右键选择 "Explain Workflow with AI"

配置说明

  • AI 提供商配置：在 Settings → Tools → IntelliAI Engine 中配置和测试 AI 提供商

技术栈

  • 基于 IntelliJ Platform SDK 2.1.0
  • 依赖 IntelliAI Engine 插件提供统一的 AI 服务接口
  • 使用 PSI（Program Structure Interface）进行代码分析
  • 完整的国际化支持（中英文）

idea-plugin.name: IntelliAI Nacos
idea-plugin.description:
A plugin for managing and operating Nacos configuration center directly within IntelliJ IDEA. It provides a visual configuration management interface, supporting operations such as pulling, publishing, comparing, and deleting configurations, greatly improving development efficiency.

GitHub | Issues | Homepage | Docs

Powered by IntelliAI Engine: Seamlessly integrates with IntelliAI Engine to provide unified, pluggable, and high-performance AI capabilities ⚡

Core Features

  • 📍 Nacos Connection Management: Configure and manage Nacos server connections
  • 📁 Configuration Tree View: Display configurations in a three-level hierarchy: Namespace → Group → DataId
  • 📝 Configuration Editor: Support multi-tab editing with formats like YAML, JSON, XML, etc.
  • 🔄 Configuration Operations: Pull, publish, and compare configurations
  • 🔍 Configuration Search: Search for Namespace, Group, and DataId in the configuration tree
  • 🗑️ Configuration Deletion: Support single or batch deletion of configurations
  • 🤖 AI Integration: Integrated with IntelliAI Engine for intelligent configuration generation

Development Environment

  • JDK 17+
  • Gradle 8.0+
  • IntelliJ IDEA 2022.3+
  • IntelliAI Engine Plugin (automatically installed during local development)
  • Nacos Client 2.2.0

Quick Start

  1. Configure Nacos server connection in Settings → Tools → IntelliAI Nacos
  2. Test connection and verify permissions
  3. Open Nacos tool window to start managing configurations

Features

  • Nacos server connection configuration and testing
  • Configuration tree structure display
  • Multi-format configuration editor
  • Configuration pull, publish, and compare functionality
  • Context menu operations
  • Intention actions
  • Publish configuration from project view context menu

Technology Stack

  • Based on IntelliJ Platform SDK 2.1.0
  • Integrated with IntelliAI Engine Plugin
  • Uses Nacos Client 2.2.0
  • Configured with Kotlin DSL
  • Integrated with JUnit 5 testing framework

⚡ 由 IntelliAI Engine 驱动：深度集成 IntelliAI Engine，提供统一、可扩展、高性能的 AI 能力支持

IntelliAI Nacos

这是一个用于在 IntelliJ IDEA 中直接管理和操作 Nacos 配置中心的插件。插件提供了可视化的配置管理界面，支持配置的拉取、发布、对比、删除等操作，极大提升了开发效率。

核心功能

  • 📍 Nacos 连接管理：配置和管理 Nacos 服务器连接
  • 📁 配置树视图：按 Namespace → Group → DataId 三级分组展示配置
  • 📝 配置编辑器：支持多 Tab 编辑，支持 YAML、JSON、XML 等格式
  • 🔄 配置操作：拉取、发布、对比配置
  • 🔍 配置搜索：在配置树中搜索 Namespace、Group、DataId
  • 🗑️ 配置删除：支持单个或批量删除配置
  • 🤖 AI 集成：集成 IntelliAI Engine，支持智能配置生成

开发环境

  • JDK 17+
  • Gradle 8.0+
  • IntelliJ IDEA 2022.3+
  • IntelliAI Engine 插件（本地开发时自动安装）
  • Nacos Client 2.2.0

快速开始

  1. 在 Settings → Tools → IntelliAI Nacos 中配置 Nacos 服务器连接
  2. 测试连接并验证权限
  3. 打开 Nacos 工具窗口开始管理配置

包含功能

  • Nacos 服务器连接配置和测试
  • 配置树形结构展示
  • 多格式配置编辑器
  • 配置拉取、发布、对比功能
  • 右键菜单操作
  • 意图操作（Intention Action）
  • 项目视图右键发布配置

技术栈

  • 基于 IntelliJ Platform SDK 2.1.0
  • 集成 IntelliAI Engine 插件
  • 使用 Nacos Client 2.2.0
  • 使用 Kotlin DSL 配置构建
  • 集成 JUnit 5 测试框架

idea-plugin.name: MC Studio Helper
idea-plugin.description:
MC Studio Helper

An unofficial plugin to support component development and debugging for Minecraft China Edition.
为网易我的世界中国版提供组件开发与调试支持的非官方插件。

功能 / Features

  • 在 PyCharm 中添加运行配置，直接运行开发端。
    Add run configurations in PyCharm to launch the game client directly.
  • 运行配置支持协同运行组件、设置世界规则等。
    Support coordinated component runs and setting world rules in run configurations.
  • 支持 MCS 3.7.0.222545 及以上版本的 DAP 调试，通过 LSP4IJ 插件可实现断点调试功能。
    Support DAP debugging for MCS 3.7.0.222545 and above, with breakpoint debugging via the LSP4IJ plugin.
  • 将开发端日志重定向到 PyCharm 的日志控制台并提供着色支持，并支持错误日志文件快速跳转等功能。
    Redirect game client logs to PyCharm's console with color support, and enable quick navigation for error log files.
  • 在游戏中通过快捷键快速重载组件与世界（例如按键 R 或小键盘 0）。
    Quickly reload scripts and worlds in-game via hotkeys (e.g., R or Numpad 0).

鸣谢 / Acknowledgements

  • 感谢 Zero123 的 MCDevTool 提供的思路与部分代码。
    Thanks to Zero123's MCDevTool for ideas and partial code.
  • 感谢 Dofes 提供了启动器的 DAP 协议支持和部分疑难解答。
    Thanks to Dofes's support for DAP protocol in the launcher and help with troubleshooting.
  • 感谢 CloudburstMC 的基岩版 NBT 解析库。
    Thanks to CloudburstMC for the Bedrock NBT parsing library.
  • 感谢 theTd 帮忙测试和修复了 Windows 符号链接提权问题。
    Thanks to theTd for testing and fixing the Windows symbolic link privilege escalation issue.
  • 感谢 QuMod 开发者交流群的各位朋友提供的帮助。
    Thanks to the QuMod developer community for their assistance.

源码与协议 / Source & License

源码：https://github.com/TartaricAcid/MCStudioHelper
本插件遵循 MIT 开源协议发布，详见 LICENSE 文件。
Source: GitHub repository
License: MIT (see LICENSE file).

idea-plugin.name: Linear Viewer
idea-plugin.description:
View and manage Linear issues directly from your JetBrains IDE.

Features

  • Issue List - View your assigned issues in a dedicated tool window
  • Filtering - Filter by status (Started, Unstarted, Backlog, etc.) and project
  • Sorting - Sort by updated date, priority, status, or created date
  • Issue Details - Double-click to view issue details with Markdown rendering
  • Comments - View issue comments in the detail dialog
  • Copy Branch Name - Customizable branch name format with placeholders
  • Open in Browser - Quick access to Linear web interface

Getting Started

  1. Get your Linear API key from Settings → Security & access → Personal API Keys
  2. Go to Settings → Tools → Linear Viewer and enter your API key
  3. Open the Linear tool window from the right sidebar

LinearのIssueをJetBrains IDEから直接閲覧・管理できるプラグインです。

機能

  • Issue一覧 - 担当Issueを専用ツールウィンドウで表示
  • フィルタリング - ステータス（Started, Unstarted, Backlogなど）やプロジェクトで絞り込み
  • ソート - 更新日、優先度、ステータス、作成日で並び替え
  • Issue詳細 - ダブルクリックでMarkdownレンダリング付きの詳細を表示
  • コメント - Issue詳細ダイアログでコメントを閲覧
  • ブランチ名コピー - プレースホルダーでカスタマイズ可能なブランチ名形式
  • ブラウザで開く - Linear Webインターフェースへのクイックアクセス

使い方

  1. Settings → Security & access → Personal API KeysからAPIキーを取得
  2. Settings → Tools → Linear Viewer でAPIキーを設定
  3. 右サイドバーからLinearツールウィンドウを開く

  • Comments order - Comments sorted by newest first / コメント新しい順表示

idea-plugin.name: DevToolbox
idea-plugin.description:
A comprehensive developer toolbox plugin for IntelliJ IDEA, providing essential utilities for daily development tasks.

Features:
  • JSON Formatter - Beautify, compress, validate JSON with syntax highlighting and error detection
  • Base Decoder - Convert between hexadecimal, binary, and decimal with bit-level visualization
  • Byte Parser - Parse byte data by offset and length, supporting multiple data types (Int8/16/32/64, Float, Double, String) with endianness support
  • TCP Sender/Receiver - Send and receive TCP data with custom rules

开发者工具箱插件，包含：JSON 格式化工具（美化、压缩、语法校验）、进制解码器（十六进制/二进制/十进制转换、位可视化）、字节解析器（自定义规则解析）、TCP 发送接收工具（TCP 发送、接收并解析）。

idea-plugin.name: Message Worker
idea-plugin.description:
New in 1.6.0: Kafka administration the way AKHQ does it - consumer groups with lag and offset reset, search over a whole topic, topic details and configuration, Schema Registry subjects, batch send,
tombstones, export and copy between clusters. Everything new sits in collapsed sections, the familiar views stay as they were.

Browse and send messages to JMS queues and topics and to Apache Kafka topics directly from IntelliJ IDEA.

Features:

  • Support for Apache ActiveMQ Artemis
  • Support for ActiveMQ Classic 5.x
  • Support for IBM MQ
  • Support for Apache Kafka: browse topics from the newest or oldest record, from an offset or from a point in time, per partition. Produce records with key, headers and partition, live tail, create, purge and
    delete topics. PLAINTEXT, SSL / mutual TLS, SASL PLAIN and SCRAM.
  • Kafka Schema Registry: Avro and JSON Schema records shown and sent as JSON, keys and values, with the subject list from the registry
  • Binary Kafka values in both directions: send a key or value as hex, byte for byte, and see every value exactly as stored
  • Kafka consumer groups: state, members, committed offsets and lag, reset offsets (earliest, latest, time, offset, shift), delete offsets or the group
  • Kafka topic search on the broker by key, value and headers, topic details (partitions, replicas, sizes), configuration view and edit, more partitions
  • Schema Registry subjects: versions, compatibility, register new versions with a compatibility check, delete
  • Kafka batch send (one record per line), record timestamp, tombstones by key, JSON export, byte-exact copy to another topic or cluster
  • Browse queue messages without consuming them
  • Send messages with custom properties and correlation ID
  • View message details and properties
  • Topic support: subscribe (durable/non-durable), publish, live message feed
  • Multiple encoding support (UTF-8, UTF-16, CP1252, CP912, EBCDIC-US)
  • Message history with persistent storage
  • Search and filter messages by content
  • Message Templates with variable substitution ({{uuid}}, {{timestamp}}, custom variables)
  • Move, copy, or purge messages
  • Resend messages from history
  • Non-blocking broker operations with responsive dialogs
  • Built-in message body formatting, search, and bytes hex view

Quick Start:

  1. Open Settings - Tools - Message Worker
  2. Add your first broker connection (JMS or Kafka)
  3. Test the connection before saving
  4. Open the Message Worker tool window at the bottom of the IDE
  5. Select your connection and browse queues

For detailed documentation and support, visit the GitHub repository.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.6.1 - Kafka records sent like the topic's own, smoother browsing
  • Changed (Kafka): the send dialog starts with the key and value format of the records already in the topic, so a new record is encoded like the topic's producers write it (Schema Registry, text or hex, the key included). An empty topic uses its <topic>-value subject. A format you pick yourself is kept. The connection setting New record format switches to subject naming or to text.
  • New: a message you send blinks in the list of its queue or topic. A Kafka record is read back right away and shows its stored format (AVRO, JSON).
  • Fixed: the arrow keys move through the message list again (the focus jumped to the body after each selection).
  • Fixed: refreshing the list, also by auto refresh, keeps the selected messages.
  • Fixed: disabling or updating the plugin no longer asks for an IDE restart because the plugin did not unload. Takes effect for updates from this version on.
  • Changed: the buttons above the message body look like the IDE's own: flat icons, arrows for the find bar, and Decoded / Raw / Bytes as a toggle.
1.6.0 - Kafka administration like AKHQ
  • New (Kafka): Consumer Groups in the connection tree with state and lag. Open a group for its members and, per partition, the committed offset, end offset and lag. Reset offsets to the earliest or latest record, a point in time, a specific offset or by a shift, delete a topic's offsets or the whole group.
  • New (Kafka): search a whole topic on the broker by key, value, header name and header value (contains, not contains, equals), up to a time and a number of records per partition. The header says how many records matched and how many were read.
  • New (Kafka): Topic Details - partitions with leader, replicas, in-sync replicas, offsets and size, the topic configuration with edit and reset to default, the consumer groups reading the topic with their lag, and Increase Partitions.
  • New (Kafka): Schema Registry subjects in the tree. Browse versions, set the compatibility per subject or globally, register a new version or subject after a compatibility check, delete versions and subjects, find a schema by its id.
  • New (Kafka): send a batch (every line of the body is a record, optionally with its own key before a separator) and set the record timestamp. A batch is checked completely before the first record is sent.
  • New (Kafka): delete a record by key on a compacted topic (tombstone), export records to JSON, and copy many records byte for byte to a topic on the same or another Kafka connection, keeping partitions and timestamps if wanted.
  • New (Kafka): topic configuration (cleanup policy, retention, any other setting) when creating a topic.
  • Changed: everything new is in collapsed tree categories, a collapsed search row and collapsed dialog sections, so browsing and sending look as before.
  • Changed: the send history database gains two columns for batch sends, added automatically on first start.
1.5.0 - Apache Kafka support with Schema Registry, renamed to Message Worker
  • Renamed: JMS Worker is now Message Worker, because it works with Apache Kafka as well as JMS brokers. Only the name changes: your connections, stored passwords, history, templates, settings, tool window layout and keymap shortcuts are kept.
  • New: Apache Kafka as a fourth connection type, next to Artemis, ActiveMQ Classic and IBM MQ. Kafka topics appear in the same tree and are browsed, sent to, templated and kept in history the same way as queues.
  • New (Kafka): read position for browsing - newest, oldest, from an offset or from a point in time, all partitions or one. Browsing never consumes: the plugin reads without a consumer group and commits nothing.
  • New (Kafka): records show partition, offset, key, timestamp and headers. Binary values are shown in the Bytes / hex view.
  • New (Kafka): send records with key, headers and an optional target partition. Keys and partitions are kept in templates and in the send history.
  • New (Kafka): live tail in the Topics tab, either from the current end or as a consumer group that resumes where it stopped.
  • New (Kafka): create topics (partitions, replication factor), purge a topic, delete a topic, and copy records to another topic with key, value and headers unchanged.
  • New (Kafka): PLAINTEXT, SSL with optional mutual TLS, SASL PLAIN, SCRAM-SHA-256 and SCRAM-SHA-512. Passwords are kept in the IDE credential store.
  • New (Kafka): Confluent Schema Registry. Avro and JSON Schema keys and values are shown as JSON with their schema and subject, and sent from JSON with the latest schema of a subject. JSON that does not fit the schema is refused with the name of the field.
  • New (Kafka): key and value format per record: Text (in the chosen encoding), Bytes (hex, sent byte for byte) or Schema Registry. Resend opens a record in the format that sends it unchanged, and the Raw and Bytes views always show the value as stored in the topic.
  • Fixed: stopping a topic subscription did not stop receiving messages on the broker connection.
  • Fixed: saving or editing a connection with a password no longer triggers an IDE error report about slow operations on the UI thread.
  • Fixed: Copy to Queue ignored a destination typed by hand that was not in the list yet.
  • Fixed: a message deleted right after it was sent kept reappearing in the browser until the queue was reselected.
  • Fixed: collapsible sections in the connection dialog now open expanded when they hold configured values.
  • Fixed: the preview of a binary message showed the length of its Base64 text instead of its size in bytes.
  • Fixed: closing the IDE reported a memory leak in the plugin's message body view.
  • Fixed (Kafka): reading a topic that does not exist could create it on a broker with automatic topic creation.
1.4.3 - Maintenance
  • Compatibility: the plugin version is now injected at build time and read from the plugin's own resources, removing all use of internal IntelliJ Platform API flagged by JetBrains Marketplace verification. No functional or behavioural changes - includes the 1.4.1 message-delete fix.
1.4.1 - Bug fix
  • Fixed: deleting a selected message from a queue had no effect - the message stayed in the queue and no error was shown. The Delete action (toolbar, right-click menu, and the Delete key) now actually removes the selected message(s) on IBM MQ and Apache Artemis, refreshes the queue, and reports how many were deleted, not found, or failed.
1.4.0 - Performance, Stability & IBM MQ Polling Fixes
  • Fixed: editor and tab-switch responsiveness no longer degrades while a connection is active in the background
  • Improved: queue depth refresh in the tree now uses a single batched broker call per connection (Apache Artemis, ActiveMQ Classic, IBM MQ)
  • Improved: the depth poller skips connections whose tree node is collapsed - collapse a connection to silence its polling without disabling it globally
  • Improved: tree updates redraw only the queues whose count actually changed - no more flicker or subtree rebuild on refresh
  • Improved: live topic messages are coalesced into a configurable time window (default 150 ms) before reaching the UI - UI stays responsive under heavy throughput
  • Improved: IDE shutdown and Disconnect are bounded by a hard timeout - a hung or unreachable broker can no longer stall IDE exit; per-connection Disconnect over VPN that previously took 25-30 s is now sub-second
  • Fixed (IBM MQ): broker-side MQRC_NOT_AUTHORIZED (2035) log flood on Basic+mTLS - depth probes pause after a denial, per-queue when only individual queues are inaccessible (others keep updating) and connection-wide only when the channel itself has no admin access; mTLS connection setup unified between the main JMS path and background admin requests
  • Security: connection passwords, keystore and truststore passwords are stored exclusively in the IDE's credential store (PasswordSafe); a one-time migration runs on first launch to scrub any plaintext credentials older versions could leave behind in the settings file
  • New: queue tree shows a distinct icon + color and a hover tooltip for each state - empty, normal, backlog (>100), dead-letter / error queue with messages, and broker-denied depth probe (rendered as italic grey "(?)" instead of a misleading "(0)")
  • New: column widths in all data tables (queue browser, message history, templates, live topic messages) are persisted across IDE restarts
  • New: "Report a Problem" action - opens a pre-filled GitHub issue in your browser; reachable from the tool window toolbar and as a one-click action on every connection-error notification
  • New: "Duplicate Connection" action in plugin settings - clones the selected connection (every field, including credentials and keystore paths) into a fresh dialog with (copy) appended to the name
  • New: Performance settings section in Tools → JMS Worker - refresh interval (2/5/10/30 s, default 5 s), coalesce window (default 150 ms), connection close timeout (default 3 s), Jolokia HTTP timeouts (default 5 s / 5 s)
1.3.0 - IBM MQ mTLS Support & Connect/Disconnect Lifecycle Fixes
  • New (IBM MQ): mutual TLS (mTLS) authentication - connect using a client certificate and private key (PKCS12 or JKS keystore) instead of, or together with, username/password. Configurable cipher suite and IBM cipher mapping toggle. Auth modes: None / Basic / mTLS / Basic + mTLS.
  • Fixed (IBM MQ): queue message counts now work on mTLS and app-only channels - falls back to direct MQOO_INQUIRE when PCF admin access (SYSTEM.ADMIN.COMMAND.QUEUE) is unavailable. Requires only per-queue BROWSE + INQUIRE rights.
  • Fixed: explicit disconnect now truly prevents auto-reconnect - background operations and queue count refresh can no longer silently re-establish a connection after the user clicked Disconnect
  • Fixed: double-clicking a disconnected connection node in the tree now reconnects instead of just expanding the empty node
  • Fixed: right-click on a queue or topic no longer triggers queue browse and tab switch
  • Fixed: connection tree collapses and resets to a "Loading..." placeholder on disconnect so the expand arrow stays visible and reconnect works on first try
  • Fixed: a failed queue load (Error: child in tree) no longer blocks the next expand - retry on expand triggers a fresh load attempt
1.2.3 - Compatibility fixes
  • Compatibility: minimum supported version is now 2025.3 (build 253); plugin is verified compatible with 2025.3, 2026.1 and all future versions
  • Fixed: deprecated URL(String) constructor replaced with URI.create().toURL() in Jolokia HTTP calls
1.2.2 - IntelliJ IDEA 2026.1 Compatibility
  • Compatibility: plugin now works with IntelliJ IDEA 2026.1 (build 261+)
  • Internal: Kotlin compiler updated to 2.3.0 to match IDEA 2026.1 bundled runtime
  • Internal: added integration tests for Artemis, ActiveMQ Classic and IBM MQ using TestContainers
1.2.1 - Stability, Templates & Queue Refresh Fixes
  • Fixed: sending to a sorted queue with pagination no longer resets the loaded range or makes the new message disappear after refresh
  • Fixed: newly sent messages now keep a valid Message ID in the browser by propagating broker send receipts back into the UI
  • Improved: reduced IDE freeze risk by removing broker reloads from tree search, moving tree updates onto the EDT-safe path, and moving History DB reads off the UI thread
  • Improved: topic subscription list refresh is throttled under heavier live message throughput
  • Improved: templates can now be saved without a bound connection or destination
  • New: using an incomplete template opens a follow-up target dialog that asks only for the missing connection/destination values at send time
  • Improved: the template target completion dialog now supports Connect & Load, Reload, and global progress reporting

  • Fixed: Artemis topic publish blocking indefinitely - routes through Artemis core API with MULTICAST routing
  • Fixed: "Convert ASCII to HEX" checkbox in Send Message dialog had no effect

  • Send Message dialog: on-demand destination loading; Refresh button; status moved to footer

idea-plugin.name: Akeyless MCP
idea-plugin.description:
Akeyless MCP Plugin for JetBrains IDEs

Integrate Akeyless secrets management directly into your JetBrains IDE through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Browse, create, and manage secrets, keys, certificates, and other Akeyless resources — all without leaving your IDE.

Features

  • Hierarchical Tree View — Browse all your Akeyless items organized in a folder tree structure
  • Item Details — Click on any item to view its full details and metadata
  • Create Secrets — Create new secrets directly from the IDE
  • Query Interface — Natural language queries to interact with Akeyless (e.g. "List all secrets")
  • MCP Tools — Access all 17+ Akeyless MCP tools directly from the IDE
  • Real-time Refresh — Refresh your secrets list anytime with one click
  • Secure Authentication — Supports Akeyless CLI profiles including SAML and other auth methods

Getting Started

  1. Install the Akeyless CLI: brew install akeyless/tap/akeyless (macOS) or download from akeyless.io
  2. Configure your Akeyless profile: akeyless configure --profile saml
  3. Open Settings → Tools → Akeyless MCP and configure:
    • Server Command: e.g. npx -y @akeyless/cli-mcp
    • Working Directory: optional working directory for the MCP server
    • Akeyless Profile: optional CLI profile name (uses default if empty)
  4. Open View → Tool Windows → Akeyless MCP to start managing your secrets

MCP Server

The plugin connects to an Akeyless MCP server using stdio transport. The server communicates via JSON-RPC over stdio. Authentication is handled by the Akeyless CLI using profiles or environment variables.

Requirements

  • JetBrains IDE (IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, etc.) 2023.2 or higher
  • Akeyless CLI installed and configured
  • Node.js (if using npx to run the MCP server)
  • Valid Akeyless account

Troubleshooting

  • Verify the MCP server command is correct in Settings
  • Check that Akeyless CLI is installed and configured
  • Ensure the Akeyless profile (if specified) exists and is valid
  • Check IDE logs: Help → Show Log in Files

Support

  • Plugin issues: Open an issue in the plugin repository
  • Akeyless MCP Server: Contact Akeyless support
  • Akeyless CLI: See Akeyless CLI documentation

For more information, visit akeyless.io
idea-plugin.change-notes:

  • Default Akeyless profile credentials are injected only when the MCP server command is the akeyless CLI (avoids breaking other commands).
  • JDK 17 Gradle toolchains for reproducible builds.

idea-plugin.name: Direnv Loader
idea-plugin.description:
Direnv Loader

Automatically injects direnv-managed environment variables into IntelliJ Run Configurations at execution time.

Features

  • Automatic Environment Injection — When a Run Configuration starts, the plugin runs direnv export json in your project directory and merges the resulting environment variables into the process.
  • Per-Configuration Control — Enable or disable direnv loading independently for each Run Configuration via two simple checkboxes in the Run Configuration editor.
  • Trust Management — Optionally auto-allow blocked .envrc files with the "Trust .envrc" option, eliminating the need to run direnv allow manually.
  • Broad Run Configuration Support — Works with Java applications, JUnit tests, Gradle tasks, Spring Boot configurations, and any other Run Configuration type.
  • Non-Intrusive Notifications — Displays balloon notifications for success (number of loaded variables), warnings (direnv not installed, .envrc blocked), and errors (command failures, timeouts).

How It Works

  1. Open any Run Configuration and check "Enable Direnv" in the Direnv settings panel.
  2. Optionally check "Trust .envrc" to auto-allow your .envrc file.
  3. Run your configuration — direnv environment variables are automatically loaded and applied.

Environment Variable Priority

When a Run Configuration is executed, environment variables are merged in the following order. Higher priority values override lower ones when the same key exists.

PrioritySourceDescription
1direnv export jsonVariables defined in your .envrc file
2Run ConfigurationVariables explicitly set by the user in the IDE (highest priority)
  • Run Configuration variables always take precedence over direnv variables.
  • The working directory for direnv is resolved from the project root path, and .envrc file lookup is delegated to the direnv CLI.

Requirements

  • direnv must be installed and available on your system PATH.
  • A valid .envrc file in your project directory.

idea-plugin.name: Project Intelligence Bridge
idea-plugin.description:
Stop wasting agent tokens on project discovery. One API call gives your AI everything it needs — SDK, frameworks, dependencies, modules, and VCS state in a single structured JSON response.

The Problem

Your AI agent spends 30 seconds reading pom.xml, tsconfig.json, and .git/config. That's 10+ file reads, 500+ tokens wasted, and fragile heuristics that break on unfamiliar projects. Project Intelligence Bridge does it in 50ms with one call.

Features

  • One-Call Context — SDK, build tools, modules, frameworks, VCS, file stats
  • Framework Detection — Spring Boot, React, Vue, Angular with version and detection signal
  • Dependency Analysis — Full tree, transitive deps, conflict detection
  • File Classification — Source, test, resource, generated — the IDE already knows
  • LLM Summary — Token-optimized text: "Java 21 / Maven / Spring Boot 3.5 / 12 modules"
  • Change Streaming — WebSocket events when project structure changes
  • Zero Config — Works immediately when your IDE opens

How Is This Different from the Built-in MCP Server?

The built-in MCP server requires 5+ separate tool calls. Project Intelligence Bridge returns everything in one structured response — saving agent tokens, reducing latency, and providing richer analysis (framework detection, dependency conflicts) that the built-in server doesn't offer. Plus, it's a standard REST API that works with any HTTP client, not just MCP-capable agents.

Use Cases

  • AI agents bootstrapping project understanding in milliseconds
  • DevOps dashboards showing project health across services
  • Dependency audit and security scanning via REST
  • Onboarding automation for new team members

Part of the Bridge Suite — works alongside Terminal Bridge and Run Configuration Bridge for complete IDE automation.

Runs entirely on localhost. No data leaves your machine.

API available at http://localhost:9885/api/v1/

idea-plugin.name: Memory Leak Detector
idea-plugin.description:
Memory Leak Detector

Real-time memory leak detection for IntelliJ IDEA that helps you identify and prevent memory issues in your Java applications.

📊 Features

  • Real-time Memory Monitoring - Live visualization of heap, young generation, and old generation memory usage
  • Intelligent Leak Detection - Automatically detects rapid memory growth patterns and potential memory leaks
  • Multi-metric Visualization - Toggle between heap, young gen, and old gen views with color-coded charts
  • GC Event Analysis - Tracks garbage collection efficiency and frequency
  • Smart Alerts - Prompts user when rapid old generation growth is detected
  • Remote Monitoring - Monitor memory usage of remote Java applications via JMX
  • Manual GC Control - Optional System.gc() invocation with user confirmation
  • Historical Data - Maintains up to 200 data points for trend analysis

🚀 Usage

  1. Start Monitoring
    • To monitor a remote Java application, add these VM options:
    • -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.port=9010 -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.authenticate=false -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.ssl=false
    • Trigger the tool window by clicking the left‑bottom Memory Monitor button.
    • Monitor the heap size change by pressing Run GC. If the heap size didn't decreases as expected, …
    • Refer to this example project for a memory leak check.
  2. View Memory Charts
    • Monitor real-time memory usage in the tool window
    • Toggle individual metrics (Heap/Old Gen/Young Gen) using checkboxes
    • Hover over the chart to see exact values at specific timestamps
  3. Leak Detection Alerts
    • The detector will automatically notify you when suspicious memory patterns are detected
    • When rapid old gen growth is detected, you'll receive a prompt with options to investigate or invoke GC
  4. Analyze Results
    • Review GC efficiency metrics in the statistics panel
    • Export memory usage data for further analysis (coming soon)

💡 Tips

  • Use the checkbox toggles to focus on specific memory areas when debugging
  • Remote monitoring requires JMX to be enabled on the target application with -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote
  • The detector works best when monitoring applications for at least 30 seconds to establish baseline patterns

Supported IntelliJ versions: 2023.3 and later.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Version 1.0.1

  • 🎉 Refer a git repo to check suspicious memory leak application

Version 1.0.2

  • 🎉 Upgrade to support IntelliJ 2026.3

idea-plugin.name: Send to AI Assistant
idea-plugin.description:
Send selected code to JetBrains AI Assistant — with the file name and line numbers already attached.

No more switching windows, copying code, and typing "this is from file X line Y". Select the code, press the shortcut, and start asking your question.

How to use

  1. Select any code in the editor.
  2. Press Alt+Shift+A (macOS: ⌥⇧A), or right-click → Send to AI Assistant Chat.
  3. The AI Assistant panel opens with the chat input pre-filled:
    @file:UserService.kt [lines 42 to 58]
  4. Type your question and press Enter.

The message is inserted but not sent automatically — you can review and add context before submitting.

How to change the shortcut

  1. Open Settings → Keymap.
  2. Search for Send to AI Assistant Chat.
  3. Double-click → Add Keyboard Shortcut → press your keys → OK.

Requirements

  • The JetBrains AI Assistant plugin must be installed and enabled.
  • Works in all JetBrains IDEs: IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, PhpStorm, GoLand, CLion, Rider, RubyMine, RustRover, DataGrip, Android Studio.
