idea-plugin.name: Minecraft Multiversion Modding
idea-plugin.description:
IDE support for Multiversion, a compile-time mixin system for Minecraft mods that lets you maintain a single codebase across multiple game versions.

Instead of maintaining separate forks per version, you write version-specific patches using familiar Mixin-style annotations. The Gradle plugin merges your version layers into a unified source tree at build time with zero runtime overhead. Whenever part of a class breaks in a more recent Minecraft version, you essentially only need to write a mixin-like patch that fixes the relevant change, vastly reducing code duplication.

IDE Features

  • Live patchedSrc updates: saves, structural edits, file creation, and file deletion trigger an immediate re-merge with cascading to downstream versions.
  • Version navigation: Alt+W / Alt+S to jump upstream/downstream. Context-sensitive: navigates the member at cursor, or the class.
  • All-versions popup: Alt+Shift+V shows every version of the current member or class with status labels.
  • Gutter icons: up/down arrows on annotated members and members overridden downstream for quick navigation.
  • Error suppression: hides false duplicate class errors, uninitialized field warnings on shadow members, and other false positives.
  • Annotation validation: validates descriptor strings and flags missing annotations on members that exist in the base version.
  • Navigation: Go to Declaration and Find Usages work correctly across version layers via patchedSrc remapping.
  • Refactoring: renames and moves propagate across all version modules, including descriptor strings in annotations.

See the GitHub repository for setup instructions, Gradle plugin documentation, and the annotation reference.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.6.0

  • Version navigation Alt+Shift+W/S to jump upstream/downstream versions; context-sensitive (navigates the member at cursor, or the class). Replaces the current tab in-place.
  • All-versions popup Alt+Shift+V shows every version of the current member or class with status labels, click to navigate.
  • Gutter icons Up/down arrows on annotated members, members overridden downstream, and versioned class declarations for quick navigation.
  • Centralized version directory scanning, member resolution, and path classification utilities across the plugin.
  • Missing explicit annotation inspection Errors when a member exists in the original class but has no @OverwriteVersion or @ShadowVersion, with a quick fix to add the appropriate one
  • @ModifySignature collision detection Errors when the new member name already exists in the original class as a different member
  • Missing original annotations inspection Warns when @OverwriteVersion or @ShadowVersion members are missing annotations present on the original member, with a quick fix to add them
  • BUG FIX @NotNull @ShadowVersion fields no longer show a spurious "must be initialized" warning
  • Config parsing now uses engine's shared EngineConfig.fromJson() instead of a local regex parser
  • Origin map caching now delegates to engine's CachedOriginMap
  • Descriptor resolution now uses engine's shared MemberDescriptor utilities (parsing, init disambiguation, param matching)
  • BUG FIX @ModifySignature with a method body but no @OverwriteVersion now correctly shows an error suggesting @OverwriteVersion
  • @ShadowVersion body warning @ShadowVersion methods or fields with a body now show a warning with quick fixes to replace with @OverwriteVersion or remove the body
  • BUG FIX "Missing explicit annotation" inspection now correctly suggests @OverwriteVersion for fields with initializers (previously always suggested @ShadowVersion for fields)
  • Some refactoring for future maintenance

0.5.5

  • BUG FIX Declared K2 Kotlin plugin compatibility mode, fixing the conflict warning when both this plugin and the Kotlin K2 plugin are installed.

0.5.4

  • Many many smaller bugfixes and changes, as well as refactors for future maintainability.

0.5.3

  • Auto-update on structural changes Adding or removing a method, field, or inner class now triggers a patchedSrc re-merge in the background without saving.
  • File deletion cascade Deleting a versioned source file now triggers a cascading patchedSrc recompute for the affected version and all downstream versions.
  • New file detection Creating a new .java file in a versioned source directory automatically merges it into patchedSrc.
  • Origin map consistency The origin map is now kept up to date across all update paths (save, structural change, file creation, file deletion), fixing stale navigation after incremental edits.
  • BUG FIX Multiversion annotations (@OverwriteVersion, @ShadowVersion, etc.) no longer leak into merged patchedSrc output as imports.
  • BUG FIX Edits to the base version (e.g. 1.20.1) now correctly cascade to all downstream patchedSrc (1.21.1, etc.).
  • BUG FIX Fixed SlowOperations violation when opening files in patchedSrc.

0.5.2

  • Find Usages Find Usages on a method, field, or class in a versioned source root now searches patchedSrc instead of true source, then maps each result back to its real source file and line via the origin map.

0.5.1

  • Bumped merge engine version

0.5.0

  • On-save patchedSrc update Saving a versioned source file now automatically re-merges it into patchedSrc, keeping the IDE's view of the merged class in sync without a full Gradle sync.
  • Engine config bridge The Gradle plugin now writes build/multiversion-engine-config.json per version module during generateAllPatchedSrc.

0.4.7

  • BUG FIX Ctrl+Click on init and init(params) descriptor strings inside @DeleteMethodsAndFields now navigates to the correct constructor declaration.
  • BUG FIX Renaming a constructor no longer incorrectly triggers cross-version rename propagation, which would previously attempt to rename a non-existent method.
  • BUG FIX Move refactoring now propagates to all other version modules, not just newer ones.
  • BUG FIX Move refactoring now propagates when files are moved via the project view or drag-and-drop, not only when using Refactor → Move (F6).
  • BUG FIX Opening a file in patchedSrc no longer redirects to the real source when the user is already browsing patchedSrc.

0.4.6

  • Constructors All features now support constructors. See README.md for documentation.

0.4.5

  • BUG FIX Refactors wouldn't properly propagate back due to caches not updating.

0.4.4

  • BUG FIX Fixed an IDE error on startup
  • Rename propagation renaming a method, field, or class in one version automatically renames it across all other version modules
  • @Delete* descriptor sync renaming a method or field also updates its descriptor string inside @DeleteMethodsAndFields annotations in later versions, including parameter types
  • Move propagation moving a class to a different package propagates the package change and file relocation to all later version patch files
  • Propagation toggle a "Propagate to other Minecraft versions" checkbox in the rename dialog and in Settings → Tools → Multiversion controls whether cross-version propagation is active (on by default, persisted across sessions)
  • Sentinel guard all plugin features are now disabled in projects that do not have the multiversion annotations library on the classpath, preventing interference with unrelated codebases

idea-plugin.name: JBL SSH Terminal
idea-plugin.description:
English

SSH Terminal brings Linux remote operations into the IDE with a practical, workflow-first experience.

  • Connection management: Save and manage SSH profiles, then open connection-specific terminal tabs.
  • Interactive terminal: Built-in shell with customizable font selection and Chinese display compatibility improvements.
  • Terminal appearance: Choose Follow IDE (default) for console/selection colors aligned with your color scheme, or Traditional for softer fixed grays.
  • Remote file explorer: Browse, upload/download (files and folders with progress), drag-and-drop upload/download, open in IDE, copy remote path, and sync local edits back to server with confirmation.
  • Follow terminal folder: Keep the remote file path in sync with current terminal working directory.
  • Host insights: Monitor memory/CPU/disk trends with live charts and quick diagnostic views.
  • Pro features: Advanced charts, command templates, log highlight alerts, and session history with reuse/copy/delete controls.

中文

SSH Terminal 将 Linux 远程运维能力直接带入 IDE，提供更贴近日常使用习惯的操作体验。

  • 连接管理：保存和管理 SSH 连接配置，并按连接打开独立终端面板。
  • 交互终端：内置 Shell 终端，支持字体选择与中文显示兼容优化。
  • 终端外观：可选「跟随 IDE」（默认：与当前配色下控制台/选区色一致）或「传统」柔和灰。
  • 远程文件管理：浏览、上传/下载（支持文件夹与进度条）、拖放上传/拖出下载、在 IDE 打开、复制路径；本地修改后可确认同步到服务器。

  • 主机信息面板：内存/CPU/磁盘趋势实时展示，便于快速排查。
  • Pro 功能：高级监控图表、命令模板、日志高亮告警、会话历史（复用/复制/删除）。

idea-plugin.name: Open in Cursor IDE
idea-plugin.description:
Open the current file (or any file/folder from the Project view) directly in Cursor IDE.

The action is added to IDEA's standard Open In submenu (RevealGroup), so it appears wherever IDEA already shows "Reveal in Finder":

  • editor right-click → Open In → Cursor (uses the caret line),
  • editor tab right-click → Open In → Cursor,
  • Project view right-click → Open In → Cursor (also works on folders),
  • navigation bar popup → Open In → Cursor.

It builds a cursor://file<absolute-path>[:line] URL — the same scheme Cursor inherits from VS Code — and hands it to the OS protocol handler. No configuration required: the IDE already knows the project root, file path, and caret line.

To make sure the file lands in the right Cursor window (and not whichever window Cursor focused last), the action fires the project folder URL first and then the file URL ~350 ms later. Combined with Cursor's "window.openFoldersInNewWindow": "on" setting, this opens a new Cursor window per project without disturbing the previously focused one.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Changed

  • Update plugin icons with new SVG designs for light and dark themes

idea-plugin.name: Mermaid Markdown Bridge
idea-plugin.description:
Render Mermaid fenced code blocks directly inside the built-in JetBrains Markdown Preview.

Mermaid Markdown Bridge is a JetBrains IDE Markdown Preview extension package. It extends the official JetBrains Markdown plugin preview so Markdown authors can see Mermaid diagrams in the preview pane without switching editors, installing a separate Mermaid language plugin, or replacing the IDE's Markdown tooling.

The project is intentionally narrow: it is a preview rendering bridge for Mermaid fenced code blocks. It is not a Mermaid language support plugin, not a standalone diagram editor, and not a replacement for JetBrains Markdown Preview. The goal is to make Mermaid diagrams feel natural in the existing Markdown Preview, with a rendering style that stays close to the familiar GitHub Markdown and Mermaid preview experience.

  • Renders fenced mermaid code blocks in Markdown Preview.
  • Bundles the Mermaid runtime locally for diagram rendering.
  • Adapts Mermaid output to the IDE light or dark theme.
  • Supports preview controls: hold Control / Command and use the mouse wheel over a diagram to zoom, then drag the diagram to pan.
  • Keeps the rendered diagram experience close to familiar GitHub Markdown and Mermaid previews.
  • Does not add Mermaid language services, syntax highlighting, completion, inspections, or .mmd/.mermaid file type support.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
🔄 Changed

  • Updated the bundled Mermaid runtime to mermaid@12.1.0.

idea-plugin.name: FHIR Toolkit
idea-plugin.description:
FHIR Toolkit — productivity tooling for healthcare developers working with FHIR R4.

Inline validation, visual resource exploration, multi-resource scenario generation, an embedded mock server, and an interactive FHIRPath playground — all without leaving your IDE.

Features

  • Inline validation — HAPI FHIR R4 validator surfaces issues as you type, with FHIRPath-resolved error locations.
  • FHIR Resource tree tool window — collapsible visual hierarchy of the active resource; click any node to navigate to that JSON element.
  • Bundle Graph tool window — each entry shown with its outgoing references, marked ✓ resolved or ✗ unresolved within the Bundle. Click to navigate.
  • FHIRPath playground — interactive query input + result panel; evaluates FHIRPath expressions against the open resource using HAPI's engine.
  • Mock FHIR server — Tools → Run Mock FHIR Server spins up an in-memory R4 endpoint on a localhost port for client wiring tests.
  • Sample resource generator — insert minimum-valid skeletons for Patient, Observation, Encounter, Bundle, Practitioner, Organization.
  • Insert FHIR Scenario — pick from 4 hand-crafted multi-resource clinical Bundles (diabetes, pediatric asthma, hypertension+lipid panel, acute MI).
  • Datatype hovers — contextual documentation for CodeableConcept, Coding, Reference, Quantity, Identifier properties.
  • Bundle reference navigation — gutter icons next to reference values jump to the matching entry.
  • Curated code lookup — ~380 hover-readable codes across LOINC, SNOMED CT, ICD-10-CM, and UCUM.

Designed for engineers building EHR integrations, healthtech apps, and payer systems. Open source, no telemetry, no outbound network calls. The optional Mock FHIR Server binds to 127.0.0.1 only.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Six new features focused on giving FHIR developers more in-IDE workflows: visual exploration of resources and bundles, interactive FHIRPath evaluation, a local mock server for client testing, multi-resource clinical scenarios, and a 4× expansion of the curated code library.

Added

  • FHIR Resource tree tool window. A right-anchored "FHIR Resource" panel renders the active FHIR JSON as a collapsible hierarchy (resource type → properties → array entries → primitives). Click any node to navigate to that JSON element in the editor. Auto-detects the active file via FhirContextHolder.resourceTypes.
  • Bundle Graph tool window. A right-anchored "Bundle Graph" panel (stacks as a tab next to FHIR Resource) shows each Bundle entry as a node with its outgoing references nested as children, marked ✓ (resolved within the Bundle) or ✗ (unresolved). Click an entry → navigate to its resource. Click a reference → navigate to the resolved target. Reuses the same resolution rules as the inline gutter-icon navigation: relative Type/id, exact fullUrl, absolute URLs whose suffix matches Type/id.
  • FHIRPath playground tool window. A right-anchored "FHIRPath" panel with a text input + Evaluate button. Runs FHIRPath expressions against the currently-open FHIR resource using HAPI's modern IFhirPath engine. Results render as raw values for primitives and pretty-printed JSON for resources/elements. Useful for exploring real-world FHIR data shape interactively.
  • Mock FHIR server. New Tools → Run Mock FHIR Server action toggles an in-memory R4 server on an auto-allocated localhost port. Endpoints: GET /fhir/metadata, GET/POST /fhir/{Type}, GET/PUT/DELETE /fhir/{Type}/{id}. Bound to 127.0.0.1 only; nothing accepts external connections. Echo-mode storage (server returns exactly what was POSTed); resource is given a UUID id when one isn't provided. Project-scoped service auto-stops on close.
  • Insert FHIR Scenario. New Tools → Insert FHIR Scenario… action with a chooser popup of 4 hand-crafted multi-resource clinical Bundles: Adult Type 2 Diabetes management, Pediatric asthma ED visit, Hypertension + Hyperlipidemia panel, Acute MI (NSTEMI). Each Bundle uses absolute fullUrls so internal references resolve cleanly under the Bundle Graph and gutter-icon navigation. Locked in by integration tests that assert zero validation errors per scenario.
  • Curated code-system tables expanded ~4×. LOINC 25 → 88 codes (added CBC, CMP, thyroid, coag, cardiac troponin, BNP/NT-proBNP, inflammatory markers, urinalysis, COVID, mental-health screens). SNOMED CT 20 → 93 codes (more cardiovascular, GI, neuro, MSK, derm, infectious, oncology, pregnancy). ICD-10-CM 21 → 104 codes (matched to SNOMED additions plus more E/F/G/J/K/L/M/N/R series). UCUM 30 → 97 codes (mass/volume/length scaling, dose units, lab/cell counts, pressure, energy, IU/mIU). Total 96 → 382 curated codes available for hover lookup.

Notes

  • Privacy stance unchanged in spirit, slightly clarified: no outbound network calls, no telemetry. The optional Mock FHIR Server binds to 127.0.0.1 (loopback) only — nothing on your network or the internet can reach it.
  • Plugin zip size ~91 MB (no new external dependencies — all six features use the existing HAPI bundle, JDK built-ins, and IntelliJ Platform APIs).

idea-plugin.name: vgo
idea-plugin.description: Optimize SVG and Android VectorDrawable files with vgo from the Project view context menu.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Added

  • --check verifies inputs are already fully shrunk without writing anything. Files that would change are printed and the process exits non-zero, making it suitable for CI.
  • checkVectorGraphic Gradle task, a verification counterpart to shrinkVectorGraphic that fails the build when vector graphics are not fully shrunk.
  • Paint attributes that can't affect rendering are removed. A fill rule is dropped when nothing is filled, and the stroke width, cap, join, and miter limit are dropped when nothing is stroked — either because the stroke paint is transparent or because its width is zero. A miter limit is also dropped for joins that never read one. Elements with an id keep everything, since an animation or a <use> reference can make their paint visible later. Beyond the bytes, this lets more paths merge.

Changed

  • Breaking (API): Shape fill and stroke properties now use Brush, allowing them to represent gradient paints directly.
  • Breaking (API): TopDownTransformer now has an exit(ContainerElement) callback for cleaning up ancestor-scoped state after a container's descendants. Apply top-down transformers with traverseTopDown(Graphic, List<TopDownTransformer>) (as TransformerSet now does); invoking a stateful transformer's visit methods directly no longer traverses an entire graphic.
  • Breaking (CLI): Standard-input processing is now explicit. Use vgo --stdin to read newline-delimited file paths; invoking vgo without inputs now prints help and exits with a usage error.
  • Breaking (Gradle plugin): the vgo extension now uses lazy Gradle types (ConfigurableFileCollection for inputs/outputs, Property for the remaining options), making it compatible with the configuration cache, isolated projects, and declarative-style assignment. indent is now an Int rather than a Byte.
  • Gradle plugin: the shrinkVectorGraphic task now tracks the contents of its input files, so editing a vector re-runs the task and unchanged inputs are skipped as UP-TO-DATE. Build cache entries are relocatable (relative path sensitivity), and the task is skipped with NO-SOURCE when no inputs match.
  • Gradle plugin: shrinkVectorGraphic fails the build when optimization reports an error instead of silently succeeding.

Deprecated

  • Shape fillBrush and strokeBrush; use fill and stroke instead.

Fixed

  • Gradle tasks no longer hang waiting for standard input when no configured input files exist.
  • Gradle plugin: the default OutputFormat.UNCHANGED no longer prints an "Unknown format unchanged" warning for every file.
  • Vector drawable output wrote a non-default stroke miter limit into android:strokeLineJoin, overwriting the line join. It's now written to android:strokeMiterLimit.
  • Paths whose only paint came from an ancestor were deleted as fully transparent. An SVG paint server reference or an unrecognized color keyword on a <g> or <svg> paints its descendants, but each path was judged on its own resolved paint alone.
  • SVG paint the color parser doesn't recognize — currentColor above all — was dropped from the element that declared it, because it parses as the inherited color and so looked redundant. Together with the deletion above, an icon in the common <svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor"> form optimized to an empty document.
  • fill="transparent" and stroke="transparent" fell back to the channel default rather than resolving to a transparent color, painting a black fill where the source painted nothing.

idea-plugin.name: StockLite
idea-plugin.description:
StockLite — stock, crypto, fund & futures quotes with portfolio tracking, charts and AI analysis, right inside your JetBrains IDE. Native & free. 2024.1+.

完整功能介绍见下方中文 · Details in Chinese below

中文介绍

StockLite — 把股票行情和持仓账本装进 JetBrains IDE：写代码的同时看行情、记账、画K线、问 AI，全程不用离开编辑器。

A 股（含北交所）· 港股 · 美股 · 加密货币 · 基金 · 国内/国际期货 · 全球 19 大指数，一块原生面板全部搞定。纯 Kotlin/Swing 实现——没有 Electron、没有额外进程；免费、无广告、无需注册账号。

🏆 它和"行情插件"有什么不同

  • 不止看价格，还能记账 —— 交易记录（买入 / 卖出 / 清仓）、已实现盈亏、按历史仓位逐笔回放的盈亏走势曲线。多数插件只是报价器，StockLite 是一套持仓系统。
  • IDE 插件里独有的 AI —— 右键任意标的即可呼出 DeepSeek 深度分析：多轮对话、联网搜索，内置宏观 / 技术 / 基本面 / 量化 / 风控五种专家角色（需自备 API Key）。盘后多空信号自动记录、次日自动结算对错，信号芯片上直接显示历史准确率。
  • 盯盘细节拉满 —— 到价提醒、财报日期临近提醒、两市成交额放量/缩量同期对比、大盘涨跌家数与主力资金、股指期货多空动向、美股盘前盘后涨跌。
  • 为程序员准备 —— 每个 HTTP 请求可视化、一键复制 cURL；JSON 导入导出；多个 IDE 窗口数据实时同步；中英双语、红涨绿跌方案可切换。

📈 行情与持仓

  • 股票：沪深北 A 股 / 港股 / 美股实时行情；填写成本价与数量即可自动计算市值、浮动盈亏、累计收益率；支持自定义分组。批量导入：粘贴一段自选股文本（名称、6 位代码、sh/sz/bj/hk 前缀、.SZ/.SS 后缀、美股代码任意混排），自动解析校验、选择分组，重复自动合并、无效行沉底标注原因。
  • 基金：天天基金实时估值与官方净值双列显示，净值发布后自动切换；QDII 智能识别；右键可查看季度持仓明细，并附带持仓股的实时涨跌。
  • 期货：股指期货、商品期货与国际期货同板显示，秒级刷新。
  • 加密货币：BTC / ETH 等 2000+ USDT 计价交易对实时行情，7×24 小时交易，展示 24 小时滚动涨跌与 24h 高低价。Bitget → Gate.io → Binance 镜像三源自动降级，无需注册；面板顶部常驻连通状态指示，当前网络无法直连交易所接口时明确提示（可经 IDE HTTP 代理解决），其它标签页不受影响；安装后内置主流币，开箱即看。
  • 全球指数：沪深创 / 科创50、恒指 / 恒生科技、标普 / 道指 / 纳指 / 纳指100 / VIX、德法英日韩台印等 19 个指数；交易所节假日自动识别休市，延迟数据带来源标注。
  • 美股板块看板：30+ 行业与主题 ETF（AI、半导体、机器人、新能源、黄金、生物医药……）按板块网格排布；收盘 / 实时双视图，悬浮同时显示盘前、盘中、盘后三段行情。
  • 新股：新股申购日历 + 次新股表现一屏展示；今日申购自动气泡提醒；发行价对比行业市盈率；右键一键加自选并跳转东方财富。

📊 图表

  • 点击任意行的涨跌幅列，面板底部内嵌 TradingView 开源 lightweight-charts：日内 / 日K / 周K / 月K 真实蜡烛图，MA5 / MA10 / MA20 均线与成交量柱可开关，A 股日线前复权消除除权跳空。
  • 盈亏走势图：单只股票或全部持仓的每日浮动盈亏曲线，逐笔回放交易记录还原历史仓位，口径与持仓表完全一致。
  • 添加股票对话框内嵌行情卡片与K线图，下单前先看走势。

🌡️ A 股大盘概览（全球指数页底部）

  • 涨跌家数（含北交所）、涨跌停统计、两市成交额（悬浮对比上一交易日同一时刻，标注放量/缩量）、大小盘代表指数、领涨领跌板块、主力资金净流入。
  • 股指期货多空摘要：中金所四大品种（IH/IF/IC/IM）全部合约的中信期货及前二十席位当日净增减仓。
  • 盘后多空信号：综合 A50 / 纳指期货、期指持仓、资金面与大盘广度生成 -100 ~ +100 评分，每个因子悬浮可看判断理由。

🔔 提醒与日常细节

📌 三个必试操作

  • 点击任意行的涨跌幅列 → 展开K线图
  • 右键任意行 → 编辑 / 到价提醒 / 交易记录 / AI 深度分析 / 修改显示别名
  • 股票页「批量导入」→ 粘贴自选股文本，一键建组合

🌐 数据与声明

  • 行情来自新浪 / 腾讯 / 东方财富 / 天天基金 / Yahoo Finance / Bitget / Gate.io 等公开接口；A 股与港股为实时，美股等海外行情约有 15 分钟延迟（面板内已标注）。

  • 所有数据仅供个人参考，本插件不构成任何投资建议。

idea-plugin.name: Embedded Terminal Emulator
idea-plugin.description:
Embedded Terminal Emulator

Embed a professional, fast, and fully integrated terminal experience inside PyCharm without resource overhead.

Key Features and Advantages over the Official JetBrains Terminal:

  • Ultra-Lightweight Swing Native Architecture: Unlike the official terminal which uses a heavy web engine or complex HTML/JS layers that significantly increase RAM and CPU consumption, this plugin uses a pure Swing engine written in Kotlin with a hardware-accelerated glyph cache (image blitting), reducing memory consumption by 98% without additional processes.
  • Smart Paste & Drag and Drop for Agents (PNG, PDF, Text Logs): Copy screenshots (images), documents (PDFs), or massive text files and paste them directly into the terminal with Cmd+Shift+V (or Drag & Drop). Handles file generation, folder isolation, and dynamic physical/symbolic links for heavy resources. Clickable paths open directly in the editor.
  • Instant File & Directory Path Drag & Drop (with Auto-Escaping): Drag any file or folder from PyCharm's project tree, Finder, or system explorer, or copy and paste it directly into the terminal prompt. The plugin automatically detects your shell (zsh, bash, fish, cmd, powershell) and inserts the absolute path with correct character escaping, saving time and preventing path syntax errors.
  • Guaranteed Automatic Virtual Environment Activation: Instant detection of Python environments (`.venv`, `venv`, `env`) linked to the project and injection into the PTY process's `PATH` when opening a tab. Avoids the usual problems and misconfigurations of the official terminal to activate environments transparently.
  • Full Shell Keyboard Shortcut Control (Ctrl+R, Ctrl+C, etc.): Priority event interception that prevents the IDE from capturing critical shell shortcuts (such as history search with `Ctrl+R`, suspensions with `Ctrl+Z`, interrupts with `Ctrl+C`, or word navigation with `Opt/Ctrl + Arrows`), while maintaining accessibility of global ToolWindow shortcuts (`Cmd/Alt + 1..9`).
  • Protected Paste Mode (Bracketed Paste Mode - ANSI 2004): Native support to prevent visual corruption, long line misalignment, and unintended execution of commands when pasting multiline text into the prompt.
  • Passive Paste Sanitizer for macOS: Automatically intercepts pasted multi-line commands, strips trailing line continuation backslashes (\) and trailing whitespace, and collapses them into a single-line command dynamically to prevent accidental carriage-return execution and shell parsing errors on macOS.
  • Customizable Aesthetics: Allows showing or hiding the vertical scrollbar from the plugin settings, adapting to minimalist or traditional interfaces.
  • Hot Font and Color Sync: Real-time adaptation to code ligatures, console font sizes, and PyCharm theme palettes instantly and without restarting open tabs.
  • Multiple Tabs and Lazy Loading: Native navigation and PTY resource loading deferred until the terminal tab becomes visible.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
What's new in version 1.38.0:

  • JetBrains 2026.2 Platform Support: Added full compatibility and verification for JetBrains IDEs and PyCharm version 2026.2 (build branch 262).
  • Java 25 Toolchain: Upgraded compiler and plugin setups to JVM target 25 to match JetBrains' platform update. Integrated the Foojay Toolchain Resolver to auto-provision JDK 25 during builds.
  • Low-Latency Typing & 120 FPS Support: Reduced the render scheduling limit to 8ms (targeting 120 FPS) and simplified repaint coordination to draw the entire viewport in a single pass, making fast typing feel much snappier.
  • PTY Backpressure Auto-Reset: Implemented instant backpressure clearance when reading transitions from high-throughput output to typing mode, removing residual input lag.
  • Alternate Buffer Cursor Fix: Fixed a bug that hid the terminal cursor in CLI text editors like vi and nano when primary buffer history was present.

What's new in version 1.36.0:

  • Terminal Window Resize Scroll Anchor: Fixed scrollbar offset corruption when resizing the terminal window. The scroll position is now anchored to the bottom (or its current relative scroll offset) and temporary Swing layout-induced adjustment events are ignored, preventing the viewport from jumping to the beginning of the terminal history or the active `agy` conversation during resize.
  • Ctrl+C Process Interruption Fix (Windows/Linux): Fixed an issue where the copy shortcut (Ctrl+C) on Windows/Linux was unconditionally consumed even when no text was selected, preventing SIGINT (break process) from being sent to the running shell/PTY. Ctrl+C now properly sends the break sequence (`\u0003`) when there is no text selection.
  • Non-Blocking Instant Terminal Startup: Optimized the Project SDK virtual environment detection during shell startup. The SDK query now executes asynchronously with a strict 100ms timeout, ensuring that the terminal shell starts up instantly and does not freeze or wait when the IDE is busy with background tasks, indexing, or loading skeletons.

What's new in version 1.34.0:

  • Transparent Paste Sanitizer for macOS: Added an automatic, passive paste sanitizer that intercepts clipboard pasting (both normal Cmd+V and smart Cmd+Shift+V). It removes trailing backslashes (\) and trailing whitespace from multi-line commands, unifying them into a clean, single-line command dynamically to prevent accidental execution and shell interpretation errors in macOS.

What's new in version 1.32.0:

  • Gentoo-Style Terminal Colors & Aliases Loading Fix: Fixed an issue where classic Gentoo-style terminal colors, LSColors, and command aliases (like ls, grep, diff) were not loaded in Unix shell sessions (zsh, bash) when no Python virtual environment was detected or configured in the project workspace.

What's new in version 1.30.0:

  • Snappy Reactive Repaint & Low-Latency Rendering: Redesigned the terminal repaint scheduler to be fully event-driven, triggering repaints instantly on EDT for typing/idle periods and rate-limiting to 60 FPS under heavy output. Removed background polling thread and extra EDT scheduling hops to make typing extremely snappy.
  • ANSI Inverse Video Support (SGR 7 & 27): Implemented support for ANSI inverse/reverse video mode (SGR 7 to enable, SGR 27 to disable). This ensures that highlighted selections inside interactive CLI prompts (such as agy option selectors) are rendered with proper background/foreground color swapping.
  • Lazy Shell Wrapper Startup: Sped up shell startup by avoiding temporary wrapper directory/file generation when no Python virtual environment is active in the project workspace, preserving native shell prompts and system configurations.
  • Dumb Mode Responsive Loading: Shifted blocking shell startup and PTY reader loops to asynchronous daemon background threads, keeping tab creation, close actions, and UI interactive even during PyCharm project indexing (Dumb Mode).
  • Interactive Mouse Double-Click Word Selection: Intercept mouse double-clicks to dynamically expand and select word tokens, paths, variables, and links.
  • High-Precision Wobble-Free Scroll: Implemented fractional mouse/trackpad wheel accumulation (preciseWheelRotation) to eliminate scroll jitter and wobbles when scrolling slowly.
  • Sticky Scrollback Viewport: Locks scrollback viewport position while background processes append new lines, preventing the viewport from jumping or shifting.
  • Keyboard Page Navigation: Added support for Page Up and Page Down keys to scroll through scrollback history when the alternate buffer is inactive.
  • PTY Write Performance Optimization: Added batched character writing (writeGraphemes) and disabled verbose Raw PTY input diagnostics to optimize console output throughput.

What's new in version 1.26.0:

  • Smart Paste & Drag and Drop: Copy screenshots (images), documents (PDFs), or massive text logs and paste them directly into the terminal with Cmd+Shift+V (or Drag & Drop). Handles automatic file generation, isolated session directories, and dynamic physical/symbolic links for heavy resources.
  • Clickable Hyperlinks: Injected temporary files are displayed as active terminal hyperlinks (underlined and highlighted) that instantly open in the PyCharm editor on mouse click.
  • Minimum Linking Configuration: Added a setting under tools configuration (default 50MB) to choose when to switch from copying to hardlinks/symlinks for pasted resources.
  • Default Right-Top Alignment: Positioned the tool window by default to the upper-right sidebar for fresh installations.

What's new in version 1.24.0:

  • Silent Virtual Environment Auto-Activation: Automatically detect and activate Python virtual environments (venv, .venv, env) on startup without printing commands to the shell (using temporary ZDOTDIR profiles for zsh, --rcfile for bash, and -C for fish).
  • Gentoo-Style Terminal Colors: Classic Gentoo-style terminal colors, LSColors, and command aliases (like ls, grep, diff) automatically configured for all zsh and bash terminal sessions.
  • Close Tab Active Process Protection: Prevent closing terminal tabs if background processes are executing, displaying a confirmation warning and abruptly terminating running process trees if accepted. Optimized to check descendants robustly using OS-level process handles.
  • Dynamic Localized Interface: Automatically translate plugin settings, options, and actions between English and Spanish depending on the system's JVM locale.

What's new in version 1.22.0:

  • Color & Theme Customization: Added settings interface with preset themes (Dracula, Solarized Dark/Light, Monokai, One Dark, Konsole Default), fully custom scheme creation, and a compact 2x8 grid picker for the 16 ANSI colors.
  • Background Opacity (Konsole Style): Added a background transparency slider (0-100%) that dynamically adjusts the terminal background opacity over the IDE tool window background while keeping text, selections, and cursors fully opaque and readable.
  • Shift + Enter Shortcut: Map Shift + Enter to backslash + enter (\\\r) to facilitate multiline text editing and newlines in CLI chat agents (like agy) and shell line continuations.

What's new in version 1.20.0:

  • Configurable Scrollbar Visibility: Added settings option to show or hide the vertical scrollbar, aligning with different layout preferences.
  • Mac Scroll/Rubber-Banding Fix: Fixed trackpad overscroll and rubber-banding flickering in macOS/JBR by introducing a locked viewport position.
  • Clean Telemetry HUD: Disabled debug/diagnostic telemetry overlay HUD by default for clean production builds.
  • Deprecation Warnings Resolve: Fixed OLD_EDT thread deprecation warnings on tab actions to ensure compatibility with modern IntelliJ platform versions.
  • English Documentation: Fully translated all user-facing plugin descriptions and release change-notes to English.

What's new in version 1.19:

  • Bracketed Paste Mode Support (ANSI 2004): Implemented full support for ANSI mode `2004`. When pasting long or multiline text, the emulator now wraps the block with special escape sequences (`\u001b[200~` and `\u001b[201~`). This prevents the shell (like `zsh`/`bash`) from interpreting the block character-by-character too quickly, avoiding cursor/redraw desynchronization and resolving visual corruption and misalignment on long pasted lines.

What's new in version 1.18:

  • IDE Global Shortcut Interception (e.g., Ctrl + R): Implemented a high-priority event dispatcher (`IdeEventQueue.EventDispatcher`) that captures and consumes global IDE keyboard shortcuts when the terminal emulator has focus. This prevents PyCharm from intercepting crucial shell combinations (like `Ctrl+R` for history search, `Ctrl+C`, `Ctrl+Z`, etc.). Essential shortcuts like toggling ToolWindows (`Cmd`/`Alt` + `1..9`) or modifiers alone are excluded to keep `Double Shift` functioning.

What's new in version 1.17:

  • Command Autocompletion with Tab Key Support: Disabled Swing's default focus traversal keys interception for the terminal panel. This allows `Tab` and `Shift + Tab` keystrokes to be delivered directly to the terminal emulator instead of switching UI components in IntelliJ. Thus, native shell autocompletion (`zsh`/`bash`) and tab-dependent commands now work transparently and directly.

What's new in version 1.16:

  • Orphaned Characters Fix when Exiting Interactive Programs (Letter 'q' bug): Added support for intermediate characters (range `0x20..0x2F`, like space) within CSI escape sequences. This fixes a bug where cursor style change commands (`DECSCUSR` sequence: `CSI Ps SP q`) broke halfway due to the intermediate space character, causing the trailing `q` to print as ordinary text when exiting `/help` or other interactive console utilities.

What's new in version 1.15:

  • Cursor Save and Restore Support (Save/Restore Cursor): Added full support for ANSI cursor save and restore sequences (`ESC 7`/`ESC 8` and CSI `s`/`CSI u`). This fixes prompt misalignment, offset issues, and unwanted space insertions when navigating word-by-word (`opt + arrows` on macOS) or refreshing complex prompts in Zsh (e.g., with syntax-highlighting or autosuggestions plugins).

What's new in version 1.14:

  • Scrollback Margins Support (DECSTBM): Implemented full support for CSI `r` sequence to define top and bottom scrolling margins. This fixes bugs in interactive carousel-like menus (where items rotate/slide in a screen sub-region while the rest remains fixed), respecting margins during line insertions and deletions (`IL`, `DL`) and line wraps.

What's new in version 1.13:

  • Terminal Font Proportion and Size Fix: Bound automatic typography to PyCharm's specific console settings (`consoleFontName` and `consoleFontSize`), rather than editor font settings.
  • Compact and Precise Line Height: Implemented a default line height of `1.0` for the terminal. This prevents excessive vertical spacing, letting the correct number of rows fit so interactive menus are not clipped and box-drawing characters join vertically without gaps.

What's new in version 1.12:

  • Vertical Resize Duplication Fix: Implemented an adaptive resizing algorithm anchored to the bottom that preserves cursor position in the history buffer. This prevents duplication of interactive menus, banners, and prompts (like `agy` and `inquirer`) when dragging to change terminal height.

What's new in version 1.11:

  • Advanced Scroll and Line ANSI Support: Added support for `ESC M` (Reverse Index) and CSI `E` (Cursor Next Line), `F` (Cursor Previous Line), `S` (Scroll Up), and `T` (Scroll Down) commands. This fixes line duplication issues in dynamic menus and interactive prompts (like `inquirer` and similar).
  • Advanced Text Deletion and Navigation Shortcuts: Added system shortcuts for text deletion and navigation:
    • macOS: `Opt+Backspace` (delete previous word), `Cmd+Backspace` (delete entire line), `Opt+Arrows` (move word-by-word), `Cmd+Arrows` (move to start/end of line).
    • Windows/Linux: `Ctrl+Backspace` (delete previous word), `Alt+Backspace` (delete entire line), `Ctrl+Arrows` (move word-by-word), `Alt+Arrows` (move to start/end of line).
  • Modifier Key Combinations: Added full support for modifier key combinations (Shift, Alt, Ctrl) combined with navigation and editing keys (arrows, Home, End, PageUp, PageDown, Delete) in accordance with the standard xterm emulator (e.g. `Ctrl+Home` and `Ctrl+End`).
  • Advanced ANSI Support: Added support for CSI DCH, ECH, ICH, IL, and DL commands. This fixes text overlapping and corruption in interactive tools like `agy` file lists and terminal editors.
  • Pure Swing Engine: Complete migration from JCEF to native Swing, removing the embedded Chromium engine.
  • Lazy Loading: System processes are launched only when the Tool Window becomes visible.
  • Autodetect Virtual Environment: Automatic activation of Python virtual environments on shell startup.
  • History Limit: Option added in settings to adjust lines in the scrollback buffer.
  • Login Shells: Forced execution as a Login Shell on Unix/macOS to inherit system environment variables (PATH, aliases, etc.).
  • Keyboard Input Fixes: Separated PTY read and write threads to prevent keyboard lockups. Removed Enter character duplication in `keyTyped`.
  • Sizing Safeguard: Prevents shell lockups by avoiding sending microscopic window sizes (1x1) during startup.

idea-plugin.name: SeedBase
idea-plugin.description:
Generate realistic, foreign-key-consistent test data from your database schema, right inside your JetBrains IDE. Point it at a SQL dump, Django models.py, a Prisma schema, or a live Postgres/MySQL connection, and get a full dataset where every foreign key resolves and the data actually looks real, not "Premium Widget 1" and lorem ipsum.

Want to see the output first? Try the login-free sandbox in your browser: seedba.se/playground.

  • New Project from Schema: turn a workspace SQL dump, Django models.py or a Prisma schema into a project, DB type detected automatically, pick which tables to send, large dumps streamed
  • Push Schema: update a project from your schema files with a checkbox table picker
  • Generate Data and Preview Data: build a foreign-key-consistent dataset and view sample rows in a table inside the IDE
  • Insert Test Data at Caret: drop FK-consistent rows into the open file, formatted for the file type (SQL/PHP/Python/JSON)
  • Mock API and Upload OpenAPI: serve a project as a live REST API with a built-in Swagger Explorer, or bring your own OpenAPI contract
  • Pull a generation as SQL, CSV or JSON, or Push to Database (Pro/Team)
  • Secure login: browser-based authorization, token stored in the IDE's Password Safe

Getting started: create a free account at seedba.se (no credit card), then click the key icon in the tool window to sign in. The free tier is enough to generate full, foreign-key-consistent datasets for your schema.

More about the plugin: seedba.se/jetbrains.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.6.3
  • Marketplace listing now leads with what you get: realistic, foreign-key-consistent test data that does not look fake, plus a link to the login-free browser sandbox
0.6.2

0.6.1
  • Local database workflow: load, reset and reseed against a local psql/mysql/sqlite connection (auto-detected from .env, docker-compose or schema.prisma), matching the VS Code extension
0.6.0
  • Reset & Reseed and Seed Test Data (generate + load): full database-workflow parity with the VS Code extension
  • Settings (Tools → SeedBase): configurable preview row count
0.5.x
  • Push to Database: load generated data into a configured connection (Pro/Team)
  • Preview Data: view sample rows in a table inside the IDE; wide tables scroll horizontally
  • Decluttered tool window: a slim toolbar plus a context menu; Pull SQL/CSV/JSON merged into one action with a format chooser
0.3.0–0.4.x
  • New Project from Schema with automatic DB-type detection, table selection and streamed large dumps
  • Insert Test Data at Caret, Mock API with a Swagger Explorer, and Upload OpenAPI to serve your own contract
  • Delete Generation; clearer error messages and a guard when generating with an empty schema

  • Clearer upgrade hint: when an export format is not available on your plan (for example Parquet on the Free plan), the error now points to upgrading to Pro instead of showing a generic failure. Free includes SQL, CSV and JSON.

idea-plugin.name: Hoppscotch Sync
idea-plugin.description:
English

Sync Spring Boot REST API endpoints to Hoppscotch self-hosted instance.

⚠️ Spring Boot (Java) only.

⚠️ Personal workspace only. Syncs to your Hoppscotch personal workspace; team/shared workspaces are not supported.

Features:

  • Parse @RestController and @Controller classes in your project
  • Extract all HTTP endpoints (@RequestMapping, @GetMapping, @PostMapping, etc.)
  • Parse path/query/body/header parameters with JSON skeleton preview
  • Incremental sync to Hoppscotch via GraphQL API — skip existing, only create new
  • Dual-hash sync status tracking: SYNCED (green), MODIFIED (blue), UNSYNCED (white)
  • Multi-project/module support in a single IDEA window
  • Selective sync with checkbox — search filters auto-select visible rows
  • Collection tree picker to choose target folder before sync
  • Auto token refresh with access_token + refresh_token dual auth
  • Adjustable table columns (show/hide, reorder, resize with session persistence)
  • Bilingual UI (English / 中文) with instant switch

中文

将 Spring Boot REST API 端点同步到 Hoppscotch 自托管实例。

⚠️ 仅支持 Spring Boot (Java) 项目。

⚠️ 仅支持个人工作空间。插件同步到 Hoppscotch 个人工作空间；不支持团队工作空间同步。

功能：

  • 扫描 @RestController / @Controller 类，提取所有 HTTP 端点
  • 解析路径/查询/请求体/请求头参数，展示 JSON 骨架预览
  • 通过 GraphQL API 增量同步到 Hoppscotch — 跳过已存在，仅创建新增
  • 双 Hash 同步状态追踪：🟢 已同步 / 🔵 已修改 / ⬜ 未同步

  • access_token + refresh_token 双 Token 认证，自动续期
  • 表格列显隐 / 排序 / 拖拽调整宽度，重启后保留
  • 中英文界面即时切换

idea-plugin.name: Deep Project Search
idea-plugin.description:
Deep Project Search

Deep Project Search adds a dedicated JetBrains IDE tool window for searching current project files, project text content, Java library roots, dependency jar entries, dependency text resources, and frontend package directories in one place.

Smart Search keeps the UI small while supporting phrases, wildcards, regex queries, and lightweight scope prefixes from the same keyword field.

It is designed for cases where Search Everywhere may miss files inside dependency jars, package directories, or generated dependency resources until they have been opened once.

How to use

  • Open the Deep Search tool window.
  • Enter a keyword such as UserService, spring.factories, or META-INF services.
  • Choose All, Project Files, or Dependencies.
  • Click Search, or press Enter from the keyword field.
  • Double-click a result, or press Enter on the selected result, to open the project file, package file, jar resource, or class file.
  • Use recent searches from the keyword dropdown to rerun previous queries.
  • Use quick actions to open results, copy paths, or clear the result list.

Smart Search examples

  • password for normal keyword search.
  • "spring boot" for phrase search.
  • *.properties for wildcard file name/path search.
  • /BeanFactory.*/ for regex search.
  • project: password to search only project files.
  • dep: spring.factories to search only dependencies.

Features

  • Searches current project files.
  • Searches project text file contents.
  • Searches Java dependency class and source roots, including jar entries.
  • Searches frontend dependency directories such as node_modules.
  • Searches dependency text resources and source content where available.
  • Supports filename, path, and text content keyword matching.
  • Supports Smart Search phrases, wildcards, regex queries, and lightweight scope prefixes.
  • Shows a preview line for project and dependency content matches.
  • Opens text content matches directly at the matched line and column when possible.
  • Keeps recent search history.
  • Provides quick actions for opening results, copying paths, and clearing results.
  • Provides scope selection without taking over the double-Shift shortcut.
  • Runs searches in a background task.

中文说明

Deep Project Search 是一个独立的 JetBrains IDE 搜索工具窗口，用来统一搜索当前项目文件、Java 依赖 jar 内部的 class/resource 文件，以及前端项目中的 node_modules 依赖文件。 它也支持搜索项目和依赖中的文本内容，不会占用 IDE 双击 Shift 的快捷键。

适合搜索依赖包里的 .class、META-INF、.properties、 .xml、.yml 等文件，也适合在 WebStorm 等前端项目中搜索 node_modules 下的包文件，同时可以搜索当前项目文件和文本内容。 文本内容命中会显示预览，并在可行时直接跳转到命中行。输入框会保留最近搜索记录， 结果列表支持打开、复制路径和清空等快捷操作。

Smart Search 支持 "spring boot" 短语、*.properties 通配符、 /BeanFactory.*/ 正则，以及 project: / dep: 轻量范围前缀， 不需要增加额外按钮或高级面板。
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Fixed

  • Replaced manual getChildren() recursion with VirtualFileVisitor to eliminate excessive VFS notifications that trigger IDE performance warnings.
  • Replaced full-file loadText() with line-by-line streaming in text content search, reducing memory usage.
  • Pre-compiled whitespace regex to avoid recompiling Pattern on every preview build.
  • Batch-updated list model and used StringBuilder in the result renderer to reduce EDT string allocations.
  • Added missing cancellation checks inside recursive file traversal loops.

idea-plugin.name: Revision Graph for Git (SVN style)
idea-plugin.description:
A TortoiseSVN-style revision graph for Git inside your JetBrains IDE (IntelliJ IDEA, WebStorm, PyCharm, GoLand, …). Commits, local & remote branches, tags, stashes and merges are displayed as connected, color-coded boxes.

▶ Try the live demo in your browser — no install required; runs the real renderer on a sample repository.

How to open

Open a project that is under Git version control, then either:

  • open the Tools menu and choose Revision Graph, or
  • press Shift twice (Search Everywhere) and type "Revision Graph".

The graph opens as a full tab in the center editor area.

Features

  • DAG layout — commits in columns per branch with connecting lines; modern (free canvas) or classic (trunk-pinned) display modes.
  • Color-coded nodes — HEAD/current branch (red), local branches (green), remote branches (blue), remote-only commits, tags (yellow), stashes, plain commits (grey), and commits merged into the branch that received them.
  • Built-in legend — a panel spells out every color and every line: parent link, merge (arrow at the merge commit), fork-off point, stash tie, and the line threading merged-in commits back to the branch they were written on.
  • Branch — create a branch from any commit via an SVN-style folder-tree dialog or the IDE's native branch UI; rename, delete or push a branch.
  • Merge — merge or squash-merge one branch into another, with a schematic preview that shows the merge direction.
  • Rewrite history — reword a commit message; undo a commit while keeping its changes.
  • Inspect — a commit's changed files, file diffs with a minimap, and search inside a diff (Ctrl/Cmd+F).
  • Commit — stage and commit working-tree changes from the graph, with an optional review step.
  • Stash — apply, pop or drop a stash.
  • Remotes — fetch, pull, push and sync from the toolbar; search commit messages; jump to HEAD; zoom & pan.
  • Localized — English, Magyar, 中文, Русский; light/dark themes; optional plain-language labels instead of git jargon.

Other hosts

Also available for VS Code, Visual Studio 2022 / 2026, Eclipse and Apache NetBeans.

Source code & license

  • Source code: https://github.com/HunKonTech/git_Revision_Graph
  • License: Business Source License 1.1 — free for personal, internal, and non-commercial use. Selling, reselling, or offering the software as a paid product or service is not permitted. Converts to MPL 2.0 four years after each version's release.

One build, installable in any IntelliJ Platform IDE — IntelliJ IDEA, Android Studio, Huawei DevEco Studio, WebStorm, PyCharm, GoLand, and more.

Egy TortoiseSVN-stílusú revíziógraf Git-hez a JetBrains IDE-den belül (IntelliJ IDEA, WebStorm, PyCharm, GoLand, …). A commitok, helyi és távoli ágak, tagek, stash-ek és merge-ök összekötött, színkódolt dobozokként jelennek meg.

▶ Próbáld ki az élő demót a böngésződben — telepítés nélkül; a valódi megjelenítő fut egy minta-repozitóriummal.

Megnyitás

Nyiss meg egy Git verziókövetés alatt álló projektet, majd:

  • nyisd meg a Tools menüt és válaszd a Revision Graph pontot, vagy
  • nyomd meg kétszer a Shiftet (Search Everywhere) és írd be: "Revision Graph".

A gráf középen, teljes editor-fülként nyílik meg.

Funkciók

  • DAG elrendezés — commitok áganként oszlopokban, összekötő vonalakkal; modern (szabad vászon) vagy klasszikus (balra rögzített törzs) nézet.
  • Színkódolt csomópontok — HEAD/aktuális ág (piros), helyi ágak (zöld), távoli ágak (kék), csak-távoli commitok, tagek (sárga), stash-ek, sima commitok (szürke), és a fogadó ágba merge-ölt commitok.
  • Beépített jelmagyarázat — egy panel elmagyaráz minden színt és minden vonalat: szülő-kapcsolat, merge (nyíl a merge-commitnál), leágazási pont, stash-kötés, és a beolvasztott commitokon átfutó vonal vissza az ágra, ahol készültek.
  • Ág — új ág bármely committól SVN-stílusú mappafa-párbeszéddel vagy az IDE natív ág-ablakával; ág átnevezése, törlése, push-olása.
  • Merge — egy ág merge-ölése vagy squash-merge-ölése egy másikba, a merge irányát mutató sematikus előnézettel.
  • Történet átírása — commit üzenet átírása; commit visszavonása a változtatások megtartásával.
  • Vizsgálat — egy commit módosított fájljai, fájl-diffek minimappel, és keresés a diffen belül (Ctrl/Cmd+F).
  • Commit — a munkakönyvtár változtatásainak stage-elése és commitolása a gráfból, opcionális átnézési lépéssel.
  • Stash — stash alkalmazása, pop-olása vagy eldobása.
  • Távoli — fetch, pull, push és sync az eszköztárból; commit üzenetek keresése; ugrás a HEAD-re; nagyítás és mozgatás.
  • Honosított — English, Magyar, 中文, Русский; világos/sötét téma; opcionálisan közérthető feliratok a git szakzsargon helyett.

Más hosztokon

Elérhető VS Code-hoz, Visual Studio 2022 / 2026-höz, Eclipse-hez és Apache NetBeans-hez is.

Forráskód és licenc

  • Forráskód: https://github.com/HunKonTech/git_Revision_Graph

Egyetlen build, amely bármely IntelliJ Platform IDE-be telepíthető — IntelliJ IDEA, Android Studio, Huawei DevEco Studio, WebStorm, PyCharm, GoLand és több más.

idea-plugin.name: ADB Toolkit+
idea-plugin.description:
ADB Toolkit+

Run any ADB command, control connected devices and mirror the screen directly from the IDE, without leaving Android Studio.

  • Console — run arbitrary adb commands with history; the selected device serial is injected automatically.
  • Quick Actions — install/uninstall, force-stop, clear data, reboot (recovery/bootloader), screenshot & screen record, push/pull files, developer toggles, wireless adb and more.
  • Screen Control — live screenshot mirroring; click to tap, drag to swipe, type text and use hardware keys.
  • Logcat — live log streaming with a filter.
  • Info — searchable reference of adb commands with descriptions.

Screen mirroring uses adb exec-out screencap — no external binaries required.
idea-plugin.change-notes: • 1.0.0 — Initial release: Console, Quick Actions, Screen Control, Logcat and a searchable command Info reference.

idea-plugin.name: Better Image Viewer
idea-plugin.description:
Better Image Viewer

A clean, practical image viewer for IntelliJ-based IDEs, built for inspecting images without leaving the editor.

  • Open common image formats in a dedicated Better Image Viewer editor.
  • Zoom, pan, fit to window, jump back to actual size, and move the viewport with the keyboard.
  • Use the canvas context menu for file copy/cut, absolute or relative path copying, and common image actions.
  • Rotate images left or right by 90 degrees, rotate by 180 degrees, reset rotation, and flip horizontally or vertically.
  • Inspect pixel position and color values directly under the cursor.
  • Copy HEX or RGB values with the built-in color picker.
  • Toggle checkerboard background, pixel grid, and color channels.
  • View image metadata including resolution, format, bit depth, and file size.

idea-plugin.name: Cockpit for GitLab
idea-plugin.description:
Run the full GitLab merge request review cycle without leaving your IDE. Cockpit for GitLab adds a dedicated tool window where you browse, review and merge your merge requests, and follow their pipelines from first job to green.

  • Browse and filter merge requests by role (author, reviewer, reviewer not yet approved) or by user, across a single project, every project of the instance, and multi-root repositories.
  • Review in depth: discussion threads with replies, draft reviews with bulk submit, and inline comments anchored to the diff, right inside the editor.
  • Merge with a status-aware button that knows when the request is mergeable, offers "merge when the pipeline succeeds", and shows the blocking reason otherwise.
  • Pipelines for each merge request: stages, jobs, retry, cancel and play actions, and live logs with ANSI colors streamed as the job runs.
  • Images and attachments from descriptions and comments are fetched with your token and rendered inline.
  • Configurable notifications, including background polling with the tool window closed and a per-merge-request watch toggle.

Setup: open Settings > Tools > Cockpit for GitLab, add a personal access token with the api scope, and point it at your instance. Works with self-managed GitLab 17+ and gitlab.com.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Changed

  • A notification's "Open in Cockpit" action now lands on the section that matches the event instead of always opening the merge request's default view: a pipeline (or downstream pipeline) balloon opens the Pipelines view, a new-comments balloon opens Events & Discussions, and the remaining events (new merge request, state change, new push, approval) open the Info view as before — including when the merge request's tab is already open (GLC-64)

Fixed

  • The Marketplace verifier's "deprecated constructor usage" warning against 2026.2 EAP is gone: markdown rendering now uses the primary MarkdownParser constructor (with CancellationToken.NonCancellable), which exists in every supported IDE's bundled library. The remaining buildMarkdownTreeFromString(String) warning is structural — its CharSequence replacement does not exist in the org.intellij.markdown 0.7.2 bundled by 2025.2–2026.1, so migrating would break those IDEs at runtime; it stays until the plugin's minimum platform moves past 2026.1 (GLC-63)

idea-plugin.name: dotnet outdated GUI
idea-plugin.description:
Keep a solution's NuGet packages up to date without leaving Rider. dotnet outdated GUI wraps the dotnet-outdated CLI in a tool window: list every package, check for updates on demand, and upgrade the ones you choose — in place.

It handles the parts of real-world .NET solutions that trip other tools up:

  • Central Package Management — updates the central <PackageVersion> in Directory.Packages.props and leaves the versionless <PackageReference> in each project untouched.
  • NuGet version ranges & floating versions — interval and floating notation ([1.0.0,2.0.0), (,3.0.0], 3.*) resolve to the concrete current version instead of showing raw brackets.
  • Severity at a glance — each available update is colored by NuGet / Semantic Versioning: green for patch, yellow for minor, red for major or pre-release.

Packages are grouped by project and target framework. Pick the ones you want (checkboxes, or multi-select + Space), type to search, and upgrade in place. Every dotnet outdated argument — pre-release, version lock, transitive dependencies, filters, timeouts — is available under Settings → Tools → dotnet outdated GUI.

Complements Rider's built-in NuGet window with a fast, CLI-driven, solution-wide view of what's outdated. Requires the dotnet-outdated global tool; no known conflicts.

Source & issues: github.com/iamr8/dotnet-outdated-gui
idea-plugin.change-notes: See the CHANGELOG for release notes.

idea-plugin.name: A-Share Stock Watcher
idea-plugin.description: A compact IntelliJ IDEA tool window for watching A-share stock quotes, backed by Sina Finance.
idea-plugin.change-notes: Initial A-share stock watcher tool window with Sina Finance quotes, add/delete, manual refresh, configurable refresh interval, and persisted stock list.

idea-plugin.name: Dev Workspace Launcher Bridge
idea-plugin.description: Connects IntelliJ IDEA projects to Dev Workspace Launcher so users can select and control existing Run/Debug Configurations or run configured commands in the IDEA Terminal. The plugin only accepts authenticated local requests from the Launcher.

idea-plugin.name: RestfulController
idea-plugin.description: Discovers REST endpoints across Spring, JAX-RS, Micronaut, and FastAPI, then provides grouped browsing, filtering, and jump-to-source navigation.

idea-plugin.name: Raptor21 SAP RFC
idea-plugin.description:
Browse the SAP Data Dictionary and generate typed table classes into your project — C# in Rider, Java in IntelliJ IDEA, TypeScript in WebStorm, Python in PyCharm, and any of them in any IDE that opens the project.

Add an RFC data source the way you would a database connection, expand it to see its tables, expand a table to see its columns — types, keys, conversion exits, check tables — and tick what you want. The classes are written as ordinary source you can read, review and commit. Nothing is generated at build time and no build ever contacts SAP.

Two systems can be added side by side. An ECC landscape and an S/4HANA one hold tables of the same name, so each source generates into its own namespace and the two never collide.

The project you generate into names its runtime — the Raptor21.SAP.RFC NuGet package, the io.github.raptortwentyone:raptor21-sap-rfc Maven artefact, the @raptortwentyone/sap-rfc npm package or the raptor21-sap-rfc PyPI package — and that choice decides the language the classes come out in. The scaffolder itself is found in the restored NuGet package, or fetched once as a small native binary when there is no .NET on the machine.

Raptor21 SAP RFC is an independent, community-developed plugin. It is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by SAP SE. SAP, SAP S/4HANA and ABAP are trademarks or registered trademarks of SAP SE (or an SAP affiliate company) in Germany and other countries. This plugin is designed for use with SAP software and is not an SAP product.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Changed

  • The native tool the plugin fetches — for a project with no restored NuGet package — is now the stable v0.1.0, the first release whose binary scaffolds Python and names the published @raptortwentyone packages in its help.

idea-plugin.name: ANSI Log Cleaner
idea-plugin.description:
Turn messy terminal output into clean, usable text.

ANSI Log Cleaner reconstructs terminal transcripts containing ANSI escape sequences, progress redraws, cursor movement, and overwritten lines, so the result matches the useful final state instead of the raw control stream.

Clean the current file, selected editor text, or clipboard content, then copy, save, or preview the reconstructed result.

Processing runs locally inside your JetBrains IDE, with no network access or telemetry.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Added

  • Clean the saved raw bytes of the current file, with an explicit choice when the editor has unsaved changes.
  • Open cleaned output in a temporary read-only editor preview.
  • Save the full cleaned result as a new file.
  • Editor context actions for cleaning the current selection or current file.
  • Bounded Result Dialog previews for large outputs while preserving the complete cleaned result.

Changed

  • Expanded terminal reconstruction for cursor movement and erase behavior used by real terminal output.
  • Added explicit success and warning states when terminal operations cannot be reconstructed faithfully.
  • Moved expensive reconstruction work for current-file, selection, and clipboard workflows off the EDT.
  • Shortened results now use Copy Preview; normal results continue to use Copy.
  • Hardened real-world handling with frozen fixtures from Git, Gradle, clang, Python unittest, npm, and progress-style output.

idea-plugin.name: J2o SQL Tools
idea-plugin.description:
SQL text toolbox for IntelliJ IDEA.
IN list tools: generate/revert SQL IN lists from selected lines, and split large lists to avoid Oracle's 1000-item limit.
SQL formatting: full formatting with Druid (Oracle/PostgreSQL), keyword case conversion, clause line breaking, single-line compaction, and comment removal.
Extraction and generation: extract tables/columns, convert CREATE TABLE DDL to Java entities or MyBatis ResultMap, and generate INSERT statements from tabular data.
List conversion: switch between single-line and multi-line value lists.
General text tools: JSON format/compact, Base64 encode/decode, timestamp conversion, and naming style conversion.
Icon enhancement: provide 1400+ colorful project file icons with configurable settings.

SQL 文本处理工具箱。
IN 列表：选中多行文本生成/回退 SQL IN 列表（单引号包裹 + 逗号分隔），批分割规避 Oracle 1000 项上限。
SQL 格式化：完整美化（Druid，Oracle/PG）、关键字大小写、子句换行、压缩单行、去注释。
提取与生成：表名/字段提取、建表语句转 Java 实体/MyBatis ResultMap、数据转 INSERT。
列表转换：单行/多行值列表互转。
通用转换：JSON 美化/压缩、Base64 编解码、时间戳互转、命名风格互转。
图标美化：为项目文件提供 1400+ 彩色图标，可在设置页开关。

idea-plugin.name: AEM Toolkit
idea-plugin.description:
AEM Toolkit brings Adobe Experience Manager development workflows directly into IntelliJ IDEA.

Independent community project. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Adobe.

  • Navigate and complete resource types, templates, policies, dialogs, HTL, and Sling Models.
  • Inspect AEM XML, HTL, FileVault filters, Dispatcher configuration, and Sling Models.
  • Explore content trees and Granite UI dialogs with structure and visual previews.
  • Manage AEM Author content, packages, OSGi bundles, and remote debugging.
  • Synchronize files and JCR node definitions from the IDE.
  • Develop Sling CAConfig and ACS AEM Commons integrations with navigation, completion, and inspections.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
New Features

  • Add ClientLib category intelligence and js.txt/css.txt completion and navigation.
  • Complete Java Use classes, Sling Models, HTL templates, and FileVault i18n keys.
  • Navigate between OSGi services and run-mode configurations.
  • Add Classic UI xtype completion and quick documentation.
  • Resolve chained HTL Java properties and propagate safe renames.

idea-plugin.name: Siphrix - AI Action Monitor
idea-plugin.description:
See what your AI agents actually did. Every tool call — which file, which command, in which app — on a tamper-evident record, with risky actions raised as warnings. Audit-first: nothing is ever blocked.

This plugin is the editor half. It records text that arrived in a file without being typed, together with which AI plugins were enabled at the time. It does not claim to know which one did it — an in-IDE assistant writes through the platform's own API, exactly as you do, so there is no honest way to name an author. Entries are attributed to "unattributed" and carry the circumstance; the reviewer draws the conclusion.

Your coding agents are recorded properly and by name. Claude Code and Codex call a hook before every tool use, so the record says which command was run and on which file. Run siphrix agent-setup once in a terminal.

Nothing here reads file contents. The IDE already knows how much text arrived; how much is the only part that leaves. Requires the Siphrix engine: pip install siphrix.

idea-plugin.name: DataGrid Column Sidebar
idea-plugin.description:
Adds a persistent right-side column management panel for DataGrip/IDEA, replacing the Ctrl+F12 popup with freeze, visibility, and navigation controls.

How to open: In DataGrip: Menu View → Tool Windows → Column Sidebar. In IntelliJ IDEA: click the Toggle Column Sidebar button on the database result set toolbar (the panel is closed by default and auto-closes when focus moves to a code editor).

  • Freeze Column (Pin) — Pin columns to the left side of the data grid; frozen columns stay visible while scrolling horizontally, with font/row-height auto-sync on zoom
  • Column Visibility Control — Toggle column visibility via checkboxes; frozen columns are protected from being hidden
  • Column Search & Filter — Search columns by keyword
  • Select All / Deselect All — Toggle all columns at once (respects frozen columns)
  • Invert Selection — Invert the selection state of all columns
  • Clear All Frozen — Unfreeze all pinned columns with one click
  • Column Locate — Click the arrow button to scroll the data grid to the corresponding column

为 DataGrip/IDEA数据库工具添加右侧列管理面板，替代 Ctrl+F12 弹窗，提供列冻结、列显隐、列定位等持久化管理功能。

如何打开：DataGrip 中：菜单栏 View → Tool Windows → Column Sidebar； IntelliJ IDEA 中：点击数据库结果集工具栏上的 Toggle Column Sidebar 按钮（面板默认关闭，切到代码页时自动关闭）。

  • 列冻结（固定列） — 将指定列固定到数据网格最左侧，水平滚动时始终可见；缩放字体时自动同步行高
  • 列显隐控制 — 通过勾选框快速显示/隐藏数据网格中的列；已固定的列不允许隐藏，需先取消固定
  • 列搜索过滤 — 支持按列名关键字搜索，快速定位目标列
  • 全选/取消全选 — 一键切换所有列的显示状态（自动跳过固定列）
  • 反选 — 将当前所有列的选中状态取反
  • 清除所有固定 — 一键取消所有已固定的列
  • 列定位 — 点击每行右侧按钮，自动滚动数据网格到对应列

鸣谢: Jian Cai小伙伴们的反馈和意见
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• ✅ 适配IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate数据库工具窗口
  • 🐛 修复部分版本兼容性问题
  • 🐛 修复滚动到底部时固定列比数据区多显示几行导致的错位问题
  • 🐛 修复固定列与数据行行高不一致造成的逐行累积错位问题
  • 🐛 修复固定列垂直滚动位置与数据区不同步的问题

idea-plugin.name: SuiteScript Pro
idea-plugin.description:
SuiteScript and SDF intelligence for JetBrains IDEs.

Write and navigate with curated N/* completion and documentation, project-local IDs, SDF XML assistance, File Cabinet paths, structure views and SuiteScript templates. Refactor script IDs, inspect governance estimates and API usage, map TypeScript output, and run project-owned Jest tests. Optional SuiteCloud CLI integration uses the user's separately installed and authenticated Oracle CLI.

This release requires no NetSuite account or developer membership for local editor tools. Direct NetSuite account connections, live metadata, Records and SuiteQL are deferred and are not included. No Ngaio backend, telemetry or source-code upload by editor assistance. Try every feature free for 30 days. Continued use requires a paid license managed by JetBrains Marketplace.

For IntelliJ IDEA, WebStorm and PhpStorm with JavaScript support. Independent and unofficial; not endorsed by Oracle.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• Rename local SDF script IDs across JavaScript, TypeScript and XML, with Find Usages and Undo.
  • See governance estimates for supported API calls.
  • Follow TypeScript output and run your project's Jest tests.
  • Get guidance for supported SuiteScript 1.0 APIs and migration patterns.
Local editor tools work without a NetSuite login. Account connections, live metadata, Records and SuiteQL are not included in this release.

idea-plugin.name: Remap
idea-plugin.description: Provides live validation for Remap calls in Kotlin source files. Gradle compilation remains responsible for generated mapping code.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.0

  • Live validation for Remap enum and object mappings.
  • Diagnostics for nested objects, collections, maps, and property overrides.

idea-plugin.name: Bitbucket Pipelines
idea-plugin.description:
Watch Bitbucket Cloud Pipelines without leaving the IDE.

The Bitbucket Pipelines tool window drills down through your workspace — Bitbucket project → repository → run → step — and shows the log of the selected step beside it. A build that is still going updates in place: step statuses, the progress bar and the log of the running step all keep up while you work.

  • Repositories are discovered from the workspace and grouped by their Bitbucket project.
  • Runs are fetched when a repository is expanded and refreshed only while it stays open, so requests follow what is on screen rather than the size of the workspace.
  • A filter box narrows the tree as you type; a project filter in Settings hides whole projects for good.
  • Step logs open in the side panel automatically, or in a read-only editor tab.
  • Start a pipeline on any branch, optionally a custom one, or stop a running pipeline — each after a confirmation naming exactly what will run.
  • Suggest Fix analyses a failed step's log with a local CLI or the Claude API, masking secrets first. Off until you choose a backend.
  • The repository holding the file you are editing is selected for you, which suits a project that holds several clones side by side.

The workspace is read from the project's git remote. Credentials are an Atlassian API token with your account e-mail, or a workspace access token on its own, and are kept in the IDE password safe — never in project files. Configure it all in Settings | Tools | Bitbucket Pipelines.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.7.3

  • ⌥⇧⌘B (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+B on Windows and Linux) shows the tool window, and hides it again when it already has focus. Rebind it under Settings | Keymap.
  • A spinner now appears in the Fix column of the step being worked on, and over the answer pane, while the log is fetched and the model is thinking.
  • Clicking a step that is already loading does nothing, instead of starting a second request.

0.7.2

  • The side pane now shows rendered Markdown — real headings, lists and code blocks, themed to the IDE — instead of highlighted source.
  • Suggest Fix answers are cached per step, so asking again costs nothing. A finished step's log cannot change, so its answer stays valid; a step that is still running is never cached.
  • The cache survives restarts, holds the most recent 100 answers, and lives in its own file rather than in the project settings.
  • New on the step's right-click menu: Re-analyse Step, which ignores the cached answer, and Open Suggestion as File, which opens it as a real .md.

0.7.1

  • The right pane now shows the Suggest Fix answer, formatted as Markdown.
  • New Fix column in the step table: click it on a failed step to analyse that step.
  • Step logs are now read in an editor tab only, reachable from the toolbar, a double-click, or the new right-click menu on a step.
  • The API backend calls the Claude API directly instead of through the Anthropic SDK, taking the plugin from 26 MB back to under half a megabyte.

0.7.0

  • Suggest Fix: analyse a failed step's log and get a cause, a concrete fix and an honest confidence note, opened in an editor tab.
  • Two backends, chosen in Settings: a local CLI (Claude Code's non-interactive mode, so no key is stored and the log goes only through your own tool), or the Claude API with a key you supply.
  • Secrets are masked before anything is sent — tokens, private keys, authorization headers, credentials inside clone URLs, and values named like secrets.
  • Off by default; picking a backend is the opt-in to sending build output off the machine.

0.6.1

  • Fixed step logs failing with HTTP 406: the request asked for JSON and the plain-text log at the same time.

0.6.0

  • Run Pipeline: start a pipeline for the selected repository, choosing the branch, an optional commit and an optional custom: pipeline.
  • Stop Pipeline: signal a running pipeline and its unfinished steps to stop.
  • Both confirm first, naming exactly what will run, and need a token with the Pipelines: Write scope.
  • Note: Bitbucket has no API for re-running only the failed steps of a run, or for resuming a paused manual step, so both actions work on a whole pipeline.

0.5.0

  • Fixed the log disappearing while reading it: refreshing the steps reset the table's selection, which cleared the log panel on every poll.
  • The selected step is now kept when a running pipeline adds steps.
  • A refreshed log keeps its scroll position, and holds the bottom if you were already there, so a running step's log tails.
  • New floating Scroll to Bottom button in the top right of the log.

0.4.0

  • Step logs moved into a third column beside the steps, fetched automatically when a step is clicked.
  • The log of a step that is still running refreshes with each poll.
  • The eye icon toggles the log column, and the choice is remembered.
  • Opening a log in an editor tab is now its own action, still on double-click.
  • ANSI colour codes are stripped from logs; very large logs keep their tail.

0.3.0

  • Filter box above the tree, matching repository and project names as you type.
  • Step logs, opened in a read-only editor tab.

0.2.0

  • Drill-down tree of the whole workspace: Bitbucket project → repository → run.
  • Repositories discovered automatically and grouped by their project.
  • Project filter in Settings, replacing the single-repository setting.
  • Repository detection walks up from the file being edited, so projects holding several clones resolve to the right one.

0.1.0

  • First release: recent runs for one repository, with per-step progress.
  • Workspace and repository read from the project's git remote.
  • Token stored in the IDE password safe, with basic and bearer authentication.

idea-plugin.name: Project Finder
idea-plugin.description:
Open any project by name, even one you have never opened in this IDE.

Ctrl+Shift+O lists every folder of your project directories with its favicon or application icon, and typing filters the list - no hunting through recent projects or the file chooser.

A second, separately scrollable section lists the repositories of your connected GitLab and GitHub accounts that are not cloned yet, shown as owner/repo. Picking one clones it, enables the File Watchers and opens it. Accounts and tokens come from the IDE itself (Settings | Version Control), so there is nothing extra to set up.

Optionally it adds a PostgreSQL data source to projects that have none, taking the database name from the project's .env, so the Database tool window is connected right away.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.10.3

  • Projects that already have a PostgreSQL data source are handled too: the password is stored for good and a full refresh runs, while the selected databases stay untouched
  • The database list is refreshed with the full server scope, so the counter is up to date
  • Notification tells whether the password was stored or is still missing

1.9.0

  • GitHub support next to GitLab, any number of accounts in one list
  • Optional automatic PostgreSQL data source per project
  • Open in this window / new window / ask, selectable in the settings
  • Project folders are managed as a list instead of a text area

idea-plugin.name: WSL Macros
idea-plugin.description: Provides Wsl-prefixed macros ($WslFilePath$, $WslFileDir$, $WslProjectFileDir$, $WslProjectpath$, $WslContentRoot$) that always expand to the Windows-visible path (\\wsl.localhost\...). Where a built-in path macro such as $FilePath$ can expand to the Linux-side path for a file on a WSL mount, the matching Wsl macro yields a path a plain Windows tool can open.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Added

  • Wsl-prefixed macros that always expand to the Windows-visible path, so a plain Windows tool consuming a file on a WSL mount always receives a path it can open:
    • $WslFilePath$ — absolute Windows path of the current file
    • $WslFileDir$ — absolute Windows path of the directory containing the current file
    • $WslProjectFileDir$ — absolute Windows path of the current project directory
    • $WslProjectpath$ — absolute Windows path of the current project source path
    • $WslContentRoot$ — absolute Windows path of the content root containing the current file
  • Compatibility with IntelliJ Platform 2025.3+.

idea-plugin.name: LogQuarry Log Viewer
idea-plugin.description:
Inspect local Serilog and ASP.NET logs inside your IDE.

LogQuarry provides a read-only viewer with background indexing, event details, message templates, exceptions, typed property filters and request/trace ID navigation.

Supported profiles include CLEF, Serilog JSON and text, Microsoft.Extensions.Logging, JSON Lines, Logback, logfmt, syslog, Docker and plain UTF-8 text.

Search within results or the whole file, inspect original context, map build paths to local source files, follow a growing file and export complete events as original bytes.

Table previews are bounded. Semantic event processing is limited to 8 MiB; events that cannot be evaluated are reported. Larger raw events can be exported. Clipboard preparation is limited to 8 MiB. UTF-16/32 requires conversion of a copy to UTF-8.

Log content is processed locally without telemetry or uploads. Paid release activation and license checks use the JetBrains platform.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0

  • Large-file log viewer with typed field filters, decoded exceptions and request/trace navigation.
  • Support for Serilog, CLEF, JSON Lines, Logback, logfmt, syslog, Docker and plain text logs.
  • Background indexing, file following and original-event export.
  • Source navigation and stable session restoration.

idea-plugin.name: Env Switcher
idea-plugin.description:
Env Switcher — free, non-commercial open source plugin.

Switch named environment profiles inside the IDE with one click.

  • Edit profiles and variables in Settings → Tools → Env Switcher
  • Copy profiles or import existing .env files into the settings editor
  • Load profiles from env-profiles.json in the project root
  • Write the active profile into a generated .env file
  • Inject the active profile into Java and local Python Run Configurations at runtime (Python Community is optional)
  • Show the current profile on the status bar
