idea-plugin.name: InputSpark
idea-plugin.description:
InputSpark is an intelligent input method switcher plugin designed for IntelliJ IDEA. It automatically switches between English and Chinese input methods based on the cursor context, such as code, comments, and Git commit messages, helping developers maintain focus while coding.

专为中文母语开发者设计，解决在编码过程中频繁切换输入法的问题。

核心特性：
- 代码区域：自动切换为英文输入，专注于代码编写
- 注释区域：进入 // 或 /* */ 注释时，自动切换为中文输入
- Git 提交信息：在编写 Git Commit Message 时自动切换为中文
- 字符串字面量：可配置是否在字符串中自动切换，默认关闭
- 工具窗口：对终端、项目视图等非代码编辑区域优先避免误切换到中文
- 应用窗口监听：离开 IDE 时自动切换至中文，返回时按当前编辑器上下文恢复输入法
- 无感切换：使用底层 Windows API (IMM32) 检测输入法状态，并在目标状态不一致时模拟配置热键切换
- 防抖动设计：100ms 智能防抖，减少 50% 无效切换操作
- 热键可配置：支持按系统实际设置自定义中英文切换按键，兼容单键、组合键与常用快捷配置按钮
- 可视化反馈：切换成功时提供轻量的气泡提示，切换失败时提供配置引导提醒

Version 1.5.1 更新：
- 🛠 修复 ALT+TAB 切换窗口时误触发中英文切换热键的问题
- 🔔 修复 IDEA 窗口重新激活时错误弹出“切换到英文失败”提示的问题
- ⚙ 优化窗口激活后的输入法恢复策略，按真实编辑器上下文恢复中英文状态

注意：当前版本主要针对 Windows 10/11 系统的微软拼音输入法进行了深度优化。

InputSpark 是一个开源插件，采用 MIT 许可证。

idea-plugin.name: Copy Claude Reference
idea-plugin.description:
Copy Claude Reference

Copy file references in Claude Code format (@file#Lstart-end) directly from your editor to clipboard — paste them straight into Claude Code conversations for precise code context.

Why use this plugin?

When working with Claude Code, referencing specific lines of code requires the @file#Lstart-end format. Without this plugin, you have to manually type relative file paths and line numbers every time — tedious and error-prone. Copy Claude Reference automates this with a single shortcut.

Features

  • Single line reference — Place your caret on any line → copies @path/to/File.kt#L42
  • Multi-line reference — Select a range of code → copies @path/to/File.kt#L10-25
  • Project-relative paths — Automatically resolves paths relative to your project root
  • Editor context menu — Right-click → "Copy Claude Reference"
  • Keyboard shortcut — Alt+C (customizable in Settings → Keymap)

How to use

  1. Open any file in your project
  2. Place your caret on a line, or select a range of lines
  3. Press Alt+C or right-click → Copy Claude Reference
  4. Paste the reference into your Claude Code conversation

Examples

ActionClipboard result
Caret on line 42 of src/main/App.kt@src/main/App.kt#L42
Select lines 10-25 of src/main/App.kt@src/main/App.kt#L10-25

Compatibility

Works with all JetBrains IDEs: IntelliJ IDEA, Android Studio, WebStorm, PyCharm, GoLand, Rider, CLion, RubyMine, and more.

Requires IDE version 2024.1 or later.

한국어

에디터에서 Claude Code 형식(@file#Lstart-end)의 파일 참조를 클립보드에 복사합니다. Claude Code 대화에 바로 붙여넣어 정확한 코드 컨텍스트를 전달하세요.

왜 이 플러그인을 사용하나요?

Claude Code에서 특정 코드를 참조하려면 @file#Lstart-end 형식이 필요합니다. 이 플러그인 없이는 매번 상대 경로와 라인 번호를 직접 입력해야 합니다 — 번거롭고 실수하기 쉽습니다. Copy Claude Reference는 단축키 하나로 이 과정을 자동화합니다.

기능

  • 단일 라인 참조 — 커서를 아무 줄에 놓으면 → @path/to/File.kt#L42 복사
  • 다중 라인 참조 — 코드 범위를 선택하면 → @path/to/File.kt#L10-25 복사
  • 프로젝트 상대 경로 — 프로젝트 루트 기준의 상대 경로를 자동으로 생성
  • 우클릭 메뉴 — 에디터 컨텍스트 메뉴에서 "Copy Claude Reference" 선택
  • 키보드 단축키 — Alt+C (Settings → Keymap에서 변경 가능)

사용 방법

  1. 프로젝트의 아무 파일을 엽니다
  2. 커서를 원하는 줄에 놓거나, 코드 범위를 선택합니다
  3. Alt+C 또는 우클릭 → Copy Claude Reference
  4. Claude Code 대화에 붙여넣기 합니다

예시

동작클립보드 결과
src/main/App.kt의 42번 줄에 커서@src/main/App.kt#L42
src/main/App.kt의 10-25번 줄 선택@src/main/App.kt#L10-25

호환성

모든 JetBrains IDE에서 사용 가능: IntelliJ IDEA, Android Studio, WebStorm, PyCharm, GoLand, Rider, CLion, RubyMine 등

IDE 버전 2024.1 이상 필요

idea-plugin.name: Better-Changelist
idea-plugin.description:
Better-Changelist is a time-saving version control plugin designed to automatically sort your messy Git changes into neatly organized, logical changelists. It is especially powerful for Unity developers who struggle with massive commits containing a mix of code, assets, and meta files.

Key Features:

  • Intelligent Auto-Sorting: Automatically categorizes your modified files into designated changelists based on file extensions (e.g., Materials, Scripts, Prefabs, Scenes, Assembly).
  • Smart Meta File Grouping: Keeps your .meta files tethered to their parent assets. If you modify Player.prefab and Player.prefab.meta, they are grouped together automatically.
  • ScriptableObject Detection: Deep-scans .asset files to detect if they are ScriptableObjects (by checking for MonoBehaviour:) and isolates them into their own changelist for safer reviews.
  • Fully Customizable: Don't like the default categories? Use the built-in settings panel to add, remove, or modify sorting rules and extensions to fit your exact workflow.
  • Catch-All: Any files that don't match your rules are safely placed in an "Other Changes" changelist, ensuring nothing slips through the cracks.

How to use: Simply open your Commit tool window and press Alt + S (or find "Sort Changelists" in the VCS actions menu) to instantly organize your working tree.

idea-plugin.name: Method Timer
idea-plugin.description:
Method Timer — Automatic Method Execution Time Profiling

Automatically measures Java method execution time and displays results as Code Vision lenses above method declarations in the editor.

Features

  • Zero configuration — no annotations or code changes required
  • User code only — libraries and frameworks are never instrumented
  • Real-time updates — timings refresh every 3 seconds while the app is running
  • Console and server apps — works with short scripts and Spring Boot alike
  • Persistent data — results are saved between IDE restarts
  • Clickable lenses — click on timing to see method details

How it works

When you run a Java application from the IDE, the plugin automatically attaches a Java Agent that instruments your methods with timing hooks. Results are displayed as Code Vision lenses (like "N usages") above each method.

Limitations

  • Works with direct Java/JUnit runs only (not Gradle-delegated)
  • Java methods only (not Kotlin)

idea-plugin.name: Color Manipulation
idea-plugin.description:
A powerful color toolkit for developers. Select any color in your code, right-click, and convert, adjust, mix, or analyze it — all without leaving the editor.

Convert Format

Convert between 30+ color formats across all major platforms:

  • Web/CSS: #RGB, #RRGGBB, #RRGGBBAA, #AARRGGBB, rgb(), rgba(), hsl(), hsla(), hwb(), Named CSS Colors
  • Android/Kotlin: 0xRRGGBB, Color(0xAARRGGBB), Color.rgb(), Color.argb()
  • iOS/Swift: UIColor(red:green:blue:alpha:), Color(red:green:blue:)
  • Java: new Color(r, g, b), new Color(r, g, b, a)
  • Generic: Float RGB/RGBA (0.0-1.0), with and without parentheses
  • Toggle: Toggle # prefix, Toggle 0x prefix, Swap RRGGBBAA/AARRGGBB byte order

Convert from Name

Convert named colors from popular design systems to hex values:

  • CSS Named Colors (red, cornflowerblue, ...)
  • Tailwind CSS (gray-800, blue-500, ...)
  • Bootstrap (primary, danger, blue-400, ...)
  • Material Design (Blue 500, Red 300, ...)
  • iOS System Colors (systemBlue, systemRed, ...)

Adjustments

  • Lighten/Darken by preset (5%, 10%, 20%) or custom percentage
  • Saturate/Desaturate with presets, grayscale, or custom
  • Adjust Alpha: 100%, 75%, 50%, 25%, 0%, or custom
  • Hue Rotate: +30, +60, +90, +180 degrees, invert, or custom
  • Temperature: Warmer/Cooler with presets or custom

Mixing & Palette

  • Color Mixing: Tint (mix with white), Shade (mix with black), custom percentages
  • Palette Generate: Complementary, Analogous, Triadic, Shades (100-900)

Accessibility

  • WCAG Contrast Check: Shows contrast ratio against white/black with AA/AAA pass/fail
  • Auto-fix: Make AA or AAA compliant on white or black backgrounds

Color Blindness Simulation

  • Protanopia (red-blind), Deuteranopia (green-blind), Tritanopia (blue-blind)

Closest Match

Find the closest color in popular design systems and convert to name or value:

  • Named CSS, Tailwind, Bootstrap, Material Design, iOS System Colors

Practical Utils

  • Random Color
  • Sort Lines by Hue, Lightness, or Saturation (reorders full lines by their color)
  • Sort Colors by Hue, Lightness, or Saturation (swaps color values in place)
  • Normalize to Same Format: Convert all selected colors to match the first one's format

Show Color Info

Popup showing all format conversions, HSL values, alpha, and closest matches across all design systems.

Replace with Color

Replace one or many colors with a custom color value. Type any color format (hex, rgb, hsl, named CSS, etc.) in the dialog and all selected occurrences are updated, each keeping its original format. Available in both the editor menu and the palette context menu.

Project Color Palette

A dedicated side panel (Tool Window) that scans your entire project and gives you a bird's-eye view of every color in your codebase.

  • Full project scan: Finds all color occurrences across 40+ file types (CSS, HTML, JS, TS, Kotlin, Swift, Java, Python, Go, Rust, and more)
  • Tree view organized by frequency or hue, with color swatches and occurrence counts
  • Similar colors detection: Groups visually similar colors that could be unified into one
  • Format inconsistencies: Highlights the same color written in different formats across files
  • WCAG contrast badges: Inline AA/AAA/Fail indicators on every color node
  • Rich tooltips on hover: Full color details with all format conversions and WCAG contrast ratios
  • Color Info popup: All formats, HSL, alpha, WCAG contrast with colored pass/fail badges, suggested AA fix with visual swatch preview, and closest matches in CSS, Tailwind, Bootstrap, Material, and iOS
  • Click-to-navigate: Click any occurrence to jump to the exact line and column in the editor
  • Right-click context menu: Apply the same transforms as the editor menu (convert format, lighten/darken, saturate, hue rotate, mix, accessibility fixes, color blindness simulation) on single colors, multiple selections, or entire groups
  • Inspect in Color Palette: Right-click any color in the editor to open the palette filtered to that color — see all occurrences, similar-color clusters, and format inconsistencies for it (matched by RGB, format-agnostic)
  • Replace with Color: Batch-replace selected colors or groups with a custom color value
  • Display format selector: View colors in #RRGGBB, rgb(), hsl(), 0x, Color(), or UIColor()
  • File filter: Narrow the scan to specific file patterns (e.g. *.tsx, *.css)
  • State preservation: Expanded nodes, selection, and scroll position are preserved across re-scans

Open it from: View > Tool Windows > Color Palette, or from the right sidebar.

More Features

  • Repeat Last Action: Quickly re-apply any previous transform (including custom values)
  • Multi-cursor support: Apply transforms to all selected colors at once
  • Embedded color detection: Select a block of text and the plugin finds and transforms all colors inside
  • Live preview icons: See the resulting color in the menu before clicking
  • Keyboard shortcut: Ctrl+Alt+C (Cmd+Alt+C on Mac)

Works in all JetBrains IDEs (IntelliJ, WebStorm, Android Studio, PyCharm, etc.) with all file types.


If you find this plugin useful, consider sponsoring its development. Your support helps keep it free and actively maintained. Thank you!

idea-plugin.name: Breeze Dev Helper
idea-plugin.description:
Breeze Dev Helper is a developer productivity plugin with two independent feature sets: bidirectional navigation between source code and specification documents, and an MCP server that lets AI assistants control IntelliJ's debugger directly.

🤖 AI Debug Control (MCP Server)

Starts a local HTTP server (default port 19876) that exposes IntelliJ's debugger via the Model Context Protocol. An AI assistant (e.g. Claude) can set breakpoints, inspect variables, evaluate expressions, and step through code — without you touching the IDE manually.

Exposed MCP tools include:

  • create_remote_debug_config – create a Remote JVM Debug run configuration; automatically establishes an SSH tunnel through the jumper host
  • launch_debug / stop_debug – connect and disconnect the debugger
  • add_breakpoint / remove_breakpoint / list_breakpoints – manage breakpoints
  • get_debug_status – returns RUNNING or PAUSED at file:line
  • read_variables / get_stack_frames – inspect the current suspended frame
  • evaluate_expressions – batch-evaluate Java expressions
  • step_over / step_into / step_out / resume_debug – execution control
  • setup – one-stop initialization: auto-detects idea CLI and jumper SSH settings

Configure the MCP endpoint in your AI client: http://localhost:19876/mcp

📄 Jump to Document (Code Comment → Markdown)

Write @spec <path>.md in a Java, Kotlin, or Scala comment, then press Ctrl/Cmd+B or Ctrl/Cmd+Click on the path to jump directly to the corresponding Markdown document.

🔗 Jump to Code (Markdown → Source Code)

Place a spec-jump:// link in your Markdown file, then press Ctrl/Cmd+B, Ctrl/Cmd+Click, or click the link in the preview panel to navigate to the specified location in Java/Kotlin/Scala source code.

Supported link formats:

  • spec-jump://com.example.MyClass – jump to class
  • spec-jump://com.example.MyClass#myMethod – jump to method or field
  • spec-jump://com.example.MyClass:42 – jump to line number
  • spec-jump://com.example.MyClass#myMethod:42 – method + line offset

⚙️ Settings

All options are under Settings → Tools → Breeze Dev Helper:

  • MCP Server – enable/disable, listening port
  • Jumper SSH Tunnel – MIS ID, jumper host, proxy script path, SSH key paths
  • Comment Keyword – default @spec
  • Link Protocol Prefix – default spec-jump://
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• Initial JetBrains Marketplace release.
  • Support jumping from @spec comments to Markdown documents.
  • Support jumping from spec-jump:// links in Markdown back to source code.
  • Allow customizing the comment keyword and URI protocol prefix in settings.

idea-plugin.name: FileRush - Blazing Fast File Creation
idea-plugin.description:
Keyboard-first file creation and navigation. Fuzzy-find paths, autocomplete, and create files — no mouse needed.

Open with Ctrl+Alt+Shift+N. Navigate with Ctrl+N / Ctrl+P (or ↓ / ↑). Autocomplete path with Tab. Create and open with Enter.

Use Cases

  • Create a file in the current folder
    Open FileRush → press Tab to select the current folder → type the filename → Enter.
  • Create a file in another folder
    Type part of the folder name (fuzzy search finds it) → press Tab → type the filename → Enter.
  • Create a folder
    Same as above, but don't type a file extension. FileRush creates a directory instead.
  • Create a file beside an existing file
    Type part of an existing filename (e.g. UserRepo to find UserRepository.kt) → press Tab → the extension is pre-filled, just type your new name (e.g. CachedUserRepository) → Enter.

Customizing the Shortcut

  • Go to Settings → Keymap, search for FileRush, and assign any shortcut you want.
  • With IdeaVim, use the FileRush.Open action:
    nnoremap <leader>fc :action FileRush.Open<CR>

idea-plugin.name: BookmarkAI
idea-plugin.description:
BookmarkAI

English

BookmarkAI is a code bookmark and project knowledge tool built for the AI-assisted coding era.

It helps developers and AI build project context together: developers can manually mark important code locations, organize groups, and write notes; AI can generate bookmark candidates through BookmarkAI Skills, pointing out code it analyzed, changed, or recommends reviewing.

AI-generated candidates are staged first and reviewed by humans before becoming official bookmarks. BookmarkAI makes key logic, change traces, and project knowledge visible, navigable, and maintainable.

Core Capabilities

  • Shared project context for humans and AI: manual bookmarks and AI-generated candidates become lasting project knowledge together.
  • AI bookmark candidates: AI uses BookmarkAI Skills to generate structured candidates for entry points, changed areas, risks, and review targets.
  • Automatic AI batch intake: validated Skill output appears in Staged Bookmarks automatically when the IDE sees a completed import batch.
  • Review before merge: AI candidates do not directly change official data. Review, edit, delete, or confirm them in Staged Bookmarks.
  • Better bookmark management for complex projects: organize by feature, module, task, bug, or review topic, with sorting, location review, and direct navigation back to the corresponding code.
  • Key Notes for project knowledge: use Markdown to record domain concepts, module notes, design decisions, and debugging experience.

Use Cases

Daily Coding and Source Reading

  • Organize complex projects by topic
    While reading code or developing features, add entry functions, core logic, debugging locations, and review points as bookmarks, then organize them by feature, module, task, bug, or review topic. Later, jump directly back to the corresponding code from the BookmarkAI panel.
    Editor Right Click -> Add Bookmark -> Select Group
  • Capture project knowledge and experience
    Use Key Notes to record domain terms, module explanations, design decisions, debugging experience, and review conclusions.

The fastest workflow is to open the BookmarkAI Notes panel, turn on Follow Code Selection, and keep the note detail area in reading mode. Select a term or code fragment in the editor: if a matching note already exists, the panel opens it automatically; if not, the panel shows that selection so you can click Edit to create and fill in the note under the active note group.

You can also create notes manually from New Note in the Notes panel, or select text in the editor and use Editor Right Click -> Add Note.

Deep Integration with Claude Code, Codex, and Other AI Coding Assistants

  • Use AI to generate project-wide labels
    Useful when joining a new project, understanding the architecture, or rebuilding project context. Ask AI to use BookmarkAI Skill bookmarkai-full to scan the project and generate global bookmark candidates for entry points, modules, and core flows.
    Claude Code / Codex -> BookmarkAI Skill: bookmarkai-full -> Auto Staged Bookmarks -> Review -> Merge -> Confirm
  • Use AI to generate bookmarks for a feature or workflow
    Useful when you want to understand a feature path, business workflow, or key call chain. Ask AI to use BookmarkAI Skill bookmarkai-workflow to focus on that flow and generate related bookmark candidates.
    Claude Code / Codex -> BookmarkAI Skill: bookmarkai-workflow -> Auto Staged Bookmarks -> Review -> Merge -> Confirm
  • Use AI to generate review bookmarks for current code changes
    Useful after AI or a developer finishes a round of changes. Ask AI to use BookmarkAI Skill bookmarkai-changes to analyze current changes and mark modified areas, risk points, and recommended review locations.
    Claude Code / Codex -> BookmarkAI Skill: bookmarkai-changes -> Auto Staged Bookmarks -> Review -> Merge -> Confirm

BookmarkAI is not just a bookmark tool. It is a shared project context system maintained by humans and AI together.

Support

  • GitHub Issues: https://github.com/LyOuYang/bookmarkai-plugin/issues
  • Email: bookmarkai@outlook.com
  • QQ Group: 613256990

中文

BookmarkAI 是一款面向 AI 编程时代的代码书签与项目知识管理工具。

它帮助开发者和 AI 共同建设项目上下文：开发者可以手动标记关键代码、整理分组、记录笔记；AI 可以通过 BookmarkAI Skill 生成书签候选，标出它分析过、修改过或建议 Review 的位置。

所有 AI 候选都会先进入暂存区，经过人工审查后再合并为正式书签。BookmarkAI 让项目中的关键逻辑、修改线索和知识说明变得可见、可导航、可持续维护。

核心能力

  • 人和 AI 共建项目上下文：手动书签与 AI 生成候选可以一起沉淀为项目长期知识。
  • AI 书签候选：AI 通过 BookmarkAI Skill 生成结构化候选，记录入口、修改点、风险点和 Review 点。
  • AI Batch 自动进入暂存区：Skill 生成并验证完成的候选文件会被 IDE 自动导入到 Staged Bookmarks。
  • 先审查，再合并：AI 候选不会直接进入正式数据，可在 Staged Bookmarks 中查看、修改、删除或确认。
  • 更适合复杂项目的书签管理：按功能、模块、任务、Bug 或 Review 主题分组，支持排序、位置复核，并可从书签直接跳转到对应代码。
  • Key Notes 项目知识库：用 Markdown 记录业务概念、模块说明、设计约定和排查经验。

使用场景

日常高效编码与源码阅读

  • 按主题梳理复杂项目
    阅读代码或开发功能时，把入口函数、核心逻辑、排查位置、Review 重点加入书签，并按功能、模块、任务、Bug 或 Review 主题分组管理；之后可从 BookmarkAI 面板直接跳转回对应代码。
    Editor Right Click -> Add Bookmark -> Select Group
  • 沉淀项目知识和经验
    用 Key Notes 记录业务术语、模块说明、设计约定、排查经验和 Review 结论。

最快捷的方式是打开 BookmarkAI 的 Notes 面板，并开启 Follow Code Selection，同时保持笔记详情区处于阅读状态。然后在代码编辑器中选中一个术语或代码片段：如果已有同名 Note，面板会自动切到对应笔记；如果还没有，面板会显示这个选词，点击 Edit 就可以在当前 Note 分组下创建并补充内容。

需要手动创建时，也可以在 Notes 面板点击 New Note，或在编辑器中选中文本后右键选择 Add Note。

与 Claude Code / Codex 等 AI Coding 深度联动

  • 使用 AI 为整个项目生成标签
    适合新接手项目、梳理架构或重建项目上下文。让 AI 使用 BookmarkAI Skill bookmarkai-full 扫描项目，生成入口、模块、核心流程等全局书签候选。
    Claude Code / Codex -> BookmarkAI Skill: bookmarkai-full -> Auto Staged Bookmarks -> Review -> Merge -> Confirm
  • 使用 AI 为指定功能或业务流程生成书签
    适合理解某个功能链路、业务流程或关键调用路径。让 AI 使用 BookmarkAI Skill bookmarkai-workflow 聚焦分析，并生成该流程相关的书签候选。
    Claude Code / Codex -> BookmarkAI Skill: bookmarkai-workflow -> Auto Staged Bookmarks -> Review -> Merge -> Confirm
  • 使用 AI 为本次代码改动生成 Review 书签
    适合在 AI 或开发者完成一轮修改后进行复查。让 AI 使用 BookmarkAI Skill bookmarkai-changes 分析当前变更，标记修改点、风险点和建议复核的位置。
    Claude Code / Codex -> BookmarkAI Skill: bookmarkai-changes -> Auto Staged Bookmarks -> Review -> Merge -> Confirm

BookmarkAI 不只是书签工具。它是人和 AI 共同维护的项目上下文系统。

支持与反馈

  • GitHub Issues: https://github.com/LyOuYang/bookmarkai-plugin/issues
  • 邮箱: bookmarkai@outlook.com
  • QQ 群: 613256990

Features

Free and open source. This is an unofficial community plugin and is not endorsed by or affiliated with Excalidraw.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.2.12 - 2026-09-19

  • Open, edit, and save .excalidraw.svg and .excalidraw.png files, including drawings created in VS Code.
  • Automatically save SVG and PNG edits, keeping the rendered image and embedded scene data together in one file ready to include in Markdown.

💬 Feedback & Support

idea-plugin.change-notes:
Added
  • Keyboard shortcut `Ctrl+Shift+Alt+O` — trigger Order Tabs without touching the mouse.
  • Enable / disable groups — each group in the settings table now has a checkbox; unchecked groups are completely skipped during sorting and matching without being deleted.

idea-plugin.name: DBF Reader
idea-plugin.description:
View and edit dBASE/xBase .dbf files as a table inside the IDE — instead of raw binary.
  • Table editor — records as rows, fields as columns, with a row-number gutter and a status bar (record count, DBF format variant, active encoding).
  • Cell editing for the C, N, F, L and D field types with type-aware editors: a checkbox for logical columns, a calendar picker for dates. Memo and extended types are shown read-only.
  • Find in table (the IDE Find shortcut) — highlights all matches with an "N of M" counter; Match Case, Whole Words, Regex and an optional row filter.
  • Go to Column (the File Structure shortcut) — a speed-search popup to jump to a field.
  • Copy as TSV — copies the selected cells to the clipboard as displayed.
  • Row and column operations — add/delete records; add, delete or edit a column's name, data type and size, with best-effort conversion of existing values.
  • Encoding handling — auto-detected from the DBF language-driver byte, with a manual override combo box and a configurable default (Settings | Tools | DBF Reader).
  • Safe saving — detects external changes on disk and offers to overwrite or reload; optional one-time .bak backup before the first overwrite.
Licensed under the MIT License. Bundles third-party libraries under their own licenses; the full license texts and attribution ship in the plugin distribution.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Added

  • Damaged and truncated files now open cleanly — a .dbf whose data is followed by trailing junk, or whose last record is cut short (a truncated file), previously showed phantom rows parsed from the leftover bytes, including junk hiding in the slots of deleted records. Such a file now opens with only the records that could actually be read; the status bar flags the malformed tail and how many header-declared records could not be read, and Save warns that this unreadable trailing data will be discarded and rewrites the file with a well-formed end.
  • Columns with a defective definition are now handled instead of silently corrupted on save — a column whose stored definition is invalid (an empty field name, a length outside the type's writable range, or a garbage decimal count) is detected on open and shown read-only. As with memo and other unsupported columns, Save stays disabled while any such column is present, and the close prompt now explains the changes cannot be saved yet; fixing the name, type or size in the Edit Column dialog makes the file saveable again.
  • Text (CHARACTER) columns up to 255 bytes long now open and save — previously the writable limit was 254, so a file using the full one-byte field length was read-only.

Changed

  • A column whose field name cannot be encoded in the file's current encoding, or is longer than 10 bytes once encoded, is now treated as read-only (and disables Save) instead of being written with ? substituted for the unencodable characters or truncated. Changing the encoding re-evaluates this.

Fixed

  • Keyboard focus now lands on the table when a file finishes loading and when you switch back to an already-open .dbf tab, so the keyboard works immediately without clicking the table first.
  • The toolbar no longer briefly freezes while a large file is loading.

idea-plugin.name: Markdown Image Paster
idea-plugin.description:
Paste images into Markdown files — auto-saved to the correct directory based on front matter rules.


Why this plugin?

Jekyll / Hexo and other static blog frameworks require strict path correspondence between posts and images. IntelliJ's built-in Markdown plugin doesn't support dynamic image paths based on the document filename. This plugin fills that gap.


Features

  • Intercept image paste only in Markdown files with front matter; other files keep the IDE default paste behavior.
  • Front matter aware: typora-root-url is treated as a Typora resource root and expands to .../img/<basename>/; media_subpath is treated as the target image directory. Other front matter is ignored.
  • Path rules: absolute front matter paths are project-relative; relative paths are resolved from the current Markdown file directory and cannot escape the project.
  • No prompt: images are named from the clipboard source filename when available, otherwise image, plus a yyyyMMddHHmmss timestamp.
  • Markdown links use project-root absolute paths and URL-encoded path segments.
  • Stable output: clipboard images are written as PNG.

在 Markdown 文件中粘贴图片时，根据 front matter 规则自动保存到正确目录。


背景

Jekyll / Hexo 等静态博客的文章文件和图片目录有严格的路径对应关系。 IntelliJ 内置 Markdown 插件不支持根据文件名动态决定图片路径，此插件弥补了这一能力。


功能

  • 仅拦截带 front matter 的 Markdown 图片粘贴，其它情况保留 IDE 默认粘贴行为。
  • 识别 front matter：typora-root-url 按 Typora 资源根语义展开为 .../img/<basename>/；media_subpath 按目标图片目录处理；其它 front matter 不接管。
  • 路径规则：front matter 绝对路径从 project 根目录解析，相对路径从当前 Markdown 文件目录解析，且不能逃逸出 project。
  • 无需弹窗：图片文件名优先使用剪贴板原文件名，拿不到时使用 image，并追加 yyyyMMddHHmmss 时间戳。
  • Markdown 引用使用 project 根目录绝对路径，并对路径片段做 URL encode。
  • 稳定输出：剪贴板图片统一写为 PNG。

idea-plugin.name: Hex Support
idea-plugin.description:
Open, edit, compare, and inspect files as hexadecimal data inside IntelliJ IDEA.

Provides an editable hex byte table, an extensible Binary Structure host for optional format-provider plugins, and side-by-side and unified Hex viewers for the IDE Diff window.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• 3.0.1: Replace hard-coded Structure provider plugin IDs with shared Marketplace keyword discovery, including Kaitai Struct Support, and document the public discovery convention for third-party providers.
  • 3.0.0: Replace the built-in .bt interpreter with a public, dynamic Binary Structure Provider extension point; keep all Hex editing and Diff features fully standalone; add localized provider discovery, installation guidance, generic template import, multi-provider selection, and provider-neutral structure results; fix custom-editor Undo scoping; add two-target history restoration, arbitrary-name history import, and Save As-style manual history export while keeping standard-name sidecars for automatic export/import; and retain in-memory Undo/Redo history across saves and open-editor switches.
  • 2.4.0: Add sandboxed read-only analysis with user-supplied .bt templates, localized Structure and History tool-window titles, automatic refresh after Hex edits, a focused Import/Clear/Expand/Collapse toolbar, supported background highlights, and bidirectional byte-range navigation.
  • 2.3.1: Restore IntelliJ IDEA 2025.1+ compatibility with stable platform APIs, and synchronize unchanged selections from both unified viewers to both old/new sides across all four Diff modes.
  • 2.3.0: Synchronize all selection ranges bidirectionally between Hex and text editors, including Text Editor and Markdown Split Editor multi-caret selections and mixed line separators; share one multi-range selection state across all four Diff viewers (Side-by-side, Unified Viewer, Hex-by-Hex, and Unified Hex), so switching from any viewer to any other preserves the old/new side and exact byte offsets.
  • 2.2.0: Add an assignable Hexadecimal file type under Settings | Editor | File Types, allowing filename patterns to make Hex the exclusive default editor while keeping Hex available as an alternate editor for other supported local files.
  • 2.1.0: Add selectable side-by-side and unified Hex Diff viewers with byte-level alignment, synchronized scrolling, difference highlighting/navigation, configurable bytes per row, native IDEA colors and fonts, and Jump to Source support that follows the exact active byte and source side, including insert/delete gap fallback and selection restoration.
  • 2.0.1: Fix the Find/Replace ASCII string field converting non-Latin-1 characters (e.g. CJK) to 0x3F by using the file's detected charset instead of ISO-8859-1, so multi-byte text searches match the file's actual bytes.
  • 2.0.0: Rework the editor around HexDocument with in-memory and piece-based large-file editing, 64-bit offsets with paged reads, streaming save/import/export, IntelliJ UndoManager integration with a Hex History tool window, and debounced background search — enabling very large files to be opened, searched, edited, saved, imported, and exported.
  • 1.0.1: Fix plugin configuration defect reported by the Plugin Verifier (remove until-build; set since-build to 251).
  • 1.0.0: Initial release.

Render Mermaid and Structurizr diagrams from your README

  • Live preview — updates as you type (debounced) and when you switch editors
  • Theme-aware — dark/light rendering follows the IDE theme
  • Works in any Markdown file (.md, .markdown), not just README

Usage

  1. Open a Markdown file containing ```mermaid or ```structurizr blocks
  2. Open the README Diagrams tool window (right sidebar), or right-click the editor → Preview README Diagrams

Requirements

  • Any IntelliJ-based IDE 2023.2+ running on the JetBrains Runtime (JCEF)

Support

  • Contact: support@jakubjirak.com

idea-plugin.name: WAAAGH
idea-plugin.description:
WAAAGH — Feign / Controller navigation for Spring Cloud projects.



WAAAGH is an IntelliJ IDEA plugin collection; popular tools may later be split into
standalone plugins. This tool connects Spring Cloud @FeignClient interfaces
with the @RestController / @Controller endpoints they map to,
right inside the editor.



Features

  • Bidirectional navigation — matching methods show a gutter icon; click it to jump between a Feign method and its Controller endpoint.
  • Go to Declaration / Implementation — Ctrl+B / Ctrl+Click and Ctrl+Alt+B work between Feign clients and Controllers.
  • Call Hierarchy — on a Feign method, Callees list the Controller methods it maps to; on a Controller method, Callers list the Feign methods that reach it.
  • Copy URL — click the clipboard gutter icon to copy the complete request URL (context path + servlet path + package prefix + class path + method path).
  • Accurate matching — matched by full path + HTTP method; understands endpoints inherited from base API interfaces, duplicate mappings, many-to-many relations, and paths written as constants.
How to use
  1. Open a project with Spring Cloud OpenFeign clients and Spring MVC Controllers.
  2. Open a @FeignClient interface or a Controller class — matching methods get a gutter icon; click it to jump to the other side.
  3. Or put the caret on a method and press Ctrl+B (Go to Declaration) or Ctrl+Alt+B (Go to Implementation).
  4. Or press Ctrl+Alt+H (Call Hierarchy) to explore the mapping in both directions.
  5. Editor-tab icons for Feign / Controller classes can be toggled in Settings → search "WAAAGH".


中文

WAAAGH —— Spring Cloud 项目的 Feign ↔ Controller 跳转工具。

WAAAGH 是一个 IntelliJ IDEA 插件集合，受欢迎的工具未来可能会拆分成独立插件。 当前工具把 Spring Cloud 的 @FeignClient 接口与它们映射到的 @RestController / @Controller 端点连起来，直接在编辑器里跳转。

功能
  • 双向跳转 —— 匹配的方法旁会出现侧边栏图标，点击即在 Feign 方法与 Controller 端点之间跳转。
  • Go to Declaration / Implementation —— 在 Feign 与 Controller 之间使用 Ctrl+B / Ctrl+单击、Ctrl+Alt+B。
  • Call Hierarchy —— 在 Feign 方法上看 Callees，列出它映射到的 Controller 方法； 在 Controller 方法上看 Callers，列出会调用到它的 Feign 方法。
  • 复制 URL —— 点击侧边栏的剪贴板图标，复制完整请求 URL （上下文路径 + servlet 路径 + 包前缀 + 类路径 + 方法路径）。
  • 精确匹配 —— 按「完整路径 + HTTP 方法」匹配；支持从基础 API 接口继承的端点、 重复映射、多对多关系，以及写在常量里的路径。
怎么用
  1. 打开包含 Spring Cloud OpenFeign 客户端与 Spring MVC Controller 的项目。
  2. 打开 @FeignClient 接口或 Controller 类 —— 匹配的方法旁会出现侧边栏图标，点击即跳到对端。
  3. 或者把光标放在方法上，按 Ctrl+B（Go to Declaration）/ Ctrl+Alt+B（Go to Implementation）。
  4. 或者按 Ctrl+Alt+H（Call Hierarchy），双向查看映射关系。
  5. Feign / Controller 类的编辑器标签图标可在 Settings → 搜索 "WAAAGH" 中开关。

GitHub
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.1.0
  • HTTP method matching: endpoints now match on full path and HTTP method. A mapping without an explicit method matches any method; multi-value method attributes are compared as a set intersection.
  • Package-based path prefixes: prefixes registered via PathMatchConfigurer#addPathPrefix (package / annotation lambdas, HandlerTypePredicate and their combinations) are applied to matching and to copied URLs.
  • Smarter path resolution: annotation paths built from constants, static fields, local variables and @Value("${...}") are resolved, together with server.servlet.context-path and spring.mvc.servlet.path.
  • IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2 support: built and tested against IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2.3; Call Hierarchy keeps working on both older and newer IDEs.
  • More reliable Feign / Controller discovery through annotation indexing.
  • Automatic cache refresh: after files are saved or changed by an external editor (and synchronized by the IDE), mappings are rescanned automatically — no need to close and reopen the project.
1.0.1
  • Feign inheritance: endpoints declared on a base API interface (extended by an empty @FeignClient sub-interface) are now navigable and appear in Call Hierarchy.
  • Call Hierarchy: Controller methods now list matching Feign clients as callers.
1.0.0
  • Initial release: Feign ↔ Controller Go to Implementation / Go to Declaration and Call Hierarchy.

idea-plugin.name: Caret Fill Sequentially
idea-plugin.description:
Caret Fill Sequentially

Fill multiple carets with consecutive numbers or letters in IntelliJ IDEA. Perfect for batch numbering, quick sequence generation and column-based editing.

在多个光标处依次填充连续的数字或字母，用于批量编号、批量生成序列，配合列选择模式使用效率极高。

Usage / 用法

  1. Create multiple carets in the editor: column selection (Alt+Shift+drag), or hold Alt and click on multiple lines.
  2. Right-click → Fill Carets Sequentially (or shortcut Ctrl+Alt+Shift+F7).
  3. Choose fill type (Number / Lowercase letters / Uppercase letters), start value, step and zero padding, then click Fill.

Examples / 示例

Select 3 lines → Number mode fills 1, 2, 3; Letter mode fills a, b, c or A, B, C.

Supports Excel-style column names: more than 26 carets continue with aa, ab or AA, AB.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
v1.0.0

  • 首个版本：多光标连续填充插件
  • 支持三种填充模式：数字（可补零）、小写字母、大写字母
  • 可配置起始值、步长、数字补零位数，带实时预览

idea-plugin.name: Spring Helm Env Hints
idea-plugin.description:
Links Spring application*.yml|yaml configuration to the environment variables declared in Helm chart templates, with highlighting and two-way navigation. Env var occurrences are coloured differently depending on whether they exist on both sides (matched) or only one (unmatched), and an inline N refs tag is shown next to every env var that resolves to at least one occurrence on the opposite side — hover for the target file:line list, click to navigate.

Go to Declaration (Ctrl/Cmd+B) jumps Spring → Helm and Helm → Spring. Because Spring and Helm occurrences are registered as real PSI references, Ctrl+Click navigation and Refactor → Rename work across files as well.

Placeholders that reference a property of the same application*.yaml (url: ${app.host}:${app.port}) — or that the IDE itself already resolves — count as valid references: they are highlighted as matched instead of missing and navigate to the declaring key. Targets the IDE resolves on its own are merged in, so a key declared in several profile files (application-local.yml, …) offers every declaration.

Settings live under Settings → Other Settings → Spring Helm Env Hints: toggle Spring property key matching, switch to a project-wide scope, include folders excluded in the project structure, show or hide the N refs tag (including hiding it for a single reference), choose between background highlight and font colour with separate light/dark theme colours, and open a debug view that dumps the live index per scope as matched / Helm-only / Spring-only.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Changed

  • A ${...} placeholder that only points at its own line is no longer treated as resolved: such a circular reference (url: ${url}) is highlighted as missing again, and the N refs tag no longer counts it.

idea-plugin.name: Apple Container Manager

A native IntelliJ IDEA experience for managing Apple's container runtime not a generic Docker UI. Manage containers, images, volumes, networks, and the container system daemon from a dedicated tool window, launch containers with first-class Run Configurations, stream logs and exec sessions into the Run tool window, and jump to anything from Search Everywhere.

  • Containers: run, start, stop, kill, delete, logs, exec, inspect, live stats
  • Images: pull, push, build (with Dockerfile gutter integration), tag, delete, prune
  • Volumes & Networks: create, inspect, delete, prune

  • Run Configurations for launching containers like any other IDE run target

  • Compose projects now use labels and configuration fingerprints to preserve unchanged running services and recreate changed services safely.

idea-plugin.name: Error Indicator
idea-plugin.description:
Error Indicator Meme for IntelliJ IDEA

A plugin for IntelliJ IDEA that displays a reaction image based on the problems detected in the editor. It uses cat memes as a visual indicator and is shown in a dockable IntelliJ tool window, without modifying or replacing the Project panel.

Features

  • Dedicated, dockable tool window in the bottom area of IntelliJ.
  • Visual state for a clean project.
  • Three severity levels for normal problems.
  • Three severity levels for critical problems.
  • Critical errors take priority over normal ones.
  • The image automatically returns to the clean state once all problems are resolved.
  • Images are bundled inside the plugin; no extra folder needs to be copied.
  • Compatible from IntelliJ IDEA build 253 when using the Java 21 version of the plugin.

Changed notes (v0.1.19)
v0.1.19 improvements

  • Multi-version support for IntelliJ IDEA from build 253 to 262.*.
  • Built with Java 21 bytecode.
  • Dedicated, dockable tool window for the indicator.
  • Correct priority of critical errors over normal errors.
  • Automatic image change when all problems are resolved.
  • Full source code included in the main branch.

idea-plugin.name: Inlay Hints Extension
idea-plugin.description: Displays line-oriented notes from mirrored IHM files as clickable end-of-line inlay hints in source editors.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
2.1.0

  • Resolve adjacent IHM files before searching inlay-hints directories from the source directory up to the project root.
  • Edit the highest-priority existing IHM file when inline editing is activated.
  • Create missing IHM files in the nearest existing inlay-hints directory, or in the project-root inlay-hints directory when none exists.

2.0.0

  • Map IHM files from the project root so root-level source files are supported.
  • Preserve the complete project-relative source path, including src when present.
  • Remove the incompatible 1.x mapping that treated the nearest src directory as the source root.

1.0.0

  • Use inlay-hints as the sidecar directory for IHM files.
  • Display mirrored IHM lines as clickable end-of-line inline inlays.
  • Keep sidecar line positions synchronized with editor and external source changes.
  • Restore deleted hints when source line deletions are undone or redone.
  • Optionally clear hints on modified source lines.
  • Show or hide hints from Settings | Tools | Inlay Hints Extension.
  • Open the matching IHM line with Ctrl-click while leaving ordinary clicks unchanged.
  • Edit a hint inline by typing a configurable activation keyword at the end of its source line.
  • Use a leading and trailing space around the default activation keyword: " ^^ ".
  • Save inline edits immediately on focus loss and restore the source caret after Enter.
  • Display Chinese text correctly while editing a new or existing hint inline.
  • Optionally delete an IHM file when inline editing removes its last non-empty hint.
  • Optionally remove empty IHM parent directories after automatic IHM file deletion.
  • Save IHM documents with the write access required by recent IntelliJ Platform versions.
  • Create a line-aligned IHM file automatically when inline editing is activated for a new source file.
  • Support source files from multiple language and source-set directories.
  • Use UTF-8 and the IDE inlay color scheme for hint text.
  • Build with the IntelliJ Platform Gradle Plugin 2.x for current IDE compatibility.

idea-plugin.name: Markdown Poster
idea-plugin.description:
Markdown Poster turns the Markdown you already have — AI assistant output (Copilot, Qoder, and other coding agents), READMEs, design docs, notes — into polished, share-ready long images or self-contained HTML, without leaving your IDE.

Why: Chat tools like WeChat, DingTalk and Slack cannot render Markdown. When you copy an AI answer or a doc and paste it into a chat, everyone sees raw asterisks and backticks — and asking the reader to install a Markdown viewer is never an option. Markdown Poster renders it once, in the IDE, and you paste a crisp image instead.

  • WYSIWYG live preview — edit, preview, or split view with synced scrolling; cursor-anchored zoom, middle-drag pan, fit-width.
  • Broad Markdown support — CommonMark plus GFM tables/task lists, Mermaid diagrams and pie charts, LaTeX math ($…$, \(…\), \[…\]), callouts and ::: containers, ruby annotations, [TOC], footnotes, code highlighting.
  • Second-level copy and export — one click puts a PNG or rich HTML on the clipboard or saves it to disk; vector PDF keeps text selectable at any length.
  • Themes and presets — three themes, four presets, custom theme packs; reusable templates for articles, social posts and tech blogs.
  • Fully offline — everything renders locally; your content never leaves the machine.
  • Right-click to share — export a whole Markdown file from the Project View, or just the selected lines from the editor.

Works with IntelliJ IDEA 2020.3 through 2026.x and other IntelliJ-based IDEs.

中文

Markdown Poster 把你手边现成的 Markdown —— AI 助手的输出（Copilot、Qoder 等编码智能体的回答）、README、设计文档、笔记 —— 直接变成排版精致、即贴即分享的 PNG 长图或独立 HTML，全程不用离开 IDE。

为什么需要它：微信、钉钉、企业微信都不渲染 Markdown。把 AI 回答或文档粘进聊天框，对方看到的是满屏星号和反引号；让阅读的人专门装一个 Markdown 查看器更是不现实。Markdown Poster 在 IDE 里一次渲染到位，你粘贴出去的是一张清晰的长图。

  • 所见即所得实时预览 —— 编辑、预览、分屏三模式（分屏滚动双向同步）；以光标为锚点的缩放、中键拖拽平移、一键适配宽度。
  • 广泛 Markdown 语法 —— CommonMark 及 GFM 表格/任务列表、Mermaid 流程图与饼图、LaTeX 公式（$…$、\(…\)、\[…\]）、提示框与 ::: 容器、Ruby 注音、[TOC] 目录、脚注、代码高亮。
  • 秒级复制与导出 —— 一次点击把 PNG 或富 HTML 放进剪贴板或保存到本地；矢量 PDF 文字可选中、超长不糊。
  • 主题与预设 —— 三套主题、四组预设、自定义主题包；文章、社交、技术博客模板可复用。
  • 完全离线 —— 全部本地渲染，内容不出本机。
  • 右键即分享 —— 项目树中分享整个 Markdown 文件，或编辑器中只分享选中片段。

兼容 IntelliJ IDEA 2020.3 – 2026.x 及其他 IntelliJ 平台 IDE。
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.6.6 — Cleaner Imports

  • Unwraps the AI "copy" shell. Many assistants copy answers wrapped in an outer ```markdown fence — importing now strips that shell automatically, so no stray backticks ever reach the poster.

中文

  • 自动剥离 AI 复制外壳。不少助手的复制按钮给出的内容整体包着一层 ```markdown 围栏——导入时自动剥离这层外壳，反引号壳不会再出现在海报上。

0.6.5 — Shortcut Settings In-App

  • Rebind the import shortcut right in the plugin settings. Settings → Export now has an "Import shortcut" row: click "Set shortcut", press the key combination you want, and the binding is written back instantly — no need to dig through the IDE-wide Keymap page. When the active keymap is a read-only default, a modifiable "Markdown Poster" scheme is derived automatically.

中文

  • 插件设置内直接改导入快捷键。设置 → 导出 新增"导入快捷键"一行：点击"设置快捷键"，按下想要的组合键即完成绑定——不用再去 IDE 全局 Keymap 页翻找；当前方案不可修改时会自动派生一份可修改的方案。

0.6.4 — Stability

  • Fixed a rare internal error. Searching actions (double-Shift / Ctrl+Shift+A) when the Markdown Poster tool window had never been opened could log an internal EDT assertion — that code path is now clean, and the import shortcut works even before the tool window is ever opened (it initializes on demand).
  • Rebinding made discoverable. "Paste to Markdown Poster" is now listed in the Tools menu — click to run, or right-click the entry to rebind its shortcut.

中文

  • 修复偶发内部报错。在从未打开 Markdown Poster 工具窗时使用动作搜索（双击 Shift / Ctrl+Shift+A）可能记录一条内部线程断言——该代码路径已清理，且导入快捷键现在无需先打开插件即可使用（工具窗按需初始化）。
  • 改键入口更易找。"粘贴到 Markdown Poster" 已加入 Tools 菜单——菜单中直接点击，或右键菜单项改键。

0.6.3 — Polish & Discoverability

  • Chinese context menu in the preview. Right-clicking the preview now shows Copy / Select All / Reload Preview in your language, replacing the browser's hardcoded English menu with items that actually matter for a single-page poster.
  • Find the import command. "Paste to Markdown Poster" is now in the Tools menu — click it there, and right-click the entry to rebind its shortcut. The tooltip on the title-bar paste button also shows the shortcut.

中文

  • 预览右键菜单中文化。预览页右键现在显示 复制 / 全选 / 刷新预览 ——替换浏览器硬编码的英文菜单，只保留对海报预览真正有用的动作。
  • 导入命令更好找。"粘贴到 Markdown Poster" 现已进入 Tools 菜单——可在菜单中直接点击，右键菜单项即可改键；标题栏粘贴按钮的悬停提示也带快捷键。

0.6.2 — Your Poster, Your Brand

  • Brand card at the end. Configure a QR code / signature image with an optional tagline once, and every poster ends with it automatically — a content block in the flow (not a watermark overlay), so the layout stays clean.
  • Image sizing syntax. ![alt](img.png){width=60%} or {width=300} controls image size — standard Pandoc/MDX-style attributes; images without attributes are untouched.
  • Two-step share. An optional setting auto-copies the rendered PNG right after a clipboard import: copy the AI answer, press Ctrl+Alt+Shift+M, and the image is already on your clipboard.
  • Append mode. Shift + the import shortcut (or the "Append" choice in the confirm dialog) adds clipboard content to the end of the current document — stitch multi-part AI answers into one poster.

中文

  • 文末签名卡。一次性配置二维码/签名图与可选标语，每张海报末尾自动附加——它是文档流内的内容块（非水印覆盖层），版式保持干净。
  • 图片尺寸语法。![alt](img.png){width=60%} 或 {width=300} 控制图片大小——Pandoc/MDX 标准属性语法；无属性的图片不受影响。
  • 两步分享。可选设置：从剪贴板导入完成后自动把渲染好的 PNG 放入剪贴板——复制 AI 回答，按下 Ctrl+Alt+Shift+M，图片已在手边。
  • 追加模式。Shift + 导入快捷键（或确认框中的"追加"选项）把剪贴板内容接到当前文档末尾——多段 AI 回答拼成一张完整海报。

0.6.1 — Paste from Clipboard

  • AI output → poster in one keystroke. Copy an answer from Copilot, Qoder or any other assistant, press Ctrl+Alt+Shift+M, and it lands in the poster preview — ready to copy as an image and paste into WeChat, DingTalk or Slack. Rebind it in Settings → Keymap by searching "Paste to Markdown Poster" (also available from the Tools menu).
  • Smart guard. If the clipboard doesn't look like Markdown (detected by structure heuristics), the import asks for confirmation first, so stray text never silently replaces your poster.
  • Toolbar button too. A paste button now sits first in the tool window title bar, next to history and copy.
  • Settings apply instantly. Saving the settings dialog now re-renders the poster immediately — toggling Obsidian adaptation, watermark or CSS no longer requires an IDE restart.
  • Hover tooltips fixed. The title-bar icon tooltips show their labels again.
  • WeChat footer references. An opt-in setting rewrites external links as text[n] with a reference list at the end of the poster — WeChat articles don't support external links, and now every citation still lands.

中文

  • AI 输出一键变海报。从 Copilot、Qoder 等任意助手复制回答，按下 Ctrl+Alt+Shift+M，内容直接进入海报预览——复制成图片，粘进微信、钉钉、Slack 就是成品。改键：Settings → Keymap 搜索 "Paste to Markdown Poster"（该命令也可从 Tools 菜单触发）。
  • 导入有护栏。剪贴板内容经结构启发式检测，不像 Markdown 时先弹确认，不会误替换当前海报。
  • 标题栏也有入口。工具窗标题栏最左侧新增粘贴按钮，与历史、复制并列。
  • 设置即时生效。设置对话框保存后海报立即重渲染——切换 Obsidian 适配、水印、CSS 不再需要重启 IDE。
  • 悬停提示修复。标题栏图标的悬浮说明恢复正常显示。
  • 公众号外链转底部引用。新增可选设置：正文中的外部链接改写为 文字[编号]，文末自动生成引用列表——公众号不支持外链，但每一条引文都不会丢。

0.6.0 — Broader Markdown Syntax

  • More inline styles. ++underline++, ~subscript~ and ^superscript^ now render everywhere — and ==highlight== is no longer tied to the Obsidian toggle; it works as the common syntax it is.
  • LaTeX standard delimiters. Write math as \(inline\) or \[display\] in addition to $…$ and $$…$$ — textbooks and existing notes just work. Delimiters inside inline code or fenced code blocks are correctly left alone.
  • ::: container blocks. The ::: tip / note / theorem … ::: syntax from Doocs, VuePress and MDX renders as styled callouts, with optional custom titles and arbitrary type names (academic environments like theorem or proof fall back to a unified style titled by their name).
  • Ruby annotations. [文字]{pinyin} and [文字]^(reading) render as proper ruby text — per-character alignment when the readings match, whole-annotation otherwise.
  • [TOC] table of contents. A standalone [TOC] line becomes a compact, linked contents list of the document's h2/h3 headings.
  • Horizontal slide galleries. Doocs-style multi-image lines render as horizontally scrolling image strips.
  • Scrolling that finally works everywhere. The editor pane scrolls like the preview (always-visible scrollbar, line numbers), and in split view the editor and preview scroll in sync — move either side, the other follows.
  • Live progress feedback. Copying or exporting shows a spinner animation in the status bar until done.
  • A richer welcome document. The built-in sample now demonstrates every supported syntax as a live tutorial.
  • Formula safety. $ and \( delimiters inside inline code or code fences are no longer mistaken for math.

中文

  • 更多行内样式。++下划线++、~下标~ 与 ^上标^ 全面支持——==高亮== 不再绑定 Obsidian 适配开关，作为通用语法始终生效。
  • LaTeX 标准分隔符。除 $…$ 与 $$…$$ 外，支持 \(行内\) 与 \[块级\] 公式——教材与既有笔记直接可用；行内代码与代码块内的分隔符不会被误认（"用 `$$` 包裹公式"这类描述文字安全了）。
  • ::: 容器语法。Doocs / VuePress / MDX 风格的 ::: tip / note / theorem … ::: 渲染为彩色提示框，支持自定义标题与任意类型名（定理、证明等学术环境自动套用统一默认样式并以名称作标题）。
  • Ruby 注音。[文字]{拼音} 与 [文字]^(注音) 渲染为标准注音排版——注音段数与文字对齐时逐字标注，否则整体标注。
  • [TOC] 目录。独立一行的 [TOC] 生成全文 h2/h3 标题的紧凑可跳转目录。
  • 横屏滑动图组。Doocs 风格的单行多图语法渲染为横向滑动图片条。
  • 处处可滚。编辑模式改为页面级滚动（滚动条常驻、显示行号），与预览一致；分屏下编辑器与预览滚动双向同步——动哪边，另一边跟随。
  • 实时进度反馈。复制与导出过程中状态栏显示旋转动画，完成即停。
  • 示例文档焕新。内置示例重写为全部语法的活教材，打开即见。
  • 公式安全护栏。行内代码与代码块内的 $、\( 分隔符不再被误认为公式。

0.5.12 — Cursor-Anchored Zoom & Decluttered Layout

  • Zoom follows your cursor. Ctrl + wheel zooming is now anchored to the pointer — the spot under your cursor stays put as the poster scales, the way Figma and Excalidraw do it. Multiplicative steps keep the feel consistent at every zoom level.
  • Middle-button drag to pan. Zoomed into a detail? Hold the middle mouse button and drag to glide across the poster — left, right, up, down — with a grabbing cursor as feedback.
  • Reset & fit controls. One click jumps back to 100% or scales the poster to exactly fit the preview width.
  • A calmer interface. History, copy, export and settings now live as small icons in the tool window title bar; the second row keeps only the mode switcher and the full copy/export menus, and the style summary moved to the status bar. Every icon button is now borderless (hover highlights it) — and hovering a title-bar icon shows its tooltip.

中文

  • 缩放跟随光标。Ctrl + 滚轮缩放改为以鼠标位置为锚点——光标下的内容在缩放中保持不动，与 Figma、Excalidraw 的手感一致；乘法步进让任意缩放级别的观感统一。
  • 中键拖拽平移。放大查看细节时，按住鼠标中键拖动即可平移海报——左右上下随意查看，抓取光标实时反馈。
  • 重置与适配。一键回到 100%，或按预览宽度自动缩放到最合适的比例。
  • 更清爽的界面。历史、复制、导出与设置改为标题栏小图标；第二行只留模式切换与复制/导出菜单，样式摘要移到底部状态栏。所有图标按钮改为无边框样式（悬停高亮），标题栏图标悬停正确显示功能提示。

0.5.11 — Wheel Zoom & Settings Navigation

  • Ctrl + mouse wheel zooms the preview. Hold Ctrl and scroll over the preview to zoom smoothly between 25% and 300% — the zoom level is remembered for the session and shown in the preview header.
  • Settings navigation, restructured. The settings dialog now uses a left-side section list with the content on the right — sections are one click away and always visible.

中文

  • Ctrl + 滚轮缩放预览。按住 Ctrl 在预览上滚动即可在 25%–300% 间平滑缩放——缩放级别会话内记忆，并在预览头部实时显示。
  • 设置导航重构。设置对话框改为左侧分区列表 + 右侧内容——分区一键可达、始终可见。

0.5.10 — Interface Polish

  • Settings, reorganized. The settings dialog is now four focused sections — Style, Layout, Watermark, Export — so every option is one click away instead of one long scroll.
  • More room for your work. The editor/preview/split mode switcher moved into the main toolbar, freeing a full row of vertical space for your content.
  • Preview zoom. Scale the live preview (display only — exports are always governed by the export scale), on both the JCEF and fallback preview paths.
  • At-a-glance document info. The status bar now shows character and line counts as you type.

中文

  • 设置重新分区。设置对话框重组为四个聚焦的分区——样式、版式、水印、导出——每个选项一键可达，不再长滚动。
  • 给内容更多空间。编辑/预览/分屏切换移入主工具栏，为内容区腾出一整行垂直空间。
  • 预览缩放。实时预览支持缩放（仅显示；导出尺寸始终由导出倍率决定），JCEF 与回退预览两条路径均支持。
  • 状态栏一目了然。状态栏现在实时显示字符数与行数。

idea-plugin.name: Markdown Browser Preview
idea-plugin.description:
Preview Markdown files in a configurable browser; auto-refresh on save. Also available as a VSCode extension with the same features.

Features

  • Right-click a .md file → Open Preview in Browser (works in the editor and the project view)
  • Self-rendered: GFM tables / strikethrough / task lists / code highlighting / Mermaid diagrams / KaTeX math
  • Save to refresh: save the file in the IDE (Ctrl/Cmd+S), the browser preview auto-syncs via SSE
  • Relative image proxy (e.g. img.png loads directly from the document's directory)
  • Configurable browser (system default, or app name / executable path)
  • Configurable port (default 0 = auto-pick a free port)
  • Mdtht theme: sidebar TOC, light/dark theme, optional heading numbering

Configuration

Settings: Settings/Preferences → Tools → Markdown Browser Preview.

  • Browser (default default) — Which browser to open. default = system default; otherwise a browser name or executable path (see examples below). Falls back to the default on failure.
  • Port (default 0) — Local preview server port. 0 = auto-select a free port; otherwise a fixed port (1–65535). Requires an IDE restart to take effect.
  • Theme (default auto) — auto = follow system; light / dark = force a specific theme.
  • Show sidebar TOC (default on) — Show a sidebar table of contents generated from document headings.
  • Auto-number headings (default off) — Automatically prefix headings with 1., 1.1, 1.2 … numbering.

Browser examples

A value without a path separator is treated as an app name (on macOS passed to open -a, on Windows/Linux used as a command); a value with / or \ is launched as an executable path.

  • default (all) — System default browser
  • Google Chrome / Safari / Firefox (macOS) — open -a "..."
  • /Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome (macOS) — direct executable
  • chrome (Windows) — cmd /c start "" chrome
  • C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe (Windows) — direct executable
  • google-chrome (Linux) — direct command (must be on $PATH)
  • /usr/bin/firefox (Linux) — direct executable

Tip: on macOS the app name must match what open -a accepts — usually the display name shown in /Applications (e.g. Google Chrome, not google-chrome).

Usage

  1. Open any .md file
  2. Right-click → Open Preview in Browser
  3. Edit and save in the IDE; the browser refreshes automatically

idea-plugin.name: Pin Guard
idea-plugin.description:
Makes pinned editor tabs genuinely hard to close.

Pinning a tab normally only protects it from automatic closing, such as tab-limit eviction. Any explicit close still discards it instantly: the close shortcut, the tab context menu, "Close All Tabs", or a middle-click.

Pin Guard intercepts those close attempts on pinned tabs and either blocks them silently or asks for confirmation. Unpinning a tab restores every normal close path immediately, and the plugin can be switched off entirely without restarting the IDE.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Added

  • Initial release.
  • Pinned editor tabs are protected from explicit close attempts: the close shortcut (Ctrl+F4 / Cmd+W), the tab context menu, Window | Editor Tabs | Close, "Close All Tabs", "Close Others", and middle-click / Shift+click on a tab.
  • Three modes, at Settings | Editor | Pin Guard: Block (default, silently ignores the close), Confirm (asks first), and Off (restores stock behaviour). Switching modes takes effect immediately, with no restart.
  • Separate toggle for the middle-click guard, since that path is the only one requiring a global AWT event filter and therefore carries the most runtime risk.
  • Notification on every blocked close, so the behaviour is not mistaken for a broken keybinding. Limited to one per tab -- repeating the gesture while the balloon is up adds nothing, and each tab keeps a single entry in the Notifications tool window rather than one per attempt. Count- aware, so a blocked "Close All Tabs" produces a single notification naming the number of protected tabs. When exactly one tab is blocked, the notification is titled with that tab's name and carries its icon, so it reads like the tab it is about. Can be switched off with Show a notification when a close is blocked.
  • Runtime check that logs a warning if the platform ever stops honouring the undocumented overrides="true" mechanism the plugin depends on.

idea-plugin.name: Freemarker Plus
idea-plugin.description:
An IntelliJ IDEA plugin that provides rich syntax highlighting and code navigation for FreeMarker template files (.ftl, .ftlh, .ftlx), with embedded CSS and JavaScript support.

Features

Syntax Highlighting

  • FreeMarker syntax highlighting — comments, directives (<#if>, <#list>, <#assign>, ...), macro calls (<@...>), interpolation (${...}), strings, numbers, keywords, and operators.
  • Expression support — ?builtin functions (with arguments, e.g. ${list?size}, ${x?string("a","b")}), chained builtins, ?? existence checks, comparisons in interpolations, and parenthesized comparisons in directives (<#if (a > b)>).
  • HTML highlighting — full HTML tag, attribute, and content highlighting via IntelliJ's built-in HTML lexer.
  • Embedded CSS highlighting — CSS code inside <style> blocks is highlighted with the platform CSS lexer.
  • Embedded JavaScript highlighting — JavaScript code inside <script> blocks is highlighted with the platform JS lexer.
  • Color scheme customization — all FreeMarker token colors are configurable at Settings → Editor → Color Scheme → Freemarker.

Template Language Architecture

  • The HTML/XML data area of a template is parsed into real HTML/XML PSI — the platform template-language mechanism, same architecture as the official plugin — so platform HTML features (tag navigation, usage search, etc.) work inside templates.

Code Navigation

  • Go to declaration (Ctrl+B) — #include/#import file paths (multi-level relative paths), <@macro> calls (same file and cross-file via the declaration index), variable references (${var}, directive conditions), namespace members (ns.member), and macro/function parameters inside macro bodies.
  • Find usages (Alt+F7) — macros, functions, and variables, with cross-file search that respects the IDE search scope.
  • Structure view (Alt+7) — directives and macro calls; breadcrumbs show the enclosing directive context.
  • Code folding — if/list/switch/macro/function/compress/noparse/escape blocks, block-level <#assign>, and long <#-- --> comments.
  • Rename (Shift+F6) — macros, functions, and variables rename together with all their usages; import aliases are protected against accidental rename.
  • Commenting — Ctrl+/ wraps the selection in <#-- --> block comments.
  • HTML/JavaScript navigation — onclick="login()" resolves to the login function declared in the same file's <script> block or in external .js files; <script src="app.js"> opens the referenced file. JavaScript features require the IDE's JavaScript support (bundled in IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate and WebStorm); on Community Edition without the JS plugin, HTML navigation still works.

Supported File Types

Extension Description
.ftl FreeMarker template (plain text)
.ftlh FreeMarker template (HTML)
.ftlx FreeMarker template (XML)

Highlight Categories

The following categories are available in Settings → Editor → Color Scheme → Freemarker:

Category Example
Comment <#-- comment -->
String "hello", 'world'
Keyword gt, true, if, as
Directive name if, list, assign
Interpolation delimiters ${, }, <#, >
Number 42, 3.14
Operator ., =, (, )
Bad character Unexpected tokens

Colors follow your active color scheme and are anchored to standard IntelliJ language defaults. Customize them under Settings → Editor → Color Scheme → Freemarker.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.4.0
  • Expression support: ?builtin functions with arguments (${list?size}, ${x?string("a","b")}), chained builtins, and ?? existence checks — no more red syntax in real-world templates.
  • Comparisons: parenthesized >/</>=/<= inside directives (<#if (a > b)>) and inside interpolations.
  • Block-level <#assign x>...</#assign> parsing and folding; <#escape x as html> now parses.
  • Navigation: macro/function parameters resolve as variables inside macro bodies; multi-level <#import "partials/lib.ftl"> paths now resolve.
  • Editor: Ctrl+/ block commenting with <#-- -->; folding for compress/noparse/escape and long comments; more precise Find Usages type labels.

idea-plugin.name: GoToInOppositeGroup
idea-plugin.description:
Navigates to a symbol's implementation directly in another editor split, without leaving your current position. It adds two actions:

  • Goto Implementation in Opposite Group — opens the implementation in the opposite group, alternating back and forth as you use it.
  • Goto Implementation in Right Split — always opens the implementation in a group to the right: the group next to the current one when there is one, otherwise a new group split off to the right.

Either action creates the split when the editor is not split yet. Both have their own Keymap entry, so you can bind a separate shortcut to each (or only to the one you use).

When a mouse shortcut (e.g. Cmd+Opt+Click) is bound to either action, hovering over a symbol with the modifier keys held underlines it, switches to the hand cursor, and shows the usual info hint — just like the built-in Go To Declaration.

Features:

  • Navigate to a symbol's implementation directly in the opposite editor split
  • Automatically creates a split if one does not exist
  • Keeps your current editor position intact
  • Available from the Navigate menu, editor context menu, and Search Everywhere

Especially useful for C++ developers and anyone who frequently investigates implementations while keeping their current context intact.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Added

  • "Goto Implementation in Right Split" action, which always navigates into a group to the right instead of alternating between groups: it reuses the group next to the current one, or splits off a new one when the current group is the rightmost. Both actions have their own keymap entry, so they can be bound separately
  • Ctrl-mouse highlighting: with a mouse shortcut such as Cmd+Opt+Click bound to either action, hovering over a symbol underlines it, switches to the hand cursor and shows the usual info hint

Fixed

  • The opposite group no longer gets an extra tab with the file the action was invoked from
  • NoSuchMethodError on IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2: the action no longer opens the editor through the internal FileEditorOpenOptions, whose constructor signature changed in the 2026.2 platform. It now targets the opposite split with EditorWindow.setAsCurrentWindow() + OpenFileDescriptor, which is stable public API

idea-plugin.name: Angular Files Navigator
idea-plugin.description:
Angular Files Navigator

Jump instantly between the files that make up an Angular building block. Put the caret in any file of a component or NgRx feature and press Ctrl+Alt+A ("A" for Angular). A popup opens next to the caret listing every related file that exists.

From the popup, press the letter mnemonic to open a file, or use the arrow keys and Enter:

  • T → component TypeScript (*.component.ts / *.ts; from a spec, the matching source)
  • H → template Html (*.component.html / *.html)
  • S → Styles (*.scss / *.sass / *.less / *.css)
  • U → Unit test (*.spec.ts; from a spec, toggles back to source)
  • R → NgRx Reducer
  • E → NgRx Effects
  • L → NgRx seLectors
  • A → NgRx Actions
  • F → NgRx Facade
  • M → Module

Every command also lives under the editor context menu (Angular Files Navigator) and can be bound to its own shortcut under Settings → Keymap → Angular Files Navigator.

Open source under the MIT License. Contributions are welcome at github.com/vunguyen96/angular-files-navigator.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• 1.1.0 – Ctrl+Alt+A now opens a popup near the caret listing the related files; press a letter or use arrows to pick. Pressing T from a *.spec.ts now opens its implementation source.
  • 1.0.0 – Initial release: navigation between Angular component and NgRx related files.

idea-plugin.name: TailScope: Log Viewer, Filter & Follow
idea-plugin.description:
Fast, non-freezing log viewer for .log files. Colour-coded levels, timestamps, threads, loggers and stack traces; one-click level filters; regex filter with live hidden-line folding; and a Follow mode that tails the file as it grows. Never locks your file read-only.

  • Highlighting for ERROR / WARN / INFO / DEBUG / TRACE, ISO and common timestamp formats, [thread] names, logger names and Java/Kotlin/.NET/Python stack traces.
  • Level filter bar at the top of every log: tick the levels you want, everything else folds away with a count of hidden lines.
  • Regex / text filter applied in the background - the editor stays responsive on large files.
  • Follow (tail -f): keeps the view pinned to the newest line while the file is being written.
  • Works in IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, GoLand, PhpStorm, Rider, CLion, RubyMine, DataGrip and Android Studio.

Trial of 30 days, then a small yearly licence. Support: info@mhdint.com

idea-plugin.name: Peek Definition
idea-plugin.description:
Peek Definition for Java. It shows the definition of the symbol at the caret right below the current line, inside the editor you are working in, so you can read an implementation without leaving your file or losing your place.

Unlike Quick Definition, the Peek is not a popup: it does not cover your code, it stays open while you keep working, and you can open several at once.

Features

  • Embedded in the editor: the definition opens between the lines of your code, with the lines below moved down instead of hidden.
  • Just the definition: the Peek shows only the method, with its signature and module in the header, like Quick Definition. Switch to the whole file or turn on line numbers from the ⋮ menu; your choice is remembered for the next Peek. It is a real editor on the real file: it uses your color scheme, font and theme, Ctrl+Click works inside it, and it updates live when the file changes.
  • Accurate: definitions are resolved the same way as Go to Declaration, so overloads, constructors and library classes (attached or decompiled sources) resolve correctly.
  • Implementations: peeking an interface or abstract method adds a dropdown to the header listing its implementations, like Quick Definition; pick one to show it in the same Peek.
  • Several Peeks at once: peek from different lines and every Peek stays open. Peeking from inside a Peek replaces its content with the new definition.
  • Read-only: opening, switching and closing a Peek never modifies your code.

Usage

  • Put the caret on a method call or constructor and choose Peek Definition from the editor's right-click menu or from Navigate.
  • Click the Peek's title bar to collapse or expand it. Its Open in Editor button opens the file in a regular editor tab.
  • The ⋮ menu in the header opens the file in an editor tab, switches between the method only and the whole file, and shows or hides line numbers.
  • Esc inside a Peek (or its × button) closes that Peek. Esc in the editor closes all of its Peeks.

No shortcut is assigned by default. Bind one in Settings | Keymap | Peek Definition.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.2

  • The Peek Definition action now has its own icon in the editor's right-click menu and in Navigate.

0.1.1

  • Implementations: peeking an interface or abstract method adds a dropdown to the header listing its implementations; pick one to show it in the same Peek.
  • Shows only the method by default. Switch to the whole file, or turn on line numbers, from the new ⋮ menu; the choice is remembered for the next Peek.
  • Header redesigned after Quick Definition: the definition's icon and signature, plus its module or library.
  • New Open in Editor button in the header. Double-clicking the title no longer opens the file, so it can't be triggered by accident; clicking the title still collapses or expands the Peek.
  • The Peek stands out more from the surrounding code: rounded outline in the theme's accent color, header in the tool window color, and a slightly tinted background.

0.0.1

  • Initial release: Peek Definition for Java, embedded below the current line.

idea-plugin.name: Helix Keymap (T68k)
idea-plugin.description:
Helix Keymap brings the modern, selection-first modal editing paradigm of the Helix editor directly into JetBrains IDEs. Rather than layering fragile vim emulations or static keymaps, this plugin deeply integrates authentic Helix workflows with IntelliJ's native CaretModel, SelectionModel, PSI/AST structure, and ActionManager.

Beta Notice: I have been using this plugin for real work for several weeks; however, it is considered beta and might still contain bugs or incorrect behavior. Feedback and issue reports are warmly welcomed on GitHub, but please don't flood me with AI slop!

The Selection-First Paradigm

Traditional modal editors rely on the verb → object pattern (such as d3w), forcing you to guess text boundaries before acting. Helix inverts this into selection → action: every motion creates or manipulates a visible selection, providing instant visual feedback before executing a delete, change, or yank.

Key Features

  • Interactive Which-Key Popups: Pressing Space, g, m, [, ], z, Z, Ctrl+w, or " reveals an instant visual chord menu in authentic snake_case. Press Tab to inspect underlying IntelliJ Action IDs in real time, or bypass the popup entirely with rapid muscle memory.
  • Native Multi-Caret & Piece-Wise Registers: Add cursors vertically (Alt+C / C), split on regex patterns or newlines (s, S, Alt+s), filter selections (K, Alt+K), and align into columns (&). Supports named ("a–"z), clipboard ("+), black hole ("_), and selection-index ("#) registers with authentic 1:1 piece-wise multi-caret pasting.
  • Surround & PSI Textobjects (m menu): Add, replace, and delete surround delimiters (ms, mr, md) and match brackets (mm). Select inside and around structural elements including functions (maf), classes (mat), arguments (maa), indent blocks (mii), XML tags (max), tests (maT), and VCS hunks (mag).
  • AST-Aware & Unimpaired Navigation: Expand/shrink selection by syntax tree scope (Alt+o / Alt+i), navigate AST sibling elements (Alt+p / Alt+n), or jump between functions, diagnostics, comments, and VCS changes via [ and ] chords.
  • Helix Command Palette & Shell Filters (:): Signature Helix prompt with live fuzzy completion for buffer actions (:w, :q, :vsp, :format, :sort, :jumps, and DAP debugging) plus external shell piping (|, !, $).
  • Status Bar Widget & Visual Feedback: Live indicator displaying active mode (NOR, INS, SEL), caret counts, active register, and macro state, complete with flash-on-yank feedback.

Space Leader Highlights

  • Space + f / b → File picker (GotoFile) / Buffer switcher (RecentFiles)
  • Space + / → Project-wide text search (FindInPath)
  • Space + s / S → Document structure & workspace symbol search
  • Space + a / r → Code actions (Alt+Enter) & symbol rename
  • Space + d / D → Diagnostic inspection & Problems tool window
  • Space + w → Window and split layout management
  • Space + G → Interactive DAP debugging menu (breakpoints, stepping, eval)
  • Space + k / ? → Documentation hover & command search

Configuration & Ctrl Handling

Customize activation scope (diff viewers, console, commit messages), platform-aware Ctrl key routing (Helix vs. IDE ownership per mode), Which-Key hint styles, vertical navigation (Stock Helix visual vs. physical lines), and color themes under:
Settings → Tools → Helix Keymap

Documentation & Support

Source code, documentation, and issue tracker: GitHub Repository | Issue Tracker
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Added

  • First public Marketplace release.
  • Selection-first Helix modal editing (Normal / Insert / Select) on top of IntelliJ's native multi-caret model.
  • Motions, text objects (mi/ma), surround (ms/mr/md), PSI-based structural selection and navigation.
  • Registers (named, clipboard, black hole, selection index), macros, jumplist, and . repeat.
  • Which-Key popups for Space, g, m, [, ], z, Z, Ctrl-w and ".
  • : command palette, shell pipes (|, !, $), regex select / split / keep / remove.
  • Master Enable Helix mode switch and Toggle Helix Mode action (:toggle-helix).
  • Configurable editor scope: code editors, diff viewers, consoles, commit message, other embedded editors.
  • Configurable Ctrl key handling per key and mode, with platform-aware defaults (Insert-mode Ctrl keys go to the IDE on Windows/Linux).

Changed

  • Minimum supported IDE version is now 2025.1.
  • Ctrl and Escape keys are no longer registered in the global keymap; they are handled only inside Helix-active editors.

Removed

  • Incompatible with IdeaVim; both plugins replace the editor's typed-key handler.

idea-plugin.name: Extensions for arc42
idea-plugin.description:
Browse and check arc42 architecture documents written in AsciiDoc that use the extensions for arc42:

  • links: typed links between elements such as decisions, requirements, inputs and stakeholder roles
  • triggers: event-driven revisits of architecture decisions

The arc42 tool window lists the elements of each document by arc42 section or by kind. For each element it shows the links written at it, the links into it, and its revisit subscriptions and history. It reports violations of the links rules, follows include:: directives, and updates as you type.

Key Features

  • Real-time validation of 8 link rules (L1, L3-L8, B1) as you edit
  • Dual view modes: group elements by arc42 section or by element kind
  • Live updates: automatically refreshes as you edit AsciiDoc files (300ms debounce)
  • Navigation support: double-click or press Enter to jump to elements in source
  • Read-only interface: your documents remain the single source of truth
  • Works during indexing: no need to wait for IDE to finish indexing
  • Include directive support: follows include:: across multiple files

Independent project; not affiliated with or endorsed by arc42 or its creators.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Added

  • Initial release
  • arc42 tool window for browsing architecture documents written in AsciiDoc
  • Support for links extension: typed links between elements (decisions, requirements, inputs, stakeholder roles)
  • Support for triggers extension: event-driven decision revisits
  • Link visualization showing owned links and inverse links for each element
  • Real-time validation of links rules (L1, L3-L8, B1)
  • Dual view modes: group elements by arc42 section or by element kind
  • Live updates as AsciiDoc files change (debounced, 300ms)
  • Navigation support: double-click or Enter to jump to element source locations
  • Follow include:: directives across multiple files
  • Read-only interface: documents remain the source of truth
  • Works during IDE indexing (DumbAware service)

Limitations

  • Triggers rules T1-T17 validation not yet implemented
  • Historical status view for revisits not yet supported
  • Baseline management UI not available

idea-plugin.name: Rolewise for Ansible
idea-plugin.description:
Rolewise brings complete Ansible support to JetBrains IDEs, without ever touching the YAML files that are not Ansible.

  • Strict Ansible scope: Rolewise only activates inside Ansible roots it detects (ansible.cfg, roles/, group_vars/, inventories…) or that you configure. Kubernetes manifests, Compose files and CI pipelines stay untouched.
  • Your own modules: the module catalog is read from your Ansible installation with ansible-doc (ansible-core and installed collections), cached on disk and refreshed in the background.
  • Completion for keywords, modules (FQCN or short names), options and their choices, roles, handlers, tags, hosts, files, templates and variables.
  • Jinja2 in YAML values, when: conditions and *.j2 templates: highlighting, variables, filters and tests.
  • Variables resolved across nested roles, group_vars, host_vars, plays, set_fact and register: go to declaration, find usages, rename and value preview following Ansible precedence.
  • Ansible Vault, natively: edit decrypted files in memory, encrypt or decrypt files and single values, change passwords and vault IDs. Passwords live in the IDE password safe only.
  • Inspections and quick fixes: unknown modules and options, missing required options, invalid values, deprecated modules, FQCN conversion, undefined variables, unknown handlers, missing roles and files, unquoted Jinja2 and more.
  • Inventories in INI and YAML, an Ansible project view, Search Everywhere for roles, playbooks, variables and hosts.
  • Run ansible-playbook, Molecule scenarios and ansible-navigator from the editor, see ansible-lint results inline, and launch AWX / Ansible Automation Platform job templates.
  • Collection development: galaxy.yml completion and checks, and the modules of the collections you develop join the catalog without being installed; Ctrl+click opens their Python source.
  • Beyond the basics: role argument_specs validation, dynamic inventory preview, inventory and role dependency graphs, ansible.cfg support, completion of registered results from module return values, warnings on secrets left in clear text.
  • Safe by default: in untrusted projects Rolewise never runs ansible-doc, ansible-lint, dynamic inventories or password scripts on its own; external tools always run in the background, one at a time.

Rolewise is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Red Hat. Ansible is a trademark of Red Hat, Inc.
idea-plugin.change-notes: • Error reports from the IDE now reach the developer through JetBrains Marketplace, only when you click "Report".
