Key Features: - Live Preview Editing: headings, emphasis, links, lists, task lists, quotes, code blocks, images and tables render in place; click into an element to edit its markdown. - Reading-Optimised Typography: NV Palatium for body text and Geist Mono (by Vercel) for code. - Seamless Sync: Bi-directional synchronization with the standard IntelliJ editor. - Theme Awareness: Automatically adapts to Light and Dark IDE themes.

# JBLSpringBootAppGen ![Build](https://github.com/liaojianbin/JBLSpringBootAppGen/workflows/Build/badge.svg) [![Version](https://img.shields.io/jetbrains/plugin/v/PLUGIN_ID.svg)](https://plugins.jetbrains.com/plugin/PLUGIN_ID) [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/jetbrains/plugin/d/PLUGIN_ID.svg)](https://plugins.jetbrains.com/plugin/PLUGIN_ID) License: Proprietary (All rights reserved) JBLSpringBootAppGen intro

JBLSpringBootAppGen 简介

idea-plugin.name: Patcher
idea-plugin.description:
Patcher is an IntelliJ IDEA plugin designed for efficiently extracting and packaging patch files for Java applications. Key features include:

  • Extracting modifications from existing Java applications
  • Packaging modifications into executable patch files
  • Supporting multiple module types and file formats
  • Simplifying patch creation and distribution workflows

Patcher 是一个 IntelliJ IDEA 插件，用于高效地提取和打包 Java 应用程序的补丁文件。主要功能包括：

  • 从现有 Java 应用程序中提取修改内容
  • 将修改打包成可执行的补丁文件
  • 支持多种模块类型和文件格式
  • 简化补丁创建和分发流程

idea-plugin.name: MakeTypeScriptModel
idea-plugin.description:
Make Java model to TypeScript model. For example, Java model:
Class Info {
    private Integer id;
    private String name;
    // getter setter
}
to typeScript model:
export interface Info {
    id: number;
    name: string;
}

How to use:
Code -> Generate -> MakeTypeScriptModel
idea-plugin.change-notes: make Java model to TypeScript model init.

idea-plugin.name: Payara Ultimate Tools
idea-plugin.description:
Payara Ultimate Tools allows configuring and using the Payara Platform, for deploying and managing applications from the IDEA. The plugin also provides seamless integration with Payara Qube for deploying and managing Jakarta EE applications:
  • Login to the Payara Qube platform.
  • Start and Stop Payara Qube applications.
  • Launch Payara Qube applications in development mode.
  • Deploy and undeploy applications on Payara Qube.
  • Retrieve lists of applications, namespaces, and subscriptions from the Payara Qube.

idea-plugin.name: Spring Mybatis CE
idea-plugin.description:
Tools for developing Spring, Mybatis, etc. Main focus on Java developers who use IDEA Community Edition. Free during the EAP period.
To enable the Java folding extensions for Java and Spring, please click File | Settings | Editor | General | Code Folding for Windows and Linux, IDEA | Preferences | Editor | General | Code Folding for macOS Ctrl+Alt+S, then switch on checkbox General | Custom folding regions.
⚠️ After you editing the JavaDoc or annotation, please place caret in the tag (eg. @param) inside the JavaDoc or annotation, then press Command+. to toggle folding.

Below for Chinese instrunction:

本插件提供Spring, Mybatis开发的支持工具. 主要关注 IDEA社区版的Java开发人员. 当前的早期开发版免费.
要默认启用Java和Spring代码的自定义折叠选项, 在Windows 或 Linux 请依次点击 File | Settings | Editor | General | Code Folding, 在 Mac 上，依次点击 Ctrl+Alt+S IDEA | Preferences | Editor | General | Code Folding , 然后选中复选框 General | Custom folding regions.
⚠️ 修改完 JavaDoc 或者 注解后, 请将光标移动到 JavaDoc 内的标签上(例如@param)或者注解上, 然后按下快捷键 Command+. 来切换代码折叠.

idea-plugin.name: SuperBootGenPLG
idea-plugin.description:
Provides a netless way to create "not-only" sub-springboot-module,

associate poms'relation automatically. Trying to manage sb project.


SuperBootGenPLG [chain-gen]


GitHub | Issues

- maven based version

- TODO: dir templates, pom module optimize


CreateSubSpringBootModule

- provide the way to create sub-springboot-module without spring.io

- automatically associate poms'relationship between targeted parent & new sub module

- support mybatis plus CodeGen template, since 3.2 support DIY all the templates

QA

1 Q: What's new about ftl DIY

- A: [pomXml.ftl] allows u create pom.xml with you template(see demo on github). [settingsFileProperties.ftl] and [settingsFileYml.ftl] allows u create settings file as you wish. [mybatisPlusProperties.ftl] is Deprecated due to the template DIY.


2 Q: Input validation

- A: Validate Empty plus some tips, take it easy for normal use, all of them are under ur ctrl


3 Q: How to avoid duplication of module name?

- A: Only validate under same dir, so be careful


4 Q: How ftl DIY works?

- A: First of all, ftl dir should be selected, SuperBootGenPLG trying to use any provided ftl. [application.ftl], [applicationTest.ftl], [mybatisPlus.ftl], [mybatisPlusProperties.ftl], [pomXml.ftl], [settingsFileProperties.ftl], [settingsFileYml.ftl] all the templates are optional. Default templates are always nice if any of DIY temp missing. The new DIY log will notice u which DIY temp is used or missing, jz relax. [mybatisPlusProperties.ftl] is optional. It's special but Deprecated, if not provide, the [sbg-mpg.properties] won't be created, this is a used-once-for-codegen-then-delete file, log database settings temporarily. [pomXml.ftl] is advanced. Little difficult to handle it, like gav involved, pom EL also 'conflict' with freeMaker. u may spend some time on freeMaker but SuperBootGenPLG already provide some demo for u. Vars' name already determined by SuperBootGenPLG, u could get ftl dome on github or this opensource plugin jar(zip).


5 Q: User DIY ftl error

- A: Depend on users, SuperBootGenPLG can only alert error log


ConvertMavenToSpringBoot

- convert init-like maven project to single or agg springboot project as u like

- support persist 3 spring-boot-starter-parent's versions.

- support mybatis plus CodeGen template, since 3.2 support DIY all the templates

QA

1 Q: Why write this action? for what

- A: Any same environment jz saved in template and created by a single click


2 Q: How could I choose spring version?

- A: On springboot version clipboard, it helps u remember versions thus u jz choose on click


3 Q:Single or agg project?

- A:Single project have no submodule, agg is short for aggregation project, it has no src folder


ToggleApplicationBootstrap

- rename settings file especially using Spring Cloud Config

- toggle feature allows you play around and around

QA

1 Q: How to use it

- A: right click on SETTINGS FILE, chose SuperBootGenPLG > ToggleApplicationBootstrap

idea-plugin.name: HotSecondsClient
idea-plugin.description:
This plugin is mainly used for hot deployment to remote server after coding.
It can support hot reloading of java, xml, html, css, js and other files, and also supports hot reloading of frameworks such as spring and mybatis.
It needs to be used with HotSecondsServer on the server side.
Visit HotSecondsIDEA to see more detailed documents.

idea-plugin.name: yms-ide
idea-plugin.description:
YMS IDE runs and debugs YMS Maven applications locally or in Docker, including Docker Engine hosted in WSL. It prepares the YMS runtime and provides startup analysis, BASIC snapshots, timed DETAIL diagnostics, offline reports, and outbound HTTPS URL monitoring. Configure container CPU quotas in the Docker target's run options.

YMS IDE 为 YMS Maven 应用提供运行、调试和诊断能力。插件自动识别使用 com.yonyou.iuap:yms-module-maven-plugin 的模块，准备匹配的 YMS 运行环境， 并创建专用的 YMS 运行配置。

主要功能

  • 自动识别 YMS Maven 模块，构建并运行或调试选定模块。
  • 支持本机和 Docker Linux 目标，适配运行环境、开发文件挂载和端口映射；可通过 IDE 的 Docker 连接使用 WSL 中的 Docker Engine。
  • Docker 的 CPU 硬配额由 Linux cgroup 执行，在 Docker 目标的运行选项中配置，例如 --cpus=2。
  • 支持配置 YMS 运行环境、模块、JVM 参数、环境变量、JDK 和服务端口。
  • 提供一键 BASIC 即时快照和定时 DETAIL 深度诊断，支持本机进程及当前运行的 Docker 容器。
  • 分析 DETAIL 执行记录、阶段、线程、运行信息及转储完整性，生成可离线查看的报告。
  • 通过 ServerDumpCapture JMX MBean 开启 1–600 秒的 DETAIL 采集窗口。
  • 实时显示 YMS 进程发起的 HTTPS 请求地址，采集 TLS 加密前的 URL 元数据，不读取请求体或响应体。
  • 按需下载并挂载 yms-start-agent，在应用就绪后生成启动能力分析报告。
  • 在 IDE 内预览离线报告，禁用预览页面的网络访问和主机桥接。
  • 支持清理本地生成的 YMS 运行缓存，在下次启动时重新准备运行环境。

使用条件

  • 基于 Maven 的 YMS 项目，目标模块已配置 YMS Maven 插件。
  • 能够访问项目所需 YMS 运行组件的 Maven 仓库。
  • 通过 Attach API 进行 DETAIL 采集需要完整 JDK；容器诊断也需要容器内提供完整 JDK。
  • BASIC 优先使用运行中服务的本地控制通道，必要时使用运行环境中的 kernel 脚本。
  • 使用 Docker 时，IDE 需启用 Docker 插件并连接可用的 Linux Docker Engine；WSL 中的 Engine 也通过该连接访问。需要配置可用的目录挂载和网络连接。

使用方法

  1. 打开或导入 YMS Maven 项目，等待 Maven 同步完成。
  2. 在项目视图中右键点击已配置 YMS Maven 插件的模块，选择 Yms → Run 或 Yms → Debug，插件会自动构建模块并准备运行环境。
  3. 在 Run → Edit Configurations 中修改 YMS 配置，可设置模块、JDK、JAR 路径、应用地址、JVM 参数、环境变量和服务端口，默认端口为 8080。
  4. 使用容器时，在 Run on 中选择 Docker 目标，并在目标设置中配置镜像、目录挂载及运行选项。CPU 配额直接在该目标中设置，无需在 YMS 配置页面重复填写。
  5. Run 保留手动配置的 JDWP 参数，可在另一个工程中使用 Remote JVM Debug 连接；Docker 目标需在运行选项中发布对应调试端口，例如 -p 5000:5000。suspend=y 会等待调试器连接，suspend=n 会直接启动。选择 Debug 时，插件自动配置调试连接。
  6. 启动应用后打开 View → Tool Windows → YMS IDE TOOL，在 HTTP Requests（HTTP 请求）页查看实时 HTTPS 请求地址，无需开启定时采集。
  7. 点击 BASIC 即时诊断，采集、筛选和分析当前运行快照，并显示报告。
  8. 排查偶发问题时，选择 DETAIL 采集时长并点击深度诊断，在倒计时内复现问题；倒计时结束后，插件读取快照并生成报告。
  9. 需要重建运行环境时，右键模块选择 Yms → clean cache，下次运行时会重新生成缓存。
  10. 分析启动过程时，右键 YMS 模块选择 Yms → Run Analysis '模块名'，仅对本次启动开启分析；agent 会下载到对应 YMS 运行目录的 bin 下。也可在运行配置中勾选“分析启动能力并生成启动报告”，对后续启动持续启用。

文件和网络访问说明

插件从项目配置的 Maven 仓库解析所需组件，在项目的 .yms 目录中准备运行文件， 将采集的 ZIP 文件和离线报告保存到 .yms/server-dumps 目录。 启动分析按需从配置的 JFrog 地址下载 agent。 Server Dump 和 DETAIL 操作针对选定的 YMS 进程，容器诊断在当前运行的容器内使用其 JDK 和插件内置辅助程序执行。 Docker 运行使用本机目录挂载；HTTP 监控使用带令牌验证的独立监听端口，该端口需能够从 Docker 虚拟机访问，本机运行使用回环地址。 插件在 Docker Engine 中缓存本地生成的空挂载镜像，并用仅创建的临时容器传递挂载，业务容器创建后清理该临时容器。 离线报告预览不加载网络资源。
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• 修复 Docker 启动分析后 BASIC 无法找到实际工作目录的问题；kernel 兜底使用目标进程的工作目录，失败时显示控制采集原因和脚本错误输出。
  • 修复 Docker 继承挂载模式转换导致项目目录只读的问题，启动分析 agent 和 Liberty 工作目录可以正常写入报告及运行文件。
  • Docker 普通运行使用后台准备和启动流程，修复 WSL 地址查询在 UI 线程执行的异常，并正常报告容器启动失败。
  • IDEA 临时上传目录与 YMS 项目挂载分开，避免在只读父挂载中创建临时子挂载点失败。
  • 修复 Docker 普通运行丢失手动 JDWP 参数的问题，恢复从其他工程远程调试的能力；Debug 继续自动发布和连接调试端口。
  • 新增 Docker 运行和调试支持，适配 WSL 中的 Docker Engine、YMS 目录映射及服务端口。
  • 修复 Docker 调试时 JDWP 连接被拒绝的问题，使用容器监听和主机端口映射建立调试连接。
  • 适配容器内的 BASIC Server Dump 和定时 DETAIL 采集，保留启动分析及离线报告能力。
  • CPU 硬配额统一在 Docker 目标中配置，移除 Windows 本地 CPU 限制及相关配置。
  • 详细介绍、使用说明和更新记录改为中文；市场介绍保留审核要求的英文概要。

idea-plugin.name: ClassFinder
idea-plugin.description: Introducing the Class Finder – a productivity-enhancing plugin that seamlessly bridges Java source code with compiled class files. With one-click functionality, developers can instantly locate the corresponding .class file for any Java source, intelligently detecting output paths across Maven, Gradle, and standard project structures. The plugin automatically resolves build configurations and dependency hierarchies, supports multi-module projects, and opens the precise class file location in your system's native file explorer. Ideal for debugging compilation issues, verifying obfuscation results, or analyzing third-party libraries, this tool eliminates manual directory hunting while maintaining full compatibility with Windows, macOS, and Linux environments.

idea-plugin.change-notes:
Fixed

  • Scope XML undeployment to the selected virtual host, preferring exact hosts over regexp fallbacks
  • Restore generated configuration entries on redeployment and verify runtime status instead of reporting success after an XML write
  • Use local JMX deployer directories, reject unsupported custom targets and overlapping source paths, and preserve dotted exploded-directory names during cleanup
  • Stop injecting the obsolete Java 5 source level while retaining explicit compiler options
  • Release generated configuration and imports after startup failures or process exit, and reject session replacement while its process is alive
  • Discard stale directory-detection results and invalidate installation caches when version-detection JARs change

Changed

  • Separate XML strategies, JMX deployment, local artifact transport, deployment observations, and per-run resources
  • Replace reflective field copying with explicit snapshot collaborators and isolated run sessions
  • Debounce installation inspection and move filesystem/JAR detection off the UI thread
  • Remove unused configuration dialog/helpers/setters and rename the metadata-only version detector
  • Use the checked-in wrapper as the Gradle version source and allow local IDE paths for compatibility validation

idea-plugin.name: CoderTools
idea-plugin.description:
CoderTools — Spring Dev Toolkit for IntelliJ IDEA

A productivity plugin for Spring Boot / Spring MVC developers. One toolkit covering URI copy, cURL generation, interface search, Bean field exploration, and code chain annotation.

面向 Spring Boot / Spring MVC 开发者的效率插件，一套工具覆盖 URI 复制、cURL 生成、接口搜索、Bean 字段浏览和代码链标注。

Features / 功能特性

🔗 Copy URI & Copy cURL

  • Right-click any Controller / Feign method → copy full URI (class path + method path) to clipboard
    右键 Controller / Feign 方法，一键复制完整 URI（类路径 + 方法路径）到剪贴板
  • Supports @RestController, @Controller, @FeignClient and all Spring MVC method mapping annotations
    支持 @RestController、@Controller、@FeignClient 及全部 Spring MVC 方法级映射注解
  • Copy cURL: auto-generates query params (GET) or JSON body skeleton (POST/PUT/PATCH) from method signature
    Copy cURL：自动从方法签名生成查询参数（GET）或 JSON 请求体骨架（POST/PUT/PATCH）
  • Configurable Host / Headers / Cookies (Settings → Tools → CoderTools)
    可配置 Host、Headers、Cookies（Settings → Tools → CoderTools）
  • Shortcut: Ctrl+Shift+Alt+R (Win/Linux) / Cmd+Shift+Alt+R (Mac)
    快捷键：Ctrl+Shift+Alt+R（Win/Linux）/ Cmd+Shift+Alt+R（Mac）

🔍 Search URI

  • Global popup (Ctrl+Alt+/) — search Spring MVC / Feign URIs across the whole project and jump to the method
    全局弹窗（Ctrl+Alt+/）—— 跨整个工程搜索接口并一键跳转到方法定义
  • Path-variable wildcard: typing /users/123 matches /users/{id}
    路径变量通配：输入 /users/123 可命中 /users/{id}
  • Filters: HTTP Method / Scope (project vs. all incl. dependencies) / Module
    筛选器：HTTP Method / 范围（工程代码 vs. 含依赖）/ 模块
  • Incremental paging for large codebases; manual refresh to rebuild index
    大型工程增量分页加载；支持手动刷新重建索引

📋 Copy Code Location

  • Select any code snippet → right-click → CoderTools → Copy Code Location, or press Ctrl+Alt+Shift+W
    选中任意代码片段 → 右键 → CoderTools → Copy Code Location，或按 Ctrl+Alt+Shift+W
  • Copies the file path and line:column range in AI-friendly format: src/main/java/Foo.java:10:5-25:3
    将文件相对路径和行列范围以 AI 友好格式复制到剪贴板：src/main/java/Foo.java:10:5-25:3

🏷️ Copy Field Name

  • Place the caret on (or select the name of) a getter/setter method such as getType() / setType() / isActive() and press Alt+Z — it resolves the actual backing field in the Bean (including inherited fields and Lombok-generated accessors) and copies its name (e.g. type, active)
    光标置于（或选中）getter/setter 方法名如 getType() / setType() / isActive()，按 Alt+Z —— 解析 Bean 中真实的字段（含继承字段、Lombok 生成的访问器）并复制其名称（如 type、active）
  • Resolves the field by name first; falls back to method-body analysis for non-conventional naming; works on method definitions, call sites, and selections
    先按名查找字段，找不到则分析方法体找真实字段；方法定义处、调用处、选中文本均可

🧩 Bean Fields Explorer

  • Right-click any Java class or press Ctrl+Alt+B → right-side panel shows all fields including inherited ones
    右键任意 Java 类或按 Ctrl+Alt+B → 右侧面板展示所有字段（含继承字段）
  • Fuzzy name search, type filter, modifier filter (public / static / final …), all AND-combined
    字段名模糊搜索、类型精确筛选、修饰词筛选，AND 组合实时过滤
  • Expandable nested object fields (up to 3 levels); double-click to navigate to declaration
    可展开嵌套对象字段（最深 3 层）；双击跳转到声明位置
  • Right-click any field → Copy Path (Ctrl+Shift+Alt+C, full path from root class qualified name) or Copy Field Name (Ctrl+C)
    右键任意字段 → 复制路径（Ctrl+Shift+Alt+C，从根类权限定名开始的完整路径）或 复制字段名（Ctrl+C）

⛓️ Chain Annotation

  • Press Ctrl+Alt+Shift+F or right-click → CoderTools → Annotate Chain Step to mark any line as a numbered step in a named chain
    按 Ctrl+Alt+Shift+F 或右键 → CoderTools → Annotate Chain Step，将任意代码行标记为命名链路的有序步骤
  • Steps visualized via colored gutter icons (step number) and after-line-end inlay hints (remark text)
    步骤通过彩色行号图标（序号）和行尾嵌入提示（备注）可视化
  • Navigate forward / backward: Ctrl+Alt+Shift+. / ,
    顺序 / 逆序跳转步骤：Ctrl+Alt+Shift+. / ,
  • Chains sidebar: create / rename / delete chains, edit remarks inline, copy PlantUML sequence diagram
    链路侧边栏：新建 / 重命名 / 删除链路，行内编辑备注，一键复制 PlantUML 时序图
  • Drag steps within a chain to reorder — whole-row drag with visual insertion line indicator; right-click step for Move Up / Down / Top / Bottom
    链路内步骤拖拽排序 —— 整行拖拽，带插入线视觉指示；右键支持上移 / 下移 / 置顶 / 置底
  • Drag a step's gutter icon in the editor to relocate it to another code line (same file); target line highlighted during drag, release to update
    在编辑器中拖拽步骤的行号图标即可将该步骤重定位到同文件的其他代码行，拖拽时目标行高亮，松开即更新行号

Example / 示例

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/users")
public class UserController {
    @GetMapping("/list")   // Copy URI → /api/users/list
    public List<User> list() { ... }
}

@FeignClient(name = "user-service", path = "/api/users")
public interface UserClient {
    @GetMapping("queryById")  // Copy URI → /api/users/queryById
    User queryById();
}
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.9.1 — Bean Fields Fixes & 2026.2 Compatibility

  • New: Chains visibility switches — a per-chain toggle switch on the right of each chain row shows / hides that chain's editor markup (line background, gutter icons, remarks), plus a global switch in the toolbar to toggle all chain markup at once; hidden chains are grayed out in the tree
    新增：Chains 展示开关 —— 每条链路行右侧的 Switch 开关控制该链路在编辑器中的标记（行背景色、gutter 图标、备注），工具栏另有全局开关一键控制所有链路标记；隐藏的链路在树中置灰
  • Improved: editor markup is now rendered for all visible chains at once — no need to select a chain first
    优化：编辑器现在同时渲染所有可见链路的标记，无需先选中某条链路
  • New: Bean Fields now drills into collection-typed fields — List<Foo> expands Foo's fields; Map<K, V> expands into distinct key / value nodes (value can be drilled further when it is a bean)
    新增：Bean Fields 支持集合类型字段下钻 —— List<Foo> 直接展开 Foo 的字段；Map<K, V> 展开为独立的 key / value 节点（value 为 bean 时可继续下钻）
  • Improved: when no chain exists, annotating a step now opens the chooser with the + New Chain option instead of a hint popup; the inline new-chain editor is redesigned (rounded border, placeholder, Enter/Esc hint)
    优化：无链路时添加步骤会弹出含「新建链路」的选择框，不再是提示弹窗；新建链路的内联编辑器重新设计（圆角边框、占位提示、Enter/Esc 快捷键提示）
  • Fix: choosing New Chain while annotating now adds the pending step to the newly created chain (previously the step was lost); removed the duplicated "+" in the chooser row
    修复：添加步骤时选择「新建链路」会把本次步骤一并加入新链路（此前步骤会丢失）；修复选择框中「+」图标与文本重复的问题
  • Fix: Bean Fields panel now auto-loads the current class's fields when the tool window opens, and reloads each time the window is shown
    修复：Bean Fields 面板在工具窗口打开时自动加载当前类的字段，每次显示窗口时自动刷新
  • Fix: the refresh button works reliably again — non-blocking read actions could be silently canceled on the EDT, so refresh appeared to do nothing
    修复：刷新按钮恢复可用 —— 此前 nonBlocking 读操作在 EDT 上可能被静默取消，导致刷新无反应
  • Fix: refresh falls back to the first top-level class when the caret is outside any class body
    修复：光标不在类体内时，刷新回退加载文件中的第一个顶层类
  • Fix: replaced all on-EDT ReadAction.nonBlocking().executeSynchronously() calls and wrapped bare PSI access in read actions (Chains markup refresh / step annotating / gutter drag, Copy URI, Copy cURL, Copy Field Name, Search URI navigation, Search in Method) — these throw "Access from Event Dispatch Thread (EDT) is not allowed" or "Read access is allowed from inside read-action only" on 2026.2
    修复：替换所有在 EDT 上执行的 ReadAction.nonBlocking().executeSynchronously()，并为裸 PSI 访问补上读动作（Chains 高亮刷新 / 添加链路步骤 / gutter 拖拽、Copy URI、Copy cURL、Copy Field Name、Search URI 跳转、方法内搜索）—— 这些代码在 2026.2 会直接抛线程访问异常
  • Compatibility: verified on IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2 (build 262.*)
    兼容：适配 IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2（build 262.*）

1.9.0 — Search in Method

  • New: Search in Method (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+X) — a compact find bar docks at the top of the editor (like the built-in Find bar) and searches only within the current method; the method scope is highlighted with a background
    新增：方法内搜索（Ctrl+Alt+Shift+X）—— 查找条停靠在编辑器顶部（与自带查找条一致），仅在当前方法作用域内搜索；方法区间带背景高亮
  • Live search as you type, match count (current/total), previous / next navigation with wrap-around (Enter = next, Shift+Enter = previous), and a regex toggle
    输入即实时搜索，显示匹配数（当前/总数），支持上一个 / 下一个导航与回绕（Enter = 下一个，Shift+Enter = 上一个），可切换正则匹配
  • Esc or clicking outside closes the bar and clears all highlights
    Esc 或点击外部关闭查找条并清除全部高亮
  • Fix: Bean Fields / Chains tool windows failed to open (blank + error) because the custom theme-aware icon did not implement the platform's ScalableIcon interface; now uses the platform icon loading which resolves the dark variant automatically
    修复：Bean Fields / Chains 工具窗口打不开（空白+报错）——自定义主题图标未实现平台 ScalableIcon 接口所致；现改用平台图标加载，自动按主题解析深色变体

1.8.2 — Theme-aware Tool Window Icons

  • Updated: Bean Fields and Chains tool window icons now use the redesigned artwork and switch automatically between the light and dark variants based on the IDE theme
    更新：Bean Fields 与 Chains 工具窗口图标采用重新设计的图标，并根据 IDEA 主题自动切换浅色 / 深色版本
  • Improved: the theme is evaluated at paint time, so switching between Light / Dark / High Contrast themes takes effect immediately without restarting the IDE
    改进：主题在渲染时判定，Light / Dark / 高对比度主题之间切换后图标立即生效，无需重启 IDE
  • Tests: added checks that the light icons use dark strokes, the dark icons use bright strokes, and that both variants stay distinct
    测试：新增校验——浅色图标使用深色描边、深色图标使用亮色描边，且两套图标不得相同

1.8.1 — New Icons, Global Search Enhancements & Compatibility

  • New: brand-new plugin logo and redesigned tool window icons for Bean Fields and Chains (SVG, with light/dark variants)
    新增：全新的插件图标，并重设计了 Bean Fields 与 Chains 两个工具窗口图标（SVG，含深浅色两套）
  • New: Global Search YAML gains a search scope filter, properties-file key support, keyboard navigation and performance improvements
    新增：全局搜索 YAML 支持搜索范围过滤、properties 文件 key、键盘导航与性能优化
  • Fix: migrated deprecated/removed platform APIs and set UTF-8 source encoding, improving compatibility with recent IDE versions
    修复：迁移已废弃/待删除的平台 API 并设置 UTF-8 源码编码，提升对较新 IDE 版本的兼容性

1.8.0 — YAML Toolkit

  • New: Search YAML Key (Ctrl+Alt+G) — in a YAML file, type the properties-style full path of a key (e.g. server.port) and press Enter to jump to and highlight the matching config item; the search bar appears at the top of the editor
    新增：YAML 键搜索（Ctrl+Alt+G）—— 在 YAML 文件中输入 properties 风格的全路径（如 server.port），回车即可跳转并高亮对应配置项；搜索条出现在编辑器顶部
  • New: Global Search YAML (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+G) — search a key path across all .yml / .yaml files in the project; the result list shows files on the left and a highlighted preview on the right, right-click a file to open it in the editor
    新增：全局搜索 YAML（Ctrl+Alt+Shift+G）—— 跨项目内所有 .yml / .yaml 搜索键全路径；左侧展示文件列表，右侧高亮预览，右键文件即可在编辑器中打开定位
  • Improve: Global Search YAML — scope filter (whole project / module subdirectory / resources directory), also searches .properties files, keyboard navigation (Enter to search, then ↑/↓ to switch files and Enter to jump), background search with loading indicator, and much faster via the file-type index
    优化：全局搜索 YAML —— 新增范围筛选（整个项目 / 模块·子目录 / 资源目录），支持 .properties 文件，键盘操作（回车搜索后 ↑/↓ 切换文件、回车跳转），后台搜索带加载动画，基于文件类型索引速度大幅提升
  • New: Convert to YAML — select properties-format text (e.g. server.port=8080) and right-click → CoderTools → Convert to YAML to rewrite it as YAML in place
    新增：转换为 YAML —— 选中 properties 格式文本（如 server.port=8080），右键 → CoderTools → Convert to YAML 即可原地转换为 YAML
  • New: Insert YAML Config (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+M) — input config in Properties or YAML format and insert it into the correct nesting/indentation position of the current YAML file; existing keys are overwritten
    新增：插入 YAML 配置（Ctrl+Alt+Shift+M）—— 以 Properties 或 YAML 格式输入配置，智能插入到当前 YAML 文件的正确层级与缩进位置，已存在的键会被覆盖

1.7.3 — Random Chain Color

  • New: newly created chains are assigned a random color from the preset palette instead of the default gray, making it easier to tell multiple chains apart
    新增：新建链路不再固定为默认灰色，而是从预设色板中随机分配颜色，便于区分多条链路

1.7 — Bean Fields Copy & Chain Quick Add

  • New: In the Bean Fields panel, right-click any field (or use shortcuts) to Copy Path (Ctrl+Shift+Alt+C) — copies the full path from the root class qualified name down to the selected field, e.g. com.example.A->b->c; or Copy Field Name (Ctrl+C) — copies just the field name
    新增：在 Bean Fields 面板中，右键任意字段（或使用快捷键）复制路径（Ctrl+Shift+Alt+C）—— 复制从根类权限定名到选中字段的完整路径，如 com.example.A->b->c；或 复制字段名（Ctrl+C）—— 仅复制字段名
  • New: The Annotate Chain Step chooser popup now has a "+ New Chain" entry at the bottom — select it and press Enter to instantly create a new chain in the Chains sidebar
    新增：标注链路步骤选择弹窗底部新增 "+ 新建链路" 条目，选中后回车即可在链路侧边栏中直接新建链路

1.6.1 — Copy Field Name

  • New: Copy Field Name (Alt+Z) — place the caret on (or select) a getter/setter method such as getType() / setType() / isActive(); resolves the actual backing field in the Bean (including inherited fields and Lombok-generated accessors) and copies its name (e.g. type, active)
    新增：Copy Field Name（Alt+Z）—— 光标置于（或选中）getter/setter 方法名如 getType() / setType() / isActive()，解析 Bean 中真实字段（含继承字段、Lombok 访问器）并复制其名称（如 type、active）
  • Resolves the field by name first; falls back to method-body analysis for non-conventional naming; works on method definitions, call sites, and selections
    先按名查找字段，找不到则分析方法体找真实字段；方法定义处、调用处、选中文本均可

1.6.0 — Gutter Step Drag & Relocate

  • New: Drag a chain step's gutter icon (the step number on the left of the editor) to relocate the step to another code line within the same file; the target line is highlighted during the drag, and releasing the mouse updates the step's line number
    新增：拖拽编辑器左侧链路步骤的行号图标，即可将该步骤重定位到同文件的其他代码行；拖拽过程中目标行高亮显示，松开鼠标即更新步骤行号

1.5.3 — Chain Import & Export

  • New: Chain Import & Export — import/export chains as JSON; same-name chains auto-suffixed on import
    新增：链路导入与导出 —— 支持 JSON 格式的链路导入 / 导出，导入时同名链路自动加后缀去重

idea-plugin.name: SwitchEnvironments
idea-plugin.description:
A powerful IntelliJ IDEA plugin for managing environment variables with group support and beautiful UI.

Features

  • 🗂️ Group Management: Organize environment variables into logical groups
  • ✅ Group Activation Control: Enable/disable entire groups
  • 📥 Multi-format Import: Import variables from .env, .properties, and .txt files
  • 💾 Persistent Storage: All settings are saved automatically
  • 🔧 Easy Management: Add, edit, and delete variables with simple dialogs
  • 🌍 Global View: Special first group shows all active variables
  • 📚 Project Isolation: data is isolated between different projects and does not affect each other

Usage

Accessing the Plugin

  • Tool Window: View → Tool Windows → Environment Variables
  • Menu: Tools → Environment Variables → Open Environment Manager

Managing Groups

  1. Add Group: Click the "+" button in the group toolbar
  2. Edit Group: Select a group and click the edit button
  3. Delete Group: Select a group and click the "-" button
  4. Activate/Deactivate: Use checkboxes in settings or edit group dialog
  5. Import/Export: Click the "⚙️" button in the group toolbar
  6. Sort: Long-press and drag with the left mouse button to move it

Built-in Groups

  • Env：Read-only view of all active variables from enabled groups

Managing Variables

  1. Add Variable: Select a group (not built-in groups), then click "+" in the variables toolbar
  2. Edit Variable: Double-click a variable or select and click edit button
  3. Delete Variable: Select a variable and click "-" button
  4. Variables are automatically active when their group is active
  5. Import: Select a group (not built-in groups), then click "Import File" button

License

Apache 2.0 License

Donation

If you like this plugin, you can buy me a cup of coffee. Thank you!
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Added

  • support import .sh env

Fixed

  • Solve the problem of sorting
  • Optimize the display of editing dialog window

idea-plugin.name: CodeGenerate4J
idea-plugin.description:
SQL DDL to MyBatis / MyBatis-Plus / JPA CRUD code.

Paste a CREATE TABLE script into the CodeGenerate4J tool window and get a complete CRUD backend layer for MyBatis, MyBatis-Plus or JPA — then bend the output to your own conventions with editable Velocity templates. Everything runs offline inside IntelliJ IDEA.

Highlights

  • Three frameworks, one click apart — built-in template sets for MyBatis, MyBatis-Plus and JPA (Spring Data), switchable per generation.
  • Custom templates you actually own — clone any of the 24 built-in Velocity templates and edit them inside the IDE, with syntax highlighting and syntax validation on save. Add or remove template files freely; your templates live in the IDE config directory and are never touched by plugin updates.
  • Four SQL dialects — generic DDL, MySQL, PostgreSQL and Oracle PL-SQL parsers; handles real exported scripts with backticks.
  • Nine CRUD methods, individually configurable — page query, list query, detail, save, batch save, update, batch update, delete, batch delete. Each one can be switched off and given its own method name, API path and HTTP verb.
  • Straight into your project — write the result into src/main/java and src/main/resources following the package name, export it to any directory, or just copy the current file. Existing files are listed first and only overwritten after you confirm.
  • YAML ⇄ Properties — two-way conversion that keeps nested structures and multi-document YAML, from the tool window or the editor context menu.
  • Fully offline — no account, no login, no network requests. Your SQL stays on your machine.

中文说明

粘贴建表 SQL，一键生成 MyBatis、MyBatis-Plus、JPA 三种框架的 CRUD 后端代码， 并能按自己的规范改写 Velocity 模板。全程在 IDEA 内离线运行。

  • 三种框架：内置 MyBatis、MyBatis-Plus、JPA（Spring Data）三套模板，生成时随时切换。
  • 真正能改的自定义模板：24 个内置 Velocity 模板可一键克隆，在 IDE 里直接编辑， 带语法高亮、保存时自动做 Velocity 语法校验；模板文件可自由增删。自定义模板存放在 IDEA 配置目录， 插件升级不会覆盖你的改动。
  • 四种 SQL 方言：通用 DDL、MySQL、PostgreSQL、Oracle PL-SQL；能处理带反引号的真实导出脚本。
  • 九个 CRUD 方法，逐个可配：分页查询、列表查询、查询详情、新增、批量新增、更新、批量更新、 删除、批量删除；每个方法都能单独开关，并自定义方法名、接口路径与请求方式。
  • 直接写进工程：按包名写入 src/main/java 与 src/main/resources，也可导出到任意目录， 或只复制当前文件；目标位置有同名文件时先列清单，确认后才覆盖。
  • YAML ⇄ Properties 互转：双向转换，支持嵌套结构与多文档 YAML；工具窗口内操作， 也可在文件上右键一键转换。
  • 完全离线：不需要注册登录，不发起任何网络请求，SQL 不出本机。
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.3
  • Fixed: the generated-code preview, the template preview and the template editor could not be scrolled. The embedded editors lost their vertical/horizontal scrollbars as soon as their content was replaced (e.g. after generating, picking another file, or selecting another template) — long code could not be reached any more. Scrolling is now enabled on every editor rebuild, so wheel, drag and scrollbar all work again.
  • Fixed: the same cause also made the YAML <-> Properties output area unscrollable after a conversion.
  • Fixed: Ctrl/Cmd+Enter stopped working in the template editor and SQL input after switching files or templates; the shortcut is now bound to each new editor.
1.0.2
  • First public release.
  • Generate MyBatis-Plus / MyBatis / JPA CRUD code from CREATE TABLE DDL.
  • Custom Velocity templates: clone the built-in ones and edit freely.
  • YAML <-> Properties conversion, from the tool window or the editor context menu.

idea-plugin.name: DrawableXhdpi
idea-plugin.description:
Quickly and easily convert images into images of various densities (LDPI, MDPI, HDPI, XHDPI, XXHDPI, XXXHDPI) used by Android. UI designers do not need to spend a lot of time to adapt multi-density mobile phone images


Author: Yujin Chen


Github

issues(issues)
Xhdpi image conversion, the ability to convert any Android Drawable format


"ldpi", "mdpi", "hdpi", "xhdpi","xxhdpi", "xxxhdpi"
For example, if my artist has designed a phone with an xhdpi resolution, I can use AndroidDrawable to convert this xhdpi into "ldpi", "mdpi", "hdpi", "xhdpi","xxhdpi", "xxxhdpi"

DrawableXhdpi usage



1. Search for "AndroidDrawableXhdpi" in the Android studio plugin tool and install it, then restart Android studio

2. Click Tools to find DrawableXhdpi you can also quickly launch Windows shortcuts Ctrl+Shift+D

3.
1). Click add image to add image to be converted

2). Select the image conversion storage path

3) set up the need to convert file density, total "ldpi", "mdpi", "hdpi", "xhdpi", "xxhdpi", "xxxhdpi" six density selected

that is, the image was first designed according to which density

4). Check the density that you want to convert

5). Start conversion


3.


快速方便的将图片转换成Android 使用的各个密度（ldpi、 mdpi、 hdpi、xhdpi、xxhdpi、xxxhdpi）的图片，不需要UI设计人员花费大量的时间来进行多密度手机图片的适配


作者：陈渝金


开源地址

问题反馈(issues)
xhdpi图片转换，能任意转换Android Drawable下的各种规格格式


"ldpi", "mdpi", "hdpi", "xhdpi","xxhdpi", "xxxhdpi"
比如我的美工人员设计了一个图片适合 xhdpi 分辨率的手机，我可以通过AndroidDrawable将这个xhdpi转换成 "ldpi", "mdpi", "hdpi", "xhdpi","xxhdpi", "xxxhdpi"的图片

DrawableXhdpi 使用方式



1.在Android studio 插件工具处搜索“DrawableXhdpi”并且安装，然后重启Android studio

2.点击Tools找到DrawableXhdpi 你也可以快捷启动windows系统快捷键 Ctrl+Shift+D

3.
1).点击添加图片，添加需要转换的图片

2).选择图片转换的存放路径

3).设置需要转换的文件密度，共"ldpi", "mdpi", "hdpi", "xhdpi","xxhdpi", "xxxhdpi"六个密度选择

也就是这个图片最先设计是按照哪种密度设计

4).勾选需要转换结果的密度

5).开始转换

See also the README and the user guide.

idea-plugin.name: Next Gen Kotlin Code Sorter
idea-plugin.description:
Next Gen Kotlin Code Sorter

Sorts by the following order (Shortcut: Option + Command + s)

  • PrimaryConstructor

    The primary constructor is sorted by this order in addition to alphabetically:

    • Modifier-less param e.g preferences: Preferences
    • val param
    • var param
    • private val param

    • private var param

      The sorting maintains the integrity of the constructor i.e annotations etc. Constructor params that span more than one line before sorting, will each be put on a new line on sorting completion e.g

       constructor(
      private a,private b
 )

      would become: 

       constructor(
      private a,
      private b,
 )

      NB: A trailing comma automatically gets added to sorted constructor.

  • Properties and Fields

    • Private
    • Protected
    • Internal
    • Public
      • Constants
      • Mutable
      • Immutable
        • Injected Properties
        • LateInit Properties
        • Delegated Properties
          • Android Views
          • RxBehaviourSubject
          • RxObservable
          • RxCompletable
          • RxSingle
          • MutableStateFlow
          • Flow
          • SharedFlow
          • StateFlow
          • Other Properties

  • Secondary Constructor

    • All secondary constructors are sorted by the number of parameters they have in ascending order.

  • Init

  • Functions

    • Public
    • Internal
    • Protected
    • Private
      • Lifecycle functions
      • Override Functions
      • Other Functions
      • Extension Functions

  • Classes and Interfaces

    • Inner Classes
    • Regular class
    • Interfaces

  • Companion object

idea-plugin.name: Kunpeng Development Framework
idea-plugin.description:
The Kunpeng Development Framework Plugin/鲲鹏开发框架插件 optimizes the performance of the basic software library and improves the performance competitiveness of common software libraries on the Kunpeng platform.

The Kunpeng Development Framework Plugin/鲲鹏开发框架插件 provides the following three acceleration policies based on Kunpeng processors:

  • Provides hardware acceleration solutions for common algorithms such as encryption, decryption, and compression.
  • Uses Kunpeng high-performance instructions to improve the performance of the basic software library.
  • Accelerates and optimizes the algorithms of video encoding and decoding, signal processing, and storage network libraries.

In-depth acceleration has been performed on the common software libraries based on the three acceleration policies. The optimized library interfaces remain unchanged. The target libraries include the system libraries, media libraries, encryption and decryption libraries, compression libraries, and math libraries.


Category Type Description Operation
Compression libraries gzip Data prefetch, loop unrolling, and CRC instruction replacement are used to improve the compression and decompression rates of gzip-1.10 on the Kunpeng platform, especially the compression and decompression of text files. View
zstd NEON instructions, inline assembly, and memory prefetch, adjusted code structure, and optimized instruction pipeline layout are used to improve the compression and decompression rates of zstd-1.4.4 on the Kunpeng platform.
snappy Inline assembly, high-bit instructions, optimized CPU pipeline, and memory prefetch are used to improve the compression and decompression rates of snappy-1.1.7 on the Kunpeng platform.
KAEzip KAEzip is the compression module of the Kunpeng acceleration engine. It uses the Kunpeng hardware acceleration module to implement the deflate algorithm and works with the lossless user-mode driver framework to provide an interface for high-performance compression in gzip or zlib format.
Encryption and decryption libraries KAE encryption and decryption The Kunpeng hardware acceleration module implements the RSA, SM3, SM4, DH, MD5, and AES algorithms, provides high-performance symmetric and asymmetric encryption and decryption based on the lossless user-mode driver framework. It is compatible with OpenSSL 1.1.1a and later versions and supports synchronous and asynchronous mechanisms. View
System libraries glibc-patch The memory, string, and lock are optimized and accelerated based on the microarchitecture of Huawei Kunpeng 920 processors. View
hyperscan Kunpeng instructions are used to accelerate the compilation and scanning performance of regular expressions based on the advantages of the Kunpeng micro-architecture.
AvxToNeon AvxToNeon is an interface collection library. Kunpeng acceleration instructions are used to adapt to the GCC intrinsic built-in functions defined by the traditional platform, so that applications that use the intrinsic interface of the traditional platform can be smoothly ported to the Kunpeng platform.
Media libraries x265-patch Kunpeng acceleration instructions are used to reconstruct the transcoding core code of the x265 open-source library. The transcoding performance can be improved on the Kunpeng platform without changing the original interfaces and algorithms. The underlying x265 transcoding operators are accelerated and optimized by using the Kunpeng vector instruction to improve the transcoding performance in FFmpeg video transcoding scenarios. View
HW265 HW265 is a Huawei-developed H.265 video encoder that complies with the H.265/HEVC video encoding standard and uses the NEON instructions of Kunpeng processors for acceleration. HW265 supports four preset encoding levels that correspond to application scenarios with different encoding speeds. The bit rate control supports the average bit rate (ABR) and constant QP (CQP) modes. The functions cover various scenarios such as live TV and VOD. The overall performance of HW265 is better than that of mainstream open source software.
HMPP Kunpeng Hyper Media Performance Primitives (HMPP) provides functions for allocating and releasing vector buffers, vector initialization, vector mathematical operations, vector statistics operations, vector sampling and conversion, filtering functions, as well as transform (such as fast fourier transform) functions. It complies with the IEEE 754 (a technical standard for floating-point arithmetic) and can be used on the Kunpeng platform.
Math libraries KML_FFT Based on the Kunpeng architecture, KML_FFT deeply optimizes the fast fourier transform (FFT) by using vectorization and algorithm improvement, which greatly improves the performance of the FFT interface functions View
KML_BLAS Based on the Kunpeng architecture, KML_BLAS performs in-depth mining on the computing efficiency of BLAS by means of vectorization, data prefetch, compilation optimization, and data rearrangement. As a result, the performance of BLAS interface functions approaches the theoretical peak.
KML_SPBLAS Based on the instruction set and architecture features of Kunpeng, KML_SPBLAS develops a high-performance sparse matrix operation library to improve the service performance of HPC and big data solutions
KML_MATH KML_MATH provides functions with high performance that is based on Kunpeng processors by means of periodic function reduction and algorithm improvement.
KML_VML KML_VML performs vectorization on input data by using methods such as NEON instruction optimization and inline assembly. It uses the register features in the Kunpeng architecture to improve the performance of Kunpeng processors.
KML_LAPACK KML_LAPACK optimizes the LAPACK based on the Kunpeng architecture by means of block division, algorithm combination, multithreading, and Basic Linear Algebra Subprograms (BLAS) interface optimization, improving the performance of Kunpeng processors.

The Kunpeng Development Framework Plugin/鲲鹏开发框架插件 provides the following functions:

  • You can download the plugin from the JetBrains Marketplace and install it online.
  • Performance acceleration
    During coding, the function dictionary of the Kunpeng Development Framework Plugin/鲲鹏开发框架插件 is automatically matched. The libraries and functions in the dictionary that can be re-placed supports association and are highlighted. In addition, pop-up windows providing details are displayed when you move the cursor onto the libraries and functions.
    The plugin scans the functions or assembly instructions that can be replaced by the functions or assembly optimized by the Kunpeng Development Framework Plugin/鲲鹏开发框架插件 in a code file, and generates a visualized report.

idea-plugin.name: Kunpeng Porting Advisor
idea-plugin.description:
The Kunpeng Porting Advisor Plugin/鲲鹏代码迁移插件 automatically scans and analyzes the software to be ported and provides professional porting guidance.

  • One-click deployment

    • You can download the plugin from the JetBrains Marketplace and install it online, and deploy the server environment by simply clicking the mouse.


  • Analysis and scanning

    • The plugin scans and analyzes software packages and source code files, and provides porting feasibility reports.


  • Code porting

    • The plugin analyzes the cross-platform compatibility of software source code, identifies the code to be ported, and provides porting guidance.

Version Mapping

This plug-in needs to run with the background service, which must be installed on Kunpeng-powered servers. The version mapping is as follows:
Plug-in Version Background Version
23.0.1 23.0.RC2
23.0.0 23.0.RC1
2.5.6 2.5.0.1
2.5.5 2.5.T30
2.5.3 2.5.0
2.5.2 2.5.T20
2.5.1 2.5.RC1
2.5.0 2.5.T10
2.3.5 2.3.T21
2.3.3 2.3.0
2.3.2 2.3.T20
2.3.1 2.3.T10
2.2.8 2.2.T4
2.2.7 2.2.T4
2.2.6 2.2.1
2.2.5 2.2.T3
You can use either of the following method to obtain the background version:
  1. Use the one-click deployment function of the plug-in to automatically install it.
  2. Go to the Kunpeng Community to obtain the background service installation package and installation method.

Introduction to the Kunpeng Porting Advisor

The Kunpeng Porting Advisor functions as a client to call the functions of the server to complete scanning and porting tasks. It quickly scans and analyzes the software to be ported and provides professional code porting guidance, greatly simplifying the process of porting applications to the Kunpeng platform. This tool addresses the problems of heavy workload, low accuracy, and poor overall efficiency in manual analysis.


The Kunpeng Porting Advisor provides the following functions:

  • Software porting assessment

    • Scans and analyzes software packages (not source code packages) and installed software, and provides porting assessment reports.

  • Source code porting

    • The Kunpeng Porting Advisor can automatically check and analyze users' source code, C/C++ software build project files, link libraries used by C/C++ software build project files, and content that needs to be modified in x86 assembly code. It provides automatic code compatibility check, removes the dependency on manual expertise in code porting, and increases accuracy and efficiency in code compilation and debugging.

  • Software Package rebuild

    • Analyzes the x86 software package (in RPM or DEB format) structure and hardware dependency, and rebuilds the software package applicable to the Kunpeng platform.

  • Dedicated software porting

    • Modifies, compiles, and builds software packages based on the software porting template of the Kunpeng solution, facilitating software porting.

  • Kunpeng Affinity Analysis

    • Provides static checks of software code quality, including 64-bit mode compatibility check, structure byte alignment check, cache line alignment check, memory consistency check, and calculation precision analysis.

idea-plugin.name: Kunpeng Hyper Tuner
idea-plugin.description:
Supports system profiling and Java profiling on the Kunpeng platform, performs system-level and scenario-specific performance data sampling and analysis, and provides tuning suggestions.

  • One-click deployment

    You can download the plugin from the JetBrains Marketplace, install it online, and deploy the server environment by simply clicking the mouse.

  • System Profiler

    The tool collects system data of Kunpeng-powered servers, analyzes system configuration and performance metrics, accurately locates performance bottlenecks and hotspot functions, and provides one-stop analysis reports, multi-dimensional data association, and tuning suggestions.

  • Java Profiler

    The tool graphically displays the heap, thread, lock, and garbage collection information about Java programs running on Kunpeng-powered servers, collects hotspot functions, and locates performance bottlenecks to help users take proper tuning measures.

Version Mapping

This plugin needs to run with the background service, which must be installed on Kunpeng-powered servers. The version mapping is as follows:
Plug-in Version Background Version
23.0.1 23.0.RC2
23.0.0 23.0.RC1
2.5.6 2.5.0.1
2.5.5 2.5.T30
2.5.0 2.5.0
2.3.5 2.5.RC1.1
2.3.3 2.3.T10
2.3.2 2.3.T10

You can use either of the following method to obtain the background version:

  1. Use the one-click deployment function of the plug-in to automatically install it.
  2. Go to the Kunpeng Community to obtain the background service installation package and installation method.

Introduction to the System Profiler

The System Profiler is a system performance analysis tool for Kunpeng-powered servers. It collects performance data of processor hardware, operating system, processes or threads, and functions, analyzes system performance metrics, locates system bottlenecks and hotspot functions, and provides tuning suggestions. This tool helps you quickly locate and handle software performance problems.

The System Profiler provides the following functions:

  • Overall analysis

    The tool collects the software and hardware configuration information of the entire system and the running status of system resources, such as CPU, memory, storage I/O, and network I/O, to obtain the performance metrics such as resource usage, saturation, and errors. The performance metrics help users identify system bottlenecks. Based on the existing reference values and tuning experience, the tool provides tuning suggestions for certain system metrics. In addition, the tool checks the hardware configuration, system configuration, and component configuration in big data and software-defined storage scenarios, displays the configuration items that are not optimal, and analyzes and provides typical hardware configuration and software version information.

  • Resource scheduling analysis

    The tool analyzes system resource scheduling based on CPU scheduling events. In detail, it analyzes:

    • The running status, such as Idle or Running, of the CPU core at each time point. If a CPU core is in the Running state, information about processes or threads running on the CPU core and the duration proportion of each status can be associated.
    • The running status of processes or threads at each time point, which can be Wait, Schedule, and Running, and the duration proportion of each status.
    • Process/thread switching information, including the number of switches, average scheduling delay, minimum scheduling delay, and maximum delay time.
    • The number of times that each process or thread switches between different non-uniform memory access (NUMA) nodes. If the number of switches is greater than the reference value, core binding suggestions will be provided.
  • Microarchitecture analysis

    The tool obtains the running status of instructions on the CPU pipeline based on the ARM Performance Monitor Unit (PMU) event. It helps users quickly locate the performance bottleneck of the current application on the CPU and modify the program to maximize the utilization of hardware resources.

  • Memory access analysis

    By analyzing the events related to the CPU's access to the cache and memory, the tool identifies potential performance bottlenecks on memory access, locates the possible causes, and provides the corresponding tuning suggestions.

    • Memory access statistics analysis: The tool accesses the PMU events of the cache and memory and analyzes the number of storage access times, hit rate, and bandwidth.
    • Miss event analysis: This function is implemented based on the ARM Statistical Profiling Extension (SPE) capability. SPE samples instructions and records event triggering information, including accurate PC pointer information. By using SPE, the tool analyzes miss events, such as LLC Miss, TLB Miss, Remote Access, and Long Latency Load, and accurately identifies the code that causes the events. Based on the analysis information, users can modify their programs to reduce the probability of certain events and improve the performance of their programs.
    • Pseudo sharing analysis: This function is implemented based on the ARM SPE capability. SPE samples instructions and records event triggering information, including accurate PC pointer information. By using SPE for false sharing analysis on services, the tool obtains information about the number and proportion of false sharing times, instruction addresses, code line numbers, and NUMA nodes. Based on the information, users can modify their programs to reduce the probability of false sharing and improve the performance of their programs.
  • Process/Thread performance analysis

    The tool collects information about the resources (such as CPU, memory, and storage I/O) consumed by processes or threads to obtain the performance metrics such as the utilization, saturation, and errors. The performance metrics help users identify process or thread bottlenecks. Based on the existing reference values and tuning experience, the tool provides tuning suggestions for certain system metrics. The tool also analyzes the system calling information for a single process.

  • Locks and waits

    The tool analyzes the lock and wait functions (including sleep, usleep, mutex, cond, spinlock, rwlock, and semaphore) of glibc and open-source software such as MySQL and Open MP, associates the processes and call sites to which the lock and wait functions belong, and provides tuning suggestions based on the existing tuning experience.

  • Hotspot Function Analysis

    The tool analyzes C/C++ program code, identifies performance bottlenecks, and displays hotspot functions, source code, and assembly instructions. The function call relationship can be displayed in flame graphs, and the tuning path is provided.

  • I/O analysis

    The tool analyzes block storage devices to obtain performance data such as the number of I/O operations, I/O data size, I/O queue depth, and I/O operation delay, and associates the data with specific I/O operations, processes, threads, call stacks, and I/O APIs of the application layer. Based on the I/O performance data, the tool provides tuning suggestions.

Introduction to the Java Profiler

The Java Profiler is a Java performance analysis and tuning tool for Kunpeng-powered servers. It graphically displays the heap,thread, lock, and garbage collection (GC) information about Java programs running on the servers, collects hotspot functions,and locates performance bottlenecks to help users take proper tuning measures.

The Java Profiler provides the following functions:

  • Profiling analysis

    Online profiling is to analyze the target Java virtual machine (JVM) and Java programs. The JVM performance analysis includes data about the internal JVM status, such as the heap, GC activities, and thread status. The Java program performance analysis includes analysis of called chains, hotspot functions, lock analysis, program thread status, and object distribution. JVM running data is obtained in an online manner using the agent for precise analysis. The major functions are as follows:

    • Real-time display of the JVM system status.
    • Real-time display of JVM information, including the heap size, GC activities, number of threads, number of loaded classes, and CPU usage.
    • By capturing heap snapshots, the tool analyzes the heap histogram distribution and dominator tree of an application at a certain time point and traces the reference relationship chain from each Java object in the heap memory to the GC root, helping locate potential memory problems; compares and analyzes heap snapshots at different time points and analyzes the changes of heap usage and allocation, helping users detect exceptions.
    • I/O analysis. The tool analyzes the file I/O, socket I/O latency, and consumed bandwidth in an online manner to identify hotspot I/O operations.
    • Java process/thread performance analysis.
    • Workload-related analysis for upper-layer applications.
    • Snapshots can be generated during online analysis of heap, I/O, and workload data. By comparing snapshots, the tool helps users detect the change trends of resources and service indicators and identify potential risks on resource leakage or performance indicator deterioration.
  • Sampling analysis

    The tool samples data of internal activities and performance events of the JVM and performs offline analysis through data recording and playback. This analysis features little overhead and has little impact on services. It applies to large Java programs. The major functions are as follows:

    • Display of the JVM system status.
    • Playback of recorded JVM information, including the heap size, GC activities, I/O consumption, and CPU usage.
    • By sampling objects with a long retention period, the tool enables users to analyze potential heap memory leakage in Java applications and locate possible causes.
    • The system provides reports and tuning suggestions on startup parameters and GC based on the sampling analysis records.
    • I/O analysis. The tool analyzes the file I/O, socket I/O latency, and consumed bandwidth in an online manner to identify hotspot I/O operations.
    • Java process/thread performance analysis.
    • Function performance analysis.

Disclaimer

  1. This plugin is intended for enterprise users who need to use the plugin for work. You can use this plugin for work in compliance with laws, regulations, and government policies.
  2. No individual or organization shall spread the plugin without the authorization of the plugin owner. You shall not delete the license information or other information in this plugin, or perform reverse engineering, disassembly, or decompilation on this plugin.
  3. Unless otherwise specified in laws, regulations, or contracts, this plugin is provided "AS IS" without warranties, guarantees or representations of any kind, either expressed or implied.
  4. This plugin is a beta version and is used only for the development and testing environment and open beta test (OBT). The feedback you obtain when you use this plugin is for reference only and does not constitute specific guidance or suggestions in any way or form.

idea-plugin.name: LSP4IJ
idea-plugin.description:
LSP4IJ is a free and open-source

  • Language Server protocol (LSP) client compatible with all flavours of IntelliJ.
  • Debug Adapter Protocol support with Debug Adapter Protocol Run/Debug configuration.

It allows you to integrate any language server that communicates with its client via stdio:

  • by developing an IntelliJ plugin with LSP extension points:
    • com.redhat.devtools.lsp4ij.server extension point to define a language server.
    • com.redhat.devtools.lsp4ij.languageMapping to associate an IntelliJ language with a language server definition.
  • by manually adding language server definitions, supporting custom server settings. This approach doesn't require developing a specific IntelliJ plugin.

LSP4IJ also provides:

  • an LSP Consoles view to tracks LSP requests, responses and notifications in a console:

If you select the language server node, you can configure it the same way as in the Language Servers preferences page

and use the left toolbar to Apply or Reset the settings.

  • a Language Servers preferences page to configure the LSP trace level, the debug port to use to debug language server:

You can find more documentation in:

  • the developer guide, providing step-by-step instructions on how to integrate a language server in LSP4J in an external IntelliJ plugin.
  • the User-defined language server documentation, explaining how to integrate a language server in LSP4J with few settings.
  • the user guide, which explains how to use LSP console and Language Server preferences.
  • the LSP Support overview, describing which LSP features are implemented, and how.

idea-plugin.name: Commit Message Support
idea-plugin.description:
Commit Message Support

A commit message support plugin for IntelliJ IDEA-based IDEs. It helps maintain consistent commit message formats and facilitates efficient commit creation.

Key Features

  • Provides standardized commit message templates
  • Intuitive commit type selection with emojis
  • Supports input for each commit message component (type, scope, title, body, related issues)
  • Supports Korean and English languages
  • Customizable settings
  • Stores reusable message history with timestamps

Requirements

  • IntelliJ IDEA-based IDE 2024.2 or later
  • JetBrains Runtime / JDK 21

Various Commit Types

  • ✨ feat: New feature development
  • ⚡ improve: Improvement of existing features
  • 🐛 fix: Bug fixes
  • 📝 docs: Documentation writing and modification
  • 💄 style: UI/UX design element changes (CSS, layout, components, etc.)
  • ♻ refactor: Code structure improvement (no feature changes)
  • ✅ test: Writing and enhancing test code
  • ⏪ revert: Reverting to previous commits
  • 🔧 etc: Other changes

How to Use

When committing to Git, you can write commit messages with the following structure using standardized templates:

  1. Select commit types (required)
  2. Specify change scope (optional)
  3. Enter commit title (required)
  4. Write detailed description (optional)
  5. Input related issue number (optional)

You can customize type display styles, default templates, and other settings to match your environment in IDE Settings.


This plugin was inspired by the following projects:

  • git-commit-message-helper
    Thanks to the original author for the inspiration for the basic idea and structure.

  • git-commit-message-helper-korean
    한국어 지원에 대한 아이디어를 제공해 주신 개발자분께 감사드립니다.

idea-plugin.name: Jinja2
idea-plugin.description:
Jinja2 template support for Ansible playbooks: syntax highlighting, rainbow brackets, completion, variable navigation, code folding, and diagnostics across .j2 templates and YAML var files.
  • Syntax highlighting and customizable color scheme for Jinja2 syntax
  • Rainbow bracket coloring
  • Code folding for for/if/macro/block/ call/filter/with/autoescape/ raw blocks and {# ... #} comments
  • Completion for control structures, built-in filters (with signatures and descriptions), and known variables
  • Go to declaration / Find Usages for variables, resolved across .j2 set statements, for-loop and macro/call parameters, and YAML variable files (group_vars, host_vars, role vars/defaults)
  • Diagnostics: unresolved variables are underlined, and unclosed tags / mismatched brackets are flagged with quick fixes
  • Quick Documentation (hover / Ctrl+Q) with a description, example, and a link to the official Jinja2 docs for every keyword and built-in filter
  • Go to Declaration on a variable defined in more than one place (e.g. overridden across group_vars/host_vars/role defaults) prompts you to pick which one
  • Smart typing: {%/{{/{# auto-close with their matching %}/}}/#}, and completing a block tag (if, for, macro, block, call, filter, with, autoescape, raw) immediately inserts its matching end... tag
  • Attribute completion and Go to Declaration for a variable backed by a YAML mapping (e.g. typing x. suggests y/z when group_vars/host_vars define x: {y: ..., z: ...}), including chained access like x.y.z
  • Ansible module completion, hover documentation, and diagnostics in task-shaped YAML (playbooks and role tasks/handlers), sourced from the project's own ansible-doc so results reflect the collections actually installed for that project. Only active in projects that look like Ansible projects (an ansible.cfg, a role layout, or a playbook-shaped YAML file); configure the ansible-doc/python interpreter path under Settings > Tools > Ansible Tools
  • Quick Documentation for ansible.cfg settings (hover a key = value line): description, type, default, and environment variable, sourced from ansible-config (the sibling of ansible-doc) - basic syntax highlighting for ansible.cfg comes along with it
  • Go to Declaration and Find Usages for Ansible roles referenced in a playbook's roles: list (short and map form) or via include_role/import_role, resolving to the role's tasks/main.yml/meta/main.yml/directory - aware of multiple roles/ directories in a monorepo

Requirements

  • An IntelliJ Platform IDE with the bundled YAML plugin (installed automatically - it's a declared plugin dependency)
  • Nothing else to configure for Jinja2 syntax highlighting/folding/completion/ navigation/diagnostics, or for ansible.cfg syntax highlighting and role navigation - these work out of the box in any project

Optional

  • All Ansible-aware features only activate in projects that look like Ansible projects (an ansible.cfg, a role layout, or a playbook-shaped YAML file) - nothing to configure for that detection, and it can be turned off entirely under Settings > Tools > Ansible Tools
  • Module completion, hover documentation, and unrecognized-module diagnostics, plus ansible.cfg setting documentation, additionally need a working ansible-doc (and its sibling ansible-config, resolved automatically) configured under Settings > Tools > Ansible Tools; without one configured, those two features simply stay inactive and everything else keeps working
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• 1.3.0: Quick Documentation for ansible.cfg settings (a new minimal ansible.cfg language with basic highlighting, sourced from ansible-config); Go to Declaration and Find Usages for roles referenced in a playbook (roles: list, short/map form, and include_role/import_role), monorepo-aware across multiple roles/ directories.
  • 1.2.0: Ansible module completion, hover documentation, and (conservative) unrecognized-module diagnostics in task-shaped YAML, sourced natively by shelling out to the project's own ansible-doc (no external plugin or language server required). Active only in projects that look like Ansible projects; configure ansible-doc/python interpreter paths under Settings > Tools > Ansible Tools.
  • 1.1.0: Code folding for block statements and comments; built-in filter completion with signatures/descriptions; unresolved-variable warnings; unclosed-tag and mismatched-bracket errors with quick fixes; for-loop and macro/call parameters are now resolvable variable declarations; Quick Documentation for keywords and filters, each linking to the matching section of the official Jinja2 docs; Go to Declaration now offers a chooser popup when a variable is defined in multiple places; typing an opening tag delimiter auto-closes it, and completing a block tag auto-inserts its matching end... tag; attribute completion and Go to Declaration for variables backed by a YAML mapping, including chained access (x.y.z).
  • 1.0.1: Removed use of a deprecated TextAttributesKey API; rainbow bracket and defined-variable colors are now supplied via a bundled default color scheme (no visual change).
  • 1.0.0: Initial release: Jinja2 syntax highlighting, rainbow brackets, completion, and cross-file variable navigation for Ansible playbooks.

idea-plugin.name: VibeSSH
idea-plugin.description:
Build here, run it on your server.

Sends the artifact your build just produced to an application managed by VibeSSH and restarts it - without leaving the IDE. A Minecraft plugin lands in plugins/ and the server comes back with it loaded.

Talks to the VibeSSH desktop application over a loopback endpoint on your own computer. Nothing here reaches a network, and the token is kept in the IDE's credential store rather than in a file in your project.

Requires VibeSSH 0.1.0-beta.17 or newer, running, with Settings - Claude and other assistants switched on.

idea-plugin.name: Markdown RTL
idea-plugin.description:
Seamless Right-to-Left (RTL) & Persian/Arabic Experience for Markdown

Markdown RTL transforms the built-in Markdown preview in IntelliJ IDEA and Android Studio into a first-class Right-to-Left writing and reading environment. Engineered specifically for Persian, Arabic, and bilingual documentation, it delivers intelligent bidirectional rendering without disrupting your code blocks.

Key Capabilities:

  • Smart BiDi Heuristics (Auto Mode): Automatically detects paragraph language and applies RTL alignment to Persian and Arabic prose while keeping pure English text LTR.
  • Native Offline Mermaid Diagrams: Renders ```mermaid fenced code blocks into crisp, interactive SVG diagrams completely offline without external plugins. Diagrams with pure English text use JetBrains Mono, while Persian/Arabic diagrams automatically utilize Vazirmatn with RTL text labels. Features Diagram/Source view toggling, one-click SVG/code copying, inline zoom (+ / −), and fullscreen pan-and-zoom inspection.
  • Smart YAML Front Matter Metadata Cards: Automatically parses document metadata headers (--- ... ---) into a styled card with bidirectional language detection, structured array badges, clickable URLs, and Raw YAML / Table toggles.
  • Strict Code Fence Isolation: Code blocks (pre, code), inline backticks, and technical tokens remain strictly Left-to-Right with isolated bidirectional formatting.
  • Bundled Vazirmatn & JetBrains Mono: Out-of-the-box typography featuring embedded high-legibility fonts (Regular & Bold) without requiring any operating system font installations.
  • Interactive Floating Bento Widget: Sleek, modern floating overlay in the preview window for live adjustments to font family, font size, line height, and Mermaid/Frontmatter toggles with zero lag.
  • Full Direction Control: Switch effortlessly between Auto BiDi, Force RTL, and Force LTR with keyboard shortcuts (⇧⌥R in editor, or ⌥E / ⌥R inside preview).
  • Enhanced Elements: Right-aligned bulleted and numbered lists, RTL blockquotes with themed accent borders, and proportional heading scales.

Source repository & issue tracker:
https://github.com/mahdiasd/MarkdownRTL
idea-plugin.change-notes:
What's New in Version 1.1.1

  • Native Mermaid Diagram Support: Renders ```mermaid fenced code blocks directly into crisp, interactive SVG diagrams completely offline without requiring external plugins. Features language-aware typography (JetBrains Mono for English, Vazirmatn for Persian/Arabic), Diagram/Source view toggling, one-click SVG/source copying, and fullscreen pan-and-zoom modal.
  • Security Hardening: Upgraded Mermaid integration to antiscript security level with strict script filtering and input sanitization, preventing XSS and unauthorized HTML injection.
  • Enhanced Android Studio & Multi-IDE Compatibility: Seamless Chromium JCEF preview provider resolution for Android Studio and modern JetBrains IDEs (2024.3+), supporting both modern and legacy provider classes without configuration corruption.
  • Instant State & Action Synchronization: Synchronized the in-preview Bento controller with IDE menu actions and keyboard shortcuts (⇧⌥R), eliminating setting desynchronization.
  • Context-Aware Actions: Menu actions and right-click shortcuts are strictly scoped to Markdown files, keeping general code editor menus clean.
  • Performance Optimization: Non-blocking background font discovery, conditional script loading, and debounced live preview updates.

What's New in Version 1.1.0

  • Native Mermaid Diagram Support: Renders ```mermaid fenced code blocks directly into crisp, interactive SVG diagrams completely offline without external plugins.
  • Smart Diagram Language Detection & Typography: Diagrams with pure English text default to JetBrains Mono, while diagrams containing Persian/Arabic automatically use Vazirmatn with RTL-aligned text labels.
  • Modern Interactive Card UI: Features a sleek toolbar to toggle between Diagram and Source views, copy SVG image, and copy source code.
  • Fullscreen Modal with Pan & Zoom: View complex architectural diagrams in a fullscreen overlay with mouse wheel zoom and drag-to-pan navigation.
  • Live Editing Resilience: Gracefully handles in-progress syntax errors during typing by preserving the last valid diagram render.
  • Bento Widget Quick Toggle: Easily enable or disable Mermaid diagram rendering on the fly via the floating bottom-left Bento controller.

What's New in Version 1.0.2

  • Smart YAML Front Matter Metadata Card (#1): Automatically detects and renders document metadata blocks (--- ... ---) as a styled interactive card with bidirectional (BiDi) language detection (RTL for Persian/Arabic, LTR for English/URLs).
  • Structured Array Badges & Direct Links: Formats tag and list items as visual badges and converts URLs into clickable web links.
  • Interactive Card Controls: Toggle between formatted Table View and Raw YAML, plus single-click copying to clipboard.
  • Robust Fallback Parser: Preserves freeform front matter text and gracefully handles CommonMark Setext H2 and HR edge cases without data loss.

What's New in Version 1.0.1

  • Seamless Viewport Positioning: Fixed Bento widget positioning in IntelliJ IDEA and Android Studio so it stays smoothly docked at the bottom-left during page scrolling.
  • Comfortable Bento Dimensions: Enlarged trigger button, popover card, font pickers, and metric steppers for enhanced legibility and touch/click ergonomics.
  • Settings Simplification: Cleaned up IDE settings to make the in-preview Bento controller the single responsive source of truth for direction and typography.
  • Branding Unification: Unified plugin display name to Markdown RTL across all settings and dialogs.

Version 1.0.0

  • Official Release: Comprehensive RTL and Persian/Arabic support for JetBrains IDEs and Android Studio.
  • Interactive Floating Controller: Added sleek bottom-left floating widget with quick toggles and searchable font comboboxes.
  • Live Typography Tuning: Real-time font size and line height stepper controls with instant preview synchronization.
  • Embedded Fonts: Bundled premium Vazirmatn and JetBrains Mono.
  • Code Isolation: Strict BiDi isolation preventing syntax distortion in code blocks and inline snippets.

idea-plugin.description:
This plugin has been deprecated in favor of the bundled Settings Sync plugin.

It will no longer be maintained (except for security patches). Community pull-requests, however, are welcome via https://github.com/JetBrains/intellij-community.

Related feature requests in Settings Sync:

  • Sharing settings between team members: IDEA-309002
  • Custom synchronization endpoint: IDEA-318537


Supports sharing settings between installations of IntelliJ Platform-based products used by the same developer (or team) on different computers.

Synchronization is performed automatically after successful completion of "Update Project" or "Push" actions. Also, you can do sync using VCS -> Sync Settings.

See the Share settings through a settings repository for more info.

idea-plugin.name: GitLive
idea-plugin.description:
Don't let merge conflicts dictate your workflow.

Are branching strategies designed to avoid conflicts slowing you and your team down?

If you are assigning every developer a separate feature to build be prepared for knowledge silos and individual features shipping no faster than they would with a single developer.

Whilst doing away with branching all together comes at the cost of additional development and testing to ensure work in progress doesn't break existing functionality.

So we built a faster way to work together.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
19.0.1

Fixed branches not loading in the Repository view for Azure

Improve handling of unexpected git exit codes

Improve loading of avatars

Fix Write-unsafe context error when cherry-picking changes from gutter

Fixed PERMISSION_DENIED: Missing or insufficient permissions

Update the minimum version of IntelliJ platform to 2024.3.2


19.0.0

Pull request support and more

  • View, create and open pull requests on GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket and Azure DevOps from the repository view.

  • Merge, rebase or open a pull request for tracked branches with commits to pull in the repository view.

  • Push commits and checkout branches directly from the repository view with one click.

  • Force push support detects unpushed rebased commits allowing you to force push from the repository view with one click.

  • Ignore branches and shared changes until their next commit by right-clicking a branch in Their branches or clicking their changes in the gutter.

  • Changes from leftover branches with closed pull requests no longer show in repository view or gutter.

  • Get warned for branches where additional commits have been added after a pull request was closed.

  • Protected branches are now automatically hoisted to the top level of Their branches.

18.0.9

Fixed GitLab self-hosted incorrectly connecting via HTTP instead of HTTPS


18.0.8

Fixed possible race condition causing sign in not to succeed until restart of IDE

Performance improvements and reduced diff loading times

18.0.5

Only consider changes as conflicts if they conflict with the changes you've made on your branch stack

Fixed GitException 128: M...


18.0.4

Fixed timeout of some GitHub API requests

Fixed "Could not determine repository hosting service" error for GitHub Enterprise Server

18.0.3

Stop showing commits to pull from a tracked branch if no files were changed

Increased diff size limit to 10,000 lines

Fixed Sorry, something went wrong: This no longer exists

18.0.2

18.0.1

Fixed unhandled GitException: unknown option

Fixed unhandled TooLargeException

Fixed high cpu and memory load issues

Fixed Diff is too large to show

Fixed 404 when clicking an added file in the repository view


18.0.0

Merge conflicts are now flagged in the following places:

  • Tracked branches with commits to pull that conflict with the changes on your local branch are highlighted with an exclamation mark and the count of conflicting files is shown beside the branch.

  • Their branches that conflict with your branch are also highlighted with exclamation marks, these appear beside the authors, branches and files as you expand each level.

  • Diff editors opened by selecting a file with conflicts from Tracked branches or Their branches will have their conflicting lines highlighted red in the right-hand gutter of the diff editor.

  • Text editors contain bright red indicators in the gutter highlighting conflicts with other branches, these work just as they did before but with some added improvements.
17.1.2

Fixed issues with Azure DevOps integration

Fix race condition leading to possibly getting stuck on loading


17.1.1

Show commits a branch is ahead of its base by on rollover

Add "Merge with another user..." action on context menu for unknown authors

Show the current repository based on open file / tracked branch when opening the GitLive tool window

Fix the "Remove working tree changes" action on context menu for your offline branches with working tree changes

Fixed several issues with Azure DevOps integration

Fix possible false positive with antivirus software on windows


17.1.0

Redesigned repository view

  • Tracked branches
    • Browse any changes to pull on your remote tracking branch compared to your local branch
    • Right-click a branch to set its base branch and browse changes to pull from your complete branch stack
    • Once you sign in Tracked branches will show you the latest changes from the remote without needing to fetch
  • Your branch
    • Browse all changes on your branch compared to its base branch including any local changes
    • Right-click Your branch and set the left and right of the comparison to filter to just remote or local changes
  • Their branches
    • Browse changes from all other branches ahead of their base branch (typically your default branch) grouped by author
    • Once you sign in Their branches will update without fetching and show you who is online, their current branch and any local changes they are sharing
    • Right-click Their branches to set the left and right of the comparison and filter branches by last updated
17.0.0
  • Simplified onboarding. Sign in and get started straightaway without needing administrator privileges on your repository hosting service.

  • Sign with OAuth or a personal access token. Credentials are now securely stored locally and only accessed to make direct calls from your local machine to your repository hosting service API.

  • Improved support for GitLab self-hosted. No server configuration required and it no longer needs to be accessible from the internet to work.

  • Your data is now protected by end-to-end encryption. When you share your working tree changes all sensitive data is encrypted, including source code, branch names and file paths.
