idea-plugin.name: ZsmpDoc
idea-plugin.description:
Zsmp(Zto Service Management Platform) is a collection service and document management platform.It can view service providers and consumers. And can manage the input and output of the document, which is convenient for front-end developers to view interface information and configure routing rules and dynamic configuration.
This plugin can be do :
Upload metadata to Zbase or mobile-gateway.
Support dubbo and http services.
Support the use of standard doc comments to read information.
Support the use of annotation packages provided by Zbase.
Support the use of auto check Sso limit level provided by zsmp.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1. Support IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2 and bundle the required runtime libraries explicitly.
2. Prevent unbounded circular DTO parsing during service and gateway uploads.
3. Support multiple class-level and method-level @RequestMapping paths.
4. Migrate Apache Commons Lang usage to commons-lang3 and remove the legacy commons-lang 2.x dependency.
5. Synchronize project batch upload parsing state, branch metadata and HTTP content type handling.
6. Avoid a null-field failure while parsing nested collection response models.
7. Unify generic parsing for Dubbo, HTTP and Gateway upload flows.
8. Raw List, Set, Collection and Map now fall back to Object instead of missing field details.
9. Wildcard types such as ?, ? extends Xxx and ? super Xxx now resolve to Object consistently.
10. Improve inherited and nested generic resolution to reduce collisions for same-name type parameters.
11. Support interface getter-based field extraction in complex generic models.
12. Fix Gateway featureList annotation parsing for nested annotation style configurations.
13. Improve PSI type compatibility to avoid Map generic parsing failures in some IDEA PSI implementations.
14. Initialize the ZSMP settings UI when the plugin is built without IDEA GUI Designer instrumentation.

idea-plugin.name: Code2QRcode
idea-plugin.description:
This is a tool that can help developers easily share the code in the IDEA when they need it.
Developers can select the code and click to generate a QR code, which is convenient for sharing the code quickly and accurately. Recipients can use any QR code recognition tool to extract the results.
It supports viewing the generated QR code in the ToolWindow and saving the QR code in PNG format to the local disk.
It also supports creating web sharing links, burn-after-reading web sharing links (i.e., one-time links), and using custom passwords to restrict access to web sharing content.
The content shared via the web can support the display of Java, Python, C/C++, GO, MarkDown, Json, Bash, plain text, and other formats.
It supports generating web QR codes to enable scanning and jumping to the content sharing page.

Now supports [Chinese] and [special characters]

idea-plugin.description:
Auto-Tips is an intelligent, non-intrusive code hint plugin. When developers call APIs or methods marked with @tips annotations, the plugin automatically displays relevant hint information to help developers better understand and use the code without interrupting their normal coding workflow.

Auto-Tips 是一个智能的、非中断式的代码提示插件。当开发者调用带有 @tips 注释标记的 API 或方法时， 插件会自动显示相关提示信息，帮助开发者更好地理解和使用代码，而不会中断其正常的编码流程。

Key Features / 主要功能

  • Smart Hint Display: Automatically shows hints when typing closing parenthesis / 智能提示显示：在输入方法调用的右括号时自动显示提示
  • Non-Intrusive Design: Hints displayed as non-modal popups without blocking code editing / 非中断式设计：提示以非模态弹窗显示，不阻塞代码编辑
  • Multi-Language Support: Supports Java and Kotlin / 多语言支持：支持 Java 和 Kotlin
  • Multiple Trigger Methods: Manual input, IDE auto-completion, IME auto-completion / 多种触发方式：手动输入、IDE 自动补全、输入法自动补全
  • Custom Javadoc Tag: @tips tag with code completion and syntax highlighting / 自定义 Javadoc 标签：@tips 标签支持代码补全和语法高亮
  • Smart Caching: LRU cache strategy for better performance / 智能缓存：LRU 缓存策略提升性能
  • Flexible Configuration: Customizable hint display duration and styles / 灵活配置：可自定义提示显示时长、样式等
  • External Dependencies Support: Parse @tips annotations from third-party libraries / 外部依赖支持：可解析第三方库中的 @tips 注释

Usage Example / 使用示例


/**
 * Execute database query
 * @tips This is a time-consuming operation, recommend calling in background thread
 * @tips Return value may be null, please check for null
 */
public ResultSet executeQuery(String query) {
    // Implementation
}

// Hint will be displayed automatically when calling
ResultSet result = executeQuery("SELECT * FROM users");

idea-plugin.name: Live Coverage
idea-plugin.description:
Live Coverage

An IntelliJ IDEA plugin for real-time code coverage visualization using JaCoCo.

Features

  • Cumulative Coverage Mode: Continuously highlights all executed code. Use "Clear Coverage" to reset.
  • Integrated JaCoCo Agent: The agent JAR is bundled with the plugin - no need to download separately.
  • Auto JVM Arguments: JVM arguments are automatically added to run configurations - zero manual setup.
  • Pause/Resume: Temporarily pause or resume highlighting.

Setup

Configure plugin settings in Settings -> Tools -> Live Coverage:

  • JaCoCo Agent TCP Address: Usually 127.0.0.1
  • JaCoCo Agent TCP Port: Usually 6300
  • Source output path: Absolute path to Java source root
  • Classes output path: Absolute path to compiled .class files
  • Multi-module support: Add multiple source/classes path pairs

Run your application - JVM arguments are automatically added. No manual configuration needed.

Usage

  • Code will be highlighted automatically as it executes (cumulative mode).
  • Use "Clear Coverage" action to reset coverage data and start fresh.
  • Use "Pause/Resume Coverage" when you want to temporarily disable or re-enable live background highlighting.

Solves Real Business Problems

  • Complex and hard-to-maintain legacy business code
  • Impact analysis for incremental development and requirement changes
  • Test-data preparation and bug localization before regression testing
  • Quickly answer: "Which business code paths did this request actually execute?"

Core Value

  • Request-to-code path visibility with lower understanding cost: Quickly locate executed code blocks
  • Higher regression-testing efficiency: Analyze code and requirement impact using real execution paths, then prepare test data
  • Business bug localization: Understand legacy behavior faster and pinpoint failing business code fragments
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• Initial paid release (2026.2)
  • Real-time JaCoCo coverage highlighting with auto JVM agent injection

idea-plugin.name: Soap Desk
idea-plugin.description:
Soap Desk - SOAP Client for IntelliJ IDEA

A simple SOAP client plugin for testing and debugging SOAP web services directly in your IDE.

Note: This plugin is currently in beta. Features are being developed and improved. Check the FAQ tab for the complete feature list.

Getting Started

  1. Open the Soap Desk tool window (View → Tool Windows → Soap Desk)
  2. Click "Add Project" and enter your WSDL URL or select a local file
  3. Explore services and execute SOAP requests

Support

For bug reports and feature requests, please visit our GitHub Issues page.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
2026.0.1.0-beta

Improved

  • Faster, more reliable storage - Soap Desk's projects, environments, mock-server settings, and request history have been rebuilt for speed and reliability. Your data is upgraded automatically the first time you launch the new version, and a backup of your previous data is kept in your Soap Desk folder just in case.

Added

  • Save-conflict detection - If the same saved request is open in two places and one saves first, the second save shows a Reload / Overwrite / Cancel dialog instead of silently overwriting.
  • Operation name in tab titles - Saved-request tabs now read Request 1 (Calculator:Add) so two Request 1 tabs from different methods are easy to tell apart.
  • Optional history retention - A new setting automatically deletes request/response history older than the number of days you choose. Default: unlimited.
  • Debug logging mode - A checkbox under Settings → Tools → Soap Desk → Diagnostics writes detailed logs to a daily file in your Soap Desk folder. Turn it on before reproducing an issue and attach the log to your bug report.
  • Help → Soap Desk Storage menu - Open Storage Folder reveals Soap Desk's data folder; Rebuild Storage from Backup… restores your data from the automatic backup if anything goes wrong during the upgrade.

Fixed

  • Saved-request edits no longer "lost" after closing and reopening a tab. Reopening now reliably shows the latest saved content.
  • Reload in the save-conflict dialog now actually replaces the editor content with the latest saved version.
  • Large project imports no longer fail. Importing a .soapdesk file with many or large saved requests works regardless of file size.
  • Smoother upgrades. Fixed an edge case where the plugin could fail to open right after upgrading.
  • Clearer errors on import / export. If something goes wrong, the dialog tells you what happened and points at the log file with the full details.

Security

  • Safer XML parsing - SoapUI imports and SOAP response formatting are hardened against maliciously-crafted XML files.
  • Mock server is local-only - The built-in mock server is now reachable only from your own computer.
  • Removed a leftover code path that could weaken HTTPS verification for the rest of the IDE in some edge cases.

2026.0.0.12-beta

Compatibility

  • IDE 2026.1+ Compatibility - Fixed WSDL loading on IDE 2026.1 and later

2026.0.0.11-beta

Export, Import & Bulk Operations

  • Export / Import - Export all or selected projects to a .soapdesk file and import on another machine. Includes environments, security profiles, header templates, and mock server configs
  • Import Old Data - Import soapdesk-projects.xml files from previous versions directly via the Import button
  • Bulk Delete - Select multiple projects and folders with Ctrl+Click or Shift+Click, then delete them all at once
  • Bulk Move to Folder - Select multiple projects and move them all into a folder in one step
  • Rename Project - Right-click a project to rename it
  • Project Ordering - Projects are now displayed alphabetically by name
  • Plugin Logging - Daily log files in ~/.soapdesk/logs/ for troubleshooting

Fixes

  • Data Migration - Fixed upgrade from previous versions that could result in empty project list
  • WSDL Refresh - If refresh fails, the project keeps its existing data instead of showing only an error
  • Import Duplicates - Importing no longer creates duplicate saved requests for the same operation
  • Tenant List - Long tenant lists in the environment editor now wrap correctly

2026.0.0.10-beta

New Features & Improvements

  • Project Folders - Organize SOAP projects into folders with drag-and-drop grouping, inline rename, and persistent collapse state
  • HTTP Log Drawer - View full HTTP request/response headers and bodies in a collapsible drawer below the editor, with copy-all and color-coded status indicators
  • Template Token Highlighting - Environment variable placeholders ({{VAR}}) are now highlighted in the request editor with resolved tokens in amber and unresolved tokens with wave underline
  • Environment Bulk Edit - Edit all environment variables at once in a properties file format, with automatic parsing on close
  • Portable Storage - All data now stored in ~/.soapdesk/ instead of IDE-specific config folders, with automatic migration from previous versions

2026.0.0.9-beta

Parsing Improvements

  • URL-based WSDL Parsing Fix - WSDLs loaded from URLs now correctly resolve external schema imports. Previously, schemas referenced by relative paths were not loaded when the WSDL was fetched from a remote endpoint
  • Modular WSDL Support - WSDLs that import other WSDL files now correctly discover all operations, messages, and bindings from imported contracts
  • Namespace Resolution - Improved handling of namespace prefix declarations at any level in the WSDL document

2026.0.0.8-beta

Functionality Improvements

  • Request Generation Fix - SOAP requests now correctly include all fields when the WSDL uses multi-file schemas. Previously some complex schema setups produced empty requests with no fields
  • Schema Reference Resolution - Improved handling of element references across schema files with correct namespace support
  • Schema Import Resolution - Improved handling of nested schema imports and includes
  • Security Improvements - Strengthened XML processing security

2026.0.0.7-beta

  • Find Navigation Fix - Search results now scroll the editor to the matched occurrence when navigating with Enter/arrows
  • New Request Fix - Creating a new saved request from an operation now correctly loads the request template into the editor

2026.0.0.6-beta

  • Undo/Redo - Support undo and redo in the request editor (Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z), including Format XML and Reset to Template
  • Save Shortcut - Ctrl+S / Cmd+S to save the current request from the editor
  • Global WS-Security Profiles - WS-Security profiles and custom header templates are now shared across all projects
  • Tree Stability - Saving a request no longer expands all projects; tree starts collapsed on IDE open

2026.0.0.4-beta

Custom Headers, SoapUI Import & Request Management

  • Custom SOAP Header Templates - Create reusable header templates with variable substitution
  • Built-in Variables - Auto-generated values: {{_TIMESTAMP}}, {{_UUID}}, {{_NONCE}}, {{_DATE}}, {{_TIME}}
  • External XSD Import Resolution - Properly loads types from external XSD files referenced via URL or relative path
  • Improved Schema Handling - Custom URI resolver with SSL skip support for enterprise WSDLs
  • Multi-Interface SoapUI Import - Each con:interface in a SoapUI project is now imported as a separate SoapDesk project, correctly handling projects with multiple WSDLs
  • Schema Change Detection on Refresh - When refreshing a WSDL, if the schema changed, existing saved requests are automatically renamed with a _backup suffix to preserve user data
  • Auto-Incremented Request Names - New requests default to "Request 1", "Request 2", etc., filling gaps when requests are deleted

2026.0.0.1-beta

First Public Beta Release

  • SOAP Client - Full-featured SOAP client similar to SoapUI
  • WSDL Support - Load from URL or local files, parse services/ports/operations
  • Request Editor - Split-view editor with syntax highlighting for request/response XML
  • WSDL Viewer - Interactive tree view with type details and schema exploration
  • Code Generation - Generate Java, Kotlin, or TypeScript DTOs from WSDL types
  • Environment Variables - Manage multiple environments with variable substitution
  • Multi-Tenant Support - Tenant-specific variables with automatic detection
  • WS-Security - UsernameToken profiles with Text/Digest password types
  • Request History - Track and replay previous requests
  • Mock Server - Built-in mock server for testing SOAP services
  • SoapUI Import - Import existing SoapUI projects
  • Jakarta EE Support - Code generation supports both jakarta.* and javax.* namespaces

idea-plugin.name: FMCuttingBoard
idea-plugin.description:
Work with FileMaker clipboard content as XML (fmxmlsnippet) and edit FileMaker calculations, directly from your JetBrains IDE.

Clipboard round-tripping

Actions in the Tools > FMCuttingBoard submenu and the editor/project context menus:

  • Get FileMaker Clipboard Content (Ctrl+Alt+C, X): saves copied fields, tables, scripts, script steps, custom functions, value lists or layout objects as an XML file, or copied calculation text as a .fmcalc file.
  • Push Clipboard Into FileMaker (Ctrl+Alt+C, P): puts XML back on the clipboard in FileMaker's format, ready to paste.

Use it to inspect, edit and version-control FileMaker objects as plain text.

FileMaker calculations (.fmcalc)

  • Syntax highlighting, completion and parameter hints for every FileMaker function, Get ( … ) constant and named constant.
  • Error checking: unmatched brackets, unterminated strings, wrong argument counts, unknown functions, and Let/While variables used out of scope.
  • Reformat Code with Claris-style spacing, folding, brace matching and quick fixes.

No telemetry and no network access.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Added

  • .fmcalc now knows every FileMaker function (231), Get ( … ) constant (138) and named constant (46), from the calculation catalogue built from Claris's help by fmscriptinventory. Completion lists them all, and argument counts are checked for every function.
  • .fmcalc: calls to functions that are not FileMaker built-ins (custom functions, plug-in functions, typos) get an "Unknown function" weak warning.
  • Diagnostics: new Save Raw Clipboard Capture action (Windows; visible when diagnostics are enabled). It saves the raw bytes of every clipboard format to <cutting board folder>/captures/, so they can be used as test fixtures.

Fixed

  • Clipboard data in UTF-16 without a byte-order mark could come out garbled: UTF-16LE was misdetected as UTF-16BE, and non-ASCII characters in UTF-16BE data could be misread.
  • On macOS, reading byte-based clipboard flavors now uses the same, more robust decoding as on Windows.
  • .fmcalc highlighting now follows FileMaker's syntax:
    • Table::Field, ¶ and ${ } quoted names are recognized (previously shown as bad characters);
    • Java keywords such as boolean, class, int and void are no longer highlighted;
    • only double-quoted strings are accepted, and they may span lines;
    • logical operators (and, OR, Xor, not) are recognized in any case.
  • Every function call is highlighted as a function in any case (substitute(…), custom functions), and the argument of Get ( … ) is highlighted as a constant.
  • The parser now knows every FileMaker operator and Claris's precedence order. &, ^, xor, <>, <= and >= no longer stop parsing, and unary minus/plus parse.
  • Brackets or control characters inside strings and comments no longer cause "Unmatched closing" or "Invalid control character" errors. A missing closing quotation mark is now reported.
  • Get ( … ) arguments and field references are no longer reported as possibly undefined variables.
  • Let variables written with a leading ~ (~total, a common convention for calculation-local names) are now recognized as variables instead of bad characters.
  • .fmcalc error checking now actually runs. A bug meant it never ran in a project, so you may now see:
    • errors for unmatched closing brackets and unterminated strings;
    • errors for wrong argument counts in known functions;
    • a new weak warning when a Let/While variable is used outside the function that defines it (there it silently means a field).
  • Let ( [ … ] ; … ) and While ( [ … ] ; … ; [ … ] ; … ) variable lists, and Field[n] repetitions, are now parsed.
  • Binary expressions now include their left operand in the syntax tree.
  • Substitute accepts any number of bracketed [ search ; replace ] pairs.

Removed

  • The "Script variable may be undefined" and "Undefined variable (not bound in any Let())" warnings. A plain name in a calculation is usually a field, and $/$$ variables are set by scripts, so neither can be known from the calculation alone.
  • Code style options that never affected .fmcalc formatting: the Spaces and Blank Lines tabs, and the continuation indent.

Changed

  • .fmcalc formatting (Reformat Code) is rewritten. It uses Claris spacing (If ( a > b ; "x" ; "y" )) and pretty-prints:

    • Let variables, one per line;
    • Case pairs, one per line;
    • While, one argument per line;
    • long calls, one argument per line (they break at Hard wrap at);
    • consistent indentation from the Tabs and Indents settings.

    Do not indent top let variables now works. Calculations that aren't well-formed are left untouched. Same output as the VS Code extension; see docs/fmcalc-formatting.md.

  • .fmcalc folding now uses the syntax tree. Nested calls, Let ( written with a space, any letter case and While now fold, as do multi-line [ … ] lists and block comments. Parentheses inside strings no longer confuse it.

  • A block comment is now a single token.

  • .fmcalc color settings: named constants (True, JSON types, text styles) now use the color scheme's Constant color (key FM_CALC_CONSTANT) instead of the keyword color. New keys: FM_CALC_GET_CONSTANT, FM_CALC_FIELD and FM_CALC_PARAGRAPH_MARK. FM_CALC_KEYWORD_CONTROL_FLOW and FM_CALC_KEYWORD_TYPE are removed.

  • The FileMaker function list, the Get() completion constants and the clipboard format rules now load from data files shared with the upcoming VS Code extension, so both stay in sync. No behavior change.

idea-plugin.name: XPath Injection Sink Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Flags an XPath.evaluate(...)/.compile(...) call whose argument is built from an HTTP endpoint parameter -- CWE-643 (XPath Injection), the mechanism documented in the OWASP Testing Guide: an attacker's raw input becomes XPath SOURCE TEXT, re-parsed and evaluated by the XPath engine.

Built on a real, hand-written XPath 1.0 parser -- the THIRD full custom grammar in this catalog, after the ReDoS Catastrophic-Backtracking Companion's regex grammar and the SpEL Injection Sink Companion's SpEL grammar. The grammar's job here is noise reduction: it reconstructs the argument's static skeleton (every tainted operand replaced by a placeholder) and confirms it parses as well-formed XPath before flagging -- it never suppresses a real injection, only skips a call whose argument clearly isn't shaped like XPath source text at all.

Stated honestly: v0.1 only Java, only same-method taint; AWS CodeGuru Detector Library has a dedicated XPath injection detector, but it's CI/batch, not an inline IDE inspection -- no dedicated Marketplace plugin found for this exact angle.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no network calls.

idea-plugin.name: yigo
idea-plugin.description:
Yigo Developer Assistant is an IntelliJ IDEA extension designed for Yigo-ERP and low-code framework secondary development, enhancing your coding and layout design workflow.

Yigo 开发者辅助插件

Yigo 是一款专为 Yigo-ERP 及低代码平台二次开发打造的 IntelliJ IDEA 增强插件，旨在提升配置开发与代码编写效率。

核心功能 (Key Features)

  • 文件业务结构与快速检索 (File Structure)：按业务语义深度定制 Ctrl + F12 / Alt + 7 结构大纲，支持数据源、操作集合、界面控件、嵌入表单及嵌入数据表全量跨文件展开与快速搜索跳转。
  • 公式与表达式语言支持：支持 Yigo 自定义语法的高亮显示、智能代码补全（含上下文感知提示）、括号匹配、代码格式化与常用代码模板（Live Templates）。
  • XML 模型导航与引用跳转：内置 Yigo XML Schema 校验，支持表单 (Form)、数据对象 (DataObject)、宏 (Macro)、实体域 (Domain) 的跨文件 Ctrl + Click 快速跳转、查找引用 (Find Usages) 及安全重命名重构。
  • 可视化表单布局预览 (Yigo Layout)：内置可视化设计面板（快捷键 Alt + Y），支持实时解析并预览 Form XML 布局结构，提供拖拽与控件快速检索定位。
  • 编辑器行内增强：提供行内类型标注 (Inlay Hints) 与行标记 (Line Markers)，直观呈现数据绑定关系与标签说明。
  • 协同与联动工具：集成 Trac 根据回归变更ID快速生成ServiceConfig与databaseSource配置,减少手动复制粘贴工作。

快速上手 (Getting Started)

  1. 在编辑器中打开任意 Yigo XML 表单或公式文件即可获得语法高亮与智能提示。
  2. 按下 Ctrl + F12 即可呼出业务大纲弹窗，输入字段或控件名称秒级过滤并回车跳转。
  3. 按住 Ctrl 点击 XML 中的字段绑定、数据对象引用，即可一键穿透跳转。
  4. 按下 Alt + Y 或点击右侧边栏 Yigo Layout 选项卡即可打开可视化布局面板。

idea-plugin.name: SequenceDiagram.org
idea-plugin.description:
Official offline version of the SequenceDiagram.org UML sequence diagram tool.

Creating and Editing

  • Create new sequence diagrams: File -> New or Right click in project -> New
  • See instructions and examples for supported sequence diagram elements.

Generating from Java Code

  • Generate sequence diagrams from Java code: Right click inside a method -> Sequence Diagram (in the bottom of the context menu)
  • Sequence diagrams generated from Java code are displayed in the bottom.
  • Click on an arrow in the generated diagram to navigate to the corresponding java method invocation and ctrl/cmd + click to navigate to the definition
  • Click the save icon in the action bar to save the diagram to a location and edit it in the normal main window editor (the save action removes any metadata in the diagram which is used for the previously mentioned navigation)
  • Adjust settings (package filter, limits etc.): File -> Settings -> Tools -> Sequence Diagram Org

Features

  • Text notation scripting and drawing by clicking and dragging in the same model
  • Export to SVG and PNG
  • Syntax highlight and code completion

Limitations

  • Although diagrams exported to SVG contain the diagram source, the diagram source of it cannot be opened and edited using this plugin due to file handling in intellij

If you have any question / comments / suggestions / bugs please contact info@sequencediagram.org. The more feedback we get the better we can prioritize.

idea-plugin.name: Miragon BPMN Modeler
idea-plugin.description:
Model BPMN 2.0 process diagrams visually, right inside your JetBrains IDE — no need to switch to a separate modeling tool.

Open any .bpmn file on a drag-and-drop canvas and edit it like a diagram; your changes are saved straight back to the file, ready to commit alongside your code.

Highlights

  • Draw and edit BPMN 2.0 diagrams on a visual canvas, with a source view for when you need it.
  • Compare two versions of a diagram side by side in your IDE's diff and version-control views.
  • Write task scripts with context-aware suggestions.
  • Deploy diagrams to a running Camunda 7 or Camunda 8 engine without leaving the IDE.

Troubleshooting

If a diagram fails to open or an action misbehaves, the plugin surfaces errors as IDE notifications and records the full detail in the IDE log. Open it via Help | Show Log in Finder / Explorer (or bundle it with Help | Collect Logs and Diagnostic Data).

When filing a bug, capture more detail first: open Help | Diagnostic Tools | Debug Log Settings…, add io.miragon, reproduce the problem, then attach the log. Deployment passwords and client secrets are stored in the IDE's password safe and are redacted from the log, so it is safe to attach.

For the complete feature list and documentation, visit miragon.github.io/bpmn-modeler.

Source & issues: github.com/Miragon/bpmn-modeler

idea-plugin.name: FSM Editor - UML State Machines & Code Generation
idea-plugin.description:
Visual editor and code generator for UML 2.5.1 state machines in IntelliJ IDEA and the other JetBrains IDEs.

  • Code generation: turn a machine into source code with Handlebars templates. TypeScript and C++ (Boost.SML) templates are bundled, and templates for other languages can write several files per machine. The bundled fsm generator also runs from a terminal or a build, so the IDE and CI produce the same code.
  • Composite, orthogonal and submachine states, all pseudostates, connection point references, entry/exit/do behaviors, deferrable events, time triggers and protocol state machines.
  • A diagram with a toolbox and a properties panel; the XMI text stays one click away in the Text tab.
  • Live validation of the UML well-formedness rules, on the diagram and in the Problems tool window.
  • SVG export.

*.fsm files are standard XMI 2.5.1: the UML model plus its UML DI layout. They are the same files as in FSM Editor for VS Code and for Visual Studio, and diagram elements can be copied and pasted between the three editors.

idea-plugin.name: BTS: Odoo Selector Pro
idea-plugin.description:
Your Odoo control center inside PyCharm. Switch databases and manage modules without the usual hassle.

  • Switch databases instantly - no config editing, just restart and go.
  • Manage modules faster - search, install, update, test - all in one place.
  • Generate run configs in one click - no guessing, just works.

👉 Documentation looks much better in browser (JetBrains rendering is limited): https://bts-odoo-selector.com/

✅ Quick 3-Step Setup:
  1. Configure your fetch database command.
  2. Auto-Generate BTS Run Configurations.
  3. Adjust the newly created Run Configurations.
Follow the guided instructions in the Easy Install section.

Official Music Video

What's Inside

  • Database Selector
  • Module Selector
  • Test Selection
  • Run Configurations
  • Easy Install
  • Braintec Automation - Braintec Exclusive
  • Context Menu - Braintec Exclusive
  • Custom Integration

Links

  • Website & Documentation
  • JetBrains Marketplace

Database Selector

Use the $BTSDatabase$ and $BTSDatabaseWithD$ macros directly in your Run Configurations for seamless database switching. Alternatively, the tool can update the db_name in your odoo.conf.

  • Refresh – Auto-updates on startup and config changes. Manual refresh needed after database operations.
  • Database – Use the $BTSDatabase$ or $BTSDatabaseWithD$ macros in your Run Configuration for dynamic switching, or choose to automatically update the db_name in your odoo.conf.
    • Delete – Automatically configured for Braintec, PwC, and Ventortech.
    • Duplicate / Rename – Braintec exclusive.
  • All Databases – Showing all databases.
  • Custom – Enter a db_name and run your install config to spin up a fresh database.
  • Configure – Advanced settings and automation:
    • Fetch / Drop Databases – Commands to fetch or delete databases (Auto-configured for partner environments).
    • Path to odoo.conf – Set a custom path for your configuration file (Auto-configured for Braintec, PwC, and VentorTech).
    • Predefined Databases – Set up your own list of go-to database names.
💡 Pro Tip:
  • Left-Click: Start typing to find your database.
  • Middle-Click: Fold.
  • Ctrl + Click or Ctrl + Enter: Open the query console for the database. Uses the first available database connection, refreshes its database list, and syncs the schema for the clicked database.
  • Alt + Click or Alt + Enter: Copy database name to clipboard.
  • Ctrl + Alt + \: To activate.

Module Selector

Scans your repositories and lets you pick modules to install, update, or test. Selected modules are injected into Run Configurations via macros $BTSModules$, $BTSModulesWithU$ and $BTSModulesWithI$. Simply create a new Run Configuration (e.g., Update Modules) and use the macro to target your selection.

You can also use the $BTSAddonsPaths$ macro to define a custom addons path by adding --addons-path=$BTSAddonsPaths$ to your Run Configuration.

  • Refresh – Update the module list anytime. Auto-refreshes on startup.
  • Addon Paths – Choose specific repositories to focus your search and utilize them with the $BTSAddonsPaths$ macro.
  • Module Groups – Create custom sets of modules to toggle multiple items at once. Selecting a group automatically picks all its member modules.
  • Module Selection – Pick the modules you need, then reference them in your Run Configuration using $BTSModules$, $BTSModulesWithU$ or $BTSModulesWithI$.
💡 Pro Tip:
  • Left-Click: Start typing to find your modules.
  • Middle-Click: Fold.
  • Right-Click: Show context action.
  • Ctrl + Click or Ctrl + Enter: Jump to source.
  • Alt + Click or Alt + Enter: Copy module names to clipboard.
  • _: Show all modules.
  • Ctrl + Alt + Shift + \: To activate.

Test Selection

You can select either a unit test or an entire test class, then inject it into your Run Configuration using the $BTSSelectedTest$ macro. Start it with Test Run Configuration.

Run Configurations

Short, ready-to-use command examples for running Odoo. The following configurations utilize these BTS macros:

  • $BTSDatabase$: Selected database name. If no DB is selected, returns False. (e.g. my_database)
  • $BTSDatabaseWithD$: Returns -d database_name. Empty string if none. (e.g. -d my_database)
  • $BTSModules$: Comma-separated list of selected modules. (e.g. sale,stock,web)
  • $BTSModulesWithU$: Returns -u module,list. Empty string if none. (e.g. -u sale,stock)
  • $BTSModulesWithI$: Returns -i module,list. Empty string if none. (e.g. -i sale,stock)
  • $BTSAddonsPaths$: Absolute paths to selected addon directories. (e.g. /path/to/addons)
  • $BTSSelectedTest$: Returns selected test/class with tags. Empty string if none. (e.g. --test-tags /module.test_class)
💡 Pro Tip:

You don't always have to use every macro. For example, whether you need --addons-path depends on your project setup.

1. Install Modules

Enter a new database name under Custom and pick modules to install to initialize a fresh database with those modules.

$BTSModulesWithI$ $BTSDatabaseWithD$ --workers=0

With addons paths:

$BTSModulesWithI$ $BTSDatabaseWithD$ --workers=0 --addons-path=$BTSAddonsPaths$

2. Start

Standard command to start Odoo with the selected database.

--dev=xml $BTSDatabaseWithD$

With addons paths:

--dev=xml $BTSDatabaseWithD$ --addons-path=$BTSAddonsPaths$

3. Update Modules

Select the modules to update, pick your database, and run. It’s the easiest way to apply your latest code changes to the database.

$BTSModulesWithU$ $BTSDatabaseWithD$ --i18n-overwrite --workers=0

With addons paths:

$BTSModulesWithU$ $BTSDatabaseWithD$ --i18n-overwrite --workers=0 --addons-path=$BTSAddonsPaths$

4. Test

Use this configuration to run a single test method or a single test class.

Right-Click on a test method or class, select your database, and run the tests.

$BTSSelectedTest$ $BTSDatabaseWithD$ --workers=0 --stop-after-init

With addons paths:

$BTSSelectedTest$ $BTSDatabaseWithD$ --workers=0 --stop-after-init --addons-path=$BTSAddonsPaths$

5. Test Modules

Select the modules to test, pick your database, and run. This will execute all tests in the selected modules.

--test-tags /$BTSModules$ $BTSDatabaseWithD$ --workers=0 --stop-after-init

With addons paths:

--test-tags /$BTSModules$ $BTSDatabaseWithD$ --workers=0 --stop-after-init --addons-path=$BTSAddonsPaths$

Easy Install

1. Configure your fetch database command.

  • Open the Database Selector and select Configure.
  • Navigate to Fetch / Drop Databases.
  • Enter your fetch command in the designated field.
  • Tip: Use the test function to ensure your command is working correctly.

2. Auto-Generate BTS Run Configurations

  • Open the Database Selector and click Generate Run Configs. This will automatically populate BTS recommended Run Configurations.
  • Choose whether to include --addons-path=$BTSAddonsPaths$ to your Run Configurations.
  • Configuring the path to your odoo.conf is optional.

3. Adjust the newly created Run Configurations.

  • For example: Specify the path to your odoo.conf or adjust other project-specific settings like working directory.

4. Congratulations! You're ready to rock! 🎸

Braintec Automation

Braintec Exclusive

Automation & Maintenance (Auto-run)

  • Automatic Cleanup – Detects and removes legacy -web-run- containers on startup to prevent naming conflicts and environment clutter.
  • Update Notification – Checks for BT plugins updates on startup and prompts you to update if a newer version is available.
  • Database Connection – Automatically configures a BTS database connection on project startup, including auto-detection of Docker container hostnames and PostgreSQL driver setup.

Repository & Submodule Management

Right-Click the main repository or the ext folder to manage dependencies:

  • Update Core Repositories – Synchronizes main repositories (odoo, enterprise, etc.) by pulling the latest changes from their tracked branches. The plugin automatically updates the corresponding commit hashes in deploy.yaml file.
  • Sync Submodules – git submodule update --init --recursive. Restores submodules to the specific commits tracked by the current project state.
  • Update Submodules to Latest – git submodule update --remote. Fetches and fast-forwards all submodules in the ext folder to their latest upstream commits.

Context Menu

Braintec Exclusive

Right-Click any module to access a suite of specialized actions. Some operations may automatically trigger the installation of required bt plugins.

Core Actions

  • Select/Unselect Module – Quickly add or remove a module from your current selection.
  • Generate Readme – Execute bt utility generate-readme.
  • Migrate Module – Migrate a module to the target Odoo version.

Code Analysis (Check)

  • Quality & Compliance – Run static analysis for code quality, verify licenses, and audit module dependencies.
  • Dependency Tree – Visualize the full hierarchy of module requirements to identify potential conflicts.

Automated Maintenance (Fixes)

  • Fix PO / Ruff – Run bt test checks-odoo-po or bt test ruff check with the --fix and --unsafe-fixes flags.

Odoo Testing

  • Run Tests – Execute bt test odoo with options for specific modules, project-only, or non-project modules.
  • Isolated Testing – Run tests for multiple modules simultaneously. Each module is executed in its own dedicated sandbox database with automatic log cleanup.
  • Coverage Report – Generate a detailed coverage report during execution.
  • Cleanup – Use the Remove DB option to delete the test database after the run.

Translation Management

  • Export PO – Run bt utility bt-translation for specified modules and databases.
    • Smart Diff Notification – After export, a notification appears allowing you to instantly view all translation changes (diffs) with a single click.
  • Language Selection – Define multiple languages (e.g., pl_PL, de, de_CH, fr, es_ES) using comma-separated values.

Scaffolding

Quickly generate Odoo components using bt utility scaffold:

  • New Module – Full module scaffolding.
  • Component Creators – Dedicated actions for Controllers, Migrations, Models, Views, and Wizards.

Custom Integration

EXPLORE TOGETHER

"Wanna see your workflow crack a smile?"

Need this plugin to work for your team or want custom actions built for your workflow? Let’s chat.

Tadeusz Jan Karpiński 🤙😎🤙

idea-plugin.name: Add Python SDK
idea-plugin.description: Adds "Add Python SDK" items to the Project View context menu. On virtualenv folders (.venv, venv, .virtual_env, .virtualenv) it registers the interpreter inside the folder. On module folders that contain a pyproject.toml it offers "Add Python SDK | From Poetry", which runs "poetry env info --path" and uses the active Poetry virtualenv. In both cases the interpreter is registered as a Python SDK and assigned to the containing module.

idea-plugin.name: KetraTerm
idea-plugin.description:
KetraTerm is a fast, modern terminal for IntelliJ Platform IDEs, built for shells, command-line tools, and rich TUI applications that developers keep open all day.

It provides project-aware terminal tabs, quick shell-profile launch actions, IDE color-scheme integration, configurable typography and cursor behavior, scrollback, paste handling, visual bell support, and guarded clipboard/title controls.

KetraTerm focuses on contemporary terminal workflows: responsive rendering, Unicode-aware text, modern color and notification sequences, and security-conscious handling of terminal-initiated IDE actions.
idea-plugin.change-notes: - Fixed alignment of Hebrew, Arabic, and mixed-direction text with cell backgrounds, the cursor, selection and search highlights, and mouse targets. - Fixed Arabic letter forms changing under the block cursor and missing text in very long lines that require contextual shaping. - Fixed Arabic text containing joiners unexpectedly switching fonts, particularly on macOS. - Preserved native emoji rendering and solid block graphics on lines containing right-to-left text. - Fixed concealed text and emoji becoming visible under the block cursor or when hovering over links. Prevented neighboring characters from spilling into concealed cells. - Fixed rectangular selections widening across mixed-direction lines or when part of the selection scrolls out of view. - Fixed a terminal view retaining the previous session's text or search results when switching to a new session. - Fixed blinking text and the cursor remaining hidden after unrelated output updates. - Fixed inverted colors in scrollback failing to update when reverse-video mode changes or resets. - Fixed gaps during smooth scrolling while new content is loading, scroll-position jumps during resizing, and stale scroll animations after screen switches.

idea-plugin.name: Dual Terminal Windows
idea-plugin.description:
Adds independently movable terminal tool windows to JetBrains IDEs for developers who want simultaneous shells in different places.

Choose between one and four Extra Terminal windows. Each can be docked, resized, floated, and moved separately. Every shell starts in the project root and uses the IDE's configured terminal shell.

This beta targets JetBrains IDE builds 253 through 262 and uses the bundled Classic terminal implementation.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• Replaces deprecated terminal creation and tool-window removal APIs.
  • Fixes override-only API usage in tool-window registration.
  • Creates terminal sessions directly under their extra window's lifetime.

idea-plugin.name: Statistic
idea-plugin.description:
Shows project statistic. This plugin shows files sorted by their extension along with size, line count LOC etc. User can select (Project/Module/Package/File) scope using the 'Refresh on selection' button. (This plugin requires Java 1.8)


For older versions of IDEs (IDEA, Android Studio, PHP Storm) please use version 3.8.1 !!!
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Version 5.4:
  • added: Settings "Excluded directory names" added - directory names with '*' wildcard (e.g. build;dist;testenv*) are excluded at any depth.

  • fixed: Renderer issues where skipped file indicators would disappear on hover or selection.
  • improved: Better handling of large files - users can now adjust limits per project in settings.
  • fixed: OutOfMemoryError when processing large files or files with extremely long lines (e.g., minified JS/CSS without newlines).

idea-plugin.name: WakaTime
idea-plugin.description:
Metrics, insights, and time tracking automatically generated from your programming activity.

Installation

1. Inside your IDE, select Preferences -> Plugins -> Browse Repositories....

2. Search for wakatime.

3. Click the green Install Plugin button and confirm the installation.

4. Re-launch your IDE.

5. Enter your api key, then click Save.

6. Use your IDE like you normally do and your time will be tracked for you automatically.

7. Visit https://wakatime.com to see your logged time.

Source Code: https://github.com/wakatime/jetbrains-wakatime

idea-plugin.name: Git Time Metric
idea-plugin.description:
Simple, seamless, lightweight time tracking for all your git projects

Git Time Metrics (GTM) is a tool to automatically track time spent reading and working on code that you store in a Git repository.
By installing GTM and using supported plug-ins for your favorite editors, you can immediately realize better insight into how you are spending your time and on what files.

Installation

Installing GTM is a two step process. First, it's recommended you install the GTM executable that the plug-in integrates with and then install the JetBrains GTM plug-in. Please submit an issue if you have any problems and/or questions.

1. Follow the Getting Started section to install the GTM executable for your operating system.

2. Install the plug-in from your JetBrains IDE, select Preferences -> Plugins -> Browse Repositories... and search for "Git Time Metric".

Note - to enable time tracking for a Git repository, you need to initialize it with gtm init otherwise it will be ignored by GTM. This is done via the command line. You can run this within the JetBrains IDE terminal.

> cd /path/to/your/project
> gtm init

To report a bug, please submit an issue on the GitHub Page.
Consult the README and Wiki for more information.

This Plugin allows you to create an as-is 2D diagram of your code base. You can show only a specific area or specific classes of your code base by customizing the filter logic. The resulting diagram file is in text form (PlantUML) and can be included in the documentation (e.g. AsciiDoc), reviewed in a version control diff or manually adjusted.

  • Diagrams
    • Call Hierarchy
    • Class Structure
    • Control Flow
    • Data Flow
  • A lot of filter options to only show the relevant information
  • Re-generate single diagrams or whole directories recursively
  • Diagram extensions - customize a diagram via a callback

Upcoming Features

  • Better diagram layout
  • Clustering algorithm
  • VCS changes as base for the graph edges
  • Caching
  • More options to fine tune the diagram layout
  • Mark Git changes in diagram

idea-plugin.name: Prometheus Metric Registration Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Warning icon on a Counter.build()....register() (also Histogram/Gauge/ Summary, Prometheus's Java client's four metric types) construction written inside a regular method body -- the client's own official documentation states "the best way to register a metric is via a static final class variable". Registration happens against the process-global default registry: calling .register() more than once for the same metric name throws a real IllegalArgumentException ("Collector already registered that provides name...") at runtime, not just a style nit.

100% static text/PSI analysis -- matches by simple text, so it works whether the real Prometheus client jar is on the classpath or not. Java and Kotlin.

Stated honestly: v0.1 only flags the "build from scratch inside a regular method" shape -- a metric stored as a static final field (the documented correct pattern) is never flagged.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no network calls.

idea-plugin.name: ZK
idea-plugin.description:
A ZK framework plugin for IntelliJ IDEA that helps developers work with the ZK Java Web Framework. The plugin provides powerful, schema-aware code completion and validation to accelerate development.

Enhance your ZK development experience with MVVM data binding support, featuring intelligent code completion and seamless navigation. Effortlessly jump from ZUL binding expressions to ViewModel properties, command methods, and template URIs. Benefit from deep type propagation for chained properties, smart command name suggestions, and automatic scope variable completion.

Features:
  • Layout Preview
    • A side-by-side layout preview for .zul files — see how a page lays out while you edit, refreshed on save
    • Rendered through your project's own ZK jars in a separate helper process; your application never runs (ViewModels, Composers, and converters are never instantiated), so bound values appear as placeholders rather than real data
    • A first-paint layout view, not a live application preview
  • ZUL File Support
    • ZUL code completion for ZK components, attributes, and events
    • ZUL to class declaration navigation
    • ZUL syntax check and validation
  • ZK Configuration File Support
    • ZK configuration file (zk.xml) code completion and validation
    • Language addon configuration file (lang-addon.xml) code completion and validation
    • Note: To enable code completion, either use the default filenames (zk.xml, lang-addon.xml) or add the correct namespace to your custom-named XML file.
  • MVVM Development Support
    • Intelligent code completion for MVVM annotations (@init, @load, @bind, @save, @command, etc.)
    • Advanced property completion with deep type propagation for chained paths (e.g., vm.user.name)
    • Context-aware suggestions for command names and scope variables
    • Seamless navigation from ZUL to Java ViewModel properties, command methods, and template URIs
    • Intelligent navigation between matching ZUL tags
  • Project Creation
    • Provide ZK Maven archetypes for creating ZK projects
  • Live Templates
    • Built-in ZK snippet templates: grid, listbox, tree, ns, jspatch — just type the abbreviation and press Tab
  • Feedback Menu
    • a feedback menu under the Help menu for feedback and documentation
See ZK Developer's Reference / Intellij IDEA ZK Plugin for details.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.3

  • [bug] #70 Layout Preview: images, stylesheets and scripts from your own webapp folder never load — the preview now serves regular files out of your src/main/webapp. Before this, a page with <image src="/img/logo.png"/> previewed as an empty box even though the file was right there, and a page's own CSS and JavaScript silently never applied, so the pane showed half-styled output with nothing to indicate why. Serving is confined to the webapp folder: WEB-INF, META-INF, dot-files and any path escaping the folder are refused, directories are never listed, and assets are never cached so an edit shows up on the next save.
  • [bug] #71 Layout Preview: a .zul path with no file behind it looked like a page that rendered blank — the preview pane now shows which path was not found and which webapp folder it was looked for in, instead of a silent blank pane. Before this, the render server answered such a request as if it had succeeded, with an empty page and no message anywhere, so a preview of the wrong path was indistinguishable from a page that really does render to nothing.

1.0.2

  • [bug] #69 Layout Preview: an <include> whose src is a data binding fails to load ("No dispatcher available to include …") — a bound src is no longer written into the page as raw expression text. When the binding names a constant path (src="@load('~./page.zul')") the page is now included for real; when the path comes from the ViewModel (which never runs in the preview) the include simply contributes nothing, instead of leaving an error box in the middle of the layout.

1.0.1

  • [bug] #66 Cannot open a .zul file on IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2 (NoClassDefFoundError: org/cef/handler/CefRequestHandler) — IntelliJ 2026.2 moved JCEF out of the IDE runtime into the bundled "Web Browser (JCEF)" plugin, whose classes are visible only to plugins that declare it. The plugin now declares that dependency, so the Layout Preview renders again.
  • [bug] A missing or disabled JCEF no longer costs more than the preview: the .zul editor always opens, and the preview pane explains which JCEF is missing and how to restore it — including the new "enable the bundled Web Browser (JCEF) plugin" case, and a browser that is present but fails to start.
  • [bug] #67 Layout Preview: a <zscript> naming one of the project's own classes fails to render (Class or variable not found) — the preview now hands the render process your module's compiled output, so a page whose <zscript>, use="…" or custom EL function names one of your own classes renders instead of failing. ViewModels and Composers are still never instantiated, so bound values remain placeholders.

1.0.0

  • [feature] Layout Preview — a side-by-side preview for .zul files, refreshed on save. Rendered through your project's own ZK jars in an isolated helper process, so no server and no deploy are needed. Covers MVVM binding placeholders, model-bound data components (grid, listbox, tree), <apply>/<include>, ZK add-ons, and Spring Boot jar projects.
  • [feature] A source view in the preview pane, alongside the rendered layout.
  • [feature] A formatted render-error page with a collapsible stack trace and a one-click "Report on GitHub" hand-off that states what the report contains before sending it.
  • [feature] JCEF-unavailable diagnosis with an open-in-external-browser fallback.

0.7.3

  • #64 Add support for IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2 — remove the until-build upper bound so the plugin stays compatible with current and future IntelliJ IDEA releases without a per-version update

0.7.2

  • [bug] #60 Child completion inside <listbox> shows all ZK components instead of schema-valid children only
  • [bug] #61 MVVM binding chain stops resolving past an inherited generic getter (generic type arguments not substituted)

0.7.1

  • [bug] #58 Component tag and attribute completion fails to work in a ZUL file

0.7.0

  • [feature] Built-in ZK Live Templates — type grid, listbox, tree, ns, jspatch + Tab in ZUL or JS files
  • [bug] #48 Method WebBrowserUrlProvider.getUrl(...) references an unresolved class MavenId

0.6.0

  • [feature] #41 Support navigation from ZUL component tags to Java declaration
  • [feature] #49 ViewModel ID Reference Navigation
  • [feature] #50 MVVM Property Navigation
  • [feature] #51 MVVM Property Completion
  • [feature] #52 @command binding navigation in ZUL files
  • [feature] #53 @command name completion
  • [feature] #54 Template URI navigation in ZUL files
  • [feature] #55 Scope variable completion in ZUL files
  • [feature] #56 ViewModel property completion (chained type propagation)

Thanks to Uipko Stikker for the contribution of the above features.

idea-plugin.name: JSF-EL-extension
idea-plugin.description:
Allows to see autocompletion for enums in JSF EL.
By default enums are not supported by JSF EL, but it's possible to use them with extension libraries like PrimeFaces. Even in that case there is no autocompletion support for enum names and constants. This plugin adds this support.
To use it you have to create enumPlugin.properties file somewhere in project and put there enum descriptions in format: enumName = enum.full.class.Name
Typing enumName will trigger autocompletion of enum name and enum.full.class.Name will allow to find enum constants.

Also if enum constants contain constructor arguments (usually used for description) they will be shown in suggestion description. It's a basic functionality. You are free to improve it by pull requests.

idea-plugin.name: YAPI Helper
idea-plugin.description:
YAPI Helper is a API development tool; support to generate API documents and upload to YAPI automatically; also support to copy API as CURL.

Upload To YAPI Features：
  • Javadoc-based analysis,no additional annotations.
  • Supporting field filtering, automatically ignoring the analysis of filtering fields.
  • Automatically identify classes, generate markdown documents or upload to YAPI.
  • Support list, set, collection and other data structures, and support nested generic parsing.
  • Support the parsing of common annotations such as @NotNull and @ResponseBody, and generate YAPI documents based on json5.

Usage：
  • Locate the cursor to the method area or class name, right-click YAPI Helper.

Support annotations：
javax.validation.constraints.Min
javax.validation.constraints.Max
javax.validation.constraints.NotNull
javax.validation.constraints.NotBlank
javax.validation.constraints.NotEmpty
javax.validation.constraints.Size
org.hibernate.validator.constraints.Length
org.hibernate.validator.constraints.Range
org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.Controller
org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController
org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping
org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping
org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PutMapping
org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.DeleteMapping
org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PatchMapping
org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PathVariable
org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestBody
org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestParam
org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.ResponseBody

特性：
  • 基于javadoc解析，无代码入侵
  • 支持字段过滤，自动忽略过滤字段的解析
  • 自动识别类，生成markdown文档或上传到YAPI
  • 支持List、Set、Collection等数据结构，支持嵌套泛型解析
  • 支持@NotNull、@ResponseBody等常用注解的解析，基于json5生成YAPI文档

用法：
  • 将光标定位到方法区域或者类名，鼠标右键单击"Upload To YAPI".

自定义配置项：
Preferences —> Other Settings —> YAPI Helper Setting

Project token 项目token
Default save category 默认保存分类
Classify API automatically 是否自动分类
Is Multiple Module Project 是否是多模块项目
Is Use Default Token 是否使用默认token

idea-plugin.name: Easy Deploy
idea-plugin.description:
Convenient Intellij Platform Plugin for Deploying and Upgrading Services during Development

Easy Deploy is a plugin I developed, inspired by the Alibaba Cloud Toolkit, to facilitate my service deployment during the development process. Compared to the Alibaba Cloud Toolkit, my plugin has significantly fewer features, as many of the ACT functionalities are unnecessary for me and make it somewhat bloated.

Therefore, I focused only on developing the functionalities I care about: server management and the deployment process. I named this plugin "Easy Deploy" in the hope that it will help developers simplify the deployment steps in their development process. I will continually optimize it and enhance its features.

Features

  • Add/Edit/Remove/Search server information
  • Add/Edit/Remove/Share commands
  • Upload files or directories with filtering support
  • Deploy services
  • Pre/Post-upload command execution support
  • Command execution directory override (use upload path)
  • Remote class hot update
  • Open terminal
  • SSH password-free login (private key login)
  • SSH jump host
  • Run/Debug Configuration (parallel deployment)
  • I18n support
  • SFTP transfer panel
  • Plugin settings
  • Export & Import & Clean plugin configuration

issue: easy-deploy

方便开发过程中部署升级服务的 Intellij 平台插件

Easy Deploy 是我借鉴 Alibaba Cloud Toolkit 插件开发的一个方便自己在开发过程中部署服务的插件。相比较 Alibaba Cloud Toolkit，我开发的插件功能会少很多很多，因为 ACT 很多的功能我都用不上，对我来说它有点臃肿。

因此，我只取自己关注的那部分功能进行开发，这部分就是对服务器的管理以及发布的过程。我给这个插件起这个名是希望他能够帮助开发者简化开发过程的部署步骤，我会不断地优化它，完善它的功能。

功能

  • 添加/编辑/删除/搜索服务器信息
  • 添加/编辑/删除/分享命令
  • 上传文件或者目录，并支持过滤
  • 文件（目录）上传配置
  • 前置/后置命令执行支持
  • 命令执行目录覆盖（使用上传路径）
  • 远程类热更新
  • 终端连接
  • SSH 免密登录（私钥登录）
  • SSH 代理跳板机
  • Run/Debug Configuration (并行部署)
  • 国际化
  • SFTP 传输面板
  • 插件设置
  • 导出、导入、清除插件配置

反馈: easy-deploy

idea-plugin.name: Smart Apusic
idea-plugin.description:
The Apusic plugin for Intellij IDEA.

Run/Debug Apusic Application Server or RockyAS with IDEA. Apusic Application Server(AAS) is a Web Application Server developed by KingDee.

User Guide

1. In Run/Debug, choose SmartApusic

2. Config the run/debug config

  • Apusic Server: config or choose Apusic server
  • Domain : default domain is $APUSIC_HOME/domains/mydomain
  • Deployment directory: the web application deployment directory, the plugin will find it automatically.
  • Context path: the web application context path, it will be project name by default.
  • Add libraries and classes: if the Deployment directory does not contain the dependencies libraries and classes, please select it.
  • VM Options : input the vm options, e.g. "-Xmx1024m -Xms1024m"
  • Env Options : extract apusic env parameters, e.g. "e.g. param1=value1"

3. Start run/debug

The plugin will automatically change the config.xml or apusic.conf/server.xml in Apusic Domain.

idea-plugin.name: AureliaStorm Community

This plugin brings improved support for [Aurelia Framework](https://aurelia.io) to the [IntelliJ platform](https://www.jetbrains.com/products.html?fromMenu#lang=js&type=ide)

### Custom elements & attributes
* Declaration resolving using `@customElement` and `@customAttribute` annotation or class names * Custom element property recognition (`@bindable` annotation) * Require and import tag reference detection for typescript files * Component and property navigation (ctrl+click) * Component lifecycle hooks (like `attached`, `detached`) * Detecting bindable HTML attributes and events (such as `class.bind` or `click.delegate`) * Custom element/attribute and property suggestions (ctrl+space) * GoTo HTML/ts file action when in same folder (Default Alt+Ctrl+Shift+O)
### Insight for bindings and interpolation
* Can be enabled/disabled in the **plugin settings** (ony works with public members and can sometimes resolve references wrong) * Code insight for `${}` and binding attribute values * Controller properties completion and navigation * `$this`, `$parent`, `$index`, `$event` support

idea-plugin.name: Feign-Helper
idea-plugin.description:
Feign-Helper is a paid productivity plugin for the Spring framework. It enables quick URL lookup in the source code, one-click copying of Spring Web Controller endpoint paths, and navigation between Feign interfaces and their corresponding Controller implementations in Spring Cloud projects.

Features

  • HTTP API search in "Search Everywhere" (double-press Shift): supports path parameters, descriptions, interfaces inside JAR dependencies, and method filters
  • One-click copy of Spring Web Controller endpoint paths
  • Feign <-> Controller navigation in Spring Cloud projects (class and method level)
  • Configurable project-wide prefix and custom URL prefix
  • Cross-project (multi-window) navigation

Note: API collection supports both Java and Kotlin sources (Kotlin-declared endpoints can be searched and used as navigation targets from Java code).

Usage

  • Click the status bar rabbit icon to trigger or force a re-scan; hover over it to see the number of scanned Controller methods and Feign interfaces
  • Menu: Tools -> Reparse Api re-scans the project
  • Settings -> Tools -> Feign Helper: enable/disable scanning and markers

中文说明

Feign-Helper 是一款面向 Spring 框架的付费效率插件：快速检索源码中的 HTTP 接口、一键复制 Spring Web Controller 端点路径，并支持 Spring Cloud 项目中 Feign 与 Controller 接口之间的相互导航。

主要功能

  • 双击 Shift 打开 Search Everywhere 检索 HTTP 接口：支持路径参数、描述、jar 包内接口与方法过滤
  • 一键复制 Spring Web Controller 端点路径
  • Spring Cloud 项目中 Feign 与 Controller 的类级/方法级互跳
  • 项目统一前缀、自定义 URL 前缀、跨工程窗口导航

说明：接口收集支持 Java 与 Kotlin 源码——Kotlin 中声明的接口可被检索，并可作为 Java 侧的跳转目标。

使用方式

  • 点击状态栏兔子图标触发或强制重新扫描；悬停可查看已扫描的 Controller 方法与 Feign 接口数量
  • 菜单：Tools -> Reparse Api 可重新扫描项目
  • 设置 -> 工具 -> Feign Helper：可开关扫描与行标记功能

idea-plugin.name: CodeCopy
idea-plugin.description:
Plugin Introduction

This plugin is designed to address the challenges developers face during collaborative development, especially in scenarios where sharing code snippets, conducting code reviews, or instantly backing up local code to cloud storage is necessary. It provides an extremely convenient solution. Additionally, the plugin supports all optional programming languages on the CodeCopy system.

How to Use

1) Select the code we need to share, right-click to select the CodeCopy plugin.

2) If it's the first time using it, you need to log in to the CodeCopy system. Scan the code in the pop-up interface to log in.

3) After successfully logging in, share again to upload the code to your own account and obtain the sharing link (automatically copied to the clipboard).

idea-plugin.name: Browser Extension Generator
idea-plugin.description:
Adds a new project type, Browser Extension, to the File | New Project dialog, and an option to generate a browser extension bundle as a .zip or .xpi file in the project directory. You can generate the extension from the project context menu (File | Save as extension) or from File menu (File | Save project as extension). Both options create the extension file you need:
  • As the item at the bottom of the context menu (right-click on the project name)
  • In the File menu
Additionally, the plugin can generate standard-size extension icons from a .png or .jpg image placed in the icons/ directory. The image must be square: if it's not, it will be cropped to a square by the shortest side automatically.

What's New

  • Version 1.3: A new "Generate Standard Icons" option is available when right-clicking a .png or .jpg file in the icons directory, and from the custom toolbar button dropdown.
  • Version 1.4: Additional icon sizes (64x64 and 96x96) are now generated in the icons/ directory.
Support: ij-browser-extension-support@keepdev.com

idea-plugin.name: HttpRequest
idea-plugin.description:
Provides the ability to edit and execute HTTP / WebSocket / Dubbo requests from the code editor of IDEA.
  • Support sending GET, POST and other requests
  • Support sending WebSocket request
  • Support sending Dubbo request
  • Support cookie, save cookies locally and send them with subsequent requests
  • Support Environment, build-in variable and build-in method
  • Support jump to SpringMVC Controller method from url
  • Show SpringMVC Controller method information when hover in url
  • Support jump to SpringMVC Controller method bean field from json property
  • Show SpringMVC Controller method bean field information when hover in json key
  • Support JavaScript previous handler, post handler and global handler(JavaScript syntax highlighting depends on WebCalm plugin. After install WebCalm, please restart IDEA, Otherwise JavaScript syntax highlighting will not work.)
  • Support reading file content as http request body
  • Support saving http response body to file
  • When the response Content-Type is image type, it supports direct preview of the corresponding image
  • Support preview HTML response
  • Support preview pdf response
  • Support searching SpringMVC Api in the SearchEverywhere Dialog
  • Support Mock Http Server
  • Support Mock WebSocket Server
  • Support Mock Dubbo Server
Getting Started:
  1. Create a file with an HTTP suffix
  2. Type gtr or ptr to trigger live templates and quickly create HTTP requests
  3. Click the run button on the left side of the editor to sending request and view the response
提供从 IDEA Editor 编写和执行 HTTP / WebSocket / Dubbo 请求的能力。
  • 支持发起 GET、POST 等请求
  • 支持发起 WebSocket 请求
  • 支持发起 Dubbo 请求
  • 支持 Cookie 功能，支持保存 Cookie 到本地并随着后续请求发送
  • 支持环境变量、内置变量和内置方法
  • 支持从 url 跳转到对应的 SpringMVC Controller 方法
  • url 悬浮提示对应的 SpringMVC Controller 方法信息
  • 支持从 json 属性跳转到对应的 SpringMVC Controller 方法的出入参 Bean 字段
  • json 属性悬浮提示对应的 SpringMVC Controller 方法的出入参 Bean 字段信息
  • 支持 JavaScript 语法的前置处理器、后置处理器和全局前置处理器(JavaScript 语法高亮功能依赖 WebCalm 插件. 在安装 WebCalm 插件后, 请重启 IDEA, 否则 js 语法高亮功能不会生效)
  • 支持从文件读取内容作为请求体
  • 支持保存响应到文件
  • 当响应的 Content-Type 为图片时支持直接预览响应的图片
  • 支持预览 HTML 响应
  • 支持预览 pdf 响应
  • 支持在 SearchEverywhere 窗口搜索 SpringMVC Api
  • 支持 Mock Http Server
  • 支持 Mock WebSocket Server
  • 支持 Mock Dubbo Server
开始使用：
  1. 创建一个 http 后缀的文件
  2. 输入 gtr 或 ptr 等触发实时模板从而快速创建 http 请求
  3. 点击编辑器左侧的运行按钮发起请求并查看响应

idea-plugin.name: I18n-Extractor
idea-plugin.description:
Multi-framework i18n Extractor
This plugin helps developers quickly internationalize hard-coded strings in JavaScript/TypeScript projects:
- **Multi-framework**: auto-detects Vue (vue-i18n), React (react-i18next / react-intl), Angular (ngx-translate), Solid (solid-i18n) and Svelte (svelte-i18n), producing the correct i18n call syntax - **Multi-language**: extracts Chinese, Japanese, Korean, English, French, Russian, German, Spanish, Italian and Portuguese — target languages are configurable in Settings - Scans template text nodes, attributes, TS/JS string literals, concatenations and template literals (including Vue single-file components) - Context-aware extraction based on a string's role in the syntax tree, not just raw characters - Auto-injects `import` statements and hook declarations (`useI18n` for Vue / `useTranslation` for React) - Supports both single-file extraction and project-wide batch extraction - Suggests merging similar strings via common prefix/suffix and digit-placeholder grouping - All changes wrapped in `WriteCommandAction` — fully supports undo (Ctrl+Z)
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.10.0

  • Performance: significantly faster extraction on large files and long-running sessions
  • Cached analysis for injected PSI (Vue mustache) via host-file key fallback — no more repeated full scans
  • Precompiled regex constants for local-shadow declaration detection (no per-call recompilation)
  • Binary-search scope classification replaces per-function ancestor traversal (O(n) → O(log n))
  • Shared file-level cache for React/Vue component and custom-hook detection across detect/collect/rewrite phases

1.6.9

  • Multi-framework support with auto-detection: Vue (vue-i18n), React (react-i18next & react-intl), Angular (ngx-translate), Solid (solid-i18n), Svelte (svelte-i18n)
  • Multi-language extraction for 10 languages (zh / ja / ko / en / fr / ru / de / es / it / pt), target languages configurable in Settings
  • Merge suggestions: public prefix / suffix grouping and digit-placeholder grouping to consolidate similar strings
  • Auto-injection of global \$t and import / hook planning per framework
  • More stable extraction, improved idempotency and expanded regression coverage

1.2.0

  • fix: optimize comment extraction logic

idea-plugin.name: Web Browser Panel
idea-plugin.description:
Web Browser Panel embeds a Chromium-based web browser (the IDE's bundled JCEF runtime) directly in a tool window, so you can preview a local web dev server right next to your code — no Alt‑Tab required.

Note: the embedded view is plain Chromium (the IDE's bundled JCEF runtime), so it doesn't share your everyday browser's profile, extensions, or bookmarks. The Open in… button hands the current page to your system default browser, or any browser configured in the IDE.

Features

  • Embedded browser tool window — back / forward / reload and an editable address bar.
  • Themed empty state — a clean, theme-aware SVG placeholder instead of Chromium's raw error page when nothing is loaded or a site is unreachable.
  • Live reload on save — reload when files are saved; pick the folder and file extensions to watch.
  • Timed auto-refresh — reload on a fixed interval you set, in seconds.
  • Open browser on run — when a run configuration starts, wait until the URL is reachable, then open and navigate the tool window automatically.
  • Open in… — open the current page in your system default browser, or any browser configured under Settings > Tools > Web Browsers.

Getting started

Open the Web Browser tool window from the right tool-window bar, then set your dev-server URL, live-reload, and open-on-run options under Settings > Tools > Web Browser Panel.

Requirements

Requires a JCEF-enabled JetBrains Runtime (the default JBR). If JCEF is unavailable, the tool window shows a short notice instead of a browser.

Additional information

  • Author: Dervis Mansuroglu
  • Source code & issue tracker: github.com/dervism/intellij-webbrowser
  • License: MIT — free and open source.

Technical details:

  • Written in Kotlin and built with the IntelliJ Platform Gradle Plugin.
  • Embeds Chromium via JCEF (the bundled JetBrains Runtime) — no external browser is required for the tool window.
  • Compatible with IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2+ (since-build 262) and other JetBrains IDEs running a JCEF-enabled runtime.
  • A lightweight platform plugin — depends only on the platform and the bundled JCEF module (com.intellij.modules.platform, com.intellij.modules.jcef).
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.5.8

  • Fix: the tool window no longer crashes on IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2. 2026.2 moved the embedded-browser runtime (JCEF) into a separate bundled plugin, so opening the panel failed with NoClassDefFoundError: com/intellij/ui/jcef/JBCefApp. The plugin now declares the JCEF module dependency explicitly. Requires 2026.2+ (since-build 262); 2026.1 users stay on 0.5.7.

0.5.0 – 0.5.7

The 0.5 line turns the panel into a proper in-IDE dev browser: in-page search, DevTools and a console, a full-featured tab strip, project-aware settings, and editor integration.

Dev-loop power tools.

  • Find in page (Ctrl/Cmd+F) — inline find bar with next / previous and the standard Enter / Shift+Enter / Esc keys.
  • DevTools — open the full Chromium DevTools in its own window from a toolbar button or with F12.
  • Browser console — a bottom panel shows the active tab's console.log/warn/error output in real time, with level-coloured lines. Toggle it from the settings row or with Ctrl+`.
  • Hard reload bypassing the disk cache (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+R), plus a Stop button: the reload icon turns into a stop icon while a page is loading and cancels the load on click.

A full tab strip.

  • Drag to reorder, pin tabs, and a right-click menu with Pin / Close / Close Other Tabs. Pinned tabs survive Close Other and round-trip across restarts.
  • Overflow — the tab strip scrolls horizontally when there are more tabs than fit, instead of wrapping onto a second row.
  • Reopen closed tab (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+T), middle-click to close, New Tab (Ctrl/Cmd+T), and Ctrl+Tab / Ctrl+Shift+Tab cycling.
  • Persisted session — your open tabs are restored when the project re-opens.

Project-aware settings.

  • Per-project home URL overriding the application default, used by the Home button and Open in….
  • Glob watch patterns — a power-user alternative to the folder + extensions field, e.g. /project/src/**/*.{ts,tsx}, one per line.
  • Per-host zoom memory — a site's zoom level is remembered and reapplied next time you visit that host.
  • Settings validation — Apply refuses invalid input (empty URL, unparseable globs) and focuses the offending field.

Address bar & editor integration.

  • History-backed autocomplete on the address bar — a per-project list of visited URLs suggested as you type (arrow keys to navigate, Enter to accept, Esc to dismiss).
  • Open URL in Web Browser Panel — an editor right-click action (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+B) opens the URL under the caret, or the selected text, in the panel instead of the OS browser.

0.2.8 – 0.4.3

A series of releases focused on a richer browsing experience and a tidier toolbar.

Tabs. The tool window now supports multiple tabs. Open new tabs from the New Tab button, close them with the × on each tab, and links that would normally open in a separate window (target="_blank") now open as a new tab inside the panel instead of escaping the IDE. Each tab keeps its own URL, navigation history, and zoom level; switching tabs updates the toolbar to match.

Zoom. A Zoom ▾ dropdown on the toolbar offers Zoom In, Zoom Out, and Reset Zoom, with a matching Zoom ▸ submenu on the right-click context menu. Zoom is per-tab and steps reliably in both directions.

Compact toolbar. Back, forward, and reload are now borderless icons that sit inside the URL field, so the address bar stays usable even on narrow tool windows. A new Settings ▾ toggle collapses the secondary row (Reload on save, Auto-refresh, Zoom, Open in) into a single line that hides by default, and remembers your choice between sessions.

Auto-refresh dropdown. The auto-refresh interval is now a compact dropdown of presets (1, 2, 3, 5, 10, 30, and 60 seconds) instead of a free-form number field, freeing up room in the toolbar. Any previously configured interval is rounded to the nearest preset.

Fixes.

  • View Page Source from the right-click menu now works.
  • Placeholder and blank tabs are labelled New Tab instead of an internal identifier.
  • Removed a stray bright frame that could appear around tab content under some themes.

0.2.7

  • Renamed the plugin to Web Browser Panel to avoid a Marketplace name collision. Plugin id, settings, and behaviour are unchanged.

0.2.6

  • Smart address bar: typing a search phrase (e.g. what is rust) and pressing Enter now runs a Startpage search instead of trying to load it as a URL. URL-like inputs (with a scheme, a /, a dot, localhost, an IP, or host:port) still load normally. The same routing applies when you use Open in….

0.2.5

  • Fix (real one): minimal pages no longer render dark. The previous 0.2.4 attempt set color-scheme: light via JS after the page rendered, which Chromium ignored for the already-painted canvas. The browser's Swing wrapper is now forced opaque white, and untheme pages additionally get a white body background. Pages that opt into a color scheme of their own (color-scheme: dark / dark light) are still left alone.

0.2.4

  • Fix: dark canvas on minimal pages. The embedded JCEF browser used to inherit the IDE's dark theme as its canvas, so pages that didn't declare a color-scheme (a minimal Astro/Vite starter, a stripped-down HTML page, …) rendered dark text on a dark background and were unreadable. The plugin now sets color-scheme: light on the root element of any page that doesn't opt into a scheme of its own; pages that intentionally support dark mode (dark or dark light) are left alone.

0.2.3

  • Brighter tool-window stripe icon on dark themes (added a _dark.svg variant using the standard IntelliJ icon foreground so it no longer reads as washed-out next to the platform's own icons).

0.2.2

  • Fix: "Open browser on run" now actually fires. The ExecutionListener was registered as a project listener even though the topic is application-level, so on recent IDE builds it silently never received processStarted events. Now registered as an application listener.
  • Robust port probing. The "wait until URL is reachable" mode now walks every resolved IP for the hostname (matters on macOS where localhost can resolve to ::1 first while many dev servers bind only to 127.0.0.1).
  • UI: the address bar is now on its own line below the navigation buttons, so it no longer disappears when the tool window gets narrow.
  • Added INFO-level logging in the open-on-run flow so future "nothing happened" investigations leave a trail in idea.log.

0.2.1

  • Friendlier load-failure view: when a page fails to load, the embedded view falls back to the same themed home page shown on first open — no more cryptic browser error messages or assumptions about what kind of site you're loading.
  • Subtle pulse animation on the home-page globe for a touch of life.

0.2.0

  • New — Open in…: a dropdown to open the current page in the system default browser or any IDE-configured browser.
  • New — Open browser on run: automatically open the tool window when a run configuration starts, waiting until the URL is reachable.
  • New — Live reload: reload on file save (selectable folder & extensions) plus timed auto-refresh.
  • New — Themed empty state: a themed SVG placeholder in place of Chromium's error page.

0.1.0

  • Initial release: embedded Chromium browser tool window with an address bar, navigation, and a configurable home URL.
