idea-plugin.name: Transliterate Umlauts
idea-plugin.description:
This plugin is for projects which use German for naming their classes, symbols, and files but restrict the character set used for naming to ASCII. E.g. they would have classes like "Aenderungsauftrag" instead of "Änderungsauftrag". Finding something in such an environment becomes a hassle once the use of native characters is allowed, because now you may encounter both spellings and never know, if you just missed a class when searching by one spelling or the other.

This is where this plugin steps in. It will produce hits for both spellings, i.e. if the users entered "Änd" in the "navigate to class" field (CTRL+N), IDEA will produce both "Aenderungsauftrag" and "Änderungsauftrag". It also works vice versa with the restriction that this way around the translation is not unique, e.g. searching for "Kaesefondue" would not see the actual class "Käsefondue" because the plugin overdid its job.
idea-plugin.change-notes: Broadened version dependencies.

idea-plugin.name: Navigate to URL
idea-plugin.description:
Enables navigation from any matching string literal or xml attribute value or xml element text to a url defined by url rules.
This, for instance, makes a string anywhere in the code like "GD-123", when clicked, navigate to https://mysite.atlassian.net/browse/GD-123

To create url rules, create a file called navigate-url-plugin.properties at the root of any module.

Example "navigate-url-plugin.properties" file contents :
url1.startsWith=GD-
url1.navigateTo=https://mysite.atlassian.net/browse/{0}

The source code uses code from the existing plugin: ishchenko/idea-navigate-from-literal.

TODO: Support the traditional configuration UI, if requested by plugin users. The author's use case is for a team where using the normal shared intellij plugin configuration isn't an option. Using a project config file instead provides the shared config automatically for all team members.

idea-plugin.name: Launch URL from String
idea-plugin.description:
Out of the box IntelliJ lets you define Regular Expressions to turn plain-text entries in your check-in comments and branch names into hyperlinks. The most common use case is to link issues back to your issue tracker.

This plugin applies those same rules to literal strings, comments, XML attributes and XML element text. Now code like @TestCase("DEVCCPERF-142") or <foo>DEVCCPERF-142</foo> becomes hyperlinks, too.

Of course you can define link patterns to go anywhere you like. See here for more information.

Supported Languages
  • Dart
  • Gosu
  • Java
  • JavaScript
  • Kotlin
  • Scala
  • Php
  • Python
  • XML (applied to attributes and element text)

Installation Instructions Install it like a normal plugin, then restart. Define a few Regex mappings under File/Settings/Version Control/Issue Navigation. Now you should be able to CTRL-click on matching Strings.

Acknowledgements Special thanks to Max Ishchenko, whose plugin idea-navigate-url-from-literal inspired and guided this one.

Thanks too to JetBrains for releasing the source to the wonderful IntelliJ Community Edition, and for creating Kotlin—my new favorite programming language.

Source Code This plugin is written in Kotlin. The source is available on GitHub under the Apache License.

idea-plugin.name: Navigation Wheel
idea-plugin.description: An IntelliJ plugin for fast and comfortable navigation
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Fixed

  • Fixed an issue where the navigation wheel would not reopen or display correctly after pressing the close button on multi-monitor setups, especially when the IDE is on a secondary screen.
  • Improved wheel resizing and positioning during refresh by explicitly setting window location and size to ensure it stays centered on the correct monitor.
  • Resolved a race condition where the popup could be automatically closed by the IDE during file closing by disabling auto-cancellation and ensuring the popup is recreated if necessary.
  • Enhanced active monitor detection by using KeyboardFocusManager to identify the correctly focused window, ensuring the wheel opens on the intended screen in multi-monitor environments.
  • Added a delay using SwingUtilities.invokeLater when refreshing the wheel after closing a file to ensure all IDE focus and window events are processed.

idea-plugin.name: lastedited
idea-plugin.description:
This plugin keeps in a list the file navigation history within a project, giving you a clear view on the last files you browsed previously.

It is specially designed for projects containing a lot of files, when the project tree organized in package is useless and when working on functionalities requires to navigate to several places in the tree structure.

  • Presents your navigation history in a list for further use
  • Groups into coherent sets using a kmean
  • Sorts the files the last edited first
  • Filters for a quicker access

idea-plugin.name: Smart Jump
idea-plugin.description:
Smart Jump — Navigate to anywhere you want.

🔎 REST Endpoint Search (Ctrl+\):
  • Search all REST endpoints across your project in a filterable popup
  • Languages: Java, Kotlin, Python, PHP, JavaScript, TypeScript, Go, Rust
  • Frameworks: Spring, FastAPI, Flask, Django, Laravel, Symfony, Slim, Express, Koa, NestJS, Actix-web, Rocket, Axum, Gin, Echo, Chi, Sanic, JAX-RS, Jakarta, Micronaut
  • Works in any JetBrains IDE (IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, RustRover, GoLand...)
Java / MyBatis:
  • Java Method ➔ MyBatis XML
  • MyBatis XML ➔ Java Method
  • MyBatis XML include refid ➔ sql fragment
  • MyBatis XML resultMap ref ➔ resultMap definition
Spring:
  • @Value("${key}") ↔ application.properties/yml
  • @Qualifier / @Resource ➔ @Bean definition
  • Feign Client method ➔ Controller endpoint
HTML / CSS / JS / TS:
  • HTML ➔ JS/CSS file
  • HTML ➔ JS function
  • Vue event ➔ JS function
  • JS/TS ➔ Controller RequestMapping
  • CSS class in code ➔ CSS/SCSS definition
  • i18n key (t/$t/__) ➔ translation file entry
  • process.env / import.meta.env ↔ .env definition
  • Eggjs ctx.service jump
Python (Django / Flask / FastAPI):
  • Django URL pattern ➔ view function
  • Flask/FastAPI route ➔ handler
PHP (Laravel / Symfony):
  • Laravel Route ➔ Controller method
  • Blade @include/@extends ➔ template file
  • Laravel config() ➔ config file
Ruby on Rails:
  • Rails route ➔ controller#action
  • Rails render partial ➔ partial file
  • Rails model association ➔ related model
Go / Rust / Config:
  • Go interface ➔ implementation
  • go.mod ➔ pkg.go.dev
  • Cargo.toml ➔ crates.io
  • Dockerfile FROM ➔ Docker Hub
Dependency Registry:
  • Maven pom.xml / Gradle ➔ Maven Central
  • package.json ➔ npm
  • requirements.txt / pyproject.toml ➔ PyPI
  • Gemfile ➔ RubyGems

How to use:
  • Gutter icon (left side of editor)
  • Right-click menu ➔ Smart Jump
  • Shortcut: Alt + J
  • REST Endpoint Search: Ctrl + \

Issues | Plugins | Email

idea-plugin.name: Api Savior
idea-plugin.description:
An interface document generation tool that generates interface call documents based on javadoc comment (or Swagger annotations), including url, content-type, examples and descriptions of input fields, and examples and descriptions of output fields; also supports exporting to Postman and cURL!

接口文档生成工具, 根据 Javadoc 注释(或 Swagger 注解)生成接口调用文档, 包含 url, content-type, 入参字段示例及说明, 出参字段示例及说明; 同时支持导出到 Postman 以及 cURL!

GitHub | Issues | Get Started | LICENSE

若图片显示不全，请点此打开到网页上查看

English 🇺🇸

Api Savior 是做什么的？

  • 是一个 IDEA 插件，仅支持 Java 。
  • 生成 HTTP 接口文档，格式上支持 markdown、html，目的是取代 Swagger。
  • 理论上支持所有 Spring MVC 注解开发的 HTTP 接口，同理也支持 Feign 的微服务，另外 Dubbo 这种纯接口写法也是支持的。
  • 同时附带一些相关小能力，如支持导出到 Postman，支持生成 cURL 命令，支持单个数据传输类生成说明文档表格、json 示例。
  • 移植并完善了两个插件的功能：Github GenerateAllSetter Pull#66 | Github genSets

与 Swagger 的区别

  • 随时修改，随时生成，无需启动项目
  • 支持 java doc 注释
  • 支持 RPC 接口（即 Dubbo/Feign）
  • 生成的文档带有入参/出参示例，更直观
  • 多种载体，不局限于网页或文档；比如目前就支持导出到 Postman，后续可以很轻松的实现导出到 Yapi，亦或是类似的平台；我们的目的是，写一次注释，一辈子管用！

为什么这个项目有用？

  1. 代码总是需要点注释，好记性不如烂笔头；而现在，又多了一个写好注释的好理由！
  2. 每次写接口文档都觉得在做苦力活，尤其是管理后台的业务，动辄就是好几个表的增删改查，也就意味着起码十几个接口，这完全是可避免的！
  3. 这个插件并不是是只能生成接口文档，还可以实现更多的偷懒的方式（只要和接口相关的），还有很多等待着我们去发掘！

我该如何开始？

1.安装插件

快点击 Install 吧!

2.打开一个 Spring MVC 或 Dubbo 项目

建议直接打开我专门准备的示例项目：api-savior-examples

shell git clone https://github.com/gudqs7-idea-plugins/api-savior-examples

3.生成文档

找到一个 Controller 或 RPC 接口类，
如 cn.gudqs.example.docer.restful.user.controller.UserController
在类名上右键，然后点击 Generate Api Interface Doc 即可

文档如下图

4.批量生成文档及更多

直接在项目上右键（或某个目录/某个类/任意多选亦可），然后点击相应的按钮，如下图

假设我点击了 Batch Generate Api Interface Doc，则我会得到一个文件夹，按模块（可自定义，默认是最后两级报名）分子文件夹的 Markdown 接口文档，如下图

5.通过 Search Everywhere 搜索 Api

双击 Shift 进入 Search Everywhere 后切换到 Api，或使用快捷键 Ctrl + \ 或 Ctrl + Alt + N 进入如下图界面。
此时您可通过 url 或接口描述来搜索并跳转到该接口。

为此我单独开了一个项目 search-everywhere-api-idea-plugin，欢迎来 Star！

如果需要，我可以从哪里获得更多帮助？

通过提交 Issue 来获取帮助

点击访问 Github Issue

欢迎大家提问，欢迎大家一起完善它！

另外，我接入了 IDEA 的错误处理组件，因此当发现插件报错提示时，按照 IDEA 提示，可查看错误信息，并一键上报给我（即自动生成一个 Issue）

通过查看 Wiki 来获取更多说明

点击访问 Wiki

通过查看 demo 示例来了解项目实际使用效果

  • 点击查看示例项目的 HTML 格式文档效果
  • 点击访问示例项目 Github

idea-plugin.name: Search Everywhere Api
idea-plugin.description:
在 Search Everywhere 中通过 url 或接口描述搜索 Api 并快读跳转! | Search APIs by url or interface description in Search Everywhere and read and jump quickly!

GitHub | Issues | Get Started | LICENSE

English 🇺🇸

Search Everywhere Api 是做什么的？

  • 是一个 IDEA 插件，仅支持 Java 。
  • 通过 Search Everywhere 搜索 Api

我该如何开始？

1.安装插件

快点击 Install 吧!

2.打开一个 Spring MVC 或 Dubbo 项目

建议直接打开我专门准备的示例项目：docer-savior-plugin-usage-examples

shell git clone https://github.com/docer-savior/docer-savior-plugin-usage-examples

3.通过 Search Everywhere 搜索 Api

双击 Shift 进入 Search Everywhere 后切换到 Api，或使用快捷键 Ctrl + \ 或 Ctrl + Alt + N 进入如下图界面。
此时您可通过 url 或接口描述来搜索并跳转到该接口。

不输入任何数据时，展示所有 Api；另外可以根据方法类型筛选。

在 All 下也可以搜索

如果需要，我可以从哪里获得更多帮助？

通过提交 Issue 来获取帮助

点击访问 Github Issue

欢迎大家提问，欢迎大家一起完善它！

另外，我接入了 IDEA 的错误处理组件，因此当发现插件报错提示时，按照 IDEA 提示，可查看错误信息，并一键上报给我（即自动生成一个 Issue）

通过查看 Wiki 来获取更多说明

点击访问 Wiki

贡献指南

贡献指南

致谢名单

  • Github RESTKit

idea-plugin.name: NotesTree
idea-plugin.description:
If you tired of hundred tabs in Notepad++, this plugin brings consistency and availability to your notes in pretty convenient way. The plugin adds ability to write tree structure global notes in such formats as txt, md, json, xml, yaml, sql, csv, xlsx, sh or http. The plugin brings you the way to keep Dockerfile or docker_compose templates, images(png, jpg), pdf, doc, docx, java, python or kotlin files and create symbolic links(MacOS, Linux). It also supports plum and mermaid diagrams.

Intellij idea also provides you to possibility to directly from the plugin run some of these notes like http files, sql scripts or docker_compose templates, it is really convenient and useful during development.

I would really appreciate if you star the plugin. The plugin page github.

plum files require plum integration plugin.

http files require HTTP client plugin.

Dockerfile, docker_compose.yaml require Docker plugin.

png, jpg images, pdf, csv, doc ,docx, xlsx files can be inserted from clipboard.

conf files require Nginx Configuration plugin

Supported formats

  • txt
  • md
  • json
  • xml
  • yaml
  • sql
  • sh
  • csv
  • http
  • pdf
  • jpg
  • jpeg

  • groovy
  • c
  • cpp
  • go

  • py
  • svg
  • conf
  • doc, docx
  • xlsx
  • log

idea-plugin.name: data-pivot
idea-plugin.description:
English:

data-pivot is a data analysis tool for IDEA, designed to provide developers with convenient object-relational mapping navigation and data querying and reporting analysis functions.

Tool Features

  • Default Association Strategy: ORM and ROM mapping strategies based on association.
  • Precise Configurable Mapping: Flexible and configurable ORM and ROM mapping strategies.
  • Convenient Data Matching Query: Fast and efficient object data querying function.
  • Convenient Data Analysis Reports: Easily generate analysis reports for object data.

Usage Advantages

In complex database scenarios, such as dealing with numerous database tables, multiple fields, or special naming rules, data-pivot can significantly reduce repetitive and mechanical manual operations, greatly improving development efficiency.

Database Support

Since 2.x, data-pivot targets IntelliJ IDEA 2025.3+ and reuses the bundled Database Tools support in IDEA. Navigation and metadata discovery are based on IDEA data sources; query SQL generation is currently maintained for MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, and SQL Server.

The plugin does not bundle JDBC drivers anymore. It loads the driver already configured or downloaded by the IDEA data source, which keeps the plugin package small. It does not claim support for every database or dialect supported by IDEA; MongoDB and other non-JDBC/data-source-specific dialects are not supported by the query feature in 2.x.

Future Plans

In the future, we will continue to expand and optimize the plugin's functions, providing more configurable strategy mappings and configurable report scripts, while also adapting to more databases.

Detailed operation documents: https://github.com/weilhuang/data-pivot

中文:

data-pivot 是一个IDEA的数据分析工具，旨在为开发人员提供便捷的对象关系映射导航和数据查询和报表分析功能。

工具特性

  • 默认关联策略：基于关联度的 ORM 和 ROM 映射策略。
  • 精准配置映射：灵活可配置的 ORM 和 ROM 映射策略。
  • 便捷的数据匹配查询：快速高效的对象数据查询功能。
  • 便捷的数据分析报表：轻松生成对象数据的分析报表。

使用优势

在复杂数据库场景下，例如面对大量数据库表、众多字段或特殊命名规则等情况，data-pivot 可以显著减少重复性和机械性的人工操作，大幅提升开发效率。

数据库支持

从 2.x 开始，data-pivot 面向 IntelliJ IDEA 2025.3+，复用 IDEA 内置的 Database Tools 能力。导航和元数据发现基于 IDEA 数据源；查询 SQL 生成当前维护 MySQL、PostgreSQL、Oracle、SQL Server。

插件不再打包 JDBC 驱动，而是加载 IDEA 数据源已配置或已下载的驱动，从而减小插件体积。当前不宣称支持 IDEA 支持的全部数据库或全部 SQL 方言；MongoDB 和其他非 JDBC/特殊方言数据源在 2.x 中不支持查询功能。

未来规划

未来，我们将继续扩展和优化插件功能，提供更多配置化策略映射和配置化报表脚本，同时适配更多数据库。

详细操作说明文档: https://github.com/weilhuang/data-pivot
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Added

  • Query、Analysis 对话框与 Settings 页的现代化交互（DialogWrapper、SearchTextField、空态/状态栏、主题高亮、快捷键、可访问名称）。
  • Analysis 以字段值分布表替代 Lookup 弹层作为主界面，并支持复制 SQL / 选中值。
  • 扩展 unitTest、integrationTest、ideaUiTest 覆盖查询/分析/设置/导航展示与纯逻辑。
  • Gradle 任务 verifyPluginFast：只做插件结构校验，不下载额外 IDE。
  • CI 对齐 IntelliJ Platform Plugin Template：Build → Test（check）→ Verify → Release draft；失败时上传测试报告。跨平台 ideaUiTest 矩阵改为手动/每周定时，PR 仍在 ubuntu 上跑完整测试套件。
  • Query / Analysis / 装订线共用 MappingResolver：已配置 Settings 时走与 ORM 相同的策略路径；未配置时仅接受唯一命中，歧义不再暗中取最大相似度。
  • Analysis 按 MySQL / PostgreSQL / Oracle / SQL Server 方言生成分布 SQL（含标识符引用），并限制前 20 个区分值。
  • 查询与分析错误改为状态栏 + Notification（已注册 Data Pivot Messages 通知组），不再弹出阻塞式错误对话框。

Changed

  • Settings 的 Apply 状态改为真实 isModified() / reset()，工作副本与缓存分离。
  • 动作文案、Query/Analysis 错误与装订线提示改为 i18n，并声明 ActionUpdateThread.BGT。
  • 默认 HumpUnderline / JPA / MyBatis-Plus 回退的驼峰转换改为正确的捕获组大写（hello_world_test → helloWorldTest，USER_ID → userId）。
  • 启动不再对每个数据源抢 JDBC 连接；连接池仅由 Query 按需创建，dispose 仍关闭 QueryTool 与驱动。
  • Query / Analysis 的 JDBC 移出 EDT：先展示对话框与「正在查询」，再在后台任务回写结果。
  • 装订线仅在高置信（精确名或 Settings 策略命中）时显示，并按 Profile 缩小数据源/库扫描；缓存随 PSI 修改、schema 刷新与 Settings Apply 失效，不再按访问次数驱逐。
  • Settings 帮助文案改为如实描述映射优先级、模糊回退与 Analysis 方言 SQL；实体上的 sqlCode / 自定义 SQL 字段保留反序列化但不再生效。
  • PostgreSQL / Oracle 在存在 schema 时用 schema.table 限定，不再把数据库名当成 schema。
  • Oracle Analysis 给 rs_count / percentage 加引号，避免未加引号别名被转成大写后对不上结果列。
  • Analysis 对 MongoDB / 未知 DBMS 提前给出用户可见错误，不再抛出未处理的 IllegalArgumentException。
  • 多项目 Settings 下，映射与策略查找使用 PsiElement 所属 Project（DataPivotApplication.getInstance(Project)），不再依赖当前聚焦窗口。

idea-plugin.name: FeignClient Assistant With RequestX
idea-plugin.description:
FeignClient Assistant With RequestX is a free IntelliJ IDEA plugin for SpringCloud OpenFeign. It enables bidirectional cross-module navigation between FeignClient interfaces and remote service ApiController classes, parses server.servlet.context-path and spring.mvc.servlet.path from yml/yaml/properties configuration files, and supports one-click URL path copying to the clipboard. Former name: FeignX / Navigator4URL OpenFeign RestController.

GitHub Star | Issues | Pull Request
Features:
1. Inspired by MybatisX and method-level navigation gutter `bird`, it can flexibly jump back and forth between FeignClient and remote service ApiController cross-module. eg. feignClient -> ApiController && ApiController -> feignClient.
2. It supports `server.servlet.context-path` and `spring.mvc.servlet.path` by parsing yml/yaml/properties.
3. It is sufficiently accurate with options, after many rounds of optimization.
4. It supports real-time dynamic parsing of the target interface without the need for manual cache refreshing.
5. It provides a right-side `FeignClient Assistant With RequestX Endpoints` tool window listing all SpringBoot startup classes, SpringMVC and OpenFeign endpoints in a tree (grouped by type with distinct icons), featuring fuzzy path search, HttpType/EndpointType filters, refresh, and expand/collapse-all buttons.
6. It lets you send real HTTP requests right inside the endpoints tool window: select a request node to auto-generate an editable IntelliJ HTTP Client script (with `@RequestBody` / `@RequestParam` / `@PathVariable` support), execute it with one click and inspect the response, plus a request history (saved to the project's `.idea/feignx-history`, searchable and one-click reloadable).
7. Right-clicking on Endpoints provides options, including a one-click copy function to clipboard for the request path.

中文简介: FeignClient Assistant With RequestX 是一款免费的 SpringCloud Feign 以及 HTTP 请求导航与脚本助手。
1. 受 `MybatisX` 和方法级导航侧边栏 `bird` 的启发，它可以在 FeignClient 与远程服务的 ApiController 之间灵活地跨模块来回跳转。例如 feignClient -> ApiController 且 ApiController -> feignClient。
2. 它通过解析 `yml/yaml/properties` 文件来支持 `server.servlet.context-path` 和 `spring.mvc.servlet.path`。
3. 经过多轮优化后，目标端点候选项已具有足够的准确性。
4. 它支持对目标接口进行实时动态解析，无需手动刷新缓存。
5. 它提供右侧 `FeignClient Assistant With RequestX Endpoints` 端点侧边栏，以树形结构集中展示工程内全部 SpringBoot 启动类、SpringMVC 与 OpenFeign 端点（按类型分组、图标区分），支持路径模糊搜索、HttpType/EndpointType 分类过滤、刷新与全部展开/收起。
6. 它支持在端点侧边栏内发送真实 HTTP 请求：选中请求节点自动生成可编辑的 IntelliJ HTTP Client 脚本（兼容 `@RequestBody` / `@RequestParam` / `@PathVariable`），一键执行并展示响应，同时记录请求历史（保存到工程 `.idea/feignx-history`，支持搜索与一键回填）。
7. 鼠标右键Endpoints提供可选项, 调出一键复制请求路径剪切板功能

idea-plugin.name: Fast Peek
idea-plugin.description:
Quickly peek a definition of a symbol under the cursor in an editable popup.

It is similar to the Quick Definition feature, but is different in following ways:

  1. Instead of a short snippet of the definition, it shows the containing file
  2. The file is fully editable in the popup so you can quickly adjust
  3. Further invocation of the action will continue to go deeper in the same popup

How to use it

The action is called Fast Peek, search it via Find Action (ctrl/cmd+shift+a). You can assign a shortcut to it via the keymap. For vim users action id is: com.github.vsuhanov.fastpeek.peek

I use it with ideavimrc via the following mapping:

nmap K :action com.github.vsuhanov.fastpeek.peek<CR>

I also bind the action to the double-click in the keymap of IntellJ. This allows very convenient navigation with the mouse. When I want to see where a variable or a function comes from I can just double-click on it.

Important to note that double-clicking works poorly if you rely on it to do a word selection because the popup will steal the focus and ctrl/cmd+c will copy the first line from the editor that opened in the popup

Known limitations

  1. currently double-click in the popup that opens is hardcoded to trigger the same action, so you won't be able to do selection in this way in the popup.
  2. GotoDefinition action (ctrl/cmd+b, ctrl/cmd+click, scroll wheel button click) currently only works via keyboard shortcuts and scroll wheel button click. ctrl/cmd+click does not work.
    • it's also going to open the defition in the main editor, not in the popup. Further navigation with the popup is available via double-click

What's new

1.0.6

  1. remove "until-build" to allow it to run on any new version

1.0.5

  1. show a title with the file name on top of the popup
  2. in some cases navigation in the editor (if it is in the same file) will actually happen in the popup.
  • this is work in progress, unfortunately the platform does not support any simple implementation to navigate within the same editor

idea-plugin.name: BetterJump
idea-plugin.description:
BetterJump
An IntelliJ IDEA plugin for better in-file navigation.

Repo Link

Overview
BetterJump introduces precise, customizable navigation shortcuts that make moving inside code files much faster. You can jump between blocks, words, or commas, and even select sections intelligently — without ever touching the mouse.

Default Keyboard Shortcuts

Block Navigation

  • Go to Next Block — Moves caret to the first non-whitespace character of the next {} block. Shift + Ctrl + Alt + ]
  • Go to Previous Block — Moves caret to the first non-whitespace character of the previous {} block. Shift + Ctrl + Alt + [
  • Go to Inner Block — Start of inner block content. Shift + Alt + ]
  • Go to Outer Block — Start of outer block content. Shift + Alt + [
  • Select Code Block — Selects code inside current {} block. Shift + Ctrl + Alt + W

Comma Navigation

  • Go To Next Comma — Moves caret to the next comma. Ctrl + ,
  • Go To Previous Comma — Moves caret to the previous comma. Ctrl + Shift + ,
  • Select Content To Next Comma — Selects text between commas to the right. Ctrl + Alt + ,
  • Select Content To Previous Comma — Selects text between commas to the left. Ctrl + Alt + Shift + ,

Horizontal / Word Navigation

  • Jump Horizontally — Jumps caret by a preset number of characters. Shift + Ctrl + Alt + X
  • Set Horizontal Jump Amount — Opens dialog to set jump size. Shift + Ctrl + G or Shift + Ctrl + X
  • Invert Jump Horizontal Direction — Inverts left ↔ right. Shift + Alt + X
  • Jump To Right (Word) — Jumps to next word start. Ctrl + Shift + Alt + →
  • Jump To Left (Word) — Jumps to previous word start. Ctrl + Shift + Alt + ←

Author
Stav Gordeev
Email: stav.gr8@gmail.com

idea-plugin.name: ParagraphJump
idea-plugin.description: ParagraphJump helps you quickly navigate between paragraphs or logical blocks in your code or text by jumping to the next or previous empty line. Use Shift+Control+9 to jump to the previous empty line and Shift+Control+0 to jump to the next empty line. The shortcuts are chosen to avoid conflicts with existing key bindings.

idea-plugin.name: Tab Manager Ex
idea-plugin.description:
This plugin provides convenient tab management features for IntelliJ-based IDEs, including opening files from Git commits and bulk pin/unpin operations.

This is useful when you want to review the changes in a set of commits, or quickly open all relevant files for a feature or bug fix.

Features

Open Changed Files from Git Log

  • Right-click on one or more commits in the Git log view.
  • Select "Open Changed Files" from the context menu.
  • All files that were created, modified, or moved in the selected commits will be opened in the editor.
  • Deleted files are ignored.

Pin All Open Files

  • Right-click on an editor tab or within the editor.
  • Select "Pin All Open Files".
  • All currently open files will be pinned.

Remove All Pins

  • Right-click on an editor tab or within the editor.
  • Select "Remove All Pins".
  • All currently open files will be unpinned.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Changed

  • Remove the upper limit on supported versions

idea-plugin.name: StickyProjectFolder
idea-plugin.description:
Sticky scrolling, auto-collapse and pinned folders for JetBrains IDEs.

The plugin keeps important context visible while you navigate code — both in the Project View and in the Editor — and helps keep the project tree clean while putting frequently-used directories one click away.

Features

The plugin bundles four independent features that can be enabled and tuned separately:

  1. Sticky Project View — keeps parent directories pinned at the top of the Project View as you scroll, so you always know where you are in the tree.

    • Respects file color scopes (background colors)
    • Configurable maximum number of sticky headers (default: 10)
    • Drag-and-drop support on sticky headers

  2. Sticky Editor lines (extended) — extends the IDE's built-in sticky-lines / breadcrumbs feature beyond classes and functions to also stick control-flow blocks:

    • if / else if / else
    • for, foreach, while, do…while
    • switch / when
    • try / catch / finally
    • PHP / JS array and object literals

    Supported languages: Java, Kotlin, PHP, JavaScript / TypeScript, Python, C / C++. Sticky control blocks and array-scope sticking can be toggled independently in Settings.

  3. Auto-collapse directories — automatically collapses configured directories (e.g. node_modules, vendor, build, dist) in the Project View whenever you navigate to a file outside of them, keeping the tree tidy without manual clean-up.

    • Global list of directories to collapse
    • Per-project excluded directories

  4. Pinned Folders — pin frequently-used directories to a footer at the bottom of the Project View and jump to them with one click. Order and per-folder descriptions are customizable. Stored per project.

Configuration

Go to Settings/Preferences | Tools | Sticky Project Folder to configure:

  • Maximum number of sticky headers in the Project View
  • Sticky lines for control blocks (if / for / foreach / switch / while / try, …)
  • Sticky lines for PHP / JS array and object literals
  • Enable / disable the auto-collapse feature
  • Add / remove directories for auto-collapse (e.g. node_modules/, vendor/) — global setting
  • Auto-collapse excluded directories — per-project setting
  • Manage pinned folders, their order and descriptions — per-project setting

Preview
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Fixed

  • Sticky Editor lines: PHP switch and match blocks are now recognized correctly (previously not detected).
  • Sticky Editor lines: PHP namespaces now show the full namespace path (e.g. App\Classes\Fxiers\Actions) instead of only the last segment Actions.

idea-plugin.name: Beacon Terminal Navigator
idea-plugin.description:
Beacon Terminal Navigator

Companion plugin for Beacon, a macOS menu bar app that sends notifications when Claude Code tasks complete.

This plugin provides a local HTTP API that allows Beacon to navigate directly to the correct terminal tab in JetBrains IDEs — no Accessibility permissions or fragile UI automation required.

How it works

  • Starts a lightweight HTTP server on 127.0.0.1:19877 (loopback only)
  • When a Claude Code task completes, Beacon calls the plugin to focus the right terminal tab
  • Uses native JetBrains APIs — works reliably across locales, versions, and custom tab names

API

  • GET /health — returns ok (used by Beacon to detect plugin)
  • POST /focus-terminal — accepts {"project":"…", "tabName":"…"} to focus a terminal tab

Requirements

  • Beacon macOS app installed
  • Terminal plugin enabled in your JetBrains IDE

  • HTTP server on 127.0.0.1:19877 for terminal tab navigation

idea-plugin.name: TS Typed Functions
idea-plugin.description:
Navigate between TypeScript function-typed type aliases and the functions that implement them — even when the implementation does not name the alias.

Features

  • Gutter icon on each function-typed type alias linking to matching implementations.
  • Reverse gutter icon on top-level functions and const/let arrow/expression initializers, linking back to matching signatures.
  • Find Implementations of Type Signature action (default shortcut Ctrl+Alt+Shift+P / Cmd+Alt+Shift+P) for caret-based lookup.
  • Factory detection — top-level functions whose explicit return type names a signature alias are surfaced alongside direct implementations, marked [factory].

Matching is structural and loose: a function implements an alias when its parameter and return type names align with the alias signature, regardless of import path or whether the alias is named on the function itself. Class methods, object-literal methods, and generic aliases are out of scope.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0

  • Rebuilt for IntelliJ Platform build 262 (IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate / WebStorm 2026.2). Use 0.2.0 for 2026.1 (build 261).

0.2.0

  • Annotation-based matching: typed const/let declarations whose type annotation names a signature alias and whose initializer is a function literal are now surfaced as implementations. Catches the repository-style pattern where adapters are nested inside a factory function (e.g. const findX: FindX = async (...) => ... inside makeXRepository(...)).
  • Proximity-based ordering: matches are now sorted so implementations in the same directory as the signature appear first, then siblings, then more distant project files. Library / node_modules matches all sink to the bottom as a single bucket.
  • "No implementations found" popup message changed to "No matches found" (now covers factories and annotated implementations as well as direct structural matches).

0.1.0

  • Initial release.
  • Gutter icons on TypeScript function-typed type aliases and their implementations.
  • Reverse gutter from implementations back to signatures.
  • Find Implementations of Type Signature action with default keymap binding.
  • Factory detection: top-level functions whose return type names a signature alias appear alongside direct implementations, marked [factory].

idea-plugin.name: Callscape
idea-plugin.description:
"Who calls this method?" deserves a picture, not two tabs of trees. Callscape is a free tool window that draws the call flow around your caret as one horizontal graph: callers flow in from the left, the current method sits in the middle inside a teal ring, callees exit to the right. Put your caret on any method and you instantly see where it is called from; click a node and you land on the exact calling line. PHP first, with JavaScript/TypeScript included.

In a real codebase, "where is this called from" is a question you ask a dozen times a day, and the built-in Call Hierarchy answers it with two separate tabs of vertically indented trees. For PHP it also answers it wrong: calls through arrow functions and variable functions never show up, constructor callers get misattributed (open, years-old issues), and JetBrains has formally declined to add a call diagram. Across the whole Marketplace, no other call-graph plugin supports PHP at all. Callscape exists to close exactly that gap.

  • Caret-anchored flow graph. Move the caret into another method and the graph re-roots (debounced; pin it to freeze). Callers and callees in one view: no tab-flipping, no dialog, no keystroke to remember.
  • Click to jump to the call. Clicking a node opens its file and flashes the exact calling line gold; the clicked node keeps a gold outline so you never lose your place. Full keyboard navigation too: arrows walk the graph, Enter re-roots, Esc returns to the editor.
  • Semantic role badges. Each node is tagged by what it does: entry point (controller, route, queue consumer), middle-layer service, or an outside-world sink by kind (database, HTTP, mail, cache, queue, log). Badges are solid when there is framework or structural evidence and dimmed when the signal is only a name, so the graph never claims more than it knows.
  • Module grouping. Fold the flow into labeled namespace and folder boxes with a granularity slider and a per-module role-composition strip, so a wide graph reads as an architecture at a glance instead of a wall of boxes.
  • Accumulate as you explore. Arrow-key navigation grows a multi-root map that keeps every method you visit, deduped and stacked into bands, so a debugging trail builds into one picture instead of vanishing on the next click. A single toggle opts back out to the plain single-root view.
  • Workspace mode. Turn every open editor tab into the map: each open file becomes a collapsed mini-flow, most-recently-used first with the caret file leading, so your current working set is the diagram.
  • Fan-out stays readable. At most 5 visible callers per node; the rest collapse into a "+N more" chip that expands in place. Hard node and time caps keep a 40-caller method, or a million-line project, from ever hanging the IDE, and a truncated graph says so instead of pretending it is complete.
  • Dynamic-dispatch honesty. PHP's dynamic calls cannot always be resolved with certainty, so when a caller is found only via an interface, a parent declaration, or a name-level match, its edge renders dashed with a tooltip that says why. Never silently wrong, never silently missing: the two failure modes of the built-in.
  • Scoped to your code. Vendor and library edges are hidden by default ("project only"), tests stay out until you toggle them in, and caller/callee depths are adjustable from the toolbar. Everything is theme-aware, correct in light and dark.
  • Cost overlay (optional). If the Hot Path Heatmap plugin is installed, every node carries its estimated cost score as a colored chip, so you see who-calls-whom and what-it-costs in one picture, which no other tool does. Without it, nothing changes: Callscape is fully functional on its own.

PHP first, honestly. Callscape ships with a PHP adapter because that is where the gap is, plus a JavaScript/TypeScript adapter that works out of the box in PhpStorm (which bundles the JS plugin), WebStorm, and IntelliJ IDEA. The flow engine is language-neutral and the adapters are pluggable, so more languages can follow. The one plugin installs in any IntelliJ-based IDE and activates the languages it has an adapter for.

Why it beats the built-in Call Hierarchy. One horizontal picture instead of two tabs of trees; callers and callees at once instead of one direction at a time; honest dashed edges where PHP's dynamic dispatch is uncertain instead of silently dropped calls; role badges and module boxes that turn a call list into an architecture; and it actually finds the PHP calls the built-in misses.

Completely free, for the community. No trial, no paid tier, no account, and 100% local: no network calls, no telemetry, nothing about your code ever leaves your machine.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.3
  • Fixed: zooming with an Apple mouse or a trackpad. Every high-resolution scroll event was treated as a full wheel notch, so one swipe fired dozens of zoom steps and a zero-delta event zoomed the wrong way - the canvas was effectively unusable on a Mac (thank you, William Conrad, for the report). Zoom now follows the scroll amount proportionally, one notch per event at most, and the touch surface can no longer zoom while you click and drag.
  • Zoom stays in a useful range. Scrolling and the - / + buttons keep the map between 50% and 150%, and zooming out goes exactly as far as the whole flow needs to fit the window - never to a scale where nothing is readable.
  • Trackpad pinch-to-zoom on macOS: the map zooms live and stays sharp while your fingers move, anchored on the spot you pinched, and nothing shifts when you let go.
  • Sideways swipe pans the flow instead of doing nothing - the axis a wide caller-to-callee graph needs most. The - / + buttons now zoom around the centre of what you are looking at, and + / - / 0 do the same from the keyboard.
  • Fixed: the "Recomputing map" overlay no longer flickers on the ordinary fast recomputes that follow a caret move.
  • Fixed: re-rooting onto a method already on the map now moves it into the centre column of its own band, with its callers and callees around it, instead of leaving it stranded in another band's column.
  • Fixed: the caret marker on the accumulated map. With the graph pinned, the method your caret sits in is outlined again - it was silently skipped whenever the map was in accumulate mode, which is the default.
  • The root cap has its own "Roots" control. It bounds caret exploration too, not just Workspace mode, but sat greyed out unless Workspace was on - so "map full" could not be raised. It is now always editable, and the notice says so.
  • The graph takes focus when the tool window is activated, so the first arrow key walks the map instead of changing the caller depth.
  • Node tooltips and the empty canvas now describe the real gestures (Enter re-roots the map; click opens the calling line).
1.0.2
  • Copy cleanup in UI texts.
1.0.1
  • Fixed: a class method that contains a nested anonymous class or nested function no longer shows callees it does not actually call (PHP callee resolution now matches the JS behavior).
1.0.0 - public launch
  • Accumulate-on-navigate, on by default. Walking the caret from method to method grows a multi-root band map instead of throwing the previous graph away, so exploring a path builds one picture; a toolbar toggle opts back out to the plain single-root view, and an edit-guard keeps typing from growing the map.
  • Workspace mode. Turn every open editor tab into a collapsed mini-flow, MRU-ordered with the caret's file first - a bird's-eye map of what you're working across.
  • Group by module. Fold the current graph into namespace/path module boxes with a role-composition strip and an on-demand class roster header.
  • Caret-anchored call-flow. Callers flow in from the left, the current method sits in the middle, callees exit right; click a node to open its file and flash the exact calling line. Movable/resizable nodes, scroll-to-zoom, and free 2D panning.
  • PHPDoc usages. References in @see, {@link}/{@see} and @param/@return/@var/@throws type tags now surface as dashed doc edges (documentation, not runtime calls) instead of being lost.
  • Sharper dynamic-dispatch honesty. Non-virtual scoped calls (self::/parent::/Class::) and class-name string/array callables no longer show up as false-positive callers of a subclass override they can never reach - only genuinely virtual dispatch stays dashed.
0.6.0
  • Free canvas panning. Drag empty space to move the graph in any direction (it was vertical-only), with a grab/hand cursor on press-and-hold - pan the flow around like a whiteboard even when it's smaller than the window.
  • Loading feedback on re-root. Re-rooting on a heavily-called method (its search can take a second or two) now shows a "Searching…" overlay instead of a frozen graph.
  • Tidier toolbar. The Refresh and overflow (⋮) actions are compact, evenly-padded icon buttons.
0.5.0
  • Font-aware scaling. Node boxes, role badges and the toolbar now size themselves from live font metrics, so the graph reads cleanly at any IDE font size or UI scale - no clipped labels, no cramped badges.
  • One node per call site. When a caller invokes the target on several lines, each call site becomes its own node (jumping to its own file:line) instead of a single merged caller - so repeated usages are visible and individually navigable.
  • Source-order sorting. Callers and callees now read in source order - by call-site file then line - so same-file callers group and flow top-to-bottom, matching the code you're looking at. (Cost data still paints chips; it no longer reorders the graph.)
  • Icon zoom controls. The overlay's Fit and Reset buttons are now compact icons with tooltips ("Fit to window" / "Reset zoom & layout"); Reset also restores any hand-arranged layout.
0.4.0
  • Movable & resizable nodes. Drag a node or module box to hand-arrange the graph (edges follow); drag a corner to resize; right-click → "Reset manual layout" snaps back.
  • Canvas navigation. Scroll to zoom (toward the cursor); drag empty space to pan.
  • Fix. A string array-key that matches a method name (e.g. a 'search' => […] config key) no longer shows as a false caller.
  • Polish. Compact zoom controls; number fields no longer clip their value.
0.3.0
  • Workspace mode. A default-off toolbar toggle that turns your open editor tabs into the map: every open file becomes a collapsed mini-flow (MRU-ordered, caret file first), deduped and stacked as a multi-root map. Closing a tab drops its root. Plus a subtle always-on "open" tick on any node whose file is open in a tab.
  • Responsive large maps. The multi-root layout recompute (dedup, edge routing, position solving) now runs off the UI thread with a loading overlay, so the map never freezes the IDE as it grows; a newer recompute supersedes an in-flight one.
  • Measured soft-limit. No arbitrary node cap - the map grows freely and only when a real recompute gets genuinely slow does a "large map · N nodes" notice appear and auto-accumulation pause until you clear. The measured cost sets the ceiling.
0.2.0
  • Module view. Group the flow into labeled namespace/folder boxes with a granularity slider, a per-module role-composition strip, collapse-to-capsule, and an on-demand class roster.
  • Semantic role badges. Nodes are tagged entry (world-in) / Middle-layer / sink (world-out, by kind: db, http, mail, cache, queue, …) - solid with framework evidence, dimmed when it's name-only.
  • Progressive expansion. Unexplored callers/callees show as ghost placeholders; click or Enter to expand on demand.
  • Zoom. Visible controls (− / % / + / Fit / Reset) in a floating canvas overlay, one-click zoom-to-fit, plus Cmd/Ctrl+scroll.
  • Tidier toolbar. Controls grouped (Depth · Scope · Module) with separators, wraps instead of clipping at narrow widths, compact number fields.
  • Keyboard exploration. Enter re-roots the flow on the selected node while keeping focus in the graph; clicking still opens the source.
  • Self-explaining. Hover tooltips on the composition strip and the module-granularity control.
  • Fixes. Pin state now renders and holds; fixed a crash when expanding a ghost node; toggling the cost overlay no longer hides unexplored nodes; badges are legible in both themes; no false badges from accidental substring matches; first-class-callable calls ($obj->m(...)) are detected as callers.
0.1.0
  • Initial release: horizontal caller/callee flow for PHP, caret sync, click-to-call-site navigation with line flash, fan-out caps with "+N more" expanders, dashed heuristic edges, depth/scope/test toolbar controls, keyboard navigation.
  • JavaScript/TypeScript adapter: the same flow graph and honesty rules for JS/TS - callbacks passed by reference are solid, bracket dispatch renders dashed.
  • Optional cost overlay: with Hot Path Heatmap installed, flow nodes carry its cost score chips (deep-sea ramp) and callers sort worst-first.

idea-plugin.name: Alias Source Navigator
idea-plugin.description:
Connects generated TypeScript auto-import aliases to their original source exports for both navigation and usage search.

Designed for Vue and Vite projects using tools such as unplugin-auto-import and unplugin-vue-components. Instead of stopping in auto-imports.d.ts, imports.d.ts, or components.d.ts, navigation continues to the referenced composable, store, or component. Find Usages on a source export also includes references resolved through those generated declarations.

Also supports Laravel Wayfinder: navigating a generated controller method such as PatientController.autocomplete() offers both the PHP controller method and the Wayfinder named TypeScript export.

  • Supports named exports and default component exports.
  • Handles relative typeof import(...) declaration aliases.
  • Connects TypeScript and Vue auto-import usages back to source exports.
  • Jumps from Wayfinder route methods to PHP controller methods.
  • Leaves normal IDE navigation unchanged for non-alias symbols.

0.3.0

idea-plugin.name: TomlJump
idea-plugin.description:
TomlJump makes TOML files navigable: click a path such as schema = "./schemas/user.json" to open the file it names, or click [server] to land on the Go struct, Python class, or TypeScript interface that reads it, then click that declaration to come back.

  • Jump from TOML string file paths to project files.
  • Navigate both ways between TOML tables and keys and matching source declarations.
  • Navigate pyproject.toml project scripts to Python modules and callables.
  • Resolve conservative config declarations in Go, Python, Java, TypeScript, and JavaScript.
  • Use standard JetBrains navigation actions such as Go to Declaration and command/control click.

TomlJump intentionally does not replace TOML syntax highlighting, formatting, schema validation, or completion. It focuses on high-confidence navigation and stays quiet when a configuration relationship is not credible.

TomlJump 让 TOML 文件可以跳转：点击 schema = "./schemas/user.json" 打开它指向的文件， 或点击 [server] 跳到读取它的 Go struct、Python class 或 TypeScript interface， 再点击那个声明即可跳回来。

  • 从 TOML 字符串文件路径跳转到项目文件。
  • 在 TOML table、key 与匹配的源码配置声明之间双向跳转。
  • 从 pyproject.toml 的 project scripts 跳转到 Python 模块和 callable。
  • 支持 Go、Python、Java、TypeScript、JavaScript 中的保守配置匹配。
  • 使用 JetBrains 原生跳转能力，例如 Go to Declaration 和 command/control click。

TomlJump 不替代 TOML 语法高亮、格式化、schema 校验或补全。它只专注于高置信度导航； 当配置关系不够可信时会静默跳过。

idea-plugin.name: Grep API
idea-plugin.description:
Grep API provides fast Spring MVC endpoint search and source navigation for IntelliJ IDEA.

Quick Start

  • Windows/Linux: Press Ctrl + Alt + / to open API search.
  • macOS: Press Command + Option + / (⌘⌥/) to open API search.
  • Menu: Open Navigate > 搜索 API 接口....
  • Enter a URL or keyword, optionally filter by HTTP method, then press Enter to jump to the Controller method.

快速开始

  • Windows/Linux 快捷键：Ctrl + Alt + /
  • macOS 快捷键：Command + Option + /（⌘⌥/）
  • 菜单入口：导航（Navigate）> 搜索 API 接口...
  • 输入 URL 或关键字，可按 HTTP 请求方式筛选；选择结果后按 Enter 定位到 Controller 方法。

支持完整 URL、模糊搜索、路径变量、通配符和可配置网关前缀。
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• Builds complete endpoint paths from Controller-level and method-level Spring mappings.
  • Supports left/right fuzzy matching for path fragments such as countBook/page and highlights the matched path text.
  • Restores the previous search text, auto-selects the top result, and keeps up to ten recently opened endpoints.

idea-plugin.name: Frappe Inspector
idea-plugin.description:
Frappe Inspector adds Frappe Framework and ERPNext project awareness to JetBrains IDEs.

Navigate between DocType JSON files, Python controllers, client scripts, tests, hooks, and patches. Detect invalid DocType references, unknown fields, broken hooks, and potentially unsafe schema changes before they reach production.

Community — Free forever

  • Automatic Frappe and ERPNext project detection
  • DocType, application, and module explorer
  • Navigation between JSON, Python, JavaScript, and test files
  • Basic DocType and field completion
  • Unknown DocType and field diagnostics
  • Basic hooks.py validation
  • Navigation and validation for patches.txt

Pro

  • Migration Safety Analyzer
  • Schema comparison against local project snapshots
  • Detection of removed fields, required-field changes, and risky type changes
  • Advanced field usage analysis
  • DocType relationship graph
  • Advanced hooks and fixture validation
  • Whitelisted method analysis
  • Custom Field and Property Setter support
  • Markdown, JSON, and SARIF migration reports
  • Shared CLI and CI report contract

Install the plugin for free to use the Community features. A free trial is available for Frappe Inspector Pro.

Frappe Inspector is an independent third-party plugin and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Frappe Technologies, ERPNext, or JetBrains.

idea-plugin.name: Entity Table Sync
idea-plugin.description:
Entity Table Sync

Synchronize Java entity classes and database table structures directly inside IntelliJ IDEA.

During daily development, database schemas and Java entity classes often become out of sync. For example:

  • New columns are added to a database table and need to be synchronized to the entity class.
  • New fields are added to an entity class and need to be synchronized to the database table.

Entity Table Sync simplifies this process by reducing repetitive manual work and improving development efficiency.

Key Features

  • Synchronize fields between Java entity classes and database tables.
  • Add or remove database columns and automatically synchronize changes to the corresponding entity class or database table.
  • Provide a dedicated Tool Window for selecting databases and performing synchronization operations.
  • Right-click an entity class and choose Sync Entity & Table, or press Alt + S, to synchronize newly added fields to the database with a single click.
  • Fully integrated with IntelliJ IDEA Database Tools.

How to Use

  1. Add your project database in IntelliJ IDEA Database Tools.
  2. Open the Entity Table Sync tool window, refresh the database list, and select the target database.
  3. Perform synchronization operations such as adding or removing fields as needed.
  4. Alternatively, right-click a Java entity class and select Sync Entity & Table, or use the Alt + S shortcut, to synchronize newly added fields to the database.

Note: This plugin requires the Database Tools and SQL feature available in IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate.

Entity Table Sync（中文）

同步 Java 实体类与数据库表结构

在日常开发中，经常会遇到数据库表结构和实体类字段不同步的问题，例如：

  • 数据库表新增字段，需要同步到实体类。
  • 实体类新增字段，需要同步到数据库表。

本插件旨在简化这一过程，减少重复操作，提高开发效率。

主要功能

  • 支持实体类与数据库表字段同步。
  • 支持新增、删除字段，并自动同步到对应的实体类或数据库表。
  • 提供插件工具窗口，可快速选择数据库并执行同步操作。
  • 支持在实体类中右键选择 同步类和表，或使用快捷键 Alt + S，一键将新增字段同步到数据库表。

使用步骤

  1. 在 IntelliJ IDEA Database 中添加项目数据库。
  2. 打开插件工具窗口，刷新并选择需要同步的数据库。
  3. 根据需要执行新增、删除字段等同步操作。
  4. 也可以在实体类中右键选择 同步类和表 或使用快捷键 Alt + S，快速将新增字段同步到数据库表。

说明：本插件依赖 IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate 的 Database Tools 功能。

idea-plugin.name: PHP Magic Method Navigation
idea-plugin.description:
Jump to the method PHP runs but never names. PHP calls some methods implicitly: a (string) cast or an echo quietly runs __toString(), $callable(...) runs __invoke(), and $obj->prop / $obj->method() fall through to __get() / __set() / __call() when the member is not really declared. None of these write the method's name, so Ctrl+Click and Go to Declaration have nothing to jump to. This plugin gives every one of those sites a gutter icon and a jump to the code that actually executes.

Reading the source, the call is invisible: echo $money; shows no method, yet it runs Money::__toString(); $discount(1999) looks like a function call but runs Discount::__invoke(); $obj->missing looks like a plain property read but runs __get(). You know the method exists, you just cannot get there without scrolling and searching by hand. The gutter icon closes that gap: click it and land on the method.

  • A gutter icon at every implicit site. A (string) cast, an echo / print, string interpolation ("$obj"), concatenation ("x" . $obj), a dynamic invoke ($callable(...)), and member access that resolves to no real member: $obj->prop read → __get(), $obj->prop = … → __set(), $obj->m(...) → __call(), Foo::m(...) → __callStatic(). When a union type (Money|Percentage) can dispatch to more than one implementation, the icon opens a multi-target popup.
  • Go to Declaration keeps working. Ctrl+Click / Ctrl+B on the operand offers the magic method alongside the normal jump, so you never lose the navigation you already rely on.
  • Reverse Find Usages. Run Find Usages on a magic method itself (e.g. __toString, __get, __call) and the results include the implicit sites that trigger it: the casts, the interpolations, the $obj->prop accesses that PhpStorm's own Find Usages never lists.
  • Precise, not noisy. Member access is marked only when the magic method really fires: a reference that resolves to a real declared property, constant, or method is left alone. It understands the \Stringable interface and nullable / union types (only the members that actually declare the method are offered), and it de-duplicates so nested and multi-argument sites never double-mark.
  • Yours to shape. A master switch plus a per-method toggle for __toString, __invoke, __get, __set, __call, __callStatic, and reverse Find Usages, under Settings | Tools | PHP Magic Nav.

Free, and staying free. Every feature above is free for any use, including commercial. There is no paid tier, no account, no telemetry: the plugin runs entirely inside your IDE and nothing about your code ever leaves your machine.

Built for PhpStorm, where the PHP language support ships in the box. It reuses the IDE's own type resolution to decide what runs, so a marked site is a site PHP would truly dispatch to a magic method.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• 0.2.3 - Fixed a crash in reverse Find Usages: searching for usages of a magic method (__toString, __get, etc.) could throw a threading error ("Read access is allowed from inside read-action only") because the method was inspected before the search entered its read-locked section. Find Usages runs this search on a background thread, not the UI thread, so the fix moves that check inside the existing read-locked section instead of before it.
  • 0.2.2 - First stable-channel release. No functional changes from 0.2.1.
  • 0.2.1 - A read-modify-write on an undeclared property ($obj->prop += …, $obj->prop++) now offers both __get() and __set() - PHP reads the old value then writes the new one, so both fire. When two magic methods fire on the same operand (e.g. echo $obj->prop where __get returns a Stringable), the gutter marker now offers every jump instead of silently dropping one.
  • 0.2.0 - Member-access magic: gutter markers + Go to Declaration for __get()/__set() on undeclared $obj->prop read/write, and __call()/__callStatic() on undeclared $obj->m(...)/Foo::m(...) calls - only when the member does not resolve to a real declaration. Added reverse Find Usages: Find Usages on a magic method lists its implicit invocation sites. Per-method settings toggles for all six magic methods plus reverse Find Usages.
  • 0.1.0 - First release. Forward navigation to __toString() from casts, echo/print, interpolation and concatenation; navigation to __invoke() from dynamic $callable(...) calls; gutter markers + Go to Declaration; multi-target unions; settings toggles.

idea-plugin.name: Tab Switch Reborn
idea-plugin.description:
Fixed issues with the original Tabswitch as it was not working correctly with the latest version of Jetbrain editors.

Open files/tabs switcher to quickly switch between tabs with less keystrokes than Recent Files. Open files are selected from a list in most recently used order, similarly to Alt+Tab in Windows or Ctrl-Tab in Opera. No keyboard shortcut is assigned by default: open Settings | Keymap, search for the Tab Switch Reborn actions and assign the shortcuts you prefer (popular choices are Alt+A or CMD+E).

Thanks to Timur Zambalayev for the original plugin, Martin Fuhrer for a major contribution in the form of a rewrite and Mark Scott for patching a bug.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0 — Reborn for IntelliJ 2026
  • Rebuilt for the latest IntelliJ versions — fixes the crash on recent IDEs.
  • New settings page under Settings | Tools | Tab Switch Reborn.
  • Popup order option: Same as the editor tabs (follows the tab bar, including alphabetical sorting) or Most recently used (Alt+Tab style).
  • Maximum popup width setting: the popup grows to fit the longest name, up to your limit.
  • Maximum visible rows setting: extra files stay reachable through the scrollbar.

idea-plugin.name: File QuickSwitch
idea-plugin.description: Switch between related sibling files with configurable shortcuts. Cycle through scripts, markup, styles, and tests, jump directly to a category, and add custom suffixes.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• Updated for IntelliJ Platform 2024.2 and newer.
  • Added a settings page with optional previous-tab closing.
  • Added grouped file-type controls and optional spec.ts/spec.js test cycling.
  • Added one validated custom file suffix per category.
  • Added dedicated shortcuts for tests, scripts, styles, and markup.
  • Fixed switching in editor splits and removed tab-closing side effects by default.
  • Improved support for virtual files and modern IntelliJ action APIs.

idea-plugin.name: Settings Jump
idea-plugin.description:
Fast navigation to JetBrains IDE settings pages.
  • Search settings pages by name and hierarchy, open them directly.
  • Mark favorites; they appear first when the popup opens.
  • Assign favorites to ten fixed shortcut slots and open a page with one keystroke (bind keys in Settings > Keymap > Settings Jump).
  • Recently opened pages are one keystroke away.
Settings Jump never changes setting values — it only takes you there.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.1.0
  • Slot-assigned pages are now marked in the popup list with a circled slot number next to the favorite star, plus the bound keystroke (or [Slot n]) at the end of the row.
  • The list refreshes immediately after assigning a slot.
1.0.0
  • Initial release: search settings pages and open them directly, favorites, recent pages, and ten keymap-bindable shortcut slots.

idea-plugin.name: Folder Tabs
idea-plugin.description:
Groups open editor tabs by their parent directory.

Adds a two-row header above the editor: the upper row lists the directories of the files you have open, the lower row lists the files of the selected directory. Directories with the same name are shown with the shortest path that tells them apart (api/users vs admin/users).

Works with any file type, leaves the standard editor tabs untouched, and uses only stable IntelliJ Platform APIs.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.4.0
  • Keyboard navigation between groups: new Next Folder Group / Previous Folder Group actions (Window > Editor Tabs, Find Action) move to the adjacent directory group and open the file you last used there, wrapping at the ends; in split editors they cycle through the focused pane's groups only. No default shortcut: assign one in Settings > Keymap > Plugins > Folder Tabs.
  • Collapse the header when you need the space: Collapse Folder Tabs (Window > Editor Tabs, any tab's right-click menu, or a shortcut of your choice) shrinks the header to a single line showing the current group and file; click that line or toggle again to expand. Per project, remembered until the IDE is closed; open files, ordering and settings are untouched.
1.3.1
  • Saved group and file order now follows a directory or file rename, move or delete even while no editor is open; previously the reordered position was lost the next time those files were opened.
1.3.0
  • File tabs can now be reordered by drag & drop within their group, like the group tabs; the order is remembered per project and follows rename / move / delete.
  • Split editors: each pane's header now shows only the files open in that pane, in the IDE's own tab order, and clicking a group or file tab opens the file in the pane whose header you clicked (previously it could land in the other pane).
1.2.2
  • No more jump on the first switch to a file after startup: the header's close buttons are sized in its first layout, and the tab strip is primed before it is shown so the platform's first-paint layout state (Islands theme) no longer shifts the tabs afterwards.
  • A file saved right after an edit (e.g. reformat on save) no longer keeps a stale modified marker.
  • Group tabs are keyed by their directory, so a modified-flag change no longer rebuilds the group strip on the next refresh.
1.2.1
  • The selected tab in the header now gets the same blue underline as the standard editor tab, so the current file and group are easy to spot. In split editors only the focused pane's header is highlighted, in sync with the standard tabs.
  • Clicking a header tab keeps the focus in the editor, like the standard tabs.
1.1.0
  • Close from the header: a close button and a right-click Close entry on every file tab, and Close Group in a group tab's right-click menu. Closing delegates to the IDE's own Close Editor action, so split panes behave as usual.
1.0.0
  • Two-row header above every editor: directory groups on top, files of the selected group below.
  • Group label depth setting (default 2); same-name directories always get a distinguishing path; labels reaching the project root read ~/<project>/….
  • Drag & drop to reorder group tabs; order is remembered per project.
  • Follows rename / move / delete, shows a modified marker, file type icons, full-path tooltips.
  • Works with split editors and with Tab placement: None; can be turned off in Settings > Tools > Folder Tabs.

idea-plugin.name: Angular Route Navigator
idea-plugin.description:
Quickly find the responsible component for a given route, simply by pasting the corresponding application URL - or by navigating the generated nested Route-Tree instead of your filesystem.

Paste any application URL to open its routed component, including parameterized, prefixed, and lazy-loaded routes. Quick search is available anywhere via the configurable shortcut (Alt+Z by default).

idea-plugin.name: JSON Viewer & Type Generator
idea-plugin.description:
Adds a JSON Viewer tool window that shows the JSON file you're editing as a searchable tree, and generates type definitions from it.

  • Tree view of the active JSON file that updates as you type. Comments and trailing commas are accepted, so config files like tsconfig.json work too.
  • Search keys and values, and step through matches with Enter and Shift+Enter.
  • Sync with editor: the caret selects the matching node, and selecting a node reveals it in the editor.
  • Copy a node's JSONPath or value, and expand or collapse whole subtrees.
  • Invalid JSON is reported with a link to the error position.
  • Export types for the whole file or any object or array: TypeScript interfaces, Go structs, PHP 8 classes and Python dataclasses. Copy them or save them to a file.
idea-plugin.change-notes: First release.

idea-plugin.name: GTNH Development
idea-plugin.description:
IntelliJ IDEA tooling for GregTech: New Horizons development.

Unofficial community project. GTNH Development is not developed, endorsed, or officially supported by the GT New Horizons team or JetBrains.

Extends Minecraft Development with GTNH-specific project detection, Gradle integration, bidirectional Config/Mixin navigation, patch impact analysis, environment diagnostics, ecosystem discovery, contribution workflows, and previewed code generation.

idea-plugin.name: Function Inline Viewer
idea-plugin.description:
Read code without leaving the call site. Function Inline Viewer adds a small hint after every call to a function that is defined in your project; click it and the function's body unfolds right below the call. Click again to fold it. No popups, no jumping between files.

  • Nested unfolding — calls inside an unfolded body get their own hints, so you can follow a call chain down several levels (depth is configurable).
  • Syntax and semantic colors — the unfolded code is highlighted like the editor, with parameters, fields, methods and classes colored by kind.
  • Cmd/Ctrl+click navigation inside unfolded code, plus hover highlighting that pairs a hint with the name it belongs to.
  • Interfaces and overrides — unfold an abstract method or an overridable method and load its implementations or overrides on demand (paged, with "next" and "all").
  • Method chains such as a.foo().bar() are merged into a single hint. Several calls on one line get different colors (configurable in the color scheme).
  • Stays fresh — unfolded bodies update while you edit the caller or the callee, and are restored when you reopen the project. Fold all with Ctrl+Cmd+- (macOS) / Ctrl+Alt+-.
  • Only project sources get hints; library and JDK calls are ignored.
  • Works with Java and Kotlin (including extension functions, lambdas and custom property accessors).

Settings: Settings | Editor | Function Inline Viewer (maximum lines, nesting depth, chain merging) and Settings | Editor | Color Scheme | Function Inline Viewer (colors). The hints can be switched off on the same settings page.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0
  • Initial release.

idea-plugin.name: MyBatisProviderJump
idea-plugin.description:
Gutter navigation between MyBatis annotation-based Mapper methods and their SQL provider methods — like MyBatisX's bird icon, but for the annotation style.

Forward — a forward icon appears next to Mapper methods annotated with @SelectProvider / @InsertProvider / @UpdateProvider / @DeleteProvider; click it to jump to the provider method.

Back — a back icon appears next to provider methods; click it to jump back to the referencing Mapper method(s) (a popup list is shown when there are multiple references).

Supported conventions:
• Explicit type/method attributes, or the bare short syntax @SelectProvider(ProviderClass.class)
• Same-name convention: omit method when the provider implements ProviderMethodResolver
• Default provideSql method when the resolver is not implemented
• Overloaded provider methods are matched by the mapper's parameter count
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.3.0
- Open compatibility upper bound: IDEA 2025.1+ (no until-build upper bound)
- Fix bare @SelectProvider(X.class) short syntax (value attribute) in both directions
- Same-name convention: verify ProviderMethodResolver; fall back to MyBatis default provideSql
- Reverse lookup batched per provider class (one ReferencesSearch per class per pass)
- Overloaded provider methods matched by mapper parameter count
- Rename package/group to io.github.miemiegyy; kotlin-stdlib no longer bundled (14KB zip)
- Add 8 automated headless gutter tests

idea-plugin.name: Root Groups
idea-plugin.description:
Tidy up the Project View: files that clutter your project root are grouped into named, collapsible groups such as Config, Lockfiles, Docker and Dotfiles.

  • Built-in presets that work out of the box
  • Your own groups with glob patterns (*.json, .*, docker*, {yml,yaml})
  • Group colours, case-insensitive matching, optional folder grouping
  • First matching rule wins; reorder rules to change priority
  • Purely visual: files are never moved, renamed or changed
  • Lightweight: only the project root is examined, no file-system scanning

Root Groups Pro (optional, free trial available):

  • Project-specific rules, shareable with your team via .idea
  • Hide matching files completely (purely visual)
  • Regular-expression patterns (re: prefix)
  • Preset packs: Git, CI/CD, Docs, Python, Java/Kotlin build, Tests, Infra, Editor
  • Import and export your rules as JSON

All free features keep working without a licence. No telemetry, no network access.

Configure in Settings | Tools | Root Groups.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0: Root Groups Pro: project-specific rules, hide matching files, regex patterns, preset packs, import/export. Free features unchanged.

0.1.0: First release. Root-level grouping, built-in presets, custom groups with glob patterns, colours and settings page.

idea-plugin.name: XBatis Jump
idea-plugin.description:
A gutter "bird" navigation plugin for the xbatis Java ORM — jump to Entity, Mapper, Dao and more in one click (no XML):
  • Entity ↔ Mapper ↔ Dao: the @Table entity links to its Mapper (MybatisMapper<T> / XxxMapper) and MVC Dao (XxxDao etc.); each marker jumps to the others.
  • Field refs ↔ getter/field: SysUser::getId method refs inside QueryChain/InsertChain/UpdateChain/DeleteChain (+join) and SysUser.Fields.userName constants jump both ways (Lombok or not).
  • VO ↔ Entity: @ResultEntity / @ResultEntityField / @NestedResultEntity mapping, including cross-entity target and nesting.
Code-to-code navigation only; Mapper↔XML is out of scope (handled by MyBatisX).

xbatis: https://xbatis.cn/
Source: https://gitee.com/dodoyu/xbatis-jump
idea-plugin.change-notes: 1.0.1: - Add Entity <-> Dao (MVC) navigation: @Table entity <-> Dao / IDao / BaseDaoImpl / XxxDao - Entity marker now merges Mapper + Dao + VO targets (Entity <-> Mapper <-> Dao triangle) 1.0.0 — Bird gutter navigation across the XBatis Java model (no XML involved): - Entity (@Table) <-> Mapper interface (MybatisMapper / XxxMapper naming) - Entity getter <-> Chain method references (QueryChain / InsertChain / UpdateChain / DeleteChain), supporting both of(mapper) and of(basicMapper, Xxx.class) - Entity.Fields.xxx fallback jump (works with or without Lombok) - VO (@ResultEntity) <-> Entity, VO field (@ResultEntityField) <-> Entity field Homepage: https://xbatis.cn/ Plugin source: https://gitee.com/dodoyu/xbatis-jump

idea-plugin.name: Current Project Switcher
idea-plugin.description:
Minimal plugin for switching between already opened projects.
  1. Open switcher dialog by pressing Alt-P Alt-P.
  2. Type for fuzzy search in list of projects and press Enter to switch to a project when right project selected.
  3. Use arrow keys to navigate list of project.

idea-plugin.name: jBC Support
idea-plugin.description:
Support for jBASE BASIC (jBC), the language of Temenos T24 routines.

  • Navigation: go to declaration for CALL, GOSUB/GOTO, $INSERT, DEFFUN functions and variables (to the place where a variable is initialized, or to its COMMON/EQU in an include file); find usages; call hierarchy.
  • Code checks: unbalanced blocks, missing statement clauses (LOCATE without SETTING, THEN/ELSE), undefined or duplicate labels, READ without THEN/ELSE, variables used but never assigned (usually a typo), variables assigned but never used.
  • Language reference in Quick Documentation for statements, functions and system variables, with examples and notes where T24 differs from the jBASE manual.
  • Parameter info in CALL X(…), paired keyword highlighting (IF/END ELSE/END, LOOP/REPEAT, BEGIN CASE/END CASE).
  • Formatting that changes only indentation, folding of blocks and label sections, completion of subroutines, labels, include files and names from $INSERT files.
  • Syntax highlighting; files in *.BP directories and .b files are recognized automatically.

Features and shortcuts: Help | JBasic Plugin Guide. Feedback: Help | Send JBasic Plugin Feedback.

An independent plugin, not affiliated with or endorsed by Temenos or the vendors of jBASE. Temenos, T24 and jBASE are trademarks of their respective owners.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.3.0: first release on JetBrains Marketplace.

  • Variables: Cmd/Ctrl+Click goes to where a variable is initialized, or to its COMMON / EQU in an included file; on that place it shows the usages.
  • Parameter info in CALL X(…), paired keyword highlighting, call hierarchy.
  • New checks: a variable used but never assigned (usually a typo or a missing $INSERT) and a variable assigned but never used.
  • Short guide with shortcuts: Help | JBasic Plugin Guide. Feedback: Help | Send JBasic Plugin Feedback.
  • Names with $ inside (C$SYSDIM) are lexed as one name; compiled $NAME objects are no longer opened as jBC.
  • The plugin is now called jBC Support.

idea-plugin.name: Nodegraphy
idea-plugin.description:
Real-time Interactive Architectural Node Graph Visualizer

Nodegraphy transforms your Java and Spring Boot codebases into an interactive, node-based architectural graph inside IntelliJ IDEA.

Key Features:

  • PSI-Powered Analysis: Automatically analyzes Spring Boot components (Controllers, Services, Repositories), REST endpoints, and Java method call hierarchies in real time.
  • Node Graph Visualizer: Modern node-and-wire canvas with pan, zoom, grid snapping, and minimap navigation.
  • Automated Hierarchical Layout: Integrated 2D Dagre layout engine with left-to-right edge routing and multi-column focus distribution.
  • Two-way Synchronization: Seamless bidirectional navigation between graph nodes and your IDE source code.
  • Interactive Controls: Search, visibility filtering, layer controls, and compact view mode.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0

  • Initial release of Nodegraphy.
  • Real-time PSI graph analysis for Spring Boot and Java.
  • Interactive node graph canvas powered by JCEF with 2D Dagre layout.
  • Bidirectional navigation between nodes and IntelliJ editor.

idea-plugin.name: Easy Extension
idea-plugin.description:
IntelliJ IDEA support for the Easy-Extension extension point framework.

  • Gutter icons on @ExtensionPoint interfaces to navigate to all implementations (Ability / Business / Default); requires Easy-Extension 4.x
  • Gutter icons on @Ability / @Business classes to navigate to corresponding extension point interfaces (and, for a business, to the abilities in its abilities list)
  • Resolution chains follow the order of @Business(abilities = {...}), with Self.class marking the business itself
  • Gutter icons on @ExtensionInject fields to navigate to extension point definitions
  • Tool Window panel showing the topology of all extension points in the project
idea-plugin.change-notes:
2.1.1

  • No longer uses the read-action API deprecated in IntelliJ IDEA 2026.1

2.1.0

  • Supports IntelliJ IDEA 2025.1 and later (2025.1 - 2026.2); 2024.x is no longer supported

2.0.0

  • Supports Easy-Extension 4.x: @Business(abilities = {...}) as an ordered list of ability classes, with Self.class marking the business itself
  • Navigation for @DefaultImplementation (one default implementation per extension point)
  • Requires Easy-Extension 4.x; 3.x annotations ("code::n" strings, @ExtensionPointDefaultImplementation) are not recognized

idea-plugin.name: Type Refactoring
idea-plugin.description: Adds an menu item to the Refactor menu, which allows you to change the type of a variable without breaking code.

idea-plugin.name: StringManipulation
idea-plugin.description:
Case switching, sorting, filtering, incrementing, aligning to columns, grepping, escaping, encoding...


Features:

Case switching:

  • Switch case (camelCase, kebab-lowercase, KEBAB-UPPERCASE, snake_case, SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE, dot.case, words lowercase, First word capitalized, Words Capitalized, PascalCase)
  • Toggle: SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE / camelCase
  • Toggle: snake_case / camelCase
  • Toggle: kebab-case / snake_case
  • Toggle: kebab-case / camelCase
  • Toggle: dot.case / camelCase
  • Toggle: PascalCase / camelCase
  • Toggle: lowercase words / camelCase
  • Toggle: First word capitalized / camelCase
  • Toggle: Capitalized Words / camelCase
  • To camelCase
  • To snake_case
  • To kebab-case
  • To PascalCase
  • To SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE
  • To Capitalized_Snake_Case
  • Capitalize
  • To lower case
  • To UPPER CASE
  • Invert case
  • To Spring Boot System Env Variable
-'Switch case' action can be customized, or new ones can be added in settings
-when nothing is selected, then either nothing or whole line or a particular element is selected (report an issue if you find something to improve, each file type needs its own implementation to work flawlessly)

Un/Escape:

  • Un/Escape selected Java text
  • Un/Escape selected JavaScript text
  • Un/Escape selected C# text (regular, verbatim, interpolated)
  • Un/Escape selected HTML text
  • Un/Escape selected JSON text
  • Un/Escape selected XML text
  • Un/Escape selected SQL text
  • Un/Escape selected PHP text
  • Convert diacritics (accents) to ASCII
  • Convert non-ASCII to escaped Unicode
  • Convert escaped Unicode to String
  • Unicode normalization (NFD, NFC, NFKC, NFKD)

Encode/Decode:

  • Encode selected text to MD5 Hex
  • Encode selected text to SHA-1 Hex
  • Encode selected text to SHA-256 Hex
  • Encode selected text to SHA-512 Hex
  • Encode selected text to SHA3-256 Hex
  • Encode selected text to SHA3-512 Hex
  • De/Encode selected text as URL
  • De/Encode selected text to Base64 (+ zip/deflate)
  • De/Encode selected text to Hex
  • ISO Timestamp to Epoch Milliseconds
  • Epoch Milliseconds to ISO Timestamp

Increment/Decrement:

  • Increment/decrement all numbers found.
  • Duplicate selection and increment/decrement all numbers found.
  • Create sequence - Keep first number, replace all other by incrementing
  • Increment duplicate numbers

Sort with natural order or Collator:

  • Reversing order of lines
  • Shuffle lines
  • Sort case-sensitive A-z
  • Sort case-sensitive z-A
  • Sort case-insensitive A-Z
  • Sort case-insensitive Z-A
  • Sort line length asc., desc.
  • Sort hexadecimally
  • Sort lines by subselection - only one selection/caret per line is handled
  • Sort tokens (delimited text)
  • Shuffle Characters
  • JSON sort
  • Hierarchical sort

Align:

  • Align carets/selections into a vertical line by inserting spaces
  • Format selected text to columns/table by a chosen separator/delimiter and sort by columns
  • Align text to left/center/right

Filter/Remove/Trim/Minify/Convert...:

  • Grep
  • Inverted Grep
  • Group by Grep - matched lines will be separated from not matched
  • Trim
  • Trim Leading
  • Trim Trailing
  • Replace whitespaces with a single space char
  • Remove all spaces
  • Remove duplicates (supports multicaret subselection)
  • Keep only duplicate lines
  • Group and Count
  • Remove empty lines
  • Remove consecutive empty lines
  • Remove all newlines
  • Convert Between Char and Int
  • Minify JSON
  • Minify JavaScript
  • Convert Between JSON and YAML

Other:

  • Reverse Letters
  • Swap Words
  • Swap Characters/Selections/Lines/Tokens
  • Wrap or shift double quotes to single quotes to backticks
  • Swap between double quotes and single quotes
  • Straighten/Educate quotes
  • Switch file path separators: Windows<->UNIX

  • Select All Occurrences For All Carets
  • Extend Selection in Different "CamelHumps" Mode
  • Multi Replace
  • Duplicate and Multi Replace
  • Paste - camelCased
  • Paste - and Keep Selections
  • Create Border

Actions are available under Edit menu, or via the shortcut "alt M" and "alt shift M".
You can setup your own shortcuts for better usability.
Popup can be customized in File | Settings | Appearance & Behavior | Menus and Toolbars.

idea-plugin.name: Notation Converter

idea-plugin.name: fuGen
idea-plugin.description:
Generating class fields and methods by custom templates for selected fields.
With this plugin you can create your own "Generate Action" (Alt+Insert) (e.g. like standart Getter/Setter generation).
Code will be generated by your own predefined template for this action.
You can create any number of actions.
Supported features:
