idea-plugin.name: maven-buddy
idea-plugin.description:
Maven Buddy is an IntelliJ IDEA plugin that helps you quickly search and add Maven dependencies from Maven Central directly within your IDE. This plugin streamlines the process of finding and managing dependencies for your Java and Kotlin projects.

快速从 Maven Central 搜索和添加依赖的 IntelliJ IDEA 插件。

✨ 功能特性

搜索功能

  • 🔍 快速搜索: 按两下 Shift 打开搜索，直接搜索 Maven 依赖
  • 📋 一键复制: 选择依赖后自动复制到剪贴板
  • 🎯 智能格式: 自动检测项目类型（Maven/Gradle Kotlin/Gradle Groovy），复制时使用对应格式
  • ⚡ 智能搜索: 支持按 groupId、artifactId 或关键词搜索
  • 🔎 精确匹配: 使用 : 分隔符进行精确坐标搜索

历史与缓存

  • 📜 搜索历史: 记录使用过的依赖，下拉快速选择（按 groupId:artifactId 去重）
  • 🌐 全局共享: 历史记录和缓存跨项目共享，切换项目后数据仍然保留
  • 📁 可配置路径: 存储路径可在设置中分别自定义
    • 默认: `~/.config/maven-buddy
  • 💾 持久化缓存: 搜索结果缓存 7 天，避免重复调用 API
  • 📊 分组显示: 历史(📜)、缓存(💾)、搜索(🔍) 三种来源明确区分
  • ⏱️ 时间排序: 搜索结果按更新时间降序排列

翻页与加载

  • 📄 分页加载: 支持滚动加载更多结果（默认每页 50 条）
  • 🔄 增量加载: 滚动到底部自动加载下一页

Version Catalog 支持

  • 📝 TOML 补全: 在 libs.versions.toml 中智能补全依赖
  • 🔄 批量迁移: 一键将项目中所有硬编码依赖迁移到 Version Catalog

📦 安装

从源码构建

cd /Users/zjarlin/IdeaProjects/autoddl-idea-plugin
./gradlew :plugins:maven-buddy:buildPlugin

生成的插件位于：plugins/maven-buddy/build/distributions/

安装到 IDE

  1. 打开 IntelliJ IDEA
  2. 进入 Settings → Plugins
  3. 点击齿轮图标 → Install Plugin from Disk...
  4. 选择生成的 .zip 文件

🚀 使用方法

1. 打开搜索

按 Shift + Shift 打开 Search Everywhere

2. 切换到 Maven Dependencies 标签

在搜索窗口顶部，点击 Maven Dependencies 标签

3. 输入搜索关键词

支持三种搜索方式：

方式1: 关键词搜索

spring-boot
guice
jackson

方式2: GroupId 搜索

com.google.inject
org.springframework.boot

方式3: 精确坐标搜索

com.google.inject:guice
org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter

4. 选择依赖

点击搜索结果或按 Enter 键，依赖声明将自动复制到剪贴板

⚙️ 配置

进入 Settings → Tools → Maven Buddy 进行配置：

依赖格式（自动检测）

插件会根据项目文件自动检测构建类型并选择对应的复制格式：

检测文件格式
build.gradle.kts / settings.gradle.ktsGradle Kotlin DSL
build.gradle / settings.gradleGradle Groovy DSL
pom.xmlMaven XML
无构建文件Gradle Kotlin DSL (默认)

格式示例：

// Gradle Kotlin DSL
implementation("com.google.inject:guice:5.1.0")

// Gradle Groovy DSL
implementation 'com.google.inject:guice:5.1.0'

<!-- Maven XML -->
<dependency>
    <groupId>com.google.inject</groupId>
    <artifactId>guice</artifactId>
    <version>5.1.0</version>
</dependency>

基本配置

  • 最大搜索结果数: 1-100（默认 20）
  • 自动复制到剪贴板: 选择后自动复制（默认启用）
  • 搜索超时: 1-60 秒（默认 10 秒）

全局存储配置

存储路径可在设置中分别自定义，数据全局存储，所有项目共享：

  • 重置按钮: 每个路径配置项旁都有 "Reset" 按钮恢复默认路径
  • SQLite 缓存: 支持索引和增量更新，性能更好

搜索行为（Search Behavior）⚡

1. 防抖延迟（Debounce Delay）

  • 默认值: 500 毫秒
  • 推荐值:
    • 300ms - 快速响应，适合快速输入
    • 500ms - 平衡选项（推荐）
    • 800ms - 减少请求，适合慢速网络
  • 作用: 输入停止后等待多久才触发搜索
  • 范围: 100-2000 毫秒

2. 手动触发模式

  • 选项: "Require Enter key to trigger search"
  • 默认: 关闭（自动搜索）
  • 启用后: 必须按 Enter 键才触发搜索
  • 适用场景:
    • 想完全控制搜索时机
    • 避免输入过程中的网络请求
    • 网络环境不稳定

详细说明: 参见 DEBOUNCE_CONFIG.md

📖 示例

示例 1: 搜索 Spring Boot

搜索关键词: spring-boot

结果：

org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter
org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-web
org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-data-jpa
...

示例 2: 精确搜索 Guice

搜索关键词: com.google.inject:guice

结果：

com.google.inject:guice
Version: 7.0.0 | Repo: central | Type: jar

选择后复制（Gradle Kotlin 格式）：

implementation("com.google.inject:guice:7.0.0")

示例 3: 搜索 Jackson

搜索关键词: jackson

结果：

com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-databind
com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-core
com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-annotations
...

🔄 Version Catalog 迁移

批量迁移

将项目中所有硬编码依赖迁移到 libs.versions.toml：

入口:

  • Tools 菜单 → Migrate Dependencies to Version Catalog
  • 项目右键 → Migrate Dependencies to Version Catalog

转换示例:

// 迁移前 (build.gradle.kts)
implementation("com.google.guava:guava:32.1.3-jre")
implementation("com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-core:2.15.0")

// 迁移后 (build.gradle.kts)
implementation(libs.guava)
implementation(libs.jackson.core)

# 生成的 gradle/libs.versions.toml
[versions]
guava = "32.1.3-jre"
jackson = "2.15.0"

[libraries]
guava = { group = "com.google.guava", name = "guava", version.ref = "guava" }
jackson-core = { group = "com.fasterxml.jackson.core", name = "jackson-core", version.ref = "jackson" }

TOML 文件补全

在 *.versions.toml 文件中输入时自动补全：

[libraries]
# 输入 "guava" 后触发补全
guava = "com.google.guava:guava:32.1.3-jre"

# 支持多种格式
jackson = { module = "com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-core", version = "2.15.0" }
spring = { group = "org.springframework", name = "spring-core", version = "6.1.0" }

🔧 技术栈

  • 搜索 API: Maven Central REST API
  • 网络请求: OkHttp + CurlExecutor
  • JSON 解析: Jackson
  • UI 框架: IntelliJ Platform SDK

🎯 工作原理

  1. 搜索触发: 用户在 Search Everywhere 中输入关键词
  2. API 调用: 使用 MavenCentralSearchUtil 调用 Maven Central REST API
  3. 结果展示: 使用自定义 ListCellRenderer 展示搜索结果
  4. 复制操作: 根据设置格式化依赖声明并复制到剪贴板

📁 项目结构

maven-buddy/
├── src/main/kotlin/
│   └── site/addzero/maven/search/
│       ├── MavenDependencySearchContributor.kt  # Search Everywhere 贡献者
│       ├── MavenArtifactCellRenderer.kt         # 列表渲染器（分组显示）
│       ├── settings/
│       │   ├── MavenSearchSettings.kt           # 设置持久化
│       │   └── MavenSearchConfigurable.kt       # 设置页面
│       ├── history/
│       │   └── SearchHistoryService.kt          # 搜索历史服务
│       ├── cache/
│       │   └── SearchResultCacheService.kt      # 搜索结果缓存服务
│       ├── completion/
│       │   ├── GradleKtsCompletionContributor.kt    # Gradle KTS 补全
│       │   └── VersionCatalogCompletionContributor.kt # TOML 补全
│       └── migration/
│           └── MigrateToVersionCatalogAction.kt # 批量迁移 Action
├── src/main/resources/
│   └── META-INF/
│       └── plugin.xml                            # 插件描述文件
└── build.gradle.kts                              # 构建配置

🔗 相关链接

  • Maven Central REST API 文档
  • IntelliJ Platform SDK
  • Search Everywhere API

📄 许可证

与主项目相同

🤝 贡献

欢迎提交 Issue 和 Pull Request！

📮 反馈

如有问题或建议，请在 GitHub 上创建 Issue。

享受快速搜索 Maven 依赖的乐趣！ 🎉
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Maven Buddy - 更新日志

[Unreleased] - 2025-11-28

✨ 新增功能

1. 全局存储（历史记录 + 缓存）

  • 🌐 跨项目共享: 历史记录和搜索缓存不再绑定特定项目，切换项目后数据仍然保留
  • 📁 可配置路径: 存储路径可在设置中分别自定义
  • 📍 默认位置:
    • 历史记录: ~/.config/maven-buddy/history.json
    • 搜索缓存: ~/.config/maven-buddy/cache.json
  • 🔄 一键重置: 设置中提供 "Reset" 按钮恢复默认路径
  • 💾 JSON 格式: 使用 JSON 存储，便于查看和备份

🔧 优化

  • ⚡ 缓存策略重构:

    • 之前：以 keyword 为 key 缓存整个结果集，导致不精确匹配（如搜索 "tool-" 后缓存会影响 "tool-api" 的搜索）
    • 现在：以 groupId:artifactId 为 key 缓存单个 artifact，搜索时从缓存中精确匹配
    • 好处：缓存可跨搜索复用，搜索越多缓存越丰富

  • 🚀 存储引擎升级为 SQLite:

    • 现在：SQLite 数据库，支持索引和增量更新
    • 索引：group_id、artifact_id、cached_at 字段建立索引
    • 默认路径：~/.config/maven-buddy/cache.db

🐛 修复

  • ✅ 修复缓存读取逻辑缺失问题，现在会正确从缓存加载结果
  • ✅ 修复缓存来源标记，搜索结果现在会正确显示 💾 图标

2. 项目类型自动检测

  • 🔍 智能格式选择: 自动检测项目构建类型，复制依赖时自动选择对应格式
  • ⚙️ 检测优先级:
    1. Gradle Kotlin DSL (build.gradle.kts / settings.gradle.kts)
    2. Gradle Groovy DSL (build.gradle / settings.gradle)
    3. Maven (pom.xml)
    4. 默认: Gradle Kotlin DSL
  • 🎯 零配置: 无需手动选择格式，插件根据项目文件自动判断

2. 搜索历史与缓存

  • 📜 搜索历史: 记录使用过的依赖，搜索框为空时下拉显示（最多 30 条）
  • 💾 持久化缓存: 搜索结果缓存 7 天，避免重复调用 API（最多 200 条）
  • 📊 分组显示: 历史(📜橙色)、缓存(💾蓝色)、搜索(🔍绿色) 三种来源明确区分
  • ⏱️ 时间排序: 搜索结果按 timestamp 降序排列（最新的在前）

3. 翻页支持

  • 🔄 滚动加载: 滚动到底部自动加载下一页

  • 🔄 批量迁移: Tools → Migrate Dependencies to Version Catalog
    • 扫描项目中所有 .gradle.kts 文件

    • 生成/合并 gradle/libs.versions.toml

idea-plugin.name: split-module
idea-plugin.description:
Split Module

Quickly split files from a Gradle module into a new sibling module

Features

  • Right-click to split: Select files in Project View, right-click, and choose "Split Module"
  • Automatic sibling module creation: New module is created at the same level as the source module
  • Existing module merge: If the target sibling module already exists, the plugin merges selected files into it instead of failing immediately
  • Multi-build system support: Supports Maven (pom.xml), Gradle Kotlin DSL (build.gradle.kts), and Gradle Groovy DSL (build.gradle)
  • Smart dependency injection: Automatically adds the new module as a dependency in the source module using the appropriate syntax
  • Structure preservation: Maintains file paths and package hierarchy (e.g., src/main/kotlin/...)
  • Conflict prompts: During merge, conflicting target items are handled one by one with overwrite or skip choices

Usage

  1. Select files in the Project View that you want to split into a new module
  2. Right-click and select "Split Module"
  3. Enter a name for the new module
    • If a leaf package is selected, the default becomes {source-module}-{leaf-package}
    • Otherwise it falls back to {source-module}1
  4. Click OK - the plugin will:
    • Create a new sibling module directory, or merge into an existing sibling module with the same name
    • Copy build.gradle.kts from the source module
    • Move selected files to the new module
    • Add implementation(project(":new-module")) to source module

Example

Before:

project/
├── module-a/
│   ├── build.gradle.kts
│   └── src/main/kotlin/
│       ├── FeatureA.kt
│       └── FeatureB.kt

After splitting FeatureB.kt into module-b:

project/
├── module-a/
│   ├── build.gradle.kts  (now depends on module-b)
│   └── src/main/kotlin/
│       └── FeatureA.kt
├── module-b/
│   ├── build.gradle.kts  (copied from module-a)
│   └── src/main/kotlin/
│       └── FeatureB.kt

Requirements

  • IntelliJ IDEA 2024.2+
  • Maven project OR Gradle project (Kotlin/Groovy DSL)
  • All selected files must be from the same module

Limitations

  • Copies all dependencies from source module (manual cleanup required)
  • Module registration in settings.gradle.kts is handled by external plugins

License

MIT

idea-plugin.name: Maven Resource Overlay
idea-plugin.description:
Maven Resource Overlay

Automatically applies Maven resource filtering and <webResources> overlays from active profiles when IntelliJ builds exploded WAR or JAR artifacts.

Partial fix for the long-standing IntelliJ limitation (IDEA-25934) where the artifact builder ignores maven-war-plugin configuration from Maven profiles.

What it does

  • Copies profile-specific <webResources> into the artifact output, overlaying files per the active Maven profile
  • Applies ${...} property substitution in resources configured with <filtering>true</filtering>
  • Loads properties from external filter files (<build><filters>) at both project and profile level, with correct Maven priority order
  • Filters deployment descriptors when <filteringDeploymentDescriptors> is enabled
  • Respects <nonFilteredFileExtensions> for binary files
  • Respects <includes> and <excludes> patterns
  • Caches results — skips reprocessing when nothing changed
  • Shows processing details in the Build tool window

Supported project types

  • WAR — exploded WAR artifacts with <webResources> and resource filtering
  • JAR — JAR artifacts with <resources><filtering>true</filtering>

How it works

  1. Activate a Maven profile in the Maven tool window
  2. Build your exploded artifact (Build → Build Artifacts)
  3. The plugin automatically post-processes the artifact output
  4. Check the Build tool window for details

Built-in properties

The following Maven-standard properties are available for ${...} substitution in both file contents and path configurations (<directory>, <include>, <exclude>, <targetPath>, <filter>):

  • Project: project.groupId, project.artifactId, project.version, project.name, project.packaging, project.basedir
  • Build dirs: project.build.directory, project.build.sourceDirectory, project.build.outputDirectory, project.build.testSourceDirectory, project.build.testOutputDirectory, project.build.finalName
  • Aliases: basedir, groupId, artifactId, version, pom.groupId, pom.artifactId, pom.version, pom.basedir
  • System: user.dir, user.home, user.name, java.home, java.version, os.name, os.arch, file.separator, path.separator, line.separator

Limitations

  • Environment variables (${env.VAR}) and settings.xml properties are not supported.
  • Only ${property} syntax is supported. The @property@ delimiter style (Spring Boot) is not supported.
  • Multi-module projects: each module must be built as a separate artifact. Parent property inheritance works only when both POMs are in the project.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.2.2

  • Build log now only shows files that were actually changed

1.2.0

  • Property substitution in paths: ${...} placeholders are now resolved in <directory>, <include>, <exclude>, <targetPath>, and <filter> paths — fixes "WebResource dir not found" when pom uses e.g. <directory>${basedir}/profiles/${build.profile.id}</directory>
  • 30+ built-in Maven properties: added project.groupId, project.packaging, project.name, project.build.directory, project.build.finalName, short aliases (groupId, artifactId, version), pom.* aliases, and Java system properties (user.dir, user.home, java.version, etc.)
  • Property value resolution: ${...} inside property values themselves are resolved (e.g. <custom.dir>${basedir}/custom</custom.dir>)
  • Early basedir: basedir is defined before filter file loading, so ${basedir} works in <filter> paths
  • Output file content hashing for reliable cache invalidation

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • WAR and JAR artifact support
  • Profile-based resource filtering and webResources overlays
  • External filter file support (<build><filters>) with correct Maven priority order
  • Build tool window integration
  • Incremental cache to skip unchanged builds

idea-plugin.name: Config Mapping Navigator
idea-plugin.description:
Navigate seamlessly between Quarkus @ConfigMapping interface methods and their corresponding property definitions â€” even when properties are outside application.properties.

Links

  • Source Code
  • Report an Issue

Motivation

The default Quarkus IntelliJ tooling provides navigation support only when properties are located in application.properties.
In real-world projects, configuration is often split across multiple files (custom .properties, profiles, etc.), which breaks this navigation.

Features

  • Navigate from @ConfigMapping interface methods to property keys
  • Navigate from .properties keys back to interface methods (Ctrl/Cmd + Click)
  • Gutter icon on interface methods for quick access to related properties
  • Supports properties outside application.properties
  • Works with custom and distributed .properties files

Usage

ðŸ“¸ Features in Action

ðŸ“� Multi-File Property Mapping

The plugin isn't limited to just application.properties. It intelligently scans all configuration sources in your project, ensuring your custom and environment-specific properties are always linked to your @ConfigMapping interfaces.

ðŸ“� Smart Gutter Icons

Visual indicators appear directly in your Java/Kotlin interfaces. These gutter icons provide an instant visual confirmation that a configuration method is correctly mapped to a defined property.

ðŸ”„ Bi-Directional Navigation & Hints

Navigate seamlessly between your code and configuration. Use text hints to see the full property path and click the navigation icons within .properties files to jump back to the corresponding interface method.

From interface to properties

  • Click the gutter icon next to a method

From properties to interface

  • Use Ctrl + Click / Cmd + Click on a property key

Supported Scenarios

  • @ConfigMapping interfaces
  • Nested property structures
  • Multiple .properties sources
  • Non-standard configuration file locations

Limitations

  • Only .properties files are supported (YAML support planned for next release)
  • Resolution depends on static key matching
  • Dynamic property resolution is not supported

Target Users

  • Quarkus developers
  • Projects using @ConfigMapping
  • Codebases with non-standard configuration layouts

idea-plugin.name: Pixel Pal
idea-plugin.description:
A pixel-art companion that lives in a tool window and reacts to what happens in your IDE. It celebrates a green test run, flinches when a build fails, notices breakpoints and commits, dozes off when you step away, and dances when music is playing.

Reactions are shown as speech bubbles inside the panel rather than system notifications, so nothing interrupts your work.

Features

  • Reacts to builds, test results, run and debug sessions, live error counts and commits
  • Optional music detection on Windows, macOS and Linux
  • Built-in pomodoro timer announced by your companion
  • Several pets at once, each with its own personality; they greet each other when their paths cross
  • Drag pets around, or let them follow your cursor
  • Twelve original creatures included, plus support for custom sprite packs loaded from disk

idea-plugin.name: Maven Prime
idea-plugin.description:
Everything you expect from a Maven plugin, plus the answers none of them give you. Run and debug any goal, run your tests the way Maven runs them, win any dependency argument. Then find out why the build is slow, where a version really came from, and what is rotting in your local repository.

  • Goals you save once, each one a real IDE action with its own shortcut.
  • Tests run and debugged through Maven, reported in the IDE test tree.
  • Dependency Analyzer on the tree the IDE already resolved: conflicts, every path, and why.
  • Effective values inline: every ${property} and inherited version, in the POM.
  • Profiler: which plugin, goal or module the build time went to, and which one is worth fixing.
  • Downloads: how much of the build was the network, and which repository it waited on.
  • Model: every version, plugin and property beside the POM that really set it.
  • Repository: what is missing, half-downloaded or negatively cached in ~/.m2.
  • Build context shared with your team, with your own machine always winning.
  • Maven Daemon found or installed for you, and options rendered for Maven 3, 4 or mvnd.

Run and debug any goal, on the module you are already in

One popup, from the editor or the project tree, already pointed at the right module. Save the goals you keep retyping: each one becomes a real IDE action, so it gets its own keyboard shortcut and its own toolbar button. A saved goal carries its own profiles, properties, options, JRE and Maven version, so the fast build and the thorough one live side by side.

  • Run icons in the gutter of pom.xml: the whole module, one plugin, one execution.
  • Run a goal before any run configuration launches, as a before-launch step.
  • Force Clean, skip tests and offline are toggles, not edits to the goals you saved.
  • Colored Maven output. Maven gives up on color inside an IDE; Maven Prime asks for it anyway.

Run and debug your tests through Maven

Run one test method or one test class the way Maven will run it in CI, and read the result in the IDE test tree instead of scrolling console output. Debug attaches to the JVMs that Surefire forks, so a breakpoint inside the test is actually hit.

Win the dependency argument

The analyzer opens on the pom.xml you are reading, in the editor, on the tree the IDE has already resolved, so there is nothing to wait for. It shows which versions clashed, which one won, and every path that drags an artifact in.

  • Every path also says why it was kept or dropped: omitted for conflict, managed by dependency management, duplicate, excluded. Seeing the paths is not the same as knowing the reason.
  • Exclude the one you do not want and Maven Prime writes it into the declaration that actually causes it. When that declaration is inherited, it tells you where, instead of quietly changing every module that inherits it.
  • Jump from any artifact straight into your local repository, and back again.
  • Sort by size on disk, when you need to know what made the build heavy.

That is the part you already expect. Here is the rest.

Know why the build is slow

Per-module times tell you nothing about a parallel build. Maven Prime measures the build from the inside and lays it out as a timeline, one lane per build thread Maven really used, showing where a thread sat with nothing to run and which module it was waiting for.

The same timings regroup by plugin, goal or lifecycle phase, so you can ask which plugin costs you the most across the whole reactor instead of which single module was slowest. And every module carries what the build would save if it took no time at all: a module off the critical path saves nothing however long it took, so you stop optimising the one that was never the problem.

See what the build spent on the network

Maven prints a line per file and never a total, so the time a build waits on downloads is invisible. Maven Prime totals it: how long the build was downloading, how much came down, and which repository it came from. Against a cold local repository that can be almost the whole build.

Every ${property} resolved, in the POM you are reading

A placeholder shows what the effective model actually resolved it to, right beside it, and not only inside a version tag. A dependency or plugin with no version shows the one it inherits from dependency or plugin management. Click a value and the file that decided it opens on the line, parent POMs included. No build to run, no tab to open, no guessing which ancestor won.

Know where a version came from

Every dependency, every plugin and every property, beside the POM that really set it. Parents included, even the ones that exist only in your local repository. One double-click and you are looking at the line.

One build context, honored everywhere

Profiles, properties and the Maven environment in one place, applied to every run. Flip a profile and the effective model reloads itself, so what the IDE resolves is what your next build will really do.

Keep that context in the repository and the whole team has it on the next pull. Your own changes always win, so a shared setup never fights your machine, and nothing from a repository applies until you trust it.

A local repository you can trust

Artifacts that were never downloaded, that answered 404 everywhere, or that died halfway. Which repositories were tried, and when. Sources and javadoc that are not really there. And when Maven has cached a failure and refuses to retry, clear it for that one artifact instead of deleting your local repository and downloading the internet again.

  • Any artifact in your local repository, straight from Search Everywhere.
  • Newer published versions show up on their own: no button, no request, no waiting.
  • Credentials for the repository that refused you, kept in the IDE password safe.

Builds that start instantly

The Maven Daemon keeps the JVM warm between builds. Maven Prime finds the one you have or installs one for you, keeps the daemons in check, and never sends an option the Maven you picked cannot run: it drops it and tells you which one.

And the small things you keep wishing for

  • Add as Dependency writes the element into the module POM for you.
  • Any dependency copied as ready-to-paste XML, or as plain coordinates.
  • Intentions on the POM: analyze an artifact, go to the version that decided it, exclude it.
  • Options rendered for the Maven that will really run it, whether that is Maven 3, Maven 4 or mvnd.
  • The recent builds are kept, not only the last one, so the run that failed differently is one pick away instead of another rerun.
  • The goals you save and the whole build context travel in one file at the root of the repository.

Free, and open source under Apache 2.0.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.5.0
  • The interface stays responsive while Maven Prime looks things up. Running a goal asked your Maven which options it accepts, clicking an effective value went to disk for the POM that declares it, and turning Use Maven Daemon on went hunting for a daemon to run. Each of those ran on the thread that draws the interface, so everything stopped until the answer came back, and the first of them wrote an internal error to the log while it waited.
1.4.0
  • Command line: the options on offer are the ones your Maven actually accepts. Maven Prime asks the Maven you pointed it at rather than working it out from a version number, so -UA and -UM show up on the Maven versions that carry them and the daemon offers what the daemon has. A Maven that cannot be asked keeps every flag available instead of quietly losing some.
  • Build context: Apply to the IDE Maven Import takes back only what it put there. If you had already typed the same property into the IDE importer VM options yourself, yours was the copy that got deleted, and the one Maven Prime wrote stayed behind for good. Both now survive, and only ours is removed.
  • Profiler: a repository can no longer account for more of the build than the build lasted. Files come down from one repository side by side, and adding their times together counted the same seconds over and over. The share now reads the stretch the connection was really busy; Transfer still totals the time spent on each file.
  • Cancel a build and the timeline still names its rows Worker 1, Worker 2 and so on, instead of falling back to whatever number the JVM happened to give the thread.
  • Model: resolved values stay in POMs. Any XML file that happened to sit inside a Maven module was being annotated with that module's values.
  • Maven Prime no longer trips the IDE slow-operation warning while POMs are open, and closing a project with a POM open no longer raises an internal error.
1.3.0
  • Profiler: the timings now group by plugin, goal, phase or build thread, not only by module. Grouping by plugin answers what the old table could not ask: which plugin costs you the most across the whole reactor, rather than which single module was slowest. Sort by duration, by the order the build ran things in, or by name, and narrow the rows by typing.
  • Worth speeding up: each module now carries what the build would save if that module took no time at all. A module off the critical path saves nothing however long it took, so the list stays short even when the build does not, and you stop optimising the module that was never the problem.
  • Downloads: Maven prints a line per file and never a total, so the time a build spends waiting on the network is invisible. The profiler now shows how long the build was downloading, how much came down and which repository it came from. Against a cold local repository that can be almost the whole build.
  • The timeline lanes are the build threads Maven really used, instead of a guess made from which modules happened to overlap. Where a thread sat with nothing to run, the timeline draws the gap and names the module it was waiting for.
  • Where the Build Time Went no longer repeats itself. A single-module build used to show the same number on five rows and then advise running it with -T 1 to bring six seconds down to six seconds. Rows that add nothing are left out, and a thread count is suggested only where more threads could actually help.
  • Every figure explains itself. Hover the ? beside a number, or hover a column header, to find out what Duration, Wall Clock or Payoff mean without leaving the tab.
  • Hover the profiler summary for the goals that produced the numbers you are reading, and the build drop-down to tell one recorded run from another.
  • Dependency Analyzer opens with the tree and the paths side by side instead of one above the other, which is the shape most screens have room for. The button that switches between the two now says which layout it gives you.
1.2.0
  • Profiler: Open in Editor opens the profiler as an editor tab, where the timeline gets the full width of the window instead of a narrow column beside your code.
  • Turn on Report a build whose time can be recovered and a build that could have been faster says so when it finishes, with a link straight to the profiler. It is off until you turn it on, and it stays quiet unless there are at least ten seconds and a fifth of the build to win back.
  • The verdict under the timeline no longer contradicts itself on a wide build. It used to say a build ran 37 modules at once and, in the same sentence, that only 8 were allowed.
  • A build held back by its dependencies no longer shows the same number twice, once as time more threads would win back and once as overhead.
  • Large builds are no longer reported as measured only in part.
  • Model: the value shown beside a ${property} follows the POM. Change a version property and the value moves with the next Maven reload, instead of staying on what it was the last time the model was read.
  • The Model tab is marked when the POMs have changed since the model was read, so you can tell from any tab that what it shows is behind.
  • Settings: choose how many past runs the Model, Profiler and Repository drop-downs keep. Twenty, as before, unless you change it.
1.1.2
  • Build context: a property marked Apply to the IDE Maven import no longer reaches the importer on its own. Apply to the IDE Maven Import on the Build Context properties toolbar writes the marked properties, and takes back exactly what it wrote, so whatever you typed into the importer VM options yourself stays there.
  • The two markers an earlier version fenced its region with reached the importer JVM as real -D definitions. They are taken out of the field the first time this version reads it.
  • Profiles: a profile that a module brings in, or takes away, appears and disappears as soon as the import finishes, in the profiles popup as well as in the tool window.
  • The profiles popup keeps the size you drag it to and treats it as a minimum: a longer name or one more row widens it, a shorter list leaves it as it is.
  • A finished import no longer pushes the profiles back into the IDE and starts a second one.
1.1.1
  • Profiler: the timeline no longer paints its bars over the rest of the tool window on builds with more modules running at once than fit on screen, or at any zoom past the whole build.
1.1.0
  • Profiler: every bar carries the duration of the module it stands for, and clicking a bar selects that module in the details below. Bars too short to aim at are easier to hit.
  • Goals: clone a saved goal instead of retyping it.
  • .mavenprime.json is never written on your behalf. Create it when you want to share the goals and build context you have, from the Maven settings wheel or the Maven Prime settings.
  • Until that file exists, your goals and build context stay with the project under .idea. Wherever the file is present, it is the one that counts.
  • A .mavenprime.json written by a newer Maven Prime is read as far as this one can read it, and is never written over.
  • Daemons: Remove deletes the daemon Maven Prime downloaded rather than letting it return on the next scan. A daemon you installed yourself is left where it is.
  • The tool window follows the editor and the project tree without holding the UI thread.
1.0.0
  • Initial release.

idea-plugin.name: Backlog
idea-plugin.description:
Overview

This plugin allows you to view Backlog pull requests (PRs) directly within a JetBrains IDE. It enables efficient code review without leaving your IDE.

Key Features

  • Display Backlog PR list within the JetBrains IDE
  • View PR details
  • Check changes for each commit
  • Review file-by-file changes

Planned Features

  • View and add comments
  • Revamp the Tab Views
  • OAuth2.0 Support
  • I18n Support

Installation (from Marketplace)

  1. Open a JetBrains IDE.
  2. Go to Settings/Preferences.
  3. Navigate to the Plugins section.
  4. Search for "Backlog PR Viewer" in the Marketplace tab.
  5. Click Install.
  6. Restart the IDE to activate the plugin.

Installation (Manually)

  1. Download the latest release.
  2. Open a JetBrains IDE.
  3. Go to Settings/Preferences > Plugins > ⚙️ > Install plugin from disk...
  4. Select the downloaded plugin file to install it.
  5. Restart the IDE to activate the plugin.

Initial Setup

  1. Open the IDE Settings/Preferences.
  2. Navigate to Tools > Backlog.
  3. Enter your Backlog authentication details:
    • Workspace Name: Your Backlog workspace name
    • API Key: Your Backlog API key
    • Project Name: The target Backlog project key
    • Top Level Domain: Select .com or .jp
  4. Click Apply to save the settings.

Usage

  1. Open the Backlog PR Viewer tool window from the IDE toolbar or menu.
  2. The PR list for your configured project will be displayed automatically.
  3. Click on a PR to view its details.
  4. Use the Commits tab to review changes per commit.
  5. Use the Files tab to review file-by-file diffs.

Support

If you encounter any problems or have suggestions, please create an Issue on GitHub.

License

This plugin is released under the [Apache License 2.0]. See the LICENSE file for details.

概要

このプラグインは、JetBrains IDE上でBacklogのプルリクエスト（PR）を直接確認できるようにするものです。IDEを離れることなく、効率的にコードレビューを行うことができます。

主要機能

  • JetBrains IDE内でBacklogのPRリストの表示
  • PRの詳細情報の閲覧
  • コミットごとの変更点の確認
  • ファイルごとの変更点の確認

今後追加予定の機能

  • コメントの表示と追加
  • タブビューの見直し
  • OAuth2.0のサポート
  • 多言語対応

インストール方法 (マーケットプレイス)

  1. JetBrains IDEを開きます。
  2. 設定/環境設定 を開きます。
  3. プラグイン セクションに移動します。
  4. マーケットプレイス タブで "Backlog PR Viewer" を検索します。
  5. インストール ボタンをクリックします。
  6. IDEを再起動して、プラグインを有効にします。

インストール方法 (手動)

  1. 最新のリリースをダウンロードします。
  2. JetBrains IDEを開きます。
  3. 設定/環境設定 > プラグイン > ⚙️ > ディスクからプラグインをインストール... の順に選択します。
  4. ダウンロードしたプラグインファイルを選択してインストールします。
  5. IDEを再起動して、プラグインを有効にします。

初期設定

  1. IDEの 設定/環境設定 を開きます。
  2. ツール > Backlog を選択します。
  3. Backlogの認証情報を入力します。
    • ワークスペース名: Backlogのワークスペース名
    • APIキー: BacklogのAPIキー
    • プロジェクト名: 対象プロジェクトのキー
    • トップレベルドメイン: .com または .jp を選択
  4. 適用 をクリックして設定を保存します。

使用方法

  1. IDEのツールバーまたはメニューから Backlog PR Viewer ツールウィンドウを開きます。
  2. 設定したプロジェクトのPRリストが自動的に表示されます。
  3. PRをクリックして詳細を確認します。
  4. コミット タブを選択し、各コミットの変更点を確認します。
  5. ファイル タブを選択し、ファイルごとの変更点を確認します。

サポート

問題や提案がある場合は、GitHubのIssueを作成してください。

ライセンス

このプラグインは[Apache License 2.0]の下で公開されています。詳細はLICENSEファイルを参照してください。

idea-plugin.name: YApi J
idea-plugin.description:
Introduction

By parse templates configuration in preference setting, it's easy to generate APIs which suits the YApi platform.
The project interfaces must be marked by standard JavaDoc or annotations.
Also supports custom interface register pattern not only spring-controller pattern, such as custom annotation or comment.

configuration rules

hover on the textfield to show config tips.
  • YApi url: (Required) your YApi server url.
  • Ignore classes list: add the qualified class name which should'nt be parse, such as some gateway context.
  • Project list: (Required) add YApi project tokens. Make sure that the YApi url is configured before project tokens added.
  • Parse pattern list: (Required) parse rules of interfaces.

Concrete configuration of parse pattern

  • Pattern name: (Required) the unique name of parse pattern.
  • Base Path Locator: locate rule of controller base path.
  • Method Locator: locate rule of interface request method, default POST to YApi if empty.
  • Path Locator: (Required) locate rule of interface path.

简介

通过模板配置，根据规范的JavaDoc/注解解析接口文档，一键上传至YApi，支持自定义注册方式（公司内部网关等）。
使用前请先进行YApi相关配置，及解析规则配置。
上传效果Demo可前往http://kwin.xyz:3000/查看，访客账号为visitor@foxmail.com/visitor。
更多使用方式介绍详见：https://github.com/kwin1113/YApi-J

配置规则

  • YApi地址：必填。
  • 过滤列表：允许为空。添加类的全限定名以过滤，在解析接口文档时不对列表中的类进行解析，通常用于内部网关上下文等对象的过滤。
  • 项目列表：必填，在配置前请先配置YApi列表并保存。添加YApi项目的token，将自动将其解析为项目名称（进入配置页时将进行刷新，请及时删除无效token）。
  • 配置模板：必填。配置接口文档的解析规则。

模板的具体配置方式

  • 规则名称：该字段全局唯一，以区分不同的接口文档解析规则。
  • basePath定位：该配置允许为空。用于定位接口的基本路径，将解析接口类上的注释/注解。
  • method定位：该配置允许为空。用于定位接口的请求方式，允许为空以支持内部统一网关接口注册方式，将默认以POST方式注册到YApi。
  • path定位：必填。用于定位接口路径。当定位方式为注解时，依次填入注解中接口路径定位对应属性，例如value，及注解类全限定名；当定位方式为注释时，请填入注释对应tag。

idea-plugin.name: API Radar
idea-plugin.description:
API Radar

Zero-intrusion capture of third-party HTTP requests/responses in your Java project, without adding a single line of logging or breakpoint.

API Radar attaches a lightweight Java Agent to your running JVM, intercepts the supported HTTP clients via ByteBuddy, and streams every request/response (method, URL, headers, body, duration, status code, error) to an IDE Tool Window in real time.

Supported HTTP clients

  • Spring RestTemplate
  • Apache HttpClient 4 / 5
  • OkHttp (roadmap)
  • JDK HttpClient (Java 11+) (roadmap)
  • Spring WebClient (roadmap)
  • Feign (roadmap)

How it works

  1. Start your Java application (on JDK 21+ add -Djdk.attach.allowAttachSelf=true).
  2. Run Tools → Attach API Radar and pick the target process.
  3. Open the API Radar tool window at the bottom; events appear live as your code hits external APIs.

Privacy & Security

  • All captured data stays on your local machine. Nothing is uploaded to any remote server.
  • The plugin and the Agent communicate over a local TCP port (loopback only).
  • You can pause capture, set URL include/exclude globs, and cap body sizes from the settings page.
  • Source code: GitHub

idea-plugin.name: OpenAPI Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Reliable go-to-definition for $ref in OpenAPI/Swagger specs (JSON and YAML, same-file and external-file), a warning on any $ref that doesn't resolve, detection of reusable components that nothing in the project references, validation of example and default values against their schema (OAS 3.1 type unions included, OpenAPI 3.2 documents, and the common formats such as date-time, uuid and email) -- no Spectral CLI or account needed -- and always-current compatibility with new JetBrains IDE releases.

Built from real, current evidence across four independent sources in this exact space: a paid competitor with a multi-year recurring pattern of falling 2+ releases behind every new JetBrains IDE version (weeks without a working plugin each time) and no external $ref support at all ("not usable"); a freemium competitor with a memory leak that crashes the IDE on large specs and incomplete OAS 3.1 support despite advertising it; a free competitor, abandoned since 2023, that makes the IDE unusable on large files (10+ second lags); and JetBrains's own bundled OpenAPI plugin, independently documented elsewhere in this catalog as "catastrophically slow... turned into torture" even on small 10-15-endpoint files.

100% Paid, no free tier -- every feature above requires a license after the standard JetBrains 30-day trial.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Added

  • OpenAPI 3.2 support in the example check. OAS 3.2.0 (September 2025) is not yet understood by the IDE's own OpenAPI support, so a 3.2 document now gets its new places checked: an Example Object's dataValue is validated like value (serializedValue is wire text and is never checked), the schemas of components.mediaTypes and of a media type's itemSchema are walked, and so are operations under the new query method and under additionalOperations. An unreferenced components.mediaTypes entry is reported by the unused-component check like any other component. Only a document that declares openapi: 3.2.x or later gets these.
  • format is now checked in example and default values, for the formats whose validity is unambiguous: date-time (RFC 3339, with an offset), date, time, email, uuid, uri (needs a scheme), ipv4, ipv6, hostname, byte (base64), and the int32/int64 ranges. A format outside that list (custom, binary, password, float, double, uri-reference, ...) is never reported. pattern is still not checked.

Fixed

idea-plugin.name: AsyncAPI Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Reliable go-to-definition for $ref in AsyncAPI documents (JSON and YAML, same-file and external-file) that never breaks across a JetBrains IDE version bump.

Built from real, current evidence: the leading FREEMIUM AsyncAPI plugin has 55% of its reviews at 3 stars or fewer (re-verified 2026-09) -- "suddenly no longer works... says the java plugin is required" (2026-02), "does not work with IntelliJ 2024.2.4" (2024-12), and a real preview bug ("Error: the asyncapi field is missing" on a file that validates fine elsewhere). This plugin does one thing -- resolve $ref reliably, locally, with no network calls, including across JSON and YAML files -- and keeps doing it release after release.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no popups.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Fixed

  • Review/star CTA now links to this plugin's own Marketplace reviews page instead of the vendor's generic plugin list.

idea-plugin.name: Postman OpenAPI Drift Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Warning on a Postman collection (*.postman_collection.json) endpoint whose method+path no longer exists in the project's OpenAPI/Swagger spec. Collections and specs drift apart silently: a collection is hand-edited or an endpoint gets renamed/removed in the spec, and nothing tells the team the collection now exercises a path that doesn't exist -- usually caught only when a request in the collection starts returning 404.

100% static analysis -- reads the Postman collection's real item[].request.url via the bundled JSON plugin's PSI (Postman Collection Format v2.1.0's own schema), and the OpenAPI/Swagger spec's paths: via a plain text scan (works for either YAML or JSON specs, no YAML plugin dependency). Path placeholders ({id}, :id, {{id}}) are matched as wildcards on both sides.

Stated honestly: v0.1 looks for a conventionally-named spec file (openapi.yaml/.yml/.json, swagger.yaml/.yml/.json) walking up from the collection's own directory -- a spec filed elsewhere in the project, or referenced only via $ref, isn't found, and the inspection stays silent rather than guessing.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no network calls.

idea-plugin.name: Jms Messenger

Description:

This is a plugin for providing jms support. Plugin supports:
  • browsing messages
  • deleting messages
  • sending messages

Requirements:

  • IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2 or higher

Usages:

Designed to be used for development or testing purposes

Supported jms providers:

  • Wildfly 10.x.x or higher (Artemis)
  • Artemis (via HTTP or TCP)
  • ActiveMq (via TCP or SSL)
  • Wildfly 9.x.x (HornetQ)
  • HornetQ (via HTTP)
  • RabbitMQ (via TCP)
  • Kafka (via TCP)
  • IBM MQ (via TCP)

Limitation:

  • Only sending messages is supported for kafka.
  • Only text messages may be send or browse.
  • Authorization is not supported for kafka.

Suggestions and bug reports:

In case of finding bug or having a suggestion about new features or supported providers you can open a ticket on Github or contact me directly.

idea-plugin.name: MoveTab
idea-plugin.description:
This plugin adds keyboard shortcuts for reordering IDE tabs. This is based off of the similar, but now defunct, plugin of a similar name by momomo.com.

Usage (default keyboard shortcuts):

  • Ctrl+Shift+Page Up: Move the current tab to the left.
  • Ctrl+Shift+Page Down: Move the current tab to the right.
  • Move Tab to Start / Move Tab to End: No default shortcuts; assign via Settings > Keymap.

Configure wrap-around behavior via Settings > Editor > Move Tab.

Note: The default shortcuts (Ctrl+Shift+Page Up / Ctrl+Shift+Page Down) conflict with IntelliJ's built-in Move Caret to Page Top/Bottom with Selection actions. Installing this plugin overrides those bindings when the editor is active. You can reassign either action in Settings > Keymap to restore them.

idea-plugin.name: For Mainframe
idea-plugin.description:
THIS PLUGIN IS NO LONGER BEING ACTIVELY MAINTAINED. TO CONTINUE USING THE SAME FUNCTIONALITY, SUPPORTED BY A COMMUNITY, USE ZOWE® EXPLORER PLUGIN. FOR INDIVIDUAL SUPPORT, PLEASE CONTACT UKALESNIKAU@IBAGROUP.EU OR ABURAK@IBAGROUP.EU. Smart and Interactive Mainframe code editing tool that brings support for browsing, editing and creating data on z/OS via z/OSMF REST API.
IBA Group team of mainframe enthusiasts are actively developing new features for the open-source "For Mainframe" plugin. We keep improving existing features that help you to:
  • Start working with z/OS easily with no complex configurations.
  • Organize datasets on z/OS, files on USS into Working Sets.
  • Allocate datasets, create members, files and directories with different permissions.
  • Perform renaming, copying and moving data in a modern way.
  • Edit datasets, files and members. Smart auto-save will keep your content both in the editor and on the mainframe in-sync.
  • Create multiple connections to different z/OS systems.
  • Perform all available operations with Jobs.
  • Highlight all IntelliJ supported languages automatically and recognize them once opened from the mainframe.

To start using the plugin:

  • Contact your RACF administrator so that your user is in the IZUUSER RACF group
  • You are ready to go! Start working with z/OS from the IDE.

Note: z/OS 2.1 or higher is required with configured z/OSMF. Plugin is in active development state.
Feel free to recommend or report everything on our Github
Join us in Slack

idea-plugin.name: Elasticsearch Query - EDQL
idea-plugin.description:
EDQL (Elasticsearch Query - EDQL) is your ultimate companion for working with Elasticsearch! This powerful GUI client seamlessly supports Elasticsearch, AWS OpenSearch, and OpenSearch Serverless, making data exploration a breeze. Whether you're a beginner or an expert, EDQL's intuitive interface lets you harness the full power of Elasticsearch without writing complex queries. With native support for DSL API and XPack SQL across all versions, real-time query building, and instant results visualization, EDQL transforms the way you interact with your Elasticsearch clusters. Say goodbye to command-line complexities and hello to effortless Elasticsearch management!

Take your Elasticsearch experience to the next level with EDQL's groundbreaking AI integration! Powered by ChatGPT and LLM capabilities, you can now query your Elasticsearch data using natural language - just describe what you're looking for, and let EDQL translate it into powerful search queries. This revolutionary feature combines the robust search capabilities of Elasticsearch with the intuitive nature of conversational AI, making complex data exploration as simple as having a conversation. Whether you're a data analyst, developer, or DevOps engineer, EDQL's AI-powered search will dramatically boost your productivity. (Note: ChatGPT features require your own API key)

Quick Start:

  1. Create a connection for Elasticsearch.
  2. Open indices.
  3. Double-click an index to execute a query.

Features:

  • Easy to use: Access Elasticsearch (AWS Opensearch) cluster with Query DSL or SQL.
  • Manage documents: Add, update, or delete documents.
  • Export documents: Download/Export your commonly used query documents in CSV, Raw JSON, or Images format.
  • Data viewer: Visualize query results as a compact table and diagram.
  • Smart completion: Support for generating query DSL using natural language (powered by OpenAI completion models, e.g., ChatGPT).
  • ...

For more information on usage and snapshots, visit the EDQL Wiki.

idea-plugin.name: XFTP
idea-plugin.description:
A SFTP tool for remote file management using SSH Configurations.

Features

  • Upload and download files with drag and drop.
  • Edit remote text file by double clicking.

Viewport Explain

  • The dropdown above every list is the path of its own, and it memorizes access history. And it accepts keyboard type-in to display folder or open file.
  • ---------------Left Side---------------
  • The left list displays local files, current project directory is displayed by default.
  • The "Refresh" icon button: refresh local file list.
  • The "Open Folder" icon button: display current local folder in system file manager, like Finder on MacOS or Explorer on Windows.
  • ---------------Right Side---------------
  • The right list displays remote files.
  • Right click on list to open context menu to delete, create new file/folder and more.
  • A row with empty "size" cell is a directory.
  • The "Server" icon button: connect to a server.
  • The "DownArrow" icon button: display remote access history.
  • The "Refresh" icon button: reload current folder.
  • The "Suspend" icon button: disconnect.
  • The "Terminal" icon button: open a new ssh terminal with current remote directory, like Tools | Start SSH Session.
  • The "DoubleLeftArrows" or "DoubleRightArrows" icon button: Display or hide local file list.

Usage Instructions

  • Click the "Server" icon button to select a server, if there is none, it can be managed in Preferences | Tools | SSH Configurations.
  • After connected to a server, the ssh user's home folder will be displayed in the right list.
    • Double click the file in the right list, if it is editable, it will be opened in IDE text editor, and the temporary file will be uploaded after it saved.
    • Dropping files at the right list will upload them to current remote folder.
    • Dropping remote files at the left list will download them to current local folder.
  • Disconnect or close tab while transferring files will cancel the transfer.

More information at Github.

idea-plugin.name: Proxy Toggle
idea-plugin.description:
Proxy Toggle simplifies the process of switching between proxy configurations.
For many who frequently connect and disconnect to VPNs throughout the day, it can be a hassle to toggle the correct proxy configuration give which network you're on.
This plugin will allow you to select which configurations to use throughout the day and rotate between them, so you don't waste time rotating through unused options. Upon switching you will receive a helpful notification informing you of with proxy configuration you are now using.
This change can be made via "Toggle Proxy" option in the Tools menu, or by the hotkey Alt+P.

idea-plugin.name: Release Script Helper
idea-plugin.description:
This plugin adds an additional "new-file-menu" and "generation-menu" entry, to add new release script files with semi-automatically generated names. A release script file name adheres to this pattern:
(timestamp|custom)_[(ticket-type)(ticket-number)_](description).(suffix)

The script generation is guided by a small dialog, allowing to opt out of using a ticket system, or defining ticket type, number and description. In the plugin settings ticket types, default directory and file endings can be configured. Also a choice can be made to generate UNIX timestamps as file prefix by default or ask for a custom value.

The default hot key for opening the dialog is ctrl + alt + shift + r. If text was selected prior to pressing the hot key, it will be inserted into the generated release script file. If the current project is a Git project, then a branch naming convention can be used to prefill the ticket type and ticket number field: (ticket-type)-*(ticket-number)-branch-name-...

idea-plugin.name: Zowe Explorer
idea-plugin.description:
Zowe(R) Explorer for IntelliJ IDEA(TM) is an open-source plugin by the Zowe Community, which gives access to mainframes from a modern IDE. The plugin is a core component of the Zowe project. With the help of the plugin, developers can work with mainframes through a modern interface, using a single toolbar, structured trees, and drag-and-drop operations. The solution suits those who need to work with z/OS datasets, USS files, and Jobs from the IntelliJ IDEA.
Zowe is a project hosted under the Open Mainframe Project(TM) of the Linux Foundation(TM). Zowe Explorer plug-in for IntelliJ IDEA extends the IntelliJ IDEA platform’s tools in a way similar to that of the Zowe Explorer extension for Visual Studio Code(TM), giving developers a modern way to interact with the mainframe.

It also:
  • makes interactions with Mainframe as simple and intuitive as possible;
  • reduces complexity by only requiring a mainframe connection and working set (user-created masks or filters applied to datasets);
  • follows the IntelliJ user flow to bring a modern interface to Mainframe.

Advantages:
  • Create new datasets and members;
  • Copy and paste members between datasets;
  • View the properties of any dataset or member;
  • Allocate a new dataset like an existing dataset (via the "Allocate Like" item);
  • Rename datasets and members;
  • Delete datasets and members.

To start using the plugin:
  • Install the plugin in your IntelliJ IDEA platform based IDE.
  • Contact your RACF administrator so that your user is in the IZUUSER RACF group
  • You are ready to go! Start working with z/OS from the IDE.

Note: z/OS 2.1 or higher is required with configured z/OSMF.
Feel free to recommend or report everything on our GitHub
Join us in Slack
About us:
Under the Open Mainframe Project umbrella, Zowe is an integrated and extensible open source framework for z/OS that combines the past and present to build the future of mainframes. The Zowe Explorer for Intellij IDEA is developed by the Zowe community, and you can visit the Zowe website to learn more about Zowe. Contributing to the Zowe Explorer for Intellij IDEA is the IBA Group, and other contributors to Zowe community projects include Broadcom, IBM, and Rocket Software.

The Apipost IDEA Plug-in, also known as Apipost Helper V2, transforms IntelliJ IDEA into a powerful API tool similar to Postman. It offers efficient API debugging, documentation generation in a few clicks and unites the functionalities of Restfultool, Yapi, Swaggertool and Showdoc within a single platform.

Key Features:
  • Local API debugging and history tracking in IntelliJ IDEA.
  • Tree view display and seamless navigation between API interfaces and code.
  • Search functionality through APIs and comments. Shortcut keys: Command/Ctrl + for macOS/Windows.
  • Searching within the API tree, comments inclusive. Shortcut keys: Option/Alt + for macOS/Windows.
  • Convenient save and query of request input/output.
  • Configurable host and global headers, along with uploadable APIs.
  • Adjustable prefix host and multiple methods for API upload.
  • Support for Swagger 2.0 and Swagger 3.0 annotations.
  • Custom parameter parsing.
  • Intuitive API documentation extraction based on JavaDoc (Java), KDoc (Kotlin) and ScalaDoc (Scala).

Apipost IDEA 插件（Apipost Helper V2）

Apipost IDEA 插件是一个类似于Postman的IntelliJ IDEA插件，可以帮助开发人员高效地调试Api并一键生成文档；一个Apipost IDEA插件 =Restfultool+Yapi+Swaggertool+Showdoc；

idea-plugin.name: Autoconfig
idea-plugin.description:
Autoconfig is an extension for IntelliJ IDEA that enables persistence and sharing of project specific IDE-settings outside the workspace.xml-file.

Goal

Several user-specific IDE settings are stored for each project in the VCS-ignored-workspace.xml-file. This is a good thing for individual workspace look and feel, but some project-specific settings are also stored in the workspace.xml. That's why it can be cumbersome to configure your IDE differently for each project. Here are some examples for IDE settings that might be a good idea to be shared across users:

  • Format on Save
  • Custom Plugin Repositories
  • Compiler Settings
  • Maven Importing Settings

Autoconfig helps with sharing settings across multiple users by allowing to configure settings in a separate file which can be committed into your version control. This lessens the need of project specific instructions on how to configure your IDE for working on a project, and it ensures that all users share the same settings.

Getting started

  1. Go to Tools -> Autoconfig -> Create Autoconfig File
  2. Select the type of Autoconfig that should be created
  3. Create an Autoconfig file for your project
  4. Reopen your project
  5. Autoconfig automatically configures the IDE on restart
  6. Commit the Autoconfig configuration file(s)

idea-plugin.name: JsonFormat
idea-plugin.description:
Plugin for converting between JSON, JavaBean and ets files.(如果提示不兼容，可以下载本地采取离线安装的方式进行安装)

特别提醒：
  • 2.x 版本，做了简化，只支持 DevEco Studio 中使用，便于 json 生成 ets 文件.
  • 如果需要全量功能，在IDEA、Android Studio中使用，请下载安装 1.x 的版本.

    • 有任何问题可以联系我 薇薇
    1.Json2Bean: Convert JSON to JavaBean class, manually create a new class file, such as User.java, and then call Generate, select Json2Bean, paste the corresponding JSON in the pop-up input box, and confirm that JavaBean can be generated in the current class.

    2.Json2ets: Convert JSON into Harmony ets class, manually create a class file, such as User.ets, and then call Generate, select Json2ets, paste the corresponding JSON in the input box that pops up, and confirm to generate ets model file in the current class.

    3.Json2etsFile: Convert JSON into Harmony ETS class. Right-click in the specified directory and choose Convert Json to Ets. Paste the corresponding JSON in the pop-up input box and fill in the name of the Ets file to confirm The ets model file can be generated in the current class.

    4.JavaBean2ets: Convert the JavaBean class to a great ets file. Right-click the specified JavaBean file (the file ending in.java) and choose from the displayed menu JavaBean2ets, and then select the corresponding operation in the pop-up secondary menu: save to file, copy to clipboard, modify in the edit box three operations can be.

idea-plugin.name: Manage Projects
idea-plugin.description:
Project Management

This is a powerful tool designed specifically for IntelliJ IDEA users, aimed at helping developers better organize and manage their projects. The plugin offers a rich set of features that enable you to easily group, sort, add descriptions, set labels and colors for your projects, thereby significantly enhancing their manageability and maintainability.

Main Features

  • Group Management: Create, rename, delete groups, and reorder groups by moving them up or down.
  • Project Management: Add projects manually or scan directories to batch add projects, rename projects, move projects between groups, remove projects from groups.
  • Project Sorting: Sort projects within a group by name (alphabetically) or by last modified time.
  • Descriptions: Add detailed descriptions to projects, helping team members quickly understand the project background and status.
  • Tags: Add multiple tags to projects for easy categorization and searching.
  • Project Colors: Set custom colors for project names to visually distinguish important projects.
  • Project Count: Display the number of projects in each group for quick overview.
  • Search: Search projects by name, description, or tags across all groups.
  • Open Projects: Open projects in current window or new window, open all projects in a group at once.
  • Quick Actions: Show project in file explorer, copy project path to clipboard.
  • View Controls: Collapse all or expand all groups with one click.
  • Shortcut Switch: Use Ctrl+Alt+P (Windows/Linux) or Cmd+Alt+P (macOS) to quickly switch between open projects.
  • Multi-language Support: Supports 12 languages including English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Russian, Portuguese, Dutch, and Traditional Chinese.

项目管理

是一款专为 IntelliJ IDEA 用户设计的强大工具，旨在帮助开发者更好地组织和管理他们的项目。 该插件提供了丰富的功能集，使您能够轻松地对项目进行分组、排序、添加描述、设置标签和颜色，从而极大地提升了项目的可管理和可维护性。

主要功能亮点

  • 分组管理：创建、重命名、删除分组，支持上下移动调整分组顺序。
  • 项目管理：手动添加项目或扫描目录批量添加项目，重命名项目，移动项目到其他分组，从分组中移除项目。
  • 项目排序：支持按名称（字母顺序）或按最后修改时间对分组内的项目进行排序。
  • 项目描述：为项目添加详细描述，帮助团队成员快速了解项目背景和状态。
  • 标签管理：为项目添加多个标签，便于分类和搜索。
  • 项目颜色：为项目名称设置自定义颜色，直观区分重要项目。
  • 项目计数：在分组名称旁显示项目数量，快速了解分组规模。
  • 搜索功能：支持按名称、描述或标签在所有分组中搜索项目。
  • 打开项目：在当前窗口或新窗口打开项目，支持一键打开分组内所有项目。
  • 快捷操作：在资源管理器中显示项目、复制项目路径到剪贴板。
  • 视图控制：一键折叠或展开所有分组。
  • 快捷切换：使用 Ctrl+Alt+P 快捷键快速切换已打开的项目。
  • 多语言支持：支持包括英语、中文、日语、韩语、德语、法语、西班牙语、意大利语、俄语、葡萄牙语、荷兰语、繁体中文在内的12种语言。

🔧 How to Use

  1. Open Settings → Tools → 背景图片切换 (Background Image Switch)
  2. Select the folder containing your images
  3. Configure switch interval, opacity, and fill mode
  4. Enable "Auto Switch"

Supported Formats: JPG, JPEG, PNG, GIF, BMP, WEBP

让你的 IntelliJ IDEA 拥有动态背景，让编程更有乐趣！

idea-plugin.name: JTools SSH Publisher
idea-plugin.description:
A powerful SSH client plugin for IntelliJ IDEA with terminal, file browser, and batch upload capabilities.

功能强大的 SSH 客户端插件，支持终端、文件浏览器和批量上传功能。

Source Code / 源码

Features / 功能特性

SSH Connection / SSH 连接

  • Password & private key authentication / 密码和密钥认证
  • Use local key (~/.ssh/id_rsa) / 使用本地默认密钥
  • Load key from file picker / 从文件选择器加载密钥
  • Jump host chain support / 支持跳板链连接
  • Native context action popup with icons & search / 原生右键动作弹窗，支持图标与搜索
  • Right-click add to group & rename group / 支持分组右键新建配置与重命名
  • Standalone group table, delete group keeps connections under "default" / 独立分组表，删除分组后连接归入"默认"
  • Drag to reorder connections across groups / 支持拖拽调整连接顺序并跨分组移动
  • Reveal and copy passwords/passphrases, then restore masked input / 支持查看并复制密码、私钥密码原文，关闭后恢复掩码
  • Connection testing / 连接测试
  • Heartbeat keep-alive / 心跳保活
  • Pre/Post scripts with list+editor UI / 前置/后置脚本（列表+编辑器方式）
  • Four script types: remote pre/post via SSH, local pre/post on this machine / 四种脚本类型：远程前置、远程后置、本地前置、本地后置
  • Local scripts pick a shell, auto-detected per OS / 本地脚本可指定 Shell，按操作系统自动探测
  • Collapsible script section in the config dialog / 配置弹窗脚本区域可折叠
  • Non-modal edit dialog / 非模态编辑对话框
  • Improved form alignment in SSH edit dialog / 优化 SSH 编辑对话框表单对齐

Terminal / 终端

  • JediTerm-based emulator / 基于 JediTerm
  • IDEA theme adaptation / 适配 IDEA 主题
  • Chinese font support / 中文支持
  • Large text paste stability improvements / 大文本粘贴稳定性增强
  • PTY resize sync for editors like vi / 支持 vi 等全屏程序窗口尺寸同步
  • macOS input method compatibility fix / 修复 macOS 输入法兼容问题
  • Tab drag reorder / Tab 拖拽排序
  • Cross-container Tab drag & drop / 跨容器 Tab 拖拽移动
  • Split view (right/down) / 分屏显示
  • Unlimited split nesting / 无限层级分屏
  • Focus-based Tab placement / 基于焦点添加新 Tab
  • System monitor bar (CPU/Memory/Disk/Process) / 系统监控状态栏

File Browser (SFTP) / 文件浏览器

  • Remote file explorer / 远程文件浏览
  • Upload/Download with progress / 上传下载带进度
  • Batch upload to current/selected directory / 批量上传到当前或所选目录
  • Drag local files/directories to upload recursively / 支持拖拽本地文件和目录递归上传
  • Remote tree drag move / 远程文件树内拖拽移动
  • Drag upload conflict check with confirm / 拖拽上传冲突检查与确认
  • Drag move confirm for risky operations / 拖拽移动二次确认
  • Multi-select recursive delete / 多选递归批量删除
  • Dynamic context menu by directory/file/multi-select / 按目录、文件、多选动态展示右键菜单
  • Create and batch create from toolbar or directory context menu / 工具栏或目录右键新建与批量创建
  • Toolbar create targets current path, directory context menu targets clicked folder / 工具栏创建基于当前路径，目录右键创建基于被点击目录
  • Multi-level path creation with trailing slash folder rule / 支持多级路径创建，末尾 / 表示文件夹
  • Confirmation dialog before create / 创建前显示确认提示
  • Enhanced delete warning for irreversible actions / 删除前增强不可恢复风险提示
  • Open, create, upload, edit, download, copy path, properties from context menu / 右键支持打开、新建、上传、编辑、下载、复制路径、属性等操作
  • Rename, delete / 重命名、删除
  • Double-click to edit in IDEA / 双击在 IDEA 中编辑
  • Auto-sync on save with notification / 保存时自动同步（带通知）
  • Auto-reconnect on disconnect / 断线自动重连
  • IDEA Local History support / 支持本地历史记录
  • Download file rename detection / 下载文件重名检测
  • System monitor bar (CPU/Memory/Disk/Process) / 系统监控状态栏
  • File properties view / 文件属性查看
  • Quick search / 快速搜索

Transfer Management / 传输管理

  • Unified upload/download management / 统一上传下载管理
  • Independent SSH connection per task / 每个任务独立连接
  • Stop task with cleanup / 停止任务并清理未完成文件
  • Task details (scripts & logs) / 任务详情（脚本和日志）
  • Retry, delete, batch operations / 重试、删除、批量操作

Batch Upload / 批量上传

  • Multi-file upload to multiple servers / 多文件上传到多台服务器
  • Independent config per file (server, path, scripts) / 每个文件独立配置
  • Upload queue management / 上传队列管理
  • Pre/Post scripts, remote via SSH or local on this machine / 前置/后置脚本，支持远程执行和本机执行
  • Temporary scripts / 临时脚本
  • Local scripts run with working directory fixed to the current project root / 本地脚本工作目录固定为当前项目根目录
  • Custom remote filename / 自定义远程文件名

Upload Templates / 上传模板

  • Save upload tasks as templates / 保存上传任务为模板
  • Group management / 分组管理
  • Right-click add to group & rename template group / 支持模板分组右键新建与重命名
  • Configure local file, server, remote path / 配置本地文件、服务器、远程路径
  • Custom remote filename / 自定义远程文件名
  • Select saved remote/local scripts or write temp scripts / 选择已保存的远程、本地脚本或临时脚本
  • Saved-script Checkbox toggles reliably with one click / 已保存脚本 Checkbox 单击即可可靠切换
  • Local scripts run with working directory fixed to the current project root / 本地脚本工作目录固定为当前项目根目录
  • Double-click to execute / 双击执行
  • Multi-select batch execution / 多选批量执行
  • Copy, edit, delete templates / 复制、编辑、删除模板
  • Export/Import includes templates / 导出导入包含模板

Batch Execution / 批量执行

  • Run scripts on multiple servers concurrently by group / 按分组勾选多台服务器并发执行脚本
  • Independent result tab per server / 每台服务器独立结果 Tab
  • Group-level saved scripts with reorder / 分组级已保存脚本，支持上下排序
  • Click a group or any server to show scripts of that group / 点击分组或其下任意服务器均回显所属分组脚本
  • Multi-select saved scripts run in order / 多选已保存脚本按顺序执行
  • Live script editor with shell highlighting / 实时脚本编辑器带 Shell 语法高亮
  • Live script runs before or after saved scripts / 实时脚本可选在已保存脚本之前或之后执行
  • Select all / invert, stop, clear results / 全选、反选、停止、清空结果

Config Management / 配置管理

  • Export all or selected configs / 导出全部或选择性导出
  • Import with overwrite/skip option / 导入支持覆盖或跳过
  • Secondary confirmation before overwrite import / 覆盖导入前二次确认
  • Rename SSH groups and template groups / 支持重命名 SSH 分组和模板分组
  • Preserve expand state on refresh / 刷新时保持展开状态
  • Collapsible top panel with layout restore / 上方面板支持收起展开并恢复分栏比例

Data Storage / 数据存储

SQLite: ~/.jtools/jtools-ssh-publisher/db.data
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.2.8
  • 新增：跳板机编辑弹窗增加“配置方式”，支持手动配置或选择已有 SSH 连接；已有连接按“分组 / 连接名称（用户名@主机:端口）”展示
  • 设计：选择已有 SSH 连接时，保存其地址、端口、用户名和认证参数的独立快照；原连接后续修改或删除不会隐式改变已保存的跳板链
  • 安全：已有连接列表排除当前正在编辑的 SSH 连接，并且快照不复制来源连接自身的跳板链，避免直接自引用和隐式嵌套
  • 优化：重构跳板机编辑弹窗表单布局，统一标题列和输入列，并按文字基线对齐标题与下拉框、输入框等控件
1.2.7
  • 新增：批量执行面板，按分组勾选多台服务器并发执行脚本，每台服务器独立结果 Tab，支持全选/反选、停止和清空结果
  • 新增：批量执行支持分组级已保存脚本，可新建、编辑、删除和上下排序，多选后按顺序依次执行
  • 新增：批量执行的实时脚本编辑器带 Shell 语法高亮，可选择在已保存脚本之前或之后执行
  • 新增：本地脚本体系，SSH 配置的脚本类型扩展为远程前置/远程后置/本地前置/本地后置，本地脚本通过 ProcessBuilder 在本机执行
  • 新增：本地脚本可指定 Shell，按当前操作系统自动探测可用 Shell（Windows 读 PATH 判断 PowerShell，macOS/Linux 读 /etc/shells）
  • 新增：本地前置/后置脚本的工作目录固定为当前项目根目录，脚本内相对路径以项目根目录为基准；覆盖右键上传、批量上传、模板单次执行、模板多选批量执行四个入口
  • 新增：SSH 分组改为独立分组表，支持重命名和删除分组，删除时组内连接归入“默认”、该分组的批量执行脚本级联删除
  • 新增：SSH 连接树支持拖拽调整顺序，可拖到分组内末尾或插到指定连接前后并自动切换分组
  • 优化：SSH 配置、右键上传、批量上传、上传模板的脚本区域改为可折叠区块，长表单不再被脚本编辑器挤占
  • 修复：右键上传弹窗、批量上传、上传模板的脚本列表只加载远程前置/后置脚本，已保存的本地前置/后置脚本无法勾选的问题
  • 新增：脚本选择表格增加“位置”列，区分本机执行与服务器执行
  • 修复：切换到批量执行 Tab 时把分割线宽度设为 0 触发 IllegalArgumentException 导致面板加载失败的问题
  • 修复：批量执行面板三条分割线因子组件最小尺寸限制几乎无法拖动的问题
  • 修复：编辑上传模板时，已保存脚本表格的 Checkbox 偶发需要连续点击多次才能切换；现改为鼠标按下即直接更新 Boolean 模型，并同步应用到 SSH 连接右键上传和批量上传的同类脚本选择表格
  • 优化：批量执行页面点击分组或该分组下任意服务器时，都会查询并回显所属分组的已保存脚本；切换同组服务器时保留仍有效的脚本选择
  • 修复：新增或编辑 SSH 连接时点击“测试连接”，首次主机指纹或指纹变化确认框被错误延迟到 SSH 配置窗口关闭后才显示；现将确认框绑定到当前配置窗口及其 IDEA ModalityState，使其立即显示在配置窗口上方，主机指纹安全验证策略保持不变
  • 修复：工作目录不可用时显式报错，不再静默使用 IDE 进程目录
1.2.6
  • 修复：SSH 配置与跳板机勾选“显示原文”后，密码和私钥密码无法通过 Ctrl/Cmd + C 快捷键复制的问题
  • 优化：明文状态使用普通文本框，关闭“显示原文”后恢复密码框；两种输入框共享内容，切换时保留文本、光标位置和选区
  • 修复：新增“显示原文”选项后私钥输入区域被尾部复选框挤窄的问题，恢复私钥区域完整宽度
1.2.5
  • 优化：Tab 拖拽体验重构，拖出即从源分屏移除并跟随鼠标显示半透明幽灵标签，落点显示高亮占位标签，同容器排序与跨容器移动统一逻辑
  • 修复：Tab 拖拽排序时因反复重算落点导致的闪烁问题
  • 优化：Tab 右键菜单切换为 IDEA 原生动作弹窗，支持图标与操作搜索
  • 优化：全量重绘工具栏、文件类型、状态、分屏等图标，统一为 IDEA 风格线性图标并适配明暗主题
  • 新增：SSH 主机密钥校验（known_hosts + 首次指纹确认 + 指纹变化告警），防止中间人攻击
  • 新增：SSH 配置与跳板机的密码、私钥密码支持「显示原文」，免去导出核对
  • 优化：命令执行改为并发读取 stdout/stderr，避免管道阻塞与输出截断
  • 优化：SFTP 客户端与配置存储的并发访问串行化，避免多线程共享导致的错乱
  • 修复：终端断线重连按钮监听重复注册导致的多次触发
  • 修复：传输任务停止时可能覆盖已完成状态的问题
  • 修复：shadowJar 打包因 MANIFEST.MF 输入快照失败的问题
1.2.4
  • 优化：SSH 配置、上传模板、文件系统右键菜单统一切换为 IDEA 原生动作弹窗，支持图标展示与操作搜索
  • 新增：SSH 连接分组支持右键重命名，并可直接在分组下新建配置
  • 新增：上传模板分组支持右键重命名，并可直接在分组下新建模板

  • 修复：SSH 配置编辑对话框中标签与表单内容未对齐的问题

  • 新增：本地拖拽上传到远程目录时支持同名冲突检查，并可选择覆盖上传、跳过冲突项或取消
  • 新增：导入配置选择“覆盖”时增加二次确认，明确脚本和模板引用的覆盖风险
  • 优化：远程文件和目录删除提示增强，明确递归删除与不可恢复风险
  • 优化：SSH 配置删除和上传模板删除提示增强，明确删除影响范围
1.2.2

  • 优化：目录右键创建直接作用于目标目录，减少进入目录后的重复操作

1.2.1
  • 新增：SSH 配置支持跳板链（Jump Host），可通过一台或多台跳板机连接目标服务器

idea-plugin.name: Favorite Classes
idea-plugin.description:
Favorite Classes is a lightweight IntelliJ IDEA plugin for quickly bookmarking, viewing, and navigating frequently used Java classes in your project.

主要功能：

  • 在编辑器右键菜单中，通过“收藏/取消收藏类”快速标记当前类
  • 在右侧 Favorites 工具窗口中集中展示收藏类列表
  • 支持多选收藏、批量删除以及清空全部收藏
  • 双击收藏项即可跳转到对应类

适用场景：

  • 频繁在若干核心类之间来回切换
  • 大型项目中希望快速直达常用类，减少搜索和翻找时间

idea-plugin.name: Project Juggler
idea-plugin.description:
Allows opening any project in a new IntelliJ IDEA instance with an isolated configuration. It helps keep your IDE caches clean and free of unnecessary stuff.

Use `Cmd+Shift+P`/`Ctrl+Shift+P` to open the Recent Juggled Projects ("Recent Juggled Projects" action).
Use "Browse..." to open a new project.
Use recent project items to reopen a project or switch to an already opened project.

Details:

  • The configuration is copied from the main IJ instance.
  • Each project is open with the same configuration each time.

idea-plugin.name: SQL Server Bacpac Manager
idea-plugin.description:
Import and export SQL Server .bacpac files directly from DataGrip's context menu.

A .bacpac file is a portable backup format for SQL Server and Azure SQL databases that includes both schema and data.

Features

  • Export to .bacpac - Right-click on any SQL Server database to export it
  • Import from .bacpac - Right-click on a SQL Server connection to import a .bacpac file as a new database
  • Automatic SqlPackage detection - Finds SqlPackage in PATH or common installation locations
  • One-click SqlPackage installation - Install SqlPackage automatically via .NET SDK if not found
  • Background processing - Export/import operations run in background with progress indication

Requirements

  • SqlPackage CLI tool (can be installed automatically if you have .NET SDK)

idea-plugin.name: jump2Kiro
idea-plugin.description:
Jump2Kiro is a JetBrains IDE plugin that enables seamless switching between your IDE and Kiro while maintaining precise cursor position.

Key Features

  • Open files in Kiro with one click
  • Maintain exact cursor position (line and column)
  • Support opening entire projects in Kiro
  • Convenient shortcuts (customizable):
    macOS:
    • Option+Shift+O - Open current file in Kiro
    • Option+Shift+P - Open current project in Kiro
    Windows/Linux:
    • Alt+Shift+O - Open current file in Kiro
    • Alt+Shift+P - Open current project in Kiro
  • Multiple access methods: shortcuts, context menu, tools menu

Usage

Open current file:

  • Press Option+Shift+O (macOS) / Alt+Shift+O (Windows/Linux)
  • Right-click in editor → Open File In Kiro
  • Tools menu → Open File In Kiro

Open project:

  • Press Option+Shift+P (macOS) / Alt+Shift+P (Windows/Linux)
  • Right-click in project view → Open Project In Kiro
  • Tools menu → Open Project In Kiro

Configuration

  • Go to Settings/Preferences → Tools → Jump2Kiro
  • Set Kiro executable path (default is "kiro")
  • macOS users typically need no configuration, the default value works out of the box
  • Windows users need to set the full Kiro installation path
  • Customize shortcuts in Keymap settings

Requirements

  • Kiro Editor installed (https://kiro.dev)
  • Compatible with all JetBrains IDEs
  • Supported IDE versions: 2022.3 and above
  • Cross-platform support: macOS, Windows, Linux

Jump2Kiro 是一个 JetBrains IDE 插件，可以让你在 IDE 和 Kiro 之间无缝切换，并保持精确的光标位置。

主要特性

  • 一键在 Kiro 中打开文件
  • 精确保持光标位置（行号和列号）
  • 支持在 Kiro 中打开整个项目
  • 便捷的快捷键（可自定义）:
    macOS:
    • Option+Shift+O - 在 Kiro 中打开当前文件
    • Option+Shift+P - 在 Kiro 中打开整个项目
    Windows/Linux:
    • Alt+Shift+O - 在 Kiro 中打开当前文件
    • Alt+Shift+P - 在 Kiro 中打开整个项目
  • 多种访问方式：快捷键、右键菜单、工具菜单

使用方法

打开当前文件:

  • 按下 Option+Shift+O (macOS) / Alt+Shift+O (Windows/Linux)
  • 在编辑器中右键 → Open File In Kiro
  • 工具菜单 → Open File In Kiro

打开项目:

  • 按下 Option+Shift+P (macOS) / Alt+Shift+P (Windows/Linux)
  • 在项目视图中右键 → Open Project In Kiro
  • 工具菜单 → Open Project In Kiro

配置说明

  • 进入 Settings/Preferences → Tools → Jump2Kiro
  • 设置 Kiro 可执行文件路径（默认为 "kiro"）
  • macOS 用户通常无需配置，使用默认值即可
  • Windows 用户需要配置 Kiro 的完整安装路径
  • 通过 Keymap 设置自定义快捷键

系统要求

  • 已安装 Kiro Editor (https://kiro.dev)
  • 兼容所有 JetBrains IDE
  • 支持的 IDE 版本：2022.3 及以上
  • 跨平台支持：macOS、Windows、Linux

idea-plugin.name: Project Generator
idea-plugin.description:
Project Generator manages local development environments from a YAML config file. It clones Git repositories into a structured directory layout, registers them as IDE modules, and configures VCS roots automatically. On each run it fully reconciles the project state — modules and VCS roots no longer present in the config are removed.

Features

  • Clone Git repositories into $vcsRoot/hostname/group/repo layout
  • Auto-discover repositories via GitLab API with include/exclude regex filters
  • Register local directories as modules without cloning
  • Automatically register and remove IDE modules and VCS roots to match config
  • GitLab token via literal value, environment variable, or shell command

Configuration

Go to Settings → Tools → Project Generator and set:

  • Config file — path to your YAML configuration file
  • VCS sources root — root directory for cloned repositories (default: ~/dev)

Config File Format

git:
  - url: git@github.com:org/repo.git
    fast_forward: true

raw:
  - path: /path/to/local/dir

gitlab:
  - url: https://gitlab.example.com
    token_command: "openid token --client-id=<id>"
    token_type: oauth          # private | job | oauth
    include_archived: false
    https_url: false
    fast_forward: true
    include:
      - "^group/.*"
    exclude:
      - "^group/archived-.*"

Usage

Click the Project Generator toolbar button (top-right) and choose an action, or use Tools → Project Generator menu items. Progress is shown in the IDE progress window. A summary notification is posted on completion.

idea-plugin.name: FLUX Customer Service Deploy
idea-plugin.description: FLUX Customer Service Deploy plugin for IntelliJ IDEA. Right-click on project modules to deploy files to FTP servers with one click. Supports full package deployment, Git-based auto-detection of modified files, and selective file deployment.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.4.0

  • 修复 Vue 更新时网络不稳定导致更新包被投放到系统根目录的问题。
  • Vue 更新只认服务包目录，取消 zip 投放；定位不到目录时明确报错，可刷新重试或手动指定目录。
  • Vue 模块改为整体切换发布：新内容传完校验无误后瞬间切换，不再逐文件覆盖，中断时线上保持完整旧版本。
  • 上传支持断点续传：中断后自动退避重连并从断点继续，重试用尽由你选择继续或结束。
  • 传输每 5 秒显示一次进度：总大小、已传、剩余、速率、预计时间。
  • 修复回滚未完成仍清理备份导致原始版本丢失的问题：有文件未恢复时保留备份，可再次回滚重做。
  • 备份、版本记录等远端写入改为传完校验无误才替换，并逐一核对完整性，不通过立即中止。
  • 新增并发变更拦截：备份后被他人改动的文件不再被覆盖。
  • Vue 版本记录写入失败改为整体回滚，不再出现「更新成功但没写记录」。

1.3.9

  • 新增 Vue 前端工程支持：「工程」下拉可搜索到 Vue 模块式 Web 工程（识别依据：工程根有 serve.yaml、package.json 声明 zip:module 打包脚本且存在 src/modules 或 dist/umd 模块目录形态），显示名带线上上下文名（如 sce-vtms-m01-web (tm01webVue)）。选中后源面板改为业务模块勾选列表，标注三种产物状态（未构建 / 已过期 / 产物时间），git 检测到 src/modules/<模块号>/ 有变更的模块默认勾选。执行更新时对勾选模块中「未构建 / 已过期」的自动构建（调用工程自带 CLI 的 build:one --force，模块号 stdin 喂入、构建输出进运行日志、失败即中止且远端零变更；该命令无 git 副作用，带 git reset 的全量构建命令绝不会被自动执行）。
  • Vue 目标支持「目录直更」（服务包解包形态，主流程）：选中 Vue 工程后自动在系统目录下探测与 content 同名的服务包目录（如 A06SysBizWebVue/），目标树把选中模块显示为「模块目录（目录更新）」条目并默认勾选——执行更新即把本地 dist/umd/<模块号>/ 逐文件覆盖到远端模块目录：先把整个工程包逐文件镜像备份到 backup 目录（FTP 会话复用 + 断线重连 + 进度日志），上传时子目录按需创建、manifest.json 最后传（把"半新半旧"窗口压到最小），随后逐文件核对远端字节数，失败自动回滚（被覆盖文件从备份写回、本次新增文件删除）；远端存在而本地产物没有的历史文件保留不动并在日志说明。模块目录不存在时按「新建投放」处理。版本记录按工程包一份：_update_notes.txt 放在服务包目录旁边（与 jar/war 记录放包旁的惯例一致），一次更新追加一条记录。
  • Vue 目标同时支持 zip 形态（兜底）：目标树会列出 .zip 文件，与选中模块命名匹配的（兼容旧版带时间戳命名）默认勾选，走与 jar/war 一致的备份 / 上传 / 哈希校验 / 回滚链路；FTP 上既无服务包目录也无 zip 时，注入「（新建）」虚拟 zip 节点完成首次投放。两种形态不可混选。
  • Vue 两档更新模式与后端语义对齐：「增量更新」（默认）= 左侧展示 src/modules/ 全量源文件树（git 变更项按 [A]/[M]/[D] 标色并默认勾选，直接看出自己改了哪几个文件），勾选文件所在的模块整体参与更新（源文件与编译产物非一一对应，最小闭环单元是模块，执行时自动映射为最新编译产物）；「整包更新」= 整个工程包（全部业务模块）覆盖更新，模块列表全选只读，未构建/过期的全部自动构建。
  • Vue 目标树的模块目录条目自动展开为远端现状文件视图（只列 FTP 上当前真实存在的文件，按 dialogs/、submodules/ 等真实子目录层级嵌套，行尾显示远端大小与时间，与 jar/war 列表同款风格）：勾选语义 = 本次更新是否允许覆盖该文件，取消若干即单文件更新（排除式选择：本地新增的产物文件不受影响、自动上传并在运行日志体现，不会漏传 manifest 引用的新文件）；文件全勾时父目录正确显示全选（"保留"概念已移除）。备份始终镜像整个模块目录，保证回滚是完整快照。
  • 邮件模板新增 ${更新vue包} 变量（按 .zip 后缀分组），已有模板不受影响。

1.3.8

  • 目标包列表取消过滤隐藏：不再按源产物类型 / 文件名隐藏未命中的包，FTP 上扫描到的全部 jar / war 和文件夹都完整显示，由你手动勾选要更新的目标；与源工程同名的包仍会默认勾选。勾选的同类型包（JAR 源勾 jar、WAR 源勾 war）都作为主目标直接更新，不再要求与源产物同名；JAR 源勾选的 war 仍是嵌入更新。
  • 修复系统目录下部分文件夹（及其中的包）在目标列表凭空消失的问题：扫描配额原按「条目数」计算，静态资源目录（如 Vue 前端解包后的数千个小文件）会把配额耗尽，导致字母序靠后的文件夹整个扫不到。现配额只计目录数、不计普通文件，shared-wms / timer-* 这类文件夹不会再因同级大目录而丢失。
  • 目标包列表改为按目录层级懒加载：选择系统后只读取根层（一次 FTP 请求），文件夹默认折叠、点开哪个才去 FTP 读取哪个，不再一次性递归扫描整个系统子树——大系统下加载明显变快，也不会再被深层大目录拖慢。展开过的层级会缓存，点「刷新」重新读取。勾选尚未展开的文件夹会自动加载其内容并全部勾选，保持「勾文件夹＝选中其下全部包」的语义。
  • 文件夹名称不再按「其中有没有包」置灰，样式统一。

1.3.7

  • 新增版本记录文件手动选择：目标包在远端目录里匹配不到对应的版本记录 txt 时，不再静默按标准命名新建，改为弹窗让你从该目录已有的 txt 里选一个（本次记录追加到该文件末尾），或修改文件名新建一个，也可直接取消本次更新；避免与目录里命名差异较大的已有记录文件形成两份。弹窗在预检阶段弹出，此时远端还没有任何写入，取消无副作用；手动指定的文件在回滚时也能精确找回并回退记录。
  • 统一全插件弹窗风格：按钮位置交给 IDE 排列，与 IDE 自身弹窗一致，不再出现「取消在前」「确定在前」并存；回滚、删除账号、不备份直接更新这类不可逆操作默认聚焦「取消」，回车不会误触发；按钮文案统一为动词短语（确认执行 / 确认回滚 / 开始打包 / 删除账号），不再出现系统英文 OK / Cancel；弹窗宽度、边距、说明文字风格全部拉齐。
  • FTP 登录框重做为标准弹窗，并补上端口号数字校验——原来端口输入非数字会直接报错中断。
  • 修复 JAR 源默认勾选的目标包所在目录不自动展开的问题：命中的同名包在嵌套目录（如 TMS-V9.0.0-P11/shared-tms）里时，现在会自动展开到该包，不必再逐层手动点开；原先只有 WAR 源有这个行为。
  • 修复 IDE 未内置或未启用浏览器内核（JCEF）时的一连串报错：打开部署工具窗口弹「Unhandled exception in EDT」、「使用手册」「版本记录」空白或报错、「通知邮件」编辑器直接抛异常中断。现改为安全探测——文档页自动回退到内置渲染，内容照常查看（内核初始化中途失败也会回退）；邮件编辑器改为弹窗提示，引导开启 ide.browser.jcef.enabled 后重启 IDE 再用。
  • 本地打包确认弹窗不再列出「编译项目」步骤（插件已不触发编译），只列实际执行的步骤；「Note 文件冲突」弹窗标题统一为「版本记录文件冲突」，与其他位置叫法一致。

1.3.6

  • 新增 CSV 行级增量更新：增量更新 initdata CSV 时不再整份覆盖，只把本地未提交的改动行（新增 / 修改 / 删除）同步到目标包对应行，新增行按本地文件中的位置插入；目标包里其他人尚未提交 Git 的行数据不会再被覆盖丢失。重复执行更新不会产生重复行。
  • CSV 业务主键自动识别：从工程内 tablefieldlist 字段清单自动解析每张表的主键列（支持复合主键），仅用于定位本次新增 / 修改 / 删除行；插件不再对 CSV 重复内容做校验或告警。
  • 无法按行合并的场景自动退回原有整份覆盖并在日志说明原因（文件无 Git 变更记录、表头结构不一致、识别不了业务主键、编码异常等），更新流程不中断。
  • 更新日志新增每个 CSV 的合并摘要：新增 / 替换 / 删除行数与保留的目标包行数。
  • 修复回滚安全性问题：新包已上传后部署失败，回滚不再出现"提示成功但远端实际未还原"——有备份时用备份覆盖还原，无备份时先删除新包再还原锁包，两者都没有时如实报告需人工处理。
  • 回滚业务包时同步回退版本记录 txt：按原始字节还原（保留原编码），本次新建的直接删除，不再出现包已回退但版本记录还停留在新内容的不一致。
  • 修复版本记录文件重名冲突时部署中断却不回滚的问题：命中多个候选版本记录文件现在会正确触发回滚，不再在远端残留锁包和新包。
  • 修复部署已成功、仅清理锁包失败时被误判为失败并错误回退新版本的问题：删除锁包失败自动重试 3 次，仍失败按"部署完成 + 告警"处理，残留锁由下次部署自动清理。
  • 编译产物过期检查收紧：源码修改时间等于编译产物时间也判为需要重新编译，防止上传未重新编译的旧文件。
  • 低分辨率屏幕适配：「执行操作」与「运行日志」两栏支持一键联动折叠成细条，给源工程与部署目标列表腾出高度，折叠状态重启后保持记忆。
  • 界面字号跟随 IDE 全局字体设置缩放，高分屏下卡片与图标同步高清缩放；窄面板下提示文字自动省略、悬停可查看完整内容；修复邮件模板弹窗可被重复打开多个的问题。
  • 修复编辑器中未保存的修改不进包的问题：点击「执行更新」或本地打包时自动先保存所有未保存的文件，避免 Git 面板显示有变更、实际打进包的却是改动前的旧内容。
  • 目标包列表完整显示目录结构：更新 jar / war 包时，包仍按原规则过滤隐藏，但目录不再跟着一起消失——FTP 上有哪些目录就列哪些，其中没有可部署包的目录置灰且不可勾选，不会再出现「看到的目录与 FTP 实际结构对不上」的错觉。
