idea-plugin.name: Kubernetes Control Center
idea-plugin.description:
Kubernetes with a Human Face

Finally, a Kubernetes tool that makes sense.

Tired of cryptic error messages? Confused by YAML hell? Overwhelmed by kubectl commands? Kubernetes Control Center is designed for developers who want to understand their clusters, not fight with them.

Why Developers Love It:

  • Problem Detection: Automatically finds issues and explains them in plain language
  • External Validators: Plug in Polaris, kube-linter, kube-score, Trivy, or Kubesec for deep config analysis
  • Works on Community Edition: No Ultimate license required
  • Lightweight: Fast and responsive, won't slow down your IDE
  • Real-time Updates: See changes as they happen via Kubernetes Watch API
  • Search Everywhere: Press Double Shift to find any resource instantly

Everything You Need:

  • Resource Explorer: Browse 40+ resource types in a clear hierarchy
  • Live Logs: Stream container logs in real time
  • Terminal Access: Shell into containers directly from IDE
  • Port Forwarding: Access your services locally with one click
  • Multi-cluster: Switch between clusters and namespaces effortlessly
  • Helm, Argo CD, Flux CD & CloudNativePG: See application health, reconciliation and owned resources in one place

Quick Access:

  • Double Shift — Search any resource instantly
  • Delete — Delete selected resource
  • Right-click — Context menu with all actions
  • Configure custom shortcuts in Settings → Keymap → Kubernetes

Pro Features:

  • Application Details: Open Helm, Argo CD, Flux CD and CloudNativePG inspectors for deeper status, revision and resource analysis
  • Multiple Kubeconfig Files: Combine separate kubeconfig sources in one project; one file with all its contexts stays free
  • Nginx Ingress Controller: View nginx.conf and debug routing

Supported Resources:

Pods, Deployments, Services, Ingresses, ConfigMaps, Secrets, Jobs, CronJobs, StatefulSets, DaemonSets, PVCs, RBAC, NetworkPolicies, HPAs, CRDs, and 30+ more.

Actively maintained and updated weekly. Your feedback shapes our roadmap. meanmail.dev

Keywords:

kubernetes, k8s, container, docker, devops, cloud, helm, argocd, cluster, pod, deployment, service, namespace, kubectl, microservices, orchestration, containerization
idea-plugin.change-notes:
14.0.0 (3 Sep 2026)

  • Keep Helm, Argo CD, Flux CD and CloudNativePG discovery, health, reconciliation, live updates and application-tree navigation free at the same level. Opening their detailed inspectors is now a Pro feature.
  • Use one kubeconfig file with any number of contexts for free. Combining separate kubeconfig files in one project is now a Pro feature.
  • See Flux, Argo CD and CloudNativePG reconciliation changes appear in Applications without clicking Refresh. Access failures stay visible per integration, while pausing auto-refresh still keeps the latest cluster state ready for resume.
  • Keep authenticated kubeconfig contexts working during live updates: bearer credentials now carry into resource watches, and access denied for one resource type no longer marks the whole cluster unreachable.
  • Improve JSON and YAML parsing reliability, including upstream fixes for input-limit enforcement when processing manifests and validation results.
  • Inspect CloudNativePG databases in Applications: see readiness, primary and instance counts, then browse owned resources by type. Databases deployed through Helm, Argo CD or Flux stay under their existing application without duplicate workload groups.
  • Recognize Flux CD groups and applications by their Flux logo in light and dark themes, with reconciliation status still visible beside it.
  • Inspect Flux Kustomizations and HelmReleases in Applications: see reconciliation status, revision and linked cached resources without changing the cluster. Manager-owned workloads no longer create duplicate label groups, linked Flux/Helm managers are nested, and Full is now the default view. Remote or unavailable membership is shown explicitly.
  • Find Helm, Argo CD, Flux CD and CloudNativePG at the top of Applications, followed by label-based groups with Deployments, StatefulSets, Pods and other types grouped separately. Refresh and switch between Simple and Full views without losing expansion or surviving selection. Unlabelled or ambiguous workloads remain explicitly Ungrouped; resource actions and status icons stay available.
  • Keep your place while the resource tree updates: expanded and collapsed branches, selected entries and scroll position stay stable across live and manual refreshes, including groups, favorites and special sections. Removed entries do not switch your selection to another resource.
  • Use container terminals reliably: closing a tab cancels its connection, connection errors remain readable, Unicode output stays intact, and terminal applications follow window resizing. Missing shells are retried only when the server confirms they are unavailable.
  • Fix resource loading failing when a Service uses a named target port and has no ready endpoints. Endpoint diagnostics now show both named and numeric target ports correctly.
  • Manage multiple kubeconfig files directly from the Kubernetes toolbar and choose only the contexts you need from each. Selections persist per project; duplicate names remain independent, and removing an active context never silently switches clusters.
  • Scan workload health with distinct lifecycle icons and compact resource names. Concise qualifiers show zero replicas, partial readiness or rollout, and failure reasons. Hover for complete plain-language details, also available to screen readers, with existing diagnostics close at hand.

13.0.0 (1 Aug 2026)

  • Add an Auto-refresh toggle to the Kubernetes tool window toolbar: pause live tree updates to read or click resources on busy clusters, then resume to instantly see the latest state (remembered per project)
  • Remember the last selected Kubernetes context and namespace per project and restore them when the tool window reopens
  • Show a clear status message (authentication failed, cluster unreachable, connection timed out) instead of a raw stack trace when resource loading fails
  • Search Kubernetes contexts in the tool window by typing part of their name — filters the picker by case-insensitive substring so a kubeconfig with dozens of clusters stays usable from the keyboard
  • Automatically reconnect the live resource watch after a dropped connection (network blip, API server restart, token refresh) using exponential backoff — the tree keeps updating without a manual refresh, and the status bar shows "Reconnecting…" while it recovers
  • Handle an unreachable cluster gracefully: when reconnection keeps failing (API server down, VPN off, expired credentials) the tool window clearly says the cluster is unreachable and keeps the last-known tree visible instead of blanking it, offers a one-click "Retry now", and recovers automatically once the connection returns
  • Customize the resource tree: hide the resource categories you do not use from a toolbar checklist and show them again anytime — the choice is remembered per project and re-showing a category brings it back instantly from cached data without a cluster reload
  • Mark individual resources as favorites from the right-click menu: pinned resources appear in an always-on-top "Favorites" section of the tree so the handful you actually watch stays in view even on busy clusters — the choice is remembered per project and favorites still show up even when their original category is hidden
  • Fix the "cluster unreachable" banner lingering after switching from an unreachable cluster to a working one: the banner and connection status now follow the currently selected cluster
  • Scale and restart workloads straight from the tree's right-click menu: set a new replica count for a Deployment, StatefulSet, ReplicaSet, or ReplicationController, or trigger a rolling restart of a Deployment, StatefulSet, or DaemonSet — with confirmation and validation, applied through the bundled Kubernetes client so no kubectl or terminal is needed
  • Fix the resource tree in "All Namespaces" mode: nodes are now matched by namespace and name across live refreshes, so resources that share a name in different namespaces stay as separate entries (and are shown as "namespace/name") instead of being merged, and your selection and expanded/collapsed state are preserved on every refresh

12.0.0 (15 Mar 2026)

  • Add pluggable external validators: Polaris, kube-linter, kube-score, Trivy, Kubesec
  • Add settings page to configure validators with binary path selection and version check
  • Batch validation: run each validator once for all resources via multi-document YAML
  • Show detailed validation progress with validator name, resource count, and step counter
  • Cache validation results to skip unchanged resources
  • Add export problems to JSON for reporting and CI integration
  • Show notification banner when no external validators are configured
  • Replace built-in static config checkers with external validators, keep runtime and cross-resource checks

11.0.0 (5 Feb 2026)

  • Add "What's Wrong?" panel with human-readable problem explanations and fix suggestions
  • Add "Learn more" documentation links to all problem types
  • Show actual values in diagnostics (image names, memory limits, termination reasons)
  • Add security checkers: RunAsNonRoot, ReadOnlyRootFilesystem, PrivilegeEscalation, HostNamespace, DockerSock
  • Add best practice checkers: StartupProbe, LatestTag, AntiAffinity
  • Fix cluster switching to immediately show correct data instead of stale data
  • Fix Problems panel to filter by current cluster
  • Allow plugin to work during IDE indexing (DumbAware)

  • Overview tab: multi-source apps now display each source as a collapsible section

1.1.5

  • History tab: collapsed consecutive syncs to the same revision into expandable groups, so re-syncing no longer floods the timeline
  • History tab: rollback button now shows an explanatory tooltip when Auto-Sync is enabled instead of silently being disabled

1.1.4

  • Improved server form handling and validation

1.1.3

  • Fixed error when connecting to server with no applications

1.1.2

  • Fixed server configuration form not updating correctly and improved overall form synchronization
  • Simplified configuration workflow by using standard IntelliJ OK/Apply with added input validation
  • Improved HTTPS handling with proper certificate trust and prompts

1.1.1

  • Pricing now displayed in USD to match JetBrains Marketplace billing

1.1.0

  • Now developed and tested against IntelliJ IDEA 2026.1
  • Updated Kotlin to 2.3.20
  • Remains compatible with IntelliJ IDEA 2025.3+

1.0.2

  • Fixed "Upgrade to Pro" button not clickable in Terminal tab
  • Updated marketplace URLs

1.0.1

1.0.0 - Initial Release

GitOps Cockpit for Argo CD brings full Argo CD management directly into your IDE.

Free Features

  • Connect to your Argo CD server with secure token authentication
  • View all applications with real-time health and sync status
  • Browse Kubernetes resource tree with expand/collapse navigation
  • View resource details, manifests, and events
  • Search and filter applications
  • Open applications in Argo CD web UI
  • SSL/TLS support including self-signed certificates

Pro Features

  • Multi-Server Support - Manage multiple Argo CD instances
  • Sync with Options - Prune, force, dry-run, server-side apply, and more
  • Rollback - Revert to any previous deployment revision
  • Auto-Refresh - Automatic status updates with smart change detection
  • Diff View - Compare live vs desired manifests with IntelliJ's diff viewer
  • Exec into Pods - Interactive terminal sessions via kubectl
  • Bulk Operations - Sync or refresh multiple applications at once
  • Favorites - Pin important applications to the top of your list
  • Deployment History - View deployment timeline with revision details
  • Status Notifications - Get notified when apps go out of sync or unhealthy

idea-plugin.name: AWS Cognito Quick-Admin
idea-plugin.description:
Manage AWS Cognito User Pools directly from all major JetBrains IDEs (PyCharm, IntelliJ IDEA, WebStorm, etc.). This plugin provides a comprehensive GUI for administrative tasks on AWS Cognito User Pools, making development, testing, and debugging fast and simple. Supports multiple languages (English, Spanish, Chinese, German, French, Italian, and Portuguese), dynamically adapted to your IDE or OS settings.

Key Features:

  • Multi-Language Support (i18n): Dynamically adapted interface in English, Spanish, Chinese, German, French, Italian, and Portuguese.
  • User Management: List users, enable/disable accounts, reset passwords, confirm signups, edit user attributes, and create new users. Supports standard/custom attributes dynamically, custom password config, invitation controls, and true/false combo editors for attribute verification flags.
  • Token Generation Tool ("Get Tokens"): Programmatically retrieves ID, Access, and Refresh tokens for any user to simplify API testing. Includes built-in password validation warnings, automatic API fallback (between AdminInitiateAuth and InitiateAuth), visual show/hide password toggles, and administrative password override options.
  • Bulk User Deletion: Safe deletion of single users or bulk user selections, requiring written confirmation ("confirm" or "delete") to authorize bulk operations.
  • Group Memberships: Manage group lists, precedence, descriptions, associated IAM Role ARNs, and user memberships.
  • App Clients: View client details, read client secrets, and edit Allowed Authentication Flows and read/write schema attribute access permissions via Swing controls.
  • User Pool Duplication (Cloning): Clone existing User Pools including schema settings, password policies, app clients, user groups, and Lambda triggers.
  • Safety-First Deletion: Safe deletion of user pools requiring console-like confirmation (typing the exact Pool Name or ID to authorize).
  • Tabbed Overview & Inline Editing: Segmented view (Basic Info, Auth Settings, Integration) with inline editing support for mutable attributes like Pricing Tier (Lite, Essentials, Plus), MFA Configuration (OFF, ON, OPTIONAL with SMS/TOTP switches), and Cognito subdomains.
  • Authentication Methods Dashboard:
    • Configure email settings (Cognito default sender vs. Amazon SES integration, region selector, and verified identities dynamic autocomplete).
    • Configure SMS settings (SNS Role ARN, masked/editable External ID with IAM Trust Policy copy utility).
    • Set password policy constraints (complexity, length, temporary password validity).
    • Manage WebAuthn Passkeys (Relying Party domain setup with automatic LITE tier restriction checks).
  • User Migration & Transfer Wizard: Migrates users between different User Pools with pre-flight schema compatibility checks and three distinct modalities:
    • Direct API Migration: Programmatically transfers users into the destination pool (with custom rate delay options).
    • CSV Export: Generates an import-ready CSV file compatible with the official Cognito User Import tool.
    • Lambda & IaC Generator: Generates seamless migration Lambda triggers (JS, TS, Python) and templates (Terraform, AWS SAM, AWS CDK) for password-authenticated migration on-the-fly.
  • Double-Confirmation Dialogs: Prevents accidental changes to production pools with confirmation modals.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
v2.8.0 (Official Production Release)
  • Compatibility Patch: Resolved a FileSaverDescriptor compatibility crash (NoSuchMethodError) affecting older IDE versions (2024.1, 2024.2, 2024.3).

v2.6.0 (Official Production Release)
  • JetBrains 2026.2 Compatibility: Certified compatibility and updated build target to support JetBrains 2026.2 (build 262.*) across the entire supported IDE family.

v2.4.0 (Official Production Release)
  • Token Generation Tool: Added "Get Tokens" feature directly in the user list to generate ID, Access, and Refresh tokens for API testing using a password.
  • Show/Hide Password Option: Added a password visibility eye toggle button next to the password input field.
  • Bypass Password Override: Added "Change Password & Generate" action allowing developers to change a user's password and fetch their tokens in a single click.
  • Fallback Auth Flows: Automatically falls back from AdminInitiateAuth (ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH) to InitiateAuth (USER_PASSWORD_AUTH) based on client allowed flows.
  • App Client Allowed Auth Flows: View and edit Allowed Authentication Flows (ALLOW_ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH, ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH, ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH, ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH, ALLOW_CUSTOM_AUTH) directly in the Edit Client dialog.
  • Reordered main Tool Window: Reordered main panel sections (Manage Cognito -> AWS Connection -> User Pool Information) for better readability.
  • Swing Layout Bug Fixes: Solved layout wrapping bugs in Users list bottom buttons using a Grid layout, preventing buttons from clipping on narrow screens.
  • Clean Production Logging: Disabled debug logs writing on local files in production environments.

v2.0.0 (Official Production Release)
  • Complete Internationalization (i18n): Added official localization support for English, Spanish, Chinese, German, French, Italian, and Portuguese.
  • Dynamic Localization Adaptability: Dynamically resolves user-facing strings based on active JetBrains IDE language packs or system default JVM locale, falling back safely to English for unsupported settings.
  • Comprehensive UI Translations: Localized every view, dialog, table columns, tooltips, loading/progress notifications, migration tools, and delete wizards.
  • Bug Fixes: Resolved all remaining resource bundle property validation errors in the user migration dialog and the bulk deletion wizard.

v1.4.0 (Official Production Release)
  • Create User Wizard: Added new user creation panel with pre-populated standard attributes and dynamic custom attribute insertion.
  • Sign-In Context Adaptability: Dialog auto-detects user pool sign-in configurations. If email/phone sign-in is enforced, the username field is automatically hidden from UI and mapped internally.
  • Advanced Credentials & Invitations: Configures custom/random passwords, toggles welcome message emails/SMS, and enforces password permanence (CONFIRMED status) with UI-level mutual exclusion checkboxes.
  • Bulk User Deletion: Multiple user selection can now be deleted in bulk, requiring written confirmation ("confirm" or "delete") to proceed.
  • Reliable User Pool Cloning: Automatically strips 'custom:' prefixes from custom attributes during cloning to bypass AWS Cognito validation constraints.
  • MFA Updates Fixes: Preserves existing SNS IAM Role and External ID during MFA changes. Automatically omits configuration blocks when disabling MFA to prevent schema conflicts.

v1.3.0 (Development Release)
  • User Pool Cloning: Added wizard to duplicate User Pools, with schema filtering to omit system-managed attributes, copying groups, app clients, and Lambda triggers.
  • Safety-First Deletion: Added safe teardown option requiring console-like confirmation by typing the Pool Name or ID.
  • Tabbed Overview Panel: Reorganized overview into Basic Info, Auth Settings, and Integration tabs.
  • Inline Attribute Editing: Added inline edit dialogs for Pricing Tier (LITE, ESSENTIALS, PLUS), MFA Configuration (mode and SMS/TOTP factors), and Cognito subdomains.
  • Verification Dropdowns: Integrated boolean true/false dropdown editors for user email/phone verification flags in the user attributes table.

v1.2.0 (Official Production Release)
  • Stable Pagination & Searches: Implemented control blocking to prevent race conditions during rapid pagination/search, and integrated a native visual loading indicator (AsyncProcessIcon).
  • Phone Number Searches: Added support for searching and filtering users by phone number prefix (triggers directly when starting with '+' or as a numerical fallback when no username is matched).
  • Enhanced Email Queries: Upgraded email searches to support prefix/partial matching even when the query string contains '@' (replacing the previous strict exact-match behavior).

v1.1.0 (Sandbox Development Release)
  • Authentication Methods Dashboard: Adds detailed configurations for Email, SMS, Password Policy, and WebAuthn (Passkeys).
  • Dynamic SES Integration: Splits SES settings into distinct region, identity, sender name, and configuration set inputs. Queries real-time verified SES identities and configuration sets into ComboBox dropdowns dynamically.
  • SMS Security Guardrail: Masks SMS External ID by default and blocks editing until unmasked. Displays a warning banner with copyable cross-account IAM Trust Policy JSON if edited.
  • WebAuthn Plan Check: Detects User Pool tiers and restricts Passkey configuration on the LITE plan with visual warnings.
  • Double-Confirmation Dialog: Added confirmation modal before applying user pool modifications to AWS Cognito.
  • App Client Attribute Checklist: Edit client read/write schema permissions via Swing checklists.
  • Attribute Creator: Supports adding standard or custom attributes dynamically from a list inside the user editor dialog.
  • IDE Compatibility Fix: Widened compatibility to support PyCharm 2026.1 environments (build 261.*).

idea-plugin.name: DeployX
idea-plugin.description:
DeployX - All-in-one remote deployment tool with SSH server management, file sync, auto backup, remote extraction, command execution and terminal integration.

  • 🖥️ Server management: password/key SSH authentication, connection test, config cloning
  • 📁 Directory mapping: local/remote mapping with unique IDs
  • 🔄 Smart transfer: rsync first with AUTO/RSYNC_ONLY/SFTP_ONLY; auto fall back to SFTP
  • 📤 Batch upload: multi-file merged transfer with relative paths
  • 🚀 One-click deploy: auto backup, upload, extract, execute commands
  • 💾 Auto backup: backup before deployment, selective file package
  • 📦 Auto extract: unzip remote files after upload
  • 📜 History: per-server logs, history rollback and redeploy
  • 🖥️ SSH terminal: protocol-level auth opens remote terminal
  • 📚 Script library: reusable remote SSH commands with parameters, context interpolation and safety checks
  • 🆕 Remote file browser: browse, edit and download remote files in a sidebar tree; drag-and-drop upload/download; edit in IDE with Ctrl+S auto-sync; "Open in Terminal" integration (new in v1.0.5)
  • 🛑 Abort: click "Abort" during deploy/sync/download/push/preview to immediately stop the current operation - destroys the rsync subprocess / drops the SSH channel and skips remaining batch groups (new in v1.0.6)
  • 📂 Local server: a new "Local" server type incrementally copies current-project files to a local directory via the mapping's target dir - the production-incremental-file-update scenario, no SSH needed (new in v1.0.6)
  • 🗂️ Mapping project view: a "Project / All" toggle in the mapping settings; Project view (default) shows only mappings belonging to any open project (new in v1.0.7)
  • 📂 Remote browser path dropdown: first open now lists the configured mapping remote dirs for the current server, so you can jump to them without typing (new in v1.0.7)
  • ⚡ Remote browser speed: short-TTL directory-list cache (cache hit skips the SFTP round-trip; refresh bypasses the cache) and synchronous fill on cache hit - directory switching is noticeably faster (new in v1.0.7)

全能型远程部署工具 - DeployX：一站式远程部署、自动备份、远程解压、文件同步、SSH 终端集成。

  • 🖥️ 服务器管理：支持密码/密钥 SSH 认证，支持连接测试与配置复制
  • 📁 目录映射：本地/远程目录映射，唯一 ID 管理，名称允许重复
  • 🔄 智能传输：rsync 优先，支持 AUTO / RSYNC_ONLY / SFTP_ONLY；自动降级 SFTP
  • 📤 批量上传：多文件合并传输，保持相对路径
  • 🚀 一键部署：自动执行备份、上传、解压和前后置命令
  • 💾 智能备份：部署前自动备份，支持选择文件打包备份
  • 📦 自动解压：上传后可按配置自动解压压缩包
  • 📜 日志历史：按服务器拆分日志，历史记录可回溯、重新部署
  • 📚 脚本库：可复用的远程命令片段，支持参数化、上下文插值与危险确认
  • 🖥️ SSH 终端：一键打开远程服务器终端，协议层认证真正免密登录
  • 🆕 远程文件浏览器：侧边栏树形浏览/编辑/下载远程文件；支持拖拽上传/下载；IDE 编辑器 Ctrl+S 自动回写；右键「在终端中打开」（v1.0.5 新增）
  • 🛑 终止功能：部署/同步/下载/推送/预览过程中可点击「终止」按钮立即停止当前操作，销毁 rsync 子进程/断开 SSH 通道并跳过剩余批次（v1.0.6 新增）
  • 📂 本地服务器：新增「本地」服务器类型，按映射目标目录将当前项目文件增量更新到本地指定目录，用于投产增量文件更新，无需 SSH（v1.0.6 新增）
  • 🗂️ 映射项目视图：映射设置新增「项目 / 全部」切换，项目视图（默认）只展示属于任一已打开项目的映射（v1.0.7 新增）
  • 📂 远程浏览器路径下拉：首次打开即列出当前服务器已配置的映射远程目录，无需手输即可快速跳转（v1.0.7 新增）
  • ⚡ 远程浏览器提速：短 TTL 目录列表缓存（命中跳过 SFTP 往返、刷新绕过缓存）+ 缓存命中同步填充，目录切换更流畅（v1.0.7 新增）
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Changelog

v1.0.7 - Mapping Project View & Remote Browser Speedup

  • 🗂️ Mapping Project View: The mapping settings now have a "Project / All" toggle. Project view (default) shows only the mappings belonging to any open project (a mapping belongs to a project when its local dir equals or is under a project's base path); "All" shows every mapping - the previous behavior. Useful when many mappings are configured and the list gets cluttered
  • 📂 Remote Browser Path Dropdown: On first open the path dropdown used to contain only the current path (usually /). It now also lists the configured mapping remote dirs for the current server, so you can jump to a configured remote directory in one click without typing. Mapping dirs are shown after the path history; only dirs you actually enter are recorded into the history
  • ⚡ Remote Browser Directory-Switch Speedup: Switching directories felt slow. Two optimizations:
    • Short-TTL directory-list cache: BrowserSession caches directory listings for ~5s keyed by path; a cache hit returns instantly and skips the SFTP ls round-trip. Active refresh (refresh button / right-click refresh / path change) bypasses the cache; uploads / new-dir / delete invalidate the affected path so stale entries are never shown
    • Synchronous fill on cache hit: When the cache is hit, child nodes are filled synchronously on the EDT, skipping the Task.Backgroundable scheduling + invokeLater round-trip - the tree expands instantly
  • 🐛 Project View Missing Current Project's Mappings: Fixed the project view taking openProjects.lastOrNull() as "the current project", which could pick the wrong one (the array order is not guaranteed to be most-recently-active), so the open project's mappings were not shown. Now matches any open project - the current project always matches
  • 🐛 Stale "Loading..." Placeholder After Expand: Fixed the 1.0.7 initial fine-grained optimization using treeModel.nodesWereInserted, which did not notify the JTree to remove the old placeholder child, leaving a "Loading..." row after expanding a directory until a manual refresh. Reverted to treeModel.reload(node) (matching 1.0.6's verified behavior)
  • 🐛 Right-click Refresh Collapses the Directory: Fixed right-click refresh / upload / new-dir using removeAllChildren + treeModel.reload(node) losing the subtree expansion state and auto-collapsing the directory. New refreshNodePreservingExpansion helper records expanded paths before refresh and restores them after; delete now uses nodesWereRemoved to avoid collapsing siblings

v1.0.6 - Abort & Local Server

  • 🛑 Abort Deploy/Sync: Click the "Abort" button during deploy / sync / download / push / preview to immediately stop the current operation. A new DeployCancelToken propagates through UI -> DeployService -> TransferService -> RsyncWrapper/SftpTransferClient. Hard-abort semantics: immediately destroys the running rsync subprocess (Process.destroyForcibly()) or drops the SSH command channel, and skips remaining batch groups. rsync/SFTP/local-copy loops all have cancel checkpoints; already-transferred files are kept, half-transferred files are auto-fixed by the next incremental sync. The operation panel gains an "Abort" button (enabled while a task runs, auto-disabled on completion); the progress label shows "Aborted"
  • 📂 Local Server (Production Incremental Update): Server config gains a "Local" type (ServerType.LOCAL) for incrementally updating current-project files to a local directory - the production-incremental-file-update scenario. Reuses the mapping's remoteDir as the local target dir (one local server can map to multiple target dirs). New LocalTransferService does incremental copy via java.nio.file.Files (size + mtime, matching rsync semantics) with exclude rules, dry-run and cancel-token support. TransferService dispatches LOCAL servers to local copy; DeployService skips all SSH steps for LOCAL servers. Server-edit dialog adds a Type dropdown (LOCAL hides host/port/user/auth); server table adds a Type column; mapping-edit browse button switches to a local directory chooser for LOCAL servers. Guards: RemoteFileBrowserService/TerminalService reject LOCAL servers with a friendly message
  • 🛠 Cancel Signal Through Transport Layer: RsyncWrapper (4 execution points) and SftpTransferClient (upload/download/dry-run) add a cancelToken parameter, check cancellation in their read loops, and on DeployCancelledException destroy the process / drop the channel and return an "aborted" result
  • 🛠 launchCancelableTask Helper: FileSyncToolWindowPanel extracts a generic helper unifying cancel-token lifecycle and abort-button enable/disable across all 11 background tasks, removing boilerplate
  • 🛠 ServerConfigDeserializer Backstop for type: Parses the new type field (missing/null/invalid falls back to SSH), avoiding a repeat of the 1.0.3 NPE regression; 4 new test cases cover it
  • 🐛 Server Dropdown Not Refreshing After Add: Fixed the operation-panel target-server dropdown not updating after adding/editing/deleting a server in Settings - the refresh button didn't work either, requiring an IDE restart. ServerManager now has a change-listener mechanism (addChangeListener) that notifies open tool-window panels to refresh the combo on the EDT in real time
  • 🐛 Auto-jumping to Log Tab Hides Abort Button: Fixed appendLog forcing tabbedPane.selectedIndex = 1 on every log line during upload/deploy, hiding the abort button and progress bar on the operation tab. Auto-jump removed; logs append in the background, users switch tabs manually
  • 🐛 IDE Progress-Window Cancel Button Ineffective: Fixed Task.Backgroundable passing canBeCancelled=true but never checking ProgressIndicator.isCanceled, so clicking the cancel button in the IDE's built-in progress window couldn't stop a task. launchCancelableTask now runs a daemon thread polling indicator.isCanceled and triggers cancelToken.cancel() on cancel - equivalent to the Abort button
  • 🐛 Add/Copy Server Not Validating ID Uniqueness: Fixed adding or copying a server with an existing ID saving successfully, causing an ID conflict. ServerEditDialog.doValidate now checks ServerManager.getServer for duplicates in add/copy mode (when the ID is editable), blocking the save with a "server with this ID already exists" message
  • 🎨 Abort Button Relocated to Progress Area: Moved the Abort button from the action-button row to the progress panel (bottom of the operation tab), so it stays visible alongside the progress bar regardless of tab focus

v1.0.5 - Remote File Browser & Rollback

  • 🔄 Deployment Rollback: One-click rollback to previous version for mappings with backup enabled. Rollback button appears in history for deploy records with backups, with full confirmation dialog and progress tracking. All rollback operations are logged in history with full reports
  • 📂 Remote File Browser: Browse remote server file systems in a sidebar tree (DeployX Remote tool window, right side dock). All operations are non-modal — browse remote files while editing local projects
  • 👀 View: Lazy-loaded directory tree with file size, modification time and icons; switch servers, path navigation with per-server history (up to 20 entries, jump / delete individual / clear all), create/delete directories, refresh
  • 📝 Edit: Double-click a remote text file to open it in the IDE main editor with full syntax highlighting; Ctrl+S automatically writes changes back to the remote server; files over 5MB are rejected with a download suggestion
  • ⬆️ Upload: Drag local files/directories from the project view or OS file manager onto the browser tree to upload to the target remote directory
  • ⬇️ Download: Right-click to download files/directories with a progress dialog; or drag remote entries from the tree to the project view to download directly
  • 🎯 Auto-map & Remember: First open auto-locates the remote directory by matching the current project path against configured mappings; each server's last-opened directory is remembered across sessions
  • Persistent SFTP channel with auto-reconnect and automatic I/O retry. Accessible via right-click menu, Alt+Shift+Z quick menu, and the folder button in the DeployX operation tab. Full bilingual (English / 简体中文) support
  • 📝 Script Editor Reuse: Migrated all script/command editing UIs from Swing native components (JBTextArea + hand-written LineNumberGutter) to the IDEA platform EditorTextField, with syntax highlighting, line numbers, code folding, current-line highlight and automatic theme adaptation. Fixed Enter key triggering the OK button in dialogs, multi-line paste collapsing to one line, and Tab key being swallowed by focus traversal
  • 🗑️ Removed LineNumberGutter: Deleted the hand-written LineNumberGutter.kt — the platform editor's built-in gutter fully replaces it
  • 🔐 SSH Key Permission Fix: Fixed key authentication failing in file sync/deploy with Permissions 0644 for 'xxx' are too open when terminal works fine. Root cause: the terminal uses JSch (doesn't check file permissions), while rsync uses system ssh (OpenSSH enforces strict key permissions). Fix: auto-detects overly-permissive key files, creates a temp copy with correct 0600 permissions, uses it for transfer, then cleans up. Users don't need to manually fix key file permissions anymore
  • 🐛 Update Report Mis-detects GLIBC/Library Errors: Fixed dynamic-library error lines printed by the remote shell or toolchain (mise/asdf etc.) due to missing GLIBC versions (e.g. /lib64/libc.so.6: version 'GLIBC_2.18' not found (required by ...)) being misclassified as transferred files by isFileTransferLine, inflating the report's "total files" count and listing the error message under "actually updated files". Added substring-based diagnostic filtering (not found, required by, glibc, libc.so, shared object, etc.). Further switched the default rsync options to use --out-format=::%n:: delimited output to precisely identify transferred-file lines, eliminating stderr misclassification at the source; falls back to heuristic parsing when no delimited line is present (custom rsync options / SFTP backend)
  • 🐛 Meaningless Backup File Names: Fixed backup files being uniformly named backup_{timestamp}.tar.gz with no indication of what was backed up. Now named with the backed-up file/dir name (last segment of the first relative path, truncated) + _bak + date, e.g. updates_bak_20260712_025456.tar.gz; multiple files use xxx_nfiles_bak_{timestamp}.tar.gz
  • 🐛 Missing _bak_ in Backup Names: Fixed doBackup naming tar.gz backups of directories/non-compressed files without the _bak_ identifier ({name}_{timestamp}.tar.gz), inconsistent with other backup branches. Also fixed double-extension archives (e.g. foo.tar.gz) being split incorrectly into foo.tar_bak_...gz
  • 🐛 Backup Path Returns Directory Instead of File: Fixed doBackup returning the backup directory path (instead of the specific backup file path) on success, causing the update report's "backup location" to show only the directory and rollback's test -f check to fail. Now consistently returns the specific backup file path
  • 🐛 Clear History Button Icon Misleading: Fixed the History tab "Clear" button using a history icon (AllIcons.Vcs.History, a clock) whose semantics contradict "clear all history" and is easily mistaken for "view history". Changed to the trash icon (AllIcons.Actions.GC); also replaced the top "Clear Log" button's custom gray icon with the platform AllIcons.Actions.GC so its color adapts to the theme and matches the rest of the toolbar
  • 🛠 Large File Split: Reduced single-file complexity without changing any public API - extracted BackupService (backup/unzip logic), ReportBuilder (pure report-group builder), RemotePathUtils (shared path joining), and UiButtonFactory (stateless button/action factories) from DeployService / FileSyncToolWindowPanel; cleaned up the unused rsyncWrapper field
  • 📦 History Persists Transferred Files: HistoryRecord now stores the rsync actually-transferred file list (transferred_files) as structured data (previously only in the report string), so history details can show exactly which files changed during an incremental sync; backward-compatible with old records (defaults to empty list)
  • 🎨 History Button Spacing Unified: Removed the elastic HorizontalGlue between buttons; all button gaps are now fixed (3px between action buttons, 6px before the clear button) for consistent, predictable spacing
  • 👀 History Details as Popup Dialog: Replaced the always-on right-side detail panel (JSplitPane, which took up horizontal space and couldn't be closed) with a HistoryDetailDialog popup triggered by double-clicking a record or the new "View Detail" button; shows the updated-file list and key info, closes on dismiss. The history panel is back to a single-column list layout

v1.0.4 - SSH Key Export & New Features

  • 🔑 SSH Key Export/Import: When exporting encrypted config, if any servers use SSH key authentication, users are prompted whether to include encrypted key files in the export. On import, key files are automatically decrypted and saved to the local keys directory (~/.deploy-x/keys/), with server key paths updated to point to the local files. If the user chooses not to export key files, only server config is exported (key paths preserved but content not included)
  • 🐛 Config Import Lost Server Passwords: Fixed an issue where imported servers had an empty password in memory after config import, causing SSH authentication to fail. The root cause was that ConfigExporter.importConfig passed server.copy(password = "") to ServerManager after saving the password to PasswordSafe / .passwords.dat, clearing the password from the in-memory ServerConfig. Now the full ServerConfig with password is passed through directly, and saveServers() continues to sanitize the password when writing servers.json, matching existing behavior
  • 📁 New Folder Button in Remote Path Chooser: Added a "New Directory" button in the remote path selection dialog (used in add/edit mapping and sidebar operations). Users can create directories directly on the remote server without switching to the terminal. After successful creation, the directory list is automatically refreshed and the new directory is selected.
  • 📏 Adaptive Server Dropdown Width: The target server dropdown in the add/edit mapping dialog now automatically adapts to the width of the longest server name, ensuring the server ID and name are fully visible without truncation.
  • 🔄 Bidirectional Sync (Pull from Server): New bidirectional incremental sync between local and remote files with auto-merge of differences. Right-click Pull from Server (or the Alt+Shift+Z quick menu) downloads only the files that differ on the remote to local. Uses rsync when available (transfers only changed files by size/mtime), with automatic SFTP fallback for recursive directory download
  • 🐛 rsync Pull Direction Reversed: Fixed Pull from Server in rsync mode generating a --files-from command that used the local dir as source and the remote dir as target, actually uploading instead of pulling. Command builders now swap source/target based on SyncDirection.PULL
  • 🐛 Unclear Pull Log: Fixed the download log reusing the "Preview group" header. The download group now uses a dedicated "Pull from Server group" header and prints direction, remote source dir and local target dir explicitly
  • 🐛 Alt+Shift+Z Missing Pull from Server: Added DeployX.PullFromServer to the Alt+Shift+Z quick menu (after Sync to Server)
  • 🐛 rsync Pull Directory Transfers 0 Files: Fixed pulling a directory/mapping-root (empty relative path) producing an empty --files-from entry so rsync transferred 0 files. Empty entries now do a full recursive directory pull; non-empty entries still use --files-from; both can be mixed and merged. SFTP fallback handles empty relative paths the same way
  • 🐛 History Tab Blank: Fixed the History tab showing blank after the tool window's first build (when HistoryManager wasn't ready). Now reloads latest records on each switch to the History tab, and shows a "No history yet" placeholder when empty
  • 🐛 Pull from Server not Recording History: Fixed "Pull from Server" (the download path of bidirectional sync) leaving no history entry after execution. Root cause: downloadBatch / processDownloadGroup only transferred files and never called HistoryManager.addRecord, and HistoryRecord.OperationType had no pull type. Added a PULL type and writes history on pull success/failure (only real pulls, not dry-run preview); the history summary shows "remote → local" for PULL; "redeploy" for a PULL record now re-pulls (remote → local); UpdateReportFormatter renders the new PULL operation type
  • 🐛 Sync to Server / Push to Server not Recording History: Fixed right-click "Sync to Server" / "Push to Server" leaving no history entry. Root cause: those paths go through uploadBatch → processUploadGroup, but history writing only existed in deployBatch's processDeployGroup. Added saveUploadGroupHistory (type = UPLOAD) inside processUploadGroup, writing on non-dry-run success/failure; preview (dry-run) explicitly does not write history
  • 🐛 History List Single-click Mis-jumped to Log Tab: Fixed single-clicking a history entry immediately jumping to the Log tab, preventing the entry from being selected. Root cause: addListSelectionListener triggered showHistoryDetail() on selection, whose appendLog switches to the Log tab. Changed to a MouseListener that only views details and jumps to the Log tab on double-click; single-click only selects, without affecting later "redeploy / copy report / fill config" operations
  • 🐛 Server Dropdown Too Narrow: Fixed the target server dropdown in the add/edit mapping dialog being clamped to the field width so server id/name were truncated. Now uses a wide popup (ComboBoxWithWidePopup) that expands to fit the longest entry instead of being limited to the input box width
  • 📖 "What's New" Settings Tab: Added a "What's New" tab to the DeployX settings page (right after "Script Library") showing the version changelog. It displays only the changelog for the current UI language (English in English mode, 简体中文 in Chinese mode), reusing a single changelog source shared with the plugin marketplace
  • 🐛 Settings Page Over-wide / Other Tabs Distorted: Fixed the settings page showing an extremely long horizontal scrollbar that also stretched and distorted the tables on other tabs (e.g. Script Library). Root cause: the "What's New" tab's HTML pane pushed an oversized preferred width into the tabbed pane. The tab now caps its preferred size so content scrolls only inside the tab and never widens the whole dialog

v1.0.3 - Transfer Enhancements & Multi-Server Deploy

  • 📋 History Report Copy/Export: Added "Copy Report" and "Export Report" buttons to the History tab - copy/export the Markdown report from any history entry (not just the latest one)
  • 🔍 SFTP Dry-Run Support: SFTP fallback mode now supports dry-run preview (listing files that would be uploaded without actual transfer). Preview sync works even without rsync installed
  • 🔄 Transfer Auto-Retry: Transfers now automatically retry up to 3 times (2s interval) on network/connection failures. Authentication failures and missing-path errors are not retried
  • 🔔 System Notifications: After batch upload/deploy completes, an OS-level notification is shown when the IDE window is not focused (Linux via libnotify, macOS via Notification Center, Windows 10/11 via PowerShell WinRT Toast), plus an IDE balloon is always shown. Configurable in settings. On Windows, replaced the platform SystemNotifications path (which uses the deprecated java.awt.TrayIcon balloon that silently fails when SystemTray.isSupported() returns false or AWTException is swallowed) with a reliable WinRT Toast notifier
  • ⚙️ General Settings Tab: Added a new "General" tab at the front of the DeployX settings page, consolidating language and the "system notification on transfer complete" toggle (previously buried in the rsync tab) into one place, ready for more general preferences to be added later
  • 🏷️ Server Groups & Tags: Servers now support a group field and comma-separated tags. ServerManager exposes getGroups()/getAllTags() for filtering
  • 📦 Config Import/Export (Encrypted): Export all plugin config (servers with passwords, mappings, scripts) to an AES-256-GCM encrypted JSON file. Import on another machine with password decryption; ID conflicts can be overwritten or imported as new
  • ⚡ Multi-Server Parallel Deploy: Server selection dialog now supports multi-select. When deploying to multiple servers, groups execute in parallel (thread pool, max 4 concurrent). HistoryManager is thread-safe
  • 🐛 Server List Empty Fix: Fixed an issue where users saw an empty server management page. The new group/tags fields were null in legacy servers.json, causing an NPE in server.copy() that silently wiped the server list. A ServerConfigDeserializer now backfills missing/null fields

v1.0.2 - Script Library & Windows rsync Enhancements

  • 📚 Script Export: Export now adapts to selection - exports all scripts when nothing is selected, and only the selected scripts (as a JSON array) when multiple are selected
  • 🗑️ Script Multi-Delete: Deleting now removes all selected scripts at once (previously only the first selected was deleted)
  • 📥 Script Import - Conflict Handling: On import, if a script id already exists, the user is prompted to either overwrite the duplicate or import all as new scripts
  • 🔐 SSH_ASKPASS Fallback: When rsync is present but sshpass is missing (common on Windows), password auth automatically falls back to the SSH_ASKPASS mechanism - no SFTP downgrade needed
  • ⬇️ rsync One-Click Download & Install (Windows): When rsync is not detected on Windows, a "Download & Install rsync" button appears in settings; it auto-downloads (GitHub releases, with China mirror fallback), extracts to ~/.deployx/rsync-win/, and configures the path automatically. On failure, manual download links are provided
  • 💡 First-Run rsync Install Prompt (Windows): On the first transfer with rsync missing, a dialog asks whether to auto-install. "Yes" downloads and installs; "No" remembers the choice and falls back to SFTP silently (never asks again). RSYNC_ONLY mode also degrades to SFTP after the user declines
  • 🪟 Windows rsync Optimization: Fixed rsync failing on Windows Cygwin builds:
    • Quote the ssh command passed to -e so it is not split incorrectly
    • Convert Windows drive paths (e.g. C:\Users\...) to Cygwin style (/cygdrive/c/Users/...) to avoid the drive letter being mistaken for a remote host
    • Use --files-from=FILE with a temporary file (auto-deleted after use) instead of stdin piping
  • 🐛 Windows rsync Password Auth Fix: Fixed exit code 12 / 0 bytes received when syncing with password authentication on Windows without sshpass (three root causes, all verified and fixed):
    • askpass script format: Minimal Cygwin rsync packages lack sh.exe; cygwin ssh invokes askpass via posix_spawnp which does not parse shebangs, so .sh scripts fail with No such file or directory. Switched to a .cmd askpass (@type "path") executed via cmd.exe /c
    • wrong ssh picked: rsync -e "ssh ..." resolved to the Windows native C:\Windows\System32\OpenSSH\ssh.exe instead of the Cygwin ssh, breaking SSH_ASKPASS compatibility. Now explicitly uses the ssh.exe next to rsync.exe
    • missing recursion: -a does not imply -r under --files-from, so selecting a directory only created empty subdirectories without transferring the files inside. Now always adds an explicit -r
  • 🐛 Directory Sync Fix (all platforms): Fixed selecting a directory and syncing only created empty subdirectories without transferring the files inside (same -a/-r root cause as above, affects Linux/macOS too)
  • 🐛 Update Report Fixes:
    • Fixed SSH diagnostic lines (e.g. Warning: Permanently added ...) being misidentified as transferred files in the report
    • Fixed rsync directory creation lines (ending with /) being misidentified as transferred files - report now lists only actual files, matching rsync's Number of regular files transferred
    • Fixed "Actually updated files" showing selected directories or unchanged files when 0 files were transferred (incremental skip) - now shows "No files changed" instead
  • ⚡ Multi-Server Batch Deploy: Support selecting multiple servers at the same time, files will be uploaded to all selected servers in parallel, greatly improving the efficiency of multi-environment deployment; the server selection dialog supports holding Ctrl/Shift for multiple selection, and the terminal also supports opening multiple server connections at the same time
  • 🎨 SSH Clean-up: Added -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null to suppress the Could not create directory '/home/<user>/.ssh' warning from Cygwin ssh on minimal installs
  • 🎨 Alt+Shift+Z Menu Fix: Fixed the quick menu popping up in the wrong IDEA window when multiple project windows are open - now uses guessBestPopupLocation(dataContext) for correct positioning
  • 🎨 Changelog Unification: Synced build.gradle.kts and plugin.xml changelog content - plugin marketplace now shows the full bilingual version

v1.0.7 - 映射项目视图与远程浏览器提速

  • 🗂️ 映射项目视图：映射设置新增「项目 / 全部」切换。项目视图（默认）只展示属于任一已打开项目的映射（映射的本地目录等于或位于某项目 basePath 之下即视为属于该项目）；「全部」展示所有映射--即 1.0.7 之前的行为。映射很多时不再杂乱
  • 📂 远程浏览器路径下拉：首次打开时下拉里原本只有当前路径（通常是 /）。现在会一并列出当前服务器已配置的映射远程目录，点击即可跳转，无需手输。映射目录排在路径历史之后；只有用户真正进入过的路径才会记入历史
  • ⚡ 远程浏览器目录切换提速：切换目录感觉偏慢，做了两处优化：
    • 短 TTL 目录列表缓存：BrowserSession 按路径缓存目录列表约 5 秒，命中即返回、跳过 SFTP ls 往返。主动刷新（刷新按钮 / 右键刷新 / 路径切换）绕过缓存；上传 / 新建目录 / 删除会失效对应路径缓存，不会展示陈旧内容
    • 缓存命中同步填充：命中缓存时直接在 EDT 上同步填充子节点，跳过 Task.Backgroundable 调度 + invokeLater 往返，树瞬时展开
  • 🐛 项目视图过滤不到当前项目映射：修复项目视图取 openProjects.lastOrNull() 作为「当前项目」可能选错（数组顺序不保证是最近激活顺序），导致当前打开项目的映射不展示的问题。改为匹配任一已打开项目，当前项目必然命中
  • 🐛 展开目录后残留「加载中...」占位节点：修复 1.0.7 初版用 treeModel.nodesWereInserted 做细粒度优化时，该事件不会通知 JTree 移除旧占位子节点，导致展开目录后占位「加载中...」行残留、需手动刷新才消失的问题。回退为 treeModel.reload(node)（与 1.0.6 行为一致，已验证可正确清除占位行）
  • 🐛 右键刷新导致目录自动折叠：修复右键刷新 / 上传 / 新建目录后用 removeAllChildren + treeModel.reload(node) 刷新节点时丢失子树展开状态、目录自动折叠的问题。新增 refreshNodePreservingExpansion 辅助方法：刷新前记录展开路径、刷新后恢复；删除节点改用 nodesWereRemoved 精确事件避免折叠兄弟节点

v1.0.6 - 终止功能与本地服务器

  • 🛑 终止部署/同步：部署、同步、下载、推送、预览过程中可点击"终止"按钮立即停止当前操作。新增取消信号载体 DeployCancelToken，贯穿 UI -> DeployService -> TransferService -> RsyncWrapper/SftpTransferClient。硬终止语义：立即销毁正在运行的 rsync 子进程（Process.destroyForcibly()）或断开 SSH 命令通道，并跳过批次中剩余分组。rsync/SFTP/本地拷贝循环均内置取消检查点；已完成传输的文件保留，半传文件由下次增量同步自动修复。操作面板新增"终止"按钮（任务运行时启用、完成后自动禁用）；进度标签显示"已终止"
  • 📂 本地服务器（投产增量更新）：服务器配置新增"本地"类型（ServerType.LOCAL），用于将当前项目文件增量更新到本地指定目录--投产增量文件更新场景。复用映射的 remoteDir 作为本地目标目录（一个本地服务器可对应多个目标目录）。新增 LocalTransferService：基于 java.nio.file.Files 实现增量拷贝（按大小 + 修改时间，与 rsync 语义一致），支持排除规则、dry-run 预览、取消令牌。TransferService 入口统一分流 LOCAL 服务器到本地拷贝；DeployService 对 LOCAL 服务器跳过所有 SSH 步骤。服务器编辑对话框新增"类型"下拉（LOCAL 隐藏 host/port/user/auth）；服务器表格新增"类型"列；映射编辑的"目标目录"浏览按钮对 LOCAL 服务器改用本地目录选择器。守卫：RemoteFileBrowserService/TerminalService 对 LOCAL 服务器禁用并友好提示
  • 🛠 取消信号贯穿传输层：RsyncWrapper（4 处执行点）、SftpTransferClient（上传/下载/dry-run）均新增 cancelToken 参数，在读取循环中检查取消状态，捕获 DeployCancelledException 时销毁进程/断开通道并返回"已终止"结果
  • 🛠 launchCancelableTask 统一任务生命周期：FileSyncToolWindowPanel 提取泛型辅助方法，统一管理 11 个后台任务的 cancelToken 创建/销毁与终止按钮启用/禁用，消除重复样板代码
  • 🛠 ServerConfigDeserializer 兜底 type 字段：新增 type 字段解析（缺失/null/非法值兜底为 SSH），避免 1.0.3 同款 NPE 回归；测试补充 4 个用例覆盖
  • 🐛 新增服务器后侧边栏下拉不刷新：修复在设置页新增/编辑/删除服务器后，侧边栏操作页的"目标服务器"下拉不更新、点刷新也无效、需重启 IDE 的问题。ServerManager 新增变更监听机制（addChangeListener），增删改后主动通知已打开的工具窗口面板在 EDT 上刷新下拉，实时同步
  • 🐛 执行中自动跳转日志页导致终止按钮不可见：修复 appendLog 每次写日志都强制跳转日志页，导致操作页的终止按钮和进度条不可见。移除强制跳转，日志后台追加，用户主动切换查看
  • 🐛 IDEA 进程窗口取消按钮无效：修复 Task.Backgroundable 设了 canBeCancelled=true 但从不检查 ProgressIndicator.isCanceled，导致点击 IDEA 自带进度窗口的取消无法终止任务。launchCancelableTask 新增守护线程轮询 indicator.isCanceled，检测到取消立即联动 cancelToken.cancel()，与"终止"按钮等效
  • 🐛 新增/复制服务器未校验 ID 唯一性：修复添加或复制服务器时输入已存在的 ID 会直接保存成功、导致 ID 冲突的问题。ServerEditDialog.doValidate 在新增/复制模式（ID 可编辑）下通过 ServerManager.getServer 检查 ID 是否已存在，重复时阻止保存并提示"已存在相同 ID 的服务器，请使用其他 ID"

  • 🐛 备份路径返回目录而非文件：修复 doBackup 成功后返回备份目录路径（而非具体备份文件路径）导致更新报告"备份位置"仅显示目录、回滚时 test -f 校验失败的问题。现统一返回具体备份文件路径
  • 🐛 清空历史按钮图标语义误导：修复历史标签页「清空」按钮使用历史图标（AllIcons.Vcs.History，时钟样式）导致语义与"清空所有历史记录"不符、易被误解为查看历史的问题。改为垃圾桶图标（AllIcons.Actions.GC）；同步将顶部「清空日志」按钮的自定义灰色图标替换为平台 AllIcons.Actions.GC，颜色随主题自适应，与工具栏其他图标风格统一
  • 🛠 大文件拆分：降低单文件复杂度，不改任何对外 API--从 DeployService / FileSyncToolWindowPanel 抽取 BackupService（备份/解压逻辑）、ReportBuilder（纯函数报告分组构建器）、RemotePathUtils（共享路径拼接）、UiButtonFactory（无状态按钮/Action 工厂）；清理未使用字段 rsyncWrapper
  • 📦 历史记录持久化实际传输文件：HistoryRecord 新增 transferred_files 字段，结构化保存 rsync 实际传输的文件路径（不再只存于报告字符串），增量同步时精确反映本次变更的文件；旧记录兼容（默认空列表）
  • 🎨 历史按钮间距统一：移除弹性 HorizontalGlue，按钮间距全部改为固定值（功能按钮间 3px、回滚/查看详情与清空间 6px），间距统一可预测
  • 👀 历史详情改为弹窗对话框：原右侧常驻详情面板（JSplitPane，占用水平空间且无法关闭）改为双击历史记录或点击「查看详情」按钮弹出 HistoryDetailDialog，展示更新文件清单与关键信息，关闭即消失；历史面板恢复单列列表布局

v1.0.4 - SSH 密钥导出与新功能增强

  • 🔑 SSH 密钥导出/导入：导出加密配置时，若存在使用密钥认证的服务器，会提示用户是否将密钥文件内容一并加密导出。导入到另一台机器时自动解密并保存到本地密钥目录（~/.deploy-x/keys/），服务器配置的密钥路径自动指向本地文件，无需手动复制密钥。若不选择导出密钥文件，仍按原有方式仅导出服务器配置（密钥路径保留但内容不导出）
  • 🐛 配置导入后服务器丢失密码修复：修复导入加密配置后，服务器密码在内存中丢失导致 SSH 连接失败的问题。根因：ConfigExporter.importConfig 在保存密码到 PasswordSafe / .passwords.dat 后，传给 ServerManager 的是 server.copy(password = "") 的副本，导致内存中的 ServerConfig.password 为空，SSH 密码认证失败。现已改为直接传入带密码的 ServerConfig，saveServers() 仍会在写入 servers.json 时清空密码字段，行为与现有逻辑完全一致
  • 📁 远程路径选择对话框新增新建目录按钮：在添加/编辑映射、侧边栏操作的远程路径选择对话框中，新增新建目录功能，支持直接在远程服务器上创建目录，无需切换到终端手动操作，创建成功后自动刷新目录列表并选中新目录。
  • 📏 服务器下拉列表宽度自适应：在添加/编辑映射对话框中，目标服务器下拉列表自动适配最长服务器名称的宽度，确保完整显示服务器ID和名称，避免内容截断。
  • 🔄 双向同步（从服务器拉取）：新增本地与远程文件的双向增量同步，自动合并差异。右键「从服务器拉取」或使用 Alt+Shift+Z 快捷菜单，可将远程与本地不同的文件拉取到本地；rsync 模式按大小/修改时间只传输差异文件，SFTP 降级时递归下载整个远程目录
  • 🐛 rsync 拉取方向反转：修复「从服务器拉取」使用 rsync 模式时，生成的 --files-from 命令把本地当源、远程当目标，实际变成上传。命令构建现在按 SyncDirection.PULL 动态交换源/目标
  • 🐛 拉取日志不清晰：修复下载日志误用「预览分组」标题。下载分组现使用独立的「从服务器拉取分组」标题，并明确打印方向、远程源目录与本地目标目录
  • 🐛 Alt+Shift+Z 菜单缺少「从服务器拉取」：已将 DeployX.PullFromServer 加入 Alt+Shift+Z 快捷菜单（位于「同步到服务器」之后）
  • 🐛 rsync 拉取目录/映射根时文件数为 0：修复选中目录/映射根（相对路径为空）时 --files-from 列表为空条目、rsync 实际传输 0 文件的问题。空项现走整目录递归拉取，非空项仍走 --files-from，二者可混合并合并结果；SFTP 降级模式同样处理
  • 🐛 历史 Tab 展示空白：修复侧边面板「历史」Tab 初次构建时因 HistoryManager 未就绪而加载空列表、之后一直空白的问题。现切换至历史 Tab 时自动重新加载最新记录，列表为空时显示「暂无历史记录」占位提示
  • 🐛 「从服务器拉取」不记录历史：修复「从服务器拉取」（双向同步的下载路径）执行后历史面板没有任何记录的问题。根因：downloadBatch / processDownloadGroup 只负责传输，从不调用 HistoryManager.addRecord，且 HistoryRecord.OperationType 没有拉取类型。现已新增 PULL 类型，并在拉取成功/失败后写入历史（仅实际拉取写，dry-run 预览不写），历史列表摘要对 PULL 显示「远程 → 本地」方向；历史「重新部署」对 PULL 记录改为执行「重新拉取」（远程 → 本地），更新报告 operationType 新增 PULL 渲染
  • 🐛 「同步到服务器 / 推送到服务器」不记录历史：修复右键「同步到服务器」「推送到服务器」执行后历史面板没有记录的问题。根因：这两条路径走 uploadBatch → processUploadGroup，而历史写入只存在于 deployBatch 的 processDeployGroup 中。现已在 processUploadGroup 内新增 saveUploadGroupHistory（type = UPLOAD），仅在非 dry-run 的实际同步/推送成功或失败后写入历史；预览（dry-run）明确不写历史
  • 🐛 历史列表单击误跳转日志页：修复在「历史」Tab 中单击某条记录会立即跳转到「日志」页签、无法单独选中的问题。根因：addListSelectionListener 在单击选中时就触发 showHistoryDetail()，其内部 appendLog 会切到日志 Tab。现改为 MouseListener 双击才查看详情并跳转「日志」页签；单击仅做选中，不影响后续「重新部署 / 复制报告 / 填充配置」等操作
  • 🐛 映射服务器下拉过窄：修复添加/编辑映射时「目标服务器」下拉框被输入框宽度钳制、服务器 id/名称显示不全的问题。现改用可超出输入框宽度的宽弹层（ComboBoxWithWidePopup），自动适配最长一项，不再被表单列宽截断
  • 📖 「版本更新说明」设置 Tab：在 DeployX 设置页「脚本库」之后新增「版本更新说明」Tab，展示版本更新日志。按当前界面语言只显示对应语言内容（英文模式显示英文、中文模式显示中文），更新内容与插件市场共用同一单一来源，无需多处维护。
  • 🐛 设置页横向滚动条过长/其他 Tab 表格变形：修复设置页出现超长横向滚动条、并导致「脚本库」等其他 Tab 表格被拉变形的问题。根因：「版本更新说明」Tab 的 HTML 面板推出了超大首选宽度。现已对 Tab 封顶首选尺寸，内容仅在 Tab 内部滚动，不再撑大整个对话框、影响其他 Tab 布局。

v1.0.3 - 传输增强与多服务器并行部署

  • 📋 历史记录复制/导出报告：历史记录 Tab 新增"复制报告"和"导出报告"按钮，可从任意历史记录复制/导出 Markdown 报告（不再仅限最新一次）
  • 🔍 SFTP 支持 dry-run：SFTP 降级模式现在支持 dry-run 预览（列出待上传文件而不实际传输），预览同步不再强制要求 rsync
  • 🔄 传输失败自动重试：传输失败时自动重试最多 3 次（间隔 2 秒），仅对网络/连接类失败重试，认证失败和路径不存在不重试
  • 🔔 部署后系统通知：批量上传/部署完成后，当 IDE 窗口未聚焦时弹出 OS 级系统通知，同时始终显示 IDE 气泡通知（可在设置中开关）。Linux 走 libnotify，macOS 走通知中心；Windows 10/11 改用 PowerShell 调 WinRT Toast API（稳定显示在通知中心），弃用平台 SystemNotifications 在 Windows 上走的 java.awt.TrayIcon 经典托盘气泡（已废弃、SystemTray.isSupported() 返回 false 或 AWTException 被吞掉时静默失败）
  • ⚙️ 新增「通用」设置 Tab：在 DeployX 主设置页最前面新增「通用」Tab，将语言设置和「部署后系统通知」开关（原埋在 rsync Tab 内）集中到一处，后续可继续扩展更多通用设置项
  • 🏷️ 服务器分组/标签：服务器新增分组字段和逗号分隔标签，ServerManager 提供 getGroups()/getAllTags() 用于过滤
  • 📦 配置导入导出（加密）：一键导出全部插件配置（服务器含密码、映射、脚本）为 AES-256-GCM 加密 JSON 文件，在另一台机器上用密码解密导入；ID 冲突可选覆盖或新增
  • ⚡ 多服务器并行部署：服务器选择对话框支持多选，部署到多个服务器时分组并行执行（线程池，最多 4 并发），HistoryManager 线程安全
  • 🐛 服务器列表为空修复：修复"服务器管理"页面看不到任何已保存服务器的问题。新增的 group/tags 字段在旧 servers.json 中为 null，导致 server.copy() 抛 NPE 并被静默吞掉、返回空列表。新增 ServerConfigDeserializer 对缺失/null 字段做兜底

v1.0.2 - 脚本库增强与 Windows rsync 优化

  • 📚 脚本导出优化：导出逻辑适配选中状态 - 未选中任何脚本时导出全部脚本，选中多个脚本时仅导出选中的脚本（JSON 数组形式）
  • 🗑️ 脚本批量删除：删除操作现在可一次性删除所有选中的脚本（此前只会删除选中的第一个）
  • 📥 脚本导入冲突处理：导入时若脚本 id 已存在，提示用户选择「覆盖重复项」或「全部作为新脚本新增」
  • 🔐 SSH_ASKPASS 密码认证回退：已安装 rsync 但缺少 sshpass 时（Windows 常见），密码认证自动回退使用 SSH_ASKPASS 机制，无需降级 SFTP
  • ⬇️ rsync 一键下载安装（Windows）：设置面板检测到未安装 rsync 时显示「一键下载安装」按钮，自动下载（GitHub releases，失败切换国内镜像）、解压到 ~/.deploy-x/rsync-win/、自动配置路径；下载失败提供手动下载链接
  • 💡 首次传输安装提示（Windows）：首次传输时未检测到 rsync 则弹窗询问是否自动安装。选「是」下载安装；选「否」记住选择并静默降级 SFTP（不再提示）。RSYNC_ONLY 模式下用户拒绝后也降级 SFTP
  • 🪟 Windows rsync 同步优化：修复 Windows Cygwin 版 rsync 同步失败的问题：
    • -e 后的 ssh 命令整体加引号，避免被错误拆分
    • Windows 盘符路径（如 C:\Users\...）转换为 Cygwin 风格（/cygdrive/c/Users/...），避免盘符被误识别为远程主机
    • --files-from 改用临时文件（使用完自动删除）替代 stdin 传入
  • 🐛 Windows rsync 密码认证修复：修复 Windows 无 sshpass 时密码认证同步报 exit code 12 / 0 bytes received 的问题（三个根因，均已实测验证修复）：
    • askpass 脚本格式：精简 Cygwin rsync 包不含 sh.exe，cygwin ssh 通过 posix_spawnp 调用 askpass（不解析 shebang），.sh 脚本因找不到 /bin/sh 报 No such file or directory。改用 .cmd 脚本（@type "路径"），由 cmd.exe /c 执行
    • ssh 来源错误：rsync -e "ssh ..." 用裸 ssh 时会找到 Windows 原生 C:\Windows\System32\OpenSSH\ssh.exe 而非 cygwin ssh，导致 SSH_ASKPASS 机制不兼容。改为显式使用 rsync.exe 同目录下的 ssh.exe
    • 缺少递归：-a 在 --files-from 模式下不会展开为 -r，选中目录同步时只创建空子目录、不传文件。现已显式补加 -r
  • 🐛 目录同步修复（全平台）：修复选中目录同步时只创建空子目录、不传输目录内文件的问题（同上 -a/-r 根因，Linux/macOS 同样受影响）
  • 🐛 更新报告修复：
    • 修复 SSH 诊断行（如 Warning: Permanently added ...）被误判为传输文件、拼成远程路径写入报告的问题
    • 修复 rsync 目录创建行（以 / 结尾）被误判为传输文件的问题 - 报告现在只列出实际传输的文件，与 rsync 统计 Number of regular files transferred 一致
    • 修复增量同步跳过所有文件（0 传输）时报告"实际更新的文件"回退到选中路径（含目录）的问题 - 现在显示"无文件变更"提示
  • 🎨 SSH 优化：新增 -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null，消除精简 Cygwin 环境下 Could not create directory '/home/<user>/.ssh' 警告
  • 🎨 Alt+Shift+Z 菜单修复：修复多个 IDEA 项目窗口时快捷菜单弹到错误窗口的问题 - 改用 guessBestPopupLocation(dataContext) 正确定位
  • 🎨 Changelog 统一：统一 build.gradle.kts 与 plugin.xml 的 changelog 内容，插件市场显示完整中英文双语版本

v1.0.1 - 国际化与体验优化

  • 🌐 国际化：完整的中英文双语界面支持
  • 🌐 语言切换：新增语言设置页面，支持免重启即时切换语言（English / 简体中文 / 跟随系统）
  • 🌐 动态刷新：切换语言后，所有 UI 文案立即刷新，包括工具窗口和对话框
  • 🌐 右键菜单：操作文案根据当前语言动态刷新
  • ✨ 新功能：新增 Alt+Shift+Z 快捷操作菜单，无需右键即可快速执行 DeployX 常用操作
  • ✨ 新功能：新增常用操作快捷键：
    • Alt+Shift+D / Alt+Shift+2：完整部署
    • Ctrl+Alt+Y：同步上传
    • Ctrl+Alt+Shift+P / Alt+Shift+3：快速推送
    • Ctrl+Alt+T / Alt+Shift+4：打开 SSH 终端
  • 🎨 优化：优化更新报告格式 - 上传目录时，显示目录下实际更新的文件（如 lib/api-base.jar），而非仅显示目录名
  • 🎨 优化：更新报告中显示备份文件的具体路径
  • 🎨 优化：增强 rsync 输出解析逻辑，精确识别文件名行，过滤进度信息和统计行
  • 🎨 UI 优化：调整右键菜单顺序，将 Deploy 移到 Sync 前面，更符合使用习惯
  • 🐛 修复：修复英文状态下语言设置菜单显示原始 key 的问题
  • 🐛 修复：修复打开设置页面时的 PluginException 异常

v1.0.0 - 初始版本

  • 🚀 首次公开发布

idea-plugin.name: Terragrunt Apply
idea-plugin.description:
Run Terragrunt commands straight from the Project view — no more cd-ing around your infrastructure repo.

Right-click a .tf/.hcl file or any folder and pick a command from the Terragrunt submenu:

  • Apply — terragrunt apply
  • Apply (source update) — terragrunt apply --source-update
  • Apply (auto approve) — terragrunt apply --auto-approve
  • Run all (apply) — terragrunt run --all apply
  • Plan — terragrunt plan
  • Run all (plan) — terragrunt run --all plan
  • Destroy — terragrunt destroy

Each command opens a fresh terminal tab named Terragrunt in the right directory: a file runs in its parent directory, a folder runs in itself. Run all variants recurse into every Terragrunt unit below the target directory, in dependency order.

Requires the terragrunt binary on your PATH. Works in any JetBrains IDE with the bundled Terminal plugin.

Also available for VSCode. Source, issues and contributions: GitHub.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.2
  • Plugin icon
0.1.1
  • New commands: Plan, Run all (plan), Destroy, Run all (apply)
  • Marketplace listing: full description and change notes
0.1.0
  • Initial release: Terragrunt submenu in the Project view with Apply, Apply (source update), Apply (auto approve)

idea-plugin.name: AWS Desk
idea-plugin.description:
AWS Desk

Browse and manage your AWS resources directly from your JetBrains IDE, using the AWS credentials and profiles already configured on your machine.

AWS Desk evolves continuously, and the set of supported services and features grows over time. For the current list of supported services, setup help, and answers to common questions, see the FAQ tab. For everything added, changed, or fixed in each release, see the Changelog tab.

Developed by ROUTE.MD.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
2026.0.0.3-beta

Adds two services (see the Changelog for details):

  • Lambda — functions, layers, and a local SAM + Docker runner.
  • ECR (read-only) — the container images backing image-based functions.

2026.0.0.2-beta

Maintenance release — replaces deprecated IDE APIs for compatibility with current and future IDE versions.

2026.0.0.1-beta

First Public Beta Release

Browse and manage your AWS resources from inside the IDE, using the AWS credentials and profiles already configured on your machine. This beta ships three services:

  • S3 — Browse the buckets owned by the account; create buckets (region, versioning, Block Public Access, KMS encryption); empty and delete buckets. Bucket explorer tab: list folders and objects, create/delete folders, upload (multipart above 10 MB) with drag-and-drop, download with reveal in the OS file manager, rename/move, multi-select delete, presigned URLs, and bucket/object metadata. Opt-in "Show deleted objects" to surface delete markers in versioned buckets, with per-object version history and restore.
  • CloudWatch Logs — Browse log groups and streams; open and read recent events; live-tail a group or stream in real time; view log-group tags; delete streams and groups.
  • IAM (read-only) — Browse users (with console / access-key / MFA summary), roles (with trust summary), groups, and policies; view and copy policy documents (pretty-printed, URL-decoded JSON), ARNs, and names; view policy versions and attachments; view role trust policies; open in the AWS console.

Destructive actions use a plain Yes/No confirmation. AWS gateway errors are logged locally to ~/.awsdesk/logs/awsdesk.log (log level configurable in settings). The plugin communicates only with AWS endpoints using your own credentials — no usage data is collected.

AWS Desk is a commercial plugin. License & EULA: https://route.md/awsdesk?license=1

idea-plugin.name: Terraform IAM Privesc Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Flags a Terraform aws_iam_role that can reach an admin-equivalent role through a real, whole-project AssumeRole trust chain -- not just an isolated wildcard statement in one resource, a genuine multi-hop privilege-escalation path (CWE-269), built by parsing EVERY .tf file in the project into a directed graph (role trust edges, managed/inline policy grants) and running a real BFS with cycle protection to the nearest admin-equivalent role -- the same graph-reachability idea PMapper applies to a live AWS account, applied statically to source before terraform apply ever runs.

Not a JSON parser -- jsonencode({...})'s argument is HCL map/list syntax, walked via brace/bracket balancing, same technique as this catalog's own Terraform IAM Wildcard Companion.

Stated honestly: v0.1 only resolves the direct HCL reference form (aws_iam_role.NAME.arn/.id/ .name) for both trust-policy principals and policy-attachment roles -- never a literal role name string, never an interpolated local variable, never a cross-account ARN with no matching in-project resource. A project with more than 300 .tf files skips whole-project analysis rather than risk hanging the IDE.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no network calls.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Changed

  • Corrected the plugin description: Cloudsplaining was listed next to PMapper as a tool that follows role-to-role escalation paths in a live AWS account. Only PMapper does that; Cloudsplaining flags escalation methods policy by policy and can also scan a policy file offline.

idea-plugin.name: K8s Label-Selector Exposure Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Flags a Deployment/Pod/StatefulSet/DaemonSet that is Service-exposed but NOT matched by any NetworkPolicy's Ingress-covering podSelector, even though NetworkPolicies exist elsewhere in the project -- the real, documented Kubernetes failure pattern where a team believes NetworkPolicy protects the namespace, but this specific workload silently falls outside every one of them.

Built on a real label-selector resolution index across EVERY YAML manifest in the project, implementing actual Kubernetes set-based selector semantics (matchLabels AND equality, plus matchExpressions with In/NotIn/Exists) -- never a substring/text match, and never bounded to one manifest.

Not a real YAML parser -- an indentation-based micro-scanner, same discipline as this catalog's other Kubernetes plugins, extended to walk nested key paths (spec.template.metadata.labels, spec.podSelector.matchExpressions).

Stated honestly: v0.1 treats the whole project as one flat namespace (an explicit metadata.namespace: isn't cross-checked -- the safe direction, never over-flagging); an unsupported selector operator (DoesNotExist) is treated as satisfied rather than guessed.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no network calls.

idea-plugin.name: Firebridge - Firestore Database Explorer
idea-plugin.description:
A powerful, native database explorer designed specifically for Google Cloud Firestore. Stop context-switching to your browser and bring the full power of the Firebase Console directly into your JetBrains IDE.

Key Features:

  • Native Editor Grid: View and manage your NoSQL collections in a lightning-fast, native tabular grid view.
  • Advanced Query Builder: Easily construct complex queries with WHERE, ORDER BY, and LIMIT clauses without writing a single line of code.
  • Explorer Sidebar: Seamlessly navigate your Firebase projects, databases, collections, and deeply nested subcollections.
  • Inline & JSON Editing: Edit primitive fields inline, or open the built-in JSON Document Editor for advanced manipulation of raw data.
  • Complex Type Support: Full native UI dialogs for safely editing complex Firestore types like GeoPoints, Timestamps, References, Arrays, and Maps.
  • Batch Operations: Stage multiple inserts, updates, and deletes simultaneously with visual change tracking, and commit them all at once.
  • Local Emulator Support: Safely develop against a local Firebase Emulator suite with clear visual safety indicators.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• New Feature: Added support for multiple database connections! You can now configure multiple Firestore connections in the setup dialog and associate your saved queries with specific connection IDs.
  • New Feature: Added new right-click context menu actions to quickly copy Document IDs, Collection Names, and Full Paths to your clipboard from the Explorer tree and JSON viewer.
  • UI Updates: Improved the native look of the Explorer Tree by removing legacy grey zebra striping, and added a 1-click "Open Collection" shortcut at the top of every collection node to quickly launch the Grid View.
  • Under the Hood: Improved anonymous telemetry by including IDE and OS context to better understand environment-specific usage patterns.
  • New Feature: Export your loaded grid data directly to CSV or JSON formats using the new Export button in the toolbar.
  • New Feature: Added support for Saved Queries! Save your frequent queries directly from the Grid Panel or by right-clicking a collection in the Explorer sidebar, and load them instantly.
  • New Feature: Added support for grouped OR where clauses in the Firestore query builder.
  • UI Updates: Added a pinned "Execute Query" button to the top of the Query Builder for faster workflow, and updated the grid to visually indicate that system columns (`_createTime`, `_updateTime`, `_subcollections`, `ID`) are read-only.
  • Bug Fixes: Fixed an issue where system columns were displaying incorrectly in the Select Columns popup, and resolved a bug where system columns could appear duplicated in the grid if a document contained custom fields with reserved names.

idea-plugin.name: Queue Studio for Amazon SQS
idea-plugin.description:
Look at your SQS messages without pushing them into the dead-letter queue. SQS has no peek: every look is a receive, and a few looks at a queue with a redrive policy quietly move its messages to the DLQ. Queue Studio tells you before each read what it will do, shows how many receives each message has left, holds what it read and gives it back at once when you are done.

Works with any AWS profile (SSO, assume-role, MFA) and with local emulators such as LocalStack, ElasticMQ or Moto, next to your code.

  • Read up to 10,000 messages at once, with receive counts, "left before DLQ", group and deduplication ids, attributes and pretty JSON; in a FIFO queue a held message holds back the rest of its group. Return All, or close the tab, and the messages are visible to consumers again.
  • On LocalStack, peek at messages without receiving them at all.
  • Redrive a dead-letter queue back to its sources or to any queue with a live progress, move or delete selected messages, and fix a message and resend it.
  • Search messages, export them to JSON and send them back from a file.
  • Send, purge, create and configure queues, including their dead-letter queue and max receives.
  • Publish to SNS topics and subscribe queues with the queue policy set up for you; filter policies are checked against SNS limits before they are sent.

Amazon SQS, Amazon SNS and AWS are trademarks of Amazon.com, Inc. or its affiliates; this plugin is an independent tool and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Amazon.

The plugin collects no data: it talks only to the AWS endpoints and emulators you configure.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.2 — description notes how a FIFO queue limits a read. Vendor contact is support@factodus.com.

1.0.1 — new plugin icon.

1.0.0 — first release: connections to AWS profiles and emulators, queue and topic tree, message reading with hold and receive counts, LocalStack peek, send, purge, move, resend, DLQ redrive, search, export and import, queue settings, SNS publish and queue subscriptions.

idea-plugin.name: IntelliCalc
idea-plugin.description:
A small calculator integrated in IntelliJ.

The calculator has three modes:

Simple
A simple calculator with just the basic functions
Scientific
A scientific calculator with more advanced functions
Expression
Allows to enter an expression containing variables.

Use it as a normal simple calculator (with advanced functions) or evaluate expressions directly from your editor. To evaluate an expression in the editor, simply select the expression and select Evaluate in the editor popup menu or simply press alt F8. Remember that when debugging a program, the alt F8 function will be bound to the "Evaluate Expression" action of the IntelliJ IDEA.

The expression mode knows math functions (add, subtract, sin, cos, acotan, ...), logical operators (||, !=, ...) and some special functions:

set()
will set a variable so it can be used in a calculation. Ex. set(x=2)[enter]2*x[enter]returns 4
clear()
Clears a stored variable. Ex. clear(x) will clear the variable x. Note that any calculation using x will fail until a new x has been set.
Awaiting suggestions to improve the calculator.

idea-plugin.name: Limited WIP
idea-plugin.description:
This plugin helps limit work-in-progress (WIP) by adding constraints to your normal workflow in IDE.

It has three main components (each one can be enabled/disabled):
  • Change size watchdog: shows notifications when current changelist size exceeds threshold
  • Auto-revert: automatically reverts current changelist after a timeout (the timer is reset after each commit)
  • TCR mode (test && commit || revert): you can only commit after running a test; if the test fails, current changelist is reverted; if the test passes, changes are automatically committed

Why?

  • focus on one thing at a time, make really small steps and commit as soon as you're done
  • practice various constraints as if you're at a code retreat
  • explore your limits and learn new refactoring, coding and problem solving techniques

See https://github.com/dkandalov/limited-wip for details.

idea-plugin.name: Darkyen's Time Tracker
idea-plugin.description:
Track the time spent on a project through a lightweight status bar widget.

Overview

  • Click the widget or start typing to start counting
  • Pauses the timer automatically when idle
  • Click timer widget for options
  • Git integration, inject the time it took to create the commit into the commit message

Features

  • Pause or stop after a given time of inactivity (clicking any buttons/keys or scrolling).
  • When returning after a period of inactivity and the counting is paused, short time durations are automatically counted in, long periods can be counted in manually through a message popup. The auto-count duration is configurable.
  • Start counting automatically when you type something, even when stopped. Configurable.
  • Pause the timer when you work on a different project within the same IDE process, useful when switching projects frequently. Configurable.
  • The time format on the widget is configurable using a simple but flexible template substitution. Includes clear documentation of the format, including examples of frequently requested formats.
  • Ability to inject the time it took to create a Git commit through a Git commit hook, using the same customizable time format. The time is appended at the end of the message, unless your template contains <#DTT#>, which is then replaced by the formatted time instead.
  • Reset the time (and the hidden Git counter time) manually through a button in settings or through an IDE action.
  • Manually adjust counted time.

Time is saved in IDE's workspace files, so it does not clutter the workspace directory.
idea-plugin.change-notes: • Fixed a rare issue present only when using git integration on Windows with git running in Linux (e.g. WSL)

idea-plugin.name: Sketch It!
idea-plugin.description:
SketchIt!


SketchIt@bitbucket.org | SketchIt@jetbrains.com | Author | Donate with PayPal

SketchIt! is a reverse-engineering plugin that generates UML diagrams from your code in the PlantUML format. For this reason, it works perfectly with plugin PlantUML integration (In its current version, it has only been tested with Java code)

Usage
To generate or refresh diagrams, nothing more simple; let's go to the Tools menu and select "Sketch It! (generate UML diagrams)"

Features
  • Generate a component diagram at the project root
  • Generate a light class diagram per module
  • Generate a detailed class diagram per package
  • Generate methods inside classes
  • Generate attributes inside classes
  • Generate inheritance relationships between classes
  • Generate association relationships between classes
  • Generate inner-classes relationships
  • Distinguish classes, abstract classes, interfaces, enumerations
  • Generate possible values for enumeration
  • Generate visibility for methods and attributes
  • Distinguish static methods and attributes

idea-plugin.name: Touch Typist's Completion Caddy

Adds option to disable auto-popup completions on a space to leave your already typed text as you intended.

Configure it in Editor > General > Code Completion settings (Preferences on OS X). Disable for all languages or only for languages in a configurable list.

idea-plugin.name: Quick Fix
idea-plugin.description:
Provides "Quick Fix" action to apply the top intention/inspection because life is too short to press "alt+enter, enter" when you already know it will do the right thing.

The best shortcut for "Quick Fix" is "F1" because it's a single key and located near "F2 - Next Highlighted Error". But you might need to un-assign "F1" from the "Context Help" action which is mostly useless anyway.

You can configure "Quick Fix" to re-prioritise intentions by using the "quickfix-plugin.intentionPriorities" key in IDE "Registry" (use "Main Menu -> Help -> Find Action..." and type "registry"). For example, "*;Introduce import alias;Introduce local variable" will push "Introduce import alias" and "Introduce local variable" inspections to the end of the "QuickFix" priority list, so they are less likely to be invoked. Another option is to disable inspection ("alter+enter, right" and choose "Disable").

Jumper moves your caret several lines at a time with a single keybinding. Define any jump size you like, bind keys to it, and hold them down to move through code like you would with the arrow keys, just several lines per step.

Jumps work almost everywhere in the IDE: the editor, project view, Gradle view, database view, and any other tree or list component.

Features

  • Any jump size, and as many different sizes as you want
  • Four actions per jump: up, down, and both with selection
  • Works in editors, trees, and lists across the whole IDE
  • Settings panel with integrated keybinding setup and a live overview of your bindings

Quick start

  1. Go to Settings/Preferences > Tools > Jumper Settings
  2. Enter a jump amount (for example 5) and click Add Jump
  3. Bind keys for the four actions (Up, Down, Up with Selection, Down with Selection)
  4. Use them anywhere in the IDE

idea-plugin.name: Insomniac
idea-plugin.description:
Prevents your system from sleeping while a long-running task is active in the IDE.

Too often I have started a full rebuild or an inspection run, went for coffee, and twenty minutes later when I came back: my laptop has gone into sleep mode and the task is only half finished. To prevent this from happening, I built this plugin. It detects tasks that are active for more than one-and-a-half minutes, and when it has found one, keeps the system awake. Zero user interface, just set it and forget it.

On the Mac NSProcessInfo is used to prevent sleep. On Windows the OS SetThreadExecutionState function is called. And on Linux the mouse is wiggled by one pixel (if you know of a better way, let me know or send a pull request).

idea-plugin.name: X509 Certificate
idea-plugin.description:
When you are working with an X509 Certificate, often times you want to easily obtain information about the certificate. With X509 Certificate, you can easily view some important information such as the certificate issuer, the subject DN, the dates of validity, SHA2 and SHA1 fingerprints. Additionally, if the subject DN contains a SERIALNUMBER, we show this information as well.
