idea-plugin.name: React Buddy
idea-plugin.description:
React Buddy helps developing applications based on React.js and related libraries. Provides component palettes for MUI (MaterialUI), Ant Design, Chakra UI, Mantine. Helps to create and use Storybook stories.

⚠️ Storybook in React Buddy is deprecated

JetBrains has released Storybook Connect, a more comprehensive solution for browsing, navigating, and generating stories, built with AI in mind. It adds a Storybook tool window with two-way selection sync, dev server control, one-click Storybook setup, and a storybook-connect CLI that analyses component props and generates missing stories. Learn more in the documentation.

The Storybook features in React Buddy are now officially deprecated and will be removed later. Please share requests and feedback in YouTrack.

Coding Assistance

  • Event handler generation
  • useRef generation
  • JSX lists generation (.map postfix completion, quick fix for array-like objects)
  • State generation
    • Intention to convert local variable to useState
    • Quick-fix to create state variable from non-existing symbol passed to a JSX prop
    • .state postfix completion
  • New component creation action
  • Live templates for React hooks
    • usest - useState
    • usee - useEffect
    • usec - useContext
    • userd - useReducer
    • usecb - useCallback
    • usem - useMemo
    • user - useRef
    • useih - useImperativeHandle
    • usele - useLayoutEffect
    • usedv - useDebugValue
  • Quick-fix for adding new props (TS declarations) straight from JSX
  • Intention to wrap a handler in useCallback(). Quick fix detecting missing deps (switched off when eslint integration enabled)
  • Intention to surround a JSX element with condition
  • Intention to wrap a functional component in React.memo()
  • Gutter icons designating React hooks and handlers

Interactive Component Preview

  • Preview the particular component, not the whole app
  • Navigate to the source code by clicking on any element in the preview
  • See component re-renders
  • Highlight selected component in the preview
  • Tested support for projects based on Vite, Next.js (10+) and Create React App

JSX Outline

  • Observe React components structure (JSX, hooks, handlers)
  • Navigate to/from the particular JSX element
  • Copy-paste and move JSX nodes
  • Add conditional rendering
  • Insert components from the Palette

Components Palette

Palette tool window activates when a tsx/jsx file is opened. Alternatively you can browse palette via code generation action (Alt + Insert / ⌘ N)

  • Observe available components/reusable blocks. Preview each component right in the IDE
  • Drag and drop components from the palette to the source code / JSX outline
  • Double click on the component to add it to the source code
  • Configure your own palette or use the predefined ones
  • We provide several ready-to-use palettes. The plugin detects supported libraries/versions and suggests to install the corresponding package:
    • MUI - @react-buddy/palette-mui demo
    • Ant Design - @react-buddy/palette-antd demo
    • Chakra UI - @react-buddy/palette-chakra-ui demo
    • Mantine (core + form) - @react-buddy/palette-mantine demo
    • React Intl @react-buddy/palette-react-intl demo

Component Inspector

  • View and search through selected element's properties
  • Change properties using visual components
  • Generate handlers

App Component Tree

  • View hierarchy of React application components
  • View paths of components used in (react router) routing

Storybook support (deprecated)

These features are superseded by Storybook Connect and will be removed in a future release.

  • Storybook components tool-window (displays stories defined inside the project)
  • Code generation by Storybook stories (d'n'd from the tool window / use code generation action)
  • Intention to create a story for React component
  • Live templates for story creation (story6, story7)
  • CSF 3 (Storybook 7) support
  • MDX format support

Ant Design support

  • Visual designer for Antd Form.Item validation rules

Quick Start

Open any file containing React components. In order to use preview functionality @react-buddy/ide-toolbox dependency should be added and some configuration should be done in the project. The plugin will suggest to add all required files automatically.

See the documentation to configure the preview manually.

Requirements

The plugin supports projects based on React.js (16.5+) and preact. Better experience is provided for TypeScript-based projects.

Find us at

react-buddy.com
twitter.com/reactbuddy
discord

idea-plugin.name: Agent Code Notes
idea-plugin.description:
Agent Code Notes — the ultimate knowledge management plugin for JetBrains IDEs, now integrated with Code Agents. Capture code notes, pin notes to symbols, and browse AI-generated Markdown with symbol navigation. Instead of letting AI coding agents flood your project with hundreds of scattered Markdown files, store everything in a centralized, searchable knowledge base that stays inside your IDE.

All in One: Symbol Code Notes, Visual Markdown Editor, Markdown Symbol Preview. SQLite local storage or Git-friendly Markdown folder sync. Works across all JetBrains IDEs (IDEA 252+).

📝 Agent Code Notes

Add notes and bookmarks without altering source code, now you can save your AI agent chat content directly into code nodes, just say:Save the answer to Code Notes. Or create from the JetBrains IDEs' editor with Alt+M, from the gutter right-click menu, or from the Alt+Enter intention after selecting code — the note renders in place.

  • Skills for the agent to interact with Code Notes, usage guide here: https://github.com/beansoft/code-notes-skill/blob/main/README.md
  • Save on the fly while typing or editing titles
  • Attachments management with image thumbnail view
  • Notes on read-only class files and library sources
  • Speed search across all notes
  • Virtual folder tree navigation + full-size editor mode
  • Same fragments shared across multiple running IDEs on one machine (IDEA / WebStorm / Android Studio / …)
  • Syntax highlighting for 300+ file types via TextMate bundles
  • Favorite code notes straight from the editor
  • Project-level notes with relative-path linking — portable across machines, backup/restore project bookmarks to XML for VCS sync (Git / SVN)

🤖 AI Skill — MCP Toolset for Claude Code / Agents 🆕 2026.2

Plugin ships an MCP toolset (NotesMcp) that exposes your notes to AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Cline, and any MCP-capable client) through the JetBrains MCP bridge. Ask the agent in natural language — English or Chinese — and it routes to the right tool automatically.

Exposed tools:

  • search_code_notes_title — fast title search across all notes, snippet results with line/column coordinates
  • create_code_note — create a plain note or a TODO item (checked/unchecked), optionally into a folder by UUID, with language/type tag (markdown/java/kotlin/…)
  • update_code_note_content — replace an existing note's body by UUID
  • view_current_symbol — resolve the symbol under the caret in the focused editor (class / method / field / variable), return shortName, qualifiedName, language, file path, line, and PinNote protocol:pinText
  • add_note_to_current_symbol — create a note bound to the caret symbol via PinNote protocol, so it survives file moves and renames independently of the global "pin to symbol" setting

Bundled Claude Code skill — a plugin skill file routes natural-language triggers ("my notes", "save this snippet", "note this method", "我的笔记", "记下来", "给这个类加笔记") to the right MCP tool. Drop it into your Claude Code / Agent skills directory and the agent picks up notes commands with zero configuration.

📌 Symbol Notes — Pin to Symbol 🆕 2025.2

Link notes to a programming-language symbol — class, field, method — instead of the absolute line number. Notes stay attached when symbols move inside the file or when you pull updated source from VCS.

  • Supported languages: Java, Kotlin, PHP, TypeScript, C#
  • Gutter icons render at the symbol's current location
  • More languages coming in future releases
  • Docs: Pin to Symbol

🎨 Markdown Symbol Preview (2026.2) 🆕

Native Swing-based Markdown editor. Symbol jump, Instant rendering, split-screen preview. Best companion for reading AI-generated Markdown docs.

  • Switch on at Settings | Tools | Code Notes | MD Symbol Preview
  • No external Markdown plugin required
  • Handles code symbols, tables, code blocks, outlines
  • Supports main programming languages:Java, Kotlin, PHP, TypeScript and Python.

Storage

Local (SQLite) — offline-first. Nothing leaves your machine. Single notes.db file, easy to back up with any file-sync tool or USB stick.

Git Storage(beta) — offline-first. Lets you store your code notes as markdown files in a local Git repository instead of a closed SQLite database.

Evernote sync — store and sync notes with Evernote (internet required). View clipped web pages and image attachments without leaving the IDE. Ignore pictures option for faster load. Click Refresh in the Evernote tool window after editing in the Evernote app. Details: Sync with Evernote.

Editor

Built by a developer, for developers. All major languages plus 300+ via TextMate bundles. Full Markdown / AsciiDoc / IDEA Mind Map / Mermaid / PlantUML integration.

  • Reader mode
  • Line numbers
  • Jump to referenced source file
  • Run code scratches (Java only, disable Reader Mode first)
  • Third-party language extensions: Scala, Rust, and more

Navigation

Smart display of linked source file paths. Keyboard navigation — Up/Down to move, Enter or double-click to open, Esc to return to main editor.

Tool Windows

iScratch (main notes panel) and Evernote (sync panel), both bottom-anchored. Add/remove virtual folders, create fragments in any language the IDE supports.

Notes is under active development. Issues and suggestions welcome.

Chinese Documents Below 中文说明文档

Agent 代码笔记 (Agent Code Notes) — JetBrains IDE 上的终极知识管理插件，现已集成 Code Agents。记录代码笔记、将笔记固定到符号、浏览带符号导航的 AI 生成 Markdown 文档。与其让 AI 编码助手在你的项目里散落上百个零散的 Markdown 文件，不如把所有内容集中存储到 IDE 内的可搜索知识库中。

All in One：符号代码笔记、可视化 Markdown 编辑器、Markdown 符号预览。支持 SQLite 本地存储或 Git 友好的 Markdown 文件夹同步。适配全线 JetBrains IDE (IDEA 252+)。

📝 代码笔记

无需修改源代码即可添加笔记和书签，现在还可以把 AI Agent 的对话内容直接保存到代码笔记中，只需说一句：把答案保存到 Code Notes。也可以在 JetBrains IDE 的编辑器中按 Alt+M、通过编辑器行号区域右键菜单，或选中代码后按 Alt+Enter 触发意图创建 — 笔记会直接在编辑器中实时显示。

  • 供 AI Agent 与代码笔记交互的 Skill，使用指南： [https://github.com/beansoft/code-notes-skill/blob/main/README.md](
  • 实时保存：编辑内容或修改标题时自动保存
  • 附件管理及图片缩略图浏览
  • 支持只读的库文件或 Java 类文件直接添加笔记
  • 极速搜索：快速找到你所需要的代码
  • 虚拟文件夹树结构 + 全屏编辑模式
  • 同一台电脑上多个运行中的 IDE (IDEA / WebStorm / Android Studio 等) 共享同一份代码笔记
  • 通过 TextMate 包支持 300+ 种编程语言的语法高亮
  • 从编辑器中一键收藏代码笔记
  • 项目级别笔记：所有笔记使用相对路径存储，可同步至不同电脑并保持关联到当前项目；项目书签支持备份/恢复为相对路径的 XML 文件，可通过 Git / SVN 等 VCS 同步

🤖 AI 技能 — 面向 Claude Code / AI Agent 的 MCP 工具集 🆕 2026.2

插件内置 MCP 工具集 (NotesMcp)，通过 JetBrains MCP 桥把你的笔记暴露给各类 AI 编码助手 (Claude Code、Cursor、Cline 等所有支持 MCP 的客户端)。用中文或英文自然语言提问即可，AI 会自动路由到对应工具。

已暴露的工具：

  • search_code_notes_title — 按标题快速全库搜索，返回带行列坐标的片段结果
  • create_code_note — 新建普通笔记或 TODO 项 (可选已完成/未完成)，可指定目标文件夹 UUID 和语言类型 (markdown / java / kotlin 等)
  • update_code_note_content — 按 UUID 替换已有笔记的正文
  • view_current_symbol — 解析当前编辑器光标所在的符号 (类 / 方法 / 字段 / 变量)，返回短名、全限定名、语言、文件路径、行号，以及 PinNote 的 protocol:pinText
  • add_note_to_current_symbol — 通过 PinNote 协议将笔记绑定到光标处的符号，即便文件被移动或重命名笔记也不会丢失，且不受全局"固定到符号"设置的影响

内置 Claude Code 技能 — 插件自带 skill 描述文件，把中英文自然触发词 ("我的笔记"、"记下来"、"给这个类加笔记"、"my notes"、"save this snippet"、"note this method") 直接路由到对应的 MCP 工具。放入 Claude Code / Agent 的 skills 目录即可零配置识别笔记指令。

📌 符号笔记 — 固定笔记到符号 🆕 2025.2

自研首发，遥遥领先！支持链接笔记到编程语言的符号 — 类、变量、方法(函数) — 而非固定链接到源代码的绝对行号。当符号在类文件中移动、或者从 VCS 拉取更新后，笔记仍完美显示在正确位置。

  • 已支持语言：Java、Kotlin、PHP、TypeScript、C#
  • 编辑器行号区图标始终跟随符号当前位置渲染
  • 未来版本将支持更多编程语言
  • 文档：固定笔记到符号

🎨 Markdown 符号预览 🆕 2026.2

遥遥领先！基于原生渲染的 Markdown 阅读器。支持代码符号跳转、即时渲染和分屏预览模式。阅读 AI 生成的 Markdown 文档的最佳搭档。

  • 在 设置 | 工具 | 代码笔记 | MD 符号预览 中启用
  • 无需额外安装第三方 Markdown 插件
  • 支持代码符号、代码块、表格、大纲视图
  • 支持主流编程语言:Java, Kotlin, PHP, TypeScript和 Python。

B 站视频介绍：IDEA超好用的代码笔记插件 - Notes, 国产插件就是牛

存储方式

本地存储 (SQLite) — 离线优先，数据安全。使用 SQLite 模式时不会有任何数据被发送到网络，可备份并复制同步单个 notes.db 文件，可使用任何第三方同步网盘或者 U 盘备份。

Git 存储（测试版）— 离线优先，数据安全。让你可以将代码笔记作为 markdown 文件存储在本地 Git 仓库中，而不是二进制的 SQLite 数据库。

同步到 Evernote / 印象笔记 — 所有代码笔记会存储并同步到 Evernote 或印象笔记 (需要联网)。无需离开 IDE 即可浏览通过浏览器剪藏功能收藏的网页，正确显示富文本和图片。在 Evernote 应用中修改内容后，请记得在开发工具的 Evernote 工具窗口中点击 刷新 按钮。可设置忽略图片以提升加载速度。详情：Evernote 同步。

编辑器

程序员开发，为了程序员。支持所有主流编程语言，外加 300+ 种编程语言的语法高亮 (通过 JetBrains IDE 内置的 TextMate 包)。完整支持 Markdown / AsciiDoc / IDEA Mind Map / Mermaid / PlantUML 插件集成能力。

  • 阅读器模式
  • 显示行号
  • 跳转到引用的源代码文件
  • 直接运行代码片段 (仅支持 Java，需要先禁用阅读器模式)
  • 第三方语言扩展：Scala、Rust 等

导航

智能显示笔记链接的源文件路径，支持键盘导航 — 使用上下箭头切换条目，按下回车键或双击条目打开链接的文件，按 ESC 键从工具窗口返回主编辑器。

工具窗口

代码笔记 (主笔记面板) 和 Evernote (同步面板)，均锚定在 IDE 底部。可手工添加/删除虚拟文件夹，创建和修改任意类型的编程语言代码笔记和代码片段。

代码笔记仍处于持续开发中，欢迎提出问题或者建议！

为庆祝简体中文版的发布，国内用户加 QQ 群 150453653，新用户立享 5 折优惠并不定期送一年免费优惠码。

Notes Changelog

Check out the full list of the latest version 👉 changes and updates 👈

2026.2.0

🆕New

  • Brand new code markdown reader for reading AI generated doc;
  • Integrate to JetBrains MCP Server, now support Agents to save/query/update notes;
  • All notes DB now migration to UUID;
  • Support notes folder: drag-and-drop move.
  • Support full-text search of the title and code;
  • Support TODO notes creation/edit;
  • Support import code notes from other notes in the SQLite db;
  • Support edit note's modified date;
  • Support batch move/delete/restore notes;

🪲Fixed

  • When creating a new note, the note tree focus always moved to all notes.

2026.1.0

🆕New

  • Support pin notes to TypeScript symbol.

🪲Fixed

  • Markdown note: copypasted images are saved in the project root directory #84.

2025.3.1

🆕New

  • Support pin notes to PHP symbol.

2025.3.0

🆕New

  • Quickly save JetBrains AI Chat session to code notes(Requires restart of the IDE after AIA installation and a valid AIA subscription)
  • Remember state for turn off pin notes to symbol function when creating notes(Issue #85)

🪲Fixed

  • Fix Unable to open Choose symbol dialog when the path value is invalid (Issue #87)

  • 再次遥遥领先: 支持固定笔记到 Kotlin 符号 功能!

2025.2.1

🪲Fixed

  • Exceptions under IDE 2025.1.3 version which caused settings lost.

2025.2.0

🆕New

  • 自研首发, 再次遥遥领先: 支持固定笔记到 Java 符号 功能!
  • Support IDEA 2025.2 EAP.

✅Improved

  • Remove internal API usages.

2025.1.0

🪲Fixed

  • Exceptions under IDE 2025.1 EAP.

  • Quickly hide the notes folder and note area to fit the notes tool window into the left or right.

  • Drag and drop to resort the note list in a folder.

2024.2.1

🆕New

  • Browser-based Visual Markdown editor, Support WYSIWYG, instant rendering and split-screen preview mode. You can switch markdown editor in IDE's Settings | Tools | Visual Markdown.

idea-plugin.name: Show Comment
idea-plugin.description:
Show doc comment in the Project view Tree, line End, json, other 在文件树、行末、JSON 等地方显示注释.
  • Java, Kotlin, Groovy, Scala
  • C/C++/OC, Python, Go, Rust, Ruby
  • HTML(Vue), JS/TS, PHP, SQL
  • YAML/yml

English Note

  • tree doc from lang or README.md pom .gradle etc. by settings
  • input `doc` `docc` -> /** */
  • json doc from xxx.json.tsv
  • json dict doc from (key).tsv
  • "xx-ClassNameOrSimpleName.json" and jump to field
  • from External Conf for folder, resources, COBOL etc.
  • Config: settings -> Tools -> // Show Comment App/Global/Project
External Comment
Demo(GitHub)
  • Reload: Tools -> 🔄 // Reload External Comment
  • path/[any][filename.]ext.tree.tsv // file and folder tree comment 📝 📁
  • path/[any][filename.]ext.key.regexp // line keywords to split and comment
  • path/[any][filename.]ext.doc.tsv // line words comment
  • In path, "doc" can replace any, and can use % like in SQL, effect at previous layer when folder named -1
  • The lines in key.regexp will be concatenated with `|` to regexp; longer str should in front; startWith `?` to exclude
  • Chang tsv file in find pop window would not reload!
  • The tsv conf file must could be search in "Go to File" (Ctrl + Shift + N)
My Project
  • Show doc comment at the Project view Tree, line End, json etc.: Show Comment
  • show line count for file / method, show children count for dir in project view (tree on left): Line Num
  • Method call usage graph and maven dependency graph: Draw Graph
  • Find author/comment of multiple files or lines and export Find: Find Author
  • Auto sync coverage and capture coverage during debug: Sync Coverage

中文说明

  • 在结构树显示 文件注释 或 项目说明 (README.md pom.xml 等，可设置)
  • 在行末尾显示 引用对象的文档注释，欢迎反馈您想要支持的语言，欢迎 C# 大神研究 CsLineEnd.java
  • 输入 doc / docc 等生成 /** */
  • json 字段注释从 xxx.json.tsv 读取
  • json 字典注释从 键名.tsv 读取
  • 支持 "xx-类全名或简名.json" 读取字段注释和跳转
  • 支持 从配置文件获取外部注释用于文件夹、资源、COBOL 等
  • 修改配置：设置 -> 工具 -> // Show Comment App/Global/Project
外部注释
示例(Gitee) ：比如你要给 .go 的文件配置文件注释可以放在相同目录或父目录的 xxx.go.tree.tsv 中，如果该文件夹没有索引就用 show_comment_plugin.tree.tsv
  • 重新加载：工具 -> "🔄 // Reload External Comment"
  • path/[any][filename.]ext.tree.tsv // 文件(夹)注释 📝 📁
  • path/[any][filename.]ext.key.regexp // 切割关键字与注释
  • path/[any][filename.]ext.doc.tsv // 词注释
  • key.regexp 的每一行将会用`|`连接起来形成正则表达式，较长的关键字应该放在前面，用 `?` 开头排除
  • doc 文件夹可以替换任何一层文件夹，可以像 SQL 那样用 % 模糊匹配，文件夹名为 -1 时在上一层文件夹生效
  • 在搜索弹出窗中修改 tsv 文件将不会被重加载
  • tsv 配置文件必须能被搜索(Ctrl + Shift + N)
我的项目
  • 在文件树、行末、JSON 显示注释: Show Comment
  • 在文件树显示行数、文件数: Line Num
  • 生成 方法调用图 和 Maven 依赖图: Draw Graph
  • 查找多个文件或行的作者 与 导出搜索： Find Author
  • 自动同步覆盖率 和 调试中抓取覆盖率： Sync Coverage

反馈问题和需求

    GitHub issues
  • 微信 LinWanCen
  • 邮箱 1498425439@qq.com

支持

  • 如果对你有所帮助，可以通过群或文章等形式分享给大家，在插件市场好评，或者给本项目 GitHub 主页一个 Star，您的支持是项目前进的动力。

idea-plugin.name: True Dark
idea-plugin.description:
True Black Theme


A Pure Dark theme with the highest contrast ratio eyes has ever known. I have been struggling a lot with all the outdated IntelliJ UI components; looking at what is the industry offers, we still tied to 10 years old Java UI. Additionally, we have themes that make it harder to make the IDE look nicer on High-Resolution displays. Yet I decided to eliminate all the clutter in the IDE and use a Pure #000000 and Pure #FFFFFF based theme.

Setup

Plugin marketplace (recommended) 🛒

Go to Preferences | Plugins | Marketplace and search for True Black theme Install the plugin
When prompted, restart your IDE.

Manual

- To install the plugin manually, use the following steps.
- Download the ZIP file from the latest release on GitHub.
- Go to Preferences | Plugins in your editor and click the gear icon at the top.
- Click Install Plugin from Disk...
- Select the ZIP file you downloaded.
- When prompted, restart your IDE.

Tips 🌟

- Use one of the awesome fonts in here!.
- Make Sure to hide all the non-essential Windows Tools, go to View | Appearance | Uncheck what's not important; for myself, I keep only (Status Bar, Toolbar), and Keyboard Shortcuts is enough.
- Atom Icons is recommended.
- Use a good IDE font to Preferences | Appearance & Behavior | Appearance | Check "Use custom font" | Select "Futura" for example.

Color Palette 🎨
idea-plugin.change-notes:
2.0.3 - 2025-05-24

👁️ True Black Visibility Enhancement - Critical Usability Fix

  • MAJOR IMPROVEMENT: True Black theme selection colors now have proper contrast
  • Before: #2A2A2A selections (barely visible against #000000 background)
  • After: #505050 active, #353535 inactive (87% and 40% brighter respectively)
  • Text selections, code highlighting, and UI elements now clearly visible
  • Updated scroll bars, plugin browser, and progress bars to match new colors
  • Maintains pure black aesthetic while ensuring usability

idea-plugin.name: JVMs Manager
idea-plugin.description:
This IntelliJ plugin provides a task-manager-like tool window to monitor and manage Java Virtual Machines.

The tool window is available via View | Tool Windows | JVMs and will be shown by default in the left bottom of IntelliJ.

Features

(Please take a look at the README.md to get a more detailed description and screenshots.)

  • The main part of the tool window is a tree table that lists all running JVM processes and their child processes.
  • For each JVM process the process details contains information about the main class, attached debugger and Java agents, and system properties.
  • Besides that, the process details provides the memory usage, command line, environment variables, uptime, and a lot more.
  • There is an easy-to-use UI to access detailed information about any running JVM process, like getting a thread dump, version, classloader hierarchy, and the heap space.
  • In addition, the plugin provides a one-click solution to attach a Java agent, trigger the garbage collection and start the OpenJDK JVM monitoring tool.

(Plugin icon by svgrepo.com)

idea-plugin.name: SQL Optimizer,Index Advisor MySQL/Postgre/Oracle, Tune by PawSQL
idea-plugin.description:
PawSQL Advisor is an automatic and intelligent SQL optimization tool for databases including MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle, MariaDB and etc. It helps database application developers optimize their queries by Clicks.
We also offer PawSQL Cloud, a SaaS-based alternative solution, which provides a free plan for individual users.

Features

  • Rewrite optimization, recommending semantically equivalent, but more efficient SQL.
  • Intelligent index recommendation, based on input SQL syntax, database objects and statistics information.
  • SQL Review, targeting semantic correctness and performance optimization.
  • What-if analysis to ensure gaining better performance after SQL rewriting and indexing recommendations.
  • Index analysis to detect redundant existing indexes.

Databases Supported

  • MySQL 5.6 and above
  • PostgreSQL 9.6 and above
  • Oracle 11g and above(alpha)
  • SQL Server 2008 R2 and above
  • openGauss 2.0 and above
  • MariaDB 10.6 and above(alpha)
  • KingbaseES V8(alpha)

User Guide and 用户手册 for PawSQL Advisor.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Version 2025.2.117
  • SQL Parser & Syntax
    • Enhanced SQL Server support including data types ([varchar](20), VARCHAR(MAX)), table references (db..table), temporary tables, table hints (WITH (NOLOCK)), FOR XML clauses, APPLY joins, and table alias syntax
    • Added support for N'dd' strings, jsonb_agg, OUTER APPLY, and non-standard whitespace characters
    • Fixed parsing for _UTF8 '-', window functions, and bigserial constraints
    • Improved scalar subquery parsing robustness
  • Query Optimization
    • Enhanced subquery handling with decorrelation support for outer grouping, duplicate SSQ fixes, and skip decorrelation for FOR XML AUTO
    • New optimizations including false predicate derivation, LIKE-to-equality rewrite, and same-column constant comparisons
    • Improved rules for predicate pushdown, SATTC for nested conditions, large offset rewriting, and cost calculation
  • Bug Fixes
    • Fixed memory leaks, redundant index usage, and syntax validation issues
    • Resolved defects in SATTC, predicate pushdown, and index invalidation rules
    • Corrected getSQL methods for subqueries and variable constants
Version 2025.08.01
  • SQL Parser Enhancements
    • Added support for SQL Server-specific syntax:
      • [varchar](20) data type definitions
      • db..table table references
      • Inline index definitions in CREATE TABLE
      • Table alias syntax: SELECT uid = col FROM t
      • Local/global temporary tables (#table/##table)
      • WITH (NOLOCK) table hints
      • FOR XML clauses
      • VARCHAR(MAX) data type
      • CROSS/OUTER APPLY statements
    • Enabled MySQL double-quoted string literals ("string")
    • Added JSON_TABLE syntax support
    • Supported JSON_AGG aggregate function
    • Implemented ALTER INDEX RENAME/VISIBLE syntax
    • Allowed $ in Oracle/PostgreSQL identifiers
  • Query Optimization & Rewrite
    • Improved subquery handling:
      • Skip decorrelation for subqueries with LIMIT
      • Added lateral subquery rewrite logic
      • Enhanced EXISTS subquery decorrelation
    • Added OR-to-IN predicate rewrite rule (RuleOrCond2InPredicateRewrite)
    • Supported outer join sign ((+)) in index recommendation
    • Pushed filter predicates to derived tables
    • Fixed index invalidation issues with IFNULL functions
  • Audit Rules & Execution Logic
    • Audited view definition SQL instead of view content
    • Added T-SQL script audit support
    • Exempted temporary tables from specific rules:
      • Naming conventions
      • Mandatory primary keys
      • Column comment requirements
    • Ignored "unconditional DML" warning for cursor-based operations
    • Generated individual QueryAuditResult per SQL statement
  • New Features & Improvements
    • Added SQL Server cursor operation support (DECLARE CURSOR, UPDATE/DELETE WHERE CURRENT OF)
    • Enabled SSL connections for SQL Server
    • Introduced ubtree index type
    • Supported TOP N syntax (SQL Server)
    • Added ValueExpressionTableExpr query model
    • Optimized syntax error output messages
  • Critical Bug Fixes
    • Fixed column resolution without table prefixes
    • Repaired index column merging logic defects
    • Resolved UNION ALL with LIMIT/ORDER BY issues
    • Fixed NPE in ValueExpressionAlias cloning
    • Corrected index recommendation logic with derived tables
    • Patched connection release in multi-statement execution
    • Fixed full-width space character handling
  • Other Optimizations
    • Simplified index analysis output (hidden when no indexes exist)
    • Replaced XML escape characters in SQL text (< → <)
    • Set autoCommit=true for SQL Server connections
    • Added GO as SQL Server script separator
    • Allowed BUCKET as valid identifier
Version 2025.1.01: Microsoft SQL Server Support!
  • Support local and global variable definitions in SQL Server's SQL parser.
  • Add GO as a separator in SQL Server.
  • Support #table type temporary tables in SQL Server's SQL parser.
  • Support ALTER TABLE syntax for SQL Server (e.g., ALTER TABLE [mydb].[dbo].[mytable] ADD [col3] INT NULL).
  • Support WITH table for DML statements.
  • Support CROSS/OUTER APPLY syntax for SQL Server.
  • Support predicates in function parameters and VARCHAR(MAX) data type for SQL Server.
  • Add RuleOrCond2InPredicateRewrite rule for SQL Server.
  • Optimize RuleFuncWithColumnInPredicate rule.
  • Assign columns to the single table in UPDATE/DELETE statements if only one table is present.
  • Fix bugs in LimitClausePushDown, fullcolumnname parsing, and MSSQLValidator.
  • Fix syntax issues related to LIMIT in SQL Server.
  • Enhance and optimize SQL Server support.
  • Improve SQL parser functionality for SQL Server.
Happy New Year 2025!
  • Happy New Year 2025!

idea-plugin.name: Angular File Switcher
idea-plugin.description:
Angular File Switcher is a plugin that switches between similarly named files within a directory. It is specifically designed for Angular component files but works with any set of files within a directory where file names ( except for the file extensions) match.

I built this as a reaction to Angular CLI QuickSwitch Plugin. While I find it a valuable plugin, it doesn't function exactly how I want in all circumstances. It has the following enhancements:

  • Choose file extensions to include or exclude.
  • This plugin works with multiple tab groups how one would expect.
  • It doesn't unexpectedly rearrange the tab order.
  • Optionally keep files open - by tab group or workspace.
  • If you open a similarly named file using a non-file-switcher command (such as Ctrl+Click), you can optionally close other similarly named files.

Links

Source code: https://github.com/jyjor/angular-file-switcher

Issues: https://github.com/jyjor/angular-file-switcher/issues

idea-plugin.name: ToString Reader
idea-plugin.description:
This plugin tries to simplify reading of toString() output for Java objects.
There is no such language called ToString, so we tried to implement parser and highlighter of common patterns used for toString() in Java:
  • Object with braces: User{property='value'}
  • Object with parentheses: User(property="value")
  • Lists: [ 1, 2, 3 ]
  • Maps: { key=value }
  • References: { ref=com.Example@cafe90 }

When is it useful?
— We know at least one application of this: reading diffs produced by test asserts, such as assertEquals in JUnit.

idea-plugin.name: I Love DevToys
idea-plugin.description:
This free plugin is highly inspired from the DevToys software available on Windows. Find useful tools in a Tool Window in the top right corner of your IDE:
  • Base64 encoder/decoder
  • URL encoder/decoder
  • Fake Data generator (addresses, IBAN, Chuck Norris facts, Job titles, Pokemon names, Rick and Morty characters, The It Crowd quotes...)
  • Timestamp converter
  • Cron parser (Unix, Quartz, Spring 5.3+, Cron4j)
  • Lines utils: Set Diff viewer (compare two texts, ignoring lines ordering), Lines merging (add the lines of B to A if they're new), Lines subtract (remove the lines of B from A)
  • Lorem Ipsum generator
  • Hash generator (MD5, BCrypt 2A,2B,2Y, SHA1,256,384,512)
  • HMAC generator (MD5, SHA1,224,256,384,512)
  • UUID generator
  • JSON to String converter
  • Properties to YAML converter (including Spring profiles support)
  • JSON <> YAML converter
  • BENCODE <> JSON converter
  • ASCII <> HEX converter
  • CSV/HTML/Java/JS/JSON/XML (un)escaper
  • Password strength evaluator
  • Password hash validator
  • Path converter (Convert any path to Windows, Git Bash, WSL, Unix/macOS formats)
The global idea is to provide these tools on Linux and macOS (Windows is also supported), because the original DevToys software is available on Windows only. Also, it is supposed to reduce context-switching.
Work in progress: I am trying to reproduce most of the DevToys features, while adding some exclusive features, so it will take some time. Also, contributions are welcome 😎.
GitHub | Issues | LinkedIn | 💙 Help Ukraine 💛

Check also my other plugins.

idea-plugin.name: Angular Inject Into Action
idea-plugin.description:
The Angular Inject Into action makes it easier to inject services or other classes into your Angular components/directives/services. It lets you search and select what you want to inject, then it automatically adds a private readonly field to the constructor, along with the appropriate import statement.

The plugin correctly handles files with multiple injection targets (eg, a Component and an NgModule in the same file) by asking which should be used. It also deals with classes without a constructor to inject into by creating one.

To make everything even easier, add a key binding for the action (I use Ctrl-Shift-2).

GitHub: https://github.com/slak44/intellij-angular-inject-into

idea-plugin.name: JVM Default Options
idea-plugin.description:
This IntelliJ plugin allows you to set default values for JVM options and environment variables when running Java-based configurations. The values can be scoped both globally and to a specific project.

To download and install the plugin, visit: https://plugins.jetbrains.com/plugin/21136-jvm-default-options

To set the default values, open the Build, Execution, Deployment → JVM Default Options panel in the IDE settings.

You can set two types of default values:

  • VM options, for example:

    -Dmy.favorite.property=abcd -Danother.property=helloworld

  • Environment variables, for example:

    MY_VAR=abcd MY_OTHER_VAR=1234

Values set in a run configuration take precedence over both global and project default values. Project default values take precedence over global default values.

PolyBPMN plugin for IntelliJ IDEA is a visualiser for BPMN diagrams with navigation and process debugging support. It supports editing and visualising BPMN diagrams created in such modellers as Activiti, Camunda, and Flowable.



We are waiting for your feedback, found issues, new proposals to improve the plugin, so that it becomes better and fits all your needs.

Key features:

  1. Create and edit BPMN XML files.
  2. IntelliJ IDEA tips (class, expression, delegate expression).
  3. Jump from modeller element to XML element.
  4. Smoothly change the shape of diagrams.
  5. Multi-dialect support (Camunda, Flowable, Activiti).
  6. Comparison of BPMN files with previous versions (works with Git).
  7. Embedded diagram window with controls inside XML file editor.
  8. Support for three editing modes: BPMN file, BPMN modeller, and split view.

Shortcuts:

  • Ctrl/Cmd and Y: Redo
  • Ctrl/Cmd and Z: Undo
  • Ctrl/Cmd and C: Copy
  • Ctrl/Cmd and X: Cut
  • Ctrl/Cmd and V: Paste
  • Shift and N: Open a context menu
  • Ctrl/Cmd and +: Zoom in
  • Ctrl/Cmd and -: Zoom out
  • Delete or Backspace: Delete selected element
  • Arrow keys: Move the canvas
  • Hold shift key plus left click mouse to move round canvas
  • Ctrl and scrolling mouse or touchpad: Change layer in match mode
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Features

  • Auto-layout: diagrams without BPMN DI are laid out automatically when opened, and any diagram can be re-laid out from the context menu (Layout > Auto-Layout). Can be disabled in settings. Not available for diagrams with pools
  • Lax parsing: diagrams with incomplete or unbalanced XML (e.g. while you are typing) still open and stay editable. Can be disabled in settings
  • Debugger improvements: select a process instance or execution ID (or use the latest instance), follow call activities to parent, grandparent and child instances, executed path highlighted in green, customizable SQL queries in settings

Bugfixes

  • The mail task "Text" property no longer appears on other elements

idea-plugin.name: Init Script Runner
idea-plugin.description:
This is an IntelliJ plugin that enhances the project opening experience by executing Bash scripts located in the .scripts folder of the project. This plugin enables developers to automate various tasks and customize the project environment upon project open.

Key Features:

Script Execution: Upon opening a project in IntelliJ, the plugin automatically scans the project's .scripts folder and executes any Bash scripts found within it. This allows to define custom actions, configurations, or setups that need to be performed every time the project is opened.

Project-Specific Scripts: The plugin focuses on project-specific scripts, providing a convenient way to encapsulate project-specific logic or configurations. By organizing Bash scripts within the .scripts folder, it can be ensured that project-specific tasks are executed consistently across the team.

Automation and Customization: It enables teams/developers to automate routine tasks, set up local environment configurations, or perform custom actions specific to the project. It offers flexibility and extensibility to tailor the project setup according to needs.

Git Hooks Integration: One valuable use case of this plugin is the ability to set up Git hooks on the local machines of all developers in a team. By placing the scripts to setup git hooks in the .scripts folder, the plugin can automatically execute them upon project open, ensuring consistent Git hook configurations across the team.

With this plugin, teams can streamline project setup, automate repetitive tasks, and ensure consistent project environments. It empowers teams to enforce standards, improve productivity, and maintain a cohesive development experience across projects.

idea-plugin.name: Marcelo's Flutter/Dart Essentials
idea-plugin.description:
Features


1) Show Class Separators. Draws horizontal line separators above class, enum and extension definitions in the Editor, similar to the native "Show Method Separator" setting, but applied to classes etc instead. This enhances code readability, making it easier to distinguish where one class ends and another begins.


2) Show Test and Test Group Separators. Draws horizontal line separators above test() and group() method calls in the Editor, for files that end in _test.dart. That's similar to the native "Show Method Separator" setting, but applied to tests instead. This enhances code readability, making it easier to distinguish where one test or test group ends and another begins. This plugin is needed because tests are function *calls*, not function *definitions*, which is why they don't have the native method separators applied to them.


3) Show Bdd Separators. This is for the BDD Framework package: pub.dev/packages/bdd_framework. Draws horizontal line separators above Bdd() calls, but also between the BDD keywords: .given(...), .when(...), .then(...) and .example(...). Also, in the BDD body you may want to separate the implementation of the given/when/then parts. To that end, it will also add separators above any comments that start with // Given:, // When:, // Then:, // Given/When: or // When/Then:. Note all these separators are only added for files with names that start with "bdd_" or end with "_test.dart".

Configuration

p>To configure this plugin:
  1. Open IntelliJ IDEA.
  2. For Windows, go to File -> Settings (or press Ctrl+Alt+S). For MacOS, go to IntelliJ IDEA -> Preferences (or press Command+).
  3. In the Settings (or Preferences) window, on the left panel, click Marcelo's Flutter/Dart Essentials.
  4. Configure the plugin, then click Apply, or OK to close the Settings (or Preferences) window.

Note: You may also turn on a related native setting called "Show Method Separator":

  1. In the Settings (or Preferences) window, on the left panel, click to expand Editor.
  2. Under Editor, click to expand General.
  3. Under General, click on Appearance.
  4. On the right panel, find the checkbox Show method separators.

Note: To change the color of the native method separator, fo to File > Settings (On Mac, it's IntelliJ IDEA > Preferences). In the Settings/Preferences dialog, go to Editor > Color Scheme. In the Color Scheme section, you will find an option called General. Expand the General option, you should find Code > Method separator. The Method separator color option should be there. You can click on it and a color dialog will open where you can pick a new color for the method separators.

Final Note

This plugin has my name on it, because: 1) It will provide support for the 15+ plugins that I've developed, which you can explore at https://pub.dev/publishers/glasberg.dev/packages. 2) It will incorporate features that reflect my personal preferences for IDE functionalities. While it may prioritize a specific approach and not always offer extensive customization options, you will have the flexibility to disable any features that do not align with your requirements. Currently, this plugin only includes the ability to draw separators. However, I plan to gradually enhance its capabilities in the future.

Source Code

https://github.com/marcglasberg/marcelosdartplugin

License: Apache License - Version 2.0

idea-plugin.name: Developer Tools
idea-plugin.description:
Developer Tools brings a practical toolbox of everyday development utilities directly into IntelliJ-based IDEs. It keeps common tasks such as encoding data, transforming text, validating JSON, generating identifiers, inspecting archives, formatting code and SQL, and checking certificates inside the IDE, so you do not need to switch to separate web tools or command-line snippets.

Plugin icon by Gabriele Malaspina.

Key Features

  • JWT Encoder/Decoder
  • Base32, Base64, URL Base64, MIME Base64, URL, and ASCII Encoder/Decoder
  • Text escaping and unescaping for HTML entities, Java strings, JSON, CSV, XML, and escape sequences
  • Regular Expression Matcher
  • UUID, ULID, Nano ID, password, QR code/barcode, Lorem Ipsum, and ASCII art generators
  • Text Sorting
  • Text Case Transformation
  • Text Diff Viewer
  • Config Format Conversion
  • Text Statistic
  • Text Filter
  • JSON Path Parser
  • JSON Schema Validator
  • Hashing and HMAC
  • HTTP Server (WireMock)
  • Archive viewer and extractor for ZIP, TAR, JAR, 7z, and other formats
  • Date and time tools for Unix timestamps, formatting, and parsing
  • Unit converters for time, data size, and transfer rate
  • Code Style Formatting
  • SQL Formatting
  • CLI Command Conversion
  • Color Picker
  • Fetching, analyzing, and exporting server certificates
  • Notes

Integration

The full toolbox is available in both a persistent tool window and a standalone dialog. Tools can have multiple named workbenches, so you can keep separate inputs and configurations for different tasks. Frequently used text operations are also available from the editor popup menu and as intentions; depending on the action, they work on selected text or on the Java/Kotlin string or identifier at the caret.

Plugin settings are available in IntelliJ IDEA's settings/preferences under Tools | Developer Tools.

Tool Window

The tool window is available under View | Tool Windows | Developer Tools. Inputs, selected tools, expanded menu groups, and tool configuration are stored per project.

Dialog

The dialog is available from IntelliJ IDEA's main menu under Tools | Developer Tools.

To add the "Open Dialog" action to the main toolbar, enable it in IntelliJ IDEA's settings/preferences under Tools | Developer Tools, or add it manually via Customize Toolbar... | Add Actions... | Developer Tools.

Dialog inputs, selected tools, expanded menu groups, and tool configuration are stored at the application level.

idea-plugin.change-notes:
9.0.0 - 2026-05-24

Added

  • Added editor actions for text case conversion and encoding/decoding, now available across all programming languages as well as plain text.
  • Prepared UI display text for localization and added Simplified Chinese and German translations.
  • Editor actions are now also available for multi-line selection

Changed

  • Renamed "Text Format" tool to "Config Format".
  • Changed DER export for certificate chains in the "Server Certificates" tool to write one .der file per certificate instead of a single concatenated binary file.
  • Improved the "Server Certificates" tool with a compact TLS summary, certificate chain roles, hostname matching, subject alternative names, SHA-256 fingerprints, expiry warnings, clearer export actions, URL normalization, and preserved results while fetching or after failed fetches.

Fixed

  • Fixed the HTTP Server tool potentially freezing during disposal and retaining unbounded process output.
  • Fixed the "Text Statistic" tool freezing the UI while recalculating statistics for large text.
  • Fixed opening and saving shared editor content from files blocking the UI or failing without a clear error message.
  • Fixed live conversions in converter tools blocking the UI while processing text input.
  • Fixed large editor encode/decode and escape/unescape actions blocking the UI while processing selected text.
  • Fixed closed tool workbenches being restored as disposed tabs after the tool UI was rebuilt.
  • Fixed HTML entity unescaping in editor actions and intentions so escaped values are decoded instead of escaped again.
  • Improved archive extraction safety in the "Unarchiver" tool by blocking archive entries that escape the selected target directory and by correctly handling duplicate archive entry names during extraction.
  • Fixed parsing of advanced HTTP Server command line options so option lines with values are correctly tokenized before starting WireMock.
  • Increased the HTTP Server startup grace period to reduce false startup failures on slower environments.
  • Fixed transfer rate conversions in the Units Converter so changing the time unit keeps the same rate. For example, 60 b/s is now shown as 3600 b/min instead of 1 b/min.
  • Fixed the Units Converter showing kibibits with the abbreviation kib instead of the correct Kib.
  • Fixed the Units Converter's default data size example so it starts from an exact binary value instead of a rounded bit count.
  • Fixed menu name of the plugin settings page

idea-plugin.name: Theme Switcher
idea-plugin.description:
Adds an action to quickly switch UI themes.

By default, it uses Light and Dark if they are available. Otherwise, it uses IntelliJ Light and Darcula. If they are also not available for some reason, it selects the first two themes from the list of available UI themes. In any case, you can change the themes you want to switch in Settings | Tools | Theme Switcher.

The action is Switch Theme. Call it from the Find Action popup and assign a shortcut that you like for it.
idea-plugin.change-notes: • Status bar icon

idea-plugin.name: Color Palette Generator
idea-plugin.description:
Color Palette Generator

A plugin designed to enhance your color workflow. With Color Palette Generator, you can effortlessly generate color palettes and access essential color information right at your fingertips.

Easily generate color palette for your project. Just select your hex color and generate color palette.

Main Features:

  • Tints and Shades: Easily generate a range of tints and shades from a single base color.
  • Color Name Lookup: Instantly find the closest color name to a given hex code.

Usage:

  1. Select hex color (must be selected with #). Reference screenshots which will make it more understandable.
  2. Open context actions (cmd + Enter on Mac and Alt + Enter on Windows)
  3. Run: Generate color palette

Supported filetypes:

  • tailwind.config.js
  • tailwind.config.ts
  • tailwind.config.cjs
  • Sass/SCSS files
  • CSS files

Important Notes

To generate color palette in tailwind config you must write hex color without quotes if it is on the same line with other text. For example you must write only -> { red: #c934eb }, instead of { red: "#c934eb" }. IF YOU WRITE COLOR WITH QUOTES IT WILL NOT WORK!!! However, if you write color with quotes without other text on this line then it will generate color palette.

Support Plugin Developer:

If you like the plugin, please consider supporting Me by leaving a review and making a donation.

Support my work
idea-plugin.change-notes:
New Features

  • tailwind.config.ts support
  • tailwind.config.cjs support

Features

  • css files
  • support tailwind.config.js custom colors
  • support sass/scss variables
  • tailwind.config.js quoted hex color support

idea-plugin.name: EasyTime
idea-plugin.description:
Automatically track the time you spend working in your IDE. EasyTime is a companion app to EasyTime for Jira. How it works:

Note: EasyTime requires EasyTime for Jira to be installed and configured on your Jira instance. Getting Started EasyTime integrations

idea-plugin.name: Sentry
idea-plugin.description:
The Sentry plugin allows you to browse issues, events, and stacktraces right in your IDE.

Features:

  • Browse issues and events
  • View stacktraces and navigate to the source code

idea-plugin.name: MoneyPenny AI
idea-plugin.description:
Unveil the future of Prompt Driven Development (PDD) with MoneyPenny AI Prompt, a top-notch IntelliJ IDEA plugin designed to skyrocket your coding productivity. Here are the standout features that set us apart from the rest:

  • Multi-File Refactoring: Tweak, add, or adjust multiple files all at once, unlike other platforms like Copilot X.

idea-plugin.name: Kafka Client
idea-plugin.description:
A powerful client for Apache Kafka. It provides support for multiple clusters, allowing you to efficiently manage topics, publish and consume messages, and perform various Kafka-related operations right within IntelliJ.

Multiple clusters support:

  • Easily manage different Kafka clusters through the plugin.

Topics Management:

  • Create, delete, and modify topic partitions with ease.
  • Display system topics.
  • Search topics using regular expressions.

Message Consumption:

  • Consume messages using different strategies.
  • Wait for messages within the specified poll time.
  • Read the latest messages from a topic.
  • Read messages from a specific partition with a specific offset.

Message Publishing:

  • Publish String/Byte serialized messages.
  • Integration with Schema Registry for serialization into JSON, AVRO, and Protobuf.

Bulk Message Generation:

  • Generate a large volume of messages quickly using a defined template.

Additional Operations:

  • Copy topic messages into another topic/clusterConfig.
  • Delete messages from a topic.
  • Search for specific patterns in the key or value of the topic.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Added

  • Schema Registry Manager

idea-plugin.name: VirtualKit
idea-plugin.description:
Change the displayed names of SvelteKit files for easier navigation and route identification.

This plugin changes the displayed names of SvelteKit files to make it clearer which file belongs to which route.

  • +page.svelte → {route}.svelte
  • +page.ts → {route}.ts
  • +page.server.ts → {route}.server.ts

The same will be done to layout and error files.

This will solve the issue of having many files with the same name, thus improving file navigation.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
(1.6.1) - 2025-09-05

Added

  • Handle any file extension given that the filename starts with +page or +server and so on.

idea-plugin.name: Open Keymap Settings
idea-plugin.description:
Provides actions to open IDE Keymap Settings. Can be assigned to any shortcut.

Look for "Open Keymap Panel" and "Open Keymap Settings" actions in Settings | Keymap to change the shortcut.

The default shortcut is Ctrl+Alt+Shift+; to open Keymap as a standalone panel and Ctrl+Alt+Shift+" to open the full Settings dialog with Keymap navigated in the tree on the left.

idea-plugin.name: Polaris Tomcat Server
idea-plugin.description:
Polaris Tomcat Server is a plugin for Intellij IDEA Community, Ultimate and Educational.

Highlights:

  • One-click to download tomcat
  • Auto-detect maven web projects
  • Auto-detect gradle web projects
  • Auto build artifacts before launch tomcat
  • Support launch multiple artifacts
  • Support external war files and exploded war directories

The Polaris Tomcat Server supports Tomcat 7 and above.

idea-plugin.name: Code Zenify
idea-plugin.description:
Code Zenify Plugin

This is an IntelliJ IDEA plugin which reduces Java code by all the superfluous rubbish that only disturbs a code review.

There are planty of options to customize your zenification experience:

You can choose to:

  • fold blocks
  • fold comments
  • fold field type elements
  • fold getters & setters
  • fold import lists
  • fold local variable type elements
  • fold log statements
  • fold methods
  • fold modifier lists
  • fold parameter type elements
  • fold parentheses
  • fold semicolons
  • fold throw statements
  • fold new statements
  • fold type parameter lists
  • fold arbitrary expressions

Since the zenify mode toggles it is a good idea to provide the zenify action with a specific shortcut.

idea-plugin.name: JSON Schema Generator
idea-plugin.description:
This is a plugin for generating a sample JSON Schema from a JSON file. To generate a sample JSON Schema file, follow these steps:

  1. Once installed, go to Tools -> JSON Actions, or right-click on an JSON file from Project view, and select "Generate JSON Schema...". This action displays a dialog box called "JSON Schema Generator".
  2. Choose or enter the Input URL of the JSON file.
  3. Choose the path of the resulting JSON Schema file.
  4. [Optional] Select the Open in Editor option to open the resulting JSON Schema file in the main editing pane.
  5. For the JSON Schema version option, choose the version of the resulting JSON schema: Draft 4, Draft 6, Draft 7, Draft 2019-09, or Draft 2020-12.
  6. [Optional] If you select the Extract matching format for strings option, the generator will attempt to find a format that matches the string values from the JSON Document.
  7. [Optional] You can select the Restrict additional content option if you want additional / unevaluated properties / items to be set to false in the resulting schema.
  8. [Optional] Select the Add default values for simple types option and the default values (0 for number, "" for string, false for boolean) and examples for strings will be added.
  9. [Optional] If you select the Make all properties required option, the generator will mark all the properties as required in the resulting schema.
idea-plugin.change-notes: • Remove deprecated API usage.

idea-plugin.name: JSON-RPC-Helper
idea-plugin.description:
JSON-RPC-Helper, provides enhanced features for projects using JSON-RPC.

  1. JSON-RPC to curl conversion
    During Debug debugging, quickly convert JSON-RPC to curl request text.
    For example: remoteRpcService.querySomeThing(request, false, 1, 100);
    Set a breakpoint on this line, when Debug pauses on this line, select the code expression string (in fact, selecting any part of this expression can usually succeed), right-click -> select the JsonRpc2Curl button, and the curl request will automatically be copied to the clipboard.
  2. Quick search and jump of JSON-RPC path
    Use the shortcut Command + Shift + J to quickly open the JsonRpcApi column, type in the rpc path or part of the path to quickly filter and search for the corresponding method.
    Select the item you want to jump to, Enter to confirm the jump, and using Command + Enter will directly jump to the implementation of the method.
    You can also double-click Shift to open the Search All search box for searching.
  3. Copy JSON-RPC API Markdown for LLM
    Right-click a @JsonRpcService method and choose “Copy JSON-RPC API Markdown for LLM” to copy a Markdown brief (RPC path, params/returns with enum values, Maven coords, inferred service endpoint) ready to paste into an LLM.

JSON-RPC-Helper，为使用 JSON-RPC 的项目提供额外增强功能

  1. JSON-RPC 转 curl
    在 Debug 调试时， 快速将 JSON-RPC 转换为 curl 请求文本。
    例如： remoteRpcService.querySomeThing(request, false, 1, 100);
    在该行打上断点，当Debug 暂停在该行时，选中该代码表达式字符串（实际上选中该表达式的任意地方一般都可以成功），右键 -> 选择 JsonRpc2Curl 按钮， curl 请求即会自动复制到剪贴板。
  2. JSON-RPC 路径快速搜索和跳转
    使用快捷键 Command + Shift + J 快速打开 JsonRpcApi 栏位，键入 rpc 路径或路径的一部分，即可快速过滤搜索到对应的方法。
    选中想要跳转的条目，Enter 确认即可跳转， 使用 Command + Enter 会直接跳转到方法的实现。
    也可以双击 Shift 打开 Search All 搜索框进行搜索。
  3. 复制 JSON-RPC 接口 Markdown 给 LLM
    在 @JsonRpcService 方法上右键选择“复制 JSON-RPC 接口 Markdown 给LLM”，即可复制包含 RPC 路径、入参/出参（含枚举值）、Maven 坐标、推测服务地址的 Markdown，直接粘贴给 LLM。
idea-plugin.change-notes:

  • 修复 ActionUpdateThread.OLD_EDT 弃用警告，为所有 Action 类添加 getActionUpdateThread() 方法返回 EDT
  • 修复 JsonRpcApiSearchContributor 中 isDumbAware() 方法的错误实现

idea-plugin.name: Adaptive Caret Scroll
idea-plugin.description:
Adaptive Caret Scroll: Enhanced Scrolling Behavior for JetBrain's Editors

AdaptiveCaretScroll modifies the default scrolling behavior of the JetBrain editors to automatically adjust the view when the caret nears the top or bottom edges.

Functionalities:

  • Automatically triggers editor scrolling when the caret is within a user-defined distance from the top or bottom edge.
  • Provides configuration options for setting the distance from the top and bottom edges where scrolling is activated.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Update

Ensure compatibility for 2024.1 builds

idea-plugin.name: Codebuddy - AI Coding Assistant
idea-plugin.description:
Codebuddy — multi-file AI coding, natively in your JetBrains IDE

Describe what you want in plain language and Codebuddy writes it across your codebase — creating new files and editing existing ones in a single pass, then handing you a unified diff to approve before anything lands. No copying, no pasting, no leaving your IDE.

AI written code changes

  • Automatically apply changes across multiple files, or create new files, from a single prompt! Effortlessly create new files or modify existing ones with AI-generated code changes.
  • Review code changes through a familiar unified diff patch view.

Full stack code changes

  • Request the AI to implement extensive features that span the entire codebase, from the user interface to backend databases, and do so in a single prompt.
  • Versatile Code Generation: The AI is capable of creating unit tests, UI components, backend services and controllers, scripts, or really any coding task, with your direction.

Codebase understanding

  • The AI understands your codebase, generating a vector database out of your code and using it to select files relevant to your prompt for you. Now you don't need to be familiar with your codebase to make changes to it.
  • Ask Codebuddy questions about your codebase, and it will provide you with relevant responses. How is authentication done? What are the dependencies of this project? Codebuddy has the answers.

Conversational and voice-based coding

  • Speak your code changes to the AI and watch it turn them into code. Built-in two-way voice — talk to it, and it talks back, with no setup and no extra extensions. The AI summarizes the changes it wants to make back to you with text-to-speech, so you can keep your eyes on the diff. Pick from a range of voices, including ElevenLabs.
  • Engage in meaningful back-and-forth conversations with the AI to discuss and refine the changes you envision.

Include website contents for reference

  • Include website contents in your prompt to provide the AI with additional context for your code changes. The AI will use this information to generate more accurate and relevant code changes.

Effortless filesystem integration

  • Provide your filesystem structure within your prompt, allowing the AI to intuitively understand and replicate the appropriate directory structure for new files.

Frontier models, without juggling subscriptions

  • Pick the model per request — Claude Opus 5, Claude Sonnet 5, the GPT 5.6 family, Gemini 3.5 and more, all from one plugin.
  • Stay in your IDE instead of round-tripping code through a browser chat window.
  • Bring your own keys: an OpenAI key covers the GPT models, add an OpenRouter key to cover Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, GLM and Kimi, and add an Anthropic key to cover Claude. Anything your keys don't cover is simply billed in credits.

Built for JetBrains, not ported to it

Codebuddy is a native plugin, not an out-of-process agent bolted on through a bridge. It runs in IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, GoLand, Rider, PhpStorm, CLion, RubyMine and the rest of the family.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Changed

  • Marketplace listing: the plugin is now listed as "Codebuddy - AI Coding Assistant" so it shows up when people search the Marketplace for an AI coding assistant. The plugin ID is unchanged, so existing installs, settings and ratings carry over.

idea-plugin.name: TamaCat Web Browser
idea-plugin.description:
A Full-Featured web browser with the following free features:

  • Embedded Browser: Browse any website directly in the IDE with a fully functional embedded browser.
  • Tabbed Browsing: Switch between multiple websites using tabs.
  • DevTools Integration: Utilize DevTools for web page debugging and diagnostics.
  • Formatted Source View: Automatically format and display the page source for better readability.

Extra capabilities to supercharge your development workflow (Premium features for paid users):

  • Multiple Tool Windows: Open multiple tool windows to view several websites simultaneously.
  • Tab Pinning: Pin tabs to retain the same websites across IDE restarts.
  • Flexible Browser Placement: Place the embedded full-featured browser in tool windows or editor tabs as needed.
  • Host-Based Address Bar Coloring: Assign different background colors to the browser's address bar based on the host. This feature helps users visually distinguish between environments, reducing the risk of environment mix-ups.
  • JavaScript Error Notification: Detect JavaScript errors on the loaded webpage and display notifications in the tool window. Allow one-click access to DevTools for error debugging.
  • Port Detection: Automatically detect application ports and provide one-click access to open them in the browser.
  • Auto-Reload on Port Open: Automatically reload pages that failed to load before the application started.
  • IDE Link Integration: Open files or specific lines directly in the IDE editor from GitHub, GitLab, or Backlog links.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• Removed warnings recommending a switch from JCEF out-of-process mode to in-process mode while keeping the manual switch in settings.
  • Added bidirectional switching between JCEF in-process and out-of-process modes in settings.
  • Labeled the active JCEF mode in settings and marked out-of-process mode as recommended.
  • Prevented back and forward navigation action updates from blocking the EDT while querying JCEF state.

idea-plugin.name: Git User Visor
idea-plugin.description:
The "Git User Visor" is a versatile plugin designed to enhance your Git experience by allowing you to see the actual user and email that is configured in your local repository.
The plugin works using the current state of git config in the project or the current module for a certain open file in intellij, this allows you to see with what user are you pushing your code.
The usage of this plugin is very basic since is a visor of the current git user, you don't have to configure the plugin itself.
idea-plugin.change-notes: This update allows to see the information of .git/config file in background

idea-plugin.name: Jumping Lines
idea-plugin.description:
Jumping Lines is a plugin for JetBrains IDEs that allows you to navigate your code more efficiently by jumping multiple lines at once, saving your time and reducing the strain on your hands.

Features:
  • Jump multiple lines at once.
    Forward:SHIFT+CTRL+PERIOD | Backward:SHIFT+CTRL+COMMA

idea-plugin.name: Onuro - AI Code Assistant
idea-plugin.description:
Onuro

The best AI code assistant for JetBrains IDEs. Works with IntelliJ, PyCharm, WebStorm, CLion, GoLand, and all JetBrains IDEs.

Install → Sign in → Start prompting.

Website · Documentation · Pricing

🚀 Quick Start

  1. Install from the JetBrains Marketplace (search "Onuro")
  2. Find Onuro in the right sidebar
  3. Sign in and start chatting

New users get 5 free messages with full Premium access to experience all features.

✨ Free Features

💬 AI Chat

Chat with a capable AI model about your code. Get explanations, debugging help, code suggestions, and answers to programming questions—all with full context of your codebase.

⚡ Inline Edits & Completions (Alt/Option + X)

Three powerful ways to use inline AI assistance:

ActionHow to UseWhat It Does
Inline EditHighlight code, press Alt+X, describe your changeAI rewrites the selected code based on your instructions
Quick AutocompleteTap Alt+X (no selection)Instant AI-powered code completion at your cursor
Prompted AutocompleteHold Alt+X (no selection)Add context/instructions before generating completion

Press Tab to accept suggestions.

💎 Premium Features ($15/month)

🤖 Autonomous AI Agent

Upgrade to let the AI actually write and edit your code. The Premium agent can:

  • Edit files autonomously — Describe what you want, and the AI implements it across your codebase
  • Create new files — Generate components, modules, tests, and more
  • Run terminal commands — Install packages, run builds, execute scripts
  • Search your codebase — Semantic and text search to find relevant code
  • Search the internet — Research docs, find solutions, stay up-to-date

🧠 Choose Your AI Model

Select from multiple AI providers (Anthropic, Google, OpenAI, and more). Use free models included with your subscription, or enable pay-as-you-go for cutting-edge models at direct cost with no markup.

View model pricing →

🔒 Privacy & Security

Your code stays private. We prioritize security with a local-first approach:

  • No long-term code storage — Code is only used to answer your immediate question, then discarded
  • Environment variables protected — .env file values are automatically stripped; only variable names are processed
  • Secure providers only — We only route through providers (Anthropic, Google, OpenAI) that guarantee no data storage or training on your code
  • No data selling or analysis — We don't sell, analyze, or share your data

Read our full Privacy Policy →

⌨️ Keyboard Shortcuts

ShortcutAction
Alt/Option + OToggle Onuro chat panel
Alt/Option + XInline edit (with selection) or autocomplete (without)
Alt/Option + TToggle voice mode
Alt/Option + Shift + SSemantic file search (Premium)

idea-plugin.name: Docker Run Command to Compose Converter
idea-plugin.description:
Converts docker run commands into yaml format when pasted into docker-compose.yml file.

Works like composerize.com web converter.

How to use

  1. Copy your docker run command text, for example:

    docker run --name some-postgres -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD_FILE=/run/secrets/postgres-passwd -d postgres

  2. Paste it into your docker-compose.yml file. You will get something like this:

    version: 3
services:
  some-postgres:
    image: postgres
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD_FILE=/run/secrets/postgres-passwd
    container_name: some-postgres

idea-plugin.name: Partial Page Scrolling
idea-plugin.description:
Partial PageUp and PageDown navigation plugin.

The default Page Up/Down functionality of the IDE always scrolls a whole page. With this plugin, you can adjust the scrolling behaviour to your preference.

This plugin will add new actions "Partial Page Up/Down" and "Partial Page Up/Down with Selection" that allow to scroll the editor for a specified range only, e.g. half of the visible area or 42 lines.

Please note that while this plugin by default sets up the default (Page Up/Page Down) shortcuts to enable it's actions, it can't override the default actions by itself. For it to work, you'd need to go to keymap and disable the usual "Page Up" and "Page Down" shortcuts. Simply remove them and you're good to go.

You can configure the scroll length in "Partial Page Scrolling" configuration page.

This plugin is basically a clone of the Partial Navigation plugin created by Andrey Cizov which is not compatible anymore with recent IDE versions.

idea-plugin.name: LangCursor
idea-plugin.description:
What's LangCursor?

Designed specially for developers who work in non-English languages 🌍.
It addresses the common pain point of typos caused by language switching.

⚡Avoid typo by changing cursor color

  • 🎨 Switch Cursor Color by input status: Changes for English/non-English input and Capslock status.
  • ⌨️ Vim-Friendly: Supports Vim's insert mode.

Supported Environments

  • Supported OS: Windows, macOS
  • Not using any third-party Input Method editor(IME), opposed to the default OS input methods

How to Use

Once installed, LangCursor will be automatically executed when you open your project in IDE.

Customization

You can customize the color of the cursor for non-English input methods.

  1. Go to Settings > Tools > LangCursor.
  2. Choose your preferred color for the non-English input method.
  3. Apply the changes.

Troubleshooting

Note
Please ensure you've reviewed the Supported Environments section for any compatibility issues specific to your system.

LangCursor may encounter many local-specific edge cases.
If you encounter any bugs or challenges while using LangCursor, we're here to help. Here's what you can do:

  • First, check if the issue has already been reported or resolved in our GitHub issues.
  • If you don't find a similar issue, feel free to open a new issue with a detailed description of the problem, including your local environment infos.
  • For general questions or troubleshooting assistance, you can also reach out to the community through GitHub discussions.

Contribute

We welcome contributions to LangCursor! Your ideas and work can make a significant impact on the plugin. Here's how you can contribute:

  • Reporting Bugs: If you find a bug, report it by creating a new issue on our GitHub issues page.
  • Suggesting Enhancements: Have ideas for new features or improvements? Share them as feature requests on our issues page.
  • Submitting Pull Requests: If you've developed a fix or an enhancement, submit a pull request with your changes. Please ensure your code follows the project's style and contribution guidelines.

Your contributions, whether big or small, play a crucial part in the growth and improvement of LangCursor. Join us in making this tool even better for everyone!

If you already have a License, click ‌Quick Login‌, configure your License and username in the plugin settings, and start using the tool. For detailed guidance, refer to: Help Documentation

快速开始

下载文心快码插件，之后在首页点击登录按钮，选择身份信息进行登录；如果已有License，点击点击“快速登录”，在插件设置中配置License和用户名称后进行使用。详细帮助内容请参考：帮助文档

Core Scenarios

  • Zulu: End-to-End Generation from Requirements to Code
    • Achieve requirements entirely through natural language – zero coding required
    • Understands codebase business logic to accelerate onboarding for new projects
    • Automates development environment setup and service initialization - no manual command input
  • Context-sensitive super code completion
    • Performs dependency analysis for contextual completions
    • Auto-corrects typos while generating code
    • Predicts next cursor position for editing
    • Intelligently rewrites multi-line code at predicted positions
  • Conversational codebase interaction via natural language
    • Analyzes entire codebase to map business logic
    • Enhances code generation quality through context awareness
    • Generates code with corporate knowledge base integration

核心场景

  • Zulu：从需求到代码的端到端生成
    • 全自然语言实现需求，不写一行代码
    • 理解代码库业务逻辑，帮助你迅速上手新项目
    • 帮你自动搭建开发环境和启动服务，不用一行一行输入命令
  • 丝丝入扣的超级代码补全
    • 上下文依赖分析进行代码补全
    • 自动修正拼写错误并补全代码
    • 预测下一个要编辑的光标位置
    • 智能重写预测位置的多行代码
  • 通过自然语言和代码库对话
    • 分析整个代码库梳理业务逻辑
    • 感知上下文提高代码生成质量
    • 关联企业知识库进行代码生成

Supported Languages

Baidu Comate currently supports all mainstream programming languages, with enhanced performance in the following language/framework scenarios:

  • BackEnd: C, C#, C++, Java, Python, Go, PHP, Rust
  • FrontEnd: HTML, JavaScript, CSS, Less, swan, San, Vue, Scss, Sass, Stylus, pug, mermaid
  • APP: ObjectC, Kotlin, Swift
  • Others: Perl, Ruby, Shell, VHDL, GraphQL, Dockerfile

支持语言

目前文心快码支持全部主流编程语言，其中在以下语言/框架编程场景表现更优：

  • 后端： C、C#、C++、Java、Python、Go、PHP、Rust
  • 前端： HTML、JavaScript、CSS、Less、swan、San、Vue、Scss、Sass、Stylus、pug、mermaid
  • App端： ObjectC、Kotlin、Swift
  • 其它： Perl、Ruby、Shell、vhdl、GraphQL、Dockerfile

Code Upload

Will my code be uploaded? What code gets transmitted?

During normal operation, Baidu Comate utilizes the preceding content in the currently edited file and related files to infer subsequent code generation. This necessitates transmitting the content of active code files to the model via network for inference. We explicitly confirm that no transmitted code will be retained, analyzed, processed, or utilized for any subsequent operations.

代码上传

是否会上传代码？上传哪些代码？

正常使用文心快码过程中需要利用正在编辑的文件中的上文以及其他相关文件，来推理出接下来的下文。因此确实会需要通过网络将正在编写的代码文件内容传输给模型推理。我们承诺不使用这部分上传的代码做任何积累、分析、加工等后续动作。

idea-plugin.name: AltN8-TH
idea-plugin.description:
AltN8-TH allows you to quickly navigate to related files. Related files can be specified to your liking using regular expressions. This functionality allows developers to quickly access files that are contextually linked, improving workflow efficiency.

For example:

  • Jump from source to test file.
  • Jump from angular.component.ts to angular.component.html or angular.component.css.
  • ...

Features

  • Specify contextually linked files using regex patterns.
  • Navigate to related files using a keyboard shortcut (by default [ALT][8], [CMD][ALT][8] on macOS).
  • If more than one related file is found, a popup lets you choose the specific file.

Special Thanks

Special thanks to LeapingFrogs.com for the original AltN8 plugin and Minas Manthos for his further development of the original plugin. Both plugins served as ideological foundation for this version.

idea-plugin.name: Apihug Api Design Copilot
idea-plugin.description:
ApiHug - API design Copilot is IntelliJ-based plugin of ApiHug platform.

ApiHug provides a brand-new API solution. It combines the majority of API service platforms in the market, achieving a mutually beneficial and complementary effect.

This is also where the hug comes from.

ApiHug x {Postman|Swagger|Api...} = Faster, Accurate, Efficient and Cost-saving.

Design Principles of ApiHug:

  1. Empathy: ApiHug is designed with a strong sense of empathy. From Developer for developers.
  2. Single Source of Truth: ApiHug ensures consistency and reliability by establishing a central point of Truth for API management and integration(Git).
  3. Integration and Coexistence: ApiHug emphasizes the seamless integration and coexistence of different APIs and services. It enables harmonious collaboration and interoperability between various systems and platforms.
  4. Openness and Collaboration: ApiHug promotes openness and collaboration. It encourages sharing and cooperation among developers, fostering an environment of innovation and collective problem-solving.

ApiHug Ecosystem:

  1. OAS Standard DSL: Design APIs with standardized practices using the OpenAPI Specification (OAS) DSL for consistent and interoperable development.
  2. Gradle Toolchain: Boost development efficiency with the Gradle toolchain, automating tasks and managing dependencies.
  3. Seamless Spring Integration: Integrate seamlessly with the mature Spring framework for enterprise-level development and leverage its extensive capabilities.
  4. IDE Integration: Enjoy a streamlined development experience with seamless integration into popular Integrated Development Environments (IDEs) for enhanced productivity.

This Plugin supply a enormous fantastic experience for API design and development.

ApiHug - API design Copilot supply:

  • Full life cycle management of API, from design to implementation
  • Boost development efficiency with the Gradle toolchain, automating tasks and managing dependencies
  • Integrate seamlessly with the mature Spring framework for enterprise-level development and leverage its extensive capabilities

Features

  • Proto DSL APIs design
  • API navigate & search
  • API design
  • API Management
  • API debug
  • Class Level Service Management
  • Dependency Management
  • Project Template
  • Entity Design
  • Gradle toolchain integration
  • Request & Response visualization
  • Environment configuration

Links

ApiHug make your development of API like a fantasy journey!

  • apihug IDE plugin handbook
  • apihug - getting started
