The locked Visualise tab triggers the same license flow on selection. Product descriptor release metadata remains on the approved 1.8 paid product line.
  • 1.8.0 — Pro tier preparation and batch mode: R code generation, SQL code generation, column visualisations, regex cleaning rules, .dpp pipeline import/export, and multi-file batch processing are now guarded through JetBrains Marketplace licensing. The plugin descriptor declares the freemium Marketplace product descriptor with optional free functionality. Added multi-file batch processing for CSV, Excel, and JSON inputs, pre-load batch guidance, shared pipeline execution for Apply and Batch, regex replace cleaning rules, and generated Python/R/SQL regex snippets. Batch work, .dpp I/O, VFS refresh, and validation stay off the EDT.
  • 1.7.0 — Pipeline import/export: the Clean tab can now save preprocessing steps as .dpp JSON files and import saved .dpp pipelines back into the pipeline list. Imported pipelines warn when a step references a column missing from the current dataset. The pipeline controls were split into two rows so Import Pipeline and Export Pipeline remain visible in narrow tool-window widths, and .dpp read/write, VFS refresh, and imported-column validation all run in background workers.
  • 1.6.0 — Column visualisations and SQL generation: new 📈 Visualise tab renders a histogram or box plot for every numeric column. Select a column from the left list, toggle between chart types, and scroll/zoom the chart with the mouse wheel. Charts update automatically after Apply steps so you can inspect the effect of normalization, outlier removal, and scaling visually without leaving the IDE. Powered by JFreeChart. The Clean tab can now generate PostgreSQL-style SQL CTE templates alongside Python and R scripts, with .sql save support in the Generated Code tab.
  • 1.5.6 — Compatibility: minimum supported IDE bumped from IntelliJ 2023.3 (build 233) to 2024.3 (build 243). The plugin is compiled against the 2024.3 SDK and uses APIs introduced after 2023.3 (notably the 2-argument FileSaverDescriptor constructor), so tightening sinceBuild=243 prevents NoSuchMethodError crashes on 2023.x IDEs. Upper bound remains unset — the plugin stays forward-compatible with all future IDE builds. Build-only: the Gradle IntelliJ Plugin self-update check is now disabled in gradle.properties so a transient GitHub API failure no longer breaks the build.
  • 1.5.5 — Bug fixes: Browse now uses IntelliJ's built-in single-file chooser, keeps directories visible in the filter for normal navigation, and anchors the dialog to the tool window component while preserving the 1.5.4 no-invokeLater freeze fix. Generated Robust Scaler Python/R code now guards against IQR=0 (prevented silent NaN/Inf, matching Java preview behaviour). Generated R Label Encode is now 0-based (matching pandas factorize and the Java preview; previously was 1-based due to R's factor() convention). Save-script error dialog no longer says "Python file" when saving R output. R button label updated to blue circle emoji. R codegen source path now uses ds.getFilePath() consistently with the Python codegen path.
  • 1.5.4 — Reverted erroneous ApplicationManager.invokeLater wrapper around FileChooser.chooseFiles that was introduced in 1.5.3. The wrapper created a modal-dialog / EDT deadlock that froze the entire IDE on any version with the plugin installed. FileChooser.chooseFiles is already asynchronous and must be called directly from the EDT — no wrapper is needed or safe.
  • 1.5.3 — (Retracted) Attempted Browse-button fix via invokeLater — caused IDE-wide freeze. Superseded by 1.5.4.
  • 1.5.2 — Fixed broken file save dialogs: switched from findFileByNioFile (which silently returned null for unindexed paths) to refreshAndFindFileByNioFile so the Export CSV and Save Script dialogs open reliably on first use. Renamed internal variable pyPath to scriptPath in CodePanel.
  • 1.5.1 — Replace deprecated FileSaverDescriptor varargs constructor with the 2-argument form in both the Export CSV and Save Script dialogs. Default filenames already carry the correct extension so no filter is needed. Eliminates binary compatibility warnings on IntelliJ Platform 2025.1–2026.2 EAP.
  • 1.5.0 — R code generation: one click produces a complete base-R script for all 16 operations; readxl / jsonlite / fastDummies imported only when needed. Fixed critical crash: DataPreprocessorSettings was not registered as an application service, causing a NullPointerException on startup and when opening the settings page. Save button in the Code tab now accepts both .py and .R extensions. Status message added after R code generation.
  • 1.4.0 — Settings page under Tools → Data Preprocessor for preview row limit, default normalization method, and default train/test ratio. Added undo/redo for pipeline edits, copy cleaned data as TSV for spreadsheet paste, save dialogs for cleaned CSV and generated Python script outputs, and stale-export prevention after pipeline changes.
  • 1.3.0 — Robust Scaler (median/IQR, outlier-resistant). UI improvements: step reordering (↑ ↓), column type badges [NUM/TXT/BOOL], pipeline step count badge on tab, row × col count in status bar after Apply, Apply and Generate Python code split into separate buttons, Export CSV disabled until Apply has been run.

Fixed Reload button: re-reads CSV from disk without clearing the pipeline. Path label updates correctly on right-click file open. idea-plugin.name: Flink Reactor
idea-plugin.description:
Manage and monitor Apache Flink clusters from your IDE.

Flink Reactor connects IntelliJ IDEA to your Apache Flink cluster, providing real-time visibility into jobs, task managers, and cluster health without leaving your editor. It also includes a Flink SQL console for interactive queries.

Cluster Monitoring

  • Connect to any Flink cluster via REST API with auto-connect on startup
  • Status bar widget showing connection state and Flink version
  • Cluster overview dashboard with slot availability, task manager count, and job counts by state
  • Searchable cluster configuration viewer with optional grouping by key prefix

Job Management

  • Running and completed jobs in a tabbed view with sortable columns and color-coded state badges
  • Job actions: cancel, trigger savepoint, stop with savepoint
  • Job detail with five tabs: Vertices (operator metrics, backpressure, parallelism), Checkpoints (history, config, counts), Configuration, Exceptions, and Timeline

Task Managers and Job Manager

  • Task manager list with host, slots, heap memory bars, and heartbeat indicators
  • Task manager detail: resource breakdown, JVM metrics (memory, GC, CPU, threads), logs, and thread dumps
  • Job Manager panel with logs, metrics, configuration, JVM details, and thread dumps

Flink SQL Console

  • Quick Query mode with Flink SQL syntax highlighting and tabular results
  • Streaming query support with changelog operations (color-coded INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE rows) and ring buffer for large result sets
  • SQL catalog browser with hierarchical catalog, database, table, and column tree
  • Query history and built-in sample queries

JAR Management

  • Upload, run (with entry class, arguments, parallelism, savepoint path), and delete JARs
  • Auto-detects build artifacts from Gradle and Maven output directories

Developer Integration

  • Clickable stack traces in logs, exceptions, and thread dumps navigate directly to source code
  • Unified log viewer with per-segment syntax highlighting, log level filtering, and auto-scroll

Getting Started

  1. Install the plugin and open Settings > Tools > Flink Reactor
  2. Enter your Flink REST URL (and optionally SQL Gateway URL)
  3. Open the Flink Reactor tool window from the right sidebar

idea-plugin.name: Nextflow Language
idea-plugin.description:
Bring the power of Nextflow to your JetBrains IDE.

This plugin provides enhanced support for Nextflow within JetBrains environments, with a special focus on IntelliJ IDEA and PyCharm. It bridges the gap between official Nextflow tooling and native IDE capabilities.

Features

  • Official Nextflow Language Server Support: Real-time code completion, parameter hints, hover documentation, and error checking directly integrated via the official Nextflow Language Server Protocol (LSP).
  • Native Run & Debug Configurations: Effortlessly create, execute, and remote-debug your Nextflow pipelines directly from the IDE. Includes full support for Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL).
  • Official Syntax Highlighting: Highlights Nextflow-specific syntax (like processes, workflows, channels, and operators) via official TextMate bundle integration.
  • Code Actions & Refactoring: Utilize LSP-powered formatting and specialized actions to convert legacy scripts and pipelines to static types.
  • File Templates: Quickly bootstrap your projects with built-in templates for .nf, .nf.test, and nextflow.config files.
  • Interactive Nextflow Console: Launch an interactive REPL console to test Nextflow logic directly within the IDE.
  • Dedicated Tool Windows: Specialized project and resource panels to better manage and interact with your Nextflow environment.
  • nf-core Support: Integrated support for managing nf-core-based pipelines, with a dedicated tool window (requires nf-core/tools).

Notice for non-IntelliJ IDE Users

  • Richer syntax highlighting requires the Groovy plugin, which is only bundled with the IntelliJ family of IDEs. When official Groovy support is not available, we fall back to only basic groovy syntax highlighting provided by Nextflow TextMate bundles (i.e. less rich IDE interactions will be available).

  • Debugging is only supported through the Java Debugger, which is also only bundled with the IntelliJ family of IDEs. Running pipelines without debugging enabled will still work on, however.

All screenshots on the plugin page were taken from IntelliJ IDEA. If there are unforseen issues not mentioned, please report them to the issue tracker.

idea-plugin.name: YADT - Yet Another dbt Tool
idea-plugin.description:
YADT (Yet Another dbt Tool) adds lineage visualization, code intelligence, and a command runner for dbt projects to JetBrains IDEs — IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, DataSpell, and other IntelliJ-Platform IDEs. It reads your project's compiled manifest.json, so it works with dbt Core and detects and supports the dbt Fusion engine and the dbt Cloud CLI.

Lineage graph

  • Interactive DAG of models, sources, seeds, snapshots, exposures, and tests
  • Drive the graph by typing a dbt selector — tag:, path:, source:, fqn, globs, and graph operators like 2+my_model+ — with autocomplete as you type
  • Click a node to open its file; expand boundary nodes to explore deeper dependencies
  • Build status and source freshness shown on the cards; failing tests flagged separately
  • Group cards by schema, folder, or tag; search nodes and navigate large graphs with the minimap
  • Configurable depth, layout direction, and edge style; adapts to your full IDE theme
  • Copy the visible graph to the clipboard as an image for documentation
  • Auto-updates when the manifest changes

Docs sidebar

Columns, tests, SQL, and metadata for the selected model, side by side with the lineage graph.

Code intelligence

  • Autocompletion — ref(), source(), macro() suggestions with descriptions
  • Go to definition — Ctrl/Cmd+Click a ref() / source() to jump to the file
  • Documentation on hover — columns, materialization, tags, descriptions
  • Annotations — unresolved ref() / source() highlighted as warnings
  • Potentially terminal columns — gutter hint on model output columns that no downstream model or exposure reads
  • Works in .sql, .jinja, and .jinja2 files, and in dbt Charts boards (see below)

dbt Charts boards

  • Completion, hover docs and structural errors for dbt Charts board YAML, from the schema of your installed dct (or an opt-in verified download)
  • ref() / source() completion, go to definition, hover docs and unresolved-reference warnings inside board queries

Runner

  • Run / Build / Test / Compile a single model or any dbt selection
  • Preview rows with dbt show; full-refresh toggle for incremental models
  • Docs generate to rebuild documentation
  • Flags discovered from your installed dbt, target selector, stop button, streaming output log
  • Native OS notifications when commands finish

Editor actions

In the YADT right-click submenu:

  • Copy for Target DB (Cmd+Shift+C) — ref()/source() replaced by database.schema.table
  • Paste as dbt Refs (Cmd+Shift+V) — table names replaced by ref()/source() calls
  • Convert: ref ↔ Relation — turn a selected ref()/source() into its relation name, or back

Not affiliated with or endorsed by dbt Labs. dbt is a trademark of dbt Labs, Inc.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• Lineage: zooming no longer speeds up the longer the tool window is open. The wheel, zoom-button and keyboard zoom handlers were attached again on every graph render, so after N re-renders a single scroll tick or click zoomed N times; they are now attached once
  • Lineage: the hover tooltip shows the node's name again (its title line was always empty)
  • Lineage: nodes whose last run ended in a status YADT doesn't color (for example dbt's no-op) no longer show as failed when the tool window reloads run_results.json; they keep a neutral card, as they already did right after a run
  • Lineage: when a run starts with a tag:, path:, source:, fqn: or wildcard selector, exactly the nodes it builds are marked as queued. Previously only plain model names and + operators were resolved, and any other selector marked every model/seed/snapshot visible in the graph
  • Compatibility: YADT no longer uses any IntelliJ Platform API that JetBrains marks as deprecated or scheduled for removal (flagged against 2026.2 and the 2026.3 EAP), and it now uses the IDE's own Kotlin coroutines instead of bundling a copy — that bundled copy is what kept dbt Charts support from starting on PyCharm 2026.2 in 0.6.0
  • A dbt project added to an open IDE project (a new dbt_project.yml) is now picked up without reopening the project
  • dct and uv are now also found in /usr/local/bin and /opt/homebrew/bin when they aren't on the IDE's PATH

idea-plugin.name: marimo
idea-plugin.description:
marimo is a reactive Python notebook. This plugin brings the full marimo editor inside PyCharm and other JetBrains IDEs, so you can open, edit, and run notebooks without leaving your IDE.

marimo notebooks are stored as plain .py files — no JSON, no hidden output state — so they diff cleanly, review like code, and run as scripts. The plugin detects which Python files are marimo notebooks and opens them in a dedicated reactive editor tab; everything else opens in the normal Python editor.

Features

  • Reactive editor, in the IDE — cells re-run automatically when their inputs change.
  • Interactive widgets — sliders, tables, plots, and other mo.ui elements work inline.
  • SQL cells, variables, and dependency panels — the full marimo experience.
  • Runs on your project interpreter — with a one-click offer to install marimo when it's missing.
  • Isolated sandbox runs — optionally launch a notebook in a one-off uv environment.
  • Pair with marimo — open a pairing prompt in JetBrains AI Chat when available, or attach a terminal harness.
  • Theme-aware — the editor follows your IDE's light/dark theme.

Requirements: PyCharm 2026.1+ (or another JetBrains IDE with the Python plugin) and a configured project interpreter. uv is optional, used only for sandbox runs.

Open source — github.com/marimo-team/jetbrains-marimo.

idea-plugin.name: Client for Trino and Athena
idea-plugin.description:
Run Trino, Presto, and Amazon Athena queries from a tool window in your JetBrains IDE.

The IDE doesn't support these engines natively (the Trino and Athena feature requests have been open in JetBrains' tracker since 2017 and 2018). This plugin is a standalone client that fills that gap. It works in any JetBrains IDE, including the free Community editions, and doesn't need DataGrip or Ultimate.

What you get:

  • A SQL editor with syntax highlighting and completion. Keywords complete as you type, and once a connection is open so do catalog, schema, table, and column names. Typing catalog.schema.table. walks down a level at a time. Ctrl+Enter runs the query.
  • A schema tree for browsing catalogs, schemas, tables, and columns on either engine.
  • For Athena, the status line shows how much data each query scanned and what that works out to in dollars at Athena's per-terabyte rate (including the 10 MB minimum). It's an estimate, but it's there on every query, so a bad WHERE clause shows up before the AWS bill does.
  • Saved connections. Passwords go in the IDE's password safe. Athena uses your existing AWS profile or the default credential chain; the plugin doesn't store AWS keys itself.
  • A results grid, CSV export, and a history of the queries you've run.

Works with Athena and with anything that speaks the Trino protocol (Trino, Presto, Starburst) through the standard Trino JDBC driver. The plugin talks only to the engines you configure; there is no server on our side.

14-day free trial. Bugs and requests: support@getrollupapps.com

idea-plugin.name: STVN Language Support
idea-plugin.description: Provides comprehensive language support for Strongly Typed Value Notation (STVN). Features include syntax highlighting, BNF-based parser inspection, type resolution, diagnostics, and test fixture support.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.3.1 - 2026.09.20

  • Integrated changes to stvnadore-core:1.3.1:
    • Tolerant grammar recovery for empty {} blocks in directives and metadata.
    • Normalized token coordinate spans preventing off-by-one clipping on error squiggles.
    • Enforced package enclave isolation across module boundaries.
    • Restored recursive inlay hints via bounded depth traversal (maxDepth = 16).
    • Added StvnMetadataFacetInspection with automated quick-fixes.

1.3.0 - 2026.09.17

  • Integrated changes to stvnadore-core:1.3.0:
    • Enforced strict Zero-Tab Invariant (ERR_TAB_CHARACTER_FORBIDDEN) across all document parsers.
    • Integrated centralized string capacity bounds (StvnStringCapacityUtils).
    • Added transitive reachability analysis, dead-code pruning in :defs, and universal alias desugaring to FQNI.
    • Added deterministic canonical AST formatting via AstPrettyPrinter and AstCompactPrinter.
  • Value-Oriented Programming (VOP) Rename Refactoring (Shift+F6):
    • Decoupled mutable bare identifiers from immutable syntax kinds, initializing the rename text field with bare names (e.g. AccountHolder, DefaultPort).
    • Projected canonical syntax in dialog headers (Rename Type Declaration ':AccountHolder' and its usages to:), Find Usages trees, and Structure View.
    • Added real-time dialog input validation via StvnRenameInputValidator (RenameInputValidatorEx) rejecting leading : and # with explicit footer guidance and disabling the Refactor button.
    • Established a fail-closed mutator perimeter: invoking setName() or handleElementRename() with leading sigils throws IncorrectOperationException.
    • Implemented dual Search Everywhere indexing for bare and canonical symbols (Ctrl+N / Shift+Shift).
  • Interactive Namespace Dependency Browser (Ctrl+Alt+N / Cmd+Alt+N):
    • Added interactive gutter navigation markers on :defs, :type, and :body section headers.
    • Added a multi-column searchable grid displaying symbol name, namespaced source URI, type structure, and usage resolution depth.
    • Implemented StvnPrioritizedTableSpeedSearch prioritizing Column 0 (Name) declarations over secondary metadata mentions with clean fallback.
    • Supported synthetic standard library navigation via read-only LightVirtualFile.
  • String Capacity Governance Inspection (StvnStringCapacity):
    • Inspects nominal string declarations in :defs and :type sections.
    • Audits unadorned :String tokens and explicit capacities exceeding threshold (default: 4,096).
    • Dual QuickFix Resolution Protocol: rewrites nominal types to configured threshold (:String4096) or default (:String16777216).
    • Suppresses secondary default upgrade QuickFix under ERROR severity.
    • Optional payload scope detecting string literals exceeding declared schema capacity bounds with truncation and widening quick-fixes.
  • Native Code Formatter & Dual Projections:
    • Added native code formatter (Ctrl+Alt+L / Cmd+Alt+L) enforcing canonical 2-space indentation hierarchy and zero tabs while preserving comments and fenced strings.
    • Added editor popup actions to canonicalize or copy pretty-printed and compact STVN projections.
    • Added Authoring Loss Guard dialog intercepting lossy formatting when documents contain comments, package enclaves, or unreferenced definitions.
  • Action Nomenclature & UI Modernization: Harmonized action menu display names and modernized file icons to transparent 2D vector wireframe geometry conforming to JetBrains New UI guidelines.

1.2.0 - 2026.09.12

  • Integrated changes to `stvnadore-core`:
    • Standard prelude relocated to namespace :org/stvnadore/prelude/* and out of root, completely clearing the root namespace
    • Atomic temporal primitives pruned to nominal prelude schemas
    • Package enclosures (:package) with automatic LHS FQNI expansion
    • Scoped :use with atomic unary #strip terminal slicing
    • Hermetic flat payload tier (newly introduced .stvn_f) and flat schema tier (existing .stvn_inclf)
    • Arbitrary bit-width integer overflow enforcement (BigInteger)
    • Updated shared-fixtures conformance suite
  • STVN 1.2 Namespace & Lexical Scope Architecture: Introduced native grammar and editor support for :package enclaves and lexical import statements (:use) with multi-target maps, aliasing, and #strip modifier.
  • Flat Payload Documents (.stvn_f): Registered new .stvn_f file type and parser definition for detached flat payload evaluation without embedded headers.
  • Prelude Standard Library Synchronization: Synchronized with stvnadore-core:1.2.0, transitioning temporal atoms (:DateTimeOffset, :DateTimeZoned, :DateTimeAudited, epoch timestamps) to regex-constrained standard library prelude definitions under :org/stvnadore/prelude/*.
  • 5 New In-Editor Inspections: Implemented real-time inspections for nested package declarations (StvnNestedPackage), trailing slashes in type definitions (StvnTrailingSlash), LHS reserved type keywords (StvnLhsReservedType), :include directives in flat payload documents (StvnFlatDocumentInclude), and out-of-order constant definitions (StvnConstantRange).
  • Precise Error Range Clamping: Clamped external compiler diagnostic ranges directly to offending AST elements across file definitions, resolving error displacement and suppressing cascading parser artifacts.

1.1.1 - 2026.09.07

  • Rule STR-04 Fenced String Delimiter Modernization: Formalized canonical """[TAG] opening delimiter; deprecated legacy """->[TAG] with a LIKE_DEPRECATED strikeout diagnostic and inspection warning.
  • Automated Code Cleanup: Added Remove deprecated '->' arrow intention quick-fix with full IntelliJ batch Code | Code Cleanup support across files and projects.
  • Interactive Tag Renaming (Shift+F6): Implemented live linked editing for opening and closing delimiter tags with bidirectional caret focus retention and delta-aware cursor anchoring.
  • AST Fracture & Collision Guard: Intercepts tag renames that collide with delimiter sequences inside the string payload, preventing AST breakage and rolling back invalid commits.
  • Core Dependency Alignment: Upgraded compiler and runtime engine to stvnadore-core:1.1.1.

1.1.0 - 2026.09.06

  • Implemented enum subset filtering with transitive chaining.
  • Added Control Byte 4 bitwise partitioning (1:3:4) for CRC-32C, SchemaIdentityStrategy, and BinaryEncodingStrategy.

1.0.2 - 2026.09.04

  • Initial General Availability release of STVN Language Support for IntelliJ 2025.3+.
  • Full syntax highlighting for STVN primitives, compounds, and types.
  • Compile-time diagnostics, parser verification, and test fixture support.

Designed to supercharge your code completion with multi-token proposals utilizing a deep learning model. Enjoy the benefits of advanced code completion offline, as it runs on your local device without sending anything over the internet.

We value your feedback

You can upvote existing issues in our YouTrack or log in and create a new one.


Get started in moments

Customize your settings

FAQ

- Do you send my private data or code over the internet?

- What are the plans for supporting additional languages?

- What are the hardware requirements for the plugin?

idea-plugin.name: EliteaCode
idea-plugin.description:
Generate efficient and accurate code with ease using the power of AI. AlitaCode helps you interact with artificial intelligence for a simplified code generation experience in your development workflow.

It enhances your development workflow by providing quick and accurate code generation with just a few clicks and keywords, allowing you to focus your energy on more complex tasks.

Extension Settings

This extension contributes the following settings:

  • AlitaCode: LLM Auth Token: API key for the selected LLM provider
  • AlitaCode: LLM Server URL: URL of the LLM provider server
  • AlitaCode: LLM Model Name: Default model name used for local prompts (Can be overwritten in prompt)
  • AlitaCode: Custom model name: Custom model name that overrides default one (used for flexible configuration)
  • AlitaCode: Project ID (required for Alita only): Project ID for external prompts (ignored for any OpenAI)
  • AlitaCode: Integration UID (required for Alita only): Integration UID for external prompts (ignored for any OpenAI)
  • AlitaCode: Temperature: Default temperature for model (Can be overwritten in prompt)
  • AlitaCode: Max Tokens: Default max tokens for model (Can be overwritten in prompt)
  • AlitaCode: Top P: Default top P for model (Can be overwritten in prompt)
  • AlitaCode: Top K: Default top K for model (Can be overwritten in prompt)
  • AlitaCode: Display Type: replace/append/split representation of the prediction.

Alita Configuration Example

  • Elitea Code plugin is successfully installed;
  • User is successfully logged in into Elitea platform;
  • Elitea platform's configuration page is opened;

  • Fill in inputs 'AlitaCode: Integration UID', 'AlitaCode: LLM Auth Token', 'AlitaCode: LLM Server URL', 'AlitaCode: Project ID';
  • Feel free to adjust AlitaCode: Max Tokens, AlitaCode: Top P, AlitaCode: Top K if needed;

idea-plugin.description:
Devoxx Genie - Your AI-powered coding assistant for IntelliJ IDEA

📖 Full Documentation at genie.devoxx.com

Key Features

  • Local & Cloud LLMs: Ollama, LMStudio, GPT4All, Llama.cpp, Exo + OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral, Groq, DeepInfra, DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM, OpenRouter, Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock
  • Agent Mode: Autonomous code tools with parallel sub-agents, multi-turn tool use, and built-in file/search/run_command tools
  • Skills (new in v1.5.0): Portable SKILL.md files the LLM activates mid-conversation — the same files also work in Claude Code, Codex and Gemini
  • Commands: User-defined slash commands (previously "Custom Prompts") for reusable prompt templates
  • MCP Support: Model Context Protocol with integrated marketplace for installing servers (stdio and HTTP/SSE transports)
  • Spec Driven Development: Backlog.md task management with Spec Browser, Kanban Board, and Agent Loop batch execution with dependency ordering
  • Security Scanning: Run Gitleaks (secrets), OpenGrep (SAST) and Trivy (CVEs) as agent tools — findings auto-create prioritised backlog tasks
  • Inline Code Completion: AI-powered suggestions as you type using Fill-in-the-Middle models via Ollama or LM Studio
  • ACP & CLI Runners: Integrate external agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Kimi, Copilot) via the Agent Communication Protocol or CLI invocation
  • RAG: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for semantic code search (ChromaDB + Ollama embeddings)
  • Web Search: Integrate Google and Tavily search into your prompts
  • Plugin Integration API: Other IntelliJ plugins can send findings to DevoxxGenie at runtime via a reflection-based ExternalPromptService
  • Chat History: Locally stored conversations (SQLite) with parallel conversation tabs
  • Token Cost Calculator: Real-time cost and context-window estimation for cloud providers
  • Multi-modal Support: Drag & drop images for vision models, plus project-context attachments
  • Docker Agentic Platform: CLI integration (preview)

Quick Start

  • Install the plugin
  • For local LLMs: install Ollama, LMStudio, GPT4All, Llama.cpp or Exo
  • For cloud LLMs: add your API keys in Settings → DevoxxGenie → LLM Providers
  • Optional: enable Agent Mode, configure MCP servers from the marketplace, or drop a SKILL.md into .devoxxgenie/skills/, .claude/skills/ or .agents/skills/
  • Start prompting!

Need help? Visit our Getting Started Guide or check the Troubleshooting page.

Privacy & Anonymous Usage Analytics

To guide which LLM providers and models receive engineering investment, DevoxxGenie collects anonymous usage data when you run a prompt or change models.

What is sent:

  • An anonymous install ID (UUID), generated once and stored locally
  • A per-launch session ID (random 10-digit number)
  • Plugin version and IDE version
  • LLM provider name (e.g. anthropic, ollama)
  • LLM model name (e.g. claude-3-5-sonnet)
  • Which optional features are enabled (RAG, Agent mode, MCP, Web Search, streaming) and coarse counts such as the number of configured MCP servers or custom prompts — never server names, URLs, commands, or user-defined prompt names
  • Which features are actually used during a prompt (RAG, Agent, MCP, Web Search, project context, custom prompts) — feature identifiers only, never prompt text or file content

What is never sent: prompt text, response text, conversation history, file content, file paths, project names, git remotes, API keys, credentials, token counts, cost data, MCP server names/URLs/commands, or user-defined custom prompt names.

A first-launch notification asks for your consent before any data is sent. You can change this any time in Settings → DevoxxGenie → Analytics.

Malformed highlight ranges are now discarded, and a code block that cannot be highlighted falls back to unstyled but intact text (#1277)

idea-plugin.name: Databricks
idea-plugin.description:
Databricks

The Databricks integration with PyCharm allows you to build your data and AI apps on the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform directly within the IDE, enhancing the data intelligence platform with the powerful Python IDE by JetBrains.

Features

Write code using smart completion, linters, local debugging, and a handy UI while running it in the cloud without any additional configurations.
The plugin allows you to:
  • Connect to the Databricks cluster directly via PyCharm.
  • Run Jupyter notebooks as Databricks workflows.
  • Run Python scripts as Databricks workflows or on a remote cluster.
  • Synchronize project files to the Databricks workspace.

The plugin requires a Databricks account.

Head over to the documentation to get step-by-step instructions on how to use the plugin.

idea-plugin.name: CodeVista: AI Coding Assistant (FPT Internal)
idea-plugin.description:
CodeVista: Interactive AI-Powered Coding Assistant by FPT Software AI Center

CodeVista, developed by the AI Center at FPT Software, enhances coding efficiency through an AI-driven, interactive prompting interface. Ideal for developers seeking streamlined coding assistance.

Key Features

Interactive Prompting

Engage with CodeVista by asking questions or commanding coding tasks through a simple input box.

Context-Rich Guidance

Utilise your own code as context for tailored assistance by referencing code snippets with @ in your prompts.

Prompt Library

Access over 50 ready-to-use coding prompts for common tasks like explaining, commenting, and fixing code.

Predefined Actions

Use predefined commands such as /explain, /feedback, and /fix for specialised tasks, along with a unique /web_search for integrating Google search results directly into your workflow.

Structured Formatting

Request outputs in various formats including markdown, JSON, and XML, ensuring compatibility with your project requirements.

What can CodeVista do?

Autocompletion

The Autocompletion feature leverages advanced language models to provide intelligent code completion suggestions as you type, enhancing coding efficiency and productivity.

Autodoc

This feature automatically generates docstrings and comments for your code.

Autofix

Autofix provides solutions for errors in your current coding file.

Web Search

CodeVista integrates Google Search to supplement the knowledge of its AI models and provide additional sources of information for users to validate responses.

Inline Chat

CodeVista offers an inline chat feature to ask questions directly within the coding file.

Multi-chat Conversation

CodeVista's multi-chat feature allows separate conversations for different topics. Click 'New conversation' in the chat window to create a new chat box.

All conversations can be viewed in a list. CodeVista automatically suggests names for each conversation, and users can rename or delete chats as needed.

Feedback System

CodeVista provides a feedback system for submitting bug reports or suggestions to the admin team. To submit feedback, type / in the chat window and select the desired feedback option.

  • Select the desired feedback type from the available options.
  • Input information and attach images if necessary.
  • Click to send the feedback once complete.

More Resources

  • Website: https://codevista.ai
  • Tutorial: https://codevista.ai/docs
  • Blog: https://codevista.ai/blog
  • Support: codevista-support@fpt.com
  • Contact: codevista-contact@fpt.com

Terms of Use

  • Terms of use: https://codevista.ai/terms
  • Security and Privacy: https://codevista.ai/security-privacy

idea-plugin.name: Monica Code
idea-plugin.description:
Monica Code

Monica Code is your personal AI assistant for effortless coding and development, powered by ChatGPT API and integrated seamlessly into JetBrains IDEs.

Code Completion

Enjoy real-time code suggestions based on your cursor location and comments as you code. Monica Code understands your project context and provides intelligent autocomplete options, helping you write code faster and with fewer errors.

Code Editing

Select any code snippet and update it with a simple prompt. Easily modify functions, rewrite entire classes, or refactor your code. Monica Code understands your intentions and helps you implement changes quickly and accurately.

Integrated Composer

Simply ask Monica Code to create or edit multiple files, and navigate through different composed versions. This powerful feature allows you to manage complex code changes across multiple files with ease, helping you maintain a clear overview of your project structure.

Getting Started

Monica Code leverages advanced AI models like GPT-4o and Claude 3.5 Sonnet to provide top-tier code generation, debugging, and explanation capabilities. Supporting over 20 programming languages including C++, Go, Java, JavaScript, Python, and TypeScript, Monica Code is your ultimate coding companion.

To get started with Monica Code, visit our official website for installation instructions and documentation.

Features

  • Intelligent Code Generation: Describe your project requirements in natural language, and Monica Code will produce tailored code solutions.
  • Multi-Language Support: Seamlessly work with a wide range of programming languages.
  • Advanced AI Models: Powered by state-of-the-art AI, including GPT-4o and Claude 3.5 Sonnet.
  • Integrated Development Experience: Enjoy AI-assisted coding directly within your JetBrains IDE environment.
  • Integrated Composer: Simply ask Monica Code to create or edit multiple files, and navigate through different composed versions with ease.
  • Commit Message Generation: Monica Code can generate commit messages based on your code changes, helping you maintain a clean and organized version control history.(prompt configuration is in the config.json)

Support

For additional questions or support, please contact us.

Acknowledgment

Monica Code is developed based on the Continue project. We appreciate the Continue team for their open-source contribution, which has made Monica Code possible. Continue is licensed under the Apache 2.0 License, which allows for secondary development, enabling us to bring you this enhanced coding experience.

idea-plugin.name: Elitea
idea-plugin.description:
Generate efficient and accurate code with ease using the power of AI. ELITEA Code helps you interact with artificial intelligence for a simplified code generation experience in your development workflow.

ELITEA Code is a powerful extension that accelerates your code generation process through an interactive AI experience and flexible integration with ELITEA platform. It enhances your development workflow by providing quick and accurate code generation with just a few clicks and keywords, allowing you to focus your energy on more complex tasks.

Compatibility

Important: The ELITEA Code plugin is incompatible with the previous versions of Alita Code and Alita Code Chat plugins. Please ensure these plugins are uninstalled before installing ELITEA Code to avoid conflicts.

Extension Settings

This extension contributes the following settings:

  • ELITEA Code: LLM Auth Token: API key for the selected LLM provider (required)
  • ELITEA Code: LLM Server URL: URL of the LLM provider server (required)
  • ELITEA Code: Project ID: Project ID for external prompts (required)
  • ELITEA Code: LLM Model Name: Default model name used for local prompts (Can be overwritten in prompt)
  • ELITEA Code: Temperature: Default temperature for model (Can be overwritten in prompt)
  • ELITEA Code: Max Tokens: Default max tokens for model (Can be overwritten in prompt)
  • ELITEA Code: Top P: Default top P for model (Can be overwritten in prompt)
  • ELITEA Code: Top K: Default top K for model (Can be overwritten in prompt)
  • ELITEA Code: Display Type: replace/append/split representation of the prediction
  • ELITEA Code: Custom model name: Custom model name that overrides default one (used for flexible configuration)

ELITEA Configuration Example

  • ELITEA Code plugin is successfully installed;
  • User is successfully logged in into ELITEA platform;
  • ELITEA platform's configuration page is opened;
  • Go to Intellij Settings → Tools → ELITEA: Settings;
  • Fill in inputs 'ELITEA Code: LLM Auth Token', 'ELITEA Code: LLM Server URL', 'ELITEA Code: Project ID';
  • Click at Load integrations button and select required integration and model;
  • Feel free to adjust ELITEA Code: Max Tokens, ELITEA Code: Top P, ELITEA Code: Top K if needed;
  • Click Apply and OK.
  • See more about ELITEA at ELITEA platform guide
  • Plugin's configuration details: ELITEA Code configuration for a proper plugin setup.

idea-plugin.name: Capi Copy
idea-plugin.description:
Capi Copy is a powerful developer tool designed to bridge the gap between your IDE and AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini. Instantly capture file paths, metadata, and source code — and choose the output format that best fits your AI model.

⚡ Quick Summary

  • Smart Copy: Instantly copy file path + source code in an AI-optimized format.
  • Multi-Format Output: Choose between XML Hybrid, Markdown, or Minimal — per AI model.
  • Token Efficiency: Auto-compresses unnecessary whitespaces and newlines to save LLM tokens.
  • Action: Ctrl/Cmd + Shift + Alt + Q (Double-press within 0.5s to copy all open files).
  • Support: Windows & macOS (Intel/Apple Silicon) with auto path normalization.

Tired of manually formatting code for ChatGPT or Gemini? Capi Copy copies your code, file path, and line numbers into a perfect AI-ready prompt with a single shortcut — in the format your AI model understands best.

🚀 Key Features

  • Multi-Format Output Engine (v1.4.0): Three output formats selectable from Settings:
    • 🔷 XML Hybrid (V3.2): Structured XML with rich metadata — optimized for Claude / Anthropic.
    • 📝 Markdown: Clean headers + code fences — best for GPT-4, Gemini, and universal use.
    • ⚡ Minimal: Compact bracket header — maximizes token efficiency for any model.
  • Selective Copy: Copy only the selected code block, automatically appending line numbers to the metadata.
  • Bulk Copy: Double-click the shortcut to merge and copy all open files instantly.
  • Token Optimization: Automatically strips consecutive empty lines to maximize prompt efficiency.
  • Cross-Platform: Auto-converts Windows backslashes (\) to AI-friendly slashes (/).

📋 Output Format Examples

XML Hybrid — for Claude:

<repository_context>
  <file_context>
    <metadata>
      <path>src/app.ts</path><language>typescript</language>
      <range>Full</range><status>Active</status>
    </metadata>
    <content>```typescript
...
```</content>
  </file_context>
</repository_context>

Markdown — for GPT-4 / Gemini:

## `src/app.ts` · typescript · Full · Active

```typescript
...
```

Minimal — token-efficient:

[src/app.ts | typescript | Full | Active]
```typescript
...
```

💛 If you enjoy this plugin, please support me with a cup of coffee!

🌐 Supported Languages

[🇰🇷 한국어] Capi Copy는 파일 경로·메타데이터·소스 코드를 AI에 최적화된 형식으로 즉시 복사하는 도구입니다. XML Hybrid(Claude), Markdown(GPT-4/Gemini), Minimal(토큰 절약) 세 가지 출력 포맷을 지원합니다.

[🇯🇵 日本語] Capi Copy は、ファイルパスとソースコードを AI プロンプト用にワンショットでコピーするツールです。XML Hybrid・Markdown・Minimal の3つの出力フォーマットから選択できます。

[🇨🇳 简体中文] Capi Copy 可将文件路径和源代码一键复制为 AI 提示词。支持 XML Hybrid、Markdown、Minimal 三种输出格式，适配不同 AI 模型。
idea-plugin.change-notes:
v1.4.1 - Documentation Update

[🇺🇸 English]

  • 📄 Improved Plugin Description:
    Added output format examples and a format comparison table to the marketplace description.
  • 🌐 Multilingual Description Update:
    Updated Korean, Japanese, and Chinese descriptions to reflect the new multi-format output engine.

[🇰🇷 한국어]

  • 📄 플러그인 설명 개선:
    마켓플레이스 설명에 출력 포맷별 예시 코드 및 비교 설명을 추가했습니다.
  • 🌐 다국어 설명 갱신:
    한국어·일본어·중국어 설명을 멀티 포맷 엔진 기준으로 업데이트했습니다.

v1.4.0 - Multi-Format Output Engine

[🇺🇸 English]

  • 🔷 XML Hybrid (V3.2) [Default — unchanged]:
    Existing structured XML format with rich metadata (path, language, range, status). Optimized for Claude / Anthropic. No changes to existing behavior.
  • 📝 Markdown (New):
    Markdown heading + fenced code block output. Best for GPT-4, Gemini, and universal LLM use. Widely supported across all major AI tools.
  • ⚡ Minimal (New):
    Compact bracket-style header with fenced code block. Minimizes metadata overhead for maximum token efficiency.
  • ⚙️ Settings UI:
    New "Output Format" panel added to Settings → Tools → Capi Copy Settings, alongside the existing "Copy Options" panel.
  • 🌐 Localization:
    Output format labels available in 5 languages: English, Korean, Japanese, Chinese, and German.

[🇰🇷 한국어]

  • 🔷 XML Hybrid (V3.2) [기본값 유지]:
    기존 구조화된 XML 포맷(경로·언어·범위·상태 메타데이터 포함). Claude / Anthropic 최적화. 기존 동작이 그대로 유지됩니다.
  • 📝 Markdown (신규):
    마크다운 헤더 + 코드 펜스 방식. GPT-4, Gemini 및 범용 LLM에 최적화된 포맷입니다.
  • ⚡ Minimal (신규):
    브래킷 헤더 방식으로 메타데이터 오버헤드를 최소화. 토큰 절약이 필요한 환경에 적합합니다.
  • ⚙️ 설정 UI 추가:
    Settings → Tools → Capi Copy Settings에 "Output Format" 패널이 추가되었습니다.
  • 🌐 로컬라이제이션:
    출력 포맷 레이블을 한국어·일본어·중국어·독일어·영어 5개 언어로 제공합니다.

v1.3.0 - Stability & IDE Compatibility

[🇺🇸 English]

  • 🔧 Bug Fix — ContextFormatter Immutable List Crash:
    Fixed UnsupportedOperationException thrown when an immutable list (e.g. List.of()) was passed to format().
  • 🧹 Code Cleanup:
    Removed unused wrapButton() method and unnecessary imports.
  • 🌐 IDE Compatibility:
    Removed untilBuild upper limit — now compatible with IntelliJ 2026.1 and all future versions.

[🇰🇷 한국어]

  • 🔧 버그 수정 — ContextFormatter 불변 리스트 크래시:
    불변 리스트(예: List.of())를 전달했을 때 발생하던 UnsupportedOperationException을 수정했습니다.
  • 🧹 코드 정리:
    사용되지 않는 wrapButton() 메서드 및 불필요한 import를 제거했습니다.
  • 🌐 IDE 호환성 확장:
    untilBuild 상한을 제거하여 IntelliJ 2026.1 이상 모든 미래 버전과 호환됩니다.

v1.2.0 - AI Context Architecture Refactoring

[🇺🇸 English]

  • 🧬 V3.2 XML-Hybrid Schema:
    Wraps file data in structured XML — Gemini, Claude, and GPT can now parse path, language, range, and status metadata with far greater accuracy.
  • 🔋 Token Optimization (Token Density):
    Automatically compresses consecutive blank lines and whitespace-only lines, allowing more code to fit within token limits.
  • 🧠 Smart Context Enhancement:
    Active file is placed first in multi-file output; selection line numbers are included so AI understands the developer's current focus precisely.
  • 🏗️ Architecture Refactoring:
    Fully decoupled UI from core logic — foundation laid for future logic sharing with the VS Code extension.
  • 🛠️ Build Stability:
    Fixed compilation errors occurring in certain JDK environments and modernized the build pipeline.

[🇰🇷 한국어]

  • 🧬 V3.2 XML-Hybrid 스키마 도입:
    단순 마크다운 방식을 넘어 XML 구조로 데이터를 래핑하여, Gemini/Claude/GPT가 소스 코드의 구조와 메타데이터를 훨씬 더 정확하게 파싱할 수 있도록 개선했습니다.
  • 🔋 토큰 효율 최적화 (Token Density):
    불필요한 연속 개행 및 공백 줄을 자동으로 압축하여, 동일한 토큰 제한 내에서 더 많은 코드를 전달할 수 있도록 최적화했습니다.
  • 🧠 지능형 컨텍스트 강화:
    현재 작업 중인 파일(Active)을 최상단에 배치하고, 선택 영역의 줄 번호 정보를 포함하여 AI가 개발자의 현재 맥락을 완벽히 이해하도록 돕습니다.
  • 🏗️ 아키텍처 리팩터링:
    UI와 로직을 완전히 분리하여 성능을 개선하고, 향후 VS Code 확장 버전과의 로직 공유를 위한 기반을 마련했습니다.
  • 🛠️ 빌드 안정성 강화:
    일부 JDK 환경에서 발생하던 컴파일 오류를 수정하고 빌드 파이프라인을 최신화했습니다.

v1.1.2 - macOS Optimization & Cross-Platform Update

[🇺🇸 English]

  • 🍎 macOS Native Shortcut Support:
    Added native keymap support for Mac users! You can now use Cmd + Shift + Option + Q comfortably without mapping issues.
  • 🛣️ AI-Friendly Path Formatting:
    File paths on Windows are now automatically standardized to use forward slashes (/) instead of backslashes. This ensures consistent, escape-character-free paths that are optimized for LLM prompts (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini).
  • ✨ Improved Compatibility:
    Enhanced cross-platform stability to ensure the plugin works identically on both Windows and macOS.

[🇰🇷 한국어]

  • 🍎 macOS 네이티브 단축키 지원:
    Mac 사용자를 위한 전용 키맵이 추가되었습니다! 이제 키 매핑 문제 없이 Cmd + Shift + Option + Q를 자연스럽게 사용할 수 있습니다.
  • 🛣️ AI 친화적 경로 포맷 (Path Normalization):
    Windows 환경에서도 파일 경로의 백슬래시(\)를 슬래시(/)로 자동 변환하여 복사합니다. 이를 통해 ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini 등이 경로를 더 정확하게 인식할 수 있습니다.
  • ✨ 크로스 플랫폼 호환성 강화:
    Windows와 macOS 어디서든 동일하고 안정적인 사용자 경험을 제공하도록 내부 로직을 개선했습니다.

idea-plugin.name: Wrap
idea-plugin.description:
Wrap is a launcher for AI coding assistants and custom shell commands.

Configure a wrapper.json file in your project root to define categories of commands and prompts. Access them instantly from the status bar or via Tools → Wrap: Show Menu to launch AI tools (Claude, Codex, Gemini, Coder, Hermes, etc.) in integrated terminals, or send predefined prompts to already-running AI sessions.

Features

  • Two-level popup menu: category → action
  • Run shell commands in a dedicated integrated terminal tab
  • Send prompt text directly to an active terminal (for interactive AI CLIs)
  • WSL (Windows Subsystem for Linux) support per-command
  • Configurable wrapper.json path via Settings → Tools → Wrap

Quick Start

Create wrapper.json in your project root:

[
  {
    "useWsl": ["Claude", "Codex"],
    "Command": [{ "Claude": "claude", "Codex": "codex" }],
    "Content":  [{ "Git Push": "Please commit and push all changes to origin/main" }]
  }
]

Then click Wrap in the status bar to get started.
idea-plugin.change-notes: • 0.0.1 — Initial release, ported from the VSCode extension.

idea-plugin.name: GGUF Editor
idea-plugin.description:
View, inspect, search, and edit GGUF model metadata from JetBrains IDEs.

Features

  • Inspect metadata keys, values, tensor names, tensor shapes, and quantization types

  • Edit metadata values and tensor names
  • Hide or delete tensor rows from the current editor session
  • Save changes to a new GGUF file while preserving tensor data
  • Configurable maximum displayed array elements

idea-plugin.name: Shpe
idea-plugin.description:
Important Note for Editor: This extension/plugin requires the core Python CLI tool to function. Please make sure you run pip install shpe in your environment!

A lightweight static analyzer for tracking and validating NumPy tensor shapes. It automatically infers and shows shapes, so you do not need manual shape comments anymore. It catches shape errors directly in your editor before you even run your code, and you can also integrate it into your CI/CD pipeline.

Install

Requires Python 3.12+.

pip install shpe

or with uv:

uv add shpe

Search for shpe in the VS Code Marketplace. or PyCharm Marketplace.

CLI

import numpy as np

a = np.zeros((3, 2))
b = np.ones((2, 2))
c = a + b

shpe examples/intro.py

examples/intro.py:15: [Elementwise] cannot combine a (3, 2) and b (2, 2) with element-wise operator.
examples/intro.py:17: [MatMul] cannot multiply d (3, 2) and a (3, 2): inner dimensions must match (2 != 3).
examples/intro.py:18: [Annotation] f annotated as (3, 2), but expression has the shape (2, 3).

Found 3 error(s) across 1 file(s).

Pass files or directories (*.py). --show-shapes prints inferred shapes and scalars. Exit code 1 if any shape error is reported. Skip a line with # shpe: ignore.

examples/demo.py shows more of what is inferred and what is not.

What is checked

  • Array creation (np.array, np.zeros, np.ones, random helpers, …)
  • Annotated[np.ndarray, (rows, cols)] vs the inferred expression
  • Element-wise + - * / (broadcast) and @ (matmul)
  • Simple user functions and scalars used as dimensions

If shpe is uncertain, it does not infer a shape. No control flow (if / for / while), no recursion, and only a subset of NumPy. Inplace updates such as a.resize(...) are not modeled.

Bugs and requests: GitHub Issues.

Development

See CONTRIBUTING.md and docs/architecture.md.

idea-plugin.name: Flutter Enhancement Suite
idea-plugin.description:
Simplify pubspec.yaml management, auto-complete pub packages & view package's changelogs, and documentation. Boost your workflow with editor features like parameter name and variable type hints, widget creation & extraction, snippets, and icon previews.

Download now to enhance your Flutter development experience!

pubspec.yaml Features

Autocomplete Pub Packages

When you're adding a new package to your pubspec.yaml file, the plugin will figure out what you're looking for. When pressing enter the package with its current version number will appear magically!

To help you with choosing a pub package or plugin, the number of likes will be shown behind them. If the plugin is a "Flutter Favorite", the thumbs up icon is highlighted.

Update Pub Packages

Whenever there's a new version available for a package, it will tell you. Just press alt+⮐ or ⌥+⮐ and choose "Update package".

View Pub Package's Documentation

Just hover over the package's name in the pubspec.yaml - it's as easy as that!

View Pub Package's Changelog

You want to update a package but don't know what has changed in the meantime?

No problem! Just hover over its version number to view the changelog.

Open a package's page on pub.dev

No more need to copy a package's name and pasting it into the searchbar on pub.dev!

No you can just get there by pressing ctrl+B or ⌘+B while the cursor is on the package's name.

Editor Features

Parameter Name Hints

When opting for non-named parameters, the plugin supports you by displaying parameter names alongside matching arguments during method calls.

Variable Type Hints

Show the type of variable as an inlay hint next to it.

Use the toggle in the settings (Editor | Inlay Hints | Types | Dart) to show it before or after the variable's name.

Insights of Usages, Implementations and Code Contributors

Gain visibility into the frequency of usage for your classes, functions, and variables within your codebase and track code contributors effortlessly for VCS-enabled projects.

Quickly make classes, functions and variables private or public

For all of you who got tired pressing ⇧+F6 and adding or removing the underscore: You're finally redeemed!

Just use alt+⮐ or ⌥+⮐ to make it private or public.

Extract widgets to a new file

Just use ctrl+alt+E or ⌘+⌥+⮐ to extract the widget to a new file.

Generate Widgets

When creating a new file, choose the "New Flutter Widget" option. Enter the name for your widget and select its type.

Easily navigate around

Shows breadcrumbs in your editor to easily navigate through Dart files.

Dart & Flutter Code Snippets

A bunch of snippets/LiveTemplates for quicker coding. Use ctrl+Q or F1 when hovering over a snippet to get a preview of it.

  • Dart snippets (Show snippets)
  • Flutter snippets (Show snippets)
  • Flutter Hooks snippets (Show snippets)

Icon Previews

Preview icons from different icon packs in the sidebar.

Please note: This requires you to add the package flutter_vector_icons to your pub dependencies. The only compatible iconpacks for now are FontAwesome, Ionicons and MaterialCommunityIcons.

idea-plugin.name: Quarkus Tools
idea-plugin.description:
A plugin aimed at Quarkus based development, providing easy bootstrapping and code assist from Quarkus related assets and Qute.

To provide those support, the plugin consumes:

  • MicroProfile Language Server
  • Qute Language Server

by using LSP4IJ (Language Server Protocol for Intellij).

idea-plugin.name: YAML Templates
idea-plugin.description:
Adds support for YAML completion based on user-defined templates.

How it works

  • Create a new .yaml-templates folder in the root of your project.
  • Start definining templates.
  • Each template should have a prefix: key, defining the autocomplete lookup prefix, and a data: key, containing the data that will be inserted
  • There can be multiple templates in one file, separated by ---
    Each one should have a prefix and data key
  • Autocomplete also looks for the content of the templates, as well as the prefix name

Example:

prefix: template
data:
  my:
    data: here

idea-plugin.name: StackSpot AI
idea-plugin.description:
StackSpot AI: JetBrains Extension

Welcome to the StackSpot AI JetBrains Extension! StackSpot AI transforms your IDE environment into a multi-agent platform, empowering developers to build and orchestrate AI-driven workflows using contextual knowledge and external tools.

Features

  • Knowledge Sources: Add hyper-contextualized Knowledge Sources. Connect your Agents to your organization's standards, documentation, APIs, models, or databases. Get tailored answers, not generic completions, aligned with your codebase and business rules.
  • Agents: Easily create custom Agents using a low-code, user-friendly interface. You can design Agents that automate your daily development workflows. Connect them to Knowledge Sources and share them across your team or workspace.
  • Tools integration: Connect multiple services and simplify your workflow. To extend Agent capabilities, integrate with tools like project management platforms, ticketing systems, image generators, web search, and data extraction utilities.
  • Quick Commands (QC): Automate tasks in a few clicks. Refactor code, extract logs, translate snippets, or run custom routines directly from the IDE, hassle-free.

Try it now to make your development life cycle easier!

Installation

You can easily install the StackSpot AI JetBrains extension from the JetBrains Marketplace.

Step 1. Press 'Ctrl+Alt+S' to open settings and then select Plugins. (MacOS: Press '⌘Cmd + ,' to open settings and choose Plugins).

Step 2. Click the Marketplace tab and type the plugin name StackSpot AI in the search field.

Step 3. To install the plugin, click Install and restart IntelliJ IDEA.

Step 4. Open StackSpot AI and log in with your GitHub, Microsoft, or Google account.

Getting Started

  1. Open the Extension. To open the extension, click the StackSpot AI icon in your IDE's toolbar.
  2. Log in to your StackSpot AI account. If you are new, you can create a new one using your Google, Microsoft, or GitHub account.
  3. Test the available Agents directly from the extension.
  4. Explore more. For more features, visit the StackSpot AI Portal. You can create Agents, Knowledge Sources, Quick Commands, Toolkits, and more there.

Use Cases

What can you do with StackSpot AI?

  • Generate and refactor code following your organization's standards.
  • Query APIs, documentation, and datasets using Knowledge Sources.
  • Automate repetitive workflows through Quick Commands.
  • Build and share multi-agent systems that collaborate on complex tasks.
  • Extend the IDE with connected tools from image generation to data extraction.

Feedback and Support

We appreciate your feedback! If you encounter any issues, have suggestions, or wish to report a bug, please don't hesitate to contact our support team at https://zup.service-now.com/stackspot.

Privacy and Security

StackSpot AI follows strict privacy rules and data-handling standards. Your prompts, Agents, and connected tools run securely within your development environment. For more information, check:

  • StackSpot's Terms and Agreements
  • Privacy Policy

License

This software is available for free with a StackSpot account and may not be reproduced or distributed by third parties.

idea-plugin.name: Codelines: AI Engineer for real-world coding tasks
idea-plugin.description:
Codelines: AI Engineer for real-world coding tasks

Welcome to the Codelines Jetbrains IDE plugin! This plugin provides a suite of tools to enhance your coding experience in Jetbrains IDE, making it easier to carry out your working tasks.

Features

Codelines utilizes the power of AI to provide you with the ability to automatically execute various coding tasks using your source code.

Usage

1. Enter OpenAI API key

To work with Codelines, you need to enter your OpenAI API key. You can create API key in OpenAI console

2. Ask to execute coding task

Start a new chat with Codelines to ask it to execute any coding task using your source code.

3. Review changes in source control

After task completion, view "Source Control" sidebar to see changes.

Pricing

The Codelines plugin is completely free; we do not require you to provide a credit card, and all features are available immediately after installation. However, Codelines uses OpenAI's LLM, and at the moment, only the OpenAI API can be utilized. Therefore, to work with Codelines, an OpenAI key is required, which is not free.

Privacy

The Codelines plugin does not send any code or requests to its own backend. The only data sent are analytical events for purposes such as measuring DAU and detecting errors.

However, for online functionality, an LLM provider is required, and currently, the only supported provider is OpenAI. Therefore, to work with the extension, parts of the source code as well as task descriptions are sent to the OpenAI API.

If you want to use Codelines with your own LLM server or local LLM, please contact Denis Grachev in LinkedIn.

Support and Feedback

For support or to provide feedback, please join our Discord community. We're always looking to improve and appreciate your input!

  • 支持 200 种语言及框架生成，20 多种语法深度学习，31+种补全策略，支持注释描述的补全，变量补全，函数补全等，按照 Enter 回车补全，Tab 一键采纳 With compatibility for 200+ programming languages and frameworks, deep learning models trained on 20+ syntax types, and 31+ intelligent completion strategies—including comment-driven suggestions, variable name generation, and function implementation—seamlessly integrate suggestions by pressing Enter and instantly accept them with Tab.

idea-plugin.change-notes:
Changelog

[4.12.1]

  • 新增 CodeWiki 子代理，可生成项目文档并写入工作区 .codewiki 目录
  • 新增 CodeWiki 委派前的高额积分确认
  • 新增团队模板能力，团队模式支持成员轮次上限
  • 新增命令卡片自动运行下拉的「所有对话自动运行」选项
  • 新增被步数上限中断时的明确提示与一键继续
  • 新增专享版企业下载源接入
  • 新增插件更新下载的 CDN 候选地址与逐级降级
  • 新增 CloudStudio 工具的启用、停用开关，默认关闭
  • 新增 JCEF 渲染设置三项开关
  • 新增低内存时提示用户重置插件
  • 优化 Agent Token 消耗，内置工具改为按需延迟加载，系统提示词与 Skill、MCP 描述大幅精简
  • 优化上下文压缩策略，微压缩改为临近水位才触发，避免击穿前缀缓存
  • 优化 Agent 最大步数默认上限，由 100/500 提升至 2000
  • 优化会话标题长度上限，由 30 提升至 120
  • 优化 Git 提交消息生成效果
  • 优化流式回答的界面推送，合并冗余快照后传输量大幅下降
  • 优化文件变更树计算与持久化写入，缓解切换对话标签卡顿
  • 优化会话索引与历史落盘，减少扩展宿主主线程阻塞
  • 优化延迟加载工具的卡片展示与审批入口
  • 优化消息区打开与切换时的闪烁
  • 优化安全删除的批量执行性能
  • 优化项目记忆迁移，改为一次性动作
  • 优化文件事件转发，消除大 Maven 工作区下的重导入风暴
  • 优化撤销操作，改为逐 hunk 反向合并
  • 修复长会话下单步输出被异常压缩导致的空转死循环
  • 修复 Plan 模式在子代理挂起时反复重试昂贵操作的问题
  • 修复确认卡不出现、任务假卡死、点历史会话导致当前标签被顶替的问题
  • 修复恢复历史后 Task 卡片永久显示运行中的问题
  • 修复长任务期间消息区滞后于实际执行的问题
  • 修复长任务卡死时停止按钮失效、输入框没有光标的问题
  • 修复子 Agent 等待确认按钮不显示、审批入口缺失的问题
  • 修复高积分操作确认浮层丢失或重复弹出的问题
  • 修复 Team 模式成员消息丢失、成员被误报「用户已取消」的问题
  • 修复 CodeWiki 目录生成失败不重试、停止命令不可见等问题
  • 修复自定义或第三方模型思考强度与温度不生效的问题
  • 修复 MCP 服务描述过长导致子 Agent 请求体膨胀报错的问题
  • 修复窗口失焦期间的回复需手动切换标签才显示的问题
  • 修复 diff 审阅同一变更重复渲染的问题
  • 修复执行命令卡片空白、长参数工具卡片不可见的问题
  • 修复 @ 文件或目录引用在排队消息中被静默丢弃的问题
  • 修复多会话共享工作区时文件变更跨会话串味的问题
  • 修复共享会话触发重复刷新、企业接口 401 误触发全局登出的问题
  • 修复后端返回的原始错误信息被笼统提示覆盖的问题
  • 修复消息队列激活状态丢失导致上一轮结束后不自动开始的问题
  • 修复远程恢复旧会话后历史文件被误判为已删除的问题
  • 修复已删除文件的变更 diff 展示异常的问题
  • 修复首次文件搜索提前返回空结果的问题
  • 修复大量文件变更保存的平方级开销
  • 修复 Hooks 重复加载与技能扫描阻塞扩展宿主的问题
  • 修复卡片长文本溢出导致对话面板横向滚动的问题
  • 修复企业 TLS 拦截场景下的网络链路握手失败
  • 修复项目级 Hooks 与项目级 MCP 配置被永久禁用的问题
  • 修复生成提交信息失败后提交框永久卡死的问题
  • 修复 fusion 进程重启后聊天面板永久卡在加载中的问题
  • 修复 CLion 上状态栏永久转圈的问题
  • 修复右键「添加到对话」失灵、Rider 资源管理器缺失该菜单的问题
  • 修复 macOS 无法拖拽文件到聊天输入框的问题
  • 修复插件自升级包未落持久目录导致升级后插件消失的问题
  • 修复打包后 updatePlugins.xml 残留并被改成非法 XML 的问题
  • 修复插件市场 internal API 使用异常的问题

[4.12.0]

  • 新增多根工作区支持，可在一个窗口同时打开多个项目目录，AI 能同时理解全部项目的规则、技能与文件
  • 统一插件与 Skill 市场，支持浏览、搜索、分类筛选与统一管理已安装能力，新增市场自动更新与预安装插件「仅更新」配置项
  • 快捷设置新增「查看日志」入口，可直接复制业务日志到 IDEA 日志目录并打开
  • 新增自定义 Agent 单独配置思考强度与思考开关
  • 新增 Hook 在工具执行后改写结果并让 AI 感知改写内容
  • 新增历史会话批量导出/导入（zip）与置顶
  • 新增终端选中内容加入对话时折叠为紧凑引用胶囊
  • 新增处理完一处 AI 改动后自动跳转下一处未决变更
  • 新增生图/生视频等高积分操作前置确认，支持「本次会话始终允许」
  • 新增模型选择器直接打开本地 models.json 配置文件入口
  • 新增查看与删除已部署的 CloudStudio 环境
  • 新增 Codebase Search 工具启用/禁用开关
  • 新增终端命令静默执行开关（默认保持静默）
  • 命令执行按钮文案统一为「后台运行」
  • 旗舰版账号首次使用独享通道模型时给出提示
  • 优化会话标签首次切换的卡顿，优化首屏加载速度与长会话下的消息传输体积
  • 优化消息列表渲染性能，加强大结果集/大文件场景下的内存占用防护，缓解长会话卡死与闪退
  • 优化文件监听机制，缓解长期使用后文件改动检测失效、内存暴涨与卡死的问题
  • 优化会话 ID 与系统提示词稳定性，提升大模型缓存命中率；优化配置轮询为按需拉取，减少无效网络请求
  • 修复聊天区随机白屏、文件树右键选文件后列表回调卡住的问题
  • 修复插件市场部分来源数据拉不到、快速切换来源重复请求的问题
  • 修复自定义/第三方模型思考强度不生效、部分推理模型请求报错、请求缺少统一标识的问题
  • 修复自定义 Agent 无法创建与调度 Agent Team 的问题
  • 修复配置多个 UserPromptSubmit Hook 时附加上下文只生效最后一个的问题
  • 修复 Hook 阻断敏感输入后可通过「重试」绕过拦截的问题
  • 新增项目级 MCP 服务启动前的审批确认，工作空间信任默认开启
  • 修复 delete_file 与「文件删除」安全规则互相矛盾的问题，改由「自动执行」统一决定
  • 修复切换工作区后模型列表未及时按敏感仓库策略刷新的问题
  • 修复积分余额个别格式显示异常、网络超时结果被固化的问题
  • 优化历史会话导入导出交互，修复悬浮提示错位与个别归档文件无法导入的问题
  • 修复对话页字体大小设置超出合理范围的问题
  • 修复图像生成/语言服务开关设置不生效的问题
  • 修复变更列表无法感知终端命令删除文件、点文件名与「查看变更」行为不一致的问题
  • 修复切换会话 Tab 时模型/Max 模式/思考强度互相串味的问题
  • 修复「关闭全部」标签后界面空白、切换会话后输入框未自动聚焦的问题
  • 修复粘贴或恢复超长文本导致 IDE 卡死的问题
  • 修复聊天面板资源加载失败时永久卡在「正在加载」、没有重试入口的问题
  • 修复 Windows 下执行含中文命令时输出乱码的问题
  • 修复拖拽文件到聊天框被保存到临时目录而非项目目录的问题
  • 修复输入框粘贴长文本后视图跳到对话顶部、撤销时把手动输入内容一起清空的问题
  • 修复使用不可用模型触发自动重试时用户消息重复显示的问题
  • 修复通过「/」加中文标点无法触发 Skill 列表的问题
  • 修复排队消息未改动内容发送时被防重复逻辑吞掉的问题
  • 修复模式选择器提示气泡、Tokens 明细浮窗、模型选择器下拉被遮挡等显示问题
  • 修复 Plan 任务列表长文本不换行、回复状态区撑宽消息气泡的问题
  • 修复 Plan 模式下计划文件被反复改写陷入死循环的问题
  • 修复子代理结果超长被截断为空白、使用代码索引类能力时卡在「加载中」的问题
  • 修复团队模式下成员汇报消息丢失导致主 Agent 永久挂起的问题
  • 修复长期使用后文件监听句柄耗尽导致文件改动检测失效的问题
  • 修复管理员禁用的模型仍被恢复为选中状态、旧会话模型标识错乱的问题
  • 修复自动化任务窗口模型列表未按白名单过滤的问题
  • 修复独立终端（StandaloneTerminal）状态快照膨胀导致命令卡死的问题
  • 修复命令执行器依赖进程关闭事件导致挂起、失败输出丢失的问题
  • 修复后台会话工具审批卡不下发、切换标签后危险命令授权弹窗不出现的问题
  • 修复 Agents 窗口「自动运行」只生效一次、子 Agent 关闭自动运行后命令确认卡死的问题
  • 修复多个写入排队时误报超时、批量写入大量文件卡住的问题
  • 修复读取空文件没有明确提示的问题
  • 修复 Ask 模式下反复探索陷入死循环的问题
  • 修复 IDE 冷启动立即发起对话时步数限制不生效的问题
  • 修复网络请求失败时原始错误信息被吞掉、只显示笼统提示的问题
  • 修复正常使用中偶尔被误判为已登出的问题
  • 修复 @ 引用文件列表排序不合理、预览态文件无法引用、Git 上下文缺失最近提交列表的问题
  • 修复 Windows 上自动化任务因系统策略拦截数据库组件弹出难懂报错、需重启才能恢复的问题
  • 修复新建自动化任务时界面被旧会话流式消息拉回的问题
  • 修复专享版/私有化版环境下反馈入口报错的问题
  • 修复长会话触顶自动总结内容过大被截断导致任务中断的问题
  • 修复点击工具确认框后暂停按钮不显示的问题
  • 修复后台会话报错静默丢失、消息菜单弹出位置错位的问题
  • 修复终端命令生成的文件未出现在文件变更列表的问题
  • 修复 IDE 冷启动加载会话时输入框抢占文件编辑区焦点的问题
  • 修复 read_file 读取空文件误报「文件过大」的问题
  • 修复单条历史消息文件异常导致整个会话消息区空白的问题

  • 修复子 Agent 卡片部分文案中文环境下显示英文的问题
  • 修复生图/生视频勾选「本次会话始终允许」后下一轮仍弹确认的问题

  • 修复技能/插件详情页概述区域 Markdown 格式未正确渲染的问题

  • 修复文件被终端删除后「查看变更」提示找不到文件的问题

  • 修复文件反复删除/恢复场景下记录丢失、撤销时内容丢失的问题

  • 修复模型完全空响应时兜底提示刷新/重连后消失的问题
  • 修复后台会话审批卡不出现、消息卡在待审核状态的问题

  • 优化长对话的上下文压缩策略
  • 修复 Agent 变更文件「查看变更」按钮失效

idea-plugin.name: GroovyScript
idea-plugin.description:
This IntelliJ-based Plugin provides auto-completion, signature hints, inlay support and some live templates for the Minecraft 1.12 Mod GroovyScript. This is similar to the corresponding VS Code Plugin, found on the marketplace.

You must enable the GroovyScript Language Server in your instance. See the GroovyScript Docs for how to do this.

This plugin utilizes the Language Server Protocol to provide this support, through the LSP4IJ plugin.

LSP4IJ is a hard dependency of this Plugin. IntelliJ's own support has not been used due to limited feature sets and support being restricted to Ultimate versions.

Using the Plugin

  1. Install the Plugin
  2. Open a .groovy file. You should see a small GS status icon on the bottom left of your screen.
  3. You can use the status icon to control the status of the language server, as well as to access the main settings page.
  4. If using GrS versions pre-1.2.0: In the main settings page, you can enable the Disable texture inlays? (for GroovyScript versions pre 1.2.0) checkbox.

This plugin is still in development. Future planned features are in the roadmap.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• IntelliJ Version Support:
    • Lowest supported version is now 2024.3 (before: 2023.3)
    • Now supports 2025.3+
  • LSP4IJ Version: Bumped to 0.19.0
  • Removal of deprecated API usages
  • Lots of internal dependency updates

idea-plugin.name: Fluent Builder
idea-plugin.description:
The IntelliJ Fluent Builder Plugin is your go-to solution for generating and managing fluent builders in Java projects.

Key Features:

  1. Effortless Fluent Builder Creation
    Quickly generate fluent builders for your classes with minimal effort, following a clean and intuitive design.
  2. Highly Adaptable Builders
    Customize your builder to fit your exact needs:
    • Modify parameter types or names.
    • Remove parameters to simplify your builder.
    • Make parameters optional to suit different use cases.
    • Reorder parameters for better readability and usability.
    The plugin automatically adjusts the builder interfaces and methods to reflect your changes, ensuring a consistent and reliable builder.
  3. Seamless Compatibility with Existing Code
    The plugin adheres to established naming conventions to ensure compatibility with your existing project:
    • Builder Class Names: ClassNameBuilder
    • Builder Interface Names: ClassNameParamBuilder
    This ensures that your generated builders integrate seamlessly into your current workflow.

Need help or have suggestions? Feel free to reach out.

idea-plugin.name: Jimmer Buddy
idea-plugin.description:
JimmerBuddy — First-class Jimmer support for JetBrains IDEs

Supercharge your Java/Kotlin workflow with instant model/DTO generation, deep navigation, smart inspections, and a visual toolset built specifically for Project Jimmer. JimmerBuddy turns your IDE into a real-time companion for designing entities, DTOs, and relational mappings — with zero ceremony.

Why JimmerBuddy

  • Instant feedback: Generate draft, props, fetcher, DTO view/input/specification and more as you type (debounced to stay fast and quiet).
  • Navigate everything: Jump between entities, DTOs, properties, and relations in one keystroke.
  • Design with confidence: Syntax highlighting, formatter, and compiler-grade checks for DTO files.
  • Built for productivity: Postfix templates, auto-imports, and ready-to-use wizards.

Core Capabilities

  • Entities & DDL
    • Generate entities from database or DDL (select tables/columns with precision).
    • Generate DDL from entities for round‑trip modeling.
    • IntelliJ Database Tools integration: right-click tables in Database Tools tree to generate entities.
    • @Table(name) and @Column(name) annotation completion from Database Tools data sources.
    • Project wizard to bootstrap Jimmer projects quickly.
  • Immutable Model Tooling
    • Auto-generate draft, props, fetcher, and related helpers for Immutables.
    • List and explore all Immutables and their inheritors.
  • DTO Toolkit & Designer
    • Generate view, input, specification, and more from DTOs.
    • DTO structure view, visualization, and quick navigation.
    • Automatic import management (export, implements, userProp, etc.).
    • DTO fragment completion and type-ahead suggestions.
  • Navigation & Discovery
    • Go to related types, properties, and annotations (@OneToOne, @ManyToMany, @IdView, @Formula…).
    • Count and navigate DTO types across the project.
  • Code Assistance & Automation
    • Completion/inspection for Jimmer annotations and properties (Java & Kotlin).
    • Auto-generate sources on file changes with safe debounce.
    • Built-in formatter and organizer for DTO source.
  • Extras
    • Handy postfix templates for common Jimmer patterns.
    • Execute SQL to clipboard.

How It Fits Your Build

  • During IDE work, JimmerBuddy generates lightweight sources for instant feedback and navigation.
  • During project builds, Jimmer apt/ksp generates the full sources; both workflows complement each other.

Getting Started

  1. Install JimmerBuddy from JetBrains Marketplace.
  2. Open a project using Jimmer.
  3. Edit your entities or DTOs — generation and navigation work automatically.
  4. Use context actions and the project wizard for advanced generation flows.

Notes

  • If generation seems missing, check the plugin log tool window for details.
  • Works with Java and Kotlin projects; no special configuration required.

Support

  • Found an issue or have a feature request? Open an issue on GitHub. Contributions are welcome!

License

  • Apache 2.0

1.14.x

  • Add filtered tree search to immutable, DTO, and error-family tool windows (#212)
  • Fix ClassCastException caused by annotations not in the whitelist (#214)

1.13.x

  • Migrate from ANTLR to BNF-generated PSI
  • Add DTO type index infrastructure
  • Add immutable type cache with circular reference support
  • Support DTO fragment completion
  • Optimize qualified name completion with ClassKindIndex
  • Add ForTypeCompletionProvider for fragment FOR completion
  • Add QualifiedNamePartReferenceProvider for import resolution
  • Add PropNameReferenceProvider for prop reference
  • Optimize ImmutableTree, DTOList, ErrorFamilyTree with index-based loading
  • Remove ANTLR grammar, PSI classes, and related indices
  • Error family usages

1.12.x

  • Add BaseEntity switch for generate entity (#187)

idea-plugin.name: RiverpodX
idea-plugin.description:
Boost your Flutter development with Riverpod! This plugin enhances your workflow by offering a set of useful tools specifically designed for working with Riverpod.

Features:

  • GoTo Provider Declaration: Quickly navigate to the provider's declaration.
  • Find Usages for Providers: Locate all usages of a provider in the project.
  • Code Snippets: Use predefined code snippets to save time. Generator snippets automatically add the riverpod_annotation import and the matching part '*.g.dart' directive if they are missing.
  • Convert ConsumerWidget to ConsumerStatefulWidget (and vice versa): Easily switch between ConsumerWidget and ConsumerStatefulWidget.
  • Wrap with Consumer / Remove Consumer: Wrap the widget expression under the caret in a Consumer widget, or remove an enclosing Consumer/Consumer.builder widget, keeping the widget it returns.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.8.1

  • Fixed Wrap with Consumer using an incorrect widget name in some cases by removing an incorrect fallback when determining a new-expression's widget type.

1.8.0

  • Generator snippets now add the riverpod_annotation import and part '*.g.dart' if they are missing.
  • Consumer widget intentions:
    • Wrap with Consumer: wraps the widget expression under the caret in a Consumer widget.
    • Remove Consumer: removes the enclosing Consumer/Consumer.builder widget, keeping the widget it returns. Only available when the builder contains a single return statement.

1.7.0

  • Improved detection of provider usages inside `ref.*()` calls by matching against the call prefix with a regex instead of relying on the callee expression structure, catching cases that were previously missed.
  • Usage results for provider arguments and `overrideWith` calls now point to the more precise PSI element instead of the whole call expression.

Svelte and SvelteKit Live Templates for JetBrains IDEs. Accelerate your workflow and reduce boilerplate code!


Introduction

jetbrains-svelte-templates is a compact collection of Live Templates for JetBrains IDEs (like WebStorm and IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate) designed to speed up your Svelte & SvelteKit development. Use these templates to quickly insert essential code and boost your workflow.

Features

The plugin provides a wide range of Live Templates, which you can use with simple abbreviations (sv-* or svk-*) in your code. Just type the abbreviation and press Tab to expand the template.
Have a look at the jetbrains-svelte-templates README to get more details about the features.

idea-plugin.name: Rovo LSP
idea-plugin.description:
Language Server Protocol (LSP) support for Rovo framework annotations in Rust. Write cleaner, more maintainable OpenAPI-style documentation directly in your Rust code with intelligent IDE support.

Features

  • Smart completions - Auto-complete for Rovo section headers and metadata annotations with helpful snippets
  • Hover documentation - Detailed information for section headers, metadata annotations, status codes, and security schemes
  • Real-time diagnostics - Instant feedback on syntax errors and invalid section headers or metadata annotations
  • Code actions - Quick fixes for common issues
  • Navigation - Go to definition, find usages, and rename support for tags
  • Syntax highlighting - Context-aware highlighting for section headers, metadata annotations, status codes, and security schemes

Requirements

Install the matching version of rovo-lsp:

cargo install rovo-lsp --version 0.4.11

The plugin will automatically detect the LSP server from common locations or your system PATH.

Usage Example

/// Get user by ID
///
/// # Responses
///
/// 200: Json<User> - Successfully retrieved user
/// 404: Json<Error> - User not found
///
/// # Metadata
///
/// @tag users
/// @security bearer
#[rovo]
async fn get_user(id: i64) -> impl IntoApiResponse {
    // Implementation
}

  • 🔍 Global Search: Search content across all checkpoints using Ctrl+Alt+Shift+F.
  • 📋 Diff with Clipboard: Compare any checkpoint against your current clipboard content.

idea-plugin.name: PHPPad
idea-plugin.description:
PHPPad — PHP REPL for PhpStorm

A Tinkerwell-like interactive PHP scratch pad that runs code on your remote server via SSH or inside a Docker container — right inside PhpStorm, without leaving the IDE.

✨ Features

Editor & Execution

  • Full PHP editor with syntax highlighting, autocomplete, and all PhpStorm intelligence
  • Scratch file mode — edit code in the main PhpStorm editor (phppad.php), output fills the full tool window
  • SSH & Docker connections — connect to any remote server or local Docker container
  • Laravel bootstrap — automatically bootstraps your Laravel app so you can use models, facades, and helpers directly
  • Magic comments — add //? after any expression to see its value inline in the editor
  • Inline inlay hints — magic comment values appear right next to the code, non-intrusively
  • Ctrl+Enter to run from the tool window (configurable in Settings → Keymap → PHPPad: Run Code)
  • ▶ Run in PhpPad — right-click context menu action in the editor when phppad.php is open
  • Gutter run button — green ▶ icon in the gutter of phppad.php for one-click execution

Output

  • JCEF renderer (default) — beautiful HTML result panel with collapsible result blocks
  • JSON values — inline Copy button and lazy Tree view for any JSON string in the output
  • SQL query log — all database queries captured and shown with execution time
  • Exception trace — full stack traces with file and line numbers
  • Tree renderer — lightweight Swing fallback with colored node types
  • Switch renderer (JCEF ↔ Tree) and split orientation without restarting PhpStorm

Workflow

  • Snippets — save frequently used code snippets and insert them instantly
  • Run history — browse past runs with connection info, duration, and full code
  • Flexible layout — toggle between vertical (↕) and horizontal (↔) split
  • Multiple connections — manage SSH and Docker connections with built-in test connection
  • Persistent settings — connections, last code, and preferences survive IDE restarts

Claude Code / AI Integration

  • HTTP API server built into the plugin (default: 0.0.0.0:7788)
  • Claude can read and write the editor code and run it on any configured connection
  • Works from WSL2 — connect via host.docker.internal:7788
  • Claude button in the toolbar — server status, port settings, Quick Start guide, API reference, and ready-to-use CLAUDE.md snippet
  • REST API endpoints:
    • GET /connections — list all configured connections
    • GET /editor — get current editor code
    • POST /editor — set editor code
    • POST /run — run code on a connection, returns full result JSON
    • GET /status — server status

🚀 Quick Start

  1. Open the PHPPad tool window (bottom bar)
  2. Click + → Add SSH or Docker connection
  3. Write PHP code in the editor
  4. Press Ctrl+Enter or click ▶ Run

🤖 Claude Code Quick Start

  1. Click the Claude button in the PhpPad toolbar
  2. Copy the generated CLAUDE.md snippet
  3. Paste it into your project's CLAUDE.md
  4. Claude Code can now read/write/run PHP code via the HTTP API
# Check available connections
curl http://localhost:7788/connections

# Run PHP code
curl -X POST http://localhost:7788/run \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"connection": "my-server", "code": "<?php dump(now());"}'

🔧 Magic Comments

$users = User::limit(10)->get(); //?
// Inline result shown next to the line: ← array(10)

// Works mid-chain too:
User::limit(10)->get()/*?*/->count()/*?*/->pluck('email');

🖊️ Scratch File Mode

Click Scratch in the toolbar to switch to scratch file mode:

  • phppad.php opens in the main PhpStorm editor — full IDE features, no embedded editor
  • The PhpPad tool window shows only the output panel
  • Click the ▶ gutter button or right-click → ▶ Run in PhpPad to execute
  • Click Scratch ✓ again to switch back to embedded mode

  • Claude dialog showing stale status (e.g. "Running" when server was stopped) — status now re-reads on every window focus gain
