idea-plugin.name: Git Commit Date Time
idea-plugin.description:
Choose the date, time, and time zone recorded in your Git commits directly in your IDE.

What you can do

  • Set custom dates for your next commit from the Commit options menu.
  • Right-click an unpublished commit in Git Log and choose Change Commit Date/Time.
  • Set author and committer dates together or separately.
  • Choose a time zone while keeping the clock time you entered.

How to use it

For a new commit, open Commit options and select Use custom commit date in the Git Commit Date Time section. Choose a date from the calendar and a time with the time picker, or type them, and choose a time zone. Pickers use the system date/time format or the IDE override; yyyy-MM-dd dates and HH:mm:ss times are also accepted. Clear the checkbox to return to normal Git dates. Review and confirm the custom dates before committing. Settings last for the current project session.

For an existing commit, select one commit in Git Log, right-click, and choose Change Commit Date/Time. Edit the form and select Change Dates.

Limitations

  • Existing commits must be on the current local branch and unpublished. Configured remote branches and tags are checked using the IDE's Git authentication; unavailable remotes block editing. Previously deleted or unknown remote history cannot be checked.
  • Changing an existing commit gives it and affected later commits new IDs. File contents, staged changes, merge relationships, and later commit dates are preserved. A backup keeps the original history. Other branches, local tags, and notes keep their original references.
  • Existing signed commits, signed merge tags, shallow history, detached HEADs, and active Git operations are not supported by the date editor.
  • Disable custom dates before using Amend. Requires local Git; WSL Git and remote development are unsupported.
  • Skipped daylight-saving times are rejected; repeated times use the earlier occurrence.

No telemetry or analytics. Free and open source under the MIT License.

Source code, documentation, and issues.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• Add calendar and time pickers with compact, equally sized icon buttons for new and existing commits.
  • Follow system/IDE formats, accept yyyy-MM-dd and HH:mm:ss input, and preserve seconds, historical years, and time zones.
  • Outline today and dim past dates using theme colors while keeping them selectable.
  • Confirm custom author/committer timestamps and the time zone before creating a new commit.

idea-plugin.name: Git Crypt Guard
idea-plugin.description:
Keep track of git-crypt protection directly in your IDE, without unlocking the repository.

  • Automatic inspection on project open and repository changes.
  • Lock badges in editor tabs, Project view and standard IDE file presentations.
  • A responsive repository dashboard with actionable findings for plaintext files, Git index risks, local key stores and configured content commands.
  • Inspected protected targets open in dedicated file cards, preserving existing unsaved editor changes. Decrypted working files use the standard editor with an exposure notice.
  • On local macOS IDEs, explicitly view supported encrypted text in a separate authenticated native window, while leaving the working file encrypted.

Repository inspection does not read keys or decrypt contents. Native viewing requires your consent and macOS authentication. It supports read-only text up to 64 KiB with basic Latin and Cyrillic glyphs.

Remote Development supports repository inspection and protected file cards; native secret viewing is available only in a local macOS IDE. Header observations do not authenticate encryption or provide a comprehensive security guarantee. OS/framework persistence and deliberate access by another process with your user permissions are outside the protection guarantee.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0 — First release

  • Automatic git-crypt inspection with a responsive protection dashboard and actionable findings.
  • Consistent closed, open and unverified lock badges across standard IDE file presentations.
  • Theme-aware plugin icon in protected file cards; ordinary editing for decrypted working files.
  • Explicit authenticated native read-only viewing on local macOS IDEs without unlocking the working tree.
  • Repository inspection and protected file cards in Remote Development; secure viewing stays local to macOS.

idea-plugin.name: Gitea PR & Code Review
idea-plugin.description:
Review Gitea pull requests in your IDE: browse, comment, approve and merge, and clone repositories from your Gitea servers.

Note: Development of this plugin was made with heavy assistance of AI. It is used both for coding and building and improving the developer's knowledge of the platform. All generated code is verified and manually tested to ensure it does what it needs to do.

Pull requests

  • A Pull Requests tool window for the project's Gitea remote, filterable by state, author and label
  • No account needed to read: pull requests of public repositories can be browsed read-only, and logging in from the conversation turns on commenting and reviewing
  • Details, commits, status checks and changed files for each pull request
  • A conversation timeline where you can reply to, edit, resolve and delete comments
  • Review in the diff viewer or directly in the editor: draft comments and approve / request changes / comment verdicts
    • Also supports an implementation of suggested changes, which can be applied in one click
  • Merge, close, reopen, check out the branch, and request reviewers

Accounts and repositories

  • Personal access token login, with several accounts across several servers
  • Tokens are kept in the IDE password safe and supplied to Git for HTTPS operations
  • A Gitea tab in Get from Version Control for cloning
  • Open in browser and copy link for files, lines and commits

Requirements: a Gitea 1.27 or later server (self-hosted, on a sub-path, HTTP or HTTPS) and the bundled Git plugin.

Currently other compatible services (Forgejo, Gogs, etc.) are not supported. This is to simplify maintenance and set plugin focus only on Gitea.

Source code and issue tracker

idea-plugin.name: Azure DevOps Pull Requests
idea-plugin.description:
A free inbox for Azure DevOps pull requests across all your repositories, in IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, Rider and more. Cloud or on-premises Server 2020+. No AI, no telemetry.

Every pull request (PR) waiting for your vote, with what changed since you last looked. Code review for Azure Repos on Microsoft Azure DevOps (ADO): Azure DevOps Services and Azure DevOps Server (formerly TFS), in IDE versions 2025.3 or later.

Review inbox

  • PRs waiting for your vote, from the repositories you have open, the whole project, or every project of the organization
  • Each row shows what is new to you (new, new commits, new activity), votes, open comments and when it last changed
  • A notification when a new review request arrives (the list refreshes every 5 minutes while it is open)
  • Multi-repository projects: every Azure DevOps clone in the project is listed, not only the first one

Reviewing

  • All changed files in one diff window, fetched from Azure DevOps (nothing to fetch locally); step through them file by file
  • Mark files as viewed; a later push that changes a file clears its mark, and files changed since your last visit are flagged
  • Comment threads appear in the diff gutter; comment on the selected lines straight from the diff
  • Open threads first, resolved ones folded away; reply, resolve and reactivate
  • Branch policies in words: required approvals (including "the most recent pusher's approval does not count"), builds, comment resolution, work items; run a failed or expired build again

Finishing

  • Approve, approve with suggestions, wait for author, or reject
  • Complete with your merge type (merge, squash, rebase, semi-linear), or set auto-complete to finish when the policies pass
  • Publish a draft, abandon, check out the source branch, or create a pull request from your current branch

Works with Azure DevOps Services (dev.azure.com, *.visualstudio.com, formerly Visual Studio Team Services or VSTS) and Azure DevOps Server 2020, 2022 or later (on-premises, formerly Team Foundation Server, including /tfs/ addresses), from HTTPS or SSH remotes, behind company proxies and with your own certificates. Runs in every JetBrains IDE with Git support: IntelliJ IDEA, Rider, PyCharm, WebStorm, GoLand, PhpStorm, CLion, RubyMine and others.

English and Japanese, following the IDE language. 日本語表示に対応（IDE の言語が日本語のとき）。

Public projects can be read without a token. Otherwise a personal access token with Code (Read & write) to vote, comment, complete and create as well, or Code (Read) to read only. Organizations that restrict personal access tokens can use your Azure CLI sign-in (az login) instead, on Azure DevOps Services.

Free: the review inbox, diffs, viewed marks, discussions and branch policies. Paid (marked Pro in the plugin, 30-day trial): vote, comment, reply, resolve, complete, auto-complete, publish, run a policy again, abandon and create pull requests.

For teams

  • Reading is free for everyone. Only the people who vote, comment, complete or create pull requests need a license.
  • Organization licenses are per user and sold through JetBrains Marketplace: card, PayPal or bank transfer, with quotes for purchasing departments.
  • Administrators assign them to developers in JetBrains Account, or serve them from the JetBrains on-premises License Server.
  • The paid features can be tried free for 30 days.

Security & privacy

  • Network: connects only to the Azure DevOps of the repositories you open (dev.azure.com, or your own Azure DevOps Server). No other hosts; redirects are not followed.
  • No AI, no cloud of ours: your code and comments go nowhere but your Azure DevOps.
  • Proxy and certificates: uses the IDE's HTTP Proxy settings, including proxy authentication, and the certificates the IDE trusts (system store and Settings | Tools | Server Certificates).
  • Token: kept in the IDE's password safe and sent only to that Azure DevOps, as the Authorization header. Never written to settings files or logs. With the Azure CLI sign-in turned on, the plugin runs az account get-access-token and keeps that short-lived token in memory only.
  • No telemetry: no analytics, usage statistics or crash reports, and no server of our own. Licenses are checked by the IDE through JetBrains Marketplace.
  • Stored locally: merge preferences, list choices and, if you set one, the repository URL, in the IDE settings; which pull requests you opened and which file versions you marked as viewed, in a separate IDE settings file.
idea-plugin.change-notes:

  • During the Pro trial, the days left are shown above the list; a click opens the license dialog

idea-plugin.name: OpenCVS
idea-plugin.description:
Not affiliated with the OpenBSD OpenCVS project or JetBrains.

OpenCVS brings CVS version control to maintained IntelliJ IDEA installations. Browse repositories, check out and update working copies, commit changes, inspect history, compare revisions, and manage CVS settings from the IDE. English and Chinese UI resources follow the IDE display language.

This is an independent community fork of JetBrains' frozen CVS plugin, maintained by jieyuexing. It is not an official JetBrains product and is not affiliated with JetBrains.

The declared installation range is IntelliJ IDEA 2023.2 through 2026.2 (builds 232–262.*). Maintenance targets are 2023.2.8 and 2026.2.1; this range is not a guarantee that every API path has been validated. See the source repository's platform notes for compatibility findings and outstanding runtime checks.

Source code and issue tracker · Apache License 2.0 · Original CVS source

与 OpenBSD OpenCVS 项目及 JetBrains 均无隶属关系。

OpenCVS 为仍在维护的 IntelliJ IDEA 提供 CVS 版本控制。 可在 IDE 中浏览仓库、检出和更新工作副本、提交更改、查看历史、比较修订并管理 CVS 设置。 界面文案随 IDE 显示语言在中英文之间切换。

本插件是 JetBrains 已冻结 CVS 插件的独立社区分支，由 jieyuexing 维护。 它不是 JetBrains 官方产品，与 JetBrains 无隶属关系。

声明的安装范围为 IntelliJ IDEA 2023.2 至 2026.2（构建号 232–262.*）。 维护目标为 2023.2.8 与 2026.2.1；该范围不保证每一条 API 路径均已验证。 兼容性结论与尚未完成的运行时检查见源码仓库的平台说明。

idea-plugin.name: Impact Graph
idea-plugin.description:
See what a Java or Kotlin change reaches before you ship it: who calls a method, what it calls, and which HTTP endpoints, SQL statements, and message topics are on that path.

Code analysis

  • Put the caret on a method or class and click Analyze to walk callers, callees, or both, with adjustable depth
  • Interface calls follow through to their implementations across modules. When several implementations are possible, all of them are listed
  • The canvas draws one call chain per entry point, from the HTTP endpoint down to the SQL. if / ternary / switch branches are dashed edges labeled with their condition
  • A controller opens as a list of its HTTP endpoints. Click one to draw that request's chain
  • The Details and Paths panels show a node's callers and callees, the SQL it runs (syntax-highlighted, MyBatis includes expanded), and each path from the entry point
  • Click a node to highlight the call site in the editor. Double-click to open the implementation or the mapper XML statement
  • Analyze Project Impact walks every HTTP endpoint in the project

Git impact

  • Double-click a commit in Git History, or choose Analyze Code Impact in the IDE Git log, to see the changed methods and everything they reach
  • Filter Git History by message, author, date, or hash, and switch local branches without checking out
  • Changed files counts differences the same way as the IDE diff viewer. Click a file to open the diff
  • Analyze Git Impact covers uncommitted changes plus the last commit

Supported frameworks

  • Spring Web, services, repositories, and dependency injection
  • JPA entities and repositories
  • MyBatis annotation SQL and mapper XML, MyBatis-Plus BaseMapper / IService CRUD with SQL inferred from the entity
  • Feign, RestTemplate, and WebClient
  • Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ, and RocketMQ / Aliyun ONS, where producers are linked to consumers through the topic

More

  • Export the canvas as PNG, or export the tree, a single node, or the full report as Markdown
  • Settings cover analysis scope, default depth, excluded packages and classes, and an on/off switch for each framework
  • Only changed files are re-parsed, so later runs are fast on large projects
  • Extension points let other plugins add frameworks, rules, language frontends, and node styles

Analysis runs entirely inside the IDE. Your source code never leaves your machine.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
First release.

Added

  • Code analysis. Put the caret on a method or class and click Analyze to walk callers, callees, or both, with adjustable depth. Interface calls follow through to their implementations across modules.
  • Call-chain canvas. One chain per entry point, from the HTTP endpoint down to the SQL. if / ternary / switch branches are dashed edges labeled with their condition. A controller opens as a list of its endpoints. The canvas zooms and scrolls.
  • Details and Paths panels. A node's callers and callees, its SQL (syntax-highlighted, MyBatis includes expanded), and each path from the entry point.
  • Editor navigation. Click a node to highlight the call site. Double-click to open the implementation or the mapper XML statement.
  • Analyze Project Impact walks every HTTP endpoint in the project.
  • Git impact. Analyze a commit from Git History or from Analyze Code Impact in the IDE Git log, or analyze uncommitted changes plus the last commit. Git History filters by message, author, date, or hash and switches local branches without checking out. Changed files counts differences the same way as the IDE diff viewer and opens the diff on click.
  • Frameworks: Spring Web / services / repositories / injection, JPA, MyBatis annotation SQL and mapper XML, MyBatis-Plus BaseMapper / IService CRUD, Feign, RestTemplate / WebClient, Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ, and RocketMQ / Aliyun ONS.
  • Export the canvas as PNG, or export the tree, a single node, or the full report as Markdown.
  • Settings for analysis scope, default depth, excluded packages and classes, and an on/off switch for each framework.
  • Incremental semantic cache: only changed files are re-parsed.
  • Extension points for frameworks, rules, language frontends, and node styles.
  • Report to Developer in the IDE error dialog files the error as a GitHub issue.
  • Checks for a newer version on startup and every two hours, and installs it from the notification.

idea-plugin.name: SyncEdit
idea-plugin.description:
Similar to 'SyncEdit' functionality already in Borland Delphi, and soon to be in Eclipse... This plugin allows you to do an inplace synchronized edit of all instances of a string within a defined range.

A "SyncEdit Mode" menu item is added to the Search and Editor Popup menus. Simply select a range to be edited, enter "SyncEdit Mode" and all words in the marked range become 'live' - any changes to an instance of a word changes all matching strings in real-time.

The decision about the word to SyncEdit is determined by a 'Select Word' operation at the current cursor location (respecting any CamelHump settings) when a modification is made. However, you can SyncEdit a custom region of text by first selecting it and then invoking the SyncEdit action again, or even just start typing to replace the substring completely.

There is also a "Paste with SyncEdit" action added to the Edit Menu - this will execute a paste and automatically enter SyncEdit Mode for the range of the pasted text, great for tweaking pasted code fragments for the context they are used in.

The mode can be exited by pressing either escape or enter - once to exit SyncEdit on a word, and once again to stop SyncEditing a range.

At the moment SyncEdit works purely on a textual basis, but maybe later versions will optionally use code members/identifiers if there is interest for this.

idea-plugin.name: Referencer
idea-plugin.description:
Tools for faster inserting, copying, replacing and navigating among built-in and configurable references (date, filename, text completions, bookmarks, and many more) into/from/within edited file(s).

PLUGIN CONFIGURATION:
Is given at: Settings > Other Settings > Referencer

KEYBOARD SHORTCUTS:
  • Ctrl+Shift+Alt+C twice - Open list of references for copying to clipboard
  • Ctrl+Shift+Alt+G twice - Open list of GoTo destinations in current document
  • Ctrl+Shift+Alt+F twice - Replace configured search/replace patterns in current document
  • Ctrl+Shift+Alt+V twice - Open list of references for inserting into the current document

Mac Users: On Macs, the default keyboard shortcuts are Shift+Alt+Cmd+C twice (copy), Shift+Alt+Cmd+F twice (replacee), Shift+Alt+Cmd+V twice (paste) and Shift+Alt+Cmd+G twice (go)

TYPES OF REFERENCES TO INSERT/COPY:
All parsed items in the following list are relative to the current caret position, for example "previous classname" refers to the first classname found when searching backwards starting from the caret position. Some references are only specifically available for certain file types.

  • Current date/time formatted as YYYY-MM-DD and YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS
  • Current UNIX timestamp in seconds and milliseconds
  • Path to current file
  • Current filename
  • Current filename::line number
  • Path to current file::line number
  • When having a multi-line selection: File path / selection: line num. sel. start - line num. sel. end
  • When having opened more than one file: list of paths to all opened files
  • PHP files: list of method names in current file
  • PHP files: previous classname::previous method name
  • PHP files: previous classname::line number
  • PHP files: previous classname
  • PHP files: previous function name
  • PHP files: previous/next variable name
  • JavaScript files: namespace.classname
  • JavaScript files: namespace.classname.previous method name
  • JavaScript files: namespace.classname::line number
  • JavaScript files: previous/next method name
  • JavaScript files: filepath formatted as namespace
  • General word-completions: all continuations to the word to the left of the caret, found in the current file

TYPES OF REFERENCES TO GO TO:
  • Lines w/ bookmarks in the current document
  • Lines w/ PHP or JavaScript method declarations in the current document
  • Lines w/ region-comments in the current document
  • Lines w/ occurrences of any of the configured dynamic GoTo patterns in the current document
  • Headlines within the current markdown document

TYPES OF REFERENCES TO FIND+REPLACE:
  • All matches of the configured search/replace patterns in the current file

Please note: This plugin is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS, WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.

idea-plugin.name: jQAssistant Plugin
idea-plugin.description:
New in version 2.0
  • Don't open Neo4j locally anymore because there were lots compatibility issues. Now REST requests were sent to a running Neo4j.
  • Removed Neo4j jars.
  • Because of the REST requests, the jQAssistant server can now run on any reachable computer, e.g. a CI server.
New in version 1.1
  • Update to Neo4j 2.2.0
What is it? Execute queries against an existing jQAssistant database and show results in the Find Toolwindow. So you can search for code using Neo4J Cypher database queries. Usage This plugin doesn't create the jQAssistant database. So you should get a copy from jqassistant.org, configure and run it following the jQAssistant documentation. You can also use the jQAssistant plugins provided by Kontext E available at maven central. When you have created your database and started the jQAssistant server, you can open the jQA toolwindow. The database location has the default URL where most probably the database files should be found. Take the example query or enter your own and hit the 'Find' button gently. The result is shown in the standard Find toolwindow and you can use it to navigate as you know it. What can you find? You can find classes, methods and files where
  • * nodes have a 'fqn' property that contains the fully qualified name of a class in project scope, e.g. nodes with Class, CheckstyleFile, BugInstanceClass (of FindBugs plugin), JacocoClass lables
  • * nodes have a 'relativePath' property that contains the path of a file relative to the project root, e.g. with GitFile, GitCommitFile labels
idea-plugin.change-notes: * Don't open Neo4j locally anymore because there were lots compatibility issues. Now REST requests were sent to a running Neo4j. * Removed Neo4j jars. * Because of the REST requests, the jQAssistant server can now run on any reachable computer, e.g. a CI server.

idea-plugin.name: Custom Inspections
idea-plugin.description:
Create inspections and provide quickfixes for any file type, using regular expressions.
You can use this plugin whenever you want to display errors or warnings that are not covered by the specific language inspections or an inspection based on structural search.
You can also filter files to be considered by their path, name or extension. The files paths are relative to the project directory and separated by slashes (/) independent of the operating system.

Settings are stored in project directory and can easily be shared with others.

Examples use cases
  • Create custom inspections for unstructured files like txt or rst.
  • Enforce specific code styles, e.g. to write i++ instead of i = i + 1.
  • Make sure that specific {placeholders} are used instead of writing e.g. the product name directly in changelog files.
  • Detect wrongly spelled names and provide a quickfix for the correct spelling.
  • Make sure your colleagues don't forget to praise your wisdom at least once per file.

idea-plugin.name: Toggler
idea-plugin.description:
Quickly toggle words and symbols with a hotkey. Toggles can be configured from the settings menu.

Do you really like Toggler? Consider giving a star on GitHub or leaving a review on the JetBrains marketplace.

Did you find a bug or do you have a feature request? Feel free to open an issue on GitHub.

Usage

Select or place your cursor on a word and press:
  • Ctrl + Shift + X (Windows and Linux)
  • Cmd + Shift + X (macOS)
If the word matches one of the configured word combinations / toggles, then it will be replaced with the next configured word.

true -> false
!== -> ===
&& -> ||
left -> right
LEFT -> RIGHT
addClass -> removeClass
See the "Advanced Usage" section below for more details.

Configuration

Configure the word combinations / toggles and other Toggler settings by going to Settings/Preferences -> Tools -> Toggler in your IDE.

The toggle hotkey / keybind can be changed from Settings/Preferences -> Keymap -> Plug-ins -> Toggler.

Word combinations / toggles can be added and removed by modifying the JSON-like configuration and subsequently pressing the Apply button. The Import, Export, and Reset to Defaults buttons have been added for convenience.

Toggler has a custom mechanism for distinguishing / separating words from each other. Because of that the following boundary characters can't be used inside the toggles ' ', ';', ':', '.', ',', '`', '"', ''', '(', ')', '[', ']', '{', '}', '\t'.

Default toggles are included with every fresh installment.

Advanced Usage

The configured toggles "wrap around", which means that if ["true", "false"] is configured, then continually toggling will lead to true -> false -> true -> ....

Word combinations / toggles can contain "any" number of words. Thus, ["public", "private", "protected"] is also supported.

The normal toggle action discussed thus far toggles (i.e., replaces) forward (e.g., 1, 2, 3, 1, ...). Use the reverse toggle action to toggle backwards (e.g., 1, 3, 2, 1, ...). It uses the same keybind as above, but in addition make sure to also hold the Alt (Windows and Linux) or Opt (Linux) key.

Toggler supports toggling with multiple cursors (also known as carets) at the same time.

Toggler has limited support for transferring word case. It supports, full caps (TRUE -> FALSE) and first letter capitalized (True -> False). It defaults back to lowercase in all other cases (true -> false).

The partial matching functionality allows for substrings of words to be toggled. For example, getName can be toggled to setName by placing the cursor anywhere on get and then toggling. The largest match found is prioritised. This means that if you have the following toggles configured ["dev", "prod"] and ["development", "production"], and toggle development, then it will be replaced by production. The partial matching functionality can be bypassed by using your cursor to create a precise selection of the sub word you want to toggle (for example making a selection of dev and then toggling). The partial matching functionality is enabled by default and can be disabled in the configuration menu.

Roadmap

The roadmap can be found on the Toggler board.

Contribute

Want to contribute? Check out the contribute section over on GitHub.

Alternatives

If you're looking for more text manipulation features, then check out Shifter. Which also includes a dictionary (with custom words) just like Toggler and includes many other nice features.

Acknowledgements

This plugin has drawn inspiration from similar toggle plugins / extensions.
  • VSCode (by HiDeoo)
  • Atom (by HiDeoo)
  • Sublime Text 4 (by gordio)

License

Toggler is licensed under the MIT license.

idea-plugin.name: RuntimeSearch
idea-plugin.description:
Searches the given text in all string expressions of a debugged Java SE program.

Before using, open the Debug Configuration you would like to use via Run | Edit Configurations. Under RuntimeSearch Settings, check Enable RuntimeSearch for this configuration. This may incur minor debugging performance overhead. You can also restrict the search scope to selected packages. Note that non-JVM (e.g., Android) targets are not supported.

To start searching, select Run | Find in Runtime, enter the searched string and press Find. If the program is not yet being debugged, a new process will be started. Then interact with the running application. As soon as any string expression in the program will contain the searched string (substrings are matched), the process will be paused. You can use traditional debugging actions (e.g., Step Over) or search for the next occurrence via Run | Find Next in Runtime.

For a tutorial and sample use cases, please watch the video or read the paper.

2026.921.74643902

  • 首次打开项目时新增代码库索引创建说明

2026.917.73317283

3.2.0

  • 一份订阅，全产品通用：Qoder CN 个人版统一 Credits 体系正式上线
    • 新增：
      • 一号通用 Qoder CN（全家桶）：一个 Qoder CN 账号可无缝登录 IDE / JetBrains 插件、QoderWork CN（桌面端）、Qoder CN CLI（终端）、QoderWake CN（数字员工）、Qoder CN Mobile（移动端）及 Cloud Agents（云端 Agent），无需分别注册。
      • Credits 资源池统一：原账号的 Credits 余额将按 1:1 等价转换至新全家桶账号，且有效期自升级当日起重新计算为一个月。
      • 限时模型福利：升级后的用户可享受 Qwen3.7-Max 每日 200 次免费调用的限时活动，活动结束时间以官网公告为准。
      • AI 数据完整保留：历史会话记录、个性化规则、记忆、技能、智能体、代码索引及插件通用设置等，均无损迁移至新账号。
    • 变更：
      • 登录入口切换：通过「阿里云账号登录」入口可自动升级；升级成功后请使用「Qoder CN 账号登录」入口登录，原登录方式不再可用。
      • VSC 插件停止支持：原 Qoder CN（原灵码）VSC 插件已标记为 Deprecated，不再纳入全家桶产品矩阵，建议切换至 Qoder CN IDE。
      • 订单自动退款：升级后，原订阅下个周期及之后的费用将按原支付路径自动退款，自动续费订单同步取消，无需主动申请。

2.8.0

  • 引入 Qwen-Coder-Qoder 模型
    • 一款为提升 Lingma 端到端编程体验而打造的深度定制模型。该模型基于 Qwen-Coder，并针对 Lingma Agent 框架、工具和场景进行了大规模强化学习。在我们的真实软件工程任务评测中，其任务解决率已超越 Cursor Composer-1，尤其在 Windows 系统下的终端命令准确率方面高出 50%
  • 补全和 NES 全面升级为 NEXT
    • 从被动补全到主动预测，支持依赖自动引入等功能，从能力到交互体验全面升级

  • 全面支持数据库 @database
    • 支持在 Lingma 的 Ask/Agent 模式下引用数据库作为上下文
    • 支持在 Query Console 中生成 SQL 并执行
  • 支持兼容 AGENTS.md：当前项目根目录下存在 AGENTS.md 时，智能体将自动识别并加载文件内容

2.6.0

  • 嗨，通义灵码编程智能体全新升级，新增规划能力、消息排队等，并优化工程感知能力、记忆感知能力等。
    • 编程能力升级：结合 Qwen 最新模型能力，支持工具并行调用，并深度优化编码效果，复杂编码任务执行更高效、准确；
    • 新增 To-Dos 工具：编程智能体能够在开始执行编码任务前进行结构化的待办拆解，能够更有效地执行复杂长程编码任务；
    • 新增消息排队：灵码在回复、执行的过程中，可以编辑并直接发送后续消息，能够帮助开发者快速持续迭代，无需等待；
    • 新增全自动执行模式：编程智能体支持配置自动执行模式，开启后，可配置终端命令禁止名单，在保证安全性的基础上，大幅提升编码任务执行效率；
    • 增强工程感知：优化 Grep、Search Codebase 等检索能力，工程检索更有效；
    • 增强记忆感知：优化记忆和记忆整理相关能力，让灵码的回复更加懂你；
    • 优化工具呈现体验：弱化文件阅读、网络检索、工程检索、目录检索等工具的界面呈现效果，强化确认类操作，让开发者更快获取关键信息。
  • 其他更多能力和优化：
    • 智能会话默认选择智能体模式；
    • 智能会话中添加上下文修改为输入 @ 唤起窗口后进行添加；
    • 智能问答模式默认支持检索工具调用，并支持在设置中进行关闭；
    • 支持在代码编辑器区域选中代码行后，点击右键的操作直接添加到对话窗口作为上下文；
    • 支持为工程配置多个 AI 规则，并配置其生效方式；
    • 优化行间对话编辑体验，强化文件编辑场景的体验；
    • 问题上报支持添加图片；
    • 去除模型选择入口和文件编辑模式，让开发者选择更简单。

2.5.0

  • 嗨，通义灵码新增了编程智能体，具备自主决策、环境感知、工具使用等能力，可以根据开发者的编码任务描述，使用工程检索、文件编辑、终端等工具，进行工程内多个文件的修改，端到端地完成编码任务。 我们期望打造一个开发者用起来简单的编程助手，在会话过程中，开发者可以针对不同场景和问题难度自由切换智能问答、文件编辑、智能体模式，实现工作效率最大化。
  • 同时，我们期望灵码在编码任务执行上可以更高效，为灵码内置了相关的工具，并强化了它在此方向的能力：
    • 工具使用：可自主使用十多种内置编程工具，例如读写文件、代码查询、错误排查等，同时支持 MCP 工具配置，并集成魔搭 MCP 广场，开发者可自由配置。
    • 终端命令执行：在执行编码任务时，可以自主决策需要执行的命令，自动完成命令编写并运行终端，大幅提升编码任务的执行效率。
    • 工程级变更：可根据开发者的任务描述，自主进行任务拆解和工程内多个代码文件修改，同时可通过多次对话进行逐步迭代或快照回滚，与灵码协同完成编码任务。
  • 最后，我们也期望能够让灵码越来越懂开发者及代码工程，增强了在工程感知、记忆感知方向的能力：
    • 工程自动感知：根据开发者的任务描述，可自动感知工程框架、技术栈、所需代码文件、错误信息等工程内信息，无需手动添加工程上下文，任务描述更轻松。
    • 记忆感知：支持基于大模型的自主记忆能力，在开发者与灵码的对话过程，灵码会逐步形成针对开发者个人、工程、问题等相关的丰富记忆，越用越懂你。
  • 其他功能和优化：
    • 支持在智能会话中，进行文件、方法、定义等在工程内的定位跳转
    • 智能会话中添加上下文时，支持工程目录的添加
    • 智能会话中添加上下文时，支持指定知识库（企业版）
    • 智能会话中添加上下文时，支持文件、目录、gitCommit 等多选交互

idea-plugin.name: txtic
idea-plugin.description:
Txtic is a plugin for JetBrains IDEs dedicated to reduce repetitive work by using simple commands and the power of multiple cursors in JetBrains IDEs.
Default shortcut: ctrl + alt + X

Commands

  • r/range: incremental numbers
  • a: a to z
  • A: A to Z
  • uuid: generate uuid(lower case)
  • UUID: generate UUID(upper case)
  • l/lower: to lower case
  • u/upper: to upper case
  • df/del_first: delete first specified str
  • da/del_all: delete all specified str
  • rf/rep_first: replace first specified str
  • ra/rep_all: replace all specified str
  • p/paste: paste the first line of text from the clipboard
  • rp/repeat: repeat str
  • pangu: beautify text
  • p2m: convert method parameters to map(useful for Python)
  • myip: get my public IP address(network required)
  • carbon: open the selected code in https://carbon.now.sh(support custom url)

Wiki

If you would like to know more about how Txtic can help you out, check out our wiki.

idea-plugin.name: NPM Update Dependencies
idea-plugin.description:
Update your npm dependencies with a single click.

This plugin will update all the dependencies in your package.json file to the latest version, or the satisfying version depending on your choice.

Features

  • Update a dependency to the latest or satisfying version
  • Keep comparators (e.g. ^, ~, >, <, >=, <=) when replacing versions
  • Get notified of deprecated dependencies with a banner
  • Detect and replace/remove deprecated dependencies
  • Configure and spot dependencies that are likely unmaintained
  • Batch update all dependencies (latest or satisfying) and/or all deprecated dependencies
  • Support for custom registries and private packages
  • Support of the packageManager field
  • See your outdated dependencies at a glance in the status bar
  • Exclude dependencies or versions from the scan
  • Configure everything in the settings
  • Manually invalidate the cache in case of issues
  • …and more!

Usage

There are 3 ways to invoke the extension menus:

  • Hover over an annotated dependency and click the action you want to perform
  • Right click in the package.json file and select the extension from the context menu
  • Use the Tools menu

Configuration options are available in the settings.

Works by fetching registry.npmjs.org.
Rewrite of the existing npm-dependency-checker plugin.

idea-plugin.name: EmacsJ
idea-plugin.description:
A collection of useful Emacs commands for text editing and search.

Documentation: EmacsJ on GitHub

This plugin offers a collection of commands for those of us who love Emacs and miss its functionality when working in IntelliJ-based IDEs. It is mainly intended as an extension to IntelliJ's Emacs keymap, which lacks some functionality that an Emacs user will miss. EmacsJ's aim is to offer features that make it easy to work in both Emacs and IntelliJ without having to retrain your muscle memory.

The easiest way to use the plugin after installation is to choose the EmacsJ or EmacsJ (macOS) keymap under Settings → Keymap. This activates all the functionality of the plugin. You find all the bindings of the plugin under Settings → Keymap → Plugins → EmacsJ, with short summaries of what the commands do. For more extensive documentation, visit the plugin's GitHub page.

The keymap EmacsJ (macOS) uses the same bindings as the EmacsJ keymap, but with command instead of option in almost all bindings, making it easier to use on a Mac keyboard.

The main features are:

  • Incremental search modeled on Emacs' Isearch, with text and regexp search.
  • Query-replace with text or regexps.
  • Word commands: transpose, upper-case, lower-case, capitalize, move, delete.
  • Easy access to clipboard history à la Emacs (kill ring).
  • A mark history with the ability to pop mark (mark ring), and exchange point and mark.
  • Universal argument: repeat commands a specified number of times.
  • Append-next-kill: append copied/cut text to previous kill.
  • Rectangle commands: copy, open, clear, keep, paste.
  • Zap to character.
  • Go back and forward in XRef history.
  • Whitespace commands: delete space around point, delete empty lines.
  • Duplicate and comment regions and lines.
  • Recenter and relocate caret.

Documentation: EmacsJ on GitHub
idea-plugin.change-notes:

idea-plugin.name: AoikFind
idea-plugin.description:
An IntelliJ platform based IDE plugin to show the search box or find the next or the previous occurrence, combined into one hotkey.

The plugin provides two IDE actions `AoikFind -- Find Next` and `AoikFind -- Find Previous`, which are mapped to hotkeys `Ctrl f` and `Alt f` by default. It is recommended to remap the hotkeys to remove other actions mapped to the same hotkeys.

When the hotkey `Ctrl f` or `Alt f` is pressed, if the search box is not shown or has no focus, the IDE action shows the search box with the selected text entered into it, otherwise the IDE action finds the next or the previous occurrence of the text in the search box.

To split the scenario into steps:

  • 1: Press `ESC`. This hides the search box.
  • 2: Press `Ctrl f`. This shows the search box.
  • 3: Select some text in the editor. This selects the text to be entered into the search box, but also makes the search box lose focus.
  • 4: Press `Ctrl f`. This shows the search box with the selected text entered into it.
  • 5: Press `Ctrl f`. This continues to find the next occurrence of the text in the search box.
  • 6: Press `Ctrl f`. This continues to find the next occurrence of the text in the search box.
  • 7: Press `Alt f`. This continues to find the previous occurrence of the text in the search box.
  • 8: Press `Alt f`. This continues to find the previous occurrence of the text in the search box.

Visit the project site for more information.

idea-plugin.name: Lines Sorter Pro
idea-plugin.description:
Lines Sorter Pro is a powerful and easy-to-use plugin for IntelliJ IDEA that helps you instantly organize your text, code, or configuration files. Whether you need to sort lines alphabetically, by length, shuffle them, or even recursively sort keys in complex JSON files — this tool does it in just a couple of clicks.

  • Supports plain text, code, and JSON files
  • Works with selected lines or the entire file
  • Recursively sorts nested JSON objects
  • Integrates seamlessly into the editor’s right-click Refactor menu

🚀 Key Features

  • 🅰️ Alphabetical Sorting
    Sort lines alphabetically (A-Z or Z-A).

  • 🔢 Sorting by Line Length
    Sort lines by their length (shortest to longest or vice versa).

  • 🔀 Shuffle Lines
    Randomly shuffle selected lines or the entire file.

  • 📄 Flexible Scope
    Works with selected text or the whole file if nothing is selected.

  • 🗂️ JSON File Sorting

    • Sort JSON object keys alphabetically, by value length, or shuffle.
    • Supports recursive sorting for nested JSON objects.

  • ⚡ Easy Access
    All features are available via the right-click Refactor menu in the editor.

Ideal for: Developers working with configuration files, property lists, text data, or any files where organized, readable line order improves workflow and readability.

How to Use

  1. Install the plugin and restart IntelliJ IDEA.
  2. Open any text or JSON file in the editor.
  3. Select the lines you want to sort (or leave nothing selected to sort the whole file).
  4. Right-click in the editor and choose Refactor → Sort Lines....
  5. Pick the desired sorting option from the menu:
    • Sort Alphabetically (A-Z or Z-A)
    • Sort by Line Length (ascending/descending)
    • Shuffle Lines
    • Sort JSON keys (alphabetically, by value length, or shuffle)
Example: Sorting JSON

Before:

{
  "z": 1,
  "a": {
    "d": 4,
    "b": 2,
    "c": {
      "y": 25,
      "x": 24
    }
  },
  "b": 3
}

After (alphabetical):

{
  "a": {
    "b": 2,
    "c": {
      "x": 24,
      "y": 25
    },
    "d": 4
  },
  "b": 3,
  "z": 1
}
Example: Sorting plain text lines

Before:

banana
apple
carrot

After (alphabetical):

apple
banana
carrot
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Added

  • Added recursive sorting for nested JSON objects

ChatCode turns your JetBrains IDE into a multi-agent control room: isolated git worktrees for parallel tasks, native remote-development support, and 600+ models — all in one IDE frame.

  • Remote-dev native. 100% native Swing UI, no embedded browser and no Node.js, so it works identically locally and in JetBrains Remote Development split mode.

chatcode.chinaunicom.cn

idea-plugin.name: CCopy
idea-plugin.description:
CCopy: C++ Includes Expander

CCopy is a powerful CLion plugin designed to streamline competitive programming on online judges. When you copy C++ code containing local include directives, the plugin automatically replaces them with the actual code from the referenced files.

This makes your copied code fully self-contained and ready to compile, eliminating the hassle of managing multiple source files.

Key Features

  • Automatic Include Expansion: Recursively processes local include statements to inline their contents, ensuring that your code compiles as a standalone unit.
  • Dependency Management: Constructs an include tree to prevent duplicate inclusions and maintain the correct order, while intelligently stripping out redundant include guards.
  • Selective Processing: System headers (e.g., <iostream>, <algorithm>) are left untouched, while known local headers are handled appropriately.
  • Customizable Behavior: Easily toggle the functionality on/off through the plugin settings.

This tool is ideal for competitive programmers who need to quickly generate single-file submissions for online judges.

For more information, visit: https://github.com/Aledo-Jun/CCopy

If you like this plugin, Buy me a Coffee!

idea-plugin.name: WSL Path Converter

You can also customize the WSL mount root used by fast conversion, such as /mnt, /, or /wsl, to match your own WSL path layout without calling WSL for every copy action.

Make sure you have put wsl.exe in your system variable PATH.

此插件可以让你一键复制项目中任何文件的 WSL 格式路径，省去手动转换的麻烦。

你也可以自定义快速转换使用的 WSL 挂载根路径，例如 /mnt、/ 或 /wsl，以适配自己的 WSL 路径布局，无需每次复制都调用 WSL。

idea-plugin.description:

idea-plugin.name: Vim Dial
idea-plugin.description:
IdeaVim Dial

IdeaVim extension with advanced text increment and decrement functionality. It enhances the standard increment/decrement functionality found in Vim editors by adding support for complex text patterns beyond simple numbers.

Cycle through related values from various text elements, including numbers, dates, boolean values, operators, and programming language-specific keywords.

Features

  • Vim-like Behavior: Increment or decrement numbers just like Vim's Ctrl+A/Ctrl+X
  • Search from cursor: Transforms the first matching word found from the cursor position forward within the current line
  • Works within words: Cursor can be also within the target word
  • Customizable: Define your own sets of transformations and enable them in your .ideavimrc

Built-in Text Transformations

  • Numeric Values: Increment/decrement integers, decimals, and scientific notation
  • Boolean Values: Toggle between true/false, True/False
  • Logical Operators: Switch between &&/||, and/or, AND/OR
  • Comparison Operators: Toggle ==/!=, is/is not, >/<, >=/<=
  • Bitwise Operators: Switch between &/|
  • Directional Values: Cycle through up/down/left/right
  • Quote Styles: Rotate between "string", 'string', `string`
  • Date/Time: Smart date and time manipulation
  • Language-specific: Support specific transformations for Java, Python, JavaScript, Rust or Markdown

Smart Context Awareness

  • Cursor Position Sensitive: Works regardless of where your cursor is within or before the target text
  • Word Boundary Recognition: Distinguishes between whole words and partial matches
  • Case Preservation: Maintains original case when transforming text
  • Multiple Matches: Automatically selects the closest match to your cursor

Installation

Jetbrains Marketplace

  1. Install the plugin from the IntelliJ IDEA Plugin Marketplace
  2. Ensure you have the IdeaVim plugin installed and enabled
  3. Activate the plugin in your .ideavimrc
  4. Restart IntelliJ IDEA

Manual Installation

  1. Download the latest release
  2. Install manually using Settings/Preferences > Plugins > ⚙️ > Install plugin from disk...

Configuration

Configure which transformation groups to enable in your .ideavimrc:

" Activate plugin
set dial

" Enable multiple groups
let g:dial_include = "basic,numbers,dates"

" Enable some categories (basic, numbers, dates, java) and some specific transformations (python:async, markdown:task_item)
let g:dial_include = "basic,numbers,dates,java,python:async,markdown:task_item"

" Custom transformations
let g:dial_custom_definitions = [
    ['normalizedCaseWords', ['one', 'two', 'three']],
    ['words', ['un', 'deux', 'trois']],
    ['normalizedCasePattern', ['alpha', 'beta', 'gamma']],
    ['pattern', ['start', 'middle', 'end']]
]

Recommended key mappings

Add these mappings to your .ideavimrc:

" Map Ctrl+A to increment
nnoremap <C-a> :DialIncrement<cr>

" Map Ctrl+X to decrement  
nnoremap <C-x> :DialDecrement<cr>

Available Groups

If not specified, basic, number, and date groups are enabled by default. Also, specific language groups are enabled by default based on the JetBrains application in use. For example, IntelliJ IDEA will enable Java specific transformations, Pycharm will enable Python transformations, etc.

  • basic: Boolean values, operators, directions, quotes
  • numbers: Integer, decimal, and scientific notation
  • dates: Date and time patterns
  • java: Java-specific patterns (visibility, basic types, collections methods, streams, etc.)
  • python: Python-specific patterns (basic types, loops, collections, etc.)
  • javascript: JavaScript-specific patterns
  • markdown: Markdown formatting
  • rust: Rust-specific patterns
idea-plugin.change-notes: Updated to more recent versions of IntelliJ platform and IdeaVim

idea-plugin.name: ITodoTxt
idea-plugin.description:
A plugin for managing todo.txt files directly within IntelliJ IDEA.

This plugin provides a visual interface for working with todo.txt format files, allowing you to easily manage your tasks without leaving your IDE. Key features include:
  • Visual editing of todo.txt files with a table-based interface
  • Task completion status management
  • Priority and context management
  • Advanced search and filtering capabilities
  • Task statistics and progress tracking

The todo.txt format is a simple and effective way to manage your tasks in a plain text file. This plugin makes it even easier by providing a user-friendly interface while maintaining full compatibility with the standard format.

一个用于在IntelliJ IDEA内直接管理todo.txt文件的插件。

该插件提供了可视化的界面来处理todo.txt格式文件， 让您无需离开IDE即可轻松管理任务。主要功能包括：
  • 基于表格界面的todo.txt文件可视化编辑
  • 任务完成状态管理
  • 优先级和上下文管理
  • 高级搜索和过滤功能
  • 任务统计和进度跟踪

todo.txt格式是一种在纯文本文件中管理任务的简单有效方法。 该插件通过提供用户友好的界面，同时保持与标准格式的完全兼容性， 使它变得更加容易使用。
idea-plugin.change-notes: Initial version: - Create new todo.txt files - Basic todo.txt parsing functionality

idea-plugin.description:
Xross Tools Extension provides addons to x-series tools, such as xunit, xstate, xdecision, xbehavior and xflow.

idea-plugin.name: Manage Scheduled Events
idea-plugin.description:
An IntelliJ Platform plugin that discovers and lists methods annotated with @Scheduled in Java/Spring projects.

It provides a "Scheduled Events" tool window to browse events, view cron expressions, and navigate to source, with:

  • Search
  • Grouping by package or by class
  • Direct Cron validation and update
  • Optional ShedLock helpers: add/remove @SchedulerLock to all listed methods when ShedLock is present

ShedLock ensures that scheduled tasks run on a single node in clustered environments. When enabled, this plugin can add @SchedulerLock(name = "ClassName_methodNameLock") right after @Scheduled, and will manage imports for net.javacrumbs.shedlock.spring.annotation.SchedulerLock. You can later tweak parameters like lockAtLeastFor / lockAtMostFor as needed. Learn more at ShedLock.
idea-plugin.change-notes: • 1.0.0: Initial release (browse and navigate @Scheduled methods; search; grouping; expand/collapse) ShedLock support (toolbar actions to add/remove @SchedulerLock; quick navigation to enable ShedLock)

idea-plugin.name: eGovConstant
idea-plugin.description:
7,200 entries of the Korean government naming standard, inside your IDE. Search in Korean, insert a standard identifier. No setup required.

행정표준용어 7,200건을 IDE 안에서. 한글로 검색하고 표준 변수명을 그대로 삽입하세요. 별도 설정이 필요하지 않습니다.

What it does

  • Code completion. Start naming a variable, field, parameter or column and standard names appear in the completion popup, with the matching Korean term and the domain's data type alongside.
  • Search tool window. Type a Korean term, an English abbreviation, or just the leading consonants (ㅅㅇㅈ finds 사용자). Copy or insert any of the four spellings.
  • Four spellings, always. camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, CONSTANT_CASE — each copyable and insertable on its own.
  • Rename to a standard name. Alt+Enter on an existing name runs a real rename refactoring, so every usage is updated.
  • Compliance inspection. Finds names that spell a standard word out — userName where the standard says userNm — and offers the rename. Off by default.
  • Your own dictionary. Import entries as JSON, pasted or from a file. They merge with the bundled data, or replace it entirely.
  • Works beyond Java. Java, Kotlin, SQL, JavaScript and TypeScript. Installs into IntelliJ IDEA, WebStorm, DataGrip, PyCharm and the rest.
  • Usable by AI agents. A read-only lookup endpoint and an MCP server let a coding agent consult the standard instead of inventing identifiers.

주요 기능

  • 코드 자동 완성. 변수·필드·파라미터·컬럼 이름을 입력하기 시작하면 표준 변수명이 추천 목록에 나타납니다. 대응하는 한글 용어와 도메인의 데이터 타입을 함께 보여줍니다.
  • 검색 도구 창. 한글 용어, 영문 약어, 또는 초성만으로 검색합니다 (ㅅㅇㅈ → 사용자). 4종 표기 중 원하는 것을 복사하거나 삽입할 수 있습니다.
  • 4종 표기 상시 제공. camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, CONSTANT_CASE 를 각각 복사·삽입.
  • 표준 변수명으로 변경. 기존 이름 위에서 Alt+Enter. 실제 이름 변경 리팩터링이므로 사용처까지 함께 수정됩니다.
  • 표준 표기 검사. 영문약어 대신 영문명을 그대로 쓴 이름(userName → userNm)을 찾아 변경을 제안합니다. 기본값은 꺼짐입니다.
  • 사용자 사전. JSON 을 붙여넣거나 파일에서 항목을 가져올 수 있습니다. 기본 사전과 병합하거나, 가져온 항목만 쓸 수도 있습니다.
  • Java 외 언어 지원. Java, Kotlin, SQL, JavaScript, TypeScript. IntelliJ IDEA, WebStorm, DataGrip, PyCharm 등에 설치됩니다.
  • AI 에이전트 연동. 읽기 전용 조회 엔드포인트와 MCP 서버를 제공하므로, 에이전트가 변수명을 지어내지 않고 표준 사전을 참조할 수 있습니다.

The bundled dataset / 기본 제공 데이터

CountContains
Terms (용어)5,395Full standard terms with abbreviation, domain and storage format
Words (단어)1,699Single vocabulary words with English name
Domains (도메인)106Data-type domains with type, length and unit

English and Korean UI, following the IDE's language setting. IDE 언어 설정에 따라 영어와 한국어를 모두 지원합니다.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Added

  • 영어/한글 UI 동시 지원. IDE 언어 설정을 따르며, 기존에 하드코딩돼 있던 문자열 40여 개를 리소스 번들로 분리.
  • 한글 초성 검색. ㅅㅇㅈ 로 사용자, 승인자, 사업장 등을 찾을 수 있습니다.
  • 변수명 4종 표기 동시 제공 및 개별 복사/삽입: camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, CONSTANT_CASE. 기존에는 3종을 만들어 두고 camelCase 만 사용했습니다.
  • SQL, JavaScript/TypeScript 지원. 이에 따라 WebStorm, DataGrip, PyCharm Community 에도 설치할 수 있습니다. 표준 용어가 본래 DB 컬럼명을 위해 만들어진 만큼 SQL 은 snake_case 를 기본으로 씁니다.
  • 즐겨찾기와 최근 사용 항목. 접두어 없이 자동 완성을 호출하면 최근 사용한 항목을 먼저 보여줍니다.
  • 검색 결과에 매치 구간 하이라이팅. 동의어나 약어 일부로 매치된 이유를 확인할 수 있습니다.
  • AI 코딩 에이전트 연동. IDE 내장 웹서버에 읽기 전용 조회 엔드포인트를 추가하고, 이를 감싸는 MCP 서버를 tools/mcp/ 에 제공합니다. 에이전트가 변수명을 지어내는 대신 표준 사전을 조회할 수 있습니다.
  • 검색어 기록, 결과 없음 상태 안내, 색인 진행 표시.

Changed

  • 검색 엔진을 역색인 기반으로 교체. USER_NM 의 NM 처럼 _ 로 구분된 접미어가 검색됩니다. 이 표준의 핵심 패턴인 NM/YMD/CD/NO/YN 이 그동안 사실상 검색되지 않았습니다.
  • 랭킹 재설계: 길이 정규화와 IDF 도입. 일자(1,012건) 여부(614건) 처럼 지나치게 흔한 접미어가 검색 신호를 잠식하던 문제와, 짧은 검색어에서 수백 건이 동점이 되던 문제를 해결.
  • 사전 데이터와 설정을 프로젝트 단위에서 IDE 단위로 이전. 프로젝트를 여러 개 열어도 한 번만 로딩하며, 가져온 사전을 프로젝트마다 다시 가져올 필요가 없고, .idea 에 상태 파일이 생기지 않습니다. 기존 프로젝트의 데이터는 처음 열 때 자동으로 이전됩니다.
  • 설정을 Settings → Tools → eGovConstant 로 이동. IDE 설정 검색에 노출되고 확인/취소가 동작합니다. 툴 창은 '사전'과 '가져오기' 두 탭으로 정리.
  • 자동 완성 추천이 기본적으로 IDE 자체 추천보다 아래에 표시됩니다. 1.6.2 에서 위로 올렸으나, 이미 선언된 변수가 목록 아래로 밀리는 문제가 있어 되돌리고 설정으로 선택하도록 바꿨습니다.
  • 검색 결과가 페이지 단위 이동에서 연속 스크롤로 바뀌었습니다.
  • 라이트/다크 테마 대응 색상 체계와 아이콘 세트 신규 제작. 마켓플레이스 로고 추가.
  • 자동 완성 목록의 부가 정보에 데이터 타입(VARCHAR(100) 등)을 표시.
  • 표기 규칙 통일: USER_ID_YN → userIdYn / user_id_yn. 기존에는 user_id_YN 처럼 대소문자가 섞였습니다(번들 약어 1,230건 해당).
  • 사전 가져오기 결과에 추가/병합/건너뜀 건수를 표시하고, 잘못된 항목은 해당 항목만 건너뜁니다.
  • 번들 데이터 파일 정리로 크기 47% 감소 (3.73MB → 1.98MB).
  • 버전 올리기와 CHANGELOG 작성, 릴리스 생성을 자동화.

Fixed

  • 표준 용어 149건이 조용히 사라지던 문제. 용어(TERM)와 단어(WORD)가 같은 영문 약어를 쓰면 하나가 다른 하나를 덮어쓰면서 도메인·포맷 정보까지 함께 사라졌습니다.
  • 변수명 자동 완성 중 오류가 발생하던 문제. val userNm 처럼 중간에 대문자를 입력하면 재현됐습니다.
  • 자동 완성 목록에 보이는 이름과 실제로 삽입되는 이름이 다르던 문제.
  • '표준 용어로 변경'(Alt+Enter)이 실제 이름 변경이 아니라 커서 위치의 글자만 바꿔, 해당 변수를 사용하는 모든 곳이 컴파일되지 않게 되던 문제. 이제 사용처까지 함께 변경됩니다. 또한 JSON, Markdown 등 관련 없는 파일에서 이 메뉴가 나타나던 문제도 해결.
  • 검색어가 사전에 없을 때 '결과 없음' 대신 전체 항목이 표시되던 문제.
  • 추천 개수를 적게 설정하면 상위 결과가 아닌 임의의 항목이 표시되던 문제.
  • 유형 필터를 걸면 일치하는 항목이 있는데도 결과가 비던 문제.
  • 도메인 항목을 복사·삽입하면 한글이 코드에 삽입되던 문제(도메인 106건 전체). 이제 해당 항목은 변수명을 만들 수 없음을 안내합니다.
  • 선택된 검색 결과의 유형 표시와 약어가 배경색과 겹쳐 읽기 어렵던 문제.
  • 라이트 테마에서 툴 창 아이콘이 거의 보이지 않던 문제.
  • 툴 창을 처음 열 때 IDE가 멈추던 문제.
  • 검색 중 이전 검색 결과가 최신 결과를 덮어쓰던 문제.
  • 툴 창을 키보드만으로 조작할 수 없던 문제. Enter 와 더블클릭으로 삽입, 검색창에서 ↓ 로 목록 이동.
  • '초기화' 버튼이 확인 없이 가져온 사전을 전부 삭제하던 문제.
  • 사전 가져오기 화면에서 { 를 입력할 수 없던 문제.
  • 상세 정보에 '동의어: -', '허용값: -' 처럼 빈 값이 표시되던 문제.
  • 한국어 Windows 에서 빌드하면 마켓플레이스 설명의 한글이 깨진 채 배포되던 문제.
  • 사용자 화면에 내부 값(TERM, WORD, XLSX)이 그대로 노출되던 문제.

idea-plugin.description:
Ship Elixir faster. One-click SDK downloads, asdf/mise SDK detection, Credo linting, debugger, 50+ Phoenix/LiveView templates, EEx/HEEx/LEEx support.

Why Flexible Elixir?

We built this plugin for our own production Elixir projects and are actively developing it. We're adding a few interesting new ideas to the Elixir plugin world - and since this is a fresh release, we appreciate bug reports so we can iterate quickly.

idea-plugin.name: I18n Navigator
idea-plugin.description:
I18n navigation plugin that I created to solve my own problem. I was frustrated searching for translation usages in my projects. Available plugins were not working with my Vue and Svelte projects, so I decided to fix it for myself. Plugin is mainly created to work with Vue and Svelte projects. However, other frameworks like React, Angular, Solid or plain HTML, js, ts files are supported as well. If you find issues and the plugin doesn't support your setup, then report it.

Jump from translation calls in code (Vue, Svelte, React, Solid, Angular) to locale entries in JSON, JavaScript, and TypeScript translation files, then navigate back from translation files to code usages.

  • Go to declaration from translation calls like $t("common.save"), and other custom i18n function names
  • Find missing translations used in code but absent from one or more locale files
  • Find unused translation keys that are defined in locale files but never referenced
  • Auto-detection of translation files. Manual setup is also supported if you have custom translation files.
  • Supports flat and nested translation key structures, manual locale file paths, and configurable translation function names

Useful for finding the right components, managing localization, translation files, locale JSON, and i18n key references in IDEA.

Plugin is optimized, and when translations or code is changed, then only relevant files are re-indexed, and therefore you might need to save the file you are changing to force indexing. Without saving indexing will happen at some unspecified moment in the future. k

RestfulToolkit Next 1.2.0

  • Introduced Strategy, Template Method, Composite, and Facade patterns to make Spring MVC, WebFlux, and JAX-RS endpoint resolution easier to extend and maintain
  • Reduced endpoint index rebuild overhead by reusing immutable module configuration snapshots and avoiding repeated configuration scans
  • Optimized unified search with bounded top-result ranking and fewer hot-path allocations while preserving filters, history, scoring, and navigation behavior
  • Added pluggable properties and YAML configuration parsers while preserving profile precedence, file precedence, placeholder resolution, and context-path behavior
  • Expanded regression and architecture coverage to 149 tests, including service registration and dependency-boundary checks

RestfulToolkit Next 1.1.2

  • Fixed thread-safety issues in endpoint index rebuild and navigation (AtomicInteger retryCount, removed race conditions in getter-triggered rebuild)
  • Improved navigation stability with fallback navigation and tryNavigate failure detection
  • Refactored endpoint index error handling and state tracking: EndpointResolutionException, ensureRebuildScheduled, and RebuildResult
  • Optimized async search execution to avoid EDT blocking and added result application callbacks
  • Improved user feedback on navigation failures via SearchPopupActions status messages
  • Fixed singleton state leak in GenerateUrlAction
  • Optimized SpringWebFlux resolver by replacing FileTypeIndex with keyword pre-filtering
  • Improved Spring placeholder parsing and JSON formatting error handling
  • Enhanced Kotlin endpoint resolver type-safety checks
  • Added synchronization protection and state copying for SearchHistory

RestfulToolkit Next 1.1.1

  • Updated README and plugin metadata to match the current unified search popup and editor context-menu features
  • Fixed service registration tests for EndpointIndex and the project-level SearchHistory service
  • Introduced EndpointDescriptor as a pure endpoint data model to reduce coupling between navigation, search fields, and PSI elements
  • Extracted SearchPopupModel for non-UI search popup logic such as status text, recent results, and selection restoration
  • Added ServiceResolverRegistry to centralize Spring and JAX-RS resolver registration for future framework extensions
  • Split Spring Java and Kotlin endpoint discovery collaborators to keep SpringResolver focused on orchestration
  • Added architecture guard tests and verified the project with ./gradlew test and ./gradlew build

RestfulToolkit Next 1.1.0

  • Added a unified REST endpoint search popup with path, HTTP method, module, controller, method name, and description matching

  • Preserved duplicate method/path endpoints from different controllers or modules instead of hiding them during search
  • Improved startup behavior by showing indexing status and refreshing search results and module filters after endpoint indexing completes
  • Added English and Chinese localization for the search popup, result list, preview panel, and status messages
  • Improved search performance by caching selection keys, optimizing recent endpoint ranking, and reducing renderer allocations

RestfulToolkit Next 1.0.1

idea-plugin.name: Television
idea-plugin.description:
Bring the blazing speed and elegance of Television directly into your JetBrains IDE.

This plugin integrates Television seamlessly into IntelliJ-based IDEs. It provides a fast, rusty, and highly extensible fuzzy finder TUI—acting as a powerful, keyboard-centric alternative to Telescope or the native "Search Everywhere" dialog.

Key Features

  • Default Channels: Instantly search through your workspace files with the files channel, or search through file contents using the text (grep) channel.
  • Custom Dynamic Channels: Define your own tv channels right from the IDE settings. Want a dedicated channel for git-files, todo-comments, or buffers? You can easily map them.
  • Context-Aware Execution: Execute your searches globally against the Project Root, or narrowly against the Current File's Directory (CWD) for scoped finding.
  • Editor Selection Passing: Optionally pass your current active text selection in the editor directly to Television to use as the initial search input.
  • Immersive TUI: Television opens instantly in a dedicated, full-screen editor tab, keeping you in the flow without floating popups blocking your code.
  • IdeaVim Ready: First-class support for IdeaVim. Map your favorite channels directly in your .ideavimrc (e.g., nmap <leader>ff <Action>(Television.Channel.Files)).
  • Smart IDE Navigation: Selecting a file or text match in Television instantly closes the TUI and opens the target file right in your IDE's editor, automatically jumping to the exact line and column.

Why Television?

Television is written in Rust, blazingly fast, and designed to be customized. If you love the workflow of Neovim (nvim) using Telescope but need the power of a full IDE, this plugin brings the best of both worlds: the speed and keyboard-driven ergonomics of a terminal fuzzy finder, combined with IntelliJ's robust code navigation.

Requirements

This plugin requires the television CLI to be installed and available on your system PATH.

For example, on macOS with Homebrew:

brew install television

Once installed, ensure the default channels are available:

tv update-channels

Works in IntelliJ IDEA, WebStorm, and any other JetBrains IDE that supports JSON files (2025.1+).

idea-plugin.name: Maven Up
idea-plugin.description:
Find and fix vulnerable Maven dependencies — and keep every dependency, plugin, and parent POM up to date from one tool window.

Core Features:

  • Find & Update Versions: Discover newer versions in Maven Central and private repositories, apply configurable auto-selection strategies, and bulk-update dependencies, plugins, and parent POMs directly from the tool window.
  • Vulnerability Scanning: Check dependencies, plugins, and resolved transitive components for known vulnerabilities via OSV.dev and Sonatype OSS Index with severity ratings, CVSS scores, and affected version ranges.
  • One-Click Vulnerability Fixes: Apply recommended fix versions for direct findings and pin vulnerable transitive dependencies in dependencyManagement with configurable explanatory comments.
  • Complete Dependency Overview: Displays all dependencies, plugins, and parent POMs across Maven modules in an organized table, marking entries inherited from parent POMs or BOM imports.
  • Transitive Vulnerabilities View: Inspect, filter, and remediate vulnerable transitive dependencies in a dedicated tool window tab with highlighted recommended fix versions.

Advanced Capabilities:

  • Property-Aware Versions: Recognizes and updates Maven properties (e.g., ${spring.version}) across all references while resolving placeholders accurately.
  • Dependency Hierarchy Inspection: Inspect searchable parent, BOM, management, and inclusion paths in a side panel, initially expanding table and CVE paths while keeping unreferenced transitive-only context available on demand, with an option to show or hide GroupIds.
  • Detailed Security Reports: View advisories in a master-detail split view with severity, CVSS scores and vectors, CWE identifiers, affected version ranges, fixed versions, and advisory references.
  • Safe Update Workflow: Review all planned version updates and managed-entry removals in a sortable confirmation dialog with optional automatic Maven re-sync.
  • Flexible Filtering & Sorting: Filter by name, type, inheritance, pending updates, or security findings, and sort columns ascending, descending, or in original POM order.
  • Status at a Glance: Marks the tool window icon with a colored badge dot to signal vulnerabilities and available updates while the tool window is collapsed.
  • Smart Navigation: Jump directly to pom.xml declarations or property definitions, and open artifacts in configured repository browsers with a single click.
  • Private Repository Support: Access authenticated repositories from Maven settings.xml with support for environment variable placeholders.
  • Private GroupId Filter: Exclude internal GroupIds from Maven Central queries to ensure proprietary company identifiers remain private.
  • Optional Downgrades & Version Filtering: List older versions when rollbacks are needed or hide unstable releases and custom pre-release qualifiers.
  • Repository Browser Options: Choose between MVN Repository and Sonatype Central for artifact links.
  • Transparent Error Handling: Report failed API or repository requests in closable banners with direct links to settings when credentials require attention.
  • Secure Token Storage: Stores Sonatype OSS Index API tokens safely in IntelliJ Password Safe.
  • Global Settings: Configure version lookup strategies, vulnerability scanners, and POM modification preferences under Settings | Tools | Maven Up.
  • Privacy-First Design: Only Maven coordinates are transmitted over HTTPS for version checks and vulnerability scans—your source code remains private.
  • Reliable Plugin Lifecycle: Requires an IDE restart after installing, updating, or disabling the plugin.
  • Reduced API Traffic: Caches fetched version lists and vulnerability scan results with configurable durations and persists them across IDE restarts, so unchanged dependencies are served from cache while updated versions automatically trigger a fresh, targeted query; search and scan notifications report how many results came from cache.
  • Cache Management: Inspect cached entries and remaining TTL in sortable tables and invalidate the active tab's cache across all projects.
  • Request Diagnostics: Trace cache usage and individual version and vulnerability API requests through DEBUG logs.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Added

  • Added request coalescing (thundering-herd prevention) for version metadata queries and coordinate-level vulnerability scans so concurrent requests for the same missing or expired artifact or coordinate execute at most one external request while sharing the result across all callers.
  • Added version and vulnerability result caching keyed by artifact (and, for vulnerability results, by exact version) so repeated version searches and vulnerability scans skip API calls for coordinates already queried within a configurable time-to-live, dramatically reducing redundant network traffic after repeated checks; new Version cache duration and Vulnerability cache duration settings control the TTLs (0 disables caching), and changes to private GroupId prefixes or Central-first lookup clear only the version cache, while toggling Sonatype OSS Index clears only the vulnerability cache.
  • Added disk-backed persistence for version metadata and vulnerability scan result caches in the IDE cache directory, preserving valid cached data across IDE restarts, with automatic startup-pruning of expired entries on initialization and proactive eviction prior to disk serialization.
  • Setting cache duration to 0 immediately evicts all in-memory entries and clears persistent disk cache files.
  • Added DEBUG-level logging for cache decisions and individual Maven metadata, OSV.dev, and Sonatype OSS Index requests to distinguish reused results from live queries.
  • Added a Show Cache Contents... button on the Versions and Updates and Vulnerability Check settings pages with sortable tables showing coordinates, cached counts, query timestamps, and remaining TTL in seconds for each respective cache.
  • Added Invalidate with a confirmation prompt to clear the entire application-wide cache of the active cache dialog and immediately refresh its contents and count.

Changed

  • Version-search and vulnerability-scan notifications now report how many dependency results were served from cache.
  • Added a hierarchy-toolbar toggle to show or hide Maven GroupIds for a compact artifact-focused view.
  • Automatic version searches triggered by project startup or Maven imports reuse the version metadata cache.

Fixed

  • Fixed the Gradle 9.7 deprecation warning emitted by Detekt's reporting configuration by upgrading to Detekt 2.0.0-alpha.6.
  • Fixed the row selection in the Dependencies table being permanently lost after every refresh (e.g., after a vulnerability scan finishes), which left an open Dependency Hierarchy split view empty and unusable.
  • Fixed the Dependency Hierarchy split view's toolbar (including the Close button and the toolbar toggle) becoming entirely unresponsive whenever the panel showed its empty state, because its actions targeted a tree component that was never actually displayed.
  • Fixed IDE warnings about calling AnAction.update/actionPerformed directly in tests by routing test-driven action invocations through ActionUtil.updateAction/ActionUtil.performAction.
  • Fixed the remote Eel performance inspection warning on disk-backed cache reads by switching from Files.readString to Kotlin's Path.readText.
  • Fixed IntelliJ Plugin Verifier compatibility errors against IDE builds 263+ by configuring external class prefixes and removing the obsolete com.intellij.modules.xml descriptor dependency.

idea-plugin.name: Database Tools Plus
idea-plugin.description:
Database Tools Plus

Enhance IntelliJ IDEA database workflows with always-visible field metadata and persistent Database tree search.

  • Displays a field type on its own line above the field comment.
  • Wraps comments to the current column width and limits them to 1–100 lines (2 by default), with an ellipsis when text is truncated.
  • Lets you configure a shared font, font size, and text color for field types and comments. Fonts and colors can follow the IDE/system theme.
  • Adds an optional persistent search field above the Database tree, with recent-search history, explicit filtering, native matched-text highlighting, and per-project retention of search content, history, and filter state.
  • Uses metadata already loaded by IntelliJ IDEA and does not issue additional SQL queries.
  • Preserves the native header's sorting, filtering, context menus, column dragging, resizing, and horizontal scrolling.

Supports regular relational Result Grids with available database column metadata. Transposed and hierarchical views, expression columns without a source column, and grids without database metadata are skipped safely.

数据库工具增强

增强 IntelliJ IDEA 的数据库使用体验：在表数据和 SQL 查询结果的表头中直接显示字段类型与注释，并提供 Database 树常驻搜索。

  • 字段类型单独显示在字段注释上方。
  • 字段注释会按当前列宽自动换行；可设置最多显示 1–100 行，默认 2 行，超出部分以省略号截断。
  • 字段类型和注释共用字体、字号和文字颜色设置；字体和颜色可跟随 IDEA/系统主题。
  • 可在 Database 树顶部显示常驻搜索框；支持最近搜索历史，按 Enter 或点击过滤按钮后实时过滤数据库对象、原生样式高亮关键词，并按项目保留搜索内容、搜索历史和筛选状态。
  • 仅使用 IDEA 已加载的数据库元数据，不执行额外 SQL 查询。
  • 保留原生表头的排序、筛选、右键菜单、列拖动、列缩放和横向滚动行为。

适用于具备数据库字段元数据的常规关系型 Result Grid。转置视图、层级表头、没有真实来源字段的表达式列，以及缺少数据库元数据的表格会被安全跳过。

idea-plugin.name: TreeInfoTip Notes / 目录树备注
idea-plugin.description:
TreeInfoTip Notes — notes, colors and icons for the project tree, plus a file-member outline with comments.


GitHub | Issues |

    English:

  • Right-click any file or folder in the project view: append a text note, override the display name, set a hover tooltip, change text/background color, pick any built-in IDE icon, or add a strikethrough
  • "File members" tab: the methods and properties of the file you are editing as a tree, each followed by its comment (JavaDoc / JSDoc / line comments) — any language with a structure view works: Java, Kotlin, TS / JS / TSX, Python, Go, and more
  • "Directory notes" tab: every configured rule in one list — dead paths flagged red, never-matching duplicates greyed out, one-click cleanup for both, double-click to jump to the file or to the rule's line in the XML
  • "Help" tab: what each context-menu item does, all XML attributes, and how match priority is resolved
  • Rules are stored as a nested tree, so a long shared directory is written once as a parent node
  • Everything lives in one DirectoryV7.xml in the project root: commit it to share with your team, delete it to reset, hand edits apply on save

    中文：

  • 项目树右键文件或目录：添加文字备注、覆盖显示名称、设置悬浮提示、改文字色和背景色、换成 IDE 内置的任意图标、加删除线
  • 「文件成员」tab：把当前文件的方法和属性列成一棵树，每项后面跟它的注释（JavaDoc / JSDoc / 行注释）——凡是有结构视图的语言都支持：Java、Kotlin、TS / JS / TSX、Python、Go 等
  • 「目录备注」tab：全部规则集中在一个列表——失效路径标红、永不生效的重复规则标灰、一键清理，双击跳到对应文件或 XML 里那条规则所在的行
  • 「说明」tab：右键菜单每一项做什么、XML 全部参数怎么写、命中优先级怎么算
  • 规则以嵌套树的形式存储：重复的长目录作为父节点只写一遍
  • 全部配置存在项目根目录的一个 DirectoryV7.xml 里：提交它就能同步给同事。删掉它就全部重置，手动改完保存即时生效




Send issues
