This is a maintained fork of Link-Kou/intellij-treeInfotip. Please uninstall the original TreeInfotip before using this one — running both decorates the tree twice.

本插件是 Link-Kou/intellij-treeInfotip 的复刻续维护版本。 请先卸载原版 TreeInfotip 再使用，两个一起装会重复装饰目录树。
idea-plugin.change-notes:
7.1.4

  • 「清除失效路径」「清理重复规则」两个图标补上深色变体，跟刷新按钮一样浅色主题深灰、深色主题浅灰自动切换，不再是一团黑
  • 删掉插件 logo SVG 里的 c2pa 元数据（文件从 8.6KB 瘦到不到 1KB）；两个明暗 logo 尺寸一致（都是 40×40、同一套图形，只差颜色）
  • The two toolbar icons now have dark variants and switch shade with the theme like the Refresh button; stripped c2pa metadata from the plugin logo SVGs

    7.1.3

  • 「目录备注」工具栏的按钮和「展开」层数数字并到同一行，省一行高度
  • 换了图标：「清除失效路径」用扫把、「清理重复规则」用垃圾桶，插件 logo 也换了新的（带深色变体）
  • The "Directory notes" toolbar buttons and the "expand depth" numbers are now on one row; new icons for "clear dead paths" (broom) and "clean duplicates" (trash), plus a new plugin logo with a dark variant

    7.1.2

  • 「目录备注」树现在也按规则配置渲染：配了图标就显示那个图标（没配才用目录 / 文件类型图标），文字套上配的颜色和删除线，等于项目树效果的预览。失效（红）和被覆盖（灰）两种状态更要紧，仍旧盖过配色
  • The "Directory notes" tree now reflects each rule's own styling: its configured icon (falling back to the folder / file-type icon), text color and strikethrough — a preview of the project-tree effect. Dead (red) and shadowed (grey) states still take precedence

    7.1.1

  • 「目录备注」树的展开层数数字 1-10 加了方框，看着像按钮、也把那行的空白填起来
  • 定位改成单击、双击目录展开 / 收起：以前双击目录会又展开又定位，两件事一起发生。单击一个文件立刻定位，单击目录短暂等一下（被双击打断就只展开）
  • The depth numbers 1-10 in the "Directory notes" tree now have boxed borders; navigation moved to single-click and double-click on a directory now only expands/collapses it (previously double-click both expanded and navigated)

    7.1.0

  • 去掉了 extension 属性和「按扩展名批量设置」菜单：一条规则只对应一个路径。命中规则简化为「完整路径全等」一种，不再有目录级 / 全项目的类型规则。老配置里带 extension 的规则在迁移时会被丢弃
  • Removed the extension attribute and the "batch by extension" menu: a rule now maps to a single path. Matching is simplified to exact full-path equality; extension-based rules in old configs are dropped on migration

    7.0.3

  • 「目录备注」树工具栏加了一排数字 1-10：点几就把树展开到第几层，默认 3 层。没展开的照样能手动点开，失效节点无论层数都会展开露出来
  • The "Directory notes" tree toolbar now has a row of numbers 1-10: click one to expand the tree to that depth (default 3). Collapsed nodes can still be opened by hand, and dead nodes are always revealed regardless of depth

    7.0.2

  • 「目录备注」侧边栏从平铺列表改成目录树，结构和配置文件、项目树一致；单链目录会压平成一段。失效的规则留在原位标红、其祖先链自动展开，一眼能看到；纯目录容器双击跳到对应目录
  • The "Directory notes" sidebar is now a tree mirroring the config/project structure; single-child directories are collapsed into one node. Dead-path rules stay in place, highlighted red with their ancestors auto-expanded; double-clicking a pure container jumps to that directory

    7.0.1

  • 迁移生成的 DirectoryV7.xml 缩进从 4 个空格改成 2 个空格，嵌套深了也不至于把行推得太靠右
  • The migrated DirectoryV7.xml now indents with 2 spaces instead of 4, so deeply nested nodes don't drift too far right

    7.0.0

  • 配置文件升级为 DirectoryV7.xml，结构从平铺改成嵌套树：一个 <node> 可以套下一层 <node>，每层的 path 只写相对上一层的那一截，重复的长目录天生只写一遍——原来的「抽离路径前缀」机制因此去掉了
  • 属性名全部改短：title→note、presentableText→label、tooltipTitle→tooltip、textColor→color、backgroundColor→bg、strikethrough→strike
  • 开项目时若只有旧的 DirectoryV6.xml / DirectoryV3.xml，会自动按它的内容生成一份 V7 并发通知；旧文件原样保留、不改名也不删，方便还在用旧版插件的同事，确认无误后可自行删除
  • The config file is now DirectoryV7.xml with a nested tree structure: a <node> can contain child <node>s and each level's path is relative to its parent, so a long shared directory is written once (the old prefix-extraction feature is removed)
  • Attributes renamed for brevity: title→note, presentableText→label, tooltipTitle→tooltip, textColor→color, backgroundColor→bg, strikethrough→strike
  • On open, an existing DirectoryV6.xml / DirectoryV3.xml is auto-converted into a new V7 file; the old file is kept untouched (not renamed, not deleted) for teammates still on the old plugin

    6.2.0

  • 「选择图标或颜色」弹窗的三项现在都能清空：图标选下拉框第一项「（不设置）」，文字颜色和背景色各自点旁边的「清除」。 以前三样一旦设上就再也去不掉；顺带修掉「新建一条规则一点确定就必然写入一个图标」的老毛病——现在没选就不写 icon 属性
  • 文字颜色不再盖掉 Git 的状态色：被改过（蓝）、已加（绿）、未纳入版本控制（红）的节点，文字颜色让给 Git。 配置里的颜色不会丢，文件回到「无改动」状态时自己回来；图标和背景色不受影响
  • 「未设置」的颜色色块改成白底加红斜杠，和「选了深色」区分得开
  • All three rows of the icon/color dialog can now be cleared: pick the first item "（不设置）" for the icon, or the "清除" button next to each color. Previously none of them could be removed once set, and a brand-new rule always got an icon written whether you picked one or not
  • Text color no longer overrides the VCS status color: modified (blue), added (green) and unversioned (red) nodes keep the Git color. Your color stays in the config and returns once the file is clean; icons and background colors are unaffected
  • The "no color" swatch is now white with a red slash, so it reads differently from a dark color

    6.1.0

  • 配置文件改名推迟到「保存」那一刻：开 IDE 不再动它。只有第一次点「抽离」并保存时才把 DirectoryV3.xml 改名为 DirectoryV6.xml，中途反悔文件名也没被动过，文件名和内容永远一致
  • 「抽离」的兼容性提醒只在真的要改名时弹一次，本来就是 DirectoryV6.xml 的、或者已经抽过再点一次的都不再打扰
  • 「还原」多给一个选择：换回 DirectoryV3.xml / 保留 DirectoryV6.xml / 取消。还原后内容旧版插件就能读了，文件名换不换由你定
  • 弹窗打开时给有问题的 prefix 声明上底色：红色是目录在磁盘上已经没有了，黄色是没有任何规则引用它。一条前缀失效意味着底下一批规则一起失效，光看「目录备注」列表看不出根因
  • 新增「清理前缀」按钮：没人引用的只删声明；路径失效的连引用它的规则一起删——只删声明会让那些规则剩下半截相对路径，变成指向别处的错规则
  • 手改过的 prefix id 会留着：把 carrier5 改成「承运商基础包」之后再点一次「抽离」，不会被打回自动生成的名字
  • 「说明」tab 补了「抽离路径前缀」一整节，写清了抽离的判据（净收益为正，没有「几条起步」的门槛，前缀越长越容易够本，/src 这种再多条也抽不出来）
  • Config file rename now happens only when you hit Save after Extract — never on IDE startup, so the file name always matches its contents
  • The compatibility warning is shown only when a rename will actually happen
  • Restore now offers three choices: rename back to DirectoryV3.xml, keep DirectoryV6.xml, or cancel
  • Broken (red) and unreferenced (yellow) prefix declarations are highlighted in the dialog, with a new "Clean prefixes" button
  • Hand-edited prefix ids are preserved when re-extracting

    6.0.0

  • 配置文件改名为 DirectoryV6.xml：第一次抽离路径前缀并保存时，老的 DirectoryV3.xml 会改名过来，内容一个字不动，并发一条通知告知
  • 新增抽离路径前缀：重复的长目录提到 <prefixes> 里只写一遍，每条规则只留剩下那截。真实数据实测 19 条规则的路径部分从 1012 个字符降到 830 个
  • 入口在侧边栏「目录备注」工具栏的「抽离或还原路径前缀」，点开是一个弹窗，直接显示配置文件正文；抽离和还原只改弹窗里的内容，看清楚了再保存，不满意点「还原」或者直接关掉
  • 去掉底部的「TreeInfoTip Notes XML」工具窗口：常驻占一栏、又只是偶尔用一次，内容收进了上面那个弹窗。「检查失效路径」由「目录备注」列表自带的标红代替，正则实现的「格式化」和「清理空属性」一并去掉（属性值里带 < > 时它们本来就不安全）
  • 改名的原因：抽离过的文件旧版插件读不了——它不认 prefix 属性，会把剩下那截当成完整路径。换个文件名，新旧两版就各读各的，不会互相读坏
  • Renamed the config file to DirectoryV6.xml; an existing DirectoryV3.xml is renamed the first time you extract prefixes and save, contents untouched
  • New: extract repeated path prefixes into a <prefixes> table, so a long shared directory is written once
  • New entry point in the "Directory notes" toolbar opens a dialog showing the config file. Extract and Restore only change the dialog text — nothing is written until you hit Save
  • Removed the bottom "TreeInfoTip Notes XML" tool window; its content moved into that dialog

    5.7.5

  • 修复「TreeInfoTip Notes XML」窗口点「保存」在新版 IDE 上报 Read access is allowed from inside read-action only：读取 PSI 那一步现在自己包了读操作
  • 「保存」改走 IDE 的虚拟文件系统，不再绕过它直接写磁盘：保存能用 Ctrl+Z 撤销，文件正在编辑器里开着时也不会和手上的改动互相覆盖，配置改动即时生效
  • Fixed "Read access is allowed from inside read-action only" when clicking Save in the XML tool window
  • Save now goes through the IDE virtual file system instead of writing to disk directly: undo works, edits no longer clash with the file open in an editor, and changes take effect immediately

    5.7.3

  • 插件名称、工具窗口和通知组统一使用 TreeInfoTip Notes，同步更新帮助说明、配置文件模板及发布产物名称
  • Unified the plugin name, tool windows, and notification group under TreeInfoTip Notes, with matching help text, configuration template, and release artifact names

    5.7.2

  • 修复注释提取：上一行代码的行尾注释不再被下一行元素误认为前置注释（「文件成员」列表里每项后面跟的注释现在判断更准确）
  • Fixed comment extraction: trailing comments from a previous line of code are no longer incorrectly treated as leading comments for the next element

    5.7.1

  • 修复删除 DirectoryV3.xml 后点刷新报错 NPE：PsiElement.getText() 在元素失效时会返回 null，现在统一检查
  • 新建的 DirectoryV3.xml 注释里把「TreeInfotip 的配置文件」改成「TreeInfotip Notes 的配置文件」

    5.7.0

  • 「目录备注」列表的右键菜单整行都能点：以前只有点在备注文字上才弹得出来，点行尾的空白处没反应
  • 「目录备注」会标出重复的规则：path 和 extension 都和前面某条一样的规则永远不会生效（同优先级时写在前面的那条赢），这种规则标灰显示，工具栏新增「清理重复规则」一键删掉它们，在生效的那条会保留，项目树的显示不变
  • 重复规则只标不删，不在读取配置时静默去重：DirectoryV3.xml 在项目根目录里、会进版本库，插件不背着人重写它

    5.6.0

  • 侧边栏「TreeInfotip 备注」新增「说明」tab：右键菜单七项分别做什么、DirectoryV3.xml 的九个参数怎么写、命中优先级怎么算，都在这一页里，工具栏上还有一个按钮直接打开配置文件
  • 新项目第一次加备注时自动建出的 DirectoryV3.xml，会在 <trees> 下面带一段注释说明 <tree> 的全部参数和命中优先级，手改文件时不用再去翻文档
  • 「目录备注」列表右键「置顶」支持 Ctrl 多选，一次置顶一批并保持它们原来的相对顺序：以前多选也只有一条真的挪上去了
  • 「文件成员」单击有子节点的成员时等待第二下的时间从系统双击间隔（Windows 上是 500 毫秒）压到 200 毫秒，点一下就跳、不再像卡了一下

    5.5.1

  • 修复「文件成员」点开成员跳转时报错 Read access is allowed from inside read-action only：求偏移量本身就要读 PSI，不能在读操作外面调 PsiElement.navigate，TS 的箭头函数上必崩
  • 补全注释识别：写成 const Page = () => {} 的箭头函数、以及 const x = {...} 这类变量，上面的 JSDoc 和单行注释以前一条都读不到——注释挂在整条 const 语句上，而结构视图给的是里层的函数或初始值，现在会先往上找到语句那一层再读
  • 往上找有边界：只在当前成员就处在父节点的开头（中间只隔着同一行的 token 和注释）时才往上抬，所以类的 JavaDoc 不会被认成它第一个方法的注释
  • 「文件成员」改成单击跳转、双击收缩 / 展开：以前双击一个有子节点的成员会又收缩又定位，两件事一起发生

    5.5.0

  • 侧边栏「TreeInfotip 备注」拆成两个 tab，默认打开新的「文件成员」：把当前编辑的文件里的方法和属性列成一棵树，每一项后面跟上它的注释——IDE 自带的结构视图只有成员没有注释，这里补上
  • 注释按四级依次尝试：JavaDoc / JSDoc 文档注释 → 多行注释 → 同行尾部的单行注释 → 紧贴在上方的连续单行注释（空行即断开）
  • 「文件成员」借用 IDE 的结构视图取节点，所以 Java、TS / JS / TSX / JSX、Kotlin、Python、Go 等凡是 IDE 能出结构视图的语言都支持；顶部可勾选只看方法或只看属性，拉杆调展开层数（1~10 层）
  • 「目录备注」tab：路径已失效的规则一律排到最前面，工具栏新增「清除失效路径」一键删掉全部标红项
  • 「目录备注」列表项支持右键：删除（可 Ctrl 多选批量删）、置顶——置顶是真的把这条规则挪到 DirectoryV3.xml 最前面，同优先级的多条规则命中同一节点时它先生效
  • 「备注列表（双击刷新）」这个根节点去掉了，刷新挪到工具栏的按钮上，列表直接从第一行开始

    5.4.1

  • 备注列表的显示规则收紧：只要还能在项目树上看到（路径有效），没写备注也没改显示名的规则就不列出，按扩展名批量设置的规则也一样
  • 反过来，路径已失效的规则即使什么文字都没配也一定列出——项目树上已经没有它的节点了，列表是唯一能发现并清掉它的地方，这时拿它配的路径当标题显示

    5.4.0

  • 右键菜单「目录备注」分组用新的备注图标，侧边栏改用按插件 logo 重绘的 16×16 单色图标，浅色主题显示深灰、深色主题自动切白色
  • 备注列表不再出现空白行：只设了颜色/图标/删除线、没写备注也没改显示名的规则不再列出；没写备注但覆盖了显示名称的，显示那个显示名
  • 备注列表双击不会再没反应：路径已失效的、以及只按扩展名匹配的全项目规则，双击直接跳到 DirectoryV3.xml 里这条规则所在的行

    5.3.2

  • 清掉 Marketplace 的 Plugin Verifier 报出的全部 9 处问题（5 处待删除 API、2 处已废弃 API、2 处内部 API），上传 5.3.1 时就是被这些卡住的
  • 不再引用内部 API：冲突检测从 PluginManagerCore.getPlugin 换成 isPluginInstalled + isDisabled，通知里的「打开插件管理」按 configurable id 定位，不再直接用 PluginManagerConfigurable 类
  • ContentFactory.SERVICE 换成 ContentFactory.getInstance()，ColorChooser 换成 ColorChooserService，ReadAction.run(ThrowableRunnable) 换成 Application.runReadAction
  • 删掉两个已废弃且没有实际作用的覆盖方法：ProjectViewNodeDecorator 的 PackageDependenciesNode 重载和 TreeStructureProvider.getData，渲染行为不变

    5.3.1

  • 插件名从「TreeInfotip 目录树备注」改为「TreeInfotip Notes」：Marketplace 上传时校验 plugin.xml 的 name，只放行字母、数字、空格和 .,+_-/:()#'&[]|，中文字符会被拒（Plugin Verifier 1.393 起写明必须是拉丁字符）
  • Marketplace 的插件名只能由 plugin.xml 驱动、网页后台改不了；条目上架之后可以再改成带中文的名字，这一版先用纯拉丁名把条目建起来

    5.3.0

  • 修复在 2024.1 及更新的 IDE（含 2026.x）上双击备注列表跳转时崩溃：报错是「Read access is allowed from inside read-action only」，新版平台的 EDT 不再隐式持有读锁，PSI 查找现在包在 ReadAction 里
  • 备注列表加上滚动条，条目超过窗口高度时不再只能看到前面几条
  • 备注列表检查配置的路径是否还存在，已被删除或改名的整行标红并标注「路径已失效」
  • 备注前面加上类型图标：目录是文件夹图标，文件按文件类型显示，按扩展名批量设置的规则显示对应类型的图标，路径失效的显示错误图标
  • 双击备注列表的根节点可以重新检查所有路径（在 IDE 外面删文件不会触发自动刷新）

    5.2.0

  • 插件改用独立身份发布：id 换成 com.github.yc556.treeinfotip，名称改为「TreeInfotip 目录树备注」，与原版并存不再互相顶掉更新
  • 启动时检测原版 TreeInfotip 是否还装着，装着就弹一次提示并给出「打开插件管理」入口，避免两份插件重复装饰目录树
  • 重命名了所有全局注册的 id（右键菜单组、7 个菜单项、2 个工具窗口），加上 TreeInfotip 前缀，不再占用 FirstAction、StudyAction.MyGroup、XmlEditor 这类通用名字
  • XML 编辑窗口的标签由「XmlEditor」改为「TreeInfotip XML」，备注窗口改为「TreeInfotip 备注」；窗口位置和大小需要重新拖一次

    5.1.2

  • 修复部分图标设置后把目录树行高撑高的问题：可选图标里有 50 个长边超过 16（20×20、24×24、32×32、最大 48×48），现在会等比缩到一行的高度，小图标保持原样不放大
  • 颜色/图标对话框的下拉框预览同步缩放，选的时候看到的大小就是设上去的大小

    5.1.1

  • 引入 Kotlin/Java 混编，颜色转换、图标列表等内部工具类改用 Kotlin 重写，插件不额外打包 kotlin-stdlib
  • 颜色字符串解析遇到非法数字时返回空值而不再抛异常，配置文件手写错误不会再中断渲染
  • 图标列表初始化改为兜住 Error：新版 IDE 若删改 AllIcons 字段，最坏只是"没有图标可选"，不会导致插件加载失败

    5.1.0

  • 字节码目标从 Java 8 提升到 Java 17，与编译平台 2022.3 对齐
  • 最低支持版本随之从 2021.2（since-build 212）提高到 2022.3（since-build 223）；2022.2 及更早的 IDE 请继续使用 5.0.4

idea-plugin.name: Lucene Query Injection Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Flags a QueryBuilders.queryStringQuery(...)/ .simpleQueryStringQuery(...) call whose argument is built from an HTTP endpoint parameter -- CWE-943 (an attacker's raw input becomes Lucene query SOURCE TEXT, enabling filter bypass) combined with CWE-400: CVE-2023-31419 confirms a real Denial of Service via a maliciously crafted query string against Elasticsearch's own _search API (Stack Overflow from deeply nested query syntax).

Built on a real, hand-written Lucene query-string parser -- the FIFTH full custom grammar in this catalog (after regex, SpEL, XPath, and LDAP). Introduces range queries ([1 TO 10]), boosting (term^2.0), and fuzzy matching (term~2) -- operators none of the other four grammars have.

Stated honestly: v0.1 only Java, only same-method taint; searched explicitly for a CodeQL/Datadog rule for this exact angle and found none (unlike SQL injection, which both cover extensively) -- no dedicated Marketplace plugin found either.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no network calls.

idea-plugin.name: FlagScope
idea-plugin.description:
Find and audit feature flags locally.

FlagScope scans Java, Kotlin, JavaScript, TypeScript, JSON, and YAML files in the current project for supported feature-flag definitions and usages. It groups results by flag, shows definition and usage counts, assigns a review status and priority, and lets developers open every detected source location directly in the IDE.

Analysis is local and read-only. FlagScope does not require an account, upload source code, send telemetry, make network calls, modify project files, or claim to determine a flag’s runtime state.

Free features:
• Background scanning with safe cancellation.
• Search and status filters for detected, possibly unused, definition-only, and unresolved flags.
• Definition and usage counts with the matching convention shown for every location.
• Direct navigation to source locations by double-click, Enter, or F4.

FlagScope Pro features:
• Company-specific qualified call names and custom YAML/JSON section names.
• Additional built-in recognition for Statsig, Flipt, GrowthBook, Firebase Remote Config, and Optimizely styles.
• Actionable audit priorities, findings, suggested next steps, and duplicate-definition guidance.
• Local baselines that compare added, removed, and status-changed flags.
• Complete local audit export to Markdown, CSV, or JSON, including an executive summary and detected conventions.
idea-plugin.change-notes: Adds FlagScope Pro actionable audits, custom conventions, local baseline comparison, expanded provider recognition, and local report export.

idea-plugin.name: JavaDoc Sync Plugin 10
idea-plugin.description:
The JavaDoc Sync Plugin will assist you to keep your JavaDoc in sync between interface definitions and the implementations, or method definitions and method overrides. The plugin now uses template based generation of JavaDoc, so that the JavaDoc text can now easily be customized to your needs.

The JavaDoc Sync Plugin was originally written by Raymond Brandon but was updated for IntelliJ 8 by woofgl

The JavaDoc Sync Plugin can:
  • highlight methods that define the @inheritDoc tag but there's no super method
  • highlight methods that define the @inheritDoc tag but the super method doesn't have javaDoc
  • highlight a class if one or more methods do not define JavaDoc
  • Generate JavaDoc for all methods that do not define JavaDoc according to user defined templates
  • Ignore methods that do not match the configured access modifier level
  • Ignore overridden methods of anonymous classes or inner classes
  • highlight methods that do not have JavaDoc
  • highlight fields that do not have JavaDoc
  • highlight methods of interface implementations of which the JavaDoc differs from the JavaDoc defined at interface level
  • highlight overridden methods/constructors of which the JavaDoc differs from the JavaDoc defined in the super classes

When the JavaDoc Sync Plugin detects differences between the defining interface or base method and the implementing or overriding method, the user will get quick fixes presented to update the JavaDoc like:
  • Copy JavaDoc from parent
  • Move to parent and introduce reference
  • Replace parent JavaDoc
  • Generate JavaDoc from signature
  • Generate JavaDoc from field
  • Generate JavaDoc for all methods

To turn on the JavaDoc Sync plugin, go to Settings->Errors and select "JavaDoc issues"

idea-plugin.name: Gradle View
idea-plugin.description:
What is this?

Show a split tree rollup of the dependencies for each Gradle configuration in use by a project.

Why would I need this?

Dependency wrangling isn't easy in a large Java project. This IntelliJ IDEA plugin was built to add a little more sanity to the tedious task of analyzing dependencies by rolling up the entire dependency graph into a pair of more easily digestible trees derived from a serialized version of Gradle's dependency graph. The Dependency List provides a lexicographically sorted set of all the dependencies for each configuration in your project and all of its sub-projects. The Dependency Hierarchy shows a nested view of each Gradle configuration in your project and all of its sub-projects. Grey dependencies in the tree indicate it was included by a previous dependency that was added before (and can be safely omitted if it is explicitly being included).

Features

  • Built on the Gradle Tooling API 5.6.2, but should work on other recent versions
  • Visual highlighting to indicate dependencies in use and replacement versions
  • Lexicographically sorted listing for all Gradle configurations
  • Load any project's Gradle dependencies, not just the one currently open inside IntelliJ
  • Toggle the showing of replaced dependencies

idea-plugin.name: JFrog
idea-plugin.description:
The plugin allows developers to find and fix security vulnerabilities in their projects and to see valuable information about the status of their code by continuously scanning it locally with the JFrog Platform.

Software Composition Analysis (SCA)

Scan your project dependencies for security issues. The plugin offers an automatic upgrade of the vulnerable dependencies to versions which include fixes.

CVE Research and Enrichment

For selected security issues, get leverage-enhanced CVE data that is provided by our JFrog Security Research team. Prioritize the CVEs based on:

  • JFrog Severity: The severity given by the JFrog Security Research team after the manual analysis of the CVE by the team. CVEs with the highest JFrog security severity are the most likely to be used by real-world attackers. This means that you should put effort into fixing them as soon as possible.
  • Research Summary: The summary that is based on JFrog's security analysis of the security issue provides detailed technical information on the specific conditions for the CVE to be applicable.
  • Remediation: Detailed fix and mitigation options for the CVEs.

Check out what our research team is up to and stay updated on newly discovered issues by clicking on this link: https://research.jfrog.com

Advanced Scans

Vulnerability Contextual Analysis: This feature uses the code context to eliminate false positive reports on vulnerable dependencies that are not applicable to the code. Vulnerability Contextual Analysis is currently supported for Python, JavaScript, and Java code.

Secrets Detection: Prevent the expose of keys or credentials that are stored in your source code.

Infrastructure as Code (IaC) Scans: Secure your IaC files. Critical to keeping your cloud deployment safe and secure.


Advanced Scans require Xray version 3.66.5 or above and Enterprise X / Enterprise+ subscription with Advanced DevSecOps.

For more information about the plugin see the README.
idea-plugin.change-notes: For the latest release notes, please visit our Release Notes page.

idea-plugin.name: Gradle/Maven Navigation

Overview

Open our customized popup dialog and choose from a variety of context-sensitive destinations, including tree nodes, goals, and tasks. For each destination choose from context-sensitive actions such as go, open, run, and debug.

Say goodbye to bland popup menus and fatigue invoking nested trees. You can configure options under Settings/Appearance/Gradle Navigation. Make sure to assign to the popup command to a convenient, unused function key!

Supported Technologies

Features

Destination Popup A popup window is also provided with buttons to either go to tasks or groups in the Gradle tree, or run tasks directly. You can easily customize the content and order of items in the popup.
The navigation popup now includes links to various project and module settings, along with Android resource directories, the Maven project tree, and Maven POM files (if they exist in conventional locations)

Menu Items - The Gradle/Maven Navigation Plugin for IntelliJ adds additional features to the standard Gradle and Maven plugin. You can now swivel between the source editor, the project view, and the Gradle view. A custom popup displays common destinations and user configured tasks and groups. Commands are added to various context menus in the Project Tree, Gradle Tree, and Editor Window.

Goto Gradle/Maven - project, task, or group

Goto Project - gradle settings or build, source root, or resource root

Gradle Users: This plugin works for both single-project and multi-project Gradle builds.

idea-plugin.name: Gradle Modules Generator
idea-plugin.description:
Reduce boilerplate routine in multi-module gradle projects.
To make it works, follow these steps:
  • Create a directory called gradle_templates in the root of your project.
  • Create subdirectories in that folder. Their names don't matter.
  • Inside of each folder create a config.yml file and define a name of your module.
  • Also, create additional folders - static and template and put your files in them.
All content from a static directory will be copied inside of your created module.
In a template folder you can put Apache Velocity templates which will be resolved before copying. For now, you can use only module.baseName variable in your templates. It will be a value that you enter in the dialog when Ctrl + Alt + G was pressed.
config.yml is a Velocity template as well. Besides name property in a config you can use a directories property to define a list of directories to be created. You should use it when your directory name depends on a module.baseName and use empty directories inside of a static folder in other cases.

idea-plugin.name: Kubernetes Runtime Configuration
idea-plugin.description:
This plugin loads Kubernetes ConfigMap, Secret and String Data values as environment variables in an IntelliJ run configuration. This allows for development of Kubernetes deployable modules without the need to run Kubernetes on local development environments which may not have enough resources.

Usage:

  1. Run -> Edit Configurations
  2. Select or create a new configuration
  3. "K8s Config" tab
  4. Select "Enable"
  5. Add Kubernetes configuration files
  6. Run configuration

During run configuration executions configuration files will be parsed in list order and their values injected as environment variables to the executing module. Configuration files should be ordered in the order they are consumed within deployments from generic to specific. Configuration keys with matching names in specific files will override previous values exactly as the would during a Kubernetes deployment

idea-plugin.name: Django command runner
idea-plugin.description:
Features

  • Django Commands Tool Window - Browse and run all Django commands from a dedicated panel
  • Command Palette - Quick search and execute any management command
  • Favorites - Save frequently used commands with custom arguments globally
  • Presets - Pre-configured command variants (runserver, test, migrate options)
  • Recent Commands - Quick access to recently executed commands
  • Runner Premium: Smart Arguments - Build validated forms for project and built-in Django commands and save configured commands as favorite recipes
  • Run Django management commands directly from the editor
  • Debug Django management commands with breakpoints
  • Profile Django management commands
  • Run with custom arguments dialog
  • Auto-detect Django settings module
  • Remember last used arguments per command
  • Support for django-extensions and custom BaseCommand subclasses
  • Gutter icons for quick access to run/debug/profile actions

Usage

Quick Access: Press Ctrl+Shift+D (Windows/Linux) or Cmd+Shift+D (Mac) to open the Django Command Palette.

Open the Django Commands tool window (View → Tool Windows → Django Commands) to browse all available commands organized by app.

Use the search field to quickly find commands. Double-click to run, or right-click for more options.

Hold Shift when selecting a command in the palette to run with custom arguments.

Add frequently used commands to Favorites for quick access across all your Django projects.

More info

  • meanmail.dev
  • GitHub

Your ratings and feedback are very important. The feature will appear the faster the more people request it.

idea-plugin.name: Tencent Cloud Toolkit
idea-plugin.description:
Tencent Cloud Toolkit

Tencent Cloud Toolkit is a plugin for JetBrains which makes it easier and more efficiently for developers to develop, build, configure, test, and deploy application on Tencent Cloud. More importantly, the plugin greatly improves the convenience of cloud application debugging.

Features:

  1. Authentication - Connect to Tencent Cloud using SecretId and SecretKey.
  2. Deploy to TSF - Tencent Service Framework (TSF) is a PaaS platform focus on applications and microservices, embracing Spring Cloud and Service Mesh microservice frameworks. TSF helps enterprise customers overcome the difficulties of traditional centralized architecture transformation, build a large-scale and highly available distributed system architecture, and realize the rapid implementation of services and products. TSF developers can deploy applications through graphical interface provided by the plugin, without switching between multiple tools and platforms.
  3. Deploy to TEM - Tencent Elastic Microservice (TEM) is A serverless microservice platform for auto scaling and microservice governance.
  4. Deploy to TKE (Coming soon) - Tencent Kubernetes Engine (TKE) provides highly scalable and high-performance container management services based on native kubernetes.

idea-plugin.name: AWS CodeArtifact + Maven
idea-plugin.description:
Support to update AWS CodeArtifact Auth Token on maven projects.

This plugin facilitates accessing and deploying artifacts in CodeArtifact on Maven Intellij Idea projects.

AWS provides very specific instructions to set up Maven to support AWS CodeArtifact. Basically, your file ~/.m2/settings.xml must include a server specification such as:

<settings>
  <servers>
    <server>
      <id>coderazzi-project-yz</id>
      <username>aws</username>
      <password>${env.CODEARTIFACT_AUTH_TOKEN}</password>
    </server>
 </servers>
</settings>

The token CODEARTIFACT_AUTH_TOKEN needs to be refreshed every 12 hours (by default) by doing:

export CODEARTIFACT_AUTH_TOKEN=`aws codeartifact get-authorization-token --domain DOMAIN --domain-owner DOMAIN_OWNER --query authorizationToken --output text`

After issuing the previous command, the environment that executes the command has authorized access to CodeCommit

The main problem here is that when using an IDE like IDEA, you would need to update the CODEARTIFACT_AUTH_TOKEN environment variable and then launch the IDE. And as the token needs to be refreshed, it is needed to quit the IDE and repeat the process every 12 hours. Plus, it is needed to update the environment variable in the same environment where the IDE is launched, quite inconvenient if launching the IDE from anywhere except the command line.

Idea allows to set up environment variables for MVN execution (under Settings/Build/Execution/Deployment/Build Tools/Maven/Runner), but this would imply to manually obtaining the token and updating the setting periodically.

A better option for this specific scenario is to automatically update the password in ~/.m2/settings.xml, to reflect the real token. That is, the settings file will look like:

<settings>
  <servers>
    <server>
      <id>coderazzi-project-yz</id>
      <username>aws</username>
      <password>REAL_CREDENTIALS_OBTAINED_FROM_AWS</password>
    </server>
 </servers>
</settings>

CodeArtifact-Maven Idea plugin does exactly this simple task. Note that there is an AWS-supported AWS plugin, but it does not cover getting auth tokens for CodeArtifact

Installation

Plugin available in Intellij Idea public plugin repository, as CodeArtifact+Maven

Usage

After installation, a menu entry appear under Tools: Generate AWS CodeArtifact Auth Token for Maven

When selected, a window appears to enter the required details:

  • Domain: the domain in AWS
  • Domain Owner: the account owner, something like 023174738914
  • Maven server id: the server name provided in your maven settings file -as following the instructions from AWS-. This is a value obtained already from the maven settings file, using all servers whose username is aws
  • AWS profile: the profile to use to obtain the auth tokens, read from any of the files <USER-HOME>/.aws/config, <USER-HOME>/.aws/credentials, <AWS_CONFIG_FILE>, <AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE>
  • Region: the target region. If specified, it overrides the region given by the profile -if any-
  • Maven settings file: the location of the maven settings file, usually under USER-HOME/.m2
  • AWS cli path: where to find the aws executable

The first five settings above can be defined multiple times, using different configurations. A configuration is defined using the fields:

  • Configuration: any unique non, empty name provided by the user.
  • Enabled: Whether to use this configuration when generating multiple tokens at once.

The button Generate Auth Token will initiate the requests of a token to AWS and its inclusion in the maven settings file. If there are multiple configurations defined, the user can update the state of the checkbox Generate Tokens for all configurations; if selected, a token will be generated for each enabled configuration.

MFA support

From version 3.0.0, the plugin includes support for MFA, prompting the user to enter the MFA token if required.

Currently, only MFA based on roles is supported, where the chosen profile identifies a IAM role, not a IAM user.
For more information on the distinction between role-based-MFA and user-based-MFA, check https://coderazzi.net/cloud/aws/mfa

idea-plugin.name: Gradle Utilities
idea-plugin.description:
This plugin provides some useful utilities to support the daily work with Gradle:

  • Lists all running Gradle daemons with their status. Additionally, actions to terminate daemons or viewing their command lines are available.
  • Manage Gradle home:
    • Clear all Gradle caches. This includes all downloaded dependencies and Gradle daemon caches..
    • List all downloaded Gradle wrapper distributions and their sizes on the disk and offer an action to delete them.
    • List all Gradle daemon caches and their sizes on the disk and offer an action to delete them.
  • Collect information about the current Gradle environment, like relevant paths, versions, user/project Gradle properties, and environment variables.
  • Verify Gradle wrapper JAR and distributions.
  • Edit the user Gradle properties file.
  • Find the latest Gradle releases.
  • Bookmarks to important Gradle related websites.

The utilities are available via the toolbar of the Gradle tool window (select View | Tool Windows | Gradle) under the Gradle Utilities action popup button.

If you have any suggestions or found a bug, please create an issue on GitHub or use the contact form on the plugin homepage.

(This plugin has no relation to the official Gradle project.)

idea-plugin.name: Taskfile
idea-plugin.description:
Run Taskfile.yml (Task) tasks from the IDE.

Features

  • Run configuration: a Taskfile run configuration type, with autocompletion for task names, task-level variables, environment variables, and an optional PTY.
  • Task Explorer tool window: every Taskfile in the project as a tree, with run, navigate-to-definition, and toggles for internal tasks and task descriptions. Refreshes itself when a Taskfile changes.
  • Gutter icons: a run icon next to every task in a Taskfile, right in the editor.
  • Run Anything: type task <name> in the Run Anything popup (Ctrl+Ctrl) to complete and run a task.

Requirements

  • Install task. See here
  • Make sure the task command is in your PATH

Usage

  • Open 'Run/Debug Configurations' and add a Taskfile configuration, or
  • open the Task Explorer tool window and run a task from the tree, or
  • click the run icon in the gutter next to a task in a Taskfile, or
  • press Ctrl twice and type task <name>.

Support packaging class files and static files, including JSP, JS, SQL scripts. Instructions for use: Install the plug-in and run the Java Web project. idea-plugin.name: ConfRunner
idea-plugin.description:
ConfRunner Plugin is a plugin for JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA, that can be used to simplify execution of configurations in run and debug mode.

Enables an easy way of executing configurations using keyboard shortcuts. Press Enter (or Double Mouse Click) on specific configuration to execute it in Run mode. Press Ctrl+Enter (or Ctrl+Double Mouse Click) for Debug mode.

It displays simplified popup dialog with defined configurations and enables to go through configurations and execute a specific one. Open the dialog using either Tools tab (Tools > ConfRunner) or using a shortcut.

You can specify which configuration types should be excluded from the dialog (Settings > Tools > ConfRunner):
  • Exclude temporary configurations
  • Exclude configurations stored in .idea/runConfigurations folder
  • Exclude configurations stored in arbitrary file in project
  • Exclude local configurations, not shared through VCS

More info: ConfRunner Plugin
idea-plugin.change-notes:
- Fix scrolling not keeping up when navigating within configurations using keyboard.
- Display message dialog if configuration can't be executed in run / debug mode - instead of trying to run it.
- Use IntelliJ CommonShortcuts to retrieve shortcuts for Find action. Use those shortcuts to go to lookup component. If those are not defined, then use Ctrl + F as a basic shortcut.

idea-plugin.name: maven-templating-for-intellij
idea-plugin.description:
This plugin is an assistant for the official [Maven Templating Plugin](https://www.mojohaus.org/templating-maven-plugin/).

Without using the **Maven Templating assistant**, you have to create your own `java-templates` folders and mark it as **Sources Root** or **Test Sources Root**.

Unfortunately, IntelliJ often loses those settings, especially when you re-import the Maven project. For large projects, manually reconfiguring folders is tedious and time-consuming.

The **Maven Templating assistant** does all this for you:

  • Manages template folders when adding/removing/moving/renaming.
  • Automatically scans the project on project opening.
  • Automatically scans the project on Maven project (re)import.
  • Allows you to enforce a project scan via the **Project View Context** menu or **Tools** menu.

The default `java-templates` folder name can be customized on the settings page under the **Build Tools** section.
idea-plugin.change-notes: • Declared compatibility from 2024 up to 2026.2.

IntelliJ of AndroidStudio plugin for CC Project.

With the increasing project volume, the compilation
speed also increases. Sometimes a modification needs
to wait for several minutes.

Based on this general situation, cc-build is introduced to
improve the speed of full compilation by dynamically replacing
the module with AAR in the compilation process.

idea-plugin.name: Just
idea-plugin.description:
JetBrains Just Command Runner Plugin is a plugin to integrate just commander in JetBrains IDEs.

Plugin features:

  • Just language and file types
  • Syntax highlight for a shell script
  • Run recipes by clicking and with the params input dialog
  • Run configuration support: Run -> Edit Configurations -> Just or right-click on recipe name
  • New justfile by project type, such as Maven, Gradle, Cargo, uv, zig, etc.
  • Code completion: settings names, recipe dependencies, variables with dotenv support
  • Navigation for dependency name
  • Language injection for a legal Shell script
  • Justfile structure view
  • Justfile tool Window: load Justfiles into the task-tree and support Markdown files(README.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md).
  • Submodules/import resolver
  • Interesting miscellaneous: DuckDB, Bun, Nushell, etc.
  • Justfile as a scratch file: PROJECT_DIR environment variable

How to use?

  • Download and install just command line from https://github.com/casey/just/releases
  • Install JetBrains Just plugin
  • Invoke 'Justfile' item from New file group, and a justfile file will be created with the following code:
#!/usr/bin/env just --justfile
                    
hello:
  echo "hello world"
  • Click the run button in the Gutter and run a recipe/target!

Quick to understand justfile, please click Justfile cheat sheet

Attention: keywords could not be recipe names, such as import, export, alias etc.

Tips: Please put just parameter in quotation mark, such as echo "{{NAME}}" or echo '{{NAME}}', and echo {{NAME}} is not legal script and will not be highlighted. If param as command name, such as {{MVN}} --version, please use exec '{{MVN}}' --version instead.

idea-plugin.name: GitHub Actions Manager
idea-plugin.description:
The missing GitHub Actions UI for JetBrains IDEs. GitHub ships an official Actions extension for VS Code — JetBrains users get this plugin instead: watch workflow runs live, read step-by-step logs, dispatch workflows, approve deployments, and manage Actions secrets and variables, all without leaving the IDE.

It works with GitHub.com and GitHub Enterprise Server — if your GHES instance lives behind a VPN, this is the fastest way to follow a run or approve a deployment.

Why an IDE plugin instead of the browser or gh CLI?

  • No tab-juggling: the run triggered by your push is one tool window away, filtered to your current branch.
  • Logs are split per step and rendered in the IDE, instead of one giant scrolling page.
  • A failed run is fixable on the spot — jump to the workflow file, fix, push, watch the rerun.

Viewing runs, jobs, and logs is free, forever. Advanced features (dispatch, rerun/cancel, deployment approval, artifacts, repository settings) come with a license — start a free 30-day trial on the JetBrains Marketplace, or fill this form to receive a discount code.

Free features (no license required)

  • View workflow runs, jobs, and logs
    • See real-time and historical workflow runs directly in the IDE.
    • Hover over a workflow run to see a details tooltip – what triggered it, attempt, total duration, and (for the selected run) how many artifacts it produced.
    • Jobs are shown as a tree, grouping matrix and reusable-workflow jobs under their parent for easy scanning.
    • Hover over a job to see its details tooltip – runner name and group, runner labels, attempt, branch and commit, and timing.
    • Logs are organized step-by-step for easier debugging.
    • Search within a job's log using the IDE's find bar (⌘F / Ctrl+F) – logs render in a standard editor console.
    • Track live runs as they progress or review past runs at a glance.
    • Filter runs by branch, actor, event, or status – individually or in combination. Includes a current-branch filter that updates automatically when you switch branches.
    • New runs appear automatically (refreshes every 30s by default; configurable).
  • Settings & configuration
    • Use a custom token instead of GitHub's default authentication.
    • Control the auto-refresh frequency.
    • Choose which repositories to show or hide.
    • Assign a GitHub account per repository and switch assignments anytime via plugin settings.

Paid features (license required)

  • View and download workflow run artifacts.
  • Open the pull request that triggered a run (in the IDE or browser).
  • Approve workflow-run deployments that require approval.
  • Manually trigger dispatchable workflows, with full input support (all GitHub input types).
  • Rerun or cancel a workflow run – or even just a single job.
  • View a job's annotations (failures, warnings, and notices) in a banner above the step log, and click an annotation to jump straight to the offending file and line in the editor.
  • Open the workflow file associated with a run.
  • Generate GitHub links to specific file lines from the IDE.

Repository settings (license required)

Manage a repository's GitHub Actions configuration from a dedicated settings dialog without opening the browser:

  • Variables & secrets – list, add, edit, and delete repository and organization variables and secrets. Secret values are encrypted locally with the repository/organization public key (libsodium sealed box) before upload, and are write-only: they can be replaced but never read back. Organization-level items are shown when the repository belongs to an organization, and you can choose a new organization variable's or secret's visibility (all repositories, or private/internal only).
  • Collaborators – view the repository's collaborators and add or remove them.
  • Actions caches – browse the repository's GitHub Actions caches (with per-branch filtering, sizes, and total storage usage) and delete stale entries.
  • Environments – create and delete deployment environments. For each environment:
    • Edit environment variables (add, update, delete).
    • Review environment secrets and deployment protection rules.
    • Manage which branches and tags are allowed to deploy: review the deployment branch policy and add or remove branch/tag name patterns.

Workflow file editing

  • Highlight outdated GitHub Actions as warnings with a quick-fix to update to the latest version.
  • Flag unknown actions.
  • Navigate directly to an action's repository (for remote actions).
  • Jump to the action file (for local actions).
idea-plugin.change-notes:
🐛 Bug Fixes

  • Jobs tree: the title of a group row (a matrix or reusable-workflow parent) is no longer pushed down and cut off, and rows are now really sized to their content instead of the theme's fixed row height #313
  • Jobs lists are released when their repository tab or the project is closed. Every jobs list that had been shown used to stay subscribed to the Sort by Status toggle, and so in memory, until the IDE restarted.

🧰 Maintenance

  • Internal restructuring, with no change in behavior. The plugin's packages now form a strict layering that a build-time test enforces, and several large classes were split by responsibility: plugin settings, workflow-file analysis, action-version resolution, background polling, job-log parsing, repository-tab lookup, pagination and the repository-settings panels. Action IDs and stored settings are unchanged, so keymaps, toolbar customizations and existing plugin settings carry over.

idea-plugin.name: Helm values
idea-plugin.description:
Ease configuration of values for Helm charts in your IDE

The plugin provides several actions to generate JSON schemas for values of Helm charts.
These schemas can then be used in your IDE to document, validate and auto-complete Helm values.

Plugin allows to configure Helm chart repositories directly from your IDE.
Plugin also allows to update Helm dependencies for Helm charts directly from your IDE.
This requires installation of Helm on your local workstation.

More information: Helm values documentation

Plugin is free to use, not free to build.
Consider support its development by buying me a coffee.

idea-plugin.name: Uniapp Tool
idea-plugin.description:
Uniapp Tool provides comprehensive uni-app development, running, debugging, and publishing support for JetBrains IDEs.

中文

Uniapp Tool 是一款免费的 JetBrains IDE 插件，为 HBuilderX 创建的 uni-app 项目和 uni-app CLI 项目提供开发、运行与发布支持。

编码支持

  • 提供 uni-app 内置 API、组件、属性、生命周期和 CSS 变量补全。
  • 支持 easycom 组件识别，包括自定义 easycom 规则和 node_modules 组件。
  • 支持 vue、nvue、uvue、uts 和 renderjs 文件的代码编辑。
  • 支持 pages.json、manifest.json 等配置文件的补全、校验，并提供可选的 manifest.json 可视化编辑功能。
  • 支持页面、分包、图片及 @、~ 路径的补全、跳转和存在性检查，并可预览图片。
  • 路径错误提供快速修复，可创建缺失页面或修正引用。
  • 支持条件编译指令补全、嵌套检查、代码高亮和折叠。
  • 支持 rpx、upx、uni-app CSS 变量，以及组件和样式代码的快速展开。
  • .env、.env.test、.env.* 文件使用 Ctrl+/ 时统一以 # 切换行注释。

运行与发布

  • 支持 HBuilderX 项目以及 Vue 2、Vue 3、Vue 3 + TypeScript CLI 项目。
  • 自动识别项目根目录和 monorepo 中的多个 uni-app 子项目，并可为当前文件生成运行配置。
  • 支持 H5、微信小程序、支付宝小程序、抖音小程序以及自定义 CLI 平台。
  • 支持 Android、iOS、鸿蒙设备发现与运行，可在运行配置中刷新并选择目标设备。
  • 支持运行参数、环境参数、编译模式和自定义脚本配置。
  • 支持自动打开微信、支付宝和抖音开发者工具。
  • 支持微信小程序上传，显示上传日志并配置版本、描述、AppID 和上传密钥。

项目工具

  • 创建 uni-app CLI 项目，支持 Vue 2、Vue 3 和 Vue 3 + TypeScript 模板。
  • 在项目视图中创建页面并自动注册主包或分包；新分包可在创建页面时一并建立。
  • 为 .cmd、.bat 文件提供专用图标；Windows 下可从编辑器或项目视图直接运行，输出显示在 IDE 运行控制台。
  • 批量操作项目中的 Git 仓库：一键更新所有当前分支，或将指定远端分支合并到各仓库当前分支。
  • 批量 Git 操作会跳过脏工作区和异常仓库状态，并统一汇总成功、跳过、冲突和失败结果。
  • 提供 Uniapp 工具窗口及可选实验功能。
  • Uniapp 工具窗口内置详细使用教程，覆盖项目识别、代码编辑、配置与路径、条件编译、运行发布、项目工具、自动更新和常见问题。

基本配置

打开 Settings | Tools | UniApp：

  • 运行 HBuilderX 项目前，请配置 HBuilderX 安装目录。
  • HBuilderX 项目需要通过 HBuilderX | 工具 | 插件安装 安装对应的 uni-app Vue 2 或 Vue 3 编译器，并建议先在 HBuilderX 中运行项目一次。
  • Android 真机运行还需要安装 HBuilderX 的 App 真机运行相关插件和标准基座。
  • 微信开发者工具支持自动检测；未检测到时请手动选择安装目录。支付宝和抖音开发者工具仍需手动配置路径。
  • 支持模式可选择“仅运行”“基础支持”或“完整支持”：低配置设备可使用仅运行模式，大型项目可使用基础支持，完整模式会额外启用 easycom 深度分析和多项目编辑支持。
  • 可在 Settings | Tools | UniApp（当前项目） 中选择“跟随全局”或单独覆盖支持模式，多个同时打开的项目可以使用不同性能档位。
  • 在仅运行模式与编辑支持模式之间切换后，请按通知重新打开项目，使 JavaScript 类型库缓存完全生效。

版本下载 · 问题反馈 · 商务合作与项目开发：fjdmy@outlook.com

English

Uniapp Tool is a free JetBrains IDE plugin for developing, running, and publishing uni-app projects created with HBuilderX or the uni-app CLI.

Highlights

  • Complete uni-app APIs, components, properties, lifecycle hooks, easycom components, paths, and CSS variables.
  • Edit vue, nvue, uvue, uts, and renderjs files with language-aware assistance.
  • Complete, validate, and edit pages.json and manifest.json, with an optional visual editor for manifest.json.
  • Complete and navigate pages, subpackages, images, and aliased paths, with image previews and missing-path fixes.
  • Complete, validate, highlight, and fold conditional-compilation blocks.
  • Quickly expand common uni-app component and style code.
  • Run HBuilderX, Vue 2, Vue 3, and Vue 3 + TypeScript projects, including multiple uni-app projects in a monorepo.
  • Target H5, WeChat, Alipay, Douyin, Android, iOS, HarmonyOS, and custom CLI platforms.
  • Discover mobile devices, configure scripts and arguments, launch Mini Program developer tools, and upload WeChat builds with visible logs.
  • Create CLI projects and pages with automatic package registration, including new subpackages created with their first page.
  • Toggle comments in .env and .env.* files with # using the standard line-comment shortcut.
  • Show dedicated icons for .cmd and .bat files and run them in the IDE console on Windows.
  • Update all Git repositories in the project or merge a selected remote branch into every repository's current branch in one operation.

Configure tool paths and choose Run Only, Basic Support, or Full Support under Settings | Tools | UniApp. Each project can follow that default or override it in its project settings. Reopen the project after switching into or out of Run Only mode so cached JavaScript libraries are refreshed.

idea-plugin.name: DartMappable(Flutter Json To Freezed JsonSerializable Compat)
idea-plugin.description:
Provide JSON to dart data classes conversion for use in Flutter and Dart projects.
Support multiple serialization schemes with json_serializable, dart_mappable, freezed.

Right click on package -> New -> Json To DartMappable　And Then you will know how to use.
After converting JSON to dart classes, will be automatically run 'flutter pub run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs'.

If you haven't added the dependency, it will automatically execute the command to add it.

If you change the fields in the class, right click on package -> Flutter Command -> Flutter Run Build Runner, shortcut key is Alt + r.

1. Use DartMappable

Open in the IDE Setting -> Tools -> DartMappable Settings, selected dart_mappable.
Don't forget to set up dart_mappable into your project : https://pub.dev/packages/dart_mappable
Add into your pubspec.yaml

dependencies:
  dart_mappable: ^3.0.0  
dev_dependencies: 
  build_runner: ^2.1.0
  dart_mappable_builder: ^3.0.2

Or Run command in Terminal

flutter pub add dart_mappable
flutter pub add build_runner --dev
flutter pub add dart_mappable_builder --dev

2. Use JsonSerializable

Open in the IDE Setting -> Tools -> DartMappable Settings, selected json_serializable.
Don't forget to set up json_serializable into your project : https://pub.dev/packages/json_serializable
Add into your pubspec.yaml

dependencies:
  json_annotation: ^4.8.0
dev_dependencies:
  build_runner: ^2.3.3
  json_serializable: ^6.6.0

Or Run command in Terminal

flutter pub add json_annotation
flutter pub add build_runner --dev
flutter pub add json_serializable --dev

3. Use Freezed

Open in the IDE Setting -> Tools -> DartMappable Settings, selected freezed.
Don't forget to set up freezed into your project : https://pub.dev/packages/freezed
Add into your pubspec.yaml

dependencies:
  freezed_annotation: ^2.4.1
dev_dependencies: 
  build_runner: ^2.1.0
  freezed: ^2.4.1

Or Run command in Terminal

flutter pub add freezed_annotation
flutter pub add --dev build_runner
flutter pub add --dev freezed
# if using freezed to generate fromJson/toJson, also add:
flutter pub add json_annotation
flutter pub add --dev json_serializable

idea-plugin.name: Source Synchronizer Pro
idea-plugin.description:
A fast, one-way file synchronization tool for your projects.

Sourcesync Pro's synchronization, forwarding and comparison capabilities for local vs remote files provide a fast and seamless way of transferring code, binary artifacts and configuration files between local and remote development environments.

Local VCS changes, files and directories can be transferred on the remote infrastructure using the SCP or SSH protocols. Other notable features include:

  • password and key pair authentication
  • support for key pairs with and without passphrases
  • timestamp preserving
  • file filtering
  • user-friendly UI with support for IntelliJ's New UI feature
  • synchronization of single or multi-selection files as well as VCS changes

idea-plugin.name: Easy Maven
idea-plugin.description:
Easy Maven is lightweight plugin for IDEA that gets the project model through Maven task execution and provides a convenient search for dependencies in Maven Central.
Easy Maven is a complete replacement for the bundled Maven plugin. It provides the most accurate resolution of project dependencies. Easy Maven plugin runs on top of pure Maven, without any hidden logic. The philosophy of Easy Maven plugin: "everything is a Maven task". Any interaction with Maven: import project, test execution, dependency analysis, debugging - is simply running the appropriate Maven plugin task with the required arguments. The result is original build tool behavior and a simple implementation.
An article about the plugin and the problems it solves - dev.to.

Adds support for the Maven for Java language projects:
  • Import project structure to IDE
  • Execution Maven tasks
  • Original Maven behavior for getting project model
  • Maven 4+ support
  • Support separate modules for production and test roots
  • Groovy support
  • Kotlin JVM support

idea-plugin.name: Sbt Dependency Analyzer
idea-plugin.description:
Sbt Dependency Analyzer for IntelliJ IDEA

GitHub | Issues

Adds support for the Scala's sbt. The following features are available for free with IntelliJ IDEA:
  • Dependency Tree Visualization: View a hierarchical tree of all your project's dependencies.
  • Conflict Identification: Quickly spot and resolve version conflicts between libraries.
  • Dependency Search: Easily find specific dependencies across your project.
  • Inter-Module Dependency Analysis: Visualize how different modules in your project depend on each other.
  • JAR Size Indicators: See the size of dependency JARs to better manage your project's footprint.
  • Navigate to Declaration: Click on a user-defined dependency to jump directly to its declaration in build.sbt.
  • Dependency Exclusion (Experimental):
    • Select a transitive dependency to exclude it from a user-defined dependency.
    • Select a user-defined dependency to remove it entirely.

Visit GitHub for instructions on how to properly use this plugin!

idea-plugin.name: Bazel
idea-plugin.description:
Bazel by JetBrains for IntelliJ IDEA

Main features

  • Open Bazel projects in IntelliJ IDEA
  • Supports Java and Kotlin
  • Build, run, test, debug Bazel ta rgets
  • Starlark syntax, completion, navigation support
  • Starlark debugging
  • Run and debug tests running in Bazel

To learn more about how to use the features, please check the documentation page.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Bazel Plugin 2026.2.3.1

2026.2.3.1

RELEASE NOTES

Please consider switching to Nightly channel in Settings -> Build, Execution, Deployment -> Build Tools -> Bazel -> Advanced Settings
Switching to nightly you'll get newest features and fixes faster!

Please file any issue on our YouTrack or reach us directly on slack #intellij @ slack.bazel.build

Changelog:

Features

  • Detect unsupported syntax in Starlark files. | #BAZEL-3566
  • Detect invalid and duplicate dictionary keys in Starlark files. | #BAZEL-3493, #BAZEL-3525
  • Rerun failed tests from the results tree with any test runner. | #BAZEL-2087
  • Navigate from Go test results to source code. | #BAZEL-3081
  • Run tests in a package and its subpackages with a Bazel wildcard target. | #BAZEL-2709
  • Support Scala plugins during Bazel sync. | #BAZEL-2666

Bug Fixes

  • Restore resolution of nested symbolic links in Bazel output files. | #BAZEL-3580
  • Show Starlark errors in new files without another sync. | #BAZEL-3511
  • Detect undefined Starlark variables in comprehensions and lambdas, and invalid slice assignment targets. | #BAZEL-3526, #BAZEL-3567
  • Avoid false strict dependency warnings when a class is also available from a direct dependency. | #BAZEL-3569
  • Correct Java dependency analysis for Maven artifacts and partially shadowed JARs. | #BAZEL-3561, #BAZEL-3477
  • Skip bytecode analysis for Bazel interface JARs. | #BAZEL-3499
  • Keep the Python debugger responsive at exception breakpoints and respect Bazel target arguments. | #BAZEL-3491, #BAZEL-3502
  • Fix a crash when opening a BUILD file diff. | #BAZEL-3521
  • Stop sync immediately when a required project-view import is missing. | #BAZEL-3150
  • Restore Go language features and update Go external libraries before sync completes. | #BAZEL-3513, #BAZEL-3482
  • Resolve ambiguous Protocol Buffer imports correctly. | #BAZEL-2695
  • Read Bazel build events correctly when a stream returns fewer bytes than requested. | #BAZEL-3524
  • Exclude Bazel symlinks from file watching even when their targets cannot be resolved. | #BAZEL-3518
  • Restore Java run configuration producers in Bazel projects. | #BAZEL-3522
  • Reduce delays when typing in BUILD files. | #BAZEL-3506
  • Detect the primary rule set when multiple rule sets use the same archive. | #BAZEL-3546

Maintenance

  • Reduce memory use during Bazel sync and Go dependency import. | #BAZEL-3284, #BAZEL-3542
  • Avoid build actions and redundant source output requests during plain sync. | #BAZEL-3370, #BAZEL-3568
  • Handle short Bazel version strings and apply toolchain aspects only with Bazel 9 or later. | #BAZEL-3584
  • Expose TaskId and TaskGroupId as public APIs for plugin integrations.
  • Include release notes in the plugin ZIP built with Bazel. | #BAZEL-2663

idea-plugin.name: LuffyCommonBuildJar
idea-plugin.description:
**Luffy Project Common Package Plugin** Streamline the packaging process of the Luffy project's common package by automating code pulls, merge operations (if applicable), and other preparatory tasks. Designed for Windows systems, this plugin requires Git configuration and a login account with merge permissions for optimal performance.
**Key Features:**
1. **Code Pull Automation:** The plugin seamlessly integrates with Git to fetch the latest source code for the Luffy project's common package during the packaging process.
2. **Merge Handling:** To ensure a smooth workflow, it is recommended that users have a Git account with merge permissions. Automated merge steps, if required, will be executed by the plugin. In the event of insufficient permissions, users will be prompted to manually submit a merge request to finalize packaging.
3. **Windows Compatibility:** Developed specifically for Windows systems, this plugin is not compatible with macOS due to platform-specific constraints. Users working on macOS should seek alternative packaging solutions or consider using a Windows environment for this plugin's functionality.
4. **Manual Intervention Support:** Should automated merge processes fail due to lack of permissions, users can easily fall back to manually submitting merge requests to complete the packaging process.
**Getting Started:**
1. **Configure Git:** Ensure Git is installed and properly set up on your Windows system, including authentication for a Git account with merge permissions for the Luffy project repository.
2. **Install the Plugin:** Download and install the Luffy Project Common Package Plugin from the JetBrains Marketplace into your IntelliJ IDEA installation.
3. **Initiate Packaging:** Access the plugin within IntelliJ IDEA and follow the guided steps to initiate the packaging process. The plugin will handle code pulls and merges (if permissions allow) automatically or guide you through any necessary manual interventions.
For further assistance or troubleshooting, please refer to the plugin's documentation or contact the support team.
We appreciate your patience as we work towards approving and making this plugin available on the JetBrains Marketplace.
idea-plugin.change-notes: 1.0 插件发布：这个插件是为了方便对luffy项目common包进行打包的，因为打包过程需要拉取代码，所以需要配置git，最好git登录过的账号并且有权限merge代码，否则打包最后一步会失败，不过不影响大局，自己手动提交merge request即可（由于小编并不富裕，买不起mac，所以这个插件是windos版本的，mac系统暂不支持）。 PS：其实可以再抽象一下开发一个idea调起各种脚本的通用插件，利用idea的友好界面添加参数，减少每次手动执行bat脚本的麻烦，当然了这个插件是为了特定场景用的，所以定制化了。

idea-plugin.name: LuffyCodeBuild
idea-plugin.description:
**Luffy Code Generator** - Streamline Luffy project development by automatically generating Handle, Service, and Controller code, offering multiple functionality templates and customizable options for efficient CRUD implementation.
**Plugin Overview**: The Luffy Code Generator is an invaluable tool for developers working on Luffy projects, empowering them to rapidly create well-structured code for their Handle, Service, and Controller layers. It significantly reduces development time, minimizes coding errors, and promotes adherence to best practices. The plugin offers a variety of functionality templates, such as logical and physical deletion, enabling users to choose the most suitable implementation method for their specific needs.
**Key Features**: 1. **Automated Code Generation**: Effortlessly generate Handle, Service, and Controller classes and methods for CRUD operations, eliminating the need for manual, repetitive coding. 2. **Functionality Templates**: Select from multiple pre-defined code templates, such as logical deletion and physical deletion, to implement desired functionality with ease. 3. **Customizable Options**: Tailor the generated code to your project's requirements by adjusting settings or modifying the provided templates. 4. **On-Demand Selection and Deletion**: Include only the necessary implementation methods and easily remove any unwanted code, aligning with the principle of deleting code faster than writing it.
**Usage Instructions**: 1. **Installation**: Install the Luffy Code Generator plugin from JetBrains Marketplace and restart your IDE. 2. **Project Setup**: Ensure your Luffy project is properly configured and open within the IDE. 3. **Code Generation**: Locate the plugin in the IDE's menu or context menu (usually under "Tools" or via a dedicated shortcut), and initiate the code generation process. a. Choose the target entity or model for which you want to generate CRUD code. b. Select the desired functionality template(s) from the available options. c. Customize any additional settings as needed. 4. **Review and Integration**: Examine the generated code, making any necessary adjustments to ensure compatibility with your project's architecture and conventions. Integrate the code into your project, replacing or augmenting existing implementations as required.
By leveraging the Luffy Code Generator, developers can boost productivity, maintain code quality, and focus on more complex, value-added tasks within their Luffy projects.

idea-plugin.name: SDK-Import
idea-plugin.description:
Plugin to add support for specifying global SDK definitions at the project level. It loads YML config file to define language SDK for the specific module or project.

Configuration file

In order to import custom SDKs to IDE, the sdk-import.yml file has to be created in the parent .idea directory.

For example:

import:
  - module: "python-data-science-samples"
    path: "C:/PYTHON/Miniconda3-py312_24.1.2-0/envs/python-3.12.2/python.exe"
    type: "PYTHON"
  - module: "python-data-science-samples.jupyter-notebook"
    path: "C:/PYTHON/Miniconda3-py312_24.1.2-0/envs/python-3.9.1/python.exe"
    type: "PYTHON"
  - module: "project-with-local-venv"
    path: "$PROJECT_DIR$"
    type: "PYTHON"
  - module: "python-data-science-samples.java-samples"
    path: "C:\\JAVA\\.gradle\\jdks\\adoptium-18-x64-hotspot-windows"
    type: "JAVA"
  - module: "project-dir-based-sdk"
    path: "$PROJECT_DIR$\\jdks\\adoptium-18-x64-hotspot-windows"
    type: "JAVA"

Where:

  • module should match the Intellij's module name. Nested modules are separated with .. A Java SDK is also assigned to the project when the module name matches the project name. A Python SDK is also assigned to the project when the selected module has the project base directory as one of its content roots,
  • path is the location of SDK on files system. For Python, it may point to the interpreter executable, the virtual environment directory, or a project directory containing a .venv virtual environment,
  • type should be one of the supported SDKs enumerate values,
  • $PROJECT_DIR$ is a main project base directory which will be translated into a full proper path,

Import action

In order to load the config file, developer has to either:

  • reimport/refresh Gradle project,
  • or manually choose "Tools" -> "Reimport SDK" action.

After Intellij will load the SDK and index the files, code autocompletion should be enabled.

Supported SDKs

The Plugin supports the following SDKs:

  • Python (PYTHON import type)
  • Java (JAVA import type)

Python Support

This plugin can cooperate with Python Gradle Plugin to make working with multimodule projects easier.

Gradle Python project generation

It is possible to generate the new Gradle Python project with this plugin.

New Project Generator should be available in the "New Project" wizard window. It allows bootstrapping a simple Python project.

idea-plugin.name: ConvertClassFields
idea-plugin.description:
ConvertClassFieldsAction: Streamline Java Class Field Conversion

ConvertClassFieldsAction is a powerful IntelliJ IDEA plugin designed to enhance Java development productivity. It offers a seamless way to convert fields between different Java classes, saving time and reducing errors in your code.

Key features:

  1. Smart Class Search: Quickly find and select target classes using an intuitive search interface.
  2. Intelligent Field Mapping: Automatically map fields between source and target classes based on name and type.
  3. Getter/Setter Generation: Automatically generate setter calls with corresponding getter methods.
  4. Code Insertion: Insert the generated code at the cursor position with proper formatting.
  5. Customizable Naming: Allow developers to customize variable names for better code readability.

How to use:

  1. Select a variable of a class type in your Java code.
  2. Right-click and choose the "Convert Class Fields" option from the context menu, or use the shortcut Ctrl+Shift+C.
  3. In the class chooser dialog, search for and select the target class you want to convert to.
  4. Enter the variable names for the source and target objects in the input dialog.
  5. The plugin will generate and insert the conversion code below your cursor.

DevGear simplifies the process of transferring data between objects, making your Java development workflow more efficient and error-free. With just a few clicks, you can generate clean, properly formatted code for object conversion, saving time and reducing the risk of errors in manual field mapping.

idea-plugin.name: createMapConstructor
idea-plugin.description:
Object Mapping Constructor Generator

Simplify object-to-object mapping in your Java projects with this intelligent constructor generator.

Features:

  • Automatically generate constructors that map fields from one object to another
  • Smart detection of getter methods and Lombok annotations
  • User-friendly class selection interface with fuzzy search
  • Customizable parameter naming for the source object
  • Seamless integration with your existing codebase
  • Supports various mapping scenarios: DTO to Entity, Entity to ViewModel, and more

Eliminate tedious manual field mapping and embrace efficient, error-free code generation. Ideal for projects with complex domain models, multi-layered architectures, or any scenario requiring object-to-object mapping.

How to Use:

  1. Open the Java file containing the target class (the class you want to add the constructor to).
  2. Place your cursor inside the class body.
  3. Right-click to open the context menu, or use the 'Code' menu in the top menu bar.
  4. Navigate to 'Generate' > 'Generate Mapping Constructor'.
  5. In the dialog that appears, search for and select the source class (the class you want to map from).
  6. Optionally, customize the parameter name for the source object.
  7. Click 'OK' to generate the constructor.

The plugin will automatically generate a constructor that maps all matching fields from the source object to the target object, taking into account getter methods and Lombok annotations.

Tips:

  • Use the fuzzy search in the class selection dialog to quickly find the desired source class.
  • The generated constructor will include comments for fields that don't have a matching counterpart in the source class.
  • You can generate multiple constructors for different source classes in the same target class.

Boost your productivity and maintain clean, consistent code with the Object Mapping Constructor Generator!

idea-plugin.name: DynamicSqlMaker
idea-plugin.description:
Dynamic Sql Maker

Simplify your database operations with the Interactive SQL Generator plugin for IntelliJ IDEA. This powerful tool allows you to effortlessly generate SQL and MyBatis/MyBatis-Plus/JPA code for your Java projects.

Key Features:

  • Interactive UI: Easily select fields, conditions, and mappings through a user-friendly interface.
  • Multiple SQL Types: Generate SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE with just a few clicks.
  • ORM Support: Choose between MyBatis and MyBatis-Plus and jpa for your preferred Object-Relational Mapping.
  • Custom Conditions: Set specific conditions for each field in your WHERE clauses.
  • Database Entity Mapping: Map your Java classes to database entities for accurate SQL generation.
  • Clipboard Integration: Copy generated SQL or Java code directly to your clipboard for quick use.

Whether you're working on a new project or maintaining legacy code, the Interactive SQL Generator streamlines your database interaction development process, saving you time and reducing errors.

Usage Instructions:

  1. Activation: Right-click in your Java file or use the Tools menu to activate the Interactive SQL Generator.
  2. Class Selection: Choose your Java class and corresponding database entity class when prompted.
  3. SQL Type and ORM: Select the type of SQL operation (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) and your preferred ORM (MyBatis or MyBatis-Plus or JPA).
  4. Field Selection: In the interactive table, choose which fields to include in your query.
  5. Condition Setting: For each selected field, specify the condition (e.g., =, >, LIKE) and the connection type (AND/OR).
  6. Generate: Click "OK" to generate your SQL or Java code.
  7. Review and Copy: Review the generated code in the results window. Use the "Copy to Clipboard" button to easily paste it into your project.
  8. Iterate: If needed, use the "Back" button to adjust your selections and regenerate the code.

Get started today and experience the power of effortless SQL generation!

idea-plugin.name: Sudoku T
idea-plugin.description:
Sudoku is a logic-based, combinatorial number-placement puzzle. The objective is to fill a 9 × 9 grid with digits so that each column, each row, and each of the nine 3 × 3 subgrids (known as "boxes" or "regions") contain all the digits from 1 to 9. The puzzle setter provides a partially completed grid, which has a unique solution.
1.Structure:
The grid is divided into 81 cells, arranged in 9 rows and 9 columns. The 9 subgrids each have a 3 × 3 configuration.
2.Rules:
Each digit from 1 to 9 must appear exactly once in every row, column, and subgrid. No cell can contain a number that violates these conditions.
数独是一种基于逻辑的组合数字布局谜题。目标是用数字填充一个9×9的网格，使每一列、每一行和九个3×3子网格中的每一个都包含从1到9的所有数字。拼图设置器提供了一个部分完成的网格，它有一个独特的解决方案。
1.结构：
网格分为81个单元格，排列成9行9列。9个子网格每个都有3×3的配置
2.规则：
从1到9的每个数字必须在每一行、每一列和每一个子网格中恰好出现一次。任何单元格都不能包含违反这些条件的数字

idea-plugin.name: Maven Plug-in Extensions
idea-plugin.description:
This plugin enhances Maven support in IDE. (Freemium)

The primary goal of this plugin is to provide seamless, implicit support that extends IntelliJ IDEA's existing Maven functionality. Ideally, users won’t need to perform any specific configuration to take advantage of it.

Initially, the plugin focuses on supporting the org.codehaus.mojo:properties-maven-plugin, but it is designed with extensibility in mind, enabling future support for additional Maven plugins.

Paid and free features are clearly marked in the plugin description. I reserve the right to adjust the distribution of features between the paid and free versions in future releases. The freemium model keeps me motivated to continue developing the plugin, adding new features, and supporting additional Maven plugins. I aim to designate features as paid when they require a significant investment of time and\or effort to develop. Your understanding and support are greatly appreciated. Additionally, the platform provider may offer discounts or other promotions to make premium features more accessible.

Feedback and suggestions are always welcome—your input is invaluable and deeply appreciated.

Key Features:

Enhanced Maven support in IntelliJ IDEA.

Inspections:

Maven Dependency Version Inspection

Automatically checks your pom.xml files for outdated dependencies and plugins, highlights them, and suggests more recent versions available in Maven repositories. (paid, alpha functionality)

Inspects:

  • Dependencies in the dependencies section
  • Dependencies in the dependencyManagement section
  • Dependencies in the plugins section
  • Dependencies in the pluginManagement section
  • Plugins in the plugins section
  • Plugins in the pluginManagement section

Features:

  • Real-time inspection with version highlighting
  • Quick-fix suggestions with available newer versions
  • Semantic version comparison for intelligent version suggestions
  • Local quick fixes to update all minor or all patch versions at once (for dependencies, plugins, and dependencies inside plugins)

Extract Version to Property Inspection

Suggests extracting hardcoded dependency and plugin versions in pom.xml to Maven properties for improved maintainability and consistency. Provides quick fixes to extract versions based on group ID or artifact ID, replace with existing properties, or bulk-update all dependencies/plugins at once. (paid) Inspects:

  • Dependencies in the dependencies section
  • Dependencies in the dependencyManagement section
  • Plugins in the plugins section
  • Plugins in the pluginManagement section

Features:

  • bulk update
  • suggested property name is based on group-id (a few popular group-ids are mapped to special property names, like sprint-boot)
  • suggested property name is based on artifact-id (the only choice for plugins)
  • suggest to re-use the property name and shows the used version in there for quick manual choice

Currently Supported Maven Plugins:

  • org.codehaus.mojo:properties-maven-plugin

    • read-project-properties

  • org.codehaus.mojo:build-helper-maven-plugin

    • parse-version (formattedVersion) (parsedVersion is supported by Jetbrains plugin)
    • regex-property
    • timestamp-property
    • local-ip
    • hostname
    • cpu-count
    • uptodate-property
    • uptodate-properties

  • io.github.git-commit-id:git-commit-id-maven-plugin (paid)

  • pl.project13.maven:git-commit-id-plugin (versions from 1.0 to 9.0.0) (paid)

    • revision

Details:

  • auto-completion in the pom.xml, *.properties, and plain text files
  • referencing in the pom.xml, *.properties, and plain text files (when they are in filtered resources)
    • plain text and *.properties files supported in paid version

Planned Updates:

Future updates will expand the list of supported Maven plugins based on user and community feedback.

Develocity: Real-Time Build & Test Observability

The Develocity IntelliJ plugin brings build insights and test analytics directly into your IDE. It seamlessly integrates Develocity and Build Scan capabilities to help you identify bottlenecks and fix flaky tests without ever leaving IntelliJ IDEA or Android Studio.

🚀 Key Features

Leverage data from CI and your entire team to understand the "big picture" of test health. (Requires connection to a Develocity server).

欢迎使用 Maven With Me(MPVP)。 如果您是中国大陆以外的用户，请使用 Maven With Me Pro(MPVP)。

现有PRO版 -- IDEA 插件Maven With Me Pro(MPVP)可通过 JetBrains 官方激活使用，激活可享受 JetBrains 官方安全支付渠道及发票！

注：若您使用的是Gradle，对应的IDEA 插件为 Gradle With Me(GPVP)。如果您是中国大陆以外的用户，请使用 Gradle With Me Pro(GPVP)。
Maven Project Version Plugin And Plugin Menu Added In Tools Menu.
Maven项目版本插件，插件菜单添加在工具菜单中.

How to find the operation menu?
如何找到操作菜单？

Tools > Maven Project Version

✨Features / 核心功能



1.(Maven Update) Quick upgrade/rollback of Maven project version.

Whether it's a snapshot version or a release version, simply input and submit with one click to easily help you upgrade or roll back version values (no longer have to worry and spend a lot of time adjusting version values). We will also show you the specific details of the modifications~Simplify your workflow and save you a lot of valuable time!

More Strategy To Update Version.

Default Strategy

- must have new version and changed version.

- when version exist and matched will replace and support dependency version is special value (e.g: ${version} / [1.6, 1.8]) will continue replace.

General Strategy

- must have new version.

- when version exist and matched will replace.

Support Must Same Version (Before)

- if checked: project or dependency version not equals project before replacement version will continue replace.

- if not checked: new version will to replace.



1.Maven项目版本快速升级/回退.

无论是快照版还是release版，输入后提交一键轻松帮您搞定版本值升级或回退（再也不用头疼和花费大量时间调整版本值啦）。还会为您展示修改的具体细节~ 简化您的工作流程，为您节省大量宝贵时间！

更新支持多种策略

默认策略

- 必须存在新版本并且变更版本.

- 当版本存在且匹配时将会替换；并且支持依赖版本是特殊值 (e.g: ${version} / [1.6, 1.8]) 将会跳过替换.（依赖中使用项目版本占位符的会跳过替换，但会修改对应的变量属性版本值；如果依赖中使用的是版本范围的将不做处理）.

常规策略

- 必须存在新版本.

- 当版本存在并且匹配时将替换. （即将依赖中的版本替换为当前要应用的新版本）

支持必须同一版本 (变更前)

- 选中: 项目或依赖版本如果不等于替换之前的版本将跳过替换.

- 未选中: 新版本会直接替换.



2.(Maven Version Show) Active Show Version In Project View.

Version values can be displayed directly in the project view, and the current version can be known at a glance, providing the ability to customize display rules.



2.支持项目版本展示在项目视图.

可直接在项目视图中展示版本值，一眼便能知晓当下版本~ 并提供自定义展示规则能力。



3.(Maven Search) Search Version For Central Repository or Nexus Repository.

Support querying the latest dependency versions of the central repository, as well as quickly querying the dependency versions of the Nexus repository (remote/private). Simplify your workflow and save you a lot of valuable time!
Provide convenient search capabilities (Maven pom configuration or Gradle dependency configuration can be pasted and queried, or searched by keywords), one click copying of dependency coordinates, One click access to file directory (compatible with lower versions of Nexus),One click loading update time (compatible with lower versions of Nexus), quick view of version details page, etc. Welcome to experience it~



3.支持项目版本搜索(中央仓库 / Nexus仓库).

支持查询中央仓库最新依赖版本，也可以快速查询Nexus仓库(远程/私服)依赖版本。简化您的工作流程，为您节省大量宝贵时间！
提供便捷式搜索能力(Maven pom配置或Gradle依赖配置粘贴后即可查询，也可通过关键字进行查询)， 一键复制依赖坐标， 一键访问文件目录（兼容Nexus低版本），一键加载更新时间（兼容Nexus低版本），快速查看版本详情页等，欢迎上手体验~



4.Support generate project version badges with shields.io.

Supports the quick generate badges for common Maven project versions (relying on the capabilities of shields.io).
Provides common parameter usage, allowing quick customization of text and color
Add an internal @alt parameter to define the text for the alt attribute in HTML, Markdown, and Markdown (With URL)
Provide URL, Markdown, Markdown (With URL), HTML build types
Provide the ability to quickly enter groupId and artifactId (e.g: by pasting Maven pom configuration or Gradle dependency configuration)
Markdown (with URL) provides built-in Redirect links by default, and you can also customize and enter Redirect links


4.支持项目版本徽章生成.

支持快速生成常见Maven项目版本的徽章 (依赖shields.io能力)。
提供常见参数使用，可快速自定义文本及颜色
增加内部@alt参数用于定义HTML、Markdown、Markdown(With URL)中alt属性的文本
提供URL、Markdown、Markdown(With URL)、HTML生成类型
提供支持groupId+artifactId快速输入能力(如Maven pom配置或Gradle依赖配置粘贴即可)
Markdown(With URL)默认提供内置跳转链接，也可自定义输入跳转链接


5.Project Settings Synchronous

Automatically synchronize JDK, language level specifications, and other configuration features! Whether it's individual development or team collaboration, one person configuration, shared by all! (Need to submit configuration to remote repository) Automatically recognize and switch to the corresponding JDK version and configuration, whether in project opening, Git clone, Git branch switching, Git rollback, or other scenarios!!! Further unify the team SDK specifications and save the tedious steps and time required for teams or individuals to manually configure IDE environments multiple times!!!
Other instructions: The '~' in JDK Home Path represents the user's home directory, which is used to dynamically identify a unified path under different usernames.


5.项目配置同步功能

自动同步JDK、语言level规范等配置功能！无论是个人开发还是团队协作，一人配置，全员共享！(需要提交配置到远程仓库) 无论是在项目打开，还是Git clone、Git分支切换、Git还原等场景下，自动识别切换到对应的JDK版本及配置！！！进一步统一团队SDK规范，并节省团队或个人需多次手动配置IDE环境等繁琐步骤及时间！！！
其他说明：JDK Home Path中的 ~ 代表为用户主目录，用于动态识别出不同用户名下的统一路径。
