idea-plugin.name: PAG Viewer
idea-plugin.description: Preview Portable Animated Graphics (.pag) animation files in IntelliJ-based IDEs.

idea-plugin.name: Propsy
idea-plugin.description: Shows configured .properties files as an editable Key/Value table in a tool window. Paths are configured per-project in Settings | Tools | Propsy. Edits preserve comments, blank lines and key order.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Added

  • Support for .env files in the Key/Value tool window (requires the ".env files support" plugin, ru.adelf.idea.dotenv). Edits preserve comments, blank lines and key order like .properties.

Changed

  • Lowered the minimum IDE to 2025.2 (sinceBuild = 252).
  • Reworked the Propsy settings page: clearer description, a .env support status row with a one-click install shortcut when the plugin is missing, and a download icon for the Scan action.

idea-plugin.name: JSONL Viewer
idea-plugin.description:
A fast viewer for JSON Lines files (.jsonl / .ndjson, plain or .gz), built for files that are far too large for the normal editor.

Opening a .jsonl (or .jsonl.gz) file adds a Records tab that shows the file as a virtualized, scrollable list of one-line record previews. Selecting a record pretty-prints it below with JSON syntax highlighting and independently foldable nested objects and arrays.

  • Handles huge files — the file is streamed and indexed by record offset; it is never loaded into the editor's document or PSI, so multi-hundred-megabyte files open instantly without hitting the IDE's size limits.
  • On-demand pretty-printing — each record is formatted only when selected; nested structures fold independently.
  • Full-text search — search across the entire file; the list filters to the matching records with the match highlighted.
  • Read-only — never modifies your files; the raw text stays available on a second tab.
  • Reads gzip files — .jsonl.gz / .ndjson.gz are decompressed to a temp file on open and viewed with the same streaming Records tab; the temp file is removed when the editor closes.

Works in any IntelliJ-based IDE (IntelliJ IDEA, Rider, PyCharm, and others).
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• 1.1.0 — Open gzip-compressed JSON Lines files (.jsonl.gz / .ndjson.gz / .jsonlines.gz / .ldjson.gz).
  • 1.0.0 — Initial release: streaming Records viewer for .jsonl / .ndjson with a virtualized record list, on-demand pretty-printing with nested folding, and full-text search.

idea-plugin.name: mdBook Viewer
idea-plugin.description:
Renders an mdBook inside a tool window.

Point the plugin at a GitHub repository (public or private) or any URL that hosts an mdBook. It fetches the source and renders the book internally in the background — no mdbook serve and no local mdBook installation required. Works in JetBrains Remote Development.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Added

  • Bundled preprocessors: mdbook-mermaid, mdbook-toc, and mdbook-katex are bundled for all supported platforms and placed on the serve process's PATH, so books that opt in via [preprocessor.mermaid] / [preprocessor.toc] / [preprocessor.katex] render without any extra install.

Changed

  • Targets IntelliJ Platform build 262 (2026.2) and newer, where JCEF is provided by the bundled com.intellij.modules.jcef plugin. Fixes the plugin being rejected as incompatible: it previously compiled against 252 while declaring a 253 floor, and the JCEF module it depends on exists only from 262 on.

idea-plugin.name: NATS Toolbox
idea-plugin.description:
Explore NATS directly inside IntelliJ-based IDEs.
  • Search and inspect JetStream messages
  • Follow live JetStream and Core NATS traffic
  • Browse Key/Value buckets
  • Discover NATS services and call endpoints
  • Decode Protocol Buffers payloads
idea-plugin.change-notes: Initial public release.

idea-plugin.name: Niivue Viewer
idea-plugin.description:
Niivue Viewer opens medical imaging volume files directly in your JetBrains IDE.

Powered by Niivue — the same WebGL2 viewer used in the standalone web app and the VSCode extension. Double-click a supported file in the Project View and it opens in an editor tab with multiplanar slices (axial, coronal, sagittal) plus a 3D render in a 2×2 grid.

A toolbar lets you switch views, pan and zoom, tune the colormap and window, overlay a second volume (such as a segmentation mask or statistical map), inspect the NIfTI header, and step the crosshair or move through 4D timepoints.

Useful for researchers and developers working with neuroimaging or other 3D volume data — particularly when you already use Python tooling (nibabel, dipy, ANTs, FSL, nilearn) and want to inspect a volume without leaving the IDE.

Supported formats: NIfTI (.nii, .nii.gz), NRRD (.nrrd, .nhdr), FreeSurfer (.mgh, .mgz), MetaImage (.mha), MRtrix (.mif, .mif.gz, .mih), BrainVoyager (.v16, .vmr), NumPy (.npy, .npz).
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Fixed

  • The viewer failed to open with NoClassDefFoundError: com/intellij/ui/jcef/JBCefApp on 2026.2. The embedded browser (JCEF) moved out of the platform core into a bundled plugin in that release, so the dependency on it is now declared explicitly. This build therefore requires 2026.2 or newer; for 2025.2–2026.1 use 0.1.2.

idea-plugin.name: Open HTTP Client
idea-plugin.description:
A lightweight, open-source .http / .rest request runner. Write requests in plain text files, run them from the editor, and get formatted, highlighted responses — with environments, variables, scripts, cURL import/export, HTTP/2, and gRPC support.

Features

  • Syntax highlighting, gutter run icons, Run All, variable completion, and a File Structure view for .http/.rest files
  • Formatted console output: status colored by response code, duration, size, headers, highlighted JSON/XML body; responses saved with <> references
  • HTTP/2 via HTTP/2 on the request line
  • gRPC unary calls via server reflection (v1 with v1alpha fallback), plaintext or TLS (grpcs://), with named gRPC statuses
  • Environments: http-client.env.json + private overrides, directory-local files, $shared values, editor and status-bar selectors
  • Pre-request and response handler scripts with client.test/client.assert — failed tests fail the run
  • cURL import (incl. paste conversion) and export; gRPC requests export as grpcurl

🤖 Fully vibe-coded with Claude Code, Codex, and Antigravity. Source: github.com/erdemaydin/open-http-client
idea-plugin.change-notes: • 1.0.0 — initial release: .http/.rest editing and running, environments and variables, scripts, cURL import/export, JSON/XML formatting, HTTP/2, and gRPC unary calls (plaintext and TLS) via server reflection.

idea-plugin.name: Workday Pocket
idea-plugin.description:
Workday Pocket keeps work, reading, and everyday planning inside your JetBrains IDE.

Track your workday, read local books, manage tasks, follow stocks, and estimate loans without leaving the editor.

Key features

  • Workday dashboard: salary progress, daily income, work countdown, and personal milestones
  • Local reader: TXT, EPUB, and PDF reading with page navigation and status-bar reading
  • Sticky notes: task lists, completion states, and local persistence
  • Stock watchlist: A-share search, quote refresh, and change indicators
  • Loan calculator: house price, down payment, term, rate, and repayment estimates

中文简介

Workday Pocket 是运行在 JetBrains IDE 内的本地工作与阅读助手。在编辑器中记录工资进度、下班倒计时，阅读本地小说，管理便利贴、关注股票并计算贷款。

  • 打工人：工资进度、每日收入、下班倒计时与人生时间记录
  • 阅读：本地 TXT、EPUB、PDF 阅读，支持翻页与状态栏阅读
  • 便利贴：任务清单、完成状态与本地保存
  • 股票：A 股搜索、行情刷新与涨跌幅展示
  • 贷款：房屋总价、首付、期限、利率与还款估算

所有设置和内容仅保存在本机。

idea-plugin.name: Happy Read book
idea-plugin.description:
Read ebooks and novels without leaving your JetBrains IDE.

Happy Read book is a private local reader for IntelliJ IDEA and other JetBrains IDEs. Your books and reading data stay on your computer.

Key features

  • Open TXT, EPUB, PDF, MOBI, and AZW3 books
  • Read discreetly from the IDE status bar and drag to adjust its width
  • Use keyboard shortcuts for previous page, next page, and exiting reading mode
  • Automatically detect Chinese and English chapter titles and click to jump
  • Browse recent books and a scrollable chapter directory
  • Automatically save recent books, the current file, and reading progress
  • Choose Paper, Night, or Ink themes, or customize the font, size, text color, and background
  • Use idle auto page turning and immersive reading mode
  • Right-click selected text to save a bookmark; copy, delete, or double-click bookmarks to jump
  • MOBI and AZW3 support unencrypted files; DRM- or password-protected content is not supported

中文简介

快乐读书是一款适用于 IntelliJ IDEA 和其他 JetBrains IDE 的本地电子书、小说阅读插件。 书籍与阅读记录仅保存在本机。

  • 支持 TXT、EPUB、PDF、MOBI、AZW3
  • 支持底部状态栏隐藏阅读，并可滑动调节底部栏宽度
  • 支持使用快捷键切换上一页、下一页和退出阅读
  • 自动识别中英文章节目录，点击章节即可跳转
  • 提供最近小说列表和可滚动章节目录
  • 自动保存最近打开的小说、当前文件和阅读进度
  • 内置纸书、暗夜、水墨主题，并支持自定义字体、字号、文字颜色和背景色
  • 支持鼠标静止自动翻页和沉浸阅读模式
  • 选中文字后可通过右键保存书签；书签支持复制、删除和双击跳转
  • MOBI、AZW3 支持未加密文件；受 DRM 或密码保护的内容暂不支持读取
idea-plugin.change-notes:
2.0.1

  • Added JetBrains Marketplace licensing for the paid subscription edition.
  • Reading features require an active subscription license.
  • Includes TXT, EPUB, PDF, MOBI, AZW3, chapters, bookmarks, themes, and status bar reading.

idea-plugin.name: MdLens
idea-plugin.description:
MdLens is a read-only Markdown viewer for JetBrains IDEs.

It renders GitHub Flavored Markdown and Mermaid diagrams offline with GitHub Light and GitHub Dark themes that follow the IDE or stay independent.

  • GitHub Flavored Markdown with alerts, footnotes, syntax highlighting, and Mermaid diagrams
  • GitHub Light and GitHub Dark themes with optional IDE sync
  • Compact and Spacious profiles with configurable font, size, content width, highlight colors, and live preview
  • Automatic refresh with relative images and links
  • Offline rendering with untrusted content sanitization

While enabled, MdLens opens supported Markdown and Mermaid files in its read-only viewer. AI and IDE tools can continue to modify the underlying files.

See the GitHub repository for implemented and planned features.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
New Features

  • Expand offline syntax highlighting to 45 languages with broader SQL dialect aliases.
  • Improve code readability with function-call and additional token-scope colors.

Dependency Upgrades

  • Upgrade DOMPurify and Mermaid to patched releases.

idea-plugin.name: PRISM Log Viewer
idea-plugin.description:
Find a failed request in your local JSON logs. PRISM Pro lets you combine level, logger, text, time, and JSON field filters, inspect nested fields, and save the query for your next investigation inside IntelliJ.

Try the worked Pro example: use a small synthetic checkout log to find two matching records, inspect the nested payment error, and save your filter. The guide includes the sample data, expected result, trial activation steps, and support contact.

Open large local logs without loading the complete file into the IDE document model. PRISM uses a streaming viewport for local log files.

Free viewer included. Search, level filters, follow mode, highlighting, local format detection, and configurable large-file takeover are available without Pro.

PRISM Pro unlocks JSON fields, combined filters, and saved queries. Start the 7-day trial when you need nested JSON inspection, combined level/logger/text/time/JSON filters, or reusable structured queries.

Free viewer

  • Theme-aware TRACE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, and FATAL highlighting.
  • Level filtering, plain-text search, and follow/tail updates.
  • Detection for JSON Lines, log4j/logback, java.util.logging, syslog, and plain text.
  • One persisted custom regex format plus configurable large-file takeover.
  • LF, CRLF, mixed line endings, UTF-8 BOM, and mixed UTF-8/Windows-1252 line handling.

PRISM Pro

  • Nested JSON inspection in a sortable field table and collapsible tree.
  • Combined level, logger, text, time-range, and JSON field filters.
  • Saved queries that can be loaded, updated, or deleted.

Free vs Pro

Capability Free Pro
Streaming local-file viewport Yes Yes
Search, follow, and level filters Yes Yes
Bundled formats and one custom regex Yes Yes
Nested JSON field table and tree Yes
Combined level/logger/text/time/JSON filters Yes
Saved structured queries Yes

Log contents are processed locally. PRISM includes no independent analytics, advertising, or telemetry. Paid-feature confirmation is handled by JetBrains Marketplace licensing.

PRISM reads local log files. It is not a remote tailing, log aggregation, analytics, console-highlighting, or full ANSI-rendering product.

Workflow comparison

Workflow PRISM Default editor Console-focused tool Remote aggregation
Large local file without full document loading Yes Varies
Live local-file follow Yes Console only Agent-dependent
Local JSON field inspection Pro Varies Usually
Source navigation and deep stack-trace links IDE-native Often Varies
Remote collection and cross-host search Yes
Full ANSI terminal rendering Often Varies

Supported formats

JSON Lines/NDJSON, log4j/logback-style records, java.util.logging, basic RFC 3164 syslog, plain text, and one persisted custom regex format.

Measured scope

Every release candidate must pass the predeclared 1 GB IDE gates on the supported IntelliJ 2025.2 endpoint: first fixture-data paint within 2 seconds, maximum EDT queue stall of 500 ms, full sampled-index completion within 90 seconds, and steady-state heap delta no greater than 512 MB. The release matrix also covers 5 GB, CRLF, rapid append, and opening while the IDE indexes a large project.

Exact release measurements are hardware- and workload-specific and are published only after the final artifact passes the documented methodology. These thresholds are release gates, not universal timing or unlimited-file-size claims.

  • Updates trial wording to match the live 7-day Marketplace trial.

idea-plugin.name: Swagger Viewer
idea-plugin.description:
Swagger Viewer

Preview your Swagger documentation instantly inside JetBrains IDEA — no build required

Why I Built This

  • To share API documentation written with Swagger, you typically need to build and deploy the application. If the documentation contains a typo or incorrect content, you have to fix it and rebuild — which is time-consuming. This plugin was developed to let you see how the documentation looks in advance, helping you catch mistakes before they happen.

Key Features

Real-Time Annotation Preview

  • Spring projects only — targets Java/Kotlin projects based on Spring Boot or Spring MVC
  • Scans Swagger annotations in @RestController / @Controller classes via PSI static analysis
  • Supports @Operation, @ApiResponse, @Parameter, @OpenAPIDefinition, and more
  • Supports OAS request body via @Operation(requestBody = @RequestBody(...)) (Spring @RequestBody is not recognized)
  • The Swagger UI preview in the Tool Window updates instantly as you type — no build, save, or app launch needed

YAML / JSON Spec File Preview

  • Automatically detects OpenAPI spec files (.yaml, .yml, .json) in your project
  • Renders them in the Tool Window as soon as you open the file in the editor
  • Preview updates in real time while editing the file

IDE Integration

  • Available as a Tool Window on the right side of the IDE — no separate browser needed
  • Annotation tab and YAML tab are configured automatically (tabs with no relevant files are hidden)
  • Works identically on both IntelliJ IDEA Community and Ultimate

Requirements

  • JetBrains IDE 2024.2 or later
  • Spring Boot / Spring MVC based project (required for annotation preview)

Getting Started

  1. Install the plugin from the Marketplace
  2. The Swagger Viewer Tool Window will appear automatically on the right side of the IDE
  • Annotation preview: Open and edit a file containing @RestController or @Operation to see it reflected immediately in the Annotation tab
  • YAML/JSON preview: Open an OpenAPI spec file (.yaml, .yml, .json) in the editor to view it in the YAML tab
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.1 - Fix compatibility

  • Updated compatibility for the latest IntelliJ IDEA version.
  • replace implicit Query.iterator() calls with findAll()/findFirst()

1.0.0 - Initial Release

  • Real-time Swagger annotation preview via PSI static analysis (no build or app launch required)
  • Supports @Operation, @ApiResponse, @Parameter, @OpenAPIDefinition and more
  • OpenAPI YAML/JSON spec file preview in Tool Window
  • Works on both IntelliJ IDEA Community and Ultimate

idea-plugin.name: Sheets - XLSX Editor
idea-plugin.description:
Edit Excel workbooks without leaving your IDE.

Sheets opens .xlsx files in a real spreadsheet grid, with column letters, row numbers and one tab per worksheet, and lets you actually change them. Numbers stay numbers, formulas stay formulas, and saving writes the workbook back in place.

What you can do

  • Edit any cell, and keep its type. Type =B2*C2 and you get a formula, evaluated straight away. Type 50% and you get 0.5 formatted as a percentage. Type '007 and you get the text 007. A formula shows its result in the grid and its source when you edit it.
  • Formula bar. The strip above the grid shows the selected cell's reference and its real contents, with the full width of the editor to edit a long formula in. Type a reference like C400 into the name box to jump straight there.
  • See and change how cells look. The grid shows the bold, italics, colours, fills and alignment stored in the workbook, and the Format menu changes them: bold with Ctrl+B, a colour from a palette, alignment, and number formats from currency to percentage to plain text. Every change goes through the same undo stack as everything else.
  • Sort a column, ascending or descending, from the toolbar or the right-click menu. The whole table follows the key, so every row stays together; a header row is kept pinned at the top, and formulas that move have their references adjusted to their new row.
  • Filter a table with Ctrl+Shift+L, the shortcut you already use. Every column gets an arrow, and clicking one drops down a checklist of the values that are actually in that column, with a search box for the long ones. Filter several columns at once. Hidden rows keep their real row numbers in the gutter, so B88 still says B88, and a total row below the table stays put instead of vanishing with the data.
  • Merged cells look like merged cells. A title merged across four columns is drawn across all four, aligned the way the file says, and it selects, edits and navigates as one cell, not as a value squeezed into the top-left corner. You can merge and unmerge from the Format menu too, including Merge and Centre, and both are saved into the workbook.
  • Insert and delete rows and columns, from the toolbar or the right-click menu.
  • Set column widths and row heights, and they are saved into the workbook. Drag a divider, double-click one to fit the column or row to its contents, or type an exact size: characters for a width and points for a height, the same units Excel asks for. All of it is a single Ctrl+Z away, and it is the file's own size, so it is still there when the workbook is opened in Excel.
  • Draw borders. All Borders, Outside Borders, or one edge at a time, in seven line styles and any colour. Every one of them is written into the file. Borders already in a workbook are drawn as the file describes them, including the ones POI itself reports as absent in spreadsheets written by Python and other non-Excel tools.
  • Change the typeface and the size of any cell, from every font installed on your machine. A workbook's own fonts are shown too: a cell the file makes larger than the rest is drawn larger, in proportion to your editor font rather than overriding it.
  • Copy, cut and paste whole blocks. It works both ways with Excel, LibreOffice and Google Sheets, because the clipboard is ordinary tab-separated text. Copied formulas move their references, so =B2*C2 filled down becomes =B3*C3.
  • Drag-fill from the corner handle: copy a value, continue a number run, walk a date forward, or count Run 007 up to Run 008.
  • Undo and redo with the IDE's own Ctrl+Z. Sheets uses the platform undo stack, so the Edit menu says "Undo Insert Row" and undo is scoped to the file you are in.
  • Settings that matter, under Tools → Sheets: opt in to .xlsm, .xltx and .xls, choose the formatting locale, cap how many rows are displayed, and turn off the delete confirmation.

Saving does not damage your file. The workbook is kept open and written back out, so styles, charts, conditional formatting, data validation, defined names, print settings and every sheet you never opened survive exactly as they were. This is verified on every build by a test that saves a workbook and reads it back with a separate library to confirm nothing was lost.

Sheets never touches your CSV files. It registers for .xlsx and nothing else. Whatever you already use for CSV keeps them, and there is no setting that can change that; it is deliberate, not an oversight.

It follows your IDE. The grid, headers, selection and scrollbars all take their colours from your theme, so it looks right in light and dark without configuration. Your workbook's own colours are shown too, and where one of them cannot be read against your theme, such as the near-black text most spreadsheets are full of, it is adjusted until it can be rather than left invisible.

Works everywhere JetBrains does. Sheets depends only on the platform, so it installs in IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, PhpStorm, GoLand, Rider, RubyMine, CLion, DataGrip, RustRover and Android Studio, Community editions included.

Pricing, stated plainly

  • $29 per year for a personal licence.
  • $69 per year for a commercial licence.
  • 30-day free trial with everything unlocked. No feature is held back during the trial.
  • There is no free tier. After the trial, Sheets needs a licence. Saying so here rather than letting you find out later is the whole point.

If you only need to read spreadsheets, several free plugins do that well and you do not need this one.

Known limits, stated up front

  • Sorting a block that contains merged cells is refused rather than half-done, and cells cannot be merged while a filter is hiding rows. Both would leave a merged block covering data it has nothing to do with; Excel refuses the first for the same reason. Typing into a merged cell also opens a text field the width of its first column, so a long title scrolls as you type; the value goes to the right place, it is the field that is narrow.
  • A filter is a way of looking at the file, not part of it: it is not saved into the workbook, so opening the same file in Excel shows every row. While a filter is on, rows and columns cannot be inserted or deleted: switch it off, make the change, switch it back on.
  • Borders are drawn in seven line styles. A workbook can store fourteen, and the rarer dash-dot patterns are drawn as a dashed line; the file keeps whatever it had, it is only the picture on screen that simplifies.
  • Diagonal borders, gradient fills and rotated text are kept exactly as they are in the file but are not shown or editable here.

These are on the roadmap. Compatibility with new IDE releases comes first: this plugin is built to keep working when JetBrains ships, and that is treated as a feature, not as maintenance.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
2026.1.7

A text release. The screen shown when Sheets has no licence used to open with "Your trial has ended", which is not true for somebody who has never started one, and it offered the licence before the free trial. It now reads "Sheets is not activated", says plainly that a 30-day trial can be started, and puts the trial first. Punctuation across the whole plugin has been rewritten as well: the truncation notice, both size dialogs, the merge and sort refusals, the formula bar help and four settings labels. No behaviour has changed.

2026.1.6

A maintenance release. Sheets no longer calls an IntelliJ Platform method that JetBrains have since marked as internal, which keeps it inside the platform's supported API on 2026.2 and later. There is no change to how anything behaves; every feature below is unchanged.

2026.1.5

Borders, fonts and row heights. Draw borders from the Format menu: All, Outside, or one edge at a time, in seven line styles and any colour. Change a cell's typeface and size from every font on your machine. Drag a row's bottom edge to resize it, double-click to fit it to its contents, or set an exact height in points. All undoable, all written into the workbook.

Also fixed: borders in spreadsheets written by Python's openpyxl and other non-Excel tools were not being shown at all, and editing one could quietly remove the others.

2026.1.4

Merged cells span. A merged title is drawn across the columns it covers, aligned the way the file says, and it selects, edits and navigates as one cell. New in the Format menu: Merge Cells, Merge and Centre, and Unmerge Cells, all undoable and all saved into the workbook.

2026.1.3

Column widths are editable and saved. Drag a divider, double-click one to fit the column to its contents, or set an exact width in characters from the Columns menu. All undoable, and written into the workbook rather than kept as a private preference.

2026.1.2

Filtering. Ctrl+Shift+L puts an arrow on every column of the table around the cursor; clicking one drops down a checklist of that column's own values, with a search box. Several columns filter together, hidden rows keep their real row numbers, and rows outside the table, such as a title above it or a total below it, are left alone.

2026.1.1

Sorting. Sort a column ascending or descending with the whole table following the key, the header row pinned, and moved formulas re-pointed at their new row. Also fixes a bug where typing new text over a cell that already held text could leave the old text in the saved file.

2026.1.0: first release

Open and edit .xlsx workbooks in the IDE: typed cell editing, a formula bar, cell formatting (bold, italics, underline, text and fill colours, alignment, number formats), insert and delete rows and columns, copy/cut/paste compatible with Excel, drag-fill, undo and redo on the IDE's own stack, and saving in place that preserves styles, charts and every untouched sheet. Settings under Tools → Sheets. Never registers for .csv.

idea-plugin.name: Halk Background
idea-plugin.description:
Halk Background is an IntelliJ IDEA plugin that displays and auto-rotates background images in the editor and IDE frame. It supports local folders, single images, remote URLs, and a built-in online wallpaper gallery (hefollo.com) that pre-downloads pictures to local cache for zero-latency switching.

Halk Background 是一款 IntelliJ IDEA 插件，可在编辑器与窗体区域显示背景图片并自动轮播，让编码界面更有个性。

使用方式 / How to use

  1. 在插件市场安装本插件后，打开 设置（Settings）→ 工具（Tools）→ Halk Background。
  2. 勾选「启用背景图片」，然后点击下方「添加」选择图片来源：
    • 本地文件夹：选择一个图片目录，插件会自动扫描其中的所有图片并轮播；
    • 单张图片 / 远程 URL：添加本地图片文件或网络图片地址（添加时自动下载到本地缓存，规避运行环境网络问题）；
    • 内置在线图库：直接填写 hefollo.com 的壁纸目录（如 妹子套图/粉色草莓和制服黑丝），插件会按目录预下载到本地并轮换，无需自己搜集图片。
  3. 调整「透明度」（背景浓淡，0~100%）与「轮播间隔」（分钟），设置立即生效并自动保存。

主要功能 / Features

  • 支持本地文件夹、单张图片、远程 URL、内置在线图库四种图源；
  • 内置在线图库按目录预下载到本地，切换零延迟、不依赖运行时网络；
  • 可配置透明度与轮播间隔，设置自动持久化（重启不丢失）；
  • 侧边工具窗口支持实时预览、手动切换、重新加载配置与一键禁用；
  • 基于 IntelliJ 原生背景机制，切换稳定、即开即用。

idea-plugin.name: LogLens
idea-plugin.description:
LogLens — open multi-gigabyte log files instantly.

Stop fighting your log files. LogLens opens huge logs the built-in viewers choke on — multi-GB files load in a snap with indexed, virtualized scrolling. No "file too large" wall, no freezing the IDE.

Features

  • Huge files, instantly. A streaming index means the file is never loaded whole — 10 GB opens as fast as 10 MB, with smooth scrolling through millions of lines.
  • Live tail. Follow a log as it grows, with auto-scroll — like tail -f, inside your IDE.
  • Filter without losing your place. Filter by log level or by text/regex; jump straight to the lines that matter.
  • Level highlighting. Errors, warnings, and traces are color-coded out of the box, so problems jump off the screen.
  • ANSI-aware. Colored console output renders correctly instead of showing as escape-code garbage.
  • Multi-line stack traces stay intact and readable.

Works in every JetBrains IDE — IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, GoLand, Rider, CLion, PhpStorm, RubyMine, DataGrip, and more.

By Veryation.

⭐ LogLens Pro — available now. Cross-file trace merge (follow one request across multiple logs), SQL log queries, JSON field querying & pretty-print, regex-capture columns, an error-density timeline, tail alerts, bookmarks with notes, custom highlight rules, saved filter views, and redaction-on-copy. Everything you use today stays free. Early adopters get 40% off the first year.

Website  ·  Support  ·  License (EULA)  ·  Privacy Policy
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Makes the analysis tools findable. Nothing moved from free to Pro, and nothing that was free became gated.

All five already existed, but only on the right-click menu, so anyone who filtered a log without right-clicking a line had no way to find out the plugin does any of it. On the free tier each entry is marked (Pro) and the menu also states what stays free, rather than only advertising the paid tier.
  • The tier is named in the status line, beside the line count: LogLens or LogLens Pro. Previously nothing in the running plugin said which tier you were on.
