idea-plugin.name: Modern CSS Toolkit
idea-plugin.description:
Live templates for modern CSS that you can use today: every template states its Baseline browser-support status. Works in CSS, SCSS, Less and <style> blocks (HTML, Vue); not in the indented Sass syntax, where braces are invalid. Type an abbreviation such as css-container-query and press Tab.

Templates

  • Layout: css-container-named, css-container-query, css-full-height, css-grid-auto, css-logical-spacing, css-media-range, css-scroll-snap, css-subgrid
  • Selectors: css-focus-visible, css-has, css-nth-of, css-where-reset
  • Architecture: css-component-bem, css-component-scope, css-component, css-container-style, css-layers, css-property, css-reset
  • Color: css-color-tokens, css-dark-mode, css-light-dark, css-relative-color
  • Typography: css-fluid-type, css-text-balance
  • Motion: css-dialog-animation, css-entry-animation, css-reduced-motion, css-smooth-scroll, css-view-transition
  • Accessibility: css-visually-hidden
  • Forms: css-field-sizing

Usage

Type the abbreviation and press Tab; press Tab again to move between the editable fields. Ctrl+J / ⌘J lists all templates. Customize them under Settings | Editor | Live Templates | Modern CSS Toolkit.

Privacy

The plugin collects no data and makes no network requests.

Source code: github.com/jamesmosq/modern-css-toolkit.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Added

  • 32 live templates for modern CSS, each labelled with its Baseline status: layout (auto grid, subgrid, container queries, dynamic viewport height, range media queries, scroll snap, logical spacing), selectors (:has(), :where(), :focus-visible, :nth-child(of)), architecture (cascade layers, modern reset, component scaffolds with nesting, BEM or @scope, @property, container style queries), color (OKLCH tokens with color-mix(), light-dark(), relative colors, dark mode), typography (fluid type, balanced headings), motion (reduced motion, smooth scroll, entry animations, dialog animations, view transitions), accessibility (visually hidden) and forms (field-sizing).
  • Templates work in CSS, SCSS, Less and <style> blocks, and are not offered in the indented Sass syntax (.sass), where braces are invalid.

idea-plugin.name: Taiga UI Design Tokens
idea-plugin.description:
Taiga UI Design Tokens is a community-maintained WebStorm plugin for developers working with Taiga UI. It brings project-aware design tokens, icons, CSS units, and event-plugin tooling directly into the editor.

Instead of shipping a fixed catalog, the plugin reads the Taiga UI packages installed in the current project and combines them with reachable project styles. Completion and previews therefore match the version and overrides that the project actually uses.

Features

  • Design token completion for CSS, Less, and SCSS var(--tui-...) references, with resolved values, color previews, reference chains, and source navigation.
  • Project-aware overrides so local token declarations are shown alongside installed-package values and the effective value is easy to understand.
  • Token inspections and quick fixes for unknown and explicitly deprecated Taiga UI tokens.
  • @tui.* icon completion and preview in JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, and Angular templates, using the icon packages available in the current project.
  • rem to px inlay hints for CSS, Less, SCSS, Angular component styles, and numeric Angular .rem style bindings.
  • Taiga UI event-plugin support in Angular templates and TypeScript host metadata, including completion, validation, duplicate/unknown modifier inspections, and hover documentation.

Getting started

Install the plugin, open a project that uses Taiga UI, and let WebStorm finish indexing. No separate token catalog or manual synchronization is required.

  • Type var(--tui- in CSS, Less, or SCSS to explore available design tokens.
  • Hover a complete token reference to inspect resolved values and where they come from.
  • Type @tui. in supported JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, or Angular contexts to browse icons.
  • Open Settings → Tools → Taiga UI to configure editor presentation features.

About the project

The plugin is developed in the open by splincode-taiga-labs as an independent community project focused on improving the developer experience around Taiga UI in JetBrains IDEs.

This project is not an official Taiga UI or T-Bank product. Source code, issue tracking, and contributions are available on GitHub.

idea-plugin.name: Flexible for Penpot
idea-plugin.description:
Your Penpot design system in the IDE. Tokens, components, variants and CSS. Code that notices when the design changes. Browse components with their variants, valid combinations and tokens, copy the variant properties as TypeScript, and generate CSS from the design. Link your component files to Penpot and see when the design changed. In CSS, SCSS and Less: token completion, hover and inspections, and a generated stylesheet with all themes, also as a Tailwind CSS v4 theme and as TypeScript. Works in any JetBrains IDE; completion, hover and inspections need CSS support, as in WebStorm or IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate.


We are a young plugin and want to make it the best way to bring Penpot designs into code. Your feedback is critical: report a bug or an idea and get 20% off the annual license, or one month free.

Feedback: leave a review, open an issue on GitHub, or write to info@ilscipio.com.


Documentation: open the Tutorials tab on this page, or Help > Flexible for Penpot > Getting Started in the IDE.


Flexible for Penpot is an independent plugin and is not affiliated with Penpot, Kaleidos or JetBrains.


Core Features

Components and Variants

  • Components of your Penpot library with folders, variant sets, a preview and a link to the component in Penpot
  • Variant pickers, the valid combinations, and the variant properties as a list, TypeScript, JSON or attributes
  • Tokens used by a component or by all its variants
  • Component CSS from the Penpot shapes, with tokens as var(...) and variants as modifier classes

Code Linked to the Design

  • Link source files (Vue, React, Svelte, Angular, HTML and more) to Penpot components, stored in a file you can commit
  • Editor banner with a link to the component, Copy CSS and a notice when the component changes in Penpot
  • Implemented in list for each component, and suggestions for files named like a component

Design Tokens in CSS

  • Completion of Penpot tokens inside var(...) in CSS, SCSS and Less
  • Hover documentation with the resolved value, alias chain, token set, the value in each theme, a color swatch and a link to the Penpot file
  • Hardcoded value inspection: colors, spacing and radius values that match a token, with a quick fix to use var(...)
  • Drift inspection: custom properties whose value differs from the Penpot token, with a quick fix to use the Penpot value
  • Removed token inspection: var(...) references to tokens that were removed or renamed in Penpot, with quick fixes to the renamed token
  • These editor features need CSS support in the IDE, as in WebStorm or IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate

Generated Stylesheet

  • CSS custom properties or SCSS variables with all tokens, generated on demand
  • Theme overrides with one attribute per Penpot theme group, so data-mode="dark" and data-brand="acme" combine
  • Tailwind CSS v4 theme (optional), so utilities such as bg-primary, p-md and rounded-sm use the tokens
  • JSON and TypeScript output (optional) with var(...) references and values for CSS-in-JS and build tools
  • Up-to-date check: a banner on the generated file and a warning in the tool window when it no longer matches Penpot, with Regenerate
  • Library colors and typographies as CSS variables, also in files without design tokens

Penpot Tool Window

  • Token browser with search, color swatches and a theme switcher; double-click inserts var(...) at the caret
  • Colors and typographies of the Penpot library, to insert or copy
  • Sync status with download progress, and the state of the generated stylesheet

Penpot Connection

  • Design tokens from Penpot on design.penpot.app or your own Penpot server, with a personal access token stored in the IDE password safe
  • Several Penpot files per project, including tokens that a file takes from a shared library
  • Offline cache: tokens are available when the project opens, also without a connection
  • Change check every 60 minutes while the IDE is active (5 to 60 minutes or off), with a notification of renamed, removed, added and changed tokens
  • Penpot themes: use the themes active in Penpot, or choose themes or token sets per project
idea-plugin.change-notes: • First release: Penpot design tokens, library colors, typographies and components in CSS, SCSS, Less and Tailwind code.

idea-plugin.name: SonarQube for IDE
idea-plugin.description:
SonarQube for IDE (formerly SonarLint) by Sonar is a free, sophisticated static analysis tool that enhances both your code quality and security. Start analyzing your code early—as you write or generate it. Local analysis automatically identifies quality and security issues in real-time, even with AI-generated code. Then, fix any issues found using a QuickFix or the AI CodeFix feature before pushing to your SCM. This assures your code meets your quality standards and is safe for running in production.


Want to understand the "why" behind an issue? SonarQube for IDE goes beyond simply highlighting problems, providing detailed contextual information to level up your coding experience and acting as your personal coding tutor.


When connected to SonarQube Server or SonarQube Cloud (you can create a free SonarQube Cloud account to get started!), it becomes a powerful, unified code quality platform for your entire team throughout your software development lifecycle. This connection enables sharing of consistent language rulesets and project settings, and unlocks analysis of deeply hidden security issues, fostering collaboration and code uniformity.


SonarQube for IDE is the only extension you need in your JetBrains IDE for ensuring both code quality and security. It supports a wide range of languages, including C, C++, Java, Go, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, C#, Kotlin, Ruby, HTML, CSS, PHP, and PL/SQL. Please check out our documentation for the complete list of supported languages, rules and secret detection capabilities.



Get started today for free. Check the Requirements and Installation pages— download SonarQube for IDE in the Extension Marketplace and enjoy safe coding!

idea-plugin.name: GitHub Copilot - Your AI Pair Programmer
idea-plugin.description:
What's GitHub Copilot

GitHub Copilot is your AI-powered coding assistant, offering assistance throughout your software development journey. Leveraging large language models, it offers suggestions via code completions, Ask mode, and Agent Mode, as detailed below:

  • Code Completions: Receive auto-complete suggestions from GitHub Copilot by writing code or describing intent in natural language comments.
  • Ask: Engage in conversations about your codebase within your IDE — whether debugging or building features, just ask Copilot for help.
  • Agent: Experience an autonomous coding companion that understands your project context and takes proactive actions. In agent mode, GitHub Copilot can fix errors, suggest and execute commands, and iterate based on feedback — enabling increasingly accurate, self-improving assistance.
  • Planning: The plan agent helps you create detailed implementation plans upfront, ensuring all requirements are covered before development begins.
  • Model Context Protocol (MCP): Extends agent mode by connecting Copilot to external tools and services, enabling more powerful workflows directly in JetBrains IDEs.

Feedback & Support

Copilot Plugin Feedback: Users are encouraged to submit technical/product feedback or report problems directly via our Public Repository.

Survey: You can also share your experience by filling in a private survey at https://aka.ms/ghcp-jb-survey, with an optional follow-up interview with our team.

General Support: For account, billing, or global service inquiries, please reach out via GitHub Support.

Getting access to GitHub Copilot

Sign up for a 30 day free trial with GitHub Copilot today or request Copilot access from your enterprise admin. To access GitHub Copilot, an active GitHub Copilot license is required. You can read more about our business and individual offerings at github.com/features/copilot. Users holding a GitHub Copilot Individual subscription can utilize GitHub Copilot Chat in JetBrains, in addition to our code completion features, by clicking the Copilot Chat icon in the Right Tool Window Bar.

Owners of organizations with a Copilot Business subscription can decide whether to grant access to GitHub Copilot Chat. If your organization's administrator has given chat access permissions, you can initiate the use of our chat feature by clicking on the Copilot Chat icon in the Right Tool Window Bar.

Supported languages, IDEs and framework

GitHub Copilot works on any language, including Java, PHP, Python, JavaScript, Ruby, Go, C#, or C++. Because it's been trained on languages in public repositories, it works for most popular languages, libraries and frameworks. It's also integrated into your editor, and fast enough to use as you type.

What can you do with GitHub Copilot?

GitHub Copilot offers numerous possibilities, serving as your comprehensive coding assistance and guiding you throughout your coding journey from start to finish. Here are a few use cases to illustrate its value.

  • Through our code completion features, you can autocomplete your code block, convert comments to code, create unit tests and much more using your preferred language.
  • Through our chat features, you can ask coding-specific queries, receive code explanations, generate unit tests, refactor your code, and much more

Data and telemetry

The GitHub Copilot Extension for JetBrains IDEs collects usage data and sends it to Microsoft to help improve our products and services. Read our privacy statement to learn more. This data collection can be disabled at any time through the extension settings.

Privacy

Please refer to our Privacy Statement to learn about the data we collect, how we use it, and the controls available to you.

FAQ

Got a question? We probably have the answers. Check our FAQ.

Trusted by Developers Everyday

  • "This is the single most mind-blowing application of machine learning I've ever seen." - Mike Krieger // Co-founder, Instagram

  • "GitHub Copilot works shockingly well. I will never develop software without it again." - Lars Gyrup Brink Nielsen

  • "I was stunned when I started writing Clojure with GitHub Copilot and it filled an idiomatic namespace require, just like I was going to write it." - Gunnika Batra // Senior Analyst

  • "Trying to code in an unfamiliar language by googling everything is like navigating a foreign country with just a phrasebook. Using GitHub Copilot is like hiring an interpreter." - Harri Edwards // Open AI

Moreover, the numbers speak for themselves

Research has found GitHub Copilot helps developers code faster, focus on solving bigger problems, stay in the flow longer, and feel more fulfilled with their work.

  • 74% of developers are able to focus on more satisfying work
  • 88% feel more productive
  • 96% of developers are faster with repetitive tasks

Copilot License Terms

idea-plugin.name: Windsurf Plugin for Python, JS, Java, Go...
idea-plugin.description:
Windsurf Plugin

Windsurf is the modern coding superpower, a free code acceleration toolkit built on cutting edge AI technology. Currently, Windsurf Plugin provides code completion in over 70+ languages, with lightning fast speeds and state-of-the-art suggestion quality.

There are many parts of the modern coding workflow that are boring, tedious, or frustrating, from regurgitating boilerplate to poring through StackOverflow. Recent advances in AI allow us to eliminate these parts, making it seamless to turn your ideas into code. With easy integration into all JetBrains IDEs and a less than 2 minute installation process, you can focus on being the best software developer, not the best code monkey.

With the Windsurf plugin, you get:

  • Unlimited single and multi-line code completions forever
  • Introducing the flow evolution of Chat, Cascade: no need to leave your IDE to ChatGPT, and use convenient suggestions such as Generate Docstring and Explain
  • Cascade's agentic capabilities unlock a new level of collaboration between AI and human, making it the ultimate partner for complex coding workflows.
  • Context Awareness Engine: Windsurf's Context-Awareness Engine integrates with all of your SCMs to build an unparalleled understanding of your codebase, giving you personalized suggestions that result in a 38% increase in code acceptance.
  • Tools: Cascade's tools include making edits, adding files, grep, listing files in a directory, code execution and a number of proprietary tools that have received press coverage.
  • Support for 70+ programming languages: Javascript, Python, Typescript, PHP, Go, Java, C, C++, Rust, Ruby, and more
  • Support through our Discord Community

Join millions of other developers who are using the Windsurf plugin for free to accelerate their software iteration process, improve their code quality and consistency, reduce the number of code review iterations, accelerate developer onboarding, and keep them in their flow state. Want to learn more? Check out our FAQ.

Your New Autocomplete Superpowers

Use Natural Language

Need to make changes in an unfamiliar language or codebase? Instead of spending hours learning all of the syntactical and stylistic details, type out comments in natural language and let Windsurf get the job done.

Minimize Boilerplate Coding

Sometimes feel like a code monkey copy-pasting and modifying boilerplate code over and over again? Let Windsurf handle writing the repetitive work so that you can stay in the coding flow state, generating code faster than you can type.

Find and Use APIs

Spend too much time searching for API endpoints for a task or their signatures to properly interact with them? Windsurf has seen thousands of different API calls and can insert them properly to match your needs, without ever leaving the IDE.

Unit Test Generation

Know that unit tests are important but find writing them mind-numbing? Let Windsurf autogenerate test cases for you, making sure you never miss a pesky edge case. Test-driven development just got a whole lot easier.

Your New Cascade Superpowers

Generate

Cascade can generate whole functions and applications for you with simple natural language prompting and constraints.

Explain

Diving into a foreign codebase? With the push of a button, our assistant will explain everything you need to know.

Support, Feedback, and Community

We are actively working on improving the quality of the extension. Please feel free to report any issues, suggestions, or exciting / interesting suggestions in our Discord.



We hope you enjoy the Windsurf Plugin, your modern coding superpower!

idea-plugin.name: SpringDocHelper
idea-plugin.description:
SpringDocHelper is an IntelliJ IDEA plugin designed for Spring REST API documentation. It enables developers to quickly view, copy, and export API documentation in multiple formats (HTML, JSON, Markdown, cURL), generate test cases, and provides MCP Server support for AI assistants to interact with your Spring projects.

Features

  • Mouse Hover Documentation — Quick hints for class, field, response, params, and method
  • Smart Type Inference — Object and generic return type inference
  • Gutter Icons — HTTP method icons (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) with copy operations and test case generation
  • Search Everywhere — Double-shift to search APIs with wildcard, regex, case-sensitive, and HTTP method filtering
  • Swagger Support — Swagger documentation parsing
  • Optimized Caching — Reduced memory usage with efficient caching logic
  • MCP Service — MCP Server for AI assistants to search and query API interfaces

MCP Service

SpringDocHelper supports MCP (Model Context Protocol), allowing AI assistants (Claude, Cursor, Trae, etc.) to interact directly with your Spring projects.

Configuration

Add the following configuration to your MCP-enabled AI tool:

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "SpringDocHelper": {
      "url": "http://localhost:18080"
    }
  }
}

Available Tools

After starting IDEA, the MCP service automatically starts on port 18080:

ToolDescription
getProjectsGet a list of all open projects
searchApiByKeywordSearch APIs by keyword (URL, name, or remark)
getApiForUrlAndMethodGet API details by URL and HTTP method
getApiByIdGet complete API JSON Schema by Position ID
generateCodePrompt template for generating client code

Usage Examples

AI assistants can help you through the MCP service:

  • 🔍 Search for all API interfaces in your project
  • 📋 Get detailed parameter and return value definitions
  • 💻 Generate frontend calling code based on interface documentation
  • 📚 Automatically generate API documentation

idea-plugin.name: Augment: Coding Agent Built for Large, Complex Codebases

✨ Key Features

  • 🔌 Hot-Plugging Support: Install and uninstall plugins on-the-fly without IDE restart, significantly improving development efficiency.
  • 📦 Drag & Drop Installation: Simply drag plugin files into the panel for instant installation, with right-click context menu for easy uninstallation.
  • 🚀 Multi-Language Development: Full support for Java, Kotlin, and JavaScript plugin development with rapid debugging capabilities.
  • 📂 Customizable Storage: Configure your preferred plugin installation directory with automatic isolation by JetBrains product and version.
  • 📋 Integrated Logging: Built-in logging console with soft-wrap output for easy troubleshooting during development and runtime.
  • 🤖 Agent Chat: Built-in agent entry with streaming output, reasoning blocks, and collapsible tool logs.
  • 📊 Token Usage: Agent chat shows per-session token consumption in K units near the prompt selector, with input/output and last-request details in the tooltip.
  • 🧭 Provider Manager: Multi-provider configuration (OpenAI/Anthropic) with base URL, headers, and proxy.
  • 🎛️ Provider Selector: Provider selector with model lists fetched from each provider.
  • 🧩 Provider Templates: OpenAI-compatible provider types and vendor templates with preset endpoints and parameter hints for easier third-party model integration.
  • 🌍 Broad Provider Coverage: Built-in templates for OpenAI, DeepSeek, GLM, OpenRouter, SiliconFlow, DashScope, Gemini, Ollama, and Anthropic-style integrations.
  • 🧰 Function Calling: Aggregated plugin and system tools with unique identifiers to avoid name conflicts.
  • 🧩 Structured MCP CLI Tool: A single cli tool covers MCP server configuration, connection tests, resource reads, and tool calls, with a doc command returning the full MCP command reference.
  • 🔌 MCP Client: Manage and call external MCP servers over stdio/SSE/streamable HTTP on the official MCP Java SDK, with persisted server configs and connection testing.
  • 📦 Plugin Ops: Local/URL/batch install and uninstall tool calls for faster workflows.
  • 🧪 Dev Testing: Developer panel can expose current plugin instance tool calls for debugging.
  • 📎 Attachment Workflow: Attach local files and images to chat, with model-aware capability checks, clipboard support, and optimized upload handling.
  • 🖼️ Multimodal Inputs: Per-model capability switches for image, audio, video, and file attachments, with automatic text extraction for readable files.
  • 🧠 Skill Management: Import or edit local SKILL.md skills, attach them per session, and expose skill resources directly to the agent runtime.
  • 📚 Skill Resources: references/examples/scripts resources can be mounted into agent sessions and read through dedicated resource tools.
  • 🔗 Skill Runtime Integration: Skills share the same runtime Toolkit as built-in and plugin tools, keeping SkillBox tool groups aligned with the active agent session.
  • 🎚️ Model Tuning: Configure per-model streaming, multimodal capabilities, and advanced OpenAI/Anthropic parameters from a dedicated tuning panel.
  • 🧾 Parameter Guidance: Store provider-level default and recommended parameters to make model configuration more repeatable across sessions.
  • 💾 Session Persistence: Restore sessions, enabled skills, draft attachments, and active context across projects for long-running conversations.
  • 🧠 Runtime State: Session runtime can preserve memory, tool state, and planning context for more consistent multi-step workflows.
  • ⚙️ Agent Limits: Configurable max tool iterations and tool result size limits to prevent oversized context.
  • 📂 File Listing: jtools_list_files supports maxEntries with truncation metadata.
  • 🌐 HTTP WebFetch: WebFetch works as a direct HTTP client with GET/POST/PUT/DELETE/PATCH/HEAD/OPTIONS, query params, headers, raw bodies, form params, timeout control, and Web tool proxy settings.
  • 🧭 AI Browser Tools: Browser tools can open a temporary JCEF browser session, run visible or hidden after user choice, read pages, observe element refs, click, type, wait, capture screenshots, and destroy the dynamic tool window when finished.
  • 🔧 Dynamic SDK Management: Automatic SDK dependency resolution for IDEA, Maven, and Gradle projects.
  • 🌐 Web Integration: JavaScript plugins enable flexible web page integration with custom development options.
  • 🪟 Multi-Instance Support: Open multiple instances of the same plugin simultaneously with proper resource management.
  • 📐 Split Panel View: Support for left-right panel splitting for better workspace organization.
  • 🎯 JetBrains Family Support: Compatible with the entire JetBrains IDE family including IntelliJ IDEA, WebStorm, PyCharm, and more.

🎯 Use Cases

  • Rapid prototyping and testing of IntelliJ plugins
  • Creating lightweight utility tools without full plugin overhead
  • Developing custom web-based tools integrated into the IDE
  • Building team-specific development tools with easy distribution
  • Connecting private or third-party model services through vendor templates without rebuilding the plugin workflow

🚀 Getting Started

  1. Install JTools from the JetBrains Marketplace
  2. Open the JTools panel from the right sidebar
  3. Drag and drop your plugin files or use the built-in development tools
  4. Start developing with hot-reload support!
📖 帮助文档 | 🐛 问题反馈 | 📦 版本发布

🛠️ JTools - 轻量级插件容器

JTools 是一个专为 JetBrains IDE 设计的强大且轻量级的插件管理容器。它通过提供热插拔功能彻底改变了插件开发体验，允许开发者在不重启 IDE 的情况下安装、更新和卸载插件。

✨ 核心特性

  • 🔌 热插拔支持：无需重启 IDE 即可即时安装和卸载插件，显著提升开发效率。
  • 📦 拖拽安装：只需将插件文件拖入面板即可立即安装，右键菜单轻松卸载。
  • 🚀 多语言开发：全面支持 Java、Kotlin 和 JavaScript 插件开发，具备快速调试能力。
  • 📂 自定义存储：可配置首选的插件安装目录，按 JetBrains 产品和版本自动隔离。
  • 📋 集成日志：内置日志控制台，支持软换行输出，便于开发和运行时故障排查。
  • 🤖 智能体对话：内置智能体入口，支持流式输出、推理块展示与工具调用折叠日志。
  • 📊 Token 消耗：智能体对话在提示词选择器旁展示当前会话 Token 累计消耗，按 K 单位显示，并在提示中提供输入/输出与上次请求明细。
  • 🧭 供应方管理：多供应方配置（OpenAI/Anthropic），支持 Base URL、请求头、代理。
  • 🎛️ 供应方选择：对话中可选供应方，并维护供应方级别模型列表与默认模型。
  • 🧩 供应方模板：支持 OpenAI Compatible 接入类型与厂商模板，预置端点和参数建议，便于接入第三方模型服务。
  • 🌍 广泛供应方覆盖：内置 OpenAI、DeepSeek、GLM、OpenRouter、SiliconFlow、DashScope、Gemini、Ollama、Anthropic 等接入模板。
  • 🧰 函数调用：聚合插件与系统工具并增加唯一标识，避免名称冲突。
  • 🧩 结构化 MCP CLI 工具：单一 cli 工具聚合 MCP 服务配置、连接测试、资源读取和工具调用，并通过 doc 一次性返回全部 MCP 命令参数说明。
  • 🔌 MCP 客户端：基于官方 MCP Java SDK 管理并调用外部 MCP 服务，支持 stdio/SSE/streamable HTTP 传输，服务配置持久化并可连接测试。
  • 📦 插件管理：支持本地/URL/批量安装与卸载的工具调用。
  • 🧪 开发测试：开发面板可暴露当前插件实例的工具调用用于调试。
  • 📎 附件工作流：对话支持本地文件和图片附件，具备模型能力校验、剪贴板支持与上传优化。
  • 🖼️ 多模态输入：可按模型开启图片、音频、视频、文件附件能力，并对可读文件自动抽取文本上下文。
  • 🧠 Skills 管理：支持导入或编辑本地 SKILL.md 技能，按会话挂载，并将技能资源直接暴露给智能体运行时。
  • 📚 Skills 资源：references/examples/scripts 等资源文件可随技能挂载，并通过专用资源工具读取。
  • 🔗 Skill 运行时集成：Skills 与内置工具、插件工具共享同一个运行时 Toolkit，使 SkillBox 工具组与当前智能体会话保持一致。
  • 🎚️ 模型调优：提供独立模型调优面板，可配置流式输出、多模态能力以及 OpenAI/Anthropic 高级参数。
  • 🧾 参数建议：支持保存供应方默认参数与推荐参数，让模型配置在不同会话中更容易复用。
  • 💾 会话持久化：跨项目保留会话、启用的技能、草稿附件与当前上下文，适合长会话持续协作。
  • 🧠 运行时状态：会话运行时可保留记忆、工具状态与规划上下文，适合多步骤连续任务。
  • ⚙️ 智能体限制：可配置最大工具调用轮次并限制工具返回长度，避免超大上下文。
  • 📂 文件列表：jtools_list_files 支持 maxEntries 并返回截断信息。
  • 🌐 HTTP WebFetch：WebFetch 改为直接 HTTP 客户端，支持 GET/POST/PUT/DELETE/PATCH/HEAD/OPTIONS、查询参数、请求头、原始请求体、表单参数、超时控制和 Web 工具代理。
  • 🧭 AI 浏览器工具：浏览器工具可创建临时 JCEF 浏览器会话，在用户选择后显示或隐藏运行，支持读取页面、观察元素 ref、点击、输入、等待、截图，并在完成后销毁动态工具窗口。
  • 🔧 动态 SDK 管理：自动解析 IDEA、Maven 和 Gradle 项目的 SDK 依赖。
  • 🌐 Web 集成：JavaScript 插件支持灵活的网页集成和自定义开发。
  • 🪟 多实例支持：支持同时打开同一插件的多个实例，并具备完善的资源管理。
  • 📐 分割面板视图：支持左右面板分割，更好地组织工作空间。
  • 🎯 JetBrains 全家桶支持：兼容整个 JetBrains IDE 系列，包括 IntelliJ IDEA、WebStorm、PyCharm 等。

🎯 应用场景

  • IntelliJ 插件的快速原型开发和测试
  • 创建轻量级实用工具，无需完整插件开销
  • 开发集成到 IDE 中的自定义 Web 工具
  • 构建团队专用开发工具，便于分发
  • 通过厂商模板快速接入私有或第三方模型服务，而不必重建整套插件工作流

🚀 快速开始

  1. 从 JetBrains Marketplace 安装 JTools
  2. 从右侧边栏打开 JTools 面板
  3. 拖放插件文件或使用内置开发工具
  4. 开始享受热重载开发体验！
idea-plugin.change-notes:
🚀 Version v1.1.5.7

Latest Release / 最新版本

  • 🎛️ Model-Level History Token Ratio: History character-to-token estimation is now configured per model through the existing execution_params.history_token_ratio JSON field without adding a database column.
  • 🧮 Coding Context Budget Alignment: Coding sessions read the ratio from model_snapshot.execution_params.history_token_ratio for history estimates, context budgeting, occupancy metrics, and compaction estimates.
  • ♻️ Legacy Compatibility: Older models and session snapshots without the field use 0.4; ordinary Agent history also follows the active model's configured ratio and defaults to 0.4 when unset.
  • 🖥️ Unified Model Management: Web, Swing, and CLI model management support editing, saving, and displaying the ratio, while the field is excluded from OpenAI/Anthropic request bodies.
  • 📍 Stable Timeline Expansion: Expanding reasoning, tool, and SubAgent details preserves the target event position, preventing scroll drift when details load or content height changes.
  • 🖼️ Multimodal Resource Path Support: view_* resource tools now accept workspace-relative paths, ordinary absolute paths, and IntelliJ VFS URLs such as file://, jar://, and jrt://, so images and other resources can be loaded correctly for resource-Agent analysis while ordinary project-file tools retain their workspace boundaries.
  • 🧹 Global Setting Retired from Runtime: Existing message.history_token_ratio data is retained, but it is no longer read or shown in global settings.
  • ✅ Validation: Plugin build, targeted Kotlin tests, and Agent Web production build pass.
  • 🎛️ 模型级历史 Token 字符比例：历史消息字符到 Token 的估算比例改为按模型配置，复用已有 execution_params.history_token_ratio JSON 字段，不新增数据库列。
  • 🧮 编码会话上下文预算对齐：编码会话从 model_snapshot.execution_params.history_token_ratio 读取比例，统一影响历史估算、上下文预算、占用统计和压缩估算。
  • ♻️ 旧数据兼容：旧模型和旧会话快照缺少字段时使用 0.4；普通 Agent 也按当前模型配置的比例估算，未配置时默认使用 0.4。
  • 🖥️ 模型管理入口统一：Web、Swing 和 CLI 模型管理支持配置、保存和回显该比例，且不会将其发送到 OpenAI/Anthropic 请求体。
  • 📍 对话展开位置稳定：展开推理、工具和 SubAgent 详情时保持目标事件位置，避免详情加载或内容高度变化导致滚动漂移。
  • 🖼️ 多模态资源路径支持：view_* 资源工具支持工作区相对路径、普通绝对路径及 file://、jar://、jrt:// 等 IntelliJ VFS 协议路径，图片等资源可正确读取并交给资源 Agent 分析；普通项目文件工具仍保持工作区边界。
  • 🧹 停止读取全局比例：保留已有 message.history_token_ratio 数据，但运行时和全局设置页不再读取或展示。
  • ✅ 验证：插件构建、目标 Kotlin 测试和 Agent Web 生产构建均通过。

🚀 Version v1.1.5.6

Previous Release / 上一版本

  • 🛡️ Strict Coding-Session Configuration: Project sessions now require project_path, and its canonical path must match cwd; missing project paths no longer fall back silently.
  • 🔒 Project Session Isolation: Session queries consistently limit coding-session CRUD to session_type=coding records with visibility=project, preventing unrelated sessions from being read or changed.
  • 📂 Canonical Project Visibility: Session listing normalizes project paths before filtering, so a session is shown only in its owning project while equivalent path representations match reliably.
  • 🧭 Consistent Session Boundaries: Session lookup, update, and deletion reuse the same project-session constraints, keeping management behavior aligned with project visibility.
  • 📦 Version Metadata Sync: Bumped the plugin release to v1.1.5.6 and aligned SDK helper version metadata to 1156.
  • 🛡️ 编码会话配置严格校验：项目会话必须包含 project_path，且其规范化路径必须与 cwd 一致；缺少项目路径时不再静默回退。
  • 🔒 项目会话隔离：会话查询统一限定为 session_type=coding 且 visibility=project 的项目会话，避免无关会话被读取或修改。
  • 📂 会话可见性路径规范化：会话列表过滤前统一规范化项目路径，确保会话只在所属项目中显示，并可靠匹配等价的路径表示。
  • 🧭 会话边界统一：会话获取、更新和删除复用同一套项目会话约束，使会话管理行为与项目可见性规则保持一致。
  • 📦 版本元数据同步：插件版本号升级到 v1.1.5.6，并同步 SDK Helper 版本元数据到 1156。

🚀 Version v1.1.5.5

Previous Release / 上一版本

  • ♻️ Coding Session Rewrite: Rebuilt the chat dialog on the awake-claw coding-session path. Message events, processing tasks, append items, attachments, and context compaction replace the old message-card queue. This is a major version cut: no migration, no compatibility layer, no fallback. The plugin automatically rebuilds the database when it detects an older schema version; data in the old database is not retained.
  • 🧩 Coding Environment Capability Pack: Sessions bind a coding environment instead of treating Agent as the model source. System prompt, builtin tools, plugin functions, skills, multimodal view_* tools, and the compaction Agent all come from the environment. Creating a session requires an environment first.
  • 🎛️ Composer Alignment: Model, reasoning, attachments, and file context sit at the bottom-left of the input box; Sessions stays on the top bar and other management entries live in the top-right overflow menu. Advanced params flatten like the model manager, with additional JSON params shown directly. Context metrics appear under the composer.
  • 💬 Timeline Layout: The dialog is full width. Model replies stay left at 95% width; user bubbles stay right, grow with content, and wrap at 95%. Theme-aware Element Plus icons sit on a highlighted vertical track, with looser spacing and larger type.
  • 📝 Markdown and Code Blocks: Replies use CodeMirror/Lezer highlighting. HTML blocks can preview in an iframe. Download opens the IDE save dialog and sanitizes file names for Windows/macOS/Linux.
  • 🛠️ Runtime Tooling: Plugin functions register the same way as Agent management. web_fetch and bash output limits read global settings. MCP stays behind the cli tool. Distillation UI is removed; only compaction remains.
  • 🗜️ Async Context Compaction: Compact starts in the background and reports success or failure as timeline notices. Sending is blocked until a notice arrives; compact is blocked while a turn is processing or queued. Restarted in-flight compaction is marked failed so send does not stay locked.
  • ⚡ Streaming Performance: Deltas patch the current event instead of replacing the whole host state. The conversation auto-follows the bottom like awake-claw, and stops following when the user scrolls up.
  • 📎 Attachments: Text-only models receive file metadata (name, type, size, path) so they can call view_image. Timeline, processing, and queued cards preview images via data URLs. File context sends path and line range only, not selected text.
  • 🐛 Dialog Stability: Streaming replies and reasoning persist into events; refresh no longer drops history; compact/send/save run off the EDT; an empty database renders the dialog instead of crashing; global sessions use ~/.jtools/global.
  • 📚 Skill Create and Import: Skills can be created with a name and description, or imported from a directory that contains SKILL.md files. Nested skill folders are copied into ~/.jtools/skills.
  • 📦 Version Metadata Sync: Bumped the plugin release to v1.1.5.4 and aligned SDK helper version metadata to 1154
  • ♻️ 编码会话重写：对话链路按 awake-claw 编码会话重建，消息事件、任务、追加、附件和上下文压缩替换旧消息卡队列。这是大版本切断：不迁移、不兼容、不降级。插件检测到旧数据库版本时会自动重建数据库，旧数据库中的数据不会保留。
  • 🧩 编码环境能力包：会话绑定编码环境，不再把 Agent 当模型真源。系统提示词、内置工具、插件函数、技能、多模态 view_* 和压缩 Agent 都由环境提供。建会话必须先有环境。
  • 🎛️ 输入框与布局对齐：模型、推理、附件、文件上下文放在输入框左下角；会话入口留在顶栏，其余管理入口收进右上角二级菜单。高级参数与模型管理对齐，附加 JSON 参数直接铺开。上下文指标出现在输入框下方。
  • 💬 时间线布局：对话框全宽。模型回复靠左 95%；用户气泡靠右，随内容撑开，最大 95% 后软换行。图标改用 Element Plus 并适配亮暗主题，叠在高亮竖线上，行距和字号已拉开。
  • 📝 Markdown 与代码块：回复使用 CodeMirror/Lezer 高亮。HTML 代码块可 iframe 预览。下载走 IDE 保存对话框，并按 Windows/macOS/Linux 清洗文件名。
  • 🛠️ 运行时工具：插件函数按 Agent 管理页同一套方式注册。web_fetch 与 bash 输出上限读取全局设置。MCP 仍走 cli。蒸馏相关 UI 已移除，只保留压缩。
  • 🗜️ 异步上下文压缩：压缩在后台执行，成功或失败都以时间线通知呈现。未出通知前不能发送；模型处理中或排队中不能压缩。重启时未完成的压缩会标失败，避免发送一直锁死。
  • ⚡ 流式性能：增量只补当前事件，不再每次整包替换宿主状态。对话滚动按 awake-claw 贴底跟随，用户上翻后停止跟随。
  • 📎 附件：纯文本模型会收到文件名、类型、大小和路径等元数据，可通过 view_image 读取。时间线、处理中和排队卡片用 data URL 预览图片。文件上下文只发送路径和行号，不发送选中文本。
  • 🐛 对话框稳定性：流式回复和推理会写入事件；刷新不再丢历史；压缩/发送/保存离开 EDT；空库能打开对话框而不是崩溃；全局会话工作区为 ~/.jtools/global。
  • 📚 技能创建与导入：新增技能需要名称和描述。导入技能会从所选目录递归发现包含 SKILL.md 的技能，并复制到 ~/.jtools/skills。
  • 📦 版本元数据同步：插件版本号升级到 v1.1.5.4，并同步 SDK Helper 版本元数据到 1154

🚀 Version v1.1.5.3

  • 🐛 User Shell Environment Fix: The bash tool previously ran commands through a login shell, which loads .zprofile/.bash_profile but never .zshrc/.bashrc; tools managed by sdkman, nvm, fnm or gvm were therefore missing, or resolved to a global build instead of the version selected by the manager
  • 🔄 Resolved Environment Caching: The full user environment is resolved once through an interactive login shell on first command execution and reused afterwards, so rc initialisation is not repeated per command; a failed resolution is not cached and is retried on the next call
  • 🧭 Per-Shell Probe Strategy: How the user environment is dumped is now declared by each shell: zsh/bash read their rc files, PowerShell loads $PROFILE for probing while command execution keeps -NoProfile, and cmd plus POSIX sh are not probed because they have no reliable user configuration mechanism
  • ♻️ Environment Refresh Parameter: The bash tool accepts a new refresh_env parameter to re-resolve the environment before execution when a command reports command not found, or after the user installs a tool or edits shell configuration, without restarting the IDE
  • 📝 Description Responsibility Split: The tool description now covers only tool identity, the shell in use and capability boundaries, while all parameter usage contracts live in their own parameter descriptions
  • 📦 Version Metadata Sync: Bumped the plugin release to v1.1.5.3 and aligned SDK helper version metadata to 1153
  • 🐛 用户 Shell 环境丢失修复：bash 工具此前以 login shell 执行命令，只加载 .zprofile/.bash_profile 而不读 .zshrc/.bashrc，导致 sdkman、nvm、fnm、gvm 等版本管理器配置的工具找不到，或拿到全局版本而非版本管理器选定的版本
  • 🔄 用户环境解析与缓存：首次执行命令时用交互式登录 shell 解析一次完整用户环境并缓存复用，后续命令直接注入，不重复执行 rc 初始化；解析失败不写入缓存，下次调用自动重试
  • 🧭 按 Shell 声明探测策略：环境探测方式改由各 shell 自行声明：zsh/bash 读取 rc 文件，PowerShell 加载 $PROFILE（执行命令时仍保持 -NoProfile），cmd 与 POSIX sh 无可靠机制因而不探测
  • ♻️ 环境刷新参数：bash 工具新增 refresh_env 参数，命令报 command not found 或用户刚安装工具、刚修改 shell 配置时可强制重新解析环境后执行，无需重启 IDE
  • 📝 工具描述职责分离：工具描述只说明工具身份、所用 shell 和能力边界，参数使用约定全部下沉到各自的参数描述
  • 📦 版本元数据同步：插件版本号升级到 v1.1.5.3，并同步 SDK Helper 版本元数据到 1153

🚀 Version v1.1.5.2

Previous Release / 上一版本

  • 📎 Append Attachments While Running: The append-message dialog now accepts selected or pasted images and files while a conversation is active; attachments can be sent alone or with text and follow the actual Provider message order into model context and restored history
  • 🖼️ Append Attachment Presentation: Appended-message cards show image thumbnails and file metadata, support image preview or opening files in the IDE, and provide attachment deduplication, removal and pre-send validation
  • 🛑 Layered Stop Semantics Restored: When tools are running, Stop cancels only the active tools and returns a “cancelled by user” result so the model can continue the turn; the whole model response is terminated only when no tool is active
  • 📐 Strict Chat Width Containment: Markdown, tables, code blocks, long links, tool details and appended messages stay inside the message area through wrapping or local scrolling instead of stretching the chat layout
  • 📦 Version Metadata Sync: Bumped the plugin release to v1.1.5.2 and aligned SDK helper version metadata to 1152
  • 📎 运行中追加附件：进行中的对话支持在追加消息弹窗中选择或粘贴图片与文件；附件与文字可独立或组合发送，并按真实 Provider 消息顺序进入模型上下文和会话历史
  • 🖼️ 追加附件展示与打开：追加消息卡片展示图片缩略图和文件信息，支持点击预览图片或在 IDE 中打开文件；弹窗支持附件去重、移除和发送前检查
  • 🛑 停止层级语义恢复：有工具执行时停止按钮只取消当前工具，并将“用户手动取消”结果返回模型继续本轮对话；没有工具执行时才终止整个模型回复
  • 📐 对话内容宽度约束：Markdown、表格、代码块、长链接、工具详情及追加消息统一限制在消息区域内，超宽内容改为换行或局部滚动，避免撑开对话布局
  • 📦 版本元数据同步：插件版本号升级到 v1.1.5.2，并同步 SDK Helper 版本元数据到 1152

🚀 Version v1.1.5.1

Earlier Release / 更早版本

  • 💬 Append Messages While Running: Active chat queue items now accept additional user messages without stopping the current model request or creating another queued turn; each append is delivered as an independent user message
  • 🔁 Correct Loop Continuation: A provider loop now continues when either tool calls or pending append messages exist, so a tool-free model response no longer terminates before queued appends are delivered
  • 🧾 Exact Append History: Model logs persist append metadata together with the actual provider message order, preserving the sequence of tool calls, tool results and appended user messages when history is restored
  • 🛑 Cancellation Boundary: Stopping a turn cancels model and tool requests, atomically closes the append channel and removes undelivered append messages
  • 🎨 Collapsible Append Display: User cards provide group-level and per-message expansion, internal scrolling for large lists and long content, and correctly formatted timestamps without leaking fractional-second digits
  • 📦 Version Metadata Sync: Bumped the plugin release to v1.1.5.1 and aligned SDK helper version metadata to 1151
  • 💬 运行中追加消息：进行中的对话队列项支持继续追加用户消息；追加内容按独立用户消息投递，无需停止当前模型请求或重新排队
  • 🔁 工具循环继续条件修复：下一轮由“存在工具调用或待处理追加消息”共同决定；即使模型未调用工具，只要有追加消息也会继续请求模型
  • 🧾 追加顺序精确持久化：模型日志记录追加消息元数据及实际 Provider 消息顺序，恢复历史时保留工具调用、工具结果和追加消息的真实先后关系
  • 🛑 取消边界收敛：停止会话时同步取消模型与工具请求，并原子关闭追加入口、清空尚未投递的追加消息
  • 🎨 追加消息折叠展示：用户消息卡片提供追加消息总览和单条两级展开/收起；大量消息及超长正文在区域内滚动，并修正小数秒被误显示为裸数字的问题
  • 📦 版本元数据同步：插件版本号升级到 v1.1.5.1，并同步 SDK Helper 版本元数据到 1151

🚀 Version v1.1.5.0

Previous Release / 上一版本

  • ✨ Chat Input Polish: A new "Polish" button in the chat composer runs a configured Agent over the current input and returns multiple candidate rewrites for preview and one-click fill-back
  • 🧩 Ephemeral Polish Tool: A virtual submit_polish_results tool is injected per polish run only; it never enters the global tool registry nor appears in Agent tool configuration
  • ⚙️ Select-type Global Settings: Global configuration gains a select field type, plus a new "Chat Polish Agent" option chosen from enabled Agents; leaving it unset hides the polish entry entirely
  • 🔁 Settings Apply Immediately: Saving global settings now notifies the chat panel to resync, so the polish entry appears or disappears without reopening the panel
  • 🎭 Polish Honours Agent Persona: The polish instruction now requires strict adherence to the Agent's role, capability profile and working method; the conflicting "varied styles" wording was removed so candidates differ only in wording and sentence structure
  • 📖 Full Result Review: Results use native Element Plus tabs plus a large preview pane (min(56vh,560px), internal scrolling, selectable text) with a character count in the footer; fill-back requires clicking "Apply to input" to prevent mis-taps
  • 🗂️ No Session Pollution: Polish runs are not written as session messages and never enter the chat queue; they are logged under the chat_polish type and remain traceable in model logs
  • ⚡ Non-blocking Cancellation: Cancelling runs on a background thread to avoid closing HTTP connections on the EDT and freezing the UI; running tasks can be interrupted at any time
  • 🛡️ Explicit Polish Failures: If the model does not call the submit tool as instructed, the run fails with a hint to check tool-call support instead of scraping the answer body for results
  • 📦 Version Metadata Sync: Bumped the plugin release to v1.1.5.0 and aligned SDK helper version metadata to 1150
  • ✨ 输入框润色：对话输入框新增「润色」按钮，调用指定 Agent 对当前输入内容生成多个候选版本，可预览后回填
  • 🧩 润色虚拟工具动态注册：新增 submit_polish_results 虚拟工具，仅在润色任务执行期间按次注入，不进入全局工具注册表，也不出现在 Agent 工具配置清单中
  • ⚙️ 全局设置支持下拉选项：全局配置项新增 select 类型，新增「输入框润色 Agent」配置，从已启用 Agent 中选择，默认「不启用」时对话界面不显示润色入口
  • 🔁 配置保存即时生效：全局设置保存后主动通知对话面板同步状态，润色入口无需重开面板即可出现或消失
  • 🎭 润色遵循 Agent 人格：润色指令改为要求严格遵循该 Agent 的角色设定、能力画像与工作方法，移除与人格冲突的「风格各异」措辞，多个候选只在用词句式上区别
  • 📖 润色结果完整查看：结果改为 Element Plus 原生标签页切换 + 大预览区（高度 min(56vh,560px)、内部滚动、文本可选中），底部显示当前方案字符数，需点击「应用到输入框」才回填，避免误触
  • 🗂️ 润色不污染会话历史：润色不写入会话消息、不进入对话队列，以 chat_polish 类型记录到模型日志，可在模型日志中追溯
  • ⚡ 润色中断不卡界面：取消动作放到后台线程执行，避免在 EDT 上关闭 HTTP 连接导致界面卡顿；运行中任务可随时中断
  • 🛡️ 润色失败显式暴露：模型未按约定调用提交工具时直接报错并提示检查该模型是否支持工具调用，不解析回答正文凑结果
  • 📦 版本元数据同步：插件版本号升级到 v1.1.5.0，并同步 SDK Helper 版本元数据到 1150

idea-plugin.name: Junie, the AI coding agent by JetBrains
idea-plugin.description:
Junie is an AI coding agent by JetBrains that handles tasks autonomously or in collaboration with a developer. Developers can either fully delegate routine tasks to Junie or partner with it on more complex ones


You think it, Junie makes it happen
Try it out in JetBrains IDEs and join our Discord to stay in touch

What Junie can do for you

Provide a seamless coding experience

Getting started with the AI agent is simple. Install it in your IDE and begin with small tasks that fit seamlessly into your workflow – no dramatic changes required. This approach ensures that your new way of working is empowering, not disruptive, whether you code in Java, Python, JavaScript, Go, etc.

Discover efficient solutions

Junie understands the structure, logic, and relationships in your code. When you delegate a task to the AI agent, it finds the right places to work, the right tools to use, and the best path forward.

Propose an execution plan

Once Junie has explored the project, it will provide a cohesive plan for completing the task. Junie uses Anthropic (Claude Sonnet) and OpenAI (GPT-5) LLMs for the best developer experience, both in coding and reasoning.

Adjust to the task at hand

Use Code mode to execute tasks, with Junie writing and testing the code for you. Switch to Ask mode, to pose questions, collaborate on plans, and brainstorm features and improvements.

Perform inspections you can rely on

When Junie updates your code, it uses the power of your IDE to make sure every change meets your standards. Built-in syntax and semantic checks keep your code clean, consistent, and production-ready. With AI Assistant, code completion, and other features, Junie offers a full AI experience in the IDE that you already trust.

Run tests to keep your project state green

Junie runs code and tests as needed to reduce warnings and compilation errors. After making changes, Junie verifies that everything runs smoothly so that you can focus on building instead of debugging.

Intelligent collaboration on complex tasks

Focus on the big picture while Junie takes care of the routine work. Review, refine, and stay in control. Junie’s here to support you.

idea-plugin.name: ClipCraft
idea-plugin.description:
ClipCraft - Professional Code Export for AI & Documentation

The ultimate IntelliJ plugin for exporting code to AI assistants, documentation, and team collaboration.

🚀 Key Features

  • ⚡ Super Simple: One-click "Copy for AI" - No dialogs, no configuration, instant results!
  • 8 Keyboard Shortcuts: Lightning-fast access to all features
  • Multiple Export Formats: Markdown, XML, JSON, HTML, Plain Text, ZIP archives
  • AI-Optimized: Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini optimized formats with token estimation
  • Smart Presets: AI/LLM, Documentation, Code Review, Full Project, Test Files
  • Export Options: Copy to clipboard, save to file, or export as ZIP
  • Advanced Filtering: Glob patterns, regex, .gitignore support, file size limits
  • Token Estimation: Know exactly how much context you're using
  • Smart Chunking: Automatically split large exports for AI context windows
  • Security: Secret detection and masking, PII warnings
  • Rich Metadata: Git info, timestamps, file statistics, table of contents
  • Customization: Line numbers, comment stripping, custom formatting
  • Quick Actions: One-click export current file or entire project

📋 Usage

  • Right-click context menus: Available in Project View, Editor, Editor Tabs, Changes View, Structure View, Favorites, and more
  • Main menu: ClipCraft menu in the top menu bar
  • Tools menu: Tools → ClipCraft
  • Keyboard shortcuts:
    • ⚡ Ctrl+Alt+C: Copy File for AI (Simple, no dialogs!)
    • ⚡ Ctrl+Alt+Shift+C: Copy Project for AI (Simple, no dialogs!)
    • Ctrl+Alt+M: Copy as Markdown
    • Ctrl+Alt+E: Export Current File
    • Ctrl+Alt+Shift+E: Export Project
    • Ctrl+Alt+P: Export with Preset
    • Ctrl+Alt+F: Export to File
    • Ctrl+Alt+Z: Export as ZIP
  • Settings: Configure presets in Settings → Tools → ClipCraft Settings

💡 Perfect For

  • Sharing code context with AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini)
  • Creating documentation from code
  • Code review preparation
  • Team collaboration and knowledge sharing
  • Project analysis and audits

idea-plugin.name: CalEx-JavaAI : AI Coding Assistant
idea-plugin.description:
CalEx-JavaAI : AI Coding Assistant :
CalEx-JavaAI AI代码助手 ：
Not just an AI Coding generation tool, but also an Agentic Coding Platform,
不仅仅是一个AI代码生成工具，而且是一个智能体编码平台，
it offers guided development,assists in requirement refinement and function design,
它提供指导开发，协助需求细化和功能设计，
and generates complete project source code accurately.
并准确生成完整的项目源代码。


Four Major Product Features:


产品四大功能板块：


Intelligent Guidance, SQL Chat, AI Toolbox, Intelligent Conversation
智能引导、SQL chat、AI工具箱、智能会话

Section One: Intelligent Guidance


第一板块：智能引导


Five-step intelligent guidance, one-click generation of complete project code.
五步智能引导、一键生成完整工程代码。
1. Requirement Understanding: Clarify core project or product requirements,
and intelligently break them down into executable tasks.
1、需求理解：明确项目或产品的核心需求，并将这些需求智能拆解为可执行的任务项。
2. Interface Design: Based on understood requirements, design clear and efficient interfaces.
2、设计接口：基于已理解的需求，设计清晰、高效的接口。
3. Table Structure Design: Create efficient data table structures based on requirements
and interface design.
3、表结构设计：根据需求及接口设计，创建高效的数据表结构。
4. Processing Logic (Interface): Generate business logic and implementation steps for each interface.
4、处理逻辑(接口)：为每个接口生成业务逻辑及其实现步骤。
5. Generate Source Code: One-click generation of a complete project package, including
Java project-level source code, SQL scripts, functions, configuration files, etc.
5、生成源码：一键生成包括Java工程级源代码、SQL脚本、函数、配置文件等在内的完整项目包。

Section Two: SQL Chat


第二板块：SQL chat


Utilizes natural language processing technology to convert
natural language questions into SQL queries.
用自然语言处理技术将自然语言问题转化为SQL查询。
Natural Language Query: Users can ask questions in natural
language, which will be automatically converted into SQL queries.

MCP Service:


MCP服务：


MCP refers to the Model Context Protocol. It is an open standard protocol,
and its main goals are: Standardized Connection: Providing a standardized way
for Large Language Models (LLMs) to connect and use external tools, data sources,
or systems (such as databases, APIs, software, etc.).

MCP指的是 Model Context Protocol（模型上下文协议）。是一种开放标准协议，
它的主要目标是：标准化连接：为大语言模型（LLM）提供一种标准化的方式，
来连接和使用外部的工具、数据源或系统（比如数据库、API、软件等）。
Extending Model Capabilities: Through this standardized interface, it can break through
the limitations of its own knowledge base and training data, obtain real-time information,
and perform specific operations (such as sending emails, querying orders),
thereby significantly enhancing its functions and application scenarios.

扩展模型能力：通过这种标准化接口，可以突破自身知识库和训练数据的限制，
获取实时信息、执行特定操作（如发送邮件、查询订单），从而显著提升其功能和应用场景。

Promoting Ecosystem Development: As an open standard, MCP aims to make it easier
for different developers and platforms to develop and integrate plugins or tools for LLMs,
lowering the development threshold and promoting the prosperity of the Agent ecosystem.
促进生态发展：作为一个开放标准，MCP 旨在让不同开发者和平台更容易地为 LLM 开发和集成插件或工具，
降低开发门槛，推动智能体（Agent）生态的繁荣。
You can understand MCP as a "universal adapter" or "connector standard",
which allows large models to more conveniently and consistently "call" the functions
of the external world, thereby becoming more powerful and practical.
您可以将 MCP 理解为一个“通用适配器”或“连接器标准”，
它让大模型能更方便、更一致地“调用”外部世界的功能，从而变得更加强大和实用。
At the same time, you can choose to access existing MCP services,
or develop your own exclusive MCP services according to your needs.
同时，您可以选择接入现有的MCP服务，或根据需求自主开发专属的MCP服务。
For example, platforms such as the ModelScope MCP Market and Higress MCP Market
have gathered a large number of rich service resources,for you to
explore and select, helping you quickly find solutions that fit your business scenarios,
and improving project development efficiency and innovation capabilities.

idea-plugin.name: AI Agents Debugger
idea-plugin.description:
This plugin is no longer actively supported and will be deprecated in 2027.

Overview

The AI Agents Debugger plugin gives you instant visibility into LangGraph / LangChain / Koog agents — right inside your IDE and with zero setup.

Key Features

  • Live Agent Monitoring: Observe your agents executing tasks in real time and explore detailed step-by-step traces to quickly identify and resolve issues.
  • Zero-Config: Start collecting trace data immediately — no extra configuration needed.
  • Integrated Workflow: Tracing activates from the familiar Run interface in your JetBrains IDE, with a dedicated tool window that presents a traces right inside the development environment.

Getting Started

  1. Install the plugin from the JetBrains Marketplace.
  2. Open any Python project with LangGraph / LangChain / Koog in your IDE.
    1. For LangGraph / LangChain: make sure to open at least one source code file that includes a langgraph or langchain import — this helps the plugin detect that your project uses AI components.
    2. For Koog: ensure to use Koog version 0.5.2 or higher!
  3. Start your agent with the Run command — you'll see the tool window appear automatically.

Report an Issue

You can report an issue via creating a ticket in our YouTrack project.

JetBrains IDEs

idea-plugin.name: StackTrace
idea-plugin.description:
StackTrace is a one-click forensic snapshot for Python debugger sessions.

Whenever execution stops—on an exception, breakpoint, or your own hot-key—StackTrace collects:

  • Full call-stack with code – function code, argument values and locals (frame limit configurable).
  • Console output – last STDERR block plus any warnings in flight.
  • Thread table – PID / TID, running / paused state, current thread highlighted.
  • Environment & interpreter details – OS, CPU/heap, IDE build, JRE, Python path & version, venv/Conda info.
  • Package inventory – either the full pip list or only packages imported in the stack (toggle).
  • Called-function source – project or external-library callees, depth-limited and optionally expanded to their full files.
  • Full-file dump – automatically attach the complete source file for the last N frames.

The report is emitted as clean Markdown or plain text format and copied straight to your clipboard—ready for a ticket, code-review comment, or AI prompt. All heavy work runs on background threads, no IDE restart is ever required, and nothing leaves your machine.

Why seasoned developers use it

  • Zero ceremony – auto-fires on every pause or via Tools ► Run StackTrace Now.
  • AI-ready – per-project Global, Error, and Debug prompts injected ahead of the trace.
  • Noise dial – sliders for frame count, recursion depth, path verbosity, package scope, thread info, and full-file attachments.
  • Zero-restart install – hot-loads instantly from the Marketplace.
  • Works offline – 100 % local processing; no telemetry.

Target IDEs: PyCharm 2024.1 + (Community & Professional) and IntelliJ IDEA / DataGrip / CLion with the Python plugin.

Full documentation: mixelll.github.io/StackTracePublic/Documentation.html
idea-plugin.change-notes: • Version 2025.1.3 • Bug Fix: code-object not rendering when debugger UI not on frame. • Added line numbers. Added key-combo for running the snapshot action.

idea-plugin.name: Cognotik - Open Source Agentic Power Tools
idea-plugin.description:
Cognotik is an open-source AI coding assistant for IntelliJ IDEs, designed to go beyond simple code completion. It provides a suite of powerful, high-level agentic tools to automate complex development workflows. At its core is a sophisticated Cognitive Task Planning Framework that understands your high-level goals, breaks them down into executable steps, and intelligently carries out the plan using a "Bring Your Own Key" (BYOK) model for maximum control over data, costs, and model choice.

✨ Why Cognotik? A Tool for Power Users

The AI coding assistant landscape is crowded, but Cognotik is built on a distinct philosophy for developers who demand control, transparency, and power.

FeatureCognotikProprietary Tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, JetBrains AI)
Model Control✅ Bring Your Own Key (BYOK): Use any compatible LLM, including local or fine-tuned models.❌ Locked-in: Tied to the provider's specific models.
Cost & Data✅ Direct & Transparent: You control your data and pay the LLM provider directly. No middlemen.❌ Subscription-based: Your data passes through their servers, and you pay a subscription fee.
Source Code✅ Open Source: Full transparency. Inspect, modify, and contribute.❌ Closed Source: The inner workings are a black box.
Core Focus✅ Agentic Task Automation: Designed for complex, multi-step workflows with explicit user control.🔶 Primarily Autocomplete: Agentic features are often secondary or less configurable.
PhilosophyAugmentation: A powerful tool to enhance your skills and judgment.Automation: Often aims to replace developer tasks with a more autonomous approach.

Cognotik is for developers who want to augment their capabilities, not replace their judgment. Our explicit Cognitive Task Planning Framework is designed for user invocation and oversight, giving you precise control over complex automated tasks. If you value flexibility, privacy, and a tool that adapts to your workflow, Cognotik is for you.

🔑 Open Source & Bring Your Own Key (BYOK)

Cognotik embraces transparency and control. As open-source software, you can inspect, modify, and contribute to its development. The BYOK model means you connect your preferred AI service providers (like OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) using your own API keys. This gives you:

  • Full Data Control: Your code and prompts are sent directly to the AI provider you choose, not through intermediary servers.
  • Cost Management: You pay the AI provider directly, benefiting from competitive pricing and usage tiers.
  • Model Flexibility: Use the latest and most suitable AI models available from your chosen provider.
  • Enhanced Privacy: Reduces third-party exposure of your sensitive code.

Our focus on providing robust tools rather than a managed service ensures a stable, customizable, and cost-effective AI experience tailored to your needs.

🤖 High-Level Agentic Tools (Beyond Autocomplete)

Cognotik differentiates itself by focusing on high-level agentic capabilities that automate complex workflows. Its "brain" is a powerful Cognitive Task Planning Framework that can formulate, present, and execute multi-step plans to achieve your goals. You can choose from different strategies, such as a plan-ahead Waterfall Mode for well-defined problems or an interactive, step-by-step Conversational Mode for exploratory tasks.

Key Features

  • Advanced Task Automation: Leverage the Cognitive Task Planning Framework to tackle complex goals. The AI agent can perform file operations, execute code, run shell commands, search the web, and even employ advanced reasoning techniques to solve problems from start to finish.
  • Intelligent Code Editing: Chat about your code, apply intelligent patches, edit selections with natural language, and paste code with automatic language and style transformation, all directly within the editor.
  • Project-Wide Operations: Work across multiple files simultaneously. Generate comprehensive documentation, create new files from a description, apply patches across your codebase, and perform mass refactoring with contextual awareness.
  • Deep IDE Integration: Cognotik integrates seamlessly into your workflow. Interact with AI directly from the Git Log (to chat with commits), Find Usages results, the Test Runner (to analyze failures), and the Problems view.
  • Knowledge Management: Build a semantic index of your codebase, enabling powerful knowledge retrieval and similarity-based searches to quickly find relevant information.
  • Voice to Text: Dictate code and documents using built-in voice-to-text capabilities.

idea-plugin.name: BAML v0 Playground
idea-plugin.description:
BAML v0: Basically a Made-up Language

Homepage | Docs | BAML AI Chat | Discord

BAML v0 is a simple prompting language for building reliable AI workflows and agents.

BAML makes prompt engineering easy by turning it into schema engineering — where you mostly focus on the models of your prompt — to get more reliable outputs. You don't need to write your whole app in BAML, only the prompts! You can wire-up your LLM Functions in any language of your choice! See our quickstarts for Python, TypeScript, Ruby and Go, and more.

BAML comes with all batteries included — with full typesafety, streaming, retries, wide model support, even when they don't support native tool-calling APIs

Try BAML: Prompt Fiddle • Interactive App Examples

The core BAML principle: LLM Prompts are functions

The fundamental building block in BAML is a function. Every prompt is a function that takes in parameters and returns a type.

function ChatAgent(message: Message[], tone: "happy" | "sad") -> string

Every function additionally defines which models it uses and what its prompt is.

function ChatAgent(message: Message[], tone: "happy" | "sad") -> StopTool | ReplyTool {
    client "openai/gpt-4o-mini"

    prompt #"
        Be a {{ tone }} bot.

        {{ ctx.output_format }}

        {% for m in message %}
        {{ _.role(m.role) }}
        {{ m.content }}
        {% endfor %}
    "#
}

class Message {
    role string
    content string
}

class ReplyTool {
  response string
}

class StopTool {
  action "stop" @description(#"
    when it might be a good time to end the conversation
  "#)
}

BAML Functions can be called from any language

Below we call the ChatAgent function we defined in BAML through Python. BAML's Rust compiler generates a "baml_client" to access and call them.

from baml_client import b
from baml_client.types import Message, StopTool

messages = [Message(role="assistant", content="How can I help?")]

while True:
  print(messages[-1].content)
  user_reply = input()
  messages.append(Message(role="user", content=user_reply))
  tool = b.ChatAgent(messages, "happy")
  if isinstance(tool, StopTool):
    print("Goodbye!")
    break
  else:
    messages.append(Message(role="assistant", content=tool.response))

You can write any kind of agent or workflow using chained BAML functions. An agent is a while loop that calls a Chat BAML Function with some state.

And if you need to stream, add a couple more lines:

stream = b.stream.ChatAgent(messages, "happy")
# partial is a Partial type with all Optional fields
for tool in stream:
    if isinstance(tool, StopTool):
      ...
    
final = stream.get_final_response()

And get fully type-safe outputs for each chunk in the stream.

Test prompts 10x faster, right in your IDE

BAML comes with native tooling for VS Code and JetBrains IDEs, with support for other editors continuing to expand.

Visualize full prompt (including any multi-modal assets), and the API request. BAML gives you full transparency and control of the prompt.

Using AI is all about iteration speed.

If testing your pipeline takes 2 minutes, you can only test 10 ideas in 20 minutes.

If you reduce it to 5 seconds, you can test 240 ideas in the same amount of time.

The playground also allows you to run tests in parallel — for even faster iteration speeds 🚀.

No need to login to websites, and no need to manually define json schemas.

Enable reliable tool-calling with any model

BAML works even when the models don't support native tool-calling APIs. We created the SAP (schema-aligned parsing) algorithm to support the flexible outputs LLMs can provide, like markdown within a JSON blob or chain-of-thought prior to answering. Read more about SAP

With BAML, your structured outputs work in Day-1 of a model release. No need to figure out whether a model supports parallel tool calls, or whether it supports recursive schemas, or anyOf or oneOf etc.

See it in action with: Deepseek-R1 and OpenAI O1.

Switch from 100s of models in a couple lines

function Extract() -> Resume {
+  client openai/o3-mini
  prompt #"
    ....
  "#
}

Retry policies • fallbacks • model rotations. All statically defined. Want to do pick models at runtime? Check out the Client Registry.

We support: OpenAI • Anthropic • Gemini • Vertex • Bedrock • Azure OpenAI • Anything OpenAI Compatible (Ollama, OpenRouter, VLLM, LMStudio, TogetherAI, and more)

Build beautiful streaming UIs

BAML generates a ton of utilities for NextJS, Python (and any language) to make streaming UIs easy.

BAML's streaming interfaces are fully type-safe. Check out the Streaming Docs, and our React hooks

Fully Open-Source, and offline

  • 100% open-source (Apache 2)
  • 100% private. AGI will not require an internet connection, neither will BAML
    • No network requests beyond model calls you explicitly set
    • Not stored or used for any training data
  • BAML files can be saved locally on your machine and checked into Github for easy diffs.
  • Built in Rust. So fast, you can't even tell it's there.

BAML's Design Philosophy

Everything is fair game when making new syntax. If you can code it, it can be yours. This is our design philosophy to help restrict ideas:

  • 1: Avoid invention when possible
    • Yes, prompts need versioning — we have a great versioning tool: git
    • Yes, you need to save prompts — we have a great storage tool: filesystems
  • 2: Any file editor and any terminal should be enough to use it
  • 3: Be fast
  • 4: A first year university student should be able to understand it

Why a new programming language

We used to write websites like this:

def home():
    return "<button onclick=\"() => alert(\\\"hello!\\\")\">Click</button>"

And now we do this:

function Home() {
  return <button onClick={() => setCount(prev => prev + 1)}>
          {count} clicks!
         </button>
}

New syntax can be incredible at expressing new ideas. Plus the idea of maintaining hundreds of f-strings for prompts kind of disgusts us 🤮. Strings are bad for maintainable codebases. We prefer structured strings.

The goal of BAML is to give you the expressiveness of English, but the structure of code.

Full blog post by us.

Conclusion

As models get better, we'll continue expecting even more out of them. But what will never change is that we'll want a way to write maintainable code that uses those models. The current way we all just assemble strings is very reminiscent of the early days PHP/HTML soup in web development. We hope some of the ideas we shared today can make a tiny dent in helping us all shape the way we all code tomorrow.

FAQ

Do I need to write my whole app in BAML?Nope, only the prompts! BAML translates definitions into the language of your choice! Python, TypeScript, Ruby and more.
Is BAML stable?Yes, many companies use it in production! We ship updates weekly!
Why a new language?Jump to section

Contributing

Checkout our guide on getting started

Citation

You can cite the BAML repo as follows:

@software{baml,
  author = {Boundary ML},
  title = {BAML},
  url = {https://github.com/boundaryml/baml},
  year = {2024}
}

Made with ❤️ by Boundary

HQ in Seattle, WA

P.S. We're hiring for software engineers that love rust. Email us or reach out on discord!

idea-plugin.name: ActionFX
idea-plugin.description:
ActionFX: AI Development & JavaFX Toolkit

ActionFX is a dual-purpose productivity plugin for IntelliJ IDEA. It provides a universal Smart AI Context Collector for any Java project and a dedicated suite of tools for JavaFX/FXML development.

🚀 Universal AI Features (Any Java Project)

  • Smart AI Context Collector: Automatically gather project context directly from gutter icons next to trigger comments (e.g., TODO).
  • Prompt Optimization: Extracts only public contracts (interfaces and methods) while filtering out standard library noise to minimize token usage.
  • Noise Reduction: Intelligently ignores classes without public methods to keep your AI prompts clean and relevant.

🖼️ JavaFX Specific Tools

📹 Video Demos

See ActionFX in action: Watch video demonstrations

Live FXML Preview

View and interact with your FXML layouts directly within IntelliJ IDEA without building or running your application. Modifications are reflected immediately.

Automated Controller Generation

Generate controller code automatically based on your FXML structure. ActionFX creates @FXML fields and stub methods for event handlers.

Bidirectional Navigation

Navigate seamlessly between FXML elements and their corresponding controller code using gutter icons. Right-click any UI element to jump to its field declaration.

Interactive Inspector

Modify UI properties through an integrated inspector panel. Edit IDs, text, fonts, and padding directly from the preview interface.

CSS Preview Support

Preview your JavaFX stylesheets alongside your FXML layouts with real-time visualization.

⚡ Quick Start

  • Define your AI trigger pattern in Settings | ActionFX AI, then click the AI icon in the gutter to copy context.
  • Double-click any FXML file in Project or ActionFX tool window to open preview.
  • Click UI elements to automatically generate @FXML fields and methods in your controller.
  • Note: IntelliJ IDEA versions older than 2024.2 may require triple-click instead of double-click.

Technical Requirements

  • IntelliJ IDEA 2023.1 or later (2024.2+ recommended)
  • Java 17 or higher (Supports Java 21 features)
  • JavaFX dependencies in your project

idea-plugin.change-notes:
Version 1.0.8

  • **Scan archive size** — Fixed an issue where nested `node_modules`, `dist`, `build`, `target`, and similar directories were included in the scan upload on monorepos.
  • **JetBrains plugin stuck on "Node.js not found" (Linux)** — Fixed the initialization screen hanging with `Node.js Version: not found` when the IDE was launched from a graphical session on Linux and did not inherit the shell `PATH` (common with `nvm`, `fnm`, `Volta`, `asdf`, Homebrew or Snap installs). The plugin now probes well-known install locations on every platform, and a new **Settings → Tools → CybeDefend** page lets you set an explicit Node.js path when auto-detection fails. On Linux the extension host process also inherits `/usr/local/bin`, `/snap/bin`, `/home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin`, `~/.volta/bin`, `~/.asdf/shims` and `~/.local/bin`.
  • **Expanded default excludes** — The scan archive now also skips native binaries (`.so`, `.dll`, `.dylib`, `.exe`, `.wasm`), fonts (`.ttf`, `.otf`, `.woff`, `.woff2`, `.eot`), data dumps (`.sqlite`, `.parquet`, `.db`, `.dump`, `.bak`), and additional build caches (`vendor/`, `Pods/`, `.gradle/`, `.mvn/`, `.pytest_cache/`, `.mypy_cache/`, `.ruff_cache/`, `.tox/`, `.turbo/`, `.parcel-cache/`, `.vite/`, `.next/`, `.nuxt/`, `.svelte-kit/`, `.astro/`, `out/`, `DerivedData/`).

idea-plugin.name: Coding By DeepSeek Or ChatGPT Or OtherAI
idea-plugin.description:
English

Coding By DeepSeek Or ChatGPT Or OtherAI is an IDE-based AI coding assistant for IntelliJ IDEA. It focuses on five practical development workflows and provides a polished AI Chat experience inside the IDE.

Core AI Actions

  • AI Code Explanation: explain selected code, key logic, variables, and potential risks.
  • AI Java Bean Test Data: generate realistic Java Bean test data and useful edge cases.
  • AI SQL Optimization: improve SQL readability, performance, and correctness with explanations.
  • AI API Documentation: generate API documentation for interfaces, controllers, and methods.
  • AI Unit Test Generation: generate Java unit tests with normal and boundary scenarios.

AI Chat

  • Use the AI Chat tool window for interactive conversations.
  • Open AI Chat as a standalone window from the Tools menu or the chat toolbar.
  • Use Enter to send and Shift+Enter to insert a new line.
  • Supports stop generation, retry, new conversation, copy one message, copy the last answer, and using selected editor code.
  • Message bubbles adapt to the window width by ratio for better reading on different panel sizes.
  • Button actions show localized feedback popups that disappear automatically after 2 seconds.
  • Built-in quick task buttons for Explain, Bean Data, SQL, API Doc, and Unit Test.

Configuration and Providers

  • Configure API Key, Auth Header, AI URL, provider preset, and request body template in Settings → AI Settings.
  • Built-in presets include DeepSeek, OpenAI GPT, OpenAI ChatGPT, OpenAI Codex, and OpenAI-compatible APIs.
  • Supports streaming and non-streaming response parsing for Chat Completions and Responses-style payloads.
  • Use the editor right-click menu to run the five fixed AI actions on selected code.

中文

AI Coding 是一款面向 IntelliJ IDEA 的 IDE 内 AI 编码助手，聚焦研发过程中的 5 个高频场景，并提供更完整、更易用的 AI Chat 交互体验。

核心 AI 功能

  • AI 解释代码：解释选中代码的功能、关键逻辑、核心变量和潜在风险。
  • AI 生成 Java Bean 测试数据：生成真实可用的 Bean 测试数据和边界场景。
  • AI SQL 优化：优化 SQL 的可读性、性能和正确性，并说明优化点。
  • AI 接口文档生成：根据接口、Controller 或方法生成接口文档。
  • AI 单元测试生成：生成 Java 单元测试，覆盖正常场景和关键边界情况。

AI Chat 交互

  • 通过 AI Chat 工具窗口进行交互式对话。
  • 支持从 Tools 菜单或聊天工具栏打开独立 AI Chat 窗口。
  • 支持 Enter 发送，Shift+Enter 换行。
  • 支持停止生成、重试、新建会话、复制单条消息、复制最后回复、使用当前编辑器选中代码。
  • 聊天消息宽度会按窗口比例自适应，适配不同宽度的工具窗口和独立窗口。
  • 按钮操作会显示国际化反馈弹框，并在 2 秒后自动消失。
  • 内置解释、Bean 数据、SQL、接口文档、单元测试快捷任务按钮。

配置与平台接入

  • 在 Settings → AI Settings 中配置 API Key、Auth Header、AI URL、平台预设和请求体模板。
  • 内置 DeepSeek、OpenAI GPT、OpenAI ChatGPT、OpenAI Codex 和 OpenAI 兼容接口预设。
  • 支持 Chat Completions 和 Responses 风格返回结构的流式与非流式响应解析。
  • 通过编辑器右键菜单对选中代码调用 5 个固定 AI 功能。

idea-plugin.name: SmartChangelist AI
idea-plugin.description:
Stop mixing bug fixes with features. The only plugin that AI-reorganizes your changes into atomic commits.
SmartChangelist AI analyzes your code changes and automatically groups them into logical, atomic changelists.
Generate commit messages for partial commits. Let AI clean up your commit history.

Key Features

  • Generate Commit Message: One-click AI-generated commit messages for selected changes
  • Smart Reorganization: AI understands code context and groups related changes together
  • Multi-LLM Support: OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Ollama, LM Studio, or any OpenAI-compatible API
  • Native Preview: Tree-based preview matching IntelliJ's native changelist view
  • Cancel Anytime: Stop button immediately cancels requests — no wasted tokens
  • Token Tracking: See exactly how many tokens each request uses

Supported Providers

  • OpenAI (all GPT models)
  • Anthropic Claude (all models)
  • Google Gemini (all models)
  • DeepSeek
  • Local models via Ollama or LM Studio
  • Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint

Recommended Models

  • Best value: DeepSeek (deepseek-chat) — excellent for code, very affordable
  • Best quality: GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet — premium results
  • Good balance: GPT-4o-mini, Gemini 1.5 Flash — fast and cheap
  • Local: Qwen3-Coder-30B, DeepSeek-Coder-V2 — best offline options

Privacy First

Your code stays yours. Use your own API keys — no data collection, no vendor lock-in. Run completely offline with local models like Ollama.

Your commit history deserves better. Let AI organize it.

JDC Pre-Commit Code Review - AI-Powered Code Quality Enhancement

A professional IntelliJ IDEA plugin that automatically performs AI-driven code reviews before Git commits, helping developers improve code quality with Claude Sonnet 4 integration.

Core Features:

  • Smart Code Review - Multi-dimensional code quality analysis powered by Claude Sonnet 4
  • Quality Scoring - Provides 0-100 code quality scores with detailed improvement suggestions
  • File Selection - Supports selective review with customizable file selection
  • Deep Git Integration - Automatically detects staged files, content changes, and diff comparison
  • Real-time Streaming - Streaming output of analysis results without waiting
  • Secure OAuth Authentication - Browser-based secure login with automatic re-authentication
  • Modern UI - Beautiful interface compliant with IntelliJ design guidelines
  • Multi-language Support - Supports Java, Kotlin, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, and more
  • Review History - Complete code review records and history management
  • Smart Retry - Automatic retry on network errors, auto re-login on authentication failure
  • Intelligent Filtering - Automatically filters non-code files, supports 100+ programming languages

Quick Start Guide:

  1. First Login: Click the "Login" button in the tool window, browser will automatically open JDC Tools authorization page for secure authentication
  2. Modify Code: Make code changes in your project
  3. Stage Files: Use git add to add files to the staging area
  4. Select Files: Click "Review Staged Files" and select files to review in the dialog
  5. Start Review: Confirm selection to begin AI code review
  6. View Results: Real-time view of analysis results and improvement suggestions in the tool window
  7. Optimize Code: Improve code based on AI suggestions before committing

Keyboard Shortcuts:

  • Ctrl+Shift+R - Review staged files
  • Ctrl+Shift+F - Review current file
  • Ctrl+Shift+P - Open review tool window

Authorization Process:

The plugin uses secure OAuth2 authorization flow:

  • Automatically opens browser to official authorization page
  • Secure login to your JDC Tools account in the web page
  • Automatic return to plugin after authorization confirmation, no manual operation required
  • Supports automatic re-authentication, auto-refresh when login status expires

Advanced Features:

  • File Selector - Beautiful file selection interface with select all/none support
  • Smart Retry Mechanism - Automatic retry on network errors, auto re-login on authentication failure
  • Detailed Statistics - Display file size, type, processing time and other detailed information
  • Syntax Highlighting - Code suggestions with syntax highlighting support
  • Local Caching - Smart caching of authentication information to reduce repeated logins
  • Intelligent Filtering - Automatically filters .bin, .lock and other non-code files, supports 100+ programming languages
