idea-plugin.name: CC GUI (Claude, Codex and More)
idea-plugin.description:
Multi-engine GUI for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode & more - MIT 100% Open Source

Claude Code / Codex / OpenCode 等多引擎GUI MIT 100%开源产品

支持的 CLI / Supported CLIs:

  • Claude Code Anthropic 官方 AI 编程助手（支持 Opus 4.6 等多模型）
  • OpenAI Codex - OpenAI 强大的代码生成引擎
  • Grok CLI (Beta) - xAI 的 Grok 命令行编程助手
  • Kimi CLI (Beta) - 月之暗面 Kimi 编程助手
  • OpenCode (Beta) - 开源多模型 AI 编程终端
  • PI CLI (Beta)
  • OMP CLI (Beta)
  • DeepSeek Harness (Beta)

Connection & proxy disclosure / 连接与代理说明：

  • By default, requests are sent directly to the official Anthropic API (or OpenAI API for Codex).
  • Users may optionally configure a third-party or proxy endpoint in Provider Settings. When a non-official base URL is set, the plugin UI clearly labels the request route as proxied before it is used.
  • Users can freely switch between direct and proxy modes at any time in the provider settings.
  • Only when users explicitly enable Local settings.json or CLI Login mode, the plugin may honor network proxy variables from ~/.claude/settings.json (e.g. HTTP_PROXY, HTTPS_PROXY) for API requests. Managed provider presets do not silently inherit these local proxy variables.

默认情况下，请求直接发送到 Anthropic（或 OpenAI）官方 API。用户可在供应商设置中选配第三方或代理端点，插件 UI 会在使用前明确标注请求路由方式。用户可随时在直连与代理模式间自由切换。只有当用户显式启用“本地 settings.json”或“CLI Login”模式时，插件才可能继承 ~/.claude/settings.json 中的网络代理变量（如 HTTP_PROXY、HTTPS_PROXY）；普通托管供应商预设不会静默继承这些本地代理变量。

Credential & file-access disclosure / 凭证与文件访问说明：

  • No silent credential scanning. The plugin never silently scans your disk for API keys or tokens. All credential sources require explicit user authorization via a confirmation dialog in the plugin UI.
  • Provider credentials: Users enter API keys manually in the provider settings UI, or explicitly authorize reading from ~/.claude/settings.json, or explicitly authorize delegating to the Claude SDK's native OAuth flow (CLI Login). If Claude provider access is revoked or disabled, the plugin does not continue using credentials from ~/.claude/settings.json.
  • MCP server configuration: When the user opens the MCP settings page, the plugin reads MCP server definitions (server names, commands, arguments) from ~/.claude.json. This file contains no credentials or tokens — only MCP server configuration metadata managed by the Claude CLI.

插件不会静默扫描磁盘上的凭证。所有凭证来源均需用户在 UI 中显式授权确认。MCP 服务器配置仅在用户打开 MCP 设置页面时读取，该文件仅含服务器定义，不含任何凭证或令牌。

核心功能

  • 上下文感知助手：智能编程助手，支持 @文件引用
  • 图片支持：发送图片可视化描述需求
  • Agent 系统：内置智能体自动化执行复杂任务
  • Skills 命令：斜杠命令系统（/init, /review 等）
  • MCP 服务器：通过 MCP 协议扩展 AI 能力
  • 代码 DIFF：可视化代码对比和文件导航
  • 对话回退：灵活调整对话历史
  • 会话管理：历史记录、收藏、搜索和导出
  • 主题支持：深色/浅色主题，支持 IDE 字体同步
  • 权限控制：完善的安全管理
  • 供应商管理：兼容 cc-switch

使用方法

  • 从右侧边栏打开 CC GUI 工具窗口
  • 选中代码后使用 Ctrl+Alt+K（Win/Linux）或 Cmd+Alt+K（Mac）发送给 AI
  • 即时获得 AI 驱动的代码辅助和智能建议

Keywords: CCGUI, CC-GUI, Claude, Claude Code, Codex, OpenAI Codex, OpenCode, Gemini, Kimi, Grok, PI CLI, OMP, DeepSeek, Code Generation, AI Coding, AI Coding Assistant
idea-plugin.change-notes:
English:


✨ Features

  • **Search the model dropdown with multiple terms, navigate it from the keyboard and clear the query**: whitespace-separated tokens are AND-matched against the model id, label and description, so `son 4` finds Sonnet 4.6; `ArrowUp`/`ArrowDown` walk the rendered rows with wrap-around, `Enter` picks the highlighted row and `Esc` clears the query first and only closes the menu on a second press, while IME composition keys are never hijacked; searching pre-highlights the first hit, scrolls rows into view, a clear (`x`) button in the search row keeps the dropdown open, and the empty state echoes the query (by @57ggfk)
  • **Copy a link's address from the message list and see where a link actually points**: right-clicking a link opens the context menu with "Copy Link Address" even when no text is selected — Quote/Copy appear only for a real selection, and the link action comes first, matching browser convention — while Markdown URL links whose visible text hides their target (`data-linkify="url"`) now reveal the raw `href` in the hover tooltip, resolved synchronously without a backend round-trip; file links keep their async resolution path, and a single link-type predicate is shared by mouseover/mousemove/mouseout so they always agree on which anchors own the tooltip (by @gadfly3173)
  • **Add Claude Sonnet 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Sol**: both models are selectable in the dropdown with localized labels and descriptions in all 10 locales, and are wired into the effort and max-effort sets; their context limits (200k / 1M for Sonnet 5.5, 1.05M for GPT-6.1 Sol) and pricing entries are registered ahead of the shorter `claude-sonnet-5` / `gpt-6` prefixes, so dated snapshots such as `claude-sonnet-5-5-2026-04-01` and `gpt-6.1-sol-2026-04-01` resolve to the intended rates instead of a stale alias (by @zhukunpenglinyutong)

🐛 Fixes

  • **Stop Codex turns from overlapping and queued messages from resending after an interrupt**: Codex holds a persistent per-thread writer lock for the whole turn, so a second `codex exec resume` started while the previous process was still alive failed with "thread-store conflict: already has an active writer", which the UI misdiagnosed as an expired session thread and answered with "create a new session"; sends are now serialized per channel and a still-alive previous turn is stopped before the next one spawns, the message queue dispatches at most one item per idle period, and a freshly dispatched turn's loading state survives the just-interrupted turn's late `showLoading(false)` / `onStreamEnd` echoes (an 8-second immunity window, released by the turn's real stream start or by an error snapshot) so the drain cannot re-fire mid-boot; "already has an active writer" also gets its own diagnostic with retry guidance in 10 locales instead of the wrong advice (by @57ggfk)
  • **Translate the input box's right-click menu in every locale**: `contextMenu.cut` / `paste` / `newline` existed in no locale including `en`, so Cut / Paste / Insert Newline always fell back to hardcoded English and produced a mixed-language menu in non-English UIs; the three keys are now present in all 10 webview locales, ordered cut → copy → paste → newline → quote (by @57ggfk)

中文：


✨ 新功能

  • **模型下拉支持多词搜索、键盘操作与一键清空**：以空格分隔的多个关键词按「且」的关系同时匹配模型 ID、名称与描述，因此输入 `son 4` 能找到 Sonnet 4.6；`ArrowUp`/`ArrowDown` 在可见行之间循环移动高亮，`Enter` 选中高亮行，`Esc` 先清空搜索词、再按一次才关闭菜单，且不会劫持输入法候选键；搜索时会预高亮首个命中项并把行滚动到可视区，搜索行新增清除（`x`）按钮（保持菜单展开），空结果状态会回显用户输入的搜索词（by @57ggfk）
  • **消息列表里可右键复制链接地址，并能看到链接的真实指向**：即使没有选中任何文本，右键点击链接也会弹出包含「复制链接地址」的菜单——引用/复制仅在确有选中文本时出现，且链接操作排在前面（符合浏览器习惯）；Markdown 中「显示文字掩盖了真实地址」的链接（`data-linkify="url"`）现在会在悬停浮层里显示原始 `href`（同步解析，无需请求后端），文件链接仍走异步解析路径；链接类型判断被抽成单一判定函数，保证 mouseover/mousemove/mouseout 对「哪个链接该显示浮层」的认知一致（by @gadfly3173）
  • **新增 Claude Sonnet 5.5 与 GPT-6.1 Sol**：两款模型可在下拉中选择，10 个语言包都补上了本地化的名称与描述，并接入了推理强度与最高强度集合；上下文上限（Sonnet 5.5 为 200k / 1M，GPT-6.1 Sol 为 1.05M）与价格表也在更短的 `claude-sonnet-5` / `gpt-6` 前缀之前注册，使 `claude-sonnet-5-5-2026-04-01`、`gpt-6.1-sol-2026-04-01` 这类带日期的快照按预期计费，而不会命中旧的别名（by @zhukunpenglinyutong）

🐛 修复

  • **Codex 不再出现回合重叠、中断后排队消息被重复发送**：Codex 在整个回合期间持有「按线程持久化的写锁」，因此在上一个进程仍存活时再启动一次 `codex exec resume`，会以 "thread-store conflict: already has an active writer" 失败，而界面把它误判为「会话线程已过期」并建议「新建会话」；现在按 channel 串行化发送、在下一回合启动前先停掉仍存活的上一回合进程，消息队列每个空闲期最多派发一条，并且新派发回合的 loading 状态不会再被上一回合迟到的 `showLoading(false)` / `onStreamEnd` 回声重置（8 秒免疫窗口，回合真正开始流式输出或收到错误快照时解除），从而不会在启动过程中再次触发排队派发；"already has an active writer" 也拥有了独立诊断（含重试指引，覆盖 10 个语言包），不再给出错误建议（by @57ggfk）
  • **输入框右键菜单在所有语言下完成翻译**：`contextMenu.cut` / `paste` / `newline` 在所有语言包（包括 `en`）中都不存在，导致剪切/粘贴/插入换行始终回落到硬编码英文，非英文界面出现中英混排菜单；现已在 10 个 webview 语言包中全部补齐（顺序为 cut → copy → paste → newline → quote）（by @57ggfk）

---

idea-plugin.name: Code Review Plus
idea-plugin.description:
Code Review Plus

Every branch change becomes a review checklist. Track progress, comment on issues, and let automation flag the obvious — so you can focus on what really matters.

Core Features (Free) — Review at Your Own Pace

Review sessions — pick the branch to review and a base branch to compare. The plugin lists every changed file and code block; you can also start a session from a remote GitLab MR or GitHub PR.

Progress that never gets lost — mark each block as passed or flagged. Progress is saved locally and restored after restart, so you always know exactly where you left off.

Incremental review — new commits on the branch? Refresh, and unchanged blocks keep their status. Only new or modified code needs another look. Never start over.

Comments that follow through — add comments with a priority (Mandatory / Recommended / Advisory) and a status (Pending / Resolved / No Action), so every issue is tracked to completion.

Reports — export an HTML report that developers can import and fix, closing the loop.

Premium Capabilities — Flag the Obvious in Seconds, Focus on What Matters

On top of the free core, Auto Review and AI Review handle the common, fixed-type problems — so your review time goes to the code that truly needs it.

Auto Review — rule-based checks finish in seconds, flagging fixed problem types: hardcoded secrets, N+1 queries, Spring transaction pitfalls, Redis keys without TTL, concurrency bugs, BigDecimal precision traps, null pointer risks, and more. Trivial changes like formatting and import adjustments are auto-passed.

AI Review — three expert agents run in parallel to surface deeper, easy-to-miss issues across code quality, security, and database risks.

AI Auto-Fix — once an issue is flagged, click one button and AI fixes the code directly.

Core features are free forever. Premium capabilities require a license — free for the first 30 days after install.

Documentation

  • Full Documentation (English)

Code Review Plus

每次分支变更都是一份评审清单。记录进度、评论问题，让自动化快速标记明显问题——把精力留给真正重要的代码。

核心功能（免费）— 按自己的节奏评审

评审会话 — 选择要评审的分支和对比的基准分支，插件列出所有变更文件和代码块；也可以直接从远程 GitLab MR 或 GitHub PR 创建会话。

进度不丢失 — 每个代码块标记"通过"或"问题"，进度自动保存在本地，重启后不会丢失，随时知道评审到哪了。

增量评审 — 分支有新提交？刷新一下，未变更的代码块保留原状态，只需重新看新增和修改的部分，永不从头再来。

评论有始有终 — 添加评论并设置优先级（强制 / 优先 / 建议）和状态（待处理 / 已处理 / 无需处理），每个问题都能跟踪到底。

报告 — 导出 HTML 报告给开发者导入修复，完成评审闭环。

订阅能力 — 秒级标记明显问题，专注真正重要的代码

在免费核心能力之上，自动评审和 AI 评审帮你处理常见的固定类型问题——把评审时间留给真正需要思考的代码。

自动评审 — 基于规则的检查，秒级完成，快速识别固定类型的问题：硬编码密钥、N+1 查询、Spring 事务陷阱、Redis 未设 TTL、并发 Bug、BigDecimal 精度陷阱、空指针风险等；格式调整、import 变更等噪音自动标记为通过。

AI 评审 — 三个专家 Agent 并行运行，进一步发现编码质量、安全漏洞、数据库风险中人工容易遗漏的深层问题。

AI 自动修复 — 问题被标记后，一键让 AI 直接修复代码。

核心功能永久免费。订阅能力需要许可证，安装后自动获得 30 天试用。

Rename Session from the Statistics Panel: The session name above the branch info is now clickable to rename it, sharing one validation path with the list context menu. Nullability False-Positive Fixes: Locals protected by an enclosing null guard are no longer reported. License Check Off the UI Thread: Certificate validation no longer blocks the EDT. | v2026.5.2 — 会话列表搜索：会话列表顶部新增搜索框，支持按会话名称、评审分支、基准分支过滤，展示命中计数并自动隐藏无命中项目。| 未使用方法/常量检测：未使用方法规则扩展支持常量与死字段检测——Java static final 常量与 private final 字段、Kotlin const val 与 private val；框架读写字段（Spring @Value、Jackson @JsonProperty、Lombok 注解类中的字段）已排除。| 基准分支合入后自动刷新：把基准分支合并进评审分支后自动刷新会话，不再只提示过期。| 本地分支缺失容错：本地分支不存在时回退远程引用，创建与刷新会话不再报错。| 新建会话默认值优化：开始评审对话框默认选中最近本人提交的项目与最近提交的分支，并自动填充会话名。| 统计面板直接重命名会话：分支信息上方的会话名称支持点击修改，与列表右键共用同一套校验逻辑。| 空指针误报修复：被外层非空守卫包住的局部变量不再误报。| 许可证检查移出 UI 线程：证书校验不再阻塞 EDT。

Comment Refresh Matching Upgrade: Comments are now re-attached to the correct lines via line-by-line translation based on git diff hunk structure, with a four-tier fallback chain (line-mapped → block-offset → line-overlap → outdated). Bidirectional Comment Sync: Remote inline comments are pulled into the session on creation and refresh; local comments upload back as inline comments with one click; deleting a local comment can optionally delete the remote one. idea-plugin.name: Feature Orchestrator
idea-plugin.description:
Feature Orchestrator simplifies your development workflow by combining backlog management, AI Agent Skill selection, and AI prompt generation into a single, repeatable process.

  • Combines prompt writing and backlog refinement into a single workflow.
  • Keeps the feature backlog inside the IDE, versioned alongside the codebase (no external tools required).
  • Lets you select AI Agent skills and documentation from a predefined in-IDE list.
  • Quickly download the latest AI Agent skills from the Claude Code skills repository.
  • Preview, Add, Edit, Delete and Mark Features as Completed with ease.
  • Works seamlessly with JetBrains AI Assistant.
  • Configurable feature templates for consistent planning.

** Plan in IDE → Select Agent Skills → Generate prompt → AI Assistant → Mark as completed **

How it works

Feature Orchestrator uses a BACKLOG.md file in your project root where you can plan your features using simple Markdown.

  • Manage Backlog: Add, edit, and navigate through your features directly within the IDE tool window.
  • Select Agent Skills: Choose from available Agent Skills (documentation, style guides, or specialized instructions) to include in your prompt.
  • Sync Skills: Download the latest Agent Skills from the Claude Code repository to keep your AI prompts optimized.
  • Generate Prompt: Create a structured AI prompt that includes the feature description and selected skills.
  • AI Handoff: Automatically copy the prompt to your clipboard or open the AI Assistant with the prompt ready to go.
  • Mark as Completed: Once the work is done, mark the feature as completed. The plugin handles checking off the feature or moving it to a COMPLETED.md file.
  • Configurable Templates: Customize the default template for new features in settings to fit your team's needs.

Designed for developers

  • IDE Integrated: Works with all IntelliJ-based IDEs.
  • AI Ready: Deeply integrated with JetBrains AI Assistant.
  • Transparent: Fully transparent execution logs.
  • Manual Control: Explicit user actions only—no autonomous changes to your code.

Feature Orchestrator never runs on its own and never modifies your code or planning files via AI without your command.

Who it’s for

  • Solo developers and small teams shipping fast.
  • Developers who want to keep their planning close to their code.
  • Teams using JetBrains AI Assistant or similar tools.
  • Anyone tired of hanging out in Jira or similar tools.
  • Anyone who wants to save mental energy by using a repeatable prompt generation workflow.

What it is not

  • Not an autonomous agent.
  • Not a background task runner.
  • Not another AI chat interface.

It’s a Feature orchestrator.

idea-plugin.name: One-IDE
idea-plugin.description:
Sync VS Code and JetBrains IDEs seamlessly. One-IDE is built for developers who work across multiple environments simultaneously. When you open a project in both a JetBrains IDE (IntelliJ IDEA, WebStorm, PyCharm, etc.) and VS Code (or its forks), your editors stay perfectly in sync—providing a seamless transition as you switch between tools.

Beyond file tracking, the extension automatically detects and adapts AI project rules between platforms. For example, if you update project rules in Cursor, Trae will instantly detect the changes, convert them to its native format, and apply them to the correct location.

Features

  • Cross-IDE Synchronization: Syncs active file and cursor position between VS Code and JetBrains IDEs.
  • AI Project Rules Synchronization: Automatically detects and syncs AI project rules (e.g., .cursorrules, .trae/rules) between different AI coding tools.

Usage

  • The plugin starts automatically.
  • Click the "One-IDE" status bar item to toggle synchronization.

To enable cross-platform synchronization, ensure the One-IDE extension is installed in every environment you use (including JetBrains IDEs, VS Code, and VS Code forks like Cursor or Trae).

For VS Code (and forks), install the One-IDE VS Code Extension.

idea-plugin.name: sentinel-ai-safety
idea-plugin.description:
AI Safety Guardrails for LLM Applications

Sentinel AI Safety provides comprehensive security and compliance analysis for LLM prompts, AI-generated content, and agent workflows. All scanning runs 100% locally with no data sent to external servers.

Core Features

  • THSP Protocol: Four-gate validation system (Truth, Harm, Scope, Purpose)
  • Security Scanning: Detect 67+ secret patterns, SQL injection, prompt injection
  • Compliance Checking: EU AI Act, OWASP LLM Top 10, CSA AI Controls Matrix
  • Output Validation: XSS, command injection, leaked secrets detection

idea-plugin.name: Verdent
idea-plugin.description:
Verdent is an AI-powered agentic coding assistant that brings autonomous software development capabilities directly into your JetBrains IDE. Built for professional developers who want to leverage cutting-edge AI coding agents for faster, smarter software engineering.

Unlike simple code completion tools, Verdent operates as an autonomous AI agent that understands your entire codebase, plans complex tasks, and executes multi-step workflows with full transparency and human-in-the-loop control.

Why Verdent?

  • 🤖 True Agentic AI - Not just autocomplete. Plans, reasons, and executes complex coding tasks autonomously
  • 🧠 Deep Codebase Understanding - Analyzes your project structure, dependencies, and coding patterns
  • 📋 Planning-First Approach - Creates structured plans before execution, so you always know what's happening
  • 🔄 Human-in-the-Loop - Review, approve, or modify agent actions at every step

Key Features

  • Agentic Task Execution - AI-driven planning with transparent, incremental code generation
  • Subagent Architecture - Specialized AI agents for exploration, verification, and code review
  • Multi-Model Support - Works with Claude, GPT-4, Gemini, and other leading AI/LLM models
  • MCP Integration - Extensible toolchain via Model Context Protocol for custom AI workflows
  • AGENTS.md & Rules Support - Define project-specific AI behavior and coding conventions
  • Context-Aware Assistance - Understands your codebase, tests, and documentation

Perfect For

  • 🚀 AI-Assisted Development - Accelerate coding with intelligent AI pair programming
  • 🔧 Complex Refactoring - Let the agent plan and execute large-scale code changes
  • 🐛 Debugging & Analysis - AI-powered code analysis and bug detection
  • 📝 Documentation - Generate and maintain code documentation automatically
  • 🧪 Test Generation - Create comprehensive test suites with AI assistance

Getting Started

  1. Install the plugin and restart your IDE
  2. Open the Verdent tool window from the right sidebar
  3. Sign in with your Verdent account
  4. Start a conversation to get AI coding assistance

Local Context

Verdent uses bundled open-source search tools (ripgrep and fd) to analyze files within your project directory. All analysis runs locally - your code never leaves your machine without explicit action.

Third-Party Software

  • ripgrep - MIT License
  • fd - MIT License

For full open source license information, visit our OSS Licenses page.

By using Verdent, you agree to our Terms of Service.

Keywords: AI, Agentic, Coding Assistant, LLM, Claude, GPT, Gemini, Code Generation, AI Pair Programming, Autonomous Agent, MCP, Model Context Protocol, AI Development
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.1.2 - Team BYOK Base URL & Temp Approval Fixes

Team Model Config

  • Added team model proxy config loading from /verdent/team/settings/model-config/list.
  • Attached team configured base_url to BYOK config payloads instead of handshake system info.
  • Refreshed team model configs before handshake so subagent BYOK metadata stays current.

Bash Approval

  • Fixed heredoc writes into system temp directories still asking for approval.
  • Ignored heredoc bodies during dangerous-command inspection to avoid false approval prompts from note content.

1.1.1 - Message Ordering & Checkpoint Diff Reliability

Message Display

  • Fixed streamed assistant updates occasionally appearing in the wrong message card or order.
  • Improved update-before-add handling so delayed message updates attach to the correct message.

Checkpoint & Review Changes

  • Scoped checkpoints to files touched by the current operation instead of the whole project.
  • Fixed Review Changes diffs to use the current user turn's first before-checkpoint and last after-checkpoint.
  • Improved multi-repository diff matching and rollback safety for newly created and existing files.

Tool Execution

  • Streamed bash output progressively and improved responsiveness on Intel Mac machines.
  • Bypassed approval for file writes and shell redirects into system temp directories across platforms.
  • Added guards to prevent accidental non-empty-file-to-empty-file replacement during edit flows.

UI Stability

  • Reduced tool window resize jitter and streaming markdown/code-block reflow jitter.
  • Kept running file tool cards showing line-change stats instead of spinner-only placeholders.
  • Fixed model tooltip arrow rendering, clarification alignment, and @ file reference path handling.

Browser Tool

  • Added a browser-driver abstraction and improved CDP observations, element targeting, and external URL navigation.

1.1.0 - Streaming Rendering & Message Alignment

Markdown Rendering

  • Fixed occasional rendering glitches at the end of streamed assistant messages

Message Display

  • Fixed cases where part of an assistant reply could appear in the wrong place or in the wrong card type

Plugin Compatibility

  • Cleared plugin-verifier internal-API warnings

1.0.9 - Stability & Quality of Life

Memory

  • Fixed listener / cache / timer leaks that caused memory to grow over long sessions and across session switches; tool-window close, session switch and theme change now actively release diagram render resources

Multi-window

  • Fixed clicking a file or image in chat (user message thumbnails, plan files, diagrams, browser / search results, settings rules) opening it in the wrong IDE window when multiple projects are open

Terminal Output

  • Fixed long unbroken command output (paths, hashes, etc.) being clipped under the Copy / More buttons; output now wraps to the available width

Resize Stability

  • Fixed the chat scrollbar jumping to the bottom while dragging the tool-window width; the visible message now stays in place during resize

1.0.8 - BYOK & Eco Mode & Handshake Sync & Rendering Fixes

BYOK (Bring Your Own Key)

  • Full Settings Flow - End-to-end BYOK support in the model settings page: add / edit / enable / disable custom OpenAI-compatible & Anthropic providers with their own API key, base URL, and model id
  • Subagent BYOK Selection - Each subagent's "Model" picker now lists enabled BYOK entries (BYOK: <displayName>) alongside platform models and the "Follow Agent Model" option
  • Send-time Reconciliation - Frontend keeps byok:<entryId> only as an internal selection token; on send, WebSocketMessageBuilder resolves it back to the real model and attaches the matching byok_config so server / agent never see the synthetic id
  • Handshake Carry-over - Selected BYOK entry travels through handshake / model-setting bridge so Switch Model / Enable Eco / cancel flows preserve user choice without falling back to default

Next Action / Next Prompts

  • Backend Hook-driven Advisory - SERVER_NEXT_ACTION is now produced by an agent-side hook, so prompts use the most reliable agent history and the user's locale, rather than being generated client-side
  • Client Hook Pipeline - Added session-level ChatHookPipeline / ChatExtension infra; NextPromptsExtension caches next_prompts on AdvisoryReceived, then publishes UI events on AFTER_CONVERSATION_COMPLETE so bubbles never appear while the previous round is still generating
  • History Persistence - next_action is bound to the conversation, so reopening from history shows the same suggestions instead of disappearing
  • Bubble UX - Bubbles render left-aligned with a 50% max-width (capped by actual width when narrower), entire row is clickable (not just the arrow), arrow icon corrected, top divider stays full-width

Eco Mode Popups

  • Out of Credits / Free Trial Card - Reworked ChatSubscribeNoticeView with horizontal Enable Eco Mode (ghost) + Get More Credits / Start FREE Trial (gradient) buttons. Enable Eco Mode switches the active session via SessionBridge.updateModelSetting() and replaces the button in-place with a ✓ Eco Mode enabled chip
  • Eco 5h / Weekly Limit Card - Reworked ChatPopupNotificationView (30010) with horizontal Switch to standard model + Upgrade plan. Card titles / descriptions strictly match backend EcoWindowLimitMessage / EcoWeeklyLimitMessage
  • Session-level Switching - Replaced incorrect GlobalStateManager.modelType writes with SessionBridge.updateModelSetting() carrying the right solutionName, so the active session's IsEcoSession actually flips on the server side
  • Settlement Misclassification Fix - ModelSetting.toModelSolutionName now always sends solutionName (including single-model and BYOK), preventing stale "Eco" sticky on the server when isCombination=false caused is_eco=true in settlement
  • Debug Injection - Added /debug:out_of_credits / /debug:trial / /debug:eco_window / /debug:eco_weekly chat commands for UI rehearsal without burning quota

Handshake Sync (SubAgent / Skill / Team)

  • SubAgent Change Listener - Added addChangeListener / fireChange() to SubagentRepository; FileSystemSubagentRepository fires after toggle / create / delete / copy / updateApiModel / updateTools / updateMcpServers / updateSkills
  • Skill Change Listener - FileSystemSkillsRepository install / uninstall / installFromZip / refresh and SkillsAppService.setSkillEnabled now propagate via fireChange()
  • Bootstrap Wiring - BootstrapService registers callbacks that run SessionManageHandler.invalidateAllSessions(), mirroring the existing IMcpHub tool-change pipeline; cleanup via Disposer
  • Team Switch Refresh - TeamService.switchToPersonal / switchToTeam now also calls GlobalStateManager.refreshDefaultModels() for every open project so model list re-pulls per Team context (X-Team-ID)
  • Behavior - Invalidation does not drop the WebSocket or interrupt streaming; it flips _requiresHandshake so the next send() re-handshakes with the freshest list. Empty toggles short-circuit to avoid no-op invalidations

Swing Rendering Fix (Clip Pollution / Ghosting)

  • Gradient Button Paint - ChatSubscribeNoticeView.createGradientButton.paintComponent previously used g2d.clip = roundRect + oldClip writeback (replace, not intersect), losing the ancestor clip and bleeding gradient pixels into ChatInputPanel. Now uses g.create() + g2d.clip(roundRect) + g2d.dispose()
  • Card paintChildren - Same antipattern fixed in the ChatSubscribeNoticeView root paintChildren override
  • Codebase-wide Sweep - Applied the g.create() / g.clip(Shape) / g.dispose() pattern to every other paintComponent mutating original Graphics clip: ChatInputPanel, ChatUserView, BackgroundLeafDecoration, RichTextEditor, DiscountCouponWidget, SettingsMCPContent

Subagent Settings UI

  • Card Layout Refactor - The subagent card was BorderLayout(12, 0) with avatar pinned to WEST, squeezing Model / MCP / Skills config rows into the right column. Refactored into BoxLayout.Y_AXIS: headerRow keeps avatar + title + actions; configBlock spans full card width so chips no longer wrap prematurely on narrow windows

Chat Message Action Bar

  • Copy - Hover-only icon button on finished assistant messages writes message.text to clipboard, flips to ✓ for 1.5s as feedback
  • Copy Conversation ID - More (⋯) opens a popup with Copy Conversation ID, which copies message.conversationId (covId, the session-level server id) for ops / billing debugging. Disabled when conversationId is blank

Other

  • Logout Reconnect Fix - LogoutSuccess now clears all sessions, preventing WebSocket auto-reconnect with the stale token resurrecting the old profile
  • Network Tab - Fixed Total: 0 and empty headers in HttpRequestLogger
  • Build Env Detection - Corrected dev-package environment detection
  • Default Preset Cleanup - Removed Efficiency preset from ModelConstants fallback list

1.0.7 - Tool Reliability & Checkpoint & Terminal Compatibility

Tool Reliability

  • File Deletion Fix (WriteTool / EditTool) - Fixed files being deleted after write/edit caused by the VFS Document API path. Both tools now use direct java.io.File.writeText() followed by an explicit LocalFileSystem.refreshAndFindFileByIoFile, eliminating the race that occasionally truncated or removed files
  • Newly Created Files Read Fix - Fixed ReadTool / EditTool / MultiEditTool reporting "File not found" for files just created by the AI or external processes. Added VfsFileUtils.findFileByPathOrRefresh() that triggers a synchronous VFS refresh on cache miss; ReadTool additionally falls back to direct File I/O as a final safety net
  • ReadTool Token-Based Limit - Replaced the legacy 256KB byte cap with a token-based limit (150k tokens) and a 10MB absolute fallback. Files are sized via the new TokenEstimator (heuristic-based, ASCII/CJK aware), so a single read now covers ~150k-token files instead of cutting off around ~70k tokens

Checkpoint

  • Expired Cleanup - Auto-cleanup checkpoint directories older than 7 days on IDE startup
  • Session Cleanup - Checkpoint disk files are now deleted when session history is deleted
  • Memory Leak Fix - Fixed CheckpointManager.dispose() never being called on session destroy
  • Rollback False Positive Fix - Fixed CheckpointTracker.commitExists() returning true for full 40-char hashes that don't actually exist in the shadow git (JGit repo.resolve() only validates string format, not object existence). Now verifies via RevWalk.parseCommit() and catches MissingObjectException / IncorrectObjectTypeException
  • Rollback Atomicity Fix - Fixed message history being truncated even when workspace file restore fully failed. Refactored restoreWorkspace to return a structured WorkspaceRestoreResult; the caller now aborts the restore when all intended files failed, preventing the "lost both files and chat history" disaster

Team

  • Team Switching - Added team context management with segmented control in Settings, supporting Personal / Team billing switch
  • X-Team-ID Header - All API requests now carry X-Team-ID header for team-aware billing
  • Context Persistence - Team context persisted via PasswordSafe, auto-restored on login and IDE restart

Auto-Approve

  • ~/.verdent Whitelist - File operations under ~/.verdent/ are now auto-approved regardless of approval mode
  • Tilde Expansion - Added expandTilde support in PathResolver for ~/ paths

Terminal Compatibility

  • Reworked Terminal Support - Fixed "Terminal content not available" on WebStorm / GoLand 2026.1+ where the new Reworked Terminal (com.intellij.terminal.frontend.view.impl.TerminalViewImpl$TerminalPanel) replaced the legacy JediTerm. TerminalSelectionService now detects EditorComponentImpl in the new terminal's component tree and extracts text via editor.document.text under a read action; legacy JediTerm widgets remain supported as fallback
  • Strict Class Matching Fix - Replaced fuzzy substringAfterLast class-name comparison with strict FQCN match, so the new TerminalViewImpl$TerminalPanel is no longer mis-identified as legacy jediterm.TerminalPanel

UI

  • Skill Path Display - Skill reference now shows actual path from SkillsRepository instead of hardcoded path

1.0.6 - Auth & Compatibility Fix

Auth

  • Login Failure Fix - Fixed login failing when API returns null for fields such as langChoices. JSON deserialization now coerces null to defaults instead of throwing
  • New Tab Re-login Fix - Fixed new editor tabs always showing login page even when already logged in

Compatibility

  • Exclude Android Studio & Gateway - Narrowed IDE compatibility to standard JetBrains IDEs

1.0.5 - Network & Diff & Theme Fix

Network

  • Reconnection Fix - Fixed "Network disconnected" UI persisting after network recovery. WebSocket now enters slow reconnect mode (60s interval) instead of giving up after max attempts

Diff & Review Changes

  • External File Diff - Added support for viewing diffs of files outside the current project directory via external file mirroring in shadow Git
  • Checkpoint Accuracy - Fixed intermittent empty diff caused by JGit racy-git optimization. Rewrote index update to bypass metadata comparison
  • Diff View Consistency - Fixed stale diff tab reuse and use checkpoint content for specific checkpoint comparisons
  • Repository Lifecycle - Fixed cached Git repository being prematurely closed

Theme Adaptation

  • Tooltip Color Fix - Fixed tooltip text invisible on light themes by unifying color source across all tooltip components

UI Layout

  • Bash Terminal Fix - Fixed bash command output header being obscured and right-side content being cut off when resizing the window
  • Code Block Fix - Fixed code block panels being clipped on the right side by constraining preferred width to parent container

1.0.4 - Performance & Windows Compatibility

Performance

  • BashTask CPU Fix - Fixed CPU explosion (600%+) caused by high-frequency full JSON serialization of accumulated shell output. Added 200ms throttle, 512KB output cap, and manual JSON string building
  • File Write Speed - Fixed first file write taking 60-120s on Windows by caching JGit Repository objects and pre-warming with initial empty commit

Windows Compatibility

  • Diff Missing Fix - Fixed "Review Changes" showing no diff on Windows due to path separator mismatch (\ vs /) in git index update
  • File Lock Resilience - Added git info/exclude patterns and exception handling for locked files during git add on Windows
  • File Path Fix - Fixed Review Changes file click using File() for cross-platform path joining

Tool Improvements

  • Write Outside Workspace - Removed workspace path restriction from WriteTool/EditTool/MultiEditTool; file access now controlled by approval flow
  • Skills Market Fix - Fixed empty skills market caused by JsonNull crash in API response parsing
  • YAML Parsing Fix - Fixed skill description showing raw ">" instead of actual text for YAML folded/literal scalars

UI & Navigation

  • File Open Threading Fix - Fixed WriteIntentReadAction error when opening files from MCP settings and file editor
  • @skills Feature - Added ability to mention skills in chat input via @ menu
  • User Rules Rename - Global user rules file renamed from user_rules.md to AGENT.md at ~/.verdent/

1.0.3 - Stability & UI Fix

Critical Fixes

  • UI Freeze Fix - Fixed Logback AsyncAppender blocking all DefaultDispatcher worker threads when queue is full, causing entire plugin to freeze
  • Multi-IDE Project Fix - Fixed Review Changes opening files in wrong IDE window when multiple JetBrains IDEs are open
  • Input Paste Crash Fix - Fixed plugin crash/freeze when selecting all content and pasting text or screenshots
  • Streaming UI Flickering Fix - Fixed overall streaming UI flickering by re-adding isValidateRoot to ChatBotView

SVG Rendering

SubAgent

idea-plugin.name: Code Intelligence MCP
idea-plugin.description:
Expose JetBrains IDE code analysis capabilities via MCP (Model Context Protocol) for integration with AI coding assistants like Claude Code.

Features

  • Find Symbol - Search for class, function, or variable definitions by name
  • Find References - Find all usages of a symbol across the project
  • Get Symbol Info - Get type information, documentation, and signatures
  • List File Symbols - List all symbols in a file with hierarchy
  • Get Diagnostics - Analyze specified files, including unsaved IDE contents
  • Get Call Hierarchy - Incoming/outgoing call graph with limits and completeness status
  • Find Implementations - Find implementations and overrides at a declaration or usage
  • Get Type Hierarchy - Get inheritance hierarchy for classes

Usage

  1. Install the plugin and restart IDE
  2. MCP server starts automatically on port 9876
  3. Connect Claude Code: claude mcp add intellij-mcp --transport http http://localhost:9876/mcp

Supported Languages

  • JavaScript/TypeScript (requires JavaScript plugin)
  • Vue.js (requires Vue.js plugin)
  • Python (requires Python plugin)
  • PHP (requires PHP plugin)
  • Java (requires Java plugin)
  • Kotlin (requires Kotlin plugin)
  • Rust (requires Rust plugin)
  • Go (requires Go plugin)
  • Swift (macOS only, requires Xcode or Swift toolchain)
  • C# (requires csharp-ls or OmniSharp language server)
  • Dart (requires Dart plugin)

Source code: GitHub
idea-plugin.change-notes:

idea-plugin.name: DDLABS-Snykomycin
idea-plugin.description:
Snykomycin is a free and open-source IntelliJ IDEA plugin designed to help developers swiftly remediate security vulnerabilities identified by the Snyk system. It intelligently upgrades dependency versions as prescribed by Snyk, ensuring projects remain resilient and secure. Currently, Snykomycin provides seamless support for Maven (pom.xml), Gradle (build.gradle), and NPM (package.json) ecosystems. Snykomycin supports the following environments:
  • Windows: 386, AMD64, and ARM64
  • MacOS: AMD64 and ARM64
  • Linux Alpine: 386 and AMD64
  • Linux: 386, AMD64, and ARM64

🔑Key Features:

  • Vulnerability Insights: Aggregates all dependency vulnerabilities reported by Snyk and presents them with clarity and precision.
  • Severity‑Based Visualization: Demonstrates vulnerabilities categorized by severity— Critical, High, Medium, and Low in a sortable tabular format.
  • One‑Click Remediation: Effortlessly upgrades fixable dependencies with a single click.
  • Contextual Integration: Offers a dedicated context menu, Snykomycin, with intuitive sub‑menus: “Show Snyk Issues” and “Update Dependencies.”

🌟 Why Snykomycin:

Security vulnerabilities are reported periodically by the Snyk system, requiring developers to manually retrieve information and update dependencies. It is a dilatory process and impedes the momentum of development. Snykomycin eliminates this friction by enabling rapid dependency upgrades within a minute and accelerates development velocity.

❤️ Why You’ll Love It

Synkomycin is a small light-weight plugin which acts as a small antidote to security vulnerabilities without any side effect. It is an attempt to turn chaos into clarity during development.

👉 Snykomycin: A creation from Tornado

From the visionary mind at Tornado comes Snykomycin — creafted by an Engineer to solve real problems and simplify developers’ lives. 🧐 Wanna to 🤝 join with me to a new challenging technical task ?

⚠️ Limitations

At present, Snykomycin does not provide automated upgrade, originating from transitive dependencies. Active development efforts are underway to extend support and deliver comprehensive resolution for all transitive dependency issues in future releases.

idea-plugin.name: Vestige - Temporal Code Intelligence
idea-plugin.description:
Know what you're about to break.

Vestige reads your local git history and answers the questions that matter right before you change code: what else changes with this file, who actually knows it, and what already constrains it.

Everything runs on your own machine against your own git history. No account, no sign-in, no telemetry.

What it does
  • Files that change together. History shows which files keep getting committed alongside the one you're editing, with the shared-commit count so you can judge it yourself. Co-change analysis is well established in research but almost nowhere in an editor.
  • Who to ask. If you're changing a file you have little history with, Vestige names the person who has most of it. The count of low-history contributors is the ownership signal with the strongest empirical support for predicting defects.
  • History of a selection. Select some lines and see how those lines got that way, not just who touched them last.
  • CODEOWNERS that tells the truth. Nothing validates that file. Vestige checks it against real history and reports owners who never committed, owners who have left, and lines the platform silently skips.
  • Recovering deleted code. Browse and restore files deleted from the repository, well beyond Local History's window.
  • Decisions in context. Architectural decision records surfaced against the code they constrain.
Honest about its numbers
  • The debt score ranks files within one repository. It is never shown as money or hours — converting an arbitrary score into a currency figure produces a confident number with nothing behind it.
  • Co-change is a suggestion, not a gate. It is shown with its evidence so you can disagree with it.
  • There is no leaderboard and no per-person productivity metric. Vestige reports facts about the codebase, not about people.
  • AI features are optional and off-limits when disabled: setting Disable AI makes those paths unreachable, not merely idle. Answers are always shown next to the commits they were drawn from.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Version 1.1.1 — IDE compatibility
  • Fixed: the plugin would not install on IntelliJ IDEA 2025.3, which reported "Not compatible with the version of your running IDE". 1.1.0 declared an upper compatibility bound of build 252, so 2025.3 (build 253) was refused even though the plugin runs correctly on it.
  • The upper bound has been removed rather than nudged forward. The Plugin Verifier finds no internal, experimental or non-extendable platform API usage anywhere in this plugin, so a hardcoded ceiling only ever becomes a wall on the next IDE release. Verified Compatible against builds 232, 252 and 253.
Version 1.1.0 — Freeze fix, honest metrics, new analysis
  • Fixed the IDE freezes. The real cause was uncancellable work holding the read lock: a keystroke needs the write lock and waits for every read action to release, which only happens at a cancellation check. The plugin had three. The dominant cost was a duplicate-code scan that compared every extracted pattern against every line window of every other file while recompiling its regexes in the inner loop; it is now an indexed clone detector. Two more paths ran a full tree diff for every commit pair on every tab switch and every save, and the health dashboard issued roughly 250 git calls from a panel constructor.
  • Cancellation throughout. Every file, commit and line loop now polls for cancellation, and ProcessCanceledException is rethrown rather than swallowed. History walks, project scans and snapshot storage are all bounded.
  • No more periodic re-analysis. Cache validity is keyed on the file's modification stamp instead of wall-clock age, so an idle IDE no longer re-analyses on a timer.
  • New: files that change together, with the shared-commit count as evidence.
  • New: history of the selected lines, answering how a block got that way rather than who touched it last.
  • New: CODEOWNERS audit — reports owners who never committed, owners inactive for six months, and lines the platform silently ignores.
  • New: who to ask — surfaces low-history contributors and names the file's main author, replacing the bus-factor score.
  • Removed the leaderboard. Ranking colleagues on git-derived statistics is not something this plugin should do.
  • Removed invented numbers. The "estimated remediation cost" was a score multiplied by a hardcoded hourly rate; a dashboard percentage and a "from last week" trend had no data behind them at all. All are gone.
  • Interface rebuilt. Panels now follow the IDE's own theme and fonts rather than a hardcoded dark palette that was unreadable on light themes, and the tool window builds one panel on open instead of eleven.
  • Removed dead subsystems that were unreachable, including one containing unbounded recursion.
Version 1.0.6.2
  • Bounded the analysis cache and made listener handling thread-safe. Note: this release's notes claimed to have resolved the UI freezes; it did not — the blocking work was untouched. That is fixed in 1.1.0.
Version 1.0.6.1
  • Asynchronous analysis engine, JCEF dashboard, local snapshot history, folder-level heatmaps.
Version 1.0.6
  • Marketplace icon, fixed an InstantiationException in the debt calculator, project view badges.

idea-plugin.name: vcs-auto-update
idea-plugin.description:
Vcs auto update

Automatically pull latest changes from remote before you push, avoiding Git conflicts in IntelliJ IDEA.

Features

  • 🔄 Auto Pull Before Push: Automatically triggers a git pull operation whenever you initiate a push from the IDE.
  • ⚡ Conflict Prevention: Ensures your local branch is up-to-date with the remote branch before attempting to push, significantly reducing merge conflicts.
  • 🔔 Smart Notifications: Provides balloon notifications for successful or failed pull operations.
  • ⚙️ Configurable Options:
    • Enable/Disable auto-pull globally.
    • Choose between git pull (merge) and git pull --rebase.
    • Toggle notifications.
  • 🛠️ Manual Pull Action: Adds a "Pull from Remote" action in the VCS group (after the Push action) for quick manual updates.

How it works

The plugin listens for the Vcs.Push action invoked within IntelliJ IDEA. When detected, it executes a background pull operation according to your settings. After the pull completes, it automatically refreshes the local file system (VFS) and Git status so you see the changes immediately.

Usage

  1. Go to Settings: Navigate to Settings → Tools → Vcs auto update.
  2. Enable Feature: Check the "Auto pull before push" option.
  3. Configure Style: Choose "Use rebase when pulling" if you prefer a cleaner commit history.
  4. Push as usual: Use Git → Push or the toolbar button. The plugin will handle the pull automatically.

Requirements

  • IntelliJ IDEA 2024.2+
  • Git integration enabled

License

MIT

idea-plugin.name: gradle-module-sleep
idea-plugin.description:
Gradle Module Sleep: Smart On-Demand Module Loading for Large Projects

Monorepo brings scale, but it also brings pain: endless Gradle syncs, bloated IDE memory, and the daily chore of toggling modules just to stay productive. This plugin is the antidote: it loads only the modules you are actively working on, so your IDE stays fast without editing settings.gradle.kts by hand.

Monorepo 带来了规模，也带来了痛点：Gradle 同步漫长、IDE 内存暴涨、每天都要手动开关模块才能保持效率。 该插件就是解法：只加载你正在工作的模块，让 IDE 保持轻快，无需手改 settings.gradle.kts。

Major Refactor Release

This release is a major refactor with updated toolbar behavior and clearer module-loading semantics.

本次为大重构版本，更新了工具条行为并明确了模块加载语义。

Gradle Module Sleep supercharges your IDE performance by intelligently loading only the Gradle modules you are actively working on. Say goodbye to long sync times and high memory usage in large multi-module projects.

？ (Do you face these problems?)

  1. Gradle Sync is painfully slow 🐌

    • A project with 50+ modules takes 5-10 minutes to sync.
    • Changing one line of code means a long wait for Gradle to re-index.

  2. IDE memory usage is through the roof 💥

    • IntelliJ IDEA consumes 8GB+ of memory, causing your computer's fan to spin wildly.
    • Other applications become sluggish after opening a large project.

  3. Most modules are not even used 😤

    • Out of 100 modules, you might only be working on 3-5 at any given time.
    • But the IDE loads all of them, wasting resources.

  4. Manually managing settings.gradle.kts is a nightmare 😩

    • Commenting out unused modules? That leads to merge conflicts with your team.
    • Different team members need different sets of active modules.

(The Solution)

Gradle Module Sleep solves these problems with an on-demand loading strategy:

Traditional ApproachWith Gradle Module Sleep
Load all 100 modulesLoad only the 5 you use
Sync takes 10 minutesSync takes 30 seconds
Memory usage: 8GBMemory usage: 2GB
Manual settings.gradle.kts editsFully automatic, based on open files

The principle is simple: The plugin loads only the modules for the files you have open, including their recursive dependencies.

(Features)

  • On-Demand Loading: Automatically loads modules corresponding to your open editor tabs. Unused modules are not loaded.
  • Recursive Dependency Detection: Intelligently analyzes and loads all transitive project dependencies (implementation(project(":..."))) to ensure your project compiles successfully.
  • Editor-based Controls: A convenient notification banner appears on settings.gradle.kts and build.gradle.kts files for quick access to sleep/wake actions.
  • Smart Exclusion: Build-related modules like build-logic and buildSrc are automatically ignored to prevent build issues.
  • (Experimental) Auto-Sleep: Automatically unloads modules that have been idle to conserve memory.
  • Smart Toggle: Module sleeping is enabled by default for projects with 30+ modules, but you can configure this.

(How to Use)

Once the plugin is installed, it works automatically. For manual control, open a settings.gradle.kts or build.gradle.kts file to see the control banner at the top of the editor.

A control banner will appear at the top of your settings.gradle.kts or build.gradle.kts file with the following actions:

  • Sleep other modules: Unloads all modules except those related to your currently open files.
  • Sleep other modules (keep this tab module only): Closes all other editor tabs and then unloads all modules except for the one related to your currently active file. This is perfect for focusing on a single task.
  • Clean all modules: Restores all modules in the project.
  • Close: Hides the banner for the current file until the project is reopened.

Floating toolbar behavior

The input field defines modules that must always be loaded for this project. The action buttons perform on-demand loading based on open tabs or the current file. Use the X button to hide this notification.

浮动工具条说明

输入框里填写的模块是“必加载”的项目级模块；其余按钮是基于打开标签或当前文件的按需加载。 右上角的 X 可隐藏该通知。

(Recursive Dependency Detection)

A key feature is the intelligent analysis of your module graph. When you open a file, the plugin:

  1. Detects the module the file belongs to (e.g., :plugins:autoddl).
  2. Parses that module's build.gradle.kts file.
  3. Extracts all project dependencies.
  4. Recursively processes each dependency to build a complete dependency tree.
  5. Applies this list of active modules to your settings.gradle.kts.

This ensures that even with only a few files open, your project remains fully compilable and navigable.

Supported Dependency Formats

1. Standard project() syntax

dependencies {
    implementation(project(":lib:tool-swing"))
}

2. Type-safe Project Accessors syntax

dependencies {
    implementation(projects.lib.toolSwing)
}

Tips

For small projects where you want all modules loaded, you can use the author's other plugin

// add in your settings.gradle.kts
plugins {
    id("site.addzero.gradle.plugin.modules-buddy") version "+"
}
autoModules {
    excludeModules = arrayOf("jackson", "script","pp", "lsi-ksp")
}

Pro: 4.90 per month or49 per year

  • Proxy support for the usage API request: auto-detects HTTPS_PROXY/HTTP_PROXY from ~/.claude/settings.json (falling back to the environment variables), with a new "Proxy URL" setting to override it manually (supports http://user:pass@host:port)
  • SOCKS proxy URLs (socks://, socks4://, socks5://) are recognised as SOCKS proxies instead of being treated as HTTP proxies
  • New proxy error state: HTTP 407, a failed CONNECT tunnel or an unreachable proxy is now reported as a proxy problem with an actionable hint, instead of a generic "offline"
  • Proxy URL "none" forces a direct connection even when HTTPS_PROXY is set, and a malformed Proxy URL is now rejected when applying settings instead of silently connecting directly
0.3.1
  • Live usage popup: the refresh button now shows a countdown until it is available again, and usage values update in place without closing/reopening the popup
  • Optional IDE notification when the status bar quota crosses the yellow or red threshold (configurable in settings, on by default)
  • Settings button added to the usage popup, next to Refresh, for quick access to plugin settings
  • Fixed black/empty usage popup on the macOS Metal rendering pipeline (reported on WebStorm 2026.1 / macOS 26): the popup content now paints an explicit opaque background and forces a repaint once shown
0.3.0
  • macOS Keychain support: reads OAuth tokens from the Keychain (where Claude Code now stores them), with fallback to the credentials file
  • New "Use macOS Keychain" setting (default on, macOS only)
  • Dedicated error states and actionable popup hints for keychain access denied / prompt timeout
  • On first run, macOS will prompt once for keychain access — click Always Allow for your IDE
0.2.4
  • Fixed parse error when API returns null reset time for unused quotas (widget no longer falls into error state)
  • Configurable auto-refresh interval (1–60 minutes, default 1 minute)
  • Manual refresh button now has its own 5-second cooldown, independent of the auto-refresh interval
  • Reset time hidden in UI when API reports no reset
  • Max backoff on errors increased to 60 minutes
0.2.3
  • Refresh button disabled when last fetch was less than 1 minute ago
  • Exponential backoff on all API errors to reduce unnecessary calls
0.2.2
  • Countdown timer now shows days when reset time exceeds 24 hours (e.g. "2d 14h 1m")
0.2.1
  • Updated User-Agent header to fix usage API that stopped working
  • Exponential backoff retry on rate limiting
0.2.0
  • Settings panel (Settings → Tools → Claude Code Usage): configurable quota display, warning thresholds, credentials path
  • Refresh button in usage popup
  • Error state display with actionable hints
  • Dark and light theme support
  • Fixed widget visibility issues
  • Platform version bumped to 2024.1+

idea-plugin.name: Git AI
idea-plugin.description:
Git AI tracks code generated by AI coding agents in your JetBrains IDE.

When AI agents like GitHub Copilot make edits, Git AI automatically records which lines were AI-generated along with the agent and model that wrote them. On commit, this attribution data is saved to Git Notes, enabling:

  • AI Blame - See which lines were written by AI and the prompts that generated them
  • AI contribution stats - Track how much of your codebase is AI-generated
  • Cross-agent tracking - Works with Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, and more

Requires the git-ai CLI to be installed. Learn more at usegitai.com.

idea-plugin.name: package-fixer
idea-plugin.description:
Package Fixer is an IntelliJ IDEA plugin action that aligns Java and Kotlin

package declarations with the directory structure for selected folders.

Usage

  1. Ensure the target directories are under a marked Source Root.
  2. Select one or more directories in the Project view.
  3. Run "(package-fixer) Fix Package Declarations (Recursive)" from the context menu.
  4. Review the notification summary.

Supported Files

  • .java (PsiJavaFile)
  • .kt (KtFile, non-script)

Not Supported

  • .kts scripts
  • Import statements (only package declarations are updated)
  • Files outside recognized source roots

How It Works

  • Expected package is resolved via JavaDirectoryService for each file's parent directory.
  • Java package is updated through PsiJavaFile.
  • Kotlin package directive is created or replaced via KtPsiFactory.

Requirements

  • IntelliJ IDEA with Java and Kotlin plugins enabled.

License

  • See the root LICENSE.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Changelog

  • Progress indicator and summary notifications.
  • Plugin icon.

idea-plugin.name: IntelliAI Terminal
idea-plugin.description:
IntelliAI Terminal

Powered by IntelliAI Engine: Seamlessly integrates with IntelliAI Engine to provide unified, pluggable, and high-performance AI capabilities ⚡

GitHub | Issues | Homepage

Generate executable shell commands directly in the IntelliJ IDEA terminal using natural language. No need to memorize complex shell syntax or switch windows to look up documentation. Simply type a description and press TAB to get the right command.

Why This Plugin?

When you're already working in the terminal, why switch to a separate AI CLI tool?

Existing AI tools (such as Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI) are powerful, but they're designed for complex tasks, long interactions, and multi-step reasoning. In real engineering practice, most terminal operations are actually temporary, frequent, one-off simple queries or operations.

For this one command, you shouldn't have to switch tool windows, enter AI interaction mode, or re-describe context. Our plugin chooses to integrate rather than replace: it doesn't change your terminal, reshape your habits, or introduce new cognitive load. It only helps you fill in that one command when you need it.

Key Features

  • 🚀 Natural Language → Executable Shell Commands: Type descriptions in Chinese or English, automatically generate executable commands
  • ⚡ Tab-Based Inline Completion: No window switching needed, type # + description, press Tab to generate commands
  • 🧠 Context-Aware Command Generation: Automatically detects Git / Docker / Kubernetes / build tools, generates more project-appropriate commands
  • 🛡 Only Outputs Runnable Commands: No explanations, no Markdown, generated content can be directly copied or executed
  • 📐 Readable Long Commands: Long commands are automatically formatted using \ for better readability and maintainability

Usage

  • Open Terminal (Alt+F12 or View → Tool Windows → Terminal)
  • Type a natural language description starting with trigger prefix (default #), e.g.: # List all Python files in current directory
  • Press TAB to trigger AI generation
  • Generated command will automatically replace the current line, ready to execute or continue editing

Design Philosophy

This plugin follows three core principles:

  • Minimal Cognitive Load - No new workflow, no new command system, just add a TAB key to existing terminal habits
  • Single Responsibility - Do one thing only: convert natural language to executable shell commands
  • Fail Safe - Even if it fails, the worst case is just "no command generated", no irreversible impact

Good tools don't make you do more, they make you less interrupted.

Differences from Other AI Tools

Capability Claude Code / Codex / Gemini CLI IntelliAI Terminal
Use directly in terminal ❌ ✅
One-key completion ❌ ✅
Automatic context ❌ ✅
Only outputs commands ❌ ✅
Suitable for real engineering scenarios ❌ ✅

In one sentence: This is AI designed for "engineers typing commands", not a chatbot.

Configuration

Configuration path: Settings → Tools → IntelliAI Engine → 🧩 IntelliAI Terminal

  • Enable/disable Terminal AI (enabled by default)
  • Configure trigger prefix (default #)
  • Select AI provider (defaults to first verified global provider)
  • Customize system and user prompt templates (advanced settings)

Requirements

  • IntelliJ IDEA 2025.3+: Plugin requires IntelliJ IDEA 2025.3 or higher (Terminal API requires 2025.3+)
  • IntelliAI Engine Plugin: Must install IntelliAI Engine plugin and configure at least one AI provider
  • AI Provider Configuration: Configure and verify at least one AI provider in Settings → Tools → IntelliAI Engine

IntelliAI Terminal

⚡ 由 IntelliAI Engine 驱动：深度集成 IntelliAI Engine，提供统一、可扩展、高性能的 AI 能力支持

GitHub | Issues | Homepage

在 IntelliJ IDEA 的终端里，用自然语言直接生成可执行命令。无需记忆复杂的 shell 语法，无需切换窗口查找文档，只需输入描述，按 TAB 键即可获得正确的命令。

为什么选择这个插件？

当你已经在终端里工作时，为什么还要切换到一个独立的 AI CLI 工具？

现有 AI 工具（如 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI）非常强大，但它们适合复杂任务、长时间交互和多步推理。而在真实工程实践中，大多数终端操作其实是临时的、高频的、一次性的简单查询或操作。

为了这一行命令，你不应该切换工具窗口、进入 AI 交互模式、重新描述上下文。我们的插件选择融入，而不是替代：不改变你的终端，不重塑你的习惯，不引入新的心智负担。它只在你需要的时候，轻轻帮你补上那一行命令。

核心特性

  • 🚀 自然语言生成 Shell 命令：在终端输入中文或英文描述，自动生成可直接执行的命令
  • ⚡ Tab 一键补全，不打断操作流：无需切换窗口，输入 # + 描述，按 Tab 即可生成命令
  • 🧠 基于当前目录的智能上下文感知：自动识别 Git / Docker / Kubernetes / 构建工具，生成更贴合项目的命令
  • 🛡 只生成可运行命令，无多余废话：不输出解释、不输出 Markdown，生成内容可直接复制或执行
  • 📐 复杂命令自动换行，清晰可读：长命令自动使用 \ 拆分，兼顾可读性与可维护性

使用方式

  • 打开 Terminal（Alt+F12 或 视图 → 工具窗口 → Terminal）
  • 输入自然语言描述，以触发前缀开头（默认 #），例如：# 列出当前目录下所有 Python 文件
  • 按 TAB 键触发 AI 生成
  • 生成的命令会自动替换当前行，可以直接执行或继续编辑

设计理念

这个插件遵循三个核心原则：

  • 最小认知负担 - 没有新的工作流，没有新的命令系统，只是在原有终端习惯上加一个 TAB 键
  • 单一职责 - 只做一件事：将自然语言转换为可执行的 shell 命令
  • 安全失败 - 即使失败，最坏情况也只是"没有生成命令"，不会产生不可逆影响

好的工具，不是让你做得更多，而是让你更少被打断。

与其他 AI 工具的区别

能力 Claude Code / Codex / Gemini CLI IntelliAI Terminal
在终端里直接用 ❌ ✅
一键补全 ❌ ✅
自动上下文 ❌ ✅
只输出命令 ❌ ✅
适合真实工程场景 ❌ ✅

一句话总结：这是为"正在敲命令的工程师"设计的 AI，而不是聊天机器人。

配置说明

配置路径：Settings → Tools → IntelliAI Engine → 🧩 IntelliAI Terminal

  • 启用/禁用 Terminal AI（默认已启用）
  • 配置触发前缀（默认 #）
  • 选择 AI 服务商（默认使用全局第一个已验证的服务商）
  • 自定义系统提示词和用户提示词模板（高级设置）

系统要求

  • IntelliJ IDEA 2025.3+：插件需要 IntelliJ IDEA 2025.3 或更高版本（Terminal API 要求 2025.3+）
  • IntelliAI Engine 插件：必须安装 IntelliAI Engine 插件并配置至少一个 AI 服务商
  • AI 服务商配置：在 Settings → Tools → IntelliAI Engine 中配置并验证至少一个 AI 服务商

idea-plugin.name: OpenCode Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Seamlessly integrate OpenCode CLI with your JetBrains IDE. Send selected code directly to OpenCode with full context - file paths, line numbers, and custom instructions.

Features

  • Send Code with Context - Select code and send it with automatic file path and line number references
  • Quick Templates - Pre-defined prompts: Explain, Refactor, Write Tests, Fix Bugs, Optimize, Document, Review
  • Agent Selection - Choose from available agents (build, oracle, explore, librarian, etc.) - auto-discovered from server
  • Session Targeting - Select specific OpenCode sessions or auto-detect the active one
  • TUI Mode - Append code references to your terminal TUI prompt for review before sending
  • Auto-Submit - Optionally auto-submit after appending in TUI mode
  • Server Discovery - Scan for running OpenCode instances across multiple ports

Keyboard Shortcuts

  • Cmd+Shift+. (Mac) / Ctrl+Shift+. (Win/Linux) - Send to OpenCode with dialog
  • Cmd+Alt+. (Mac) / Ctrl+Alt+. (Win/Linux) - Quick send without dialog

Getting Started

  1. Start OpenCode with a known port: opencode --port 4096
  2. Select code in your editor
  3. Press Cmd+Shift+. or right-click → Send to OpenCode...
  4. Choose a template, agent, and add context
  5. Press Enter to send

Configuration

Go to Settings → Tools → OpenCode Companion to configure server URL, authentication, TUI mode, and default agent.
