idea-plugin.name: Claude/Codex Session Manager
idea-plugin.description:
Persist and restore Claude Code and Codex terminal sessions across IDE restarts

Never lose your Claude Code or Codex conversations when closing IntelliJ. This plugin continuously detects and saves active agent sessions, then restores them in their recorded Classic or Reworked Terminal engine when you reopen a trusted project on Linux or macOS.

Features

  • Automatic save/restore — active Claude and Codex sessions are continuously persisted and restored as terminal tabs the next time a trusted project opens. No manual steps required.
  • Live terminal renaming — terminal tabs are automatically renamed to reflect the agent session name, git branch, or session ID.
  • Safe tab reuse — reuses only one unique idle same-engine tab with an exact title and canonical working-directory match. Ambiguous and unrelated tabs are never managed.
  • Classic and Reworked Terminal — preserves each session's terminal engine. Reworked support uses JetBrains' public experimental API and safely degrades if that API is unavailable or returns incomplete tab/process information.
  • IDE window isolation — sessions are scoped to terminal tabs owned by the current IntelliJ project window, even when the agent runs from another working directory.
  • Policy support — restores sessions with agent-specific permission, sandbox, approval, model, and reasoning settings where available.
  • Manual controls — save and restore sessions on demand via Tools → Claude/Codex Sessions.

How it works

Claude discovery uses claude agents --json, with validated PID records as a fallback. Codex discovery reads open rollout JSONL files through process metadata. On restore, the plugin safely reuses one exact idle same-engine match or creates a new tab in the recorded engine and runs the appropriate agent resume command. Ambiguous, active, unrelated, and other-engine tabs are never closed or reused. Failed restores can be retried with defaults in the same engine or explicitly moved to the other terminal engine while preserving saved agent settings.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
2.2.0

  • Added Reworked Terminal support through JetBrains' public experimental API.
  • Preserves the recorded terminal engine during restoration and offers explicit cross-engine retry.
  • Safely degrades discovery when Reworked tab or process information is incomplete.
  • Never manages ambiguous, unrelated, active, or other-engine terminal tabs.
  • Continues to support Classic Terminal plus Claude and Codex restoration on Linux and macOS.

2.1.0

  • Added Codex session persistence and restore alongside Claude Code.
  • Detects sessions by IntelliJ Terminal ownership instead of requiring the agent working directory to be inside the opened project.
  • Preserves each session's exact working directory on restore, including directories outside the IntelliJ project root.
  • Restores Codex sessions with their resume ID plus supported model, reasoning, sandbox, and approval settings.
  • Supports Codex session detection on Linux and macOS.
  • Hardened discovery, restoration lifecycle, and atomic persistence against partial failures.
  • Supports Classic Terminal tabs only.
  • Keeps saved sessions scoped to the IntelliJ project window that owned the terminal tab.

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • Automatic session detection, save, and restore
  • Live terminal tab renaming from session metadata
  • Smart reuse of IDE-restored terminal tabs
  • Ghost restoration prevention for external sessions
  • Manual save/restore actions in Tools menu

idea-plugin.name: CC AI Toolkit
idea-plugin.description:
CC AI Toolkit - Claude Code / Codex Workflow GUI

CC AI Toolkit：面向 Claude Code、Codex 与扩展技能工作流的图形化插件

  • Claude Code Anthropic 官方 AI 编程助手（支持 Opus 4.6 等多模型）
  • OpenAI Codex - OpenAI 强大的代码生成引擎
  • BMad / Design / GitNexus - 可视化接入常用工作流与仓库分析能力

Connection & proxy disclosure / 连接与代理说明：

  • By default, requests are sent directly to the official Anthropic API (or OpenAI API for Codex).
  • Users may optionally configure a third-party or proxy endpoint in Provider Settings. When a non-official base URL is set, the plugin UI clearly labels the request route as proxied before it is used.
  • Users can freely switch between direct and proxy modes at any time in the provider settings.

默认情况下，请求直接发送到 Anthropic（或 OpenAI）官方 API。用户可在供应商设置中选配第三方或代理端点，插件 UI 会在使用前明确标注请求路由方式。用户可随时在直连与代理模式间自由切换。

Credential & file-access disclosure / 凭证与文件访问说明：

  • No silent credential scanning. The plugin never silently scans your disk for API keys or tokens. All credential sources require explicit user authorization via a confirmation dialog in the plugin UI.
  • Provider credentials: Users enter API keys manually in the provider settings UI, or explicitly authorize reading from ~/.claude/settings.json, or explicitly authorize delegating to the Claude SDK's native OAuth flow (CLI Login).
  • MCP server configuration: When the user opens the MCP settings page, the plugin reads MCP server definitions (server names, commands, arguments) from ~/.claude.json. This file contains no credentials or tokens — only MCP server configuration metadata managed by the Claude CLI.

插件不会静默扫描磁盘上的凭证。所有凭证来源均需用户在 UI 中显式授权确认。MCP 服务器配置仅在用户打开 MCP 设置页面时读取，该文件仅含服务器定义，不含任何凭证或令牌。

核心功能

  • 上下文感知助手：智能编程助手，支持 @文件引用
  • 图片支持：发送图片可视化描述需求
  • Agent 系统：内置智能体自动化执行复杂任务
  • Skills 命令：斜杠命令系统（/init, /review 等）
  • MCP 服务器：通过 MCP 协议扩展 AI 能力
  • 代码 DIFF：可视化代码对比和文件导航
  • 对话回退：灵活调整对话历史
  • 会话管理：历史记录、收藏、搜索和导出
  • 主题支持：深色/浅色主题，支持 IDE 字体同步
  • 权限控制：完善的安全管理
  • 供应商管理：兼容 cc-switch

使用方法

  • 从右侧边栏打开 CC AI Toolkit 工具窗口
  • 选中代码后使用 Ctrl+Alt+K（Win/Linux）或 Cmd+Alt+K（Mac）发送给 AI
  • 即时获得 AI 驱动的代码辅助和智能建议

idea-plugin.name: kcloud
idea-plugin.description:
kcloud is the initial IDEA plugin version for KCloud.

Current scope in this first IDEA plugin version:

  • adds a gutter icon on generated Kotlin API declarations
  • reads the KDoc source hint like 原始文件: site.addzero.kcloud.vibepocket.routes.Favorite.kt
  • jumps from the generated declaration back to the original Kotlin source file
  • provides a local KCloud config-center tool window backed by SQLite
  • provides IDE settings for the shared SQLite storage path
  • provides a Kotlin/JVM Alt+Enter intention that extracts property initializer literals into the KCloud config center
  • provides a dedicated Kotlin/JVM Alt+Enter intention that rewrites hardcoded KCloud local endpoint URLs to KCloudLocalServerEndpoint.currentBaseUrl()

This is still the initial IDEA plugin release. The scope is intentionally focused and not the full KCloud IDE toolset yet.

Current behavior

When a Kotlin declaration contains a KDoc source reference, kcloud shows a gutter icon next to the declaration name. Clicking the icon navigates to the referenced source file inside the current IntelliJ project.

Open View -> Tool Windows -> KCloud Config to manage key/value entries by project namespace and profile. The storage schema follows the same entry/profile/namespace/storage-mode model used by the KCloud config-center runtime.

In Kotlin/JVM source files, place the caret on a property initializer literal and use Alt+Enter -> 提取到 KCloud 配置中心. The plugin stores the value in SQLite and replaces the literal with a JVM-safe System.getProperty(...) ?: default expression.

For KCloud desktop local endpoint constants such as http://localhost:18080/, use Alt+Enter -> 替换为 KCloud 本地端点. The plugin rewrites the literal to KCloudLocalServerEndpoint.currentBaseUrl() and removes const when required so the declaration stays valid.

Current limitations

  • target resolution is file-based, not symbol-based
  • the source hint must follow the 原始文件: <qualified.file.Name>.kt format
  • only the current project scope is searched
  • literal extraction is currently limited to Kotlin/JVM property initializers
  • local endpoint replacement is intentionally limited to the KCloud desktop loopback URLs on Kotlin/JVM property initializers
  • the GUI currently focuses on config entries and does not yet expose render targets

Development

Build the plugin from the IntelliJ workspace root:

./gradlew :plugins:kcloud:buildPlugin

idea-plugin.name: AI Text Polisher
idea-plugin.description:
AI Text Polisher is a lightweight, distraction-free writing assistant built into your IDE. Select any text, press ⌘⇧D (macOS) or ⊞⇧D (Windows), and get AI-refined text back in seconds — without switching apps, copying to a chat window, or breaking your flow.

Works everywhere you write: commit messages, docstrings, README files, inline comments, changelogs, API descriptions, or any other text in any file type.

✦ 7 AI Providers, One Plugin

Connect to the model you already use. Each provider is pre-configured with a working default endpoint and model — add your API key and you're ready.

  • Anthropic — Claude Haiku, Sonnet, and Opus; best-in-class writing quality
  • OpenAI — GPT-4o and GPT-4o mini; the most widely used AI API
  • DeepSeek — deepseek-chat and deepseek-reasoner; excellent value
  • Groq — Llama 3.3, Mixtral; blazing fast inference, ideal for quick edits
  • Mistral — mistral-large, mistral-small; strong European alternative
  • Gemini — Gemini 2.0 Flash and Pro; Google's latest multimodal models
  • Ollama — any local model (Llama, Mistral, Phi, …); fully offline, zero cost

All OpenAI-compatible endpoints are supported. Use the Endpoint field to point at a private proxy, a corporate gateway, or any self-hosted inference server.

✦ Four Enhancement Modes

Choose the mode that matches your goal:

  • Correct Only — silently fixes spelling and grammar. Your voice, your structure, your word choices — completely untouched. Great for proofreading without AI rewriting.
  • Rephrase — rewrites for natural, fluent expression while preserving your original meaning. Removes awkward phrasing, redundant words, and unnatural rhythm.
  • Formal — elevates casual or draft language to professional, publication-ready tone. Ideal for documentation, release notes, and external-facing content.
  • Concise — strips filler words and compresses verbose sentences. Say exactly what you mean in half the space.

✦ Multilingual Output

Write in one language, polish in another — or keep the same language but target a specific regional standard. Ten target languages supported: English, Chinese (Simplified), French, German, Spanish, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, and Italian.

Pair any mode with a custom instruction for fine-grained control: "Use British English", "Keep all technical terms as-is", "Write for a non-technical audience" — the AI follows your lead.

✦ Review Before You Apply

You control what gets changed. Three result modes to match your workflow:

  • Inline popup (default) — a compact overlay anchored just below your selection shows the polished text immediately. Hit Apply to replace, View Diff for a side-by-side comparison, or Dismiss to discard — all without moving your cursor.
  • Diff view — opens a full IDE diff panel with the original on the left and the polished text on the right. Apply and Dismiss are built directly into the dialog — no extra confirmation step.
  • Auto-apply — replaces the selected text immediately, no preview. Best for high-confidence tasks like grammar correction when you trust the model.

✦ Per-Provider Configuration

Each provider remembers its own endpoint, model, and API key independently. Switching from Claude to GPT-4o to a local Ollama model is a single dropdown click — no re-entering credentials, no reconfiguring endpoints.

✦ Secure by Default

API keys are stored exclusively in the OS credential manager: Keychain on macOS, Credential Manager on Windows. They are never written to AITextPolisher.xml or any project file, and never appear in version control. The plugin reads keys on a background thread to avoid UI freezes on credential store access.

Getting Started

  1. Open Settings → Tools → AI Text Polisher
  2. Select a provider, paste your API key — the model field auto-fills with a recommended default
  3. Select any text in the editor
  4. Press ⌘⇧D (macOS) / ⊞⇧D (Windows), or right-click → AI Text Polisher: Enhance
  5. Review the result in the popup and choose Apply, View Diff, or Dismiss

Keyboard Shortcut

Default: ⌘⇧D on macOS · ⊞⇧D on Windows.
To reassign, go to Settings → Keymap, search AI Text Polisher, and set any shortcut you prefer.

idea-plugin.name: Clauditor - Claude Code Session Manager
idea-plugin.description:
Clauditor manages your Claude Code sessions from inside your JetBrains IDE. Browse, search, resume, and fork sessions; run them in git worktrees; and watch their status live — without leaving the editor or juggling terminal windows.

Session Management

  • Browse, search, resume, fork, and delete sessions from a dedicated tool window
  • Sessions open as editor tabs with embedded terminals — arrange them alongside source files
  • Open sessions persist across IDE restarts
  • Purge old sessions in bulk by age

External Session Detection

  • Detects Claude sessions running in external terminals (iTerm, VS Code, etc.)
  • External sessions shown with distinct icon and grayed out in the session list
  • Tabs for externally-open sessions show an info panel with auto-resume when the external session closes

Git Worktree Support

  • Create isolated Claude sessions in git worktrees with their own branches; creation dialog surfaces base-branch state so you know when local main is ahead/behind the remote
  • Worktree toolbar with commit, PR, rebase, and merge controls, plus open-in-IDE/terminal/file-manager shortcuts
  • Worktrees tab lists orphaned worktrees (directories with no session) with actions to start a session there or delete the worktree
  • Git column in the Worktrees tab shows uncommitted file counts and commits not yet in your project branch, so work you forgot to commit or merge is visible without opening each worktree
  • Show Changes: review a worktree's diff in a tree + inline-diff browser — its commits vs the base branch, plus uncommitted working-tree changes — from the Worktrees tab or session toolbar

Live Status & Context

  • Tab indicators: thinking, idle, waiting for permission, compacting, unresponsive (⊘)
  • Automatic detection of frozen/unresponsive CLI sessions with reconnect prompt
  • Context usage progress bar and model info per session
  • Effort level and extended-thinking state shown in the tab status bar (CLI 2.1.119+)
  • Status panel shows 5h/7d rate-limit bars on subscription plans (Pro/Max), or a usage & budget link for non-subscription plans (e.g. Enterprise), plus auth status
  • CLI version in status bar links to release notes
  • Browse and insert rules, agents, skills, and memory files from the Context panel
  • Scratchpad tab browses the working files Claude writes during a session (probes, logs, captured output) — grouped by session, newest first, with open/copy-path/reveal actions

Editor Integration

  • Drag and drop files onto session tabs to insert their paths
  • Git toolbar with branch, change count, and session-aware diffing
  • Message history sidebar for navigating conversations
  • Model switcher and one-click /effort max button in the session toolbar

Settings Panel

  • Configure under Settings > Tools > Clauditor
  • Unresponsive timeout, claude binary path, default session args
  • Status line refresh interval (requires CLI 2.1.97+)
  • Branch status refresh interval for worktree/git toolbars
  • Background pool max threads (cap on Clauditor's owned thread pool, isolated from IDE-shared pool)
  • Environment variable toggles: COLORTERM=truecolor, telemetry, update check, prompt caching
  • Custom environment variables (KEY=VALUE) with link to Claude Code env var docs

Requires Claude Code CLI installed and available on your PATH.

idea-plugin.name: ForceField AI Security Scanner
idea-plugin.description:
AI Security Scanner for JetBrains IDEs

ForceField detects prompt injection, PII leaks, jailbreaks, and LLM attacks directly in your IDE. Scan prompts, audit code, and run security evals without leaving PyCharm, IntelliJ, or WebStorm.

Features

  • Scan Selection -- right-click any text to scan for prompt injection, role escalation, data exfiltration, and 13+ attack categories
  • Audit File -- scan the current file for hardcoded prompts, PII (SSN, credit cards, API keys, emails), and security issues
  • Audit Project -- scan your entire project directory in one click
  • Selftest -- run 116 built-in attack prompts to verify detection (100% detection rate with ML)
  • Security Eval -- run the full security evaluation suite with per-category reporting
  • Results Panel -- dedicated tool window with color-coded output

What It Detects

  • Prompt injection (10 regex categories, 60+ patterns, TF-IDF ML ensemble)
  • PII exposure (18 types: SSN, credit card, email, phone, IBAN, JWT, API keys)
  • Jailbreak attempts and role escalation
  • System prompt extraction
  • Data exfiltration (JSON payloads, obfuscated destinations)
  • Anti-obfuscation (zero-width chars, homoglyphs, leetspeak, base64)
  • Dangerous terminal commands and security-sensitive filenames

How It Works

The plugin wraps the ForceField Python CLI, the same engine that powers the ForceField cloud gateway. All scanning runs locally -- no data leaves your machine.

Getting Started

  1. Install the Python SDK: pip install forcefield (or pip install forcefield[ml] for ML-powered detection)
  2. Open any project in your JetBrains IDE
  3. Use Tools > ForceField or right-click selected text

Works With

PyCharm, IntelliJ IDEA, WebStorm, GoLand, Rider, CLion, RubyMine, PhpStorm, DataGrip, and all JetBrains IDEs (2024.1+).

Also Available On

  • VS Code Marketplace
  • Open VSX Registry
  • PyPI -- pip install forcefield
  • npm -- npx forcefield-ai scan "test"
  • GitHub Action
  • GitHub

Apache-2.0 Licensed | Plugin Documentation | SDK Documentation | Report Issues

idea-plugin.name: ide-kit
idea-plugin.description:
ide-kit packages Kotlin cleanup, source-only search, and project file hiding tools for JetBrains IDEs.

ide-kit 是一个面向 JetBrains IDE 的轻量效率插件，当前聚焦几类高频场景：

  • Kotlin 属性的冗余显式类型清理
  • Kotlin 全项目全限定名缩短
  • Kotlin class / data class 转 interface
  • Kotlin 多实体字段融合合并
  • Kotlin Entity 到 Controller / Service 跳转
  • 将函数移动到当前文件
  • Find in Files 里的“源码目录”搜索范围
  • Project 视图与 VCS 提交列表里的文件隐藏能力
  • Project 视图里的模块拆分与模块合并工具

功能一览

  • Alt+Enter 意图动作：对 Kotlin 属性提供 移除冗余显式类型
  • Alt+Enter / Code 菜单动作：缩短项目 Kotlin 文件中的全限定名
  • Alt+Enter 意图动作：对简单 Kotlin class / data class 提供 转换为 interface
  • Project 视图动作：选中多个 Kotlin 实体类后，把源字段与目标类字段对比并勾选合并
  • Kotlin 实体类左侧 gutter 图标：基于实体类型引用跳转到对应 Controller / Service
  • Alt+Enter / 自动修复：将函数移动到当前文件
  • Kotlin Inspection：自动标出可以安全删掉的冗余显式类型声明
  • 搜索范围：在 Find in Files 中增加“源码目录” scope，排除常见生成目录
  • 全局搜索降噪：自动把各模块下的 .gradle / .kotlin / .gradle-user-home / build/tmp 生成目录排除出项目索引
  • Project 视图隐藏：右键隐藏选中的文件或目录
  • 隐藏项显示切换：在 Project 视图工具栏切换是否显示已隐藏文件
  • Module Lock：按模块临时收起稳定功能模块，不影响 Gradle 构建
  • VCS 提交列表联动：隐藏项会同步从提交变更列表中排除
  • Split/Merge Module：在 Project 视图右键把选中文件拆到新模块，或把选中模块合并回目标模块

适合谁用

  • Kotlin 项目里经常需要清理样板类型声明的开发者
  • Kotlin 代码里经常需要把全限定名收敛成 import 加短名的开发者
  • 习惯先写数据承载类，后续又想把契约抽成接口的 Kotlin 开发者
  • 想把 build/、target/、.gradle/、generated/ 等目录排除出全文搜索的人
  • 想临时把噪音文件从 Project 视图和变更提交面板里收起来的人
  • 想把一批暂时不用动的稳定模块先收起来，集中盯当前功能的人
  • 想在 Gradle/Maven 项目里拆分或合并模块，并让插件处理基础目录、包名和依赖调整的人

安装后怎么用

1. 清理 Kotlin 冗余显式类型

当 Kotlin 已经能安全推断属性类型时，ide-kit 会提供 inspection 和 Alt+Enter 修复。

使用方式：

  1. 打开 Kotlin 文件，把光标放到属性声明上
  2. 如果该类型可安全移除，IDE 会显示弱提示
  3. 按 Alt+Enter
  4. 选择 移除冗余显式类型

示例：

val userName: String = "zjarlin"
val retryCount: Int = 3

执行后：

val userName = "zjarlin"
val retryCount = 3

如果你想整仓处理，而不是一个个按 Alt+Enter：

  1. 打开 Code -> Inspect Code...
  2. 作用域选择整个项目、模块，或自定义目录
  3. 运行后筛选 SmartRedundantExplicitType
  4. 直接执行批量修复

2. 缩短项目里的 Kotlin 全限定名

当代码里出现可导入的全限定名时，可以一次性对项目 Kotlin 文件执行缩短。插件会复用 Kotlin 插件自己的引用缩短逻辑，自动补 import，并把调用位置改成短名。

使用方式：

  1. 打开任意 Kotlin 文件，按 Alt+Enter
  2. 选择 缩短项目中的 Kotlin 全限定名

也可以从 Code -> 缩短项目中的 Kotlin 全限定名 直接执行。

示例：

return site.addzero.workbench.immersivedesktop.immersiveDesktopWindowDecoration(
    config = config,
    state = state,
)

执行后：

import site.addzero.workbench.immersivedesktop.immersiveDesktopWindowDecoration

return immersiveDesktopWindowDecoration(
    config = config,
    state = state,
)

3. 把 Kotlin class / data class 转为 interface

当一个 Kotlin 类型本质上只是“属性契约”时，可以直接在类声明上用 Alt+Enter 转成 interface。

使用方式：

  1. 打开 Kotlin 文件，把光标放到 class 或 data class 声明上
  2. 按 Alt+Enter
  3. 选择 转换为 interface

示例：

data class S3Config(
    val endpoint: String,
    val region: String,
    val bucket: String,
    val accessKey: String,
    val secretKey: String,
)

执行后：

interface S3Config {
    val endpoint: String
    val region: String
    val bucket: String
    val accessKey: String
    val secretKey: String
}

当前这条意图是保守转换，只会在“能稳定生成合法接口”的场景出现。下面这些情况暂时不会提供该意图：

  • 有 init 块
  • 有次构造函数
  • 主构造参数里存在非 val / var 参数
  • 存在父类构造调用，例如 : Base()
  • 类体里声明了普通属性

4. 合并多个 Kotlin 实体字段到目标类

这个功能用于把多个 Kotlin 实体/VO/DTO 的字段先融合去重，再与目标文件中的字段比较。目标可以是 Jimmer interface、普通 class、data class。

使用方式：

  1. 在 Project 视图中选中多个 Kotlin 实体文件
  2. 右键选择 合并实体字段到目标类
  3. 插件默认把最后一个选中类作为目标类，其余作为来源类
  4. 在弹窗中查看新增、相同、冲突字段；默认折叠相同字段
  5. 勾选要写入目标类的新增字段并确认
  6. 合并完成后，插件会按你的选择提示是否删除源文件

也可以分两步使用：先在 Project 视图右键 记录为实体字段合并来源，再打开目标类并在编辑器右键执行 合并实体字段到目标类。

5. 从 Entity 跳转到 Controller / Service

打开带 @Entity 的 Kotlin 实体类时，类名左侧会按实际匹配结果出现 Controller / Service 跳转图标。

Controller 查找策略不是硬编码包路径或文件名，而是从当前实体类型做引用反查，只把“引用出现在 *Controller / @RestController / @Controller 类父类型泛型里”的类作为跳转目标。

Service 查找策略同样基于实体类型引用反查，只把引用出现在 *Service / @Service / @Singleton 类内部的类作为跳转目标。

例如：

@Entity
interface MalfunctionDO

@RestController
class MalfunctionController : BaseController<MalfunctionDO>

在 MalfunctionDO 上点击 Controller 图标会跳到 MalfunctionController；如果存在引用该实体的 Service，点击 Service 图标会跳到对应 Service。

6. 在 Find in Files 里只搜源码

ide-kit 不再偷偷改写默认搜索范围，而是显式提供一个可选的“源码目录” scope。

另外，插件会自动把各模块下的 .gradle、.kotlin、.gradle-user-home 和 build/tmp 目录从项目索引里排除，避免 在项目(P) 的全局搜索把 Gradle 生成脚本、版本目录访问器源码和缓存结果混进来。

使用方式：

  1. 打开 Edit -> Find -> Find in Files
  2. 在范围选择器里切到 源码目录
  3. 输入搜索词并执行搜索

这个 scope 会优先保留 source root 下的内容，并排除常见生成输出目录，例如：

  • build
  • out
  • target
  • .gradle
  • generated
  • log
  • logs
  • *.log

7. 在 Project 视图里隐藏文件或目录

ide-kit 提供的是“项目内隐藏”，不是删除、移动或写 .gitignore。

隐藏方式：

  1. 在 Project 视图中选中一个或多个文件/目录
  2. 右键
  3. 选择 隐藏 / Hide from Project

恢复显示方式：

  1. 在 Project 工具栏打开 显示隐藏文件 / Show Hidden Files
  2. 找到之前隐藏的文件或目录
  3. 右键选择 取消隐藏 / Unhide from Project

补充说明：

  • 隐藏项会同步从 VCS 提交列表里排除
  • 隐藏状态按项目保存，在当前项目的 workspace state 中持久化
  • 打开“显示隐藏文件”只是在当前项目里临时显示，不会丢失隐藏标记

8. 用 Module Lock 暂时收起稳定模块

Module Lock 面向的是模块级收纳，不是文件级隐藏。

使用方式：

  1. 在 Project 视图里选中某个模块目录，或选中模块中的任意文件
  2. 右键选择 锁定模块 / Lock Module
  3. 该模块会从 Project 视图中暂时收起

恢复方式：

  1. 在 Project 工具栏打开 显示已锁定模块 / Show Locked Modules
  2. 选中目标模块
  3. 右键选择 取消锁定模块 / Unlock Module

补充说明：

  • 这是显示层收纳，不会改 Gradle 配置
  • 不会影响模块构建、依赖解析或同步
  • 状态按项目保存在 workspace 中，适合“这几天先别看这些稳定模块”的场景

7. 拆分或合并项目模块

Split/Merge Module 面向模块重构场景，支持 Gradle Kotlin DSL、Gradle Groovy DSL 和 Maven 项目。

拆分模块：

  1. 在 Project 视图中选中同一模块下的文件或目录
  2. 右键选择 Split Module
  3. 输入新模块名并确认

合并模块：

  1. 在 Project 视图中选中要合并的模块根目录
  2. 右键选择 Merge Modules
  3. 选择目标模块和基包后确认

补充说明：

  • 拆分会创建同级模块，并保留原始目录层级
  • 合并会尝试迁移源文件、调整包名、合并依赖并清理重复 project 引用
  • 复杂自定义构建逻辑仍然需要人工复核生成后的构建文件

示意截图

下面这张图展示了插件当前文档里提到的主要入口，包括 Kotlin 的 Alt+Enter 清理、Find in Files 的“源码目录”范围，以及 Project 视图里的隐藏文件操作。

当前限制

  • Kotlin 清理能力当前面向属性显式类型声明，不是对所有 Kotlin 类型标注做批量重写
  • class -> interface 当前只覆盖保守场景，不会尝试自动迁移 init、次构造、父类构造调用或类体属性
  • 函数移动当前只覆盖可安全搬入当前文件的顶层私有函数
  • “源码目录”是显式可选 scope，不会强制覆盖 IDE 默认搜索行为
  • 在项目(P) 的全局搜索会自动少掉 .gradle / .kotlin / .gradle-user-home / build/tmp 里的 Gradle 生成脚本和访问器源码，但不会替代你手动配置的自定义 scope
  • 隐藏文件能力作用于当前项目视图与变更列表，不会修改磁盘文件，也不会改 Git 跟踪状态
  • Module Lock 当前作用于 Project 视图显示层，不会改变 Gradle 构建和模块依赖关系
  • Split/Merge Module 会修改项目文件和构建文件，执行后应通过 IDE diff 和 Gradle/Maven 同步结果复核
  • 如果团队共享同一个仓库但各自 IDE 视图偏好不同，隐藏状态不会替代团队级规则文件

开发（本仓库）

  • 插件根模块：plugins/ide-kit
  • 插件描述：plugins/ide-kit/src/main/resources/META-INF/plugin.xml
  • Kotlin 清理实现：plugins/ide-kit/smart-intentions-kotlin-redundant-explicit-type
  • class -> interface 实现：plugins/ide-kit/smart-intentions-kotlin-class-to-interface
  • 函数移动实现：plugins/ide-kit/smart-intentions-kotlin-move-function-to-current-file
  • 搜索 scope 实现：plugins/ide-kit/smart-intentions-find-source-only
  • 隐藏文件实现：plugins/ide-kit/smart-intentions-hidden-files
  • 模块拆分/合并实现：plugins/ide-kit/split-module

构建插件：

./gradlew :plugins:ide-kit:buildPlugin

idea-plugin.name: Prism - IDE Companion for Claude Code and Codex
idea-plugin.description:
Prism is a local visual wrapper that integrates the Claude Code CLI and the OpenAI Codex CLI directly into your JetBrains IDE. It runs each CLI in a real embedded terminal and makes no external API calls — all data stays on your machine.

Requires the Claude Code or Codex CLI installed and authenticated independently.

Features

  • Interactive Terminal — Full ANSI color support via PTY (pty4j + JediTerm)
  • Terminal Settings — Use the IDE's terminal font, size, and line spacing, with zoom and live updates
  • Multi-Agent — Run Claude Code and Codex sessions side by side; pick at session start
  • Agent Changes Panel — Per-interaction diff view with history navigation and one-click revert
  • Context Menu — Explain, Review, Fix, Generate Tests, Refactor from the editor
  • Toolbar — Resume, Compact, Clear, Model, Effort, Cost, Templates, and Settings, each mapped to the active agent's own commands
  • Prompt Templates — Reusable templates with {selection}, {file}, {language} variables
  • Conversation History — Browse and resume past conversations from the active agent with full-text search
  • Multi-Session & Split Views — Run independent sessions in tabs or split panes to the right or below, where supported by the IDE
  • Status Bar Widget — Real-time session state (working/idle/stopped)
  • i18n — English, Portuguese, Spanish

Compatibility

  • IntelliJ IDEA (Community & Ultimate)
  • GoLand, WebStorm, PyCharm, CLion, Rider, RubyMine, and other JetBrains IDEs
  • Requires IDE version 2024.3 or later

Open Source & Contributing

Prism is open source under the Apache License 2.0. Found a bug or have a suggestion? Open an issue or submit a pull request on GitHub.

Disclaimer

Prism is an independent, community-built project — not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Anthropic, PBC or OpenAI, OpenCo. "Claude" and "Claude Code" are trademarks of Anthropic, PBC. "Codex" is a trademark of OpenAI.

This software is provided as-is, without warranty of any kind. See the LICENSE for details.

idea-plugin.name: TerminaLinker
idea-plugin.description:
Monitors any IDE console output (terminal, Run, Debug, etc.) for file name patterns and creates clickable hyperlinks that navigate to the corresponding source file and line.

Supported patterns:
  • MyFile.kt:73 — single line
  • MyFile.kt:73-77, 152 — line ranges and multiple refs
  • path/to/MyFile.kt[155-158] — bracketed line refs
  • path/to/MyFile.kt:10 — with path prefix
  • /c/Users/me/MyFile.kt, /mnt/c/..., /cygdrive/c/... — Windows paths in the Unix spelling a Git Bash, WSL or Cygwin shell prints
  • MyFile.kt line 34, MyFile.kt · line 34, or MyFile.kt at line 34 — single line
  • MyFile.kt · lines 310-324 or MyFile.kt at lines 310-324 — line range
  • (line 194), (lines 287, 291), (lines 253-265) — standalone line refs with smart file resolution: uses last mentioned file, identifier matching across open tabs, or falls back to the currently open file
  • Diff output: line numbers with + in Update(file) blocks link to the added line
  • Written files: every line number in a Write(file) block links to that line
  • Shell edits: the diff printed under Updated src/main/MyFile.kt (+3 -3), when a shell command changed the file, links its line numbers the same way
  • MyClass, MyClass:88-95, MyClass#method:142, MyClass#method, com.example.MyClass — class / member references (no file extension), resolved via the IDE's Go to Class engine (any language)
  • calculateMetric:142 — a bare symbol that carries a line, resolved via Go to Symbol

When an agent reports writing a file (● Update(file), ● Write(file), or an Updated ... (+3 -3) a shell command produced), the plugin immediately refreshes that file from disk, so the editor shows the new content right away instead of waiting for the IDE's next filesystem sync.
Especially useful for navigating output from AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and similar tools.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.9.0
A file changed by a shell command is reported inside the result of the action that ran it — Updated src/main/MyFile.kt (+3 -3) — with no Update(...) header of its own. The diff under it now links its line numbers too, and the file is synced from disk like any other the agent reports writing.

1.8.1
A Write(...) that replaces an existing file prints a diff, and its line numbers are now linked the way an Update(...) block's are, instead of stopping at the first gap.

1.8.0
Line numbers in Write(...) blocks now link to that line of the written file.

1.7.0
Paths printed by a shell hosted on Windows are now recognized in their Unix spelling: /c/Users/me/notes.md (Git Bash, MSYS), /mnt/c/... (WSL) and /cygdrive/c/... (Cygwin) all link to the file the IDE knows as C:\Users\....
Such a path also no longer links to an unrelated same-named file inside the project.
A file an agent had only just written now links too, instead of staying plain text until the IDE next notices on its own that the file exists.

1.6.2
Diff line numbers now stay clickable throughout the block, including the lines that were never on screen at the same time as their Update(...) header.

1.6.1
Fixed diff line numbers losing their links, or jumping to the wrong file, once the Update(...) header above them scrolled out of view.

1.6.0
Links now recognize class and symbol references that carry no file extension, resolved through the IDE's "Go to Class/Symbol" engine (works for any language, e.g. Java and Kotlin):
  • MyMetricCalculator — jumps to the class declaration
  • MyMetricCalculator:88-95, MyMetricCalculator:40,52,67 — class + line(s)
  • MyMetricCalculator#calculateMyMetric:142 — class + member + line
  • MyMetricCalculator#calculateMyMetric — jumps to the member's declaration line
  • com.example.MyMetricCalculator — fully-qualified names too
  • calculateMyMetric:142 — a bare symbol that carries a line
Standalone line references now bind to the nearest file or class named before them on the same line, instead of to whichever one happened to be named last. So in MyClass at line 31, OtherClass at line 7 each reference goes to its own class.

1.5.0
Files written by an AI agent are now synced from disk as soon as the agent reports them. When a ● Update(file) or ● Write(file) header appears in the console, that file is refreshed immediately, so an open editor tab shows the new content instead of the stale version until the IDE's next filesystem sync (which could be much later).

1.4.1
Fixed a crash when resolving a path that points at a filesystem root (a UNC share root, or a directory link resolving to a drive root); such paths are now simply left unlinked.

1.4.0
In diffs, deleted lines now make the surviving lines just before and after the deleted block clickable, so you can jump to where the change landed.

1.3.9
File links now also recognize the bracketed line-reference syntax path/to/MyFile.kt[155-158] (and [155], [155, 158]).

1.3.8
When a bare filename matches several same-named files, the link now prefers the one nearest (sharing the deepest directory) to files resolved earlier in the same console.
Also made the open-editor-tab fallback more reliable.

1.3.7
A file path that doesn't resolve directly (e.g. an out-of-project or mangled WSL-style path like ../../mnt/d/...) is now reconstructed by matching its nested directories against paths seen earlier in the same console, so it links to the real sibling file.

1.3.6
Smarter resolution when a bare filename (e.g. SKILL.md) matches several same-named files in the project. Instead of arbitrarily picking the first match, the plugin now reuses a path seen earlier in the same console for that filename, then prefers an open editor tab, then the candidate sharing the deepest directory with the active file.

1.3.5
Fixed absolute file paths pointing outside the project being incorrectly linked to a same-named file inside the project. Absolute paths are now resolved directly on the filesystem.

1.3.4
Diff header now also recognizes ● Write(file) alongside ● Update(file).
Fixed diff linking when the file path in ● Update() / ● Write() is word-wrapped across two lines due to narrow terminal width.

1.3.3
Fixed standalone line pattern falsely matching inside words (e.g. --oneline 442e3a2f no longer triggers a line 442 link).


1.3.2
Fixed file.ext:line pattern not being detected when preceded by other text (e.g. In NetworkClient.kt:462, the error...).


1.3.1
Smart file resolution for standalone line references: the plugin now tries to determine the target file automatically instead of always using the selected editor tab.
Heuristic 1: if a file was mentioned earlier in the terminal output, standalone line refs link to that file.
Heuristic 2: extracts code identifiers (camelCase, snake_case) from the line and matches them against open editor tabs to find the best candidate.

1.3.0
Added clickable standalone line references (e.g. (line 194), (lines 287, 291), (lines 253-265)) that navigate to that line in the currently open editor file.
File links now also accept file.ext line 45 syntax (without · or at prefix).

1.2.1
Reduced link to file name only (without path prefix) to avoid visual overload.

1.2.0
Added clickable links for newly added lines in diff output: line numbers with + in Update(file) diff blocks now link to the corresponding line in the file.
File paths with spaces and Windows drive letters (e.g. D:\path) are now supported.

1.1.0
Added support for · line(s) and at line(s) reference patterns:
MyFile.kt · line 34, MyFile.kt at lines 310-324

1.0.0
Initial version.
Monitors any IDE console output (terminal, Run, Debug, etc.) for file name patterns (e.g. MyFile.kt:73-77, 152) and creates clickable hyperlinks that navigate to the corresponding source file and line.

idea-plugin.name: AI Dev MCP
idea-plugin.description:
Connect IntelliJ IDEA to your self-hosted AI coding agent.

AI Dev MCP runs Qwen2.5-Coder locally via Ollama. Your code never leaves your network.

Features

  • Auto-detects project name from open project folder
  • Injects selected code as context automatically
  • Workspace Sync — zip & push local project to remote server, run agent, pull changes back

idea-plugin.name: MCP Server AI Companion
idea-plugin.description:
100 tools to give your AI assistant full access to your IDE: compilation errors, test results, debug variables, run configurations, inspections, Git operations (commit, push, pull, branch, merge, rebase, cherry-pick, revert, reset, stash, blame, file history, diff between branches…), VCS changes, database schema and data, IntelliJ diff viewer, and much more.

Works with any MCP-compatible AI client: Claude (Anthropic), GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cursor, Windsurf, and any other assistant that supports the Model Context Protocol.

MCP Companion Monitoring tool window

See every MCP tool call your AI assistant makes — with timestamps, durations, full JSON parameters and captured responses. Calls from other MCP plugins are also shown (in gray) for full visibility.

Editor & Navigation

  • get_open_editors — Open files, focused editor with caret position, and current text selection.
  • navigate_to — Opens a file and places the cursor at a given line and column.
  • select_text — Opens a file and selects a text range (ready to copy with Cmd+C).
  • highlight_text — Highlights multiple zones in a file using the IDE's search-result color (theme-aware). Press Escape to clear.
  • clear_highlights — Removes all highlights added by highlight_text.
  • show_diff — Opens IntelliJ's built-in diff viewer to visually compare the current content of a file with proposed new content (read-only — does not modify the file).
  • create_scratch_file — Creates an IntelliJ scratch file (outside the project tree) with given content and opens it — great for previewing a snippet, sample, or sketch without polluting the project.

Build & Tests

  • get_build_output — Build tool window: structured error/warning tree with file names and line numbers, plus raw console text.
  • get_console_output — Console output from both the Run and Debug tool windows. All tabs from each window, with the active window and active tab clearly indicated.
  • get_services_output — All sessions from the Services tool window, grouped by node name: SQL output log, result grids with column names, and which session/tab is currently active.
  • get_test_results — Last test run results: passed/failed/ignored status, duration, and failure messages with stack traces.
  • get_terminal_output — Content of all tabs in the embedded Terminal tool window.
  • send_to_terminal — Sends a command to a terminal tab and executes it. Optional waitForIdle=true blocks until the terminal output stops changing. ✋ Asks for confirmation.

Debug

  • list_run_configurations — Lists all run configurations with name, type, folder, and running status.
  • start_run_configuration — Launches a named run configuration in run or debug mode. Optional waitForExit=true blocks until the process terminates and returns the exit code.
  • modify_run_configuration — Modifies VM options, program arguments, env vars, or working dir of a run configuration.
  • get_run_configuration_xml — Returns the full XML definition of a run configuration.
  • create_run_configuration_from_xml — Creates a new run configuration from an XML definition (any type).
  • debug_run_configuration — Launches a run configuration in debug mode. Optional waitForExit=true blocks until the debugged process exits.
  • get_debug_variables — Local variables and their values from the current debugger stack frame (available when paused at a breakpoint).
  • get_breakpoints — Lists all line breakpoints with file, line number, enabled state, and condition expression.
  • add_conditional_breakpoint — Adds a breakpoint with an optional condition expression.
  • set_breakpoint_condition — Sets or removes a condition on an existing breakpoint.
  • mute_breakpoints — Mutes or unmutes all breakpoints in the active debug session.

Diagnostic & Processes

  • get_ide_snapshot — Lightweight snapshot of what the developer is currently doing: active file + caret, selection, open files, active runs/debug, indexing, background processes. Designed for frequent polling (e.g. a Claude Code hook to keep the AI aware of the current context).
  • get_intellij_diagnostic — One-call diagnostic: indexing status, active notifications, running/paused processes, and idea.log WARN/ERROR tail. Use this first when something is not working as expected.
  • get_running_processes — Lists all active and paused background processes (indexing, Gradle syncs, builds, etc.).
  • manage_process — Pauses, resumes, or cancels a background process by title.
  • get_ide_settings — Read IntelliJ IDE settings: Gradle build delegation, SDK, compiler, encoding. Pass a keyword (search) to filter, a key for direct lookup, or a prefix (with optional depth) to retrieve all settings in a subtree.

Code Analysis

  • get_file_problems — IDE-detected errors, warnings, and infos for a file or all open editors.
  • get_quick_fixes — Quick fix suggestions at a specific file:line:column. Use after get_file_problems to get actionable fixes for a reported problem.
  • apply_quick_fix — Applies a quick fix by its exact text at a given line (use fixes returned by get_file_problems or get_quick_fixes).
  • list_inspections — Lists all available inspections in the current profile, optionally filtered to a file or folder.
  • run_inspections — Runs inspections on a file, folder, or whole project — works on closed files too; filter by inspection ID or severity.
  • refresh_project — Syncs the project build system (Gradle or Maven). Detects the build system automatically from the project root.
  • get_project_structure — Project SDK, modules, source roots, excluded folders, and module dependencies. All paths relative to project root.
  • get_psi_tree — Dumps the PSI tree of a file as hierarchical text (element class, token type, range, preview) — handy for debugging folding builders, annotators, intentions and refactorings.

Database

Requires the Database Tools and SQL plugin (IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate).

  • list_database_sources — Lists all data sources configured in the Database tool window (name, URL, driver, user, DBMS type).
  • get_database_schema — Returns the schema tree already introspected by IntelliJ: namespaces → tables/views with keys, foreign keys, indexes, and optionally columns.
  • execute_database_query — Executes a SQL query on a configured data source and returns the results as JSON. ✋ Asks for confirmation — can execute UPDATE, DELETE, DROP.

Gradle

Requires the Gradle plugin (bundled in IntelliJ IDEA Community/Ultimate and Android Studio).

  • run_gradle_task — Executes one or more Gradle tasks and returns a structured result (status, duration, gradleProjectPath).
  • get_gradle_tasks — Lists Gradle tasks discovered by IntelliJ, grouped by category (build, verification, help, …).
  • refresh_gradle_project — Forces a Gradle re-sync (equivalent of the 🔄 button in the Gradle tool window).
  • get_gradle_dependencies — Imported dependency tree per module with resolved versions and scopes.
  • stop_gradle_task — Cancels all currently-running Gradle tasks.
  • get_gradle_project_info — Wrapper version, JDK used, list of subprojects with paths and source sets — useful for monorepo reasoning.

VCS

  • get_vcs_changes — All locally modified, added, deleted, and moved files (any VCS). Pass includeDiff=true to include a unified diff per file.
  • get_vcs_branch — Current Git branch and all local/remote branches for each repository.
  • get_vcs_log — Recent Git commit history: hash, author, date, subject, and changed files. Filter by file or branch.
  • get_vcs_blame — Line-by-line Git blame annotation: who last modified each line, when, and in which commit.
  • get_vcs_file_history — Commit history for a single file, with optional --follow to track renames across history.
  • get_vcs_diff_between_branches — Unified diff (or --stat summary) between two branches, tags, or commits.
  • vcs_show_commit — Full content of a Git commit: metadata, message, and unified diff of all changed files (git show).
  • get_local_history — IntelliJ Local History for a file or directory: revision list with timestamps, labels (e.g. "Before: Rename"), and optional diffs. Without a path, returns recent project-wide change events.
  • vcs_stage_files — Stage or unstage files in the Git index (git add / git reset HEAD).
  • vcs_commit — Create a Git commit from staged changes; warns if IntelliJ-tracked files are not staged; pass force=true to skip the check.
  • vcs_push — Push the current Git branch to its remote tracking branch (git push).
  • vcs_pull — Pull from the remote Git branch; pass rebase=true for git pull --rebase.
  • vcs_stash — Manage Git stashes: action="push" / "pop" / "apply" / "drop" / "list".
  • vcs_create_branch — Creates a new Git branch; pass checkout=true (default) to switch to it immediately, and from to specify the base.
  • vcs_checkout_branch — Switches the Git working tree to an existing branch (git checkout <branch>).
  • vcs_delete_branch — Deletes a Git branch locally, remotely, or both. ✋ Asks for confirmation — destructive.
  • vcs_reset — Resets the current branch to a previous commit (--soft / --mixed / --hard). ⚠ --hard overwrites the working tree.
  • vcs_revert — Creates a new commit that reverses the changes of a previous commit (git revert). Safe — does not rewrite history.
  • vcs_cherry_pick — Applies the changes from a specific commit on top of the current branch (git cherry-pick).
  • vcs_fetch — Fetches from one or all remotes without merging (git fetch); pass prune=true to remove deleted remote branches.
  • vcs_merge_branch — Merges a branch into the current one (git merge); pass noFf=true to force a merge commit.
  • vcs_rebase — Rebases the current branch onto another (git rebase); supports abort=true and continueRebase=true.
  • get_vcs_conflicts — Lists all conflicted files after a failed merge or rebase, with conflict type and optional file content including conflict markers.
  • vcs_open_merge_tool — Opens IntelliJ's built-in three-way merge tool for all conflicted files (equivalent to VCS → Git → Resolve Conflicts…).
  • vcs_rename_branch — Renames a branch (git branch -m); with pushRemote=true also publishes the new name and deletes the old remote branch. ✋ Asks for confirmation.
  • vcs_move_file — Moves or renames a tracked file/directory via git mv, preserving Git history so git log --follow and git blame keep working.
  • vcs_check_repo_health — Diagnoses orphan .git/index.lock files left by crashed builds; pass clean=true to remove stale locks.

Pull Requests (GitHub)

Auto-detected from the origin remote; uses the GitHub account configured in Settings → Version Control → GitHub. No terminal or gh CLI needed.

  • list_pull_requests — Lists pull requests; filter by state (open/closed/merged/all) and source branch.
  • get_pull_request — Full metadata of one PR: title, description, author, branches, state, mergeability, reviewers, CI checks.
  • get_pull_request_comments — Review and discussion comments (both issue-level and review-line comments).
  • get_pull_request_files — Files changed in the PR with status, additions/deletions, and per-file unified diff.
  • get_pull_request_commits — Commits on the PR with SHA, author, and message.
  • get_pull_request_reviews — Reviews on the PR (APPROVED / CHANGES_REQUESTED / COMMENTED / DISMISSED / PENDING) with body.
  • search_issues_or_prs — Search GitHub issues and PRs using the github.com query syntax.
  • create_pull_request — Opens a new PR (title, head, base, body, draft). ✋ Asks for confirmation.
  • add_pull_request_comment — Posts a top-level comment on a PR. ✋ Asks for confirmation.
  • update_pull_request — Updates a PR's title, body, state (close via state=closed), or base branch. ✋ Asks for confirmation.
  • merge_pull_request — Merges a PR with merge / squash / rebase strategy. ✋ Asks for confirmation.
  • request_pull_request_reviewers — Requests reviews from users and/or teams. ✋ Asks for confirmation.

Merge Requests (GitLab)

Auto-detected from the origin remote; uses the GitLab account configured in Settings → Version Control → GitLab. No terminal or glab CLI needed.

  • list_merge_requests — Lists merge requests; filter by state (opened/closed/merged/all) and source branch.
  • get_merge_request — Full metadata of one MR: title, description, author, branches, state, merge status, reviewers, pipeline.
  • get_merge_request_comments — Notes (discussion + diff-anchored comments) on the MR.
  • get_merge_request_changes — Files changed in the MR with old/new path, flags, and per-file diff.
  • get_merge_request_commits — Commits on the MR with SHA, author, title and message.
  • get_merge_request_approvals — Approval state: who approved, how many required/given, and whether approved.
  • search_gitlab — Searches the project (scope: merge_requests / issues / commits / blobs / milestones).
  • create_merge_request — Opens a new MR (title, source/target branch, description). ✋ Asks for confirmation.
  • add_merge_request_comment — Posts a comment (note) on an MR. ✋ Asks for confirmation.
  • update_merge_request — Updates an MR's title, description, state (close/reopen), or target branch. ✋ Asks for confirmation.
  • merge_merge_request — Merges (accepts) an MR, optionally squashing. ✋ Asks for confirmation.

General

  • get_mcp_companion_overview — Describes all available MCP Companion tools and how to use them.
  • execute_ide_action — Executes any IntelliJ action by ID (e.g. ShowSettings, ReformatCode, GotoFile), or searches for action IDs by keyword.
  • replace_text_undoable — Replaces text in a file via IntelliJ's document API (supports Cmd+Z undo).
  • delete_file — Deletes a file from the project (undoable).

Example prompts

  • "Add a breakpoint at line 18, start the debugger, stop when i == 3, then tell me the value of jj."
  • "Check my build output and fix the compilation errors. Make changes undoable."
  • "Run the tests and tell me which ones failed and why."
  • "Open Main.java and highlight all usages of variable i."
  • "Something is wrong in IntelliJ — run a diagnostic and tell me what you see."
  • "Stage all modified files, write a commit message based on the changes, and push to origin."
  • "Show me the Git log for the last 10 commits and summarize what changed."
  • "Create a feature branch from main, apply my changes, and push it."
  • "Show me the diff between main and feature/refactor — what would be merged?"
  • "Open the diff viewer to compare the current Util.java with this proposed refactor before I apply it."

Settings

Each tool can be individually enabled or disabled in Settings → Tools → MCP Server Companion.

Source code

Source code and documentation: github.com/maximehamm/mcp-intellij-all

idea-plugin.name: RemCodex – Remote Control for Codex (Browser & Phone)
idea-plugin.description:
RemCodex is a local-first remote control layer for Codex.

Run Codex on your machine, then monitor and control the same live session from JetBrains, your browser, or your phone.

Launch locally from JetBrains. Monitor progress, review approvals, interrupt work, and resume the same run from anywhere.

Why RemCodex

  • Control Codex from your browser or phone — keep watching and interacting with the same session without switching to remote desktop.
  • Local-first by design — RemCodex runs next to your local Codex workflow instead of moving it into a separate cloud tool.
  • Thin JetBrains integration — use JetBrains as a launch point and control surface, not a heavy IDE-only rewrite.
  • Fast setup — works with an existing remcodex command, executable path, or target URL.

What It Does

  • Start or reconnect — launches RemCodex when needed and reconnects when it is already running.
  • Same-session control — keep one Codex session visible across JetBrains, browser, and phone.
  • Live remote supervision — monitor progress, review approvals, interrupt work, and resume the same run remotely.
  • Tool window logs — keep startup feedback, recent output, and connection status visible inside JetBrains.
  • Browser handoff — open the same RemCodex session in your external browser or on your phone when needed.

Good Fit For

  • developers already using Codex locally
  • people who want JetBrains as a launch point instead of the terminal
  • users who want to monitor long-running Codex sessions away from the IDE
  • teams who want phone-friendly approvals and remote session supervision on the same network

Getting Started

  1. Install this plugin.
  2. Install RemCodex from GitHub.
  3. Start a local Codex session on your machine.
  4. Open RemCodex from JetBrains.
  5. Continue using the same session from your browser or phone.

Website: remcodex.com
Source code: github.com/lupishan/remcodex

Disclaimer: This plugin is an independent project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI.

idea-plugin.name: AgentellIJ
idea-plugin.description:
AgentellIJ hosts terminal-based AI coding agents in IntelliJ IDEA, so you can work with OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex CLI, or the native Terminal agent without leaving your project. Use an embedded chat window for graphical work or an interactive terminal for terminal workflows.

Key Features

  • Switch modes — Change between terminal (TUI) and graphical chat (GUI) modes from the tool window toolbar without restarting. Terminal-only agents stay in terminal mode.
  • Choose your agent — Select OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex CLI, or the native Terminal agent from the toolbar; your selection is remembered.
  • Per-agent program paths — Keep a separate binary path for each agent, so every profile uses the command you choose.
  • Consent-based installation — When a command-line agent is missing, review the exact install command and approve it before it runs. The native Terminal agent needs no installation or binary.
  • Context sharing — Add the current file, selected lines, or project-tree items to your agent with shortcuts or context-menu actions.
  • Live editor context — Open files and the active editor stay available to the agent automatically as you work.
  • Drag & Drop — Drop files from the project tree into chat.
  • Agent notifications — Get an IntelliJ balloon and an OS-native popup when OpenCode, Claude Code, or Codex finishes a main-agent response or asks a structured question, even while the IDE is active.

Getting Started

  1. Install a supported command-line agent (for example, OpenCode), or use the native Terminal agent.
  2. Open the AgentellIJ tool window from the right sidebar.
  3. Choose an agent and switch modes from the toolbar whenever you need.

idea-plugin.name: kmp-buddy
idea-plugin.description:
KMP Buddy for JetBrains IDEs combines Compose refactoring, Compose Blocks, and canvas-based layout authoring in one plugin.

What This Plugin Does

kmp-aio is a Kotlin and Compose productivity plugin focused on three workflows:

  • source-first Compose refactoring through intentions and inspections
  • Compose Blocks editing for structure-aware Compose code browsing
  • canvas-based low-code layout drafting that writes real Compose code

It also includes Koin cleanup tools for Kotlin projects using dependency injection.

中文说明

kmp-aio 是一个面向 JetBrains IDE 的 Kotlin / Compose 效率插件，当前主要覆盖三类能力：

  • Compose 源码重构意图与静态检查
  • Compose Blocks 积木视图与结构化源码浏览
  • 画布式低代码布局草图与 Compose 代码生成

另外还包含面向 Koin 的依赖清理能力。

Main Feature Areas

1. Compose Intentions And Refactors

The plugin adds many Alt+Enter intentions for Compose functions and call sites:

IntentionWhat It DoesTypical Use
ExpandWrapperSignatureIntentionExpands wrapper parameters into a more explicit Compose signature.When a wrapper composable hides too much state or event structure.
GenerateWrapperPropsIntentionGenerates wrapper props structures from current parameters.When you want to move toward a props-style API.
NormalizeComposeSignatureIntentionReorders or normalizes Compose parameters into a cleaner contract.When function signatures drift over time.
FlattenUsedObjectParametersIntentionFlattens object parameters that are only partially used.When a composable depends on an oversized model object.
ModifierChainIntentionExtracts or normalizes modifier chains.When modifiers become noisy, duplicated, or hard to reuse.
UiStateIntentionExtracts UI state into an explicit state model.When state is spread across many primitive parameters.
EventsIntentionExtracts event callbacks into a grouped event contract.When event lambdas become too numerous.
StateHoistIntentionHoists internal state to the caller.When a composable should become more reusable and controlled.
UiVariantIntentionSplits visual variants into clearer variant APIs.When one composable handles too many UI branches.
SlotExtractIntentionExtracts child regions into slot lambdas.When internal content should become customizable.
EffectKeysIntentionExtracts or normalizes effect keys.When LaunchedEffect or related effects use unstable keys.
SectionSplitIntentionSplits large composables into sections.When a file contains a very long function body.
StateMapperIntentionGenerates state mapping layers.When domain state and UI state should be decoupled.
ViewModelInlineIntentionReworks ViewModel usage near the UI boundary.When ViewModel plumbing is too entangled in UI code.
CallArgFillIntentionFills missing call arguments.When adapting callers after a signature change.
CallArgExtractSingleIntentionExtracts one call argument into a named construct.When a single inline argument becomes complex.
CallArgExtractBatchIntentionExtracts multiple call arguments in one pass.When many inline arguments need cleanup together.
ContainerWrapIntentionWraps selected UI with a layout container.When introducing Box, Row, Column, or another wrapper.

These are designed to turn large or messy composables into clearer contracts with more explicit state, event, slot, and preview structure.

1. Compose 意图与重构

插件为 Compose 函数和调用点提供了一组 Alt+Enter 意图：

意图作用适用场景
ExpandWrapperSignatureIntention将 wrapper 的隐式参数展开为更明确的 Compose 签名。适合 wrapper 把状态、事件藏得太深的情况。
GenerateWrapperPropsIntention基于当前参数生成 props 风格结构。适合准备把接口收敛成 props 模型时使用。
NormalizeComposeSignatureIntention统一、整理 Compose 函数参数顺序与结构。适合签名长期演进后变乱的函数。
FlattenUsedObjectParametersIntention将实际只用一部分字段的大对象参数拍平。适合 composable 对外部 model 耦合过重的情况。
ModifierChainIntention提取或规范 modifier 链。适合 modifier 过长、重复、难复用时。
UiStateIntention提取 UI State。适合状态参数过多、过散时。
EventsIntention提取事件集合。适合回调 lambda 太多时。
StateHoistIntention将内部状态提升给调用方。适合把组件改为可控组件时。
UiVariantIntention拆分视觉变体。适合一个组件内部塞了过多 UI 分支。
SlotExtractIntention提取 slot lambda。适合内部子区域需要开放定制时。
EffectKeysIntention提取或规范 effect keys。适合 LaunchedEffect 等 key 不稳定时。
SectionSplitIntention将大函数切成多个 section。适合超长 composable。
StateMapperIntention生成状态映射层。适合业务状态与 UI 状态解耦。
ViewModelInlineIntention调整 ViewModel 与 UI 边界附近的写法。适合 ViewModel 使用方式过度耦合 UI 时。
CallArgFillIntention自动补全调用参数。适合函数签名修改后的调用点修复。
CallArgExtractSingleIntention提取单个调用参数。适合某一个内联参数已经过于复杂时。
CallArgExtractBatchIntention批量提取多个调用参数。适合一次性清理多个复杂参数。
ContainerWrapIntention用布局容器包裹当前 UI。适合补 Box、Row、Column 等外层容器。

这些意图的核心目标，是把过于庞杂的 Compose 代码收敛成更稳定、可维护、可组合的 API 结构。

2. Compose Inspections

The plugin registers Kotlin inspections for common Compose problems:

  • wrapper structure inspection
  • parameter explosion inspection
  • Compose stability inspection
  • effect keys inspection

These help detect composables that are becoming too wide, unstable, or unsafe to maintain.

2. Compose 静态检查

插件当前包含几类 Compose 检查：

  • wrapper 结构检查
  • 参数爆炸检查
  • Compose 稳定性检查
  • effect keys 检查

这些检查主要用于尽早发现函数签名过宽、状态不稳定、effect key 不安全等维护风险。

3. Compose Preview Sandbox

KMP Buddy adds its own gutter entry on Compose @Preview functions using the plugin icon, separate from the built-in Compose preview marker.

The sandbox generator:

  • resolves the selected preview function as the entry point
  • walks Kotlin PSI references to find only reachable top-level source declarations
  • copies the reachable AST text into .kmp-buddy/preview-sandbox
  • prunes unrelated same-file and cross-file declarations
  • opens the KMP Buddy Preview tool window with the sandbox status, reachable file list, and generated source slice

The goal is to inspect and prepare a Compose preview from a small source slice instead of forcing the IDE to load the whole codebase around it. Generated sandbox source remains available from the preview panel when direct source inspection is needed.

3. Compose 预览沙箱

KMP Buddy 会在 Compose @Preview 函数上添加一个使用插件图标的 gutter 入口，和 Compose 自带的预览标记分开。

沙箱生成器会：

  • 将当前 preview 函数作为入口
  • 通过 Kotlin PSI 引用追踪只收集可达的顶层源码声明
  • 将可达 AST 文本复制到 .kmp-buddy/preview-sandbox
  • 剔除同文件和跨文件的无关声明
  • 打开 KMP Buddy Preview 工具窗口，展示沙箱状态、可达文件列表和生成源码切片

目标是用更小的源码切片检查并准备 Compose preview，而不是围绕它加载整个代码库。需要直接查看生成源码时，可以从预览面板进入。

4. Compose Blocks View

Compose Blocks is the structure-aware editor layer for Compose Kotlin files.

It provides:

  • a dedicated Open Compose Blocks entry from editor and tools menus
  • block parsing for Compose files
  • block-based browsing of composable structure
  • split rendering between block view and source
  • source-coupled highlighting and folding
  • inline remarks/comments bound to blocks
  • block wrap and unwrap operations
  • block selection synchronized with the corresponding code region

The goal of Compose Blocks is not to replace code editing. It makes the Compose tree easier to navigate while still keeping the Kotlin source visible and editable.

4. Compose Blocks 积木视图

Compose Blocks 是面向 Compose Kotlin 文件的结构化编辑层，不是另起一套“伪编辑器”。

它主要提供：

  • Open Compose Blocks 打开入口
  • Compose 结构解析与积木树浏览
  • 积木与源码之间的联动定位
  • 源码高亮、折叠、结构浏览
  • 与积木绑定的备注 / remark
  • wrap / unwrap 等块级操作

目标是让你在“仍然编辑真实 Kotlin 代码”的前提下，更轻松地看清 Compose 的层级结构。

5. Canvas Layout Designer

The Compose Designer tool window provides a canvas workflow for sketching layout structure and generating Compose code.

Current capabilities include:

  • left palette with built-in components
  • support for custom user-defined palette components
  • drag-and-drop insertion onto the canvas
  • root container based editing
  • Box, Row, and Column oriented layout authoring
  • sketch-region / draw-to-create layout flow
  • named slots and higher-order layout container generation
  • mutual exclusion and collision-aware placement
  • auto-growth of layout containers to fit children
  • toolbar-based editing modes
  • Shift + drag support for drawing/reparenting interactions
  • delete selected element from canvas
  • clear canvas support
  • arrange / one-click organize to reduce free-positioned output

This workflow is intentionally layout-first. The canvas is meant for building structure and placement, not for fine-grained visual styling.

5. Canvas 画布设计器

Compose Designer 工具窗口提供一个偏“布局骨架优先”的画布工作流，用于草图式搭建 Compose 布局并生成代码。

当前能力包括：

  • 左侧组件面板
  • 内置组件与用户自定义组件
  • 拖拽插入画布
  • 以根容器为基础的结构编辑
  • 以 Box / Row / Column 为核心的布局生成
  • 画布框选 / 草图区域生成布局
  • 具名插槽与高阶布局容器生成
  • 元素互斥、碰撞规避
  • 父容器自动撑大以容纳子元素
  • 基于工具栏的显式模式切换
  • Shift + Drag 辅助交互
  • 删除当前选中元素
  • 清空画布
  • Arrange / 一键整理，尽量把自由摆放整理成结构化布局

这个设计器当前不是完整视觉设计工具，而是一个“低代码布局骨架编辑器”。

6. Generated Compose File Workflow

The designer writes to a generated sibling Kotlin file instead of a detached preview buffer.

That workflow includes:

  • creating or opening a generated composable file beside the current file
  • keeping the generated file selected while the panel is active
  • syncing canvas changes back into the Kotlin file
  • generating valid Compose code for built-in palette items
  • reducing unnecessary offset(...) usage after arrange/normalization
  • package inference based on the target directory and sibling Kotlin files

This keeps the output auditable and editable as normal project code.

6. 生成代码文件工作流

设计器不会把结果写进临时预览缓存，而是直接在当前目录旁生成或更新 Kotlin 文件。

这部分包括：

  • 在当前文件同级目录生成 GeneratedComposable 文件
  • 面板激活时自动保持对应生成文件被选中
  • 画布与 Kotlin 文件双向同步
  • 为内置组件生成可编译的 Compose 代码
  • 通过整理能力尽量减少无意义的 offset(...)
  • 基于目标目录与同级 Kotlin 文件推断 package

这样做的核心好处是：输出始终是“真实项目代码”，不是黑盒状态。

7. Koin Cleanup Tools

The plugin also includes Koin-specific productivity actions:

  • remove redundant constructor dependencies when another injected dependency already exposes them
  • project-wide cleanup for @Single(binds = [...])

These tools are available from standard intention entry points and are designed for bulk cleanup without hand-editing every declaration.

7. Koin 清理工具

插件还包含 Koin 相关的清理能力：

  • 当某个已注入依赖已经暴露所需能力时，移除冗余构造参数依赖
  • 清理项目中的 @Single(binds = [...])

这些能力仍然通过标准意图入口触发，适合做项目级批量治理。

Built-In UI Elements In The Designer

The current built-in palette includes layout and primitive items such as:

  • Box
  • Row
  • Column
  • Text
  • Button
  • Icon
  • Image
  • Card
  • Divider

The palette can also be extended with your own reusable components through plugin settings and the designer-side add flow.

中文补充

当前内置组件主要包括：

  • Box
  • Row
  • Column
  • Text
  • Button
  • Icon
  • Image
  • Card
  • Divider

另外也支持通过设置页与设计器侧入口，添加用户自己的组件定义。

Actions Added To The IDE

The plugin contributes these main actions:

  • Open Compose Blocks
  • New Compose Blocks Screen
  • New Compose Blocks Dialog
  • New Compose Blocks Page
  • normalize Compose signature from refactoring/editor menus

Typical Workflows

Refactor Existing Compose Code

  1. Open a Kotlin Compose file.
  2. Use Alt+Enter on a composable or call site.
  3. Apply the desired extraction, normalization, or wrapping intention.

Inspect And Navigate Large Composables

  1. Open a Compose Kotlin file.
  2. Run Open Compose Blocks.
  3. Browse the composable tree while editing the related Kotlin source.

Draft A Screen From Layout Skeleton

  1. Open the Compose Designer tool window.
  2. Drag built-in or custom components onto the canvas.
  3. Use layout containers to organize the structure.
  4. Run Arrange / 一键整理 to reduce free-positioning.
  5. Continue editing the generated Kotlin file directly if needed.

Module Layout

  • plugins/kmp-buddy: root IntelliJ plugin descriptor and shared registrations
  • plugins/kmp-buddy/kmp-buddy-designer: canvas designer and writeback workflow
  • plugins/kmp-buddy/kmp-buddy-blocks: Compose Blocks editor, parser, builder, and file integration
  • plugins/kmp-buddy/kmp-buddy-preview-sandbox: isolated Compose preview AST slicing and sandbox generation
  • plugins/kmp-buddy/smart-intentions-koin-redundant-dependency: redundant Koin dependency cleanup
  • plugins/kmp-buddy/smart-intentions-koin-single-binds: @Single(binds = ...) cleanup

Current Positioning

This plugin is strongest when you want to:

  • restructure large Compose codebases faster
  • navigate Compose source as blocks instead of raw text only
  • draft layout skeletons visually and then continue in Kotlin
  • keep generated UI code as real project files instead of hidden metadata

It is not a full visual styling tool. The designer is intentionally biased toward layout structure, container semantics, and source generation.

idea-plugin.name: Database MCP Server
idea-plugin.description:
English

Database MCP Server helps you configure and run an embedded database MCP service in IntelliJ IDEA, with controllable SQL tools for AI assistants and MCP clients.

  • Supports H2, MySQL, SQL Server, and Oracle
  • Manage SQL templates, parameter hints, tool names, display names, and descriptions
  • One-click database connection test and preview of service URL/config JSON
  • Useful for tools like recent commits, file type summary, and report queries

在 IntelliJ IDEA 中快速配置并启动内嵌式数据库 MCP 服务,支持为 AI 助手或 MCP 客户端提供可控的数据查询能力。

idea-plugin.name: SigMap - AI Context Engine
idea-plugin.description:
SigMap — 96.8% Average Token Reduction for AI Coding Assistants

Zero-dependency AI context engine that extracts code signatures from 33 languages and generates compact context files for GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, and other AI assistants.

Features

  • Automatic Context Generation — Extracts function signatures, class definitions, and type information
  • Health Status Bar — Shows context health grade (A-F), token count, and age; click for the SigMap action menu
  • Toolbar Actions — Regenerate context, open context file, view roadmap with one click
  • Stale Context Alerts — Notifies when context is over 24 hours old
  • Settings — Tools → SigMap: explicit CLI path override, health-probe cadence
  • 33 Language Support — TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Java, Kotlin, Go, Rust, C++, C#, Ruby, PHP, Swift, Dart, Scala, SQL, GraphQL, Terraform, Protobuf, Vue, Svelte, HTML, CSS, YAML, TOML, Shell, Dockerfile, and more

Learn more at manojmallick.github.io/sigmap/
idea-plugin.change-notes:
4.3.1

  • Fixed the status bar showing "SigMap: ?" on GUI-launched IDEs: the health probe (and Ask queries) now run with the login-shell environment so node resolves, and a failed probe falls back to the age-based A–F grade instead of "?".

4.3.0

  • SigMap Ask tool window: type a natural-language question, get ranked files with signature previews, double-click to open — the retrieval half of SigMap, now inside the IDE.

4.2.0

  • Settings page (Tools → SigMap): explicit CLI path override and health-probe cadence.
  • Status-bar click now opens a menu with Regenerate / Open Context File / View Roadmap.
  • Open Context File shows a notification with a Generate action when no context file exists.
  • Listing refreshed: 33 languages, 96.8% average token reduction.

4.1.0

  • IDE compatibility extended to 2026.2 (until-build 262.*).
  • Windows: the status-bar health probe now uses the same cross-platform command resolution as Regenerate (previously fell back to a file-age grade).
  • The health probe runs only when the context file changes (or every 10 minutes) instead of every 60 seconds, and is bounded by a 30-second timeout; regeneration is now cancellable with a 5-minute cap.
  • The status bar refreshes immediately after a successful regeneration.

4.0.1

  • Fixed both Plugin Verifier warnings: the stale-context notification's Regenerate button now fires the action via ActionManager.tryToExecute(...) instead of calling actionPerformed directly with a deprecated createFromDataContext event.

4.0.0

  • First standalone release — health status bar, one-click regenerate, stale-context notification, auto-refresh.

idea-plugin.name: Agent CLI
idea-plugin.description:
Run AI coding agents directly inside your JetBrains IDE with a fully embedded terminal and session management, either in the tool window or in regular editor tabs.

  • Support for Claude Code, Cursor Agent and OpenAI Codex — start a session for any enabled agent from the + menu.
  • Multiple simultaneous sessions — create, switch, close, and delete sessions. Sessions auto-close when the agent process exits.
  • Session history — browse past sessions grouped by date (Today, Yesterday, This Week, Older) and resume previous sessions by ID where local agent data is available.
  • Editor-hosted sessions — right-click any active or historical session and pick "Open in Code Editor" to move it into a regular editor tab; a "Return to plugin view" link moves it back. Optional settings let new sessions and/or resumed historical sessions always open as editor tabs by default.
  • Attention notifications — when an agent needs your input (permission prompts, idle confirmations, Codex permission requests), the session row shows a red dot instead of the green play icon and an IDE balloon (with OS banner) fires. Opt-in: install hooks from Settings with a one-click action that merges idempotently into Claude / Codex config files, with .bak backups and clean uninstall.
  • High-performance embedded terminal — xterm.js-based with optional watermark flow control, clickable URL detection, UTF-8 encoding, and a 10,000-line scrollback buffer. If the IDE's embedded browser (JCEF) becomes unavailable, the session reports it in place instead of failing the tab.
  • Theme-aware UI — terminal colors and scrollbars follow the IDE look-and-feel and update dynamically when the theme changes.
  • Compact session sidebar — collapsible panel showing active sessions and browsable history with right-click context menus. A red overlay dot on the collapse toggle keeps attention-needed state visible when the sidebar is collapsed.
  • Per-agent configuration (Settings → Tools → Agent CLI) — enable or disable each agent, customize launch commands, adjust terminal font size, toggle flow control, and choose where new or resumed sessions open.

Note: A JetBrains Runtime with JCEF is required for the embedded terminal. Install and sign in to each agent CLI you use separately.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.1

  • Fixed a crash when opening a session in an editor tab if the IDE's embedded browser process (JCEF) had died earlier in a long-running IDE session.
  • Sessions that cannot start now report it instead of failing silently: editor tabs show a "Restart the IDE and try again" message, tool-window sessions show an error balloon, and the half-created session is dropped instead of leaving a dead row in the sidebar.

1.0.0

  • Fixed a crash (NoClassDefFoundError: JBCefApp) when opening the tool window on IntelliJ Platform 2026.2+ — the plugin now declares the JCEF platform module dependency.
  • Fixed historical session resolution for projects whose path contains a "." (or other non-alphanumeric characters) in a directory name.
  • Removed the Gemini CLI agent type following Google's discontinuation of the CLI.

0.9.1

  • Added project-scoped settings (Settings → Tools → Agent CLI → Project), stored in the project's workspace file.
  • Added a "Project args" field for the Sandbox agent — extra arguments substituted into the sandbox command's {project_args} placeholder for that project only (appended if the placeholder is absent).

Full changelogs can be found at https://github.com/sajithdilshan/agent-cli-plugin/tree/main/changelog

idea-plugin.name: DICOM Viewer
idea-plugin.description:
View, analyze, and measure DICOM medical images directly in your IDE.

DICOM Viewer lets you open .dcm files as editor tabs with Window/Level adjustments, measurement tools, ROI analysis, series navigation, and metadata browsing — all without leaving your IDE.

Features

  • DICOM Rendering — Open .dcm files as custom editor tabs with full image rendering
  • Window/Level — Interactive brightness/contrast with medical presets (Lung, Bone, Brain, Soft Tissue, Mammography)
  • Zoom and Pan — Mouse wheel zoom (cursor-centered), drag pan, fit-to-window

idea-plugin.name: opencode-web
idea-plugin.description:
Plugin Description

Note: This is an unofficial plugin for OpenCode, maintained by the community and not affiliated with OpenCode.

Features

  • Manual Start - Click the sidebar icon to open the tool window, then click the "Start OpenCode Server" button to launch the server (no automatic startup)
  • Singleflight Debounce - Multiple rapid clicks on the Start button are merged into a single server launch via Go-style singleflight pattern (concurrent clicks → 1 process)
  • Crash Detection - Server health is detected via SSE connection state; on shutdown, the tool window immediately shows the Start button (no automatic restart)
  • Auto Cleanup - Automatically stop OpenCode service when IDE exits to release resources
  • Dashboard Panel - Pure Swing 6-area panel showing server status / project path / port + SSE health / 3 control buttons (Stop / Restart / Reset) / sessions list (click row to open in Edge). No browser widget embedded in IDE.
  • Edge --app Launcher - Clicking a session row spawns external Microsoft Edge process in --app mode via OpenCodeBrowserLauncher, reusing user's daily Edge profile (no --user-data-dir), so localStorage / cookies persist across clicks and across IDE restarts. Edge not installed → Messages.showErrorDialog prompts user to install from https://www.microsoft.com/edge
  • Copy as Prompt - Right-click selected code in editor and choose "Copy as Prompt" to copy as formatted prompt with file path and line numbers
  • macOS only - Hard rule per SPEC §2

Use Cases

  • Developers who need to use OpenCode Web UI in JetBrains IDE
  • Developers who prefer explicit control over the OpenCode server lifecycle (no auto-start, no auto-restart)
  • Users who want to quickly view the AI assistant interface during coding
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Added

  • Edge extension background service worker(notification 预置 allow): 新增 src/main/resources/edge-extension/background.js(MV3 service worker),Edge 启动时主动调 chrome.contentSettings.notifications.set({primaryPattern: 'http://localhost:12396/*', scope: 'regular', setting: 'allow'}),绕开 Chromium 的 QuietNotificationPrompts 永久 block(连续 3 次忽略后该 origin 的弹框被永久抑制,requestPermission() 直接返回 denied)。manifest.json 加 permissions: ["contentSettings"] + background.service_worker: "background.js";EdgeBootstrapExtension.prepare() 加 BACKGROUND_JS 写盘逻辑(镜像现有 MANIFEST / CONTENT_JS 模式)。

Changed

  • 端口固定 12396,不再升级(M2-T1 升级版): ServerProcessLauncher.startServerSingleflight 移除 MAX_ESCALATION_DEPTH 端口升级递归,health gate 检测到端口被其他 IDE 占用时改为 killProcessTreeByHandle + onFailed(不再递归升级)。原因: Edge extension 的 background.js / manifest.json + MyToolWindow.buildOpenUrl() 均硬编码 http://localhost:12396,端口升级会引入 notification 预置 allow 错位 + Edge 连不上 server 的新失败模式。DESIGN.md §1.2 决策表 / SPEC.md §4.4 / SPEC.md §6.2 / AGENTS.md UNIQUE STYLES 同步更新。

idea-plugin.name: EggShell
idea-plugin.description:
EggShell brings AI coding agents into JetBrains IDEs. It embeds a fully interactive terminal session dedicated to AI CLI tools, letting you chat with an agent without leaving your IDE.

Bundled agent templates: Cursor, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Gemini CLI, Aider, GitHub Copilot CLI. Add your own from Settings.

Features

  • Multi-agent support — six bundled agent templates out of the box, plus a data-driven agent table in Settings to add, edit, or remove your own.
  • Embedded AI terminal — runs the chosen CLI in a native IDE terminal (same stack as the platform Terminal).
  • Per-agent SVG icons — shown on tab titles and in the new-tab chooser popup.
  • Per-agent insertion templates — each agent picks its own syntax for @path file references and for editor-selection code citations.
  • Per-command Test buttons — dry-run create/run/delete templates from the Settings dialog to validate argv before spawning a real session.
  • Delete-session cleanup — optional CLI invocation fired best-effort when a chat is removed from the Home tab.
  • MRU-driven new-tab chooser — the tool-window title action opens a popup listing agents with your most-recent one preselected.
  • Multiple chat sessions — open several agent tabs in parallel; sessions persist across IDE restarts.
  • Drag-and-drop files — drag files from the Project tree into the terminal to insert @path references (agent-specific template).
  • Drag-and-drop code — drag a text selection from the editor into the terminal to insert a code citation with file path and line range.
  • Send code selection — select code in the editor, right-click → Send Selected to EggShell Terminal (or press Ctrl+Shift+Alt+K) to insert a code citation with file path and line range.
  • Add file from Project view — right-click a file → Add File to EggShell to insert its @path reference.
  • Image paste — paste images from clipboard directly into the terminal; the plugin saves the image and inserts the path.
  • Split Mode & JetBrains Gateway — structured as a split plugin (shared / backend / frontend modules) so it works natively in both monolithic IDEs and remote development setups.

Getting started

  1. Install the CLI for the agent you want to use (e.g. Cursor CLI, Claude Code, etc.).
  2. If its executable is not on your PATH, configure the path in Settings | Tools | EggShell.
  3. Open the EggShell tool window (right sidebar) and pick an agent from the new-tab chooser.

Chat management

EggShell creates and tracks chat IDs, their owning agent, and their open/closed status in .idea/eggshell.xml. Removing a chat from the plugin deletes the local entry and, if the agent defines a deleteSession command, best-effort invokes it to clean up server-side history.

Privacy

The plugin only runs the CLIs you install locally. Agent configurations live in IDE settings; secret environment variables (API keys) are stored in the IDE Password Safe. No data is collected by the plugin itself.

This plugin is an independent integration and is not affiliated with Cursor, Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Aider, or GitHub.
