idea-plugin.name: Claudete Commit Message
idea-plugin.description:
Write better Git commit messages in one click — right inside your JetBrains IDE, powered by the Claude Code CLI.

Check the files you're about to commit, click the Claude button in the commit‑message toolbar (or press Ctrl+Alt+K — ⌘⌥K on macOS), and a clean, conventional commit message is written straight into the message field. The plugin builds a diff of exactly the changes you selected, sends it to claude, and fills in the result — in the background and cancelable at any time.

✨ Highlights

  • One click, right where you commit — the action lives in the commit‑message toolbar.
  • Conventional Commits by default, with a fully editable prompt.
  • Cancelable — the icon turns into a red stop square while generating; click it to abort.
  • Selection‑aware — includes checked unversioned files as new‑file diffs; the button is enabled only when files are selected.
  • Cross‑platform — macOS, Linux and Windows. On macOS/Linux the executable is also looked up through your login shell, so version managers (nvm, fnm, asdf, Homebrew) are found even when the IDE is started from the Dock.
  • WSL‑friendly — run the CLI inside WSL from a native‑Windows IDE, with a distro picker.
  • Model picker — Claude aliases (sonnet, opus, haiku, fable) or a full model name.
  • Painless setup — auto‑detect the claude executable and run a built‑in integration test from Settings.

🚀 Getting started

  1. Install and authenticate the Claude Code CLI (run claude once in a terminal).
  2. Open Settings → Tools → Claudete Commit Message, click Detect, then Test integration.
  3. In the Commit tool window, select files and click the Claude button (or Ctrl+Alt+K).

Requirements: the Claude Code CLI installed and authenticated. Works with PhpStorm, PyCharm, IntelliJ IDEA, and other IntelliJ‑based IDEs.

Privacy: when you generate a message, the diff of your selected changes is sent to Anthropic through your own Claude Code CLI and authentication. The plugin itself collects no telemetry. This plugin is an independent integration and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.3

  • macOS support. The claude executable is now also resolved through your login shell, so it is found when the IDE is launched from the Dock/Finder (which does not inherit the terminal PATH).
  • Auto‑detection covers Homebrew (Intel and Apple Silicon) and Node version managers (nvm, fnm, asdf, Volta, Bun).
  • Added the ⌘⌥K shortcut on the macOS keymap.
  • The WSL section is hidden outside Windows, and the message field is no longer cleared when the CLI cannot be found.

0.1.2

  • Replaced the deprecated ReadAction.compute API with a cancellable non‑blocking read action, for compatibility with 2026.1+.

0.1.1

  • All UI, status, and notification messages are now in English.
  • The message field is cleared when a new generation starts, so no stale text remains.

0.1.0

  • Generate commit messages from the selected files using the Claude Code CLI.
  • Toolbar button and Ctrl+Alt+K shortcut; cancelable stop toggle.
  • WSL mode with distro picker; model picker; executable auto‑detection; built‑in integration test.
  • Includes unversioned files; the action is enabled only when files are selected.

idea-plugin.name: DD Code GUI
idea-plugin.description:
DD Code GUI

AI-powered coding assistant with intelligent chat, code completion, and MCP tool integration. Supports Claude Agent SDK, Codex SDK, DeepSeek Harness, DeepSeek, and Anthropic-compatible APIs. Tri-engine streaming, slash commands, multi-agent mode, Git commit generation.

AI Chat

  • Tri-engine streaming chat — Claude Agent SDK, Codex SDK & DeepSeek Harness with tool calls
  • Harness engine — sandboxed execution with approval prompts for out-of-sandbox operations, persistent shell sessions, skills and MCP support
  • Slash commands — /help, /clear, /new, /compact, /summarize, /context, /mcp, /skills, /plan, /fix, /tests
  • @-file mentions — search and reference workspace files in chat
  • Multi-agent mode (Codex) — configurable threads, depth, custom agent roles

Code Operations

  • Smart code completion — context-aware multi-line suggestions (Alt+Shift+8)
  • Code edit popup — explain, fix, optimize, add comments (Alt+Shift+9)
  • Smart rename (Alt+Shift+0)
  • AI Git commit message generation

Tool Ecosystem

  • MCP server integration — 22 marketplace templates + custom stdio/SSE/HTTP servers
  • Skill system — 17 marketplace templates + auto-discovery from disk
  • CLI tools — auto-detect local tools (npm, mvn, git etc.), live-reload config
  • Built-in terminal — full PTY terminal in chat panel

Theme & Language

  • Dark & Light themes — 42 CSS variable pairs, adaptive UI
  • Internationalization — Chinese/English UI, instant switch

Engine Bridge

  • Moon Bridge — local HTTP proxy, DeepSeek/Anthropic-compatible API via Codex
  • Manual model selection — pick flash/pro directly, no auto-routing

Project Integration

  • Global + project-level settings — API keys, endpoints, permissions
  • Optional Java & VCS module support — works in non-Java IDEs
  • IDEA built-in MCP discovery — auto-connect to JetBrains MCP plugin
idea-plugin.change-notes:
v0.6.12

  • 新增 重试「更早的轮次」真的截断会话 — 点重试先把会话记录切到那一轮,再把保留的对话重放进新引擎会话;此前只改了界面上的显示,重启或换引擎后删掉的轮次会复活
  • 新增 Harness 运行时的自动安装与真实进度 — 首次发现运行时缺失或版本不符时自动下载,显示阶段、耗时与已下载字节数(不画百分比,因为它无从得知);此前 VS Code 侧那颗安装按钮点了完全没有反应
  • 修复 Harness 运行时的升级与安装 — 旧运行时的原地升级会被 npm 的依赖冲突拒绝(ERESOLVE)且此后永远装不上(备份安装器已随本版删除,没有后路);点过「稍后」之后再点「安装」也没有反应,一次点击同时压死安装按钮和此后的自动安装,直到重启 IDE;「稍后」本身此前也不会真的取消 — 只停掉了包装进程,npm 照旧把约 320MB 下完
  • 修复 Harness 引擎的状态与工具 — 运行时升级后所有工具卡片显示为失败(上游改了工具结果的形状,只认旧形状会让每个结果都对不上号);被运行时因版本不兼容跳过的插件谎报成「已挂载」,未经过一次启动裁决的组合现在会明说;回复语言被另一个引擎的设置覆盖,设置页那个选择器一直是装饰;审批桥启动失败时 MCP 服务与技能整批失效;被单实例锁拒绝的 MCP 服务静默回退成同样起不来的副本
  • 修复 压缩、权限与错误反馈 — 会话压缩结束时若释放信号来得比预期早,整条命令队列会被卡死(daemon 活着但不再响应任何设置更新与模型拉取,要重开窗口);压缩原因与设置页横幅各说各话;待确认的权限卡片被弹到视口外看不见;报错气泡关不掉、重试认不出你点的是哪一条
  • 修复 两个宿主的稳定性与集成 — IntelliJ 面板偶发黑屏后不再恢复(页面「加载完成」并不等于界面真的起来了);安装包混进了 149 个崩溃转储文件;两个 IDE 同开一个项目时 playwright 工具互相饿死,且 IntelliJ 侧白名单漏文件、真机上工具全无;VS Code 偶发把同一条消息发两遍
  • 说明 Harness 运行时升级至 0.2.0-rc.2 — 完整安装约 520MB,装完自动裁剪到约 336MB(旧版 617MB / 290MB);升级后需重启 IDE 生效。关闭上游随 0.2.0 新增的匿名遥测上报(dsh-otel / session-telemetry-otel) — 与上游默认行为的有意分歧

v0.6.11

  • 新增 DeepSeek Harness 第三引擎(harness-sdk) — 与 claude-sdk / codex-sdk 并列,在引擎选择器中直接切换;沙箱隔离执行、持久 shell 会话、会话历史独立持久化
  • 新增 沙箱越权申请接入插件审批 — 仅"越出沙箱"的操作会询问,沙箱内的操作不打扰;弹窗显示真实命令,支持 Allow Once / Always Allow / Deny;SQL 写硬拦照旧不可越过
  • 新增 Harness 引擎接入 Skills 与 MCP 服务 — MCP 工具名与另两引擎一致(mcp__服务器__工具),既有权限分类直接生效
  • 新增 压缩摘要跨会话接续 — 压缩后除摘要外附「最近操作过的文件/命令」清单,避免压缩后丢失上下文
  • 修复 权限模式在引擎间是同一个值,导致在别的引擎选过的模式会在新引擎静默生效(如 Auto 会关掉沙箱) — 现三个引擎都显示该选择器,看得见也改得动
  • 修复 工具执行失败(非零退出 / 被沙箱拒绝)在工具卡片上显示为成功
  • 修复 Harness 引擎下会话不落盘、不自动命名
  • 修复 Harness 引擎下 /compact 看似成功但实际未生效
  • 新增 Harness 逐工具权限门控 — 沙箱内的工具此前完全绕过权限分类器与 SQL 硬阻断;只读内建工具不再逐张弹卡、「从不询问」档不再静默拒绝子代理、bypass 档下的 SQL 写不再放行
  • 新增 可接入你自己的 dsh 插件 — 设置页新增插件 JSON 输入框(本地路径 / 裸包名 / 带配置对象),缺包可一键安装;/context 列出实际生效的插件明细
  • 新增 Harness 引擎支持原生图片直传 — 图片此前在 daemon 被丢掉、模型只能读到 OCR 文本;模型不支持图片时会明确提示已转为文字,不再静默丢弃
  • 新增 Harness 后台子代理有可见面 — 后台回合的输出真正到达界面(此前死在订阅关闭之后);子代理横幅可弹窗应答、带运行指示、完成会退出;回合不再在产出前提前收尾
  • 新增 Harness 会话可接续 — 切换或重启后重建线程时把既有对话喂回去;MCP 与另两引擎共用同一个 MCP 进程,配置变更立即生效
  • 新增 Harness 设置页与 VS Code 宿主层对齐另两引擎 — Provider 收敛为官方 / TokenHub / 自定义三条路由、端点处处可编辑、模型可一键刷新;VS Code 补齐一键安装与安装状态判定,此前纯 VS Code 用户装不上第三引擎

idea-plugin.name: PyGloss
idea-plugin.description:
Read unfamiliar Python without rewriting it.

PyGloss adds a linked explanation layer directly inside the PyCharm editor using folds, inlays, and reader views. Its offline Polyglot Lens maps Python idioms to concepts from JavaScript, Java, Go, or C#. Optional Intent Summaries use your configured OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic endpoint.

Your source files remain unchanged. AI features are opt-in and provider credentials are stored in the IDE password store.

idea-plugin.name: SecurStack
idea-plugin.description:
SecurStack brings cloud-powered security scans into JetBrains IDEs.

Scan your local project through the SecurStack SaaS engines and review prioritized results without leaving your development workflow.

Your API key is stored with the JetBrains secure credential store and is only read when needed to run scans.

  • Run repository, file, or directory scans from the IDE.
  • Choose scan engines such as Secrets, IaC, SAST, SCA, License, Container, and Repository Health.
  • Review findings by severity with occurrence details and remediation guidance.
  • Generate AI remediation prompts for visible, non-ignored findings.
  • Configure project Git hook scans with severity and risk score thresholds.

idea-plugin.name: AgentDock
idea-plugin.description:
Manage project-scoped AI CLI sessions without leaving your JetBrains IDE.

AgentDock brings local Codex CLI, Claude Code CLI, and Gemini CLI sessions into a dedicated tool window where you can:

  • discover sessions associated with the current project;
  • create, resume, search, rename, pin, and archive sessions;
  • launch provider commands in the built-in Terminal tool window;
  • view provider usage limits when supported by the local account configuration.

AgentDock is local-first, does not operate a cloud service, and does not collect analytics or telemetry.

Requirements: JetBrains IDE 2025.2 or later and the locally installed CLI for each provider you use.

Source code and documentation · Privacy Policy

AgentDock is an independent open-source project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Google, OpenAI, Anthropic, or JetBrains.

idea-plugin.name: HuiCai AI
idea-plugin.description:
HuiCai AI — the JetBrains edition of the HuiCai AI assistant. It embeds a graphical chat panel in a tool window and reuses exactly the same agent core as the HuiCai VSCode extension and CLI:
  • Browser-based authorization login (device-code flow, shares tokens with CLI / VSCode / Desktop);

  • Local agent tool loop — read/write files (with inline diff review inside the IDE), run commands and dispatch sub-agents in your project; hybrid "platform orchestration + local tools" mode for agents;
  • Editor integration: add selection to chat, explain selection, analyze current file / whole workspace, paste screenshots, upload documents (PDF/Word/Excel/PPT parsed server-side);
  • Skill library (built-in + custom commands + platform-synced Agent Skills), knowledge-base RAG sync, usage windows, diagnostics — UI colors follow the IDE theme.
Requires Node.js 18+ installed on the machine running the IDE.

HuiCai AI 的 JetBrains 版助手：工具窗口内嵌图形对话面板，复用与 VSCode 扩展、CLI 完全相同的智能体核心—— 浏览器授权登录（与 CLI/VSCode/桌面端同一机制、令牌共用）、模型 / 智能体 / 工作流 / 业务数字人 流式对话、 本机工具循环（文件写改经 IDE 内联 diff 审阅）、混合模式、技能库与 MCP 工具、平台知识库 RAG、 编辑器右键集成（选区入上下文/解释/分析）、截图粘贴与富文档上传，界面颜色跟随 IDE 主题。 底层经 Node 子进程运行同一套核心（需本机安装 Node 18+），与 VSCode 扩展版本一致、同步打包。

idea-plugin.change-notes:
2026.08.04 — Million-token context & parallel agents
  • Auto-compaction threshold raised from 80K to 1,000,000 tokens. Long sessions on large projects are no longer interrupted every few turns by summarization. If a model's window cannot hold the request, the client silently compacts and retries — no manual tuning needed.
  • Compaction now triggers on a CJK-aware token estimate instead of a raw character count, so the configured threshold actually takes effect for Chinese conversations.
  • Summarization is chunked and chained for very large contexts, and can also cut inside a single long turn (one prompt + hundreds of tool rounds) without breaking tool-call pairing.
  • Parallel sub-agents: one global concurrency gate shared by dispatch_agent / dispatch_agents / dispatch_member; batch fan-out raised to 12 tasks with a shared context field; a failing sub-task no longer aborts the whole batch. New setting: max parallel sub-agents.
  • Performance: read-only tool concurrency now scales with CPU cores; per-tool-result budget raised from 20K to 60K characters.
  • Also included since 2026.07.21: model-failure fallback (auto-switch to the configured fallback model on timeout/outage, mid-answer continuation included), conversation-title distillation fixes, and per-client conversation auditing.
2026.08.04 — 百万上下文与并行智能体
  • 自动压缩阈值由 8 万提升至 100 万 token：中大型项目的长会话不再每隔几轮就被摘要打断。 模型窗口装不下时客户端会自动压缩后重试，用户无感，无需手动调小阈值。
  • 压缩触发判定改为 CJK 感知的 token 估算（原为字符数×固定比例），中文会话下阈值才真正生效。
  • 超大上下文的摘要改为分块链式递进；单个超长回合（一条提问 + 上百轮工具往返）同样可压缩， 且不拆散工具调用与其结果的配对。
  • 并行子智能体：dispatch_agent / dispatch_agents / dispatch_member 共用一把全局并发闸； 批量派发上限提至 12 个并支持共用背景；单个子任务失败不再拖垮整批。新增「并行子智能体上限」设置。
  • 性能：只读工具并发按 CPU 核数自适应；单条工具结果注入上限由 2 万提升至 6 万字符。
  • 并含 2026.07.21 以来的改进：大模型调用失败兜底（超时/不可用时自动切兜底模型，半截回答续写）、 会话标题提炼修复、各端对话审计。

idea-plugin.name: LDX AI Commits
idea-plugin.description:
LDX AI Commits generates your Git commit messages from the staged diff using an LLM, right inside the IDE's commit dialog.

Features

  • Generate a commit message from the git diff using an LLM.
  • Smart diff: only the files and lines you select in the commit dialog are sent (global and per-project exclusion globs let you skip noisy files).
  • Multiple LLM clients: configure several OpenAI-compatible endpoints, set an active one, or pick any of them from the split-button dropdown to generate with a specific model.
  • Streaming (typewriter) responses with a stop button to cancel an in-progress generation.
  • Custom prompts plus built-in presets: Basic, Conventional Commits, and GitMoji.
  • Template variables to shape the prompt: {diff}, {locale}, {branch}, {hint} (with conditional syntax), {previousCommitMessages}, and IntelliJ Task Manager integration ({taskId}, {taskSummary}, {taskDescription}, {taskTimeSpent}).
  • Output cleanup via regex to strip boilerplate (e.g. "Here is your commit message:") from the model's reply.
  • Per-project overrides for the LLM client, prompt, reply language, and exclusions.
  • Reply-language selection so messages come back in the language you want.
  • Trigger it with the toolbar button in the commit dialog or the Ctrl+Alt+C shortcut.

Supported models

  • Any OpenAI-compatible API (custom base URL): OpenAI, Ollama, vLLM, LiteLLM, or any local server.

The plugin is implemented in a generic way and uses langchain4j to build the OpenAI-compatible chat client. Configure your own base URL, API token, and model ID in the LLM Client settings. To support another model that langchain4j can talk to, please open a feature request on GitHub.

Usage

Install the plugin, then configure an LLM client in the settings:
Settings > Tools > LDX AI Commits

Troubleshooting

If you hit any issues or have feature requests, please report them here.

Support

  • Star the repository

中文说明

LDX AI Commits 是一款基于 LLM 的 IntelliJ 插件，能在 IDE 的提交对话框里，根据你暂存的 git diff 自动生成提交信息。

功能特性

  • 使用 LLM 根据 git diff 生成提交信息。
  • 智能 diff：只发送你在提交对话框中选中的文件和代码行（全局与项目级排除规则可跳过无关文件）。
  • 多 LLM 客户端：可配置多个 OpenAI 兼容的接口，设置默认客户端，或从拆分按钮的下拉菜单中选择任意一个模型来生成。
  • 流式（打字机）响应，并带停止按钮可随时取消正在进行的生成。
  • 自定义 prompt，内置 Basic、Conventional Commits、GitMoji 三套预设。
  • 丰富的模板变量：{diff}、{locale}、{branch}、{hint}（支持条件语法）、{previousCommitMessages}，并集成 IntelliJ 任务管理器（{taskId}、{taskSummary}、{taskDescription}、{taskTimeSpent}）。
  • 输出清理正则：自动去除模型回复中的套话（如“以下是你的提交信息：”）。
  • 项目级覆盖：可为每个项目单独指定 LLM 客户端、prompt、回复语言与排除规则。
  • 可设置回复语言，让生成的提交信息使用你期望的语言。
  • 触发方式：提交对话框中的工具栏按钮，或快捷键 Ctrl+Alt+C。

支持的模型

  • 任意 OpenAI 兼容 API（自定义 base URL）：OpenAI、Ollama、vLLM、LiteLLM，或任意本地服务。

使用方法

安装插件后，在设置中配置 LLM 客户端：
设置 > 工具 > LDX AI Commits

问题反馈

如遇到任何问题或有功能建议，请在此提交：issues。

支持

  • 给仓库点个 Star

  • 单标签语义分类：每一条 [func-XX] 只归属**一个**最贴切的类别，杜绝 func-02（拷贝残留）同时挂到 npe/naming/comment/log/refactor 5 个类的"多标签外溢"。新增关键判断规则：复合拷贝残留 → refactor，"补空格 ≠ bugfix"，"日志描述错误 → log"，subject 不参与 func 分类。
  • 规范依据展示：skill 从 commit body 抽取 规范依据： 块（如 京东JAVA代码规范V1.1 5.3常量定义#2（命中2处）），页面每个 commit 卡片以彩色标签展示（蓝：JAVA代码规范 / 绿：需求迭代开发规范 / 黄：其他）。不去规范文档现场搜索，只忠实抽取 commit 里已声明的依据。

  • 跨用户可复用：所有 js/skill 路径改为通过 AICR_PROJECT_DIR 环境变量注入 + workspace.js 智能兜底（INIT_CWD / PWD / cwd），彻底移除硬编码用户路径。
  • 健壮性修复：修复 skill 4.3.1 shell 命令的 && 短路陷阱（[ -z ] 判空导致 USER_REPLY 丢失）；expect 交互模式移除，改为 skill 内部 shell 阻塞轮询 .joycode-step4-input 文件。
1.1.0:
  • auto-cr skill: Step 4 no longer auto-fixes; instead lists Critical/Warning candidates for the user to select by func-XX id (supports all / none / range / list).
  • Only user-selected items are modified; unselected items are skipped.
  • Review report (aiDoc/code-review/review-result/<branch>_cr_finish_*.md) now marks each func with a special symbol: [USER-APPLIED] / [USER-SKIPPED] / [FIX-FAILED] / [INFO-ONLY], and includes a legend + user-selection summary at the top.
  • Commit message tag changed from auto-fix to user-select-fix and includes the user's raw selection reply plus applied/skipped lists.
  • When user picks "none", an --allow-empty commit is created to preserve traceability.
  • Iron rules / red lines / diff table / final reminders updated: previous "zero user prompts" constraint is relaxed to "only Step 4 may ask for user selection".
1.0.9: Improved plugin metadata, added vendor info and detailed description, optimized Marketplace publishing configuration.

idea-plugin.name: MobKit
idea-plugin.description:
MobKit is a toolkit for YonBuilder mobile development (formerly YonStudio / APICloud Studio): WiFi hot-reload sync to real devices, cloud app checkout / build / publish, and a unified workbench — right inside your IDE. WebStorm first, compatible with all IntelliJ-Platform IDEs.

面向 YonBuilder 移动开发（原 YonStudio / APICloud Studio）的一站式工具，WebStorm 优先，兼容 IntelliJ 平台各 IDE。

  • WiFi 真机同步 — 打开工程自动启动同步服务，AppLoader 扫码连接；保存即增量同步、真机热刷新，Cmd/Ctrl+O 增量、Cmd/Ctrl+I 全量
  • 现代工程 · 实时开发 — 自动识别 Vite 现代构建工程，工作台一键启停开发服务、扫码连接，保存即页内 HMR 热更，无需另开终端；经典 webview 工程行为不变
  • 统一工作台 — 概览 / 同步 / 发布 / 日志 / 项目 / 账户 / 设置集中一处，右侧工具窗、编辑区全屏 tab、状态栏三个入口
  • 云端集成 — 扫码或账号密码登录用友云，免登出切换租户；检出云端应用、新建应用（内置经典 / 现代模板）、上传源码包（备注默认取 Git 提交说明）、云打包出安装包，上传历史可回切启用的源码版本；工作台内可管原生插件、端设置（图标 / 启动页 / 横竖屏）与三端证书
  • 日志面板 — 设备 console 与同步事件实时流，四级着色、来源过滤，可镜像到 IDE 底部原生控制台
  • stml 语法高亮 — 经 TextMate Bundle 提供（需启用平台内置 TextMate Bundles 插件）
  • monorepo 友好 — 工作文件夹内任意深度的多子应用识别与切换，保存同步自动定位所属工程

即将支持：AVM 的 stml / JSX 编译。

运行时要求：本机 Node.js ≥ 22 或 Bun ≥ 1.3（插件经内置 CLI 调用 MobKit 核心，本地 WiFi 同步无需登录）。

本插件免费使用、闭源分发，条款见最终用户许可协议。问题反馈：i@yangyongan.com

idea-plugin.name: OpenCode / Claude Code / Pi / Codex TUI integration
idea-plugin.description:
Use your favorite TUI AI coding agent inside IntelliJ with superpowers!

🛠️ There are many tools that integrate OpenCode, Claude Code, Pi, or Codex, but complex GUIs never perfectly mirror TUI functionality. On the flip side, pure TUI tools often lack seamless interaction between the IDE and the terminal.

💡 To bridge this gap, I forked 🍴 this Chinese plugin, translated it, and modified it for a comfortable, seamless workflow. Feedback is highly welcome!

✨ Features

  • 🎯 Jump to code: Instantly jump from terminal or console file references to exact editor locations, including line numbers and ranges.
  • 📤 Send context: Easily send editor selections, file paths, dragged files, and console error blocks directly to your active OpenCode, Claude Code, Pi, or Codex terminal.
  • 🔍 Diff review: Review file changes from each OpenCode, Claude Code, Pi, or Codex turn side-by-side using the native IntelliJ diff window.
  • ↩️ One-click revert: Instantly revert AI changes and append the context to your next message.
  • 📝 Generate commit messages: Generate concise commit messages from selected files in the Commit panel, with a configurable AI tool, model, and custom prompt.
  • 🔔 Post-turn actions: Run custom commands automatically after a turn ends (e.g., play sounds using pw-play).
idea-plugin.change-notes: Enable click-through for files outside project context. Fix OpenCode 2 commit-message command mode.

idea-plugin.name: Diffzu
idea-plugin.description:
Reviews large AI-generated diffs by grouping them into conceptual change-sets.

Instead of scrolling one endless flat diff, you get a tree of concepts ("Auth refactor", "New endpoint", "Formatting noise") with risk levels and concrete review notes. Double-click any file to open the native diff viewer.

Works on uncommitted local changes or on the current branch vs a base branch. Uses either the Claude Code CLI (your existing subscription) or the Anthropic API.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Fixed

  • Opt-in error reports now redact anything path-shaped from the error message before sending, upholding the "file paths are never sent" privacy promise.

Changed

  • Analytics moved to the PostHog EU region, matching the privacy policy.

idea-plugin.name: Gemini Relay
idea-plugin.description:
Gemini Relay — Google Gemini, native in your JetBrains IDE

A native chat panel that brings Google Gemini into IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, GoLand, Rider and the rest of the JetBrains family — a side-panel coding assistant that talks directly to the Gemini API, to Vertex AI, or to a Vertex deployment behind a custom Apigee gateway, without leaving your IDE or living in the terminal.

Highlights

  • Streaming chat with live tool activity — edits, commands, and file reads as they happen
  • Agent & Ask modes — let Gemini edit and run commands, or keep it strictly read-only
  • Editor-aware — auto-attaches your current selection, so "explain/refactor this" just works
  • Attach files & images — pick a file, or paste a screenshot straight into the prompt (Gemini is multimodal)
  • Searches the web before it answers — release notes, migration guides and real Maven Central coordinates, instead of a version-specific guess from training data
  • MCP tool servers — bring your own tools over the Model Context Protocol
  • Three connection modes — Gemini API key, Vertex AI, or Vertex via Apigee
  • Configurable everything — connection parameters in Settings; secrets in the IDE password safe

Configure the connection under Settings → Tools → Gemini Relay.

☕ Free and open source (MIT). Source, issues, and contributions: github.com/Chelayel/gemini-relay.

Independent and unofficial — not affiliated with Google. Part of the “Relay” family of IDE companions by Chelayel.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.2.0 — The agent can now check its facts. Three new tools: webSearch, fetchUrl (any page or raw file, as readable text) and mavenSearch (real coordinates and published versions from Maven Central). This closes the gap behind the most common wrong answer — asked about a framework release newer than its training data, the model used to invent plausible artifact ids and configuration properties. Search needs an API key from Brave, Tavily or Google Programmable Search, set under Settings → Tools → Gemini Relay → Web access; reading a URL and looking up Maven Central need no key and work out of the box. Also in this release: a configurable cap on tool rounds per turn, a history trim that no longer drops the original request (or breaks a request by orphaning a tool result), an optional thinking level or budget, and MCP servers that fail to start now say so in the transcript instead of silently contributing nothing. Both new pieces can be checked without spending a turn: Test web access calls each web tool live with the values you've just typed, and Test on an MCP server starts it and lists the tools it advertises (with its stderr, when it dies on startup).

1.1.1 — Cleared the last plugin-verifier warning. The 1.0.8 switch to the two-argument CredentialAttributes constructor still compiled down to the deprecated one, because every Kotlin call site goes through the same defaults bridge; the attributes are now built through the constructor that carries no deprecation. Nothing about the plugin's behaviour changes, and the service name and user name used for the keychain entries are unchanged, so a saved API key or Apigee client secret still loads after the update.

1.1.0 — Current models by default. New chats now use gemini-3.7-flash, Google's current model for coding and agentic work, instead of gemini-2.5-pro, and the suggested list follows the 3.x lineup. The list also matches the connection mode — Vertex names some models differently from the Gemini API, and a selection that has an equivalent id is translated when you switch modes rather than left to fail with a 404. In Gemini API mode the live model list is sorted newest-generation first and no longer offers models this panel can't drive (embeddings, TTS, Live, image and video generation).

1.0.9 — The 1.0.8 fix for SimpleListCellRenderer swapped one scheduled-for-removal overload for another (both static factories are marked for removal). Replaced all 4 call sites with the current textListCellRenderer DSL instead, which carries no deprecation.

1.0.8 — Cleared plugin-verifier warnings: replaced the scheduled-for-removal SimpleListCellRenderer.create(String, Function) overload with its Customizer replacement (4 call sites), and made the credential-attributes lookup use the explicit two-argument constructor.

1.0.6 — Refreshed the model list for Google's current lineup and stopped requests failing on retired models: a saved model Google has shut down (e.g. gemini-3-pro-preview) now auto-migrates to a current default, and the error shown when a model is gone points you to the model selector.

1.0.5 — Restored the rich chat transcript on IntelliJ 2026.2+ (build 262), where JCEF became a separate bundled plugin — the panel now depends on it optionally so the in-browser view works again instead of dropping to plain text. The plain-text fallback also renders at the correct font size when JCEF isn't available.

1.0.3 — Fixed the tool window failing to open on recent IntelliJ builds (NoClassDefFoundError: com/intellij/ui/jcef/JBCefApp): it now degrades to the plain-text transcript instead of failing to initialize.

1.0.0 — First release: native Google Gemini chat panel with streaming transcript & tool activity, Agent & Ask modes, three connection modes (Gemini API, Vertex AI, Vertex via Apigee), editor-aware context, file & image attachments, personas, project memory, and MCP tool servers.

idea-plugin.name: AI Diff Commit
idea-plugin.description:
AI Diff Commit — generate Git commit messages from your selected diff with AI.

  • Streamed output into the Commit message box, with Stop support
  • Many providers: OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Ollama, Kimi, DashScope, SiliconFlow, VolcEngine, Cloudflare, and custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints
  • Prompt priority: project commit-prompt.txt → global prompt → built-in default
  • Uses only changes and unversioned files selected in the Commit UI

Source: github.com/AnkioTomas/commit · Issues: GitHub Issues

idea-plugin.name: SkillOps
idea-plugin.description:
Create reliable, repository-scoped skills for Codex, Claude Code, and Gemini CLI without leaving IntelliJ IDEA.

SkillOps removes the repetitive setup from skill authoring and helps you understand how Codex, Claude, and Gemini sessions use context and tokens.

  • Create platform-specific skills with structured SKILL.md content and supporting references.
  • Copy and convert repository skills between Codex, Claude Code, and Gemini CLI.
  • Generate optional scripts and assets, plus Codex interface metadata.
  • Validate Codex skills before committing them.
  • Review local Codex, Claude, and Gemini run history, token usage, cache behavior, efficiency, and sessions without skills.
  • Search and resume previous project Codex sessions in a new IntelliJ terminal.

Private by design: generation, validation, and session analysis run locally. SkillOps does not upload project files, prompts, session logs, credentials, or analytics.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• Preserves and displays Codex prompt history for Resume Session and Run Insights.
  • Derives concise session titles from the latest meaningful prompt and filters injected project instructions.
  • Prioritizes token metrics and efficiency details before prompts in Run Insights.
  • Explains transcript-size warnings in terms of scan time and context overhead.
  • Supports IntelliJ IDEA from 2024.2 onward and verifies compatibility through 2025.2.

idea-plugin.name: OmniCode Agent
idea-plugin.description:
OmniCode Agent is a free, provider-neutral coding agent for JetBrains IDEs.

  • A focused Chat, History, and Settings workspace with inline Plan, Tasks, Subagents, and reviewed Edits.
  • Model-aware reasoning levels from Auto through Full Speed, using native controls when verified and safe Agent-only controls otherwise.
  • Bring-your-own-key support for major model APIs and OpenAI-compatible services.
  • Reviewed code edits, approved commands, workspace sandboxing, MCP, Skills, and prompt templates.
  • Approved, bounded read-only queries to user-configured remote PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MariaDB URLs without a local database installation.
  • Agent Harness preflight plus a project Harness for rules, knowledge maps, argv feedback loops, recovery-safe tool surfaces, and indexed large-repository context.
  • One-click credential-presence, network, model, MCP OAuth and sandbox diagnostics with redacted export.
  • Project and desktop attachments including images and Markdown.
  • Local, redacted lead-workflow checkpoints with explicit resume or discard after an IDE restart.
  • Theme and optional local desktop-pet controls live in Settings instead of occupying the main navigation.
  • Local history, TokenTracker-powered usage dashboard, tool auditing, and durable task recovery.
  • Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Grok, Kimi, OpenCode, Pi, OMP, and DSH local-engine integration.
  • All retained features are free; no license or trial gate is required.

Source code · Privacy notice
idea-plugin.change-notes:
3.0.27

  • 修复本地 CLI 的 Agent 工具面不一致：OpenCode 现在通过临时、仅回环的原生 MCP 获得受审批的 apply_patch、apply_change、run_command 与 query_database。
  • Claude Code、Codex CLI、Gemini、Kimi、Grok、Pi 与 OMP 的非交互适配器也会将上述请求转回 OmniCode 审批、沙箱、审计与检查点边界；Plan/Research 不会获得超出模式权限的写入工具。

3.0.26

  • 修复助手消息中的项目文件引用：支持 文件:行号、空格分隔行号、L行号、行范围、中文文件名和 Windows 路径；点击后会在 IDE 中定位并选中对应范围。
  • 内部文件链接协议在 Markdown 安全过滤后仍会受桥接白名单与项目根目录校验保护，不会将任意外部路径开放给页面。
  • 修复危险权限确认从 WebView 回调线程访问 IDE UI 的问题，并优化项目地图的节点密度、连线与窄侧栏浏览。

  • MCP HTTP 401/403 现在会自动识别 OAuth 2.1 / PKCE 或 Bearer Token 要求，保留预填配置并提供登录/保存凭据后自动复测的直接操作，不再只提示检查服务端日志。

3.0.24

3.0.23

  • 新增 CCGUI 风格的宿主桥接重注入与前端 ready 丢包重试；只重试无副作用握手，不会重复提交任务或设置操作。
  • ready 看门狗扩展为 45 秒冷启动窗口，JCEF 重建会切换页面代次，同时继续保留宿主中的会话、任务和检查点。

3.0.22

  • 新增会话标签与有界历史分页：后台任务可独立运行并随时切回，关闭标签不会停止任务，实时事件按会话与序列隔离。
  • JCEF 增加有界事件队列、ready 握手看门狗和自动重建，避免迟到快照覆盖流式内容或界面长期空白、旋转。
  • 本地 CLI 历史恢复保留安全可见的工具记录和图片引用；OpenCode、Codex、Kimi、Pi 等模型发现与运行时路径诊断进一步统一。
  • MCP 配置可按通用、Claude Code 或 Codex 隔离，并补充跨平台运行时指引；TokenTracker 支持确认后由 OmniCode 启动和停止。

  • 桌宠升级为原创矢量角色库，支持状态动画、预览、拖拽贴边、主题配色和减少动态效果。

  • 实时事件按会话、轮次和序列去重，历史快照不再覆盖流式内容，失败或取消后的阶段卡不会持续旋转。
  • 模型选择器支持搜索、收藏和自适应向上展开；输入草稿按会话隔离，窄侧栏下不再遮挡发送操作。
  • 新增会话重命名、只读上下文面板、原生任务通知以及安全导入 MCP 配置。

3.0.16

  • 修复 OpenCode 事件流静默时绕过无进展看门狗的问题；现在会在有界时间内取消挂起请求并保留可恢复会话。

3.0.9

  • 修复 OpenCode 请求取消和无响应卡死：取消会中断阻塞读取、回收读取线程，并对无进展连接提供有界看门狗；迟到事件不会重新打开已结束任务。
  • 修复历史/实时时间线重复合并与孤儿运行状态，恢复会话后能正确显示最终状态。

3.0.8

  • 修复 Windows 用户目录 PATH 生成中的混合分隔符，确保 GUI 启动的 Node/NPX MCP 服务可正确解析运行时路径。

3.0.7

  • 修复 Windows CI 中 MCP 运行时路径测试使用 Unix 固定路径导致发布构建失败的问题。

3.0.6

  • 修复 Windows 发布检查失败时无法诊断的问题，并重新验证 CLI 取消、会话恢复和多会话隔离。

3.0.5

  • 修复本地 CLI 父进程退出后子进程仍持有 stdout 管道导致运行时预检或响应读取卡住的问题；退出后输出排空现在有界且可取消。

3.0.4

  • 修复 Codex 原生会话停止/超时后仍占用输出线程的问题；MCP 连接、会话切换、历史恢复和审阅操作增加任务级隔离与可恢复性。
  • 连接错误现在提供脱敏诊断、打开设置和重试入口；文件引用支持行号范围跳转，长对话避免流式内容被旧快照覆盖。

3.0.3

  • 修复 Windows 发布流水线在标签版本检查阶段重复启动 Gradle 导致网络超时的问题；版本检查现在不依赖外部下载。

3.0.2

  • Team 模式现在会为不暴露工具调用的本地 CLI 启动真实的 Codex 原生子代理，并将有界证据交给主会话汇总。
  • 修复并行会话的子代理事件合并问题；每个子代理拥有稳定且独立的时间线区块。
  • 设置与新会话默认使用自动策略：小任务保持单 Agent，复杂任务才启用 Team。

3.0.1

  • 修复 OpenCode 已完成后仍持续旋转：同步消息响应作为终态，迟到阶段事件不再重新打开运行状态。
  • 重新整理对话时间线，只保留一个当前进度行，工具、子代理和变更卡保持完整宽度。
  • 会话任务按 conversation ID 隔离；新会话可并行运行，历史中可识别并切回后台运行的会话。
  • 后台会话事件、取消、终态持久化和审阅结果不再串入当前会话。

3.0.0

  • 重构为聊天、历史、设置三视图，计划、任务、子代理和变更审阅回归当前对话。
  • 新增统一事件信封和 JCEF/React 实时/历史管线，切页不再卸载聊天。
  • 统一八类本地 CLI 引擎，保留普通 API 供应商和既有安全边界。
  • 移除独立科研、Semi Design 和商业许可证入口；所有保留功能免费。

2.2.14

  • 修复 OpenCode 已提交请求后被 15 秒心跳误标为“模型请求完成”的问题，明确区分项目快照、上游排队和回答生成。
  • 收到 OpenCode 最终 step_finish(stop/length) 后立即完成任务并终止单次进程树，不再等待非必要的项目快照清理或进程退出。

2.2.13

  • 修复本地 CLI 子进程 stdin 未关闭导致 OpenCode 在读取非 TTY 输入时永久等待、会话无法创建的问题。
  • 所有参数式单次 CLI 请求和模型发现都会立即发送 EOF，继续保留取消、超时和隔离边界。

2.2.12

  • OpenCode 单次任务改用官方支持的内存会话数据库并显式使用非交互 build Agent，移除固定数据库的 WAL/初始化竞态。
  • 请求到达模型前若本地会话卡住，会自动重启一次全新隔离会话；失败阶段不再被 UI 误标为“初始化完成”。

2.2.11

  • OpenCode 子进程使用独立的模型 cache/state 运行区，避免与 JetBrains 内置 OpenCode ACP 争用全局锁；继续复用用户现有登录与供应商配置。

2.2.10

  • OpenCode 任务使用 OmniCode 专用会话数据库，避免与 JetBrains 内置 ACP 或用户终端 CLI 的版本、迁移和 WAL 锁互相阻塞。
  • 主时间线区分本地初始化、会话创建、项目快照和模型连接；本地会话 30 秒未创建会明确停止，不再伪装成长时间模型推理。

2.2.9

  • 移除本地 CLI 固定 45 秒首输出中止；排队或初始化期间按总请求时限等待，并持续显示可取消的进度。
  • OpenCode 跳过无关的标题模型调用及请求级目录刷新/维护，并实时显示脱敏的过载、限流、连接中断和超时状态。

2.2.8

  • 所有本地 CLI 现在在当前项目目录启动；增加运行时预检和 45 秒无输出保护，避免错误扫描 Home 目录后无限等待。
  • 修复 Kimi/Pi 模型参数转发与 Qoder 非交互启动参数；不再隐式启用 Qoder 的 --yolo。

2.2.7

  • 修复 OpenCode CLI 本地模型发现的编译问题，恢复 Windows 发布验证。

2.2.6

  • OpenCode CLI 可直接读取本机已登录账户的模型列表并在模型菜单中切换，不需要 API Key。

2.2.5

  • 统一 CLI 检测与运行时 PATH，npm CLI 不再因 IDE 缺少 Node 而显示可用却无法启动。
  • CLI 页面仅将真实可运行的工具计入统计，并保留当前选择状态与修复指引。

2.2.4

  • 修复本地 CLI 请求看似卡住、取消无法及时生效：输出改为增量显示，取消或超时会终止插件启动的整个 CLI 进程树。

2.2.3

  • 修复停止任务仍卡在“正在安全停止”：取消等待 5 秒后释放 IDE 调度器，隔离迟到事件和结果，并保留恢复点。

2.2.2

  • 修复任务取消卡住：MCP 客户端关闭增加 3 秒硬截止时间，超时后立即完成取消和恢复点收尾。

2.2.1

  • 修复 MCP 子进程找不到 node/python：将增强后的安全运行时 PATH 传递给 npx/uvx。

2.2.0

  • 新增安全独立 Session：运行中可新建对话，后台任务继续使用原会话历史，避免上下文串线。

2.1.9

  • 稳定 MCP 运行时路径探测，兼容 Windows 构建与 GUI 启动的 IDE 环境。

2.1.8

2.1.7

2.1.6

  • 修复 CLI 按钮点击无反馈：选择成功后立即显示“已选择”，失败时保留重试入口。

2.1.5

2.1.4

2.1.3

  • 修复“使用此 CLI”无反馈问题：现在立即保存供应商选择并切换到 CLI 标签页。

2.1.2

  • 深度优化对话时间线：MCP 警告改为带背景、边框和自动换行的诊断卡片。

2.1.1

2.0.13

2.0.12

2.0.8

2.0.6

2.0.5

2.0.4

2.0.3

2.0.0

1.10.0

1.9.4

1.8.0

1.7.3

1.7.2

1.7.1

1.4.1

  • Made completed-turn actions wrap inside narrow JetBrains tool windows so retry, edit, task details, copy, and timing never overflow the chat boundary.

1.4.0

1.3.0

1.2.1

  • Added a Codex-style completion summary with total duration, time to first response, tool count, and consumed tokens, so long runs remain understandable instead of appearing frozen.
  • Kept the completed-reply copy action independent from checkpoint recovery controls; disabling recovery actions no longer disables unrelated reply actions.

1.2.0

  • Added an inline Codex-style change summary after Agent edits: files, added/removed line counts, direct file/range links, and a one-click route to the persistent review center.
  • Kept file references workspace-relative and fail-closed, supporting path:148-169, path 148-169, and GitHub path#L148-L169 forms with mouse and keyboard activation.

  • Added a one-click copy action to completed assistant replies, preserving the original Markdown/code text for use outside the IDE.
  • Reduced planning noise with targeted Plan/Claude Plan exploration guidance while preserving the user's configured execution boundaries.
  • Kept Usage Statistics embedded in the third-party TokenTracker local dashboard with an external-browser fallback when JCEF is unavailable.
  • Fixed compact timeline rendering for full-width Chinese stage separators in the chat transcript.

idea-plugin.name: GitCommitAI
idea-plugin.description:
GitCommitAI is an AI-powered Git commit message generator that helps you write clean, professional, and well-structured commit messages in a fraction of a second.

🇬🇧 English Version

🤖 Supported Models
  • Online Providers: OpenAI (GPT-4o/GPT-3.5), DeepSeek (V3/Coder), Google Gemini, and any OpenAI-compatible API providers.
  • Local Models: Dynamic auto-detection for local offline models running via Ollama (e.g., Llama3, Qwen, Codegemma).
⚙️ How to Configure
  • 1. Open Settings: Go to Settings -> Tools -> GitCommitAI to open the configuration pane.
  • 2. Set Credentials: Enter your API Key, select your model provider, and configure either an online base URL or auto-sniff your local Ollama address.
  • 3. Customize Rules: Easily define custom global instructions, repository-specific commit rules (via COMMIT_CONV.md), or personalized prompt constraints.
💡 Key Features
  • ⚡ Seamless Streaming Output - Messages are generated and rendered in real-time word-by-word with zero delay.
  • 🏷️ Conventional Commits Compliance - Automatically writes messages adhering to standard conventional specifications (feat, fix, refactor, etc.).
  • 🌐 Bilingual Live UI - Instant hot-swaps between Simplified Chinese and English output with a single click.
  • 📝 Smart Message Buffer - Safely caches draft inputs, keeping your edits safe even under network disconnects.

🇨🇳 中文版说明

🤖 支持的大模型
  • 在线服务商：支持主流在线模型（如 OpenAI、DeepSeek、Gemini）以及任何兼容 OpenAI 格式的自定义服务商。
  • 本地离线大模型：支持本地离线模型，一键检测并加载本地运行的 Ollama 离线大模型（如 Llama3、Qwen、Codegemma 等）。
⚙️ 配置引导步骤
  • 1. 打开设置：依次点击 Settings -> Tools -> GitCommitAI 调出插件专属配置面板。
  • 2. 配置认证：输入您的 API 密钥，选择对应的服务商并填入自定义接口地址（或点击一键嗅探检测本地 Ollama 运行地址）。
  • 3. 设定规则：自由定义您的个性化提示词，或配置项目专属的提交规范规则（支持自动读取项目根目录下的 COMMIT_CONV.md）。
💡 核心旗舰功能
  • ⚡ 毫秒级极速流式打字：吐字过程如行云流水，流畅自然无积压缓冲，让您告别生成卡顿。
  • 🏷️ 行业规范化模板生成：智能识别代码改动并归类（feat、fix、refactor等），确保 Git 提交树高度整洁合规。
  • 🌐 中英双语一键动态动态切换：完美适配中英双语，输出语言与软件界面动态热重载同步。
  • 📝 智能输入草稿安全自愈：内置自动草稿备份，即使遭遇网络中断或生成异常，也能一键回滚恢复未提交的本地草稿。
idea-plugin.change-notes:
GitCommitAI v1.1.2 Stability & Performance Release.

🇬🇧 English Version

v1.1.2 (Stability & Performance)

  • EDT UI Freeze Cure: Segmented monolithic Read Action lock into transient scopes and relocated O(N*M) DP computations to the background thread, 100% curing the 22-second UI hanging.
  • Double Safeguard Boundaries: Integrated a hard 40,000 character buffer cap and limited single-file DP diff processing to 800 lines to prevent Gemini API HTTP 400 (Token Exceeded) failures.
  • BGT-Action Update: Fully converted action presentation state to background calculations with ActionUpdateThread.BGT, avoiding EDT jams and removing platform deprecation warnings.

🇨🇳 中文版更新日志

v1.1.2 (性能与稳定性升级)

  • 读锁解耦根治卡顿： 将原长生命周期大读锁（Read Lock）彻底碎裂解耦，仅在获取 Revision 数据时使用瞬时局部读锁。耗时极高 O(N*M) 的 DP 差分计算剥离至外部后台线程，100% 根除 22 秒 UI 冻结。
  • 双重限流边界防护： 引入全局累计 40,000 字符强行卡扣，并压缩单文件差分计算至最大 800 行。完美防御超大变动导致 Gemini 流式请求返回 HTTP 400 (Token Exceeded) 的崩溃问题。
  • BGT 并发线程消警： 重写 Action 状态更新底层逻辑，全面升级为 ActionUpdateThread.BGT。彻底消除平台层 EDT 拥堵警告，让界面渲染刷新更轻盈。

idea-plugin.name: Claude Code [Kit]
idea-plugin.description:
Claude Code [Kit] brings the Claude CLI into your JetBrains IDE — both for generating commit messages and for feeding file references straight into a Claude Code session running in the terminal.

Features
  • Generate commit messages — a button on the commit panel toolbar sends the files checked for the commit to Claude, which inspects the diffs itself via read-only git commands and fills the generated message into the commit message field. The output language can follow the IDE or be pinned to Chinese/English, and your own prompt is appended to the built-in commit conventions.
  • Copy / Send CC reference — right-click in the editor or the project view (or press Ctrl+Alt+K, Cmd+Alt+K on macOS) to build a Claude Code reference for the current file and selection (@path#Lstart-end) and either copy it to the clipboard or type it into the terminal.
    Send types the reference into only the currently active terminal tab. This deliberately differs from the official Claude Code [Beta] plugin, whose shortcut broadcasts the reference to every open Claude session at once — so you can keep several Claude sessions side by side and reference a file into exactly the one you mean.
  • Auto-open Claude Code — when you send a reference and no terminal is open, a new terminal is created, the Claude CLI is launched in it, and the reference is typed in automatically (on by default; can be turned off).
  • Switch terminal tabs with Cmd+1…9 — while the focus is inside the Terminal tool window, Cmd+N (Alt+N on Windows/Linux) selects the N-th terminal tab instead of opening the numbered tool window. Anywhere else, when there is no N-th tab, and when that tab is already the selected one, the IDE keeps its own behavior — so pressing the same shortcut again opens the numbered tool window as usual (on by default; can be turned off).
  • Switch project windows with Option+1…9 (macOS) — Option+N brings the N-th open project window to the front and moves the focus into it, numbered the way the IDE's own Window menu lists them (by project name), so the numbers stay put across restarts. It works from inside the terminal too, so you can jump between projects without leaving a Claude Code session (on by default). On Windows/Linux the actions ship without a shortcut, since Alt+1…9 belongs to the IDE tool windows there — bind your own under Settings > Keymap.
    Note: on non-US Mac keyboard layouts Option+digit is how some characters are typed (German { } = Option+8/9, Spanish @ = Option+2). The shortcut takes those keystrokes over — turn the option off if you need them.
  • Bilingual UI — the interface and settings follow the IDE display language (English or Simplified Chinese).
  • Close terminal before the project closes — an optional convenience that closes the Terminal tool window on the way out, so a terminal whose shell is already gone is not restored the next time the project opens.
Configurable under Settings > Tools > Claude Code [Kit] (Claude CLI path, API URL/key, model, timeout, custom prompt, and the terminal options above). The CC reference and auto-open features require the bundled Terminal plugin. Requires IDE 2025.3.6 or newer. Claude Code [Kit] 把 Claude CLI 集成进你的 JetBrains IDE——既能生成 Git 提交消息, 也能把文件引用直接送进终端里运行的 Claude Code 会话。

功能
  • 生成提交消息——提交面板工具栏上的一个按钮,把本次勾选提交的文件交给 Claude, 它自己用只读的 git 命令查看差异,并把生成的消息填回提交消息框。输出语言可跟随 IDE,也可固定 为中文/英文;你的自定义提示词会追加在内置的提交约定之后。
  • 复制 / 发送 CC 引用——在编辑器或项目视图中右键(或按 Ctrl+Alt+K,macOS 为 Cmd+Alt+K),为当前文件与选区生成 Claude Code 引用(@path#Lstart-end),复制到 剪贴板或输入到终端。
    发送只会把引用输入到当前激活的终端标签页。这一点有意区别于官方的 Claude Code [Beta] 插件——后者的快捷键会把引用同时广播到所有已打开的 Claude 会话; 因此你可以并排开多个 Claude 会话,把文件引用精确发送到你想要的那一个。
  • 自动打开 Claude Code——发送引用时如果没有打开的终端,会自动新建终端、在其中启动 Claude CLI,并把引用输入进去(默认开启,可关闭)。
  • Cmd+1~9 切换终端标签页——焦点在终端工具窗内时,Cmd+N(Windows/Linux 为 Alt+N) 切换到第 N 个终端标签页,而不是打开对应编号的工具窗。焦点在别处、没有第 N 个标签页、 或已经在第 N 个标签页时,仍保持 IDE 原有行为——所以再按一次同样的快捷键,会照常打开 对应编号的工具窗(默认开启,可关闭)。
  • Option+1~9 切换项目窗口(macOS)——Option+N 把第 N 个已打开的项目窗口切到前台 并把焦点移进去,编号与 IDE 自带的 Window 菜单一致(按项目名排序),重启后编号也不会变。 焦点在终端里时同样生效,因此不用离开 Claude Code 会话就能 在多个项目之间跳转(默认开启,可关闭)。Windows/Linux 上 Alt+1~9 属于 IDE 工具窗,故不预设 快捷键,可在 Settings > Keymap 中自行绑定。
    注意:在非美式 Mac 键盘布局上,Option+数字是输入字符用的(德语 { } = Option+8/9,西班牙语 @ = Option+2)。本快捷键会接管这些按键,需要它们的话请关闭 该选项。
  • 中英双语界面——界面与设置跟随 IDE 显示语言(英文或简体中文)。
  • 关闭项目前关闭终端——一个可选的便捷项,在项目关闭时先关掉终端工具窗,这样其 shell 已不存在的空终端下次打开项目时就不会再被恢复出来。
可在 Settings > Tools > Claude Code [Kit] 中配置(Claude CLI 路径、API 地址/密钥、 模型、超时、自定义提示词,以及上述终端选项)。CC 引用与自动打开功能需要启用捆绑的终端插件。 需要 IDE 2025.3.6 或更高版本。
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.5.1 — Option+1…9 project switching made reliable. Option+N now invokes the N-th entry of the IDE's own Window menu, so the numbering is the menu's (by project name) instead of the order the windows happened to finish opening in — which shifted between restarts and whenever a project was closed — and the switch moves the focus into the target window, where it previously could raise the window without taking the focus. Inside the terminal the shortcut no longer goes dead or starts typing into the shell after a project window is opened or closed. The number of the window you are already in re-focuses it instead of typing a stray character (Option+1 = "¡") into the editor.

1.5.0 — Option+1…9 (macOS) switch to the N-th open project window, numbered in the order the windows were opened. The shortcut also works while the focus is inside the Terminal tool window, so a Claude Code session no longer has to be left behind to switch projects.

1.4.1 — Cmd/Alt+N no longer swallows the keystroke when the N-th terminal tab is already the selected one: the shortcut falls through to the IDE, so pressing Cmd+1 again while on the first terminal tab activates the Project tool window as usual instead of doing nothing.

1.4.0 — The auto-close terminal option now runs when the project closes instead of when it opens: the Terminal is hidden before the layout is saved, so it is never restored and no longer flashes open on startup. The setting was renamed accordingly; existing enabled settings migrate automatically.

1.3.1 — Renamed the plugin to Claude Code [Kit] (was "Claude Code Commit"), matching the naming style of the official Claude Code [Beta] plugin. No functional changes.

1.3.0 — Cmd+1…9 (Alt+1…9 on Windows/Linux) switch to the N-th terminal tab while the Terminal tool window has the focus. Elsewhere, and when the tab does not exist, the IDE's own "Activate <X> Tool Window" still runs.

1.2.0 — Optional setting to auto-close the Terminal tool window when a project opens (independent of commit-message generation; requires the Terminal plugin). Kept in its own group on the settings page.

1.1.0 — Editor popup menu actions "复制 CC 引用" (copies a Claude Code reference, @path#Lstart-end, for the current file and selection) and "发送 CC 引用" (types the reference into the active terminal tab).

1.0.1 — Save API Key in plugin settings.

1.0.0 — Initial release: commit-panel button, Claude CLI integration, tag-based message extraction, customizable prompt.

idea-plugin.name: Sightline
idea-plugin.description:
Claude Code inside Android Studio, with reviewable changes and controlled tool execution.

Sightline provides a native Android Studio interface for a locally installed Claude Code CLI.

Use it to:

  • Chat with Claude without leaving Android Studio.
  • Attach files and IDE context, and remove any of it before you send.
  • Review tool requests and proposed changes as diffs before they apply.
  • Stop a turn without losing the conversation, and pick up where you left off.
  • Watch what a subagent is doing inside the task that started it.
  • Run your own Claude Code commands, skills and plugins from the panel.
  • Inspect structured build, test and diagnostic results.

Android-aware. Sightline knows your build variant, connected device, module and running process, so you don't have to explain them. It reads Gradle failures into typed diagnoses, resolves crashes back to the line that threw, picks the tests worth running for what you changed, and audits your merged manifest. Logcat is redacted before it can reach a prompt.

Requires the Claude Code CLI (the claude command), installed and authenticated separately. Sightline does not provide Claude access, does not handle your credentials, and has no login screen or backend of its own.

No telemetry. No analytics, no usage statistics, nothing sent anywhere except to the local claude process you started. Sightline itself writes no transcript; note that the Claude Code CLI keeps its own session history under ~/.claude/projects/, under your account and its own retention rules, which is what lets a conversation resume.

Sightline is an independent project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic, JetBrains or Google. "Claude" and "Claude Code" are trademarks of Anthropic; "Android Studio" is a trademark of Google. Both are used only to describe compatibility.

Copyright © 2026 Michael Carroll. Source-available — the source is published so it can be read and audited, but it is not open source and may not be redistributed. Using Sightline in your work, including commercially, is expressly permitted. Free during the beta. See the licence accompanying this listing.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.11.0 — a calmer, easier-to-follow conversation.

Each reply reads as a sequence of steps. Every step Claude takes sits on a thin line down the left with a dot beside it: green when a tool finished, red when it failed, a hollow ring when you denied it, and teal while it is running or waiting for you. Tool steps lead with the tool's name — Bash, Read, Edit — and a file appears as its name, which you can click to open.

Commands show what ran and what came back. You see the command and the first few lines of its output; longer output fades out, says how many lines are hidden, and opens with a click. Thinking takes one line — “Thought for 4s”.

You can always tell where things stand. A running reply ends with a line saying it is still working, with the elapsed time — or that it is waiting for you. Scroll through a long answer and the question that asked for it stays pinned at the top.

A tidier message box, with its own model button. Steps are now shown by default; for the one-line summary instead, choose More ▸ Hide technical details.

Fixed: warning and note callouts showed as plain text on Android Studio 2026.2.

idea-plugin.name: TruthSpine Connector
idea-plugin.description:
This plugin installs the TruthSpine connector, not the protected TruthSpine desktop app.

On first run, a persistent setup action opens Microsoft Store on Windows or Mac App Store on Mac. Setup remains incomplete until the plugin detects the app.

After app detection, the plugin shows the exact project already open in the IDE and asks once before reading or connecting it. It never searches the rest of the computer.

Stop re-explaining your project to every new AI chat.

TruthSpine automatically gives each connected agent what it needs to continue: your latest project decisions, completed work, supporting evidence, and next steps.

  • Connect the exact project open in your JetBrains IDE.
  • Get the Windows or Mac app from one Store action; the plugin keeps this project ready and resumes setup after the app and trial are confirmed.
  • Copy the short chat attach phrase when your workspace needs it.

TruthSpine is local-first. This plugin does not collect telemetry or upload project content.

This connector is free and licensed under Apache License 2.0. The protected TruthSpine desktop app is installed and licensed separately. Installing the plugin does not start a TruthSpine trial or create a separate connector license.

On Windows, acquire the one-time free Microsoft Store trial add-on to start 14 days. A one-time USD 95 Microsoft Store purchase unlocks TruthSpine V1 and all 1.x updates on eligible devices for that Store account; reinstalling does not restart the trial.

On Mac, the 14-day trial starts only after you choose it and Apple completes the StoreKit transaction. A one-time USD 95 non-consumable purchase unlocks TruthSpine V1 and all 1.x updates, and Restore Purchases restores access on eligible Macs.

Future major versions are separate purchases.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• Asks once before connecting the exact project already open in the IDE.
  • Uses the IDE project path directly and never searches the whole computer automatically.
  • Names the package TruthSpine Connector and keeps setup visible until the protected desktop app is detected.
  • Adds a resumable Get TruthSpine flow that routes only to the official Microsoft Store or Mac App Store and recovers the current project afterward.
  • Preserves the free connector boundary: trial, purchase, restore, and licensing remain owned by the protected desktop app and its app store.

idea-plugin.name: Claude Sessions
idea-plugin.description:
Shows exactly what Claude Code changed in a session — never mixed up with your own uncommitted edits.
  • Claude Sessions tool window: browse sessions for the current project as cards (title, date, files changed)
  • Per-file change list with +/- line stats, Keep/Reject buttons, color-coded new/deleted files
  • Native multi-file diff view for a session, with Prev/Next to cycle through every touched file
  • Inline Keep/Reject review for the latest session, directly in the editor — GitHub Copilot-style struck-through removed lines and highlighted added lines, not just a diff popup
  • Detects files deleted via Bash rm, not just Edit/Write/NotebookEdit
Independent of git — works even on files with no baseline in version control.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• 0.3.13: confirmed fixed — a line appended at the very bottom of the file now correctly gets its Keep/Reject action bar; removed 0.3.12's temporary diagnostic logging, no longer needed
  • 0.3.12: 0.3.11's fix didn't resolve it — added temporary diagnostic logging (idea.log, "computePlan:" lines) to see what reconstructEndOfSession/ownFragments/laterFragments actually produce for an EOF-ending hunk that's disappearing
  • 0.3.11: fixed 0.3.10's fix hiding a real session change — a line appended at the very bottom of the file lost its action bar entirely. Pure-string transcript replay has no notion of the IDE's own "ensure line feed at file end" behavior, so the reconstructed end-of-session text could disagree with the live document by exactly one trailing newline; right at EOF that reads as a later edit colliding with the hunk that ends there (the appended line), so remapHunksToLiveOffsets silently dropped it. Reconstructed text now matches the live document's trailing-newline convention before diffing
  • 0.3.10: fixed a manual edit (made outside any session) showing up inline as if it were part of the active session's own changes, with a Keep/Reject bar on an edit Claude never made — computePlan only took the replay+remap path (isolating this session's own hunks from anything that happened after) when another session's transcript also touched the file; a manual edit leaves no transcript, so it fell into the plain baseline-vs-live diff and got misattributed. Now always replays this session's own edits and diffs the live document against that reconstruction — any divergence since, transcript-recorded or not, is treated as "later" and never turned into a hunk of its own
  • 0.3.9: pure-insertion new line no longer gets the word-emphasis color (0.3.7's addition) — uses only the line-wash color (INSERTED_LINE_BACKGROUND_COLOR) across the whole line, same as the fallback rewrite case; the blank ghost "old" line above stays
  • 0.3.8: NEW_TEXT_EMPHASIS_COLOR (the newly-added-words highlight) set to #294436, flat across both themes
  • 0.3.7: pure-insertion new lines now get the exact same view a modified line's changed word does — an empty ghost "old" line above (instead of no ghost at all), whole-line wash, and a strong emphasis highlight on the new content — rather than just the faint wash on its own, which is what was actually invisible in dark theme. Same two colors the modified-line branch already uses for this pairing, nothing new, nothing changed
  • 0.3.6: reverted 0.3.5 entirely — layering strong emphasis over the whole new span made a pure-insertion line's background visibly stronger than before, which is exactly the color change asked not to make; back to just the plain wash. Separately, fixed a real bug 0.3.5 made obvious: a hunk's whole-line highlighter (markup.addRangeHighlighter with HighlighterTargetArea.LINES_IN_RANGE) was painting one line too many — its endOffset2 always sits exactly at the start of the following line, and LINES_IN_RANGE resolves its last line via document.getLineNumber(endOffset), which for a boundary offset resolves to that following, unrelated line. Same family of bug as 0.2.35's action-bar anchor fix, just a different API (MarkupModel, not InlayModel) that fix never touched — backing the end offset up by one character (onto the hunk's own trailing newline) fixes it here too
  • 0.3.4: reverted 0.3.3's pure-insertion whole-line background color swap — that one was explicitly meant to stay untouched, only the specific-word highlight color (0.3.2) was in scope; added a small transparent gap above the action bar so it reads as its own floating panel instead of sitting flush against the line it's reviewing
  • 0.3.3: action bar corners softened back to a slight round (was a harsh rectangle in 0.3.2), background brightened well past Darcula's editor color so it reads as its own floating panel; the pure-insertion whole-line background (brand new line, nothing to word-align against, so it never got 0.3.2's word-highlight fix) was still using the near-invisible-in-dark INSERTED_LINE_BACKGROUND_COLOR — new NEW_INSERTED_LINE_COLOR just for that spot, same approach as 0.3.2's word-highlight fix
  • 0.3.2: inline action bar is a plain rectangle now, not rounded; the specific-word highlight color on a modified line barely showed up in dark theme (its dark value sat only ~25 RGB off Darcula's editor background) — added one new, clearly-contrasted color (NEW_TEXT_EMPHASIS_COLOR) for just that spot, every other existing color (including the pure-insertion whole-line background, corrected after initially swapping it too) untouched
  • 0.3.1: nearby changes now share one Keep/Reject action bar instead of one per raw diff hunk — a file with several small edits close together no longer stacks separate floating bars a line or two apart. Adjacent hunks separated by up to 2 unchanged lines merge into one group; Keep/Reject act on the whole merged span at once (safe, since the untouched lines in between are identical in old/new text either way)
  • 0.3.0: since 0.2.20 —
    • fixed the "Keep/Reject" action bar anchoring one line below the actual change for a hunk ending exactly at a line boundary (e.g. a clean single-line insertion); EditorEmbeddedComponentManager.Properties now passes relatesToPrecedingText=true
    • "Accept All"/"Reject All" text turns green/red on hover
    • file-list and inline editor Keep/Reject pills got smaller, with the same checkmark/X icons on both
    • fixed a long session title overlapping the "● Active" badge / "..." button when the tool window is narrow
    • fixed the tool window's stripe icon flashing/losing focus on clicks inside the plugin's own panel — session-card "..." menu, list rebuilds after Keep/Reject/Accept All, and a notification-group id that collided with the tool window's own id all contributed
    • fixed active-session pinning: pinning an older session no longer self-clears within one poll cycle, and no longer mixes in or hides a newer session's hunks — the pinned session's own edits are replayed and remapped onto the live document instead
    • Accept All / Reject All no longer freeze the IDE — baseline resolution runs off the EDT
    • dismissed files and active-session pins from before the 0.2.20/0.2.21 v2 storage changes are migrated forward instead of silently discarded
    • a dismissed file no longer stays stuck hidden if Claude changes it again via a Bash command other than `rm` (sed/mv/cp/redirects)
    • added "Accept All" / "Reject All" buttons to the top of a session's file list
  • 0.2.35: fixed the actual bug behind 0.2.34's diagnostic — the "Keep/Reject" action bar was anchoring to the line AFTER the actual change for a hunk ending exactly at a line boundary (e.g. a clean single-line insertion). The diff itself was always correct (confirmed via logging: hunk landed on the right line every time); the action bar's own EditorEmbeddedComponentManager.Properties call passed relatesToPrecedingText=false, so a boundary offset got attributed to the following line instead of the end of the hunk's own last line. Now true. Diagnostic logging from 0.2.34 removed, no longer needed
  • 0.2.34: added temporary diagnostic logging (idea.log, "computePlan:" lines) for a reported bug where the inline highlight/action bar lands a couple of lines below the actual change for a pure insertion next to a blank line — investigation ruled out the diff algorithm itself (same `ComparisonManager` call, same policy as IntelliJ's own diff viewer, verified against decompiled 2026.2 platform sources) and TranscriptReplay (pure string substitution, no offset arithmetic); remains to confirm whether the cross-session remap path (remapHunksToLiveOffsets) is where the actual offset goes wrong
  • 0.2.33: "Accept All"/"Reject All" text turns green/red on hover — text color only, not background, since plain JButton.setBackground() clashes with Darcula's own chrome (same reasoning PillButton already documents)
  • 0.2.32: file-list Keep/Reject pills now have the same checkmark/X icons as the inline editor bar's (smaller size to match); inline editor bar's pills shrunk further too — smaller icon, smaller font, tighter padding/gaps, PillButton grew fontSizeDelta/iconTextGap knobs to support it
  • 0.2.31: both Keep/Reject pill sizes shrunk further — file list down to near-zero padding, inline editor bar down to a middle size between the original and the file list's
  • 0.2.30: Keep/Reject pills in a session's file list are smaller now (less padding, same font size) than the inline editor action bar's — PillButton takes optional padding so each call site can size independently
  • 0.2.29: fixed a long session title overlapping the "● Active" badge / "..." button when the tool window is narrow — title was in BorderLayout.WEST (claims full preferred width no matter how little room is left) instead of CENTER (the region BorderLayout actually shrinks); now clips instead of overlapping, with a tooltip showing the full title
  • 0.2.28: same focus-loss family as 0.2.27, this time via the session card's "..." menu — JPopupMenu shows outside this panel's own component hierarchy, so closing it (pick an item or dismiss it) never returned focus to the tool window on its own; now reclaimed the moment the popup closes
  • 0.2.27: actually fixed the stripe-icon flash on every click, including just opening a session — cardLayout.show() swaps the session-list/file-list cards but never moves focus into whichever one becomes visible; hiding the previously-focused component (the session card, the back button) with nothing claiming focus in its place sent focus wherever AWT's traversal order landed next in the whole IDE frame, almost never still inside this tool window. Both directions now explicitly reclaim focus into the newly-shown card right after the swap
  • 0.2.26: found the actual cause of the stripe-icon flash — the notification group used for "no baseline"/"diff reconstructed" warnings shared its id ("Claude Sessions") with the tool window itself, which makes the platform flash that tool window's icon on every notify() call; those warnings fire on nearly every file-row click (any untracked or cross-session- overlapping file triggers one), so the icon flashed on almost every click. Notification group renamed to a distinct id so it no longer touches the tool window's icon at all
  • 0.2.25: fixed the real cause of the stripe-icon flicker 0.2.24 only partly addressed — every Keep/Reject/Accept All/poll-driven refresh tears down and rebuilds the whole session or file list, destroying whatever card/row/button currently held focus with nothing to re-request it afterward, so focus fell out of the tool window entirely (often back to the editor) on every single action, not just certain clicks; the list containers now check whether they held focus right before a rebuild and reclaim it afterward if so, keeping the tool window's focused look stable across actions instead of just on the initial click
  • 0.2.24: fixed the tool window's own stripe icon flickering between its focused/unfocused look while clicking around inside the plugin's own panel — file rows and session cards were plain (non-focusable) JPanels, so clicking one left focus wherever it was before instead of moving it into the tool window, while clicking a real button (Keep/Reject/"...") did; both now grab focus on click too, so focus state stays consistent regardless of what's clicked
  • 0.2.23: fixed several bugs found in review of 0.2.20-0.2.22 — (1) pinning a session no longer self-clears within one poll cycle: the pin now records the real wall-clock moment it was set instead of a possibly-stale "latest session" snapshot from the last 3s poll, and auto-clears only when a session with a genuinely later start time appears, not merely a different ID at the top of the list; (2) Accept All / Reject All no longer freeze the IDE — baseline resolution (which can shell out to `git show`) now runs off the EDT, with only the actual file mutation happening on it; (3) dismissed files and active-session pins from before the 0.2.20/0.2.21 v2 storage changes are migrated forward instead of silently discarded — previously-resolved files and pinned sessions survive the upgrade; (4) a dismissed file no longer stays stuck hidden forever if Claude changes it again via a Bash command other than `rm` (sed/mv/cp/redirects) — any Bash command whose text mentions an already-touched path now also counts as new activity on it, not just Edit/Write/NotebookEdit
  • 0.2.22: added "Accept All" / "Reject All" buttons to the top of a session's file list — resolves every still-pending file in that session at once instead of one at a time; hidden when nothing is pending
  • 0.2.21: active-session pin file moved to a new v2 path — a pre-0.2.14 bare-sessionId pin file would silently misparse under the new "sessionId|latestAtPinTime" format instead of just being ignored, same class of bug 0.2.10's dismissed-files-v2.txt rename fixed
  • 0.2.20: file rows in a session's file list restyled to match — rounded light-grey card chips instead of a flat divider-line list
  • 0.2.19: session cards have slightly rounded corners now, and less vertical gap between them
  • 0.2.18: active session card no longer shows a "..." menu at all — manual unpin is redundant now that 0.2.13/0.2.14 auto-clears the pin once a genuinely newer session appears; the remaining "..." button (non-active cards) pinned to its icon's exact dimensions since the Darcula button UI enforced its own min-size regardless of margin, leaving it visibly inset from the right edge
  • 0.2.17: "..." button moved into the same row as the title (was a separate column spanning the whole 3-line card, centering wrong relative to the title) — actually flush right and on the title's line now; secondary text (date/file-count) recolored for contrast against the new light-grey card background instead of the platform's disabled-label grey
  • 0.2.16: session cards restyled — light grey background chip instead of a bordered box, no line border
  • 0.2.15: session card's "..." button fixed — was drifting away from the right edge (JButton's default margin insets) and floating below the title (BorderLayout.EAST centers within the full card height instead of anchoring to the title's top edge)
  • 0.2.14: fixed "Set as Active" doing nothing — 0.2.13's auto-clear compared the pin against whatever's latest *right now*, which is always true the instant you pin an older session (that's the point of pinning), so it self-cleared immediately; now records which session was latest at pin time and only auto-clears once something newer than that shows up
  • 0.2.13: pinning an older session as active now only holds until a genuinely newer session appears — it auto-clears at that point instead of staying stuck forever, which is what 0.2.12's manual unpin fix still required you to remember to do every time
  • 0.2.12: fixed the active session (the one getting inline editor review) getting stuck permanently on whatever was last manually pinned via "Set as Active" — there was no way back to auto-following the latest session; the active card's "..." menu now has "Use Latest Automatically" to unpin
  • 0.2.11: inline Keep/Reject bar restyled as a rounded floating capsule (icon buttons, dark semi-opaque background) instead of a flat full-width strip — tried a gutter-icon+popup approach first, reverted in favor of this; icons hand-drawn in solid white (platform AllIcons came pre-colored and nearly vanished against same-hued pill fills), bold button text, hover uses a translucent white wash instead of Color.brighter() (which was washing out contrast against the white text/icon), and Reject's icon is a plain X (the circular "revert" arrow read as unclear at this size); also removed a leftover manual strikethrough line on the whole-line ghost fallback (pure deletions/unaligned changes) that survived the 0.2.8 redesign — the word-aligned ghost renderer never had one, this path did
  • 0.2.10: fixed rejecting one session's file wrongly making an unrelated session's already-dismissed copy of that same file reappear as "changed" — dismiss-expiry now fingerprints each session's own transcript activity for the path instead of the shared live file's bytes, which any other session's Keep/Reject can mutate without this session having done anything new
  • 0.2.9: pinning an older session no longer shows a newer session's hunks mixed in inline (or hides the file outright) — replays the pinned session's own edits and remaps them onto the live document, dropping only the specific hunks a later edit actually collides with; the `git` subprocess checks for untracked/no-VCS files are now native ChangeListManager/ ProjectLevelVcsManager lookups instead (no subprocess, no custom cache needed)
  • 0.2.8: inline word-diff colors reworked to match IntelliJ's native diff popup exactly (colors picked from the real thing): grey wash/emphasis for old/removed content, green for new/added, a gutter strip on the live line, and a caret marker for pure insertion points; word-level highlighting now falls back to whole-line when most of the line changed anyway
  • 0.2.7: single-line edits now render as an inline word-diff (changed word highlighted, old word struck through right next to it) instead of a whole-line ghost block; warns when a file's diff also includes a later session's changes, instead of silently mixing them
  • 0.2.6: plugin ID changed to com.ahmedalazaizeh.sessiondiff (was com.progressoft.sessiondiff)
  • 0.2.5: fixed IDE lag from this plugin's polling (disk/git work off the EDT, cached transcript scans, memoized git checks); dismissed sessions/files now reappear once actually touched again instead of staying hidden forever; fixed inline markers and the file list rebuilding on every poll tick even with no changes; auto-hide a file once fully reviewed
  • 0.2.4: fixed a crash in "Clear All Sessions" when a touched path was actually a directory
  • 0.2.3: fixed the tool window stripe icon losing its "+" mark when active/selected; require restart on plugin install/update/uninstall
  • 0.2.2: "Clear All Sessions" button, with confirmation before auto-accepting any unreviewed changes; custom tool window stripe icon
  • 0.2.1: support 2026.2 (262.*)
  • 0.2.0: inline Copilot-style Keep/Reject review in the editor, file-list Keep/Reject buttons, Bash-delete detection, multi-file diff tab with auto-advance on reject
  • 0.1.0: session cards with titles, per-file diff stats, native diff viewer, inline gutter markers with Rollback for the latest session

idea-plugin.name: Claude Todos
idea-plugin.description:
Live observability for your Claude Code agents: agent tree, per-task progress, tokens/context/cache and a 7-day usage dashboard — read from the transcripts Claude Code already writes. Companion of the Claude Todos VS Code extension.

Claude Code 2.1.233+ turns the task-list tools off by default on the newer models: set CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS=1 in ~/.claude/settings.json to get the task list back (see the README). The rest of the panel works without it.

实时观测你的 Claude Code 智能体：智能体树、每个任务的进度、令牌/上下文/缓存， 以及 7 天用量面板 —— 全部从 Claude Code 已经写入的对话记录中读取。 Claude Todos VS Code 扩展的配套插件。

idea-plugin.name: copy-ai-reference
idea-plugin.description:
The Copy Ai Reference plugin is an IntelliJ IDEA plugin designed to facilitate copying code references (in the format @path#LstartLine-endLine) for use with AI CLI tools or assistants. It offers the following features:

  • When a user selects a file and chooses "Copy Ai Reference" from the right-click menu, the plugin copies the file's path relative to the codebase — for example: @src/main/kotlin/com/github/runtimeexcpetion/copyaireference/startup/MyProjectActivity.kt.
  • When a user selects multiple lines of code within a file and right-clicks, a context menu appears containing the "Copy Ai Reference" option; selecting this copies the reference to the clipboard in the format @path#LstartLine-endLine — for example: @src/main/kotlin/…/MyProjectActivity.kt#L10-15.
  • Shortcut: Ctrl+Alt+U (Windows/Linux) / Cmd+Option+U (macOS)

Copy Ai Reference 是一个 IntelliJ IDEA 插件，用于将代码引用以 @路径#L行号-行尾号 的格式复制到剪贴板，方便粘贴给 AI CLI 或助手使用。提供以下功能：

  • 在项目中选中文件，右键选择 "Copy Ai Reference"，插件将复制该文件相对于代码库的路径，例如：@src/main/kotlin/…/MyProjectActivity.kt
  • 在代码编辑器中选择多行代码，右键选择 "Copy Ai Reference"，插件会将选中代码的引用复制到剪贴板，格式为 @路径#L行号-行尾号，例如：@src/main/kotlin/…/MyProjectActivity.kt#L10-15
  • 快捷键：Ctrl+Alt+U (Windows/Linux) / Cmd+Option+U (macOS)

idea-plugin.name: language-interface
idea-plugin.description:
Language Interface provides Java type search and source code retrieval capabilities for MCP clients through IntelliJ IDEA.

中文说明

简介

AI Code Agent 通常可以读取当前项目的源码，但无法直接获取外部依赖或 JDK 中的 Java 类源码。因此，AI 在生成代码时经常会出现方法参数数量或类型错误，以及虚构类属性、方法等问题。本项目通过为 Code Agent 提供获取 Java 语法树与类型信息的能力来减少此类问题。

language-interface 插件利用 IntelliJ IDEA 的 PSI 语法树和项目索引，为 MCP 客户端提供以下工具：

  • searchJavaTypes：通过名称或部分名称搜索项目、外部依赖和 JDK 中的 Java 类、接口或枚举。
  • getSourceCodeByFQN：通过全限定名获取 Java 类型源码，并支持按方法名筛选。

首次安装与设置

1. 安装插件

  1. 从 GitHub Releases 下载最新的插件 ZIP。
  2. 在 IntelliJ IDEA 中打开： Settings/Preferences → Plugins → ⚙️ → Install Plugin from Disk...。
  3. 选择下载的 ZIP，安装后重启 IDEA。

插件支持 IntelliJ IDEA 2022.3.3 及更高版本。

2. 配置 MCP 客户端

将以下内容添加到 Codex、Claude Code、Cursor、Claude Desktop、Windsurf、Cherry Studio 等客户端的 MCP 配置中。

仅从 IDEA 获取 Java 类信息：

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "java-ides": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": [
        "-y",
        "mcp-server-for-language",
        "--ides",
        "idea"
      ]
    }
  }
}

同时使用 IDEA 和 VSCode 系 IDE：

如果平时会单独使用 IDEA 或 VSCode 系 IDE，并希望在 IDEA 不可用或未打开目标项目时尝试使用 VSCode，请先在 VSCode 系 IDE 中安装同系列插件 MCP Server For Java，然后使用以下配置：

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "java-ides": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": [
        "-y",
        "mcp-server-for-language",
        "--ides",
        "idea",
        "vscode"
      ]
    }
  }
}

该配置会优先使用 IDEA；当 IDEA 不可用或未打开目标项目时，再尝试使用 VSCode。

3. 打开 Java 项目

  1. 使用 IDEA 打开需要查询的 Java 项目。
  2. 等待 IDEA 完成项目加载和索引。
  3. 重启或刷新 MCP 客户端，确认已加载以下工具：
    • searchJavaTypes
    • getSourceCodeByFQN

调用工具时，workspacePath 必须与 IDEA 中已打开项目的根目录一致。

提高工具调用率（推荐）

可以在 AI Agent 的用户规则或系统提示词中添加：

当无法从项目源码中找到 Java 类、类定义或方法实现时，使用 searchJavaTypes 和 getSourceCodeByFQN 搜索依赖库或 JDK 中的类型及源码。

常见问题

  • 提示无法连接 IDEA：确认 IDEA 正在运行、插件已启用，并已打开 Java 项目。
  • 提示 IDEA 正在索引：等待索引完成后重试。
  • 提示找不到工作区：确认 MCP 客户端打开的目录与 IDEA 项目根目录一致。
  • 自定义 IDEA 地址：默认连接 http://127.0.0.1:63342，可在 MCP 参数中添加 --idea-base-url http://主机:端口。

工作原理

本插件运行在 IDEA 内，通过 IDEA 的 PSI 和项目索引提供 Java 搜索能力；配套的 mcp-server-for-language 负责接收 MCP 请求并转发给插件。

MCP 客户端 → mcp-server-for-language → IDEA 插件 → Java 项目索引

English

Overview

AI Code Agents can usually read source code in the current project, but they cannot directly retrieve Java source code from external dependencies or the JDK. As a result, AI-generated code may use the wrong number or type of method arguments or invent class fields and methods. This project helps reduce these issues by giving Code Agents access to Java syntax-tree and type information.

The language-interface plugin uses IntelliJ IDEA's PSI syntax tree and project indexes to provide MCP clients with the following tools:

  • searchJavaTypes: Searches for Java classes, interfaces, and enums by name or partial name across the project, external dependencies, and the JDK.
  • getSourceCodeByFQN: Retrieves Java source code by fully qualified name, with optional method filtering.

Installation and Setup

1. Install the Plugin

  1. Download the latest plugin ZIP from GitHub Releases.
  2. In IntelliJ IDEA, open: Settings/Preferences → Plugins → ⚙️ → Install Plugin from Disk....
  3. Select the downloaded ZIP, install the plugin, and restart IDEA.

IntelliJ IDEA 2022.3.3 or later is required.

2. Configure the MCP Client

Add the following configuration to Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Claude Desktop, Windsurf, Cherry Studio, or another MCP client.

Use IDEA only:

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "java-ides": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": [
        "-y",
        "mcp-server-for-language",
        "--ides",
        "idea"
      ]
    }
  }
}

Use both IDEA and VSCode-based IDEs:

If you use IDEA and VSCode-based IDEs separately and want to try VSCode when IDEA is unavailable or has not opened the target project, first install the companion MCP Server For Java extension in the VSCode-based IDE, then use the following configuration:

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "java-ides": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": [
        "-y",
        "mcp-server-for-language",
        "--ides",
        "idea",
        "vscode"
      ]
    }
  }
}

This configuration uses IDEA first. It tries VSCode only when IDEA is unavailable or has not opened the target project.

3. Open a Java Project

  1. Open the Java project in IDEA.
  2. Wait for IDEA to finish loading and indexing the project.
  3. Restart or refresh the MCP client and confirm that the following tools are available:
    • searchJavaTypes
    • getSourceCodeByFQN

The workspacePath passed to a tool must match the root directory of a project open in IDEA.

Improve Tool Invocation Rate (Recommended)

Add the following instruction to your AI Agent's user rules or system prompt:

When a Java class, class definition, or method implementation cannot be found in the project source, use searchJavaTypes and getSourceCodeByFQN to search dependencies or the JDK.

Troubleshooting

  • Cannot connect to IDEA: Make sure IDEA is running, the plugin is enabled, and a Java project is open.
  • IDEA is indexing: Wait for indexing to finish and try again.
  • Workspace not found: Make sure the directory open in the MCP client matches the IDEA project root.
  • Custom IDEA address: The default address is http://127.0.0.1:63342. Add --idea-base-url http://host:port to the MCP arguments to override it.

How It Works

The plugin runs inside IDEA and uses PSI and project indexes to provide Java search capabilities. The companion mcp-server-for-language receives MCP requests and forwards them to the plugin.

MCP client → mcp-server-for-language → IDEA plugin → Java project indexes
