idea-plugin.name: Pinboard
idea-plugin.description:
Pin feedback onto several pieces of code, then tell your agent to work through the lot. Adds an asynchronous feedback queue on top of the MCP server your JetBrains IDE already ships.

The built-in MCP server hands an agent your current selection: synchronous, one-shot. Reviewing code is not like that. You read a file, spot five things, and want to note all five, keep reading, and hand the batch over when you are done.

  • A queue - pin as many notes as you like, nothing is sent yet.
  • Batching - the agent picks up a cluster in one call instead of a round trip each.
  • Threads - the agent replies, asks questions, and records what it did.
  • Survives a restart - the queue and its history are still there tomorrow.
  • Stale detection - if the code moved after you pinned it, the agent is told, and is given the original snapshot and enclosing symbol to relocate from.
No MCP configuration to write by hand. No network calls, no telemetry.

Documentation and source · Free, and always will be. If it saves you time, you can buy me a coffee.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Added

  • Copy All Pending puts the whole pending queue on the clipboard as one Markdown document, each pin its own section under a horizontal rule. For handing a batch to an agent that has no MCP access to the queue, which until now meant copying pins one at a time. Pending only: acknowledged means an agent already has it. Disabled when nothing is pending, and deliberately without a shortcut - it copies every note and every captured snippet at once.

Changed

  • The thread an agent receives per item is capped at the 10 newest messages, each message body at 1MB, and the item carries threadOmitted saying how many were dropped. The code snapshot was already capped for the same reason; the thread was not, so an agent that replied repeatedly grew its own context with nothing bounding it. This bounds what the agent wrote, not your note, which is still sent whole however long it is. Nothing is hidden from you either - the panel still shows the entire thread.
  • Copy is now one entry with a submenu, the way Clear already was: hover it for Copy and Copy All Pending. Two Copy entries side by side could only be told apart by their labels, and the toolbar shows icons alone.

idea-plugin.name: Pet Whale
idea-plugin.description:
Idea Pet Whale — Whale Girl Desktop Pet

在 JetBrains IDEA 2023+ 中陪伴你写代码的鲸鱼娘。空闲时游动、编译时奔跑、测试全绿时跳跃庆祝、失败时沮丧。

idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.0.18（胶囊数值/帮助图标修复 + 跑步出发间隔可控）

  • 胶囊进度条数值显示修复：为数值标签与标签列增加最小尺寸约束，确保亲密度 / 小鱼干 / 点数始终显示在进度条右侧。
  • 帮助图标背景与胶囊统一：「?」不再单独填充背景色，改为透明底 + 描边，视觉上与胶囊底板融为一体。
  • 新增「出发间隔」设置：行为卡片增加「出发间隔」滑块（1~30 秒，默认 5 秒），控制两次自动溜达之间的休息时长；支持实时预览、Apply 持久化、恢复默认。
  • 优化跑步速度调整：溜达速度滑块保持 1~8，设置页内拖动实时透传给桌宠；对应实际移动步长保持 1~8 px/40ms，手感连续可调。

0.0.17（设置页精简：统一配色 + 去除冗余说明）

  • 「精致版」配色与「原版」保持一致：设置页卡片、强调色、恢复默认链接统一使用海洋蓝配色，切换宠物皮肤时不再跳变为珊瑚橙，视觉上更统一。
  • 去除冗余文字说明：各设置项仅保留标题，去掉下方的描述小字，显著减小设置页宽度与视觉噪音。

0.0.16（新增鲸鱼娘女仆装插件图标 + 版本递增）

  • 新增插件图标：基于领主大人提供的参考图一比一重绘鲸鱼娘女仆装头像（深蓝渐变长发、白色蕾丝女仆头饰、两侧鲸鱼鳍耳、蓝色蝴蝶结、黑白女仆衣领、开心张嘴笑），背景改为深蓝渐变，不再使用珊瑚橙配色；放置于 META-INF/pluginIcon.svg，在 IDE 设置列表与 JetBrains Marketplace 中展示。
  • 版本号递增 0.0.15 → 0.0.16。

0.0.15（溜达速度可调 + 行走手感与流畅度调优）

  • 溜达速度可调：设置页新增「行为 → 溜达速度」滑块（1~8，默认 3），支持实时预览、Apply 持久化、一键恢复默认。
  • 行走更流畅：左右跑帧时长均速化（尾帧 400ms → 300ms）；撞墙/转向改用镜像切换并保留当前帧进度，转身不再跳帧。

0.0.14（5 项交互改进：去召唤按钮 / 关宠物不弹气泡 / 左右跑动 / 自动溜达 / 一键回原位）

  • 去掉隐藏宠物后的「召唤鲸鱼娘」按钮；关闭/隐藏宠物后通过 isPetVisible() 门禁停止所有气泡、悬浮层与自动行为。
  • THINKING 阶段改用 RUNNING_LEFT（向左跑），running 改为左右跑动动画。
  • 新增自动溜达状态机：空闲时随机左右跑动、撞屏幕边界反弹、交互时自动停下。
  • 设置页「回到原位」与宠物卡片「归位」按钮，一键回右下角老家并停溜达。

0.0.13（按钮长度减半 + 修复鼠标停在按钮上悬浮层消失）

  • 按钮长度缩短约 50%：按钮卡片布局从 BoxLayout 换回 FlowLayout——此前 BoxLayout 会把按钮拉伸均分卡片宽度，现按文字实际大小排列。
  • 修复鼠标停在按钮/数值上悬浮层消失：Swing 中鼠标从面板移到子组件（按钮、标签、进度条）上也会触发面板的 mouseExited，被误判为"离开悬浮层"；现给悬浮层内所有子组件递归挂上同一悬停守卫，窗口内部任意移动都保持显示，完全移出才消失。

0.0.12（修复卡片遮挡宠物脚部 + 按钮贴合文字 + 层间穿越宽容）

  • 修复宠物被纵向拉伸：绘制时高度参数误传为「基准Y+精灵高」，宠物实际被拉长约 28px、脚部超出预期底边，导致下方卡片压住裙摆；现按精灵高度绘制，宠物比例恢复，卡片精确贴在脚底下方、不再遮挡。
  • 卡片与宠物间距加大：悬浮层与宠物边缘间隙 4px → 6px。
  • 按钮贴合文字：按钮字号 11 → 10、内边距收紧（2×7），按钮大小与文字匹配、更紧凑。
  • 层间穿越宽容：隐藏延迟 200ms → 320ms，鼠标在「脚部区域 ↔ 卡片」之间的小间隙移动不再闪断（仍在 1 秒内消失）。

0.0.11（悬浮框分区触发：头部出胶囊 / 脚部出卡片）

  • 显示逻辑分区触发：鼠标停留在宠物头部区域（顶边下方 25% 高度以上）才显示头顶数值胶囊；停留在脚部区域（底边上方 25% 高度以下）才显示脚底按钮卡片；中部区域与跳跃缓冲区不触发；两层都不压宠物本体。
  • 名字和称号移到胶囊：胶囊第一行为 名字（亮青蓝）+ Lv（绿）+ 右侧亲密度称号（粉紫）。
  • 数值全部进度条化：胶囊内 亲密度 / 小鱼干 / 点数 三条彩色渐变进度条（粉紫 / 青蓝 / 橙）+ 彩色数值；小鱼干按 99 封顶、点数按 500 封顶折算进度。
  • 卡片紧凑化：卡片只保留按钮行（喂食 / 改名 / 设置 / 隐藏），按钮大小随文字自适应、内边距收紧，布局更紧凑。

0.0.10（悬浮框深色档案卡片 + 彩色进度条胶囊 + 气泡移到宠物侧面）

  • 配色参考新设计图：下方改为深色档案卡片——第一行名字（亮青蓝）+ 右侧「亲密度 称号」（粉紫），第二行深蓝底白字圆角按钮（喂食 / 改名 / 设置 / 隐藏）；悬浮层贴宠物上下边缘，不遮挡本体。
  • 数值胶囊改彩色进度条样式：亲密度进度条（粉紫渐变自绘组件，进度按当前称号区间折算）+ 彩色数字行（小鱼干蓝色 / 点数橙色 / 等级绿色）。
  • 显示纪律：鼠标在宠物 ↔ 胶囊 ↔ 卡片任一区域内保持显示，完全离开后才 200ms 内消失。
  • 台词气泡移到宠物侧面：显示在宠物左侧或右侧（右侧优先、放不下换左侧），垂直与宠物头部平行（顶边下方 20% 高度居中），与胶囊和卡片互不遮挡。

0.0.9（悬浮框消失拖尾修复 + 字体清晰化 + 气泡/悬浮层互不遮挡）

  • 修复悬浮框不消失：直接离开宠物（未经过胶囊/按钮条）时锁定标记未复位，导致隐藏调度永不执行；现在配合独立的「鼠标在悬浮层内」标记，任何方向离开都在 200ms 内消失。
  • UI 字体清晰化：数值胶囊与按钮字号加大（11→12 加粗）、文字颜色加深、悬停高亮更明显、内边距加宽。
  • 气泡与悬浮层互不遮挡：悬停数值胶囊可见时，台词气泡自动显示在胶囊上方；胶囊出现/消失时已显示的气泡平滑上移/回落，双向不重叠。

0.0.8（悬浮框拆分：数值胶囊 + 按钮条 + 设置页跟随 IDE 主题 + 切主题即时换肤）

  • 悬浮框拆分：参考双条式设计，拆成两个独立悬浮层——宠物上方为亮色数值胶囊（亲密 · 小鱼干 · 点数 · Lv 等级，鼠标悬停宠物即浮现），宠物下方为快捷按钮条（喂食 / 改名 / 设置 / 隐藏）。鼠标在宠物 ↔ 胶囊 ↔ 按钮条之间移动保持显示，全部离开才延迟隐藏。
  • 新增等级显示：亲密度每 200 点升 1 级（Lv.1 起算），在数值胶囊显示。
  • 新增「设置」快捷按钮：按钮条一键打开设置页。
  • 设置页跟随 IDEA 主题：卡片底色 / 边框 / 强调色 / 链接全部改为 JBColor 双值，IDE 亮色、暗色主题下自动适配；描述文字用主题自适应次级前景色，暗色主题下清晰可读。
  • 切换主题立即换肤：主题下拉改用 ItemListener 直通刷新（选中项一变就换装重绘，不再依赖广播链，无需重启 IDE）；宠物窗口重建时不再把已预览的主题顶回旧值。

0.0.7（设置页配色跟随主题 + 大小/主题预览修复 + 主题改名 + 悬浮框瘦身）

  • 修复大小实时预览：拖动大小滑块现在立即改变宠物精灵的绘制尺寸（此前只改窗口大小、精灵纹丝不动）；Apply 后以持久化值为准，Cancel / 关闭设置页自动回滚。
  • 主题预览加固：切换主题改为自愈式校验（任何状态快照都核对渲染主题与运行时主题），不再依赖特定广播原因，切换即换肤。
  • 主题改名：主题下拉显示为「原版」「精致版」（持久化 key 不变，旧配置无缝兼容）。
  • 设置页配色跟随主题：选「原版」时设置页为海洋蓝配色，选「精致版」时切换为珊瑚橙配色（卡片底色、强调色、链接同步刷新）。
  • 悬浮框缩小 50%：悬停面板整体减半（宽度、内边距、字号、按钮），更轻巧不遮挡。

0.0.6（设置页重构 + 悬浮框跟随 + 实时预览 + 交互丰富）

  • 设置页卡片式重构：参考新版设置风格，将设置项分组为「宠物 / 显示 / 关怀」圆角浅色卡片，每项带标题、描述与「恢复默认」链接；移除「启动 IDE 时只显示'召唤鲸鱼娘'按钮」复选框，统一用「显示宠物」开关控制可见性。
  • 实时预览 + 确认生效：大小、不透明度、主题、显示/隐藏、状态装饰的调整会即时反映到桌宠窗口；只有点击 Apply / OK 才持久化，Cancel / 关闭时回滚预览。
  • 悬浮框实时跟随：拖拽或缩放宠物时，悬停面板会同步更新位置，不再滞留在旧位置。
  • 状态装饰开关：新增「状态装饰」选项，关闭后事件气泡（完成/失败/空闲等）不再弹出，用户触发与关怀气泡不受影响。
  • 更多表情动作与交互：拖拽结束触发挥手动画 + 拖拽台词；快速双击触发开心反馈；空闲 30 秒以上会随机冒泡（深夜自动切换为 sleepy 台词）；扩展 dialogue/whale.json 新增 bored / drag / happy / sleepy 四组台词。

0.0.5（悬停交互面板 + 跳跃动画修复 + 宠物档案）

  • 悬停交互面板：鼠标滑过鲸鱼娘时，下方浮现圆角深色卡片，显示名字、亲密度等级、小鱼干、点数；支持"喂食 / 改名 / 隐藏"三个快捷按钮。面板与宠物本体通过进入/离开延迟计时器实现平滑过渡。
  • 宠物档案：新增 persisted 宠物档案（名字、亲密度、小鱼干、点数）。喂食消耗小鱼干并增加亲密度/点数；亲密度达到不同阶段显示对应称号（素昧平生 → 灵魂伴侣）。
  • 跳跃动画真正跳起来：窗口上下扩展跳跃缓冲，绘制 JUMPING 时按帧叠加 anticipation → 跃起 → 落地的垂直偏移，避免被窗口顶部裁切。
  • 点击宠物时自动收起悬停面板，避免面板遮挡点击反馈。

0.0.4（P1 收尾 + 久坐关怀 + 交互瘦身）

  • 移除右键悬浮面板：右键不再弹出"鲸鱼娘"面板（含其设置入口）；隐藏/显示统一走设置页（Settings → Tools → Pet Whale 鲸鱼娘）的按钮。
  • 修复切换主题不生效：面板现在订阅 theme-switch 广播即时刷新精灵图与帧时长，不再依赖动画切换才生效。
  • 久坐关怀：连续编码 60 分钟冒气泡提醒喝水/起身（全局打字监听计时；离开 5 分钟以上自动重新累计；设置页可关闭）。
  • 事件台词：动画切入 JUMPING/FAILED 时冒 done/failed 台词气泡（点击触发的 1.5 秒内让路，避免双气泡）。
  • 台词库扩展：feed / done / failed / care 四组（feed 组为后续投喂入口预留）。

0.0.3（P1 交互第一期 + 设置优化）

  • 设置页迁移：Settings → Tools（工具） → Pet Whale 鲸鱼娘。
  • 桌宠窗口改用 JWindow：不再出现在任务栏和 Alt-Tab 窗口列表。
  • 设置页新增「隐藏鲸鱼娘 / 显示鲸鱼娘」按钮，点一下立即生效。
  • 点击交互：单击鲸鱼娘跳跃庆祝 + 随机台词气泡；1 秒内连点 4 次触发撒娇动画。
  • 新增台词气泡（圆角、2.5 秒自动消失、永远不遮挡本体）与台词库 dialogue/whale.json（启动问候/单击/连点三组）。

0.0.2（P0 地基加固）

  • 新增设置页（Settings → Appearance & Behavior → Pet Whale 鲸鱼娘）：大小缩放（50%~200%）、窗口不透明度（30%~100%）、默认主题、启动时收起，Apply 即时生效。
  • 设置持久化（PetSettingsState，pet.whale.settings.xml）：窗口大小/位置/透明度/主题/隐藏状态跨重启还原；保存的位置被拔掉的显示器甩出屏幕时自动回落右下角。
  • 渲染稳定性：每帧 AlphaComposite.Clear 整面清屏，消除透明窗体上的精灵图残影（重影）。
  • 主题缓存改为有界 LRU（上限 4），为后续自定义主题铺路。
  • 拖拽偏移修正：按按下点计算偏移（原先硬编码 12px），松手即持久化位置。

0.0.1

  • 项目重命名：dsh-pet-whale → idea-pet-whale。版本号从 1.0.1 回退到 0.0.1 起算，后续每次升级 +0.0.1。
  • 代码与资源全部继承自 dsh-pet-whale v1.0.1（含 v1.0.1 hotfix：PetResources 解析 v2 manifest 相对路径，23 测试全过）。

迁移前历史（dsh-pet-whale）

  • 1.0.1 修复启动期 IllegalStateException missing spritesheet；新增 resolveSpritesheetPath + classpath 资源烟雾测试。
  • 1.0.0 首个发布版：透明悬浮桌宠、9 状态动画、与编辑器/构建/VCS/测试事件联动、主题（原版/精致版）切换、拖拽定位、隐藏按钮。

idea-plugin.name: Yreview
idea-plugin.description:
Yreview writes a code review comment on any line of the editor and on any line of a diff. The plugin stores each comment as a git note in the git-appraise format. A comment therefore travels with the repository, and it needs no server and no account.

  • Write a comment on one line or on a range of lines. The editor, the diff view, and the Markdown preview all accept the action.
  • Keep a comment on your machine, or push it to your own git remote so that the team reads it.
  • Write a comment on a file that no git repository covers. The plugin keeps the record in a folder. It moves the record into the git notes as soon as a repository covers the file.
  • Read every open comment and every TODO item of the project in one tool window. The window holds four tabs and a preview pane.
  • Send the open tasks to a command line agent that runs in a tool window beside the editor.
  • Copy the same tasks to the clipboard for any other agent. The plugin also writes the tasks into the git directory as files.
  • The plugin resolves a comment when the agent reports that the task is done.

Source code and issue tracker: https://github.com/yeskiy/yreview
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Changed

  • Drop the privacy paragraph from the plugin description

idea-plugin.name: Mondoo
idea-plugin.description:
Find and fix security issues while you write code. Vulnerabilities and leaked secrets appear in the editor as you type, with one-click fixes.

Scanning runs on your machine: no account is needed and your code is not uploaded. Write and lint Mondoo policies in MQL, run them against your infrastructure, and generate software, cryptography and AI bills of materials.

Connecting to Mondoo Platform is optional, and only used if you publish a policy to a space.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Fixed

  • Vulnerabilities on the Dependencies tab open in Mondoo Vulnerability Intelligence instead of osv.dev.

idea-plugin.name: Agenstorm
idea-plugin.description:
Agenstorm removes the friction an agent-heavy workflow hits in the IDE every day.

Coding agents changed what a working day looks like, and the IDE was not built for that rhythm. Agenstorm closes the gaps, one small feature at a time. Every feature has its own on/off switch.

Markdown live markup

Obsidian-style editing: **bold**, headings, links, - [ ] task boxes and bullets show their result until the caret reaches them. Fenced code blocks and block quotes sit on a card. Tables render in place — a proportional font, wrapped cells, a bold header — and a click edits one cell without leaving the rendered view. It is folding only: the file on disk never changes, and copying always copies raw Markdown. An optional switch also hides the editor/preview layout buttons. Soft-wrapped Markdown and text stop at the right margin's line, however wide the window. The headings sit in the top-right corner as a contents card that stays put while you scroll, and a click jumps to one.

Clickable file locations

src/Foo.php:42:7 becomes a link in Markdown, in comments of every language, and in PHP strings. It is the format compilers, test runners and agents already emit, so nothing has to change on the other side. Copy Location Link puts such a token on the clipboard, ready to paste back to an agent.

open in the IDE terminal

open src/Foo.php:42 opens that file in the window the terminal belongs to, caret on line 42, instead of handing it to the OS. Anything the IDE does not claim (flags, URLs, missing paths, binaries) reaches the real open untouched.

The IDE as your terminal's editor

Press Ctrl+G in Claude Code and the prompt opens in this project's window instead of vim. Close the tab and the edited text goes back to it. git commit and everything else that reaches for $EDITOR behaves the same way.

AI commit messages

A subject and body streamed into the commit message field from the Anthropic API, any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (OpenAI, Ollama, LM Studio, OpenRouter, Groq), or the local claude CLI, which needs no API key. No SDK and no bundled jars: just the platform's own HTTP client.

Project tabs, the way a browser does them

Open projects become tabs inside the main toolbar, in the slot the project widget normally occupies, so the window loses a row of chrome. The tabs take all the room the toolbar can spare and shrink before they turn into icons. A project you have not touched for two hours is offloaded: closed with everything saved, its tab kept as a dotted bookmark that loads it again on click. The Git branch moves down to the status bar, and window titles name the project rather than whichever file is open.

Worktrees, one tab each

The worktrees of the repository, yours and the ones Claude Code, Cursor or Conductor make for their agents, become tabs above the Project tree. A click swaps the window to that worktree in place; one with a command still running in its terminal stays open behind, so no agent is cut off. Each tab says whether its worktree has uncommitted changes, commits ahead or behind, or an agent at work, and its menu merges it back, archives it or removes it, never losing work without asking. "+" makes a new one that is ready to work in: project settings, .env and vendor/ carried over, the repository's setup started in a terminal. Worktrees nested in the repository stay out of the project that holds them. With tmux and one setting, terminals running an agent or a dev server follow the switch to the next worktree, and can be kept running when a window closes or the IDE quits.

One list of your agents

An Agents sidebar lists the Claude Code sessions of every open project: the running ones, with what Claude says each is doing, and the recent ones to pick up again. It looks the same in every window, so switching projects changes everything but it. A click brings up the terminal tab a session runs in, in its own project's window, or resumes a past one in a new tab. Off by default.

A terminal that fills the window

One key fills the editor's area with the terminal, and the same key gives the editor back. Other tool windows keep their place.

Terminal output that folds

In the Reworked terminal, a var_dump, print_r, var_export, JSON line or PHP stack trace collapses to one line; click the ▸ to open it in place, coloured like code. Rules are JSON files you can add to.

Notification popups that hide themselves

Balloons fade after a few seconds instead of the IDE's 10 seconds, or 5 minutes for sticky ones. The countdown pauses while the IDE is in the background, and everything stays in the Notifications tool window; only the popup goes.

Less chrome, on request

A switch that is off until you ask for it: clear the right tool window bar so the editor reaches the window edge. And the status bar's status text, the last message at the bottom left, is hidden unless you want it back.

Names typed in the project tree

New File, New Directory, Rename and Duplicate open an editable row in the tree instead of a dialog. Type, press Enter, done. src/Http/Client.php creates the folders on the way.

A shorter New Scratch File popup

Only the languages on your allow-list, in your order, with "All Languages…" at the bottom.

Works anywhere

Features that need the PHP, Markdown, Git or Terminal plugin switch themselves off when it is missing, so the plugin is at home in any IntelliJ-based IDE of the same version.

Free and open source, MIT: https://github.com/pronskiy/agenstorm
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Added

  • Agents sidebar: one list of the Claude Code sessions in every open project — the running ones with Claude's own status (working, waiting for you, idle, and a dot for one that finished while you were in another project) and each project's recent ones. It looks the same in every window: open, width, side, selection and scroll follow you across project switches and restarts. A click brings up the Terminal tab a session runs in, in its own project's window, brings a background terminal back as a tab, or resumes a past session in a new tab with claude --resume. Off by default under Settings | Tools | Agenstorm | Agents.

Fixed

  • tmux-backed terminals: a terminal handed to another worktree's window, or a background terminal opened again, no longer stays at the size its tab had at that moment — it follows the tab, instead of leaving rows of dots below or beside the output once the tab grows.

idea-plugin.name: Copy Path for AI
idea-plugin.description:
Copy Path for AI injects a paste-ready reference like @main.ts (caret) or @main.ts#L42-L50 (selection) into the selected IDE Terminal tab (and also copies it to the clipboard).

Works with Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Grok Build, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, and other terminal AI agents that accept @path file references.

Github · JetBrains Marketplace

Features

  • One shortcut: ⌘3 (Windows/Linux: Ctrl+3) — claimed from the IDE default (Find tool window) on install unless you already remapped that key
  • Editor context menu: Copy Path for AI
  • Caret → @path; selection → @path#Lline / @path#Lstart-Lend (trailing space included)
  • Path is relative to the project root (absolute if outside the project)
  • Auto-inject into the currently selected IDE Terminal tab
  • Clipboard fallback if no Terminal is selected or inject fails
  • Balloon confirms inject / copy

Requirements for auto-inject

Uses the IDE Terminal tool window. Keep the tab with your AI agent selected. External apps (iTerm, Terminal.app) are not targeted — use clipboard paste there.
idea-plugin.change-notes:

idea-plugin.name: Codex Tabs
idea-plugin.description:
Keep independent Codex and Claude Code conversations in native editor tabs. Split chats beside your code and see which tasks need your attention.

  • Stream replies, commands, file changes, and generated images.
  • Create shared Git worktrees with native diffs and terminals.
  • Use slash commands, skills, context inspection, and immediate turn steering.
  • Edit earlier messages, preview attachments, and restore chats and drafts.
  • Work with local projects or Windows projects backed by WSL.

Requires IntelliJ IDEA 2026.1 or newer with JCEF and a current Codex CLI or Claude Code CLI. Each provider uses its own CLI sign-in. The plugin has no separate cloud service and does not ask for an API key.

Setup and usage · Report an issue

This is an independent, MIT-licensed project. It is not affiliated with OpenAI, Anthropic, or JetBrains.

idea-plugin.name: DeepSeek Harness Web
idea-plugin.description:
DeepSeek Harness Web brings your local DeepSeek Harness chat into a PhpStorm tool window. Drag files or folders from the IDE into the chat input, or select code in the editor and confirm on the hover bar - both instantly become rich references in the message and are sent with full paths.

DeepSeek Harness Web

在 PhpStorm 工具窗中嵌入本机 DeepSeek Harness 网页端（127.0.0.1:3080）， 对话界面与交互完全沿用网页端（消息/模型/设置/审批），并补充 IDE 集成： 拖入文件/代码到输入框、当前项目文件夹工作区、Harness 服务自动启动与开关。

功能

  • 拖动文件、选中代码，一键进入对话：从 IDE 拖动任意文件/文件夹到输入框， 或选中代码后点选选区上方的「添加到对话」浮条——两者都立即生成带文件图标的 彩色引用 chip（文件名:行号），消息发送时自动携带完整路径，AI 所见即磁盘真实路径
  • 嵌入式网页对话界面：与 http://127.0.0.1:3080/ 完全一致（对话窗工作区固定为当前文件夹、不再弹切换菜单；添加工作区入口隐藏；收起侧边栏时 rail 额外精简搜索图标——新建会话与设置等保留，专注对话；展开侧边栏时搜索等功能完整）
  • 文件/代码引用显示为网页原生彩色 chip（同 Qoder/QoderCN 风格，带文件图标与 文件名:行号），chip 之间可直接输入描述文字、随光标删除/回车换行，多个引用 可并存于一段消息中；鼠标悬浮 chip 出现 ×，点击一键移除该引用（编辑器对应 选区同步清空）
  • 选中代码 hover 确认：编辑器选中代码并稳定片刻后，选区上方弹出「添加到对话」 浮条（同 Qoder/QoderCN 交互），点击才把引用写入输入框——仅浏览/复制不再误 添加；发送时页面把 chip 序列化为完整路径:行号，AI 收到的始终是全路径，消息 发出后编辑器选区自动清除
  • 降级兼容：若页面结构异常无法挂载 chip，自动退回文本引用通道（光标处 [[文件名:行号]] 标记 + 发送原位展开），任何页面版本下选中/拖入/发送均可靠
  • 多窗口隔离：每个工具窗独立会话，选中代码/拖入文件/工作区只作用于所在窗口，互不串扰
  • 工作区：自动注册当前项目文件夹并置顶，列表只显示当前文件夹（UI 层过滤）
  • Harness 服务：未运行时自动启动，顶栏按钮显示状态并可手动关闭；设置项可清空保存 （三项全空 = 未配置），未配置时工具窗内显示下载安装引导与教程，不再自动探测/启动

idea-plugin.name: Flexible For Schematics
idea-plugin.description:
Schematic and PCB viewer and editor for KiCad, EasyEDA, Eagle and Gerber files. Visual canvas, 3D board viewer, component database with live stock and pricing, sticky notes, electrical rule checks, manufacturer export and an AI assistant.

We are a new IDE extension and want to make it the best schematics companion for JetBrains IDEs. Your feedback is critical: Please leave a review, reach out to us on github, the community or email and tell us your thoughts, issues and more.

Documentation: See the user guide or the plugin page on the JetBrains Marketplace.

Core Features

Schematic and Board Editor

  • Multi-format support for KiCad (.kicad_sch, .kicad_pcb, .kicad_sym, .kicad_mod), EasyEDA JSON, Eagle XML (.sch, .brd, .lbr), Gerber and Excellon drill files
  • Visual canvas as the first editor tab, with the text editor always one click away
  • Zoom, pan and grid snap with the scroll wheel, the middle mouse button and Space+drag
  • Canvas tools for select, wire, label, note and measure
  • Component placement where the part follows the cursor, R turns it and Esc cancels
  • Rotate and mirror the selection with R and X, delete with Delete, fit with F
  • Undo and redo for every canvas edit
  • Write-back of every change to the source file

Board and 3D Viewer

  • Layer manager with per-layer visibility and a bottom view
  • Pad shapes, drill holes and copper pours drawn the way the fabricator sees them
  • Software 3D board view with no GPU and no browser
  • Orbit, zoom and view presets for top and isometric
  • Component heights from the footprint or from package heuristics (0402, 0603, SOT-23, QFN, headers, connectors)
  • PNG snapshot of the 3D scene for a report or a datasheet

Gerber and Excellon Viewer

  • Stacked layer view that finds every layer of the folder and draws the real board
  • Per layer colour, opacity and solo from the layer panel
  • Aperture shapes, regions, arcs and polarity as the format defines them
  • Drill holes from the Excellon file, aligned with the copper

Language Intelligence

  • Syntax highlighting for KiCad S-expression files and for Gerber and Excellon files
  • Code completion for keywords and net labels
  • Structure view with the design hierarchy and folding
  • Quick documentation on hover for symbols and properties
  • Brace matching and formatting
  • References and rename for net labels and components
  • Live annotations for duplicate references, unknown library symbols and undefined apertures
  • Live templates for common KiCad blocks

Component Database

  • Offline index of common electronic parts
  • Live part sources including JLCPCB and LCSC stock and prices, EasyEDA symbols and footprints, the KiCad symbol library, and Nexar with an API token
  • Part details with manufacturer, package, stock level, price tiers and a datasheet link
  • One-click insertion of a part with its symbol and footprint
  • Disk cache with a configurable lifetime for offline work

Notes and Annotations

  • Sticky notes on a schematic or a board, with text, colour, author and date
  • Component anchoring that keeps a decision next to the part it belongs to
  • Resolve flag to mark a note as done
  • Sidecar storage in <file>.notes.json, so the manufacturer files stay clean
  • Bake action to write the notes into the KiCad, Eagle or EasyEDA file
  • Notes list in the Schematics tool window with jump-to

Manufacturer Export

  • Gerber and Excellon drill files per layer
  • Bill of materials as CSV in the JLCPCB and PCBWay column layouts
  • Pick-and-place files in the JLCPCB and PCBWay CSV formats
  • Manufacturer profiles for JLCPCB, PCBWay, Eurocircuits, OSH Park and Aisler
  • One-click package that writes a manufacturer-ready zip
  • Netlist export in the KiCad format
  • Format conversion between KiCad, EasyEDA and Eagle

Rule Checks

  • Electrical rule checks for unconnected pins, duplicate references, missing footprints and missing part numbers
  • Power source check that catches a floating power pin
  • Problems list in the Schematics tool window with jump-to
  • IDE inspection so the findings appear where you expect them

AI Assistant

  • Chat tab in the Schematics tool window with the full design context
  • Automatic context from the components, the nets, the selection, the notes and the rule check
  • Slash commands /explain, /bom, /erc, /note, /parts, /clear and /help
  • Multiple backends including Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, Windsurf, Aider, Ollama, OpenAI and Anthropic
  • MCP server that exposes the design to an external agent
  • Docs tab with the user guide inside the IDE

Getting Started

Quick Start

  1. Install the plugin from JetBrains Marketplace
  2. Open a project folder that holds your design files
  3. Open a .kicad_sch or a .kicad_pcb file and stay on the first editor tab
  4. Open the Schematics tool window on the right for notes, problems, parts and chat
  5. Run Tools > Schematics > Export Manufacturer Package when the board is ready

Productivity Tips

  • Scroll to zoom, middle mouse or Space+drag to pan, F to fit the sheet
  • W, L, N and M switch to the wire, label, note and measure tool, Esc returns to select
  • I opens the component search, then one click drops the part on the sheet
  • R turns the selection or the part under the cursor, X mirrors it
  • Ctrl+Z undoes the last canvas edit
  • Alt+Enter on a finding in the Problems list opens the quick fix

Customization

  • Settings File > Settings > Tools > Flexible Schematics
  • Text size set the text scale and the size at which a text disappears
  • Part sources turn each provider on or off and set the Nexar token
  • Cache set how long a part lookup stays valid
  • AI backend choose the CLI or the API service and the model
  • MCP server turn the built-in server on for an external agent

Troubleshooting

  • File not recognized? Check File > Settings > Editor > File Types for the KiCad, Gerber, Excellon and Eagle entries
  • No canvas tab? The canvas opens for KiCad, Eagle and EasyEDA design files and for Gerber files
  • Part search returns nothing? Check the provider settings and the Nexar token
  • Notes do not save? The folder of the design file needs write permission for the .notes.json sidecar
  • AI assistant offline? Check the backend and the network connection

What's New in 2026.1.2

  • A modern look across the schematic, the board, the Gerber and the 3D viewer, in the dark theme and the light theme
  • True text size that follows the zoom, so labels never overlap again
  • Stacked Gerber view that draws the real board from every layer of the folder

See CHANGELOG.md for complete details.

Made by Developers with a Passion for Hardware

The integration is the work of Ilscipio:

We develop ESP32-based devices and boards that ship to JLCPCB and PCBWay. We know the workflow of a hardware designer, and we built this plugin to bring the schematic and the board into the JetBrains IDE. Every feature comes from our own manufacturing experience.

We're sharing this tool with the hardware community to support the ecosystem's growth and to make professional board design more accessible.

  • Special discounts are available for individual developers & of course for the whole Open Source community.

Bugs & Feature Requests

If you have any questions, feature requests or stumble upon the occasional bug, come leave us a message at Ilscipio

idea-plugin.name: AI Commit Message - Free
idea-plugin.description:
An AI commit message generator for Git in IntelliJ IDEA. Generate Conventional Commits from your selected code changes and write the result directly into the Commit Message field.

Free LLM access for everyday commit messages: get started with the SenseNova Token Plan, free during public beta. Its international page lists 1,500 requests per model every 5 hours (special models excluded), a generous allowance for daily Commit Message generation. The Chinese page currently lists 60,000 credits every 5 hours; actual quotas depend on the model and current plan terms.

Use this AI commit assistant to summarize a Git diff, draft a commit title and change list, and review the message before committing. Customize the prompt and connect your own Chat Completions-compatible API endpoint and model.

Highlights

  • Only about 34 KB to download: the version 1.0.1 ZIP is 33,606 bytes. Package size may vary by version.
  • Uses the changes you selected: reads tracked and untracked files checked in the Commit tool window.
  • Writes as it generates: streams the response into the Commit Message field so you can review it immediately.
  • Generates Conventional Commits: the default prompt creates a structured commit title plus a concise change list with matching emoji.
  • Works in multiple languages: generate commit messages in Chinese, English, or Japanese.
  • Lets you stay in control: customize the prompt template, test the connection, and stop an in-progress generation from the toolbar.
  • Supports your own provider: configure a Chat Completions-compatible endpoint, model, and API key.

Quick start

  1. Open Settings | Tools | AI Commit Message.
  2. Enter your endpoint, model, and API key, then use Test Connection.
  3. Open the Commit tool window, select the changes to include, and click the M icon.

If the action is invoked outside the Commit tool window, the plugin uses the staged Git diff and copies the generated message to the clipboard.

Privacy

The selected Git diff and prompt are sent only to the AI endpoint you configure. Your API key is stored in IntelliJ IDEA's local non-roaming settings. Review your provider's data policy before sending proprietary code.

Requirements

  • IntelliJ IDEA 2024.3 or later
  • Built-in Git integration enabled
  • A Chat Completions-compatible API endpoint and API key

中文说明

免费白嫖 LLM，满足日常 Commit Message 生成需要：前往商汤日日新 SenseNova Token Plan，即可了解公测期免费方案。官网国际站标注每模型每 5 小时 1500 次免费 LLM 请求（特殊模型除外），日常生成提交信息额度充裕。中文站目前按每 5 小时 60,000 积分展示，实际额度以所选模型及官网最新规则为准。

面向 IntelliJ IDEA 的 AI Git 提交信息生成器，可作为日常代码提交助手，根据勾选的 Git Diff 自动生成提交信息（Commit Message）。支持 Conventional Commits 规范，以流式方式直接写入提交窗口，方便检查和修改后再提交代码。

  • 安装包仅约 34 KB：1.0.1 版本 ZIP 实测为 33,606 字节，下载体积小；不同版本的安装包大小可能略有变化。
  • 支持已跟踪文件、未跟踪文件，以及非提交窗口场景下的 Git 暂存区差异。
  • 支持中文、英文、日文，可自定义提示词模板。
  • 支持兼容 Chat Completions API 的自定义服务地址和模型。
  • 可在设置页检测连接；生成过程中再次点击红色停止图标即可取消。

注意：所选 Git Diff 与提示词会发送到你配置的 AI 服务，请在处理私有代码前确认服务方的数据政策。

idea-plugin.name: Claude Usage Monitor
idea-plugin.description:
Keeps an eye on your Claude usage from the IDE status bar (bottom-right). The widget shows 14% used | resets in 1:14 — how much of your subscription quota is gone and when it resets.

Two things, one widget:

  • Subscription quota — the 5-hour, 7-day and 7-day-Sonnet limits, each with a percentage, a colour indicator (green → yellow → red) and the time to the next reset. Same numbers as claude → /usage.
  • Tokens used — total tokens sent and received (and prompt-cache traffic, shown separately) for today, the last week and the last month, counted locally from the Claude Code transcript logs.

Click the widget for the breakdown. Configure it under Settings → Tools → Claude Usage Monitor (which quota to show, refresh interval, colour thresholds, threshold notifications).

No login. The plugin reuses the OAuth token the Claude Code CLI already stored (~/.claude/.credentials.json, or the macOS Keychain). It only ever sends that token to api.anthropic.com over HTTPS to read your usage — nowhere else. It never writes your credentials, and there is no telemetry.

Requirements: the Claude Code CLI installed and signed in.

Free and open source (MIT, on GitHub). Not affiliated with Anthropic. The subscription-quota endpoint it reads is undocumented and may change without notice; the token view keeps working regardless.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.0 — Initial release.
  • Status-bar widget: % used | resets in H:MM for the selected quota, with a colour indicator.
  • Click-through popup: 5-hour / 7-day / 7-day-Sonnet quota, plus tokens used today / last week / last month.
  • Settings: quota tier, refresh interval, colour thresholds, threshold notifications, credentials path.
  • macOS Keychain support with credentials-file fallback.

idea-plugin.name: Acpira
idea-plugin.description:
Native harnesses. One considered interface.

Bring Grok Build, Kimi Code, Devin and any other ACP agent CLI into a tool window or an editor tab. The agents keep their own execution engines; Acpira adds a clear execution history, inline approvals, queued follow-ups, session and account management, and a context budget.

Sessions, accounts and settings live in ~/.acpira, shared with the Acpira extension for VS Code and Cursor. Requires an IDE from 2026.1 on; the Marketplace package carries the native Acpira backend for each supported OS and CPU, with no Node.js required.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Added

  • **Session goal** for Codex and Claude: when the agent advertises the goal extension, a one-line goal strip hangs off the composer with the goal's status, its objective and the pause / resume / clear buttons the agent offers. Each status or objective change leaves a milestone row in the transcript, the goal is saved with the session and shown again when it reopens, and the newest typed prompt offers **Set as goal**. Built from the codex-acp and claude-agent-acp sources and covered by fixture-agent tests; real CLIs remain unverified.
  • On Windows, agents and everything they start run below normal priority, together capped at a share of total CPU so heavy builds and test runs no longer freeze the desktop. The new acpira.agentCpuCap setting (10–100%, default 80) applies live, 100 lifts the cap, and ACPIRA_AGENT_CPU_CAP overrides it. Agent work that used every core may now run somewhat slower.

Changed

  • Opening a session shows its transcript as soon as the record is loaded instead of waiting for the agent to start and resume, and a long session's view is sent once instead of three times.
  • The context card no longer shows the session cost, and its compact button stays in place whenever the agent supports /compact, disabled while a turn runs.
  • Setting descriptions on the settings page and in VS Code's settings are shorter in all nine languages.

Fixed

  • A steer sent while Claude compacts its context now waits for the compaction to end instead of aborting it and making it start over. If the turn ends first, the held messages go out as ordinary follow-ups.
  • Kimi and Pi turns that failed upstream (a provider error, an unknown model, a timeout) show the error the CLI logged instead of a generic empty-reply card, because both CLIs report such failures over ACP as an empty completion.
  • Reopening a Claude session that was created but never prompted starts a fresh session instead of showing a resume error whose Retry could never succeed. A session with turns stays read-only as before.
  • On macOS and Linux, a window that joins over a different SSH login no longer stays on an engine whose keychain is locked: when no other window is connected and no turn runs, that engine retires and the window starts one in its own login session.
  • The keychain unlock notice keeps its buttons usable while it waits and says to reload the window if nothing happens after the password.
  • Merging an agent's own prompt file into the shared AGENTS.md no longer leaves orphan structural lines behind, such as a table separator row whose table rows were all known.

idea-plugin.name: cem
idea-plugin.description:
Run the cem CLI from inside PyCharm / IntelliJ IDEA / GoLand / WebStorm / RubyMine / PhpStorm / Rider / CLion.

One AI thinks, another writes the code. Use a strong model for the reasoning and a cheap one for the typing: in pair mode the thinker is told not to write code — it produces a short plan (file, signature, approach, edge cases) and hands it to the writer, so the same work is not billed twice.

How to use it

  1. Select some code in the editor. No selection = the cursor lands in the input box at the bottom of the cem tool window.
  2. Press a shortcut, or use Tools → cem / the editor context menu.
  3. Read the result in the cem tool window at the bottom — each run gets its own tab.
Ctrl+Alt+Ithink ask the thinker about the selection
Ctrl+Alt+Wwrite have the writer implement it
Ctrl+Alt+Ppair thinker plans, writer codes

Examples

  • Select a function → Ctrl+Alt+P → "add retries with exponential backoff"
  • Select a failing test → Ctrl+Alt+I → "why does this fail?" — reasoning only, nothing is written
  • No selection → Ctrl+Alt+W → the input box opens in write mode, ready to type; to send a whole file, right-click it in the project tree (cem: review file… / ask about file…)
  • Keep talking: every run opens its own tab with an input box underneath. Answer a question the tool asked, or say "now do X too" — the previous turn is carried along as context (trimmed, because context is billed again on every turn).
  • Terminal tab: run commands in the project root without leaving the window — go test, git diff, npm run build. Pipes, redirects and && work; it is not a full pty, so use the IDE's own terminal for interactive programs. ＋ opens another terminal tab, so a server left running does not block the next command.
  • Interactive tab: type a prompt and press Enter, like a REPL. The selector on the left picks the mode (pair / think / write), Shift+Enter adds a line and ↑/↓ walk through earlier prompts

The working directory is the project root, so a project-level .cem.yaml (roles, models, reasoning effort) applies exactly as it does in the terminal.

Setup

Install the cem CLI first: curl -fsSL cem.pw/install | sh (PowerShell: irm cem.pw/install | iex). If the IDE cannot find it on PATH, set an absolute path in Settings → Tools → cem.

Automatic updates: add this once under Settings → Plugins → ⚙ → Manage Plugin Repositories:

idea-plugin.name: Harmness Browser
idea-plugin.description: Embed a configurable browser panel (e.g. a local Harmness instance) directly inside JetBrains IDE sidebars. Enables seamless AI-assisted coding inside PyCharm / IntelliJ IDEA without switching to a separate browser window.

idea-plugin.name: Varro: OpenJet
idea-plugin.description:
OpenCode workbench for JetBrains IDEs

Use OpenCode in IntelliJ IDEA, WebStorm, PyCharm, GoLand, DataGrip and other JetBrains IDEs. Ask questions about your project, plan changes and review AI-generated edits without leaving the IDE.

Features

  • Run parallel chat sessions in the tool window, editor tabs or detached IDE windows.
  • Add files, editor selections, terminal output and project errors and warnings as context. In IDEs with Database Tools, attach table schemas and selected rows.
  • Review plans, tool activity and file diffs. Control permissions per session or project.
  • Enable background desktop alerts and per-event sounds for permissions, questions, completed replies and plans ready for review.
  • Choose models and agents, view API pricing and provider quotas, and track token usage across projects.
  • Generate commit messages from your Git changes.
  • Connect to OpenCode V1 or V2 with automatic version detection, and import V1 conversations into V2.

Varro OpenJet brings the Varro chat interface from VS Code to the IntelliJ Platform. It uses your existing OpenCode configuration for providers, models, agents, commands, skills and MCP servers.

Requirements

  • A JetBrains IDE 2025.2 or newer with a JCEF-enabled runtime. Detached chat window commands require IDE 2026.1 or newer.
  • OpenCode CLI V2 2.0.5 or newer, or V1 1.16.0 or newer, on PATH or configured in Settings | Tools | Varro. Install V2 with npm install -g @opencode/cli.
  • A configured provider. Run opencode auth login, or use /connect in the chat.

Network and credential disclosure

  • Chat requests go through a local OpenCode server. Varro can discover a registered V2 service, connect on the configured port, or start a server when needed.
  • Provider-limit polling contacts provider quota endpoints directly.
  • Provider-limit polling uses existing provider credentials in the IDE host, including supported OAuth refresh. The webview receives quota counters and statuses, not credentials.
  • Terminal commands the chat can request are restricted to a fixed allowlist of OpenCode authentication, install and upgrade commands.

idea-plugin.name: Entroly

The plugin provides a guided setup action that copies a version-pinned MCP configuration and opens JetBrains's MCP settings. Entroly supplies bounded context selection, auditable receipts, exact recovery, and verification tools.

No telemetry is collected. The plugin does not silently change IDE settings, install software, or intercept model-provider traffic.

idea-plugin.name: Deployment Airlock
idea-plugin.description:
Guarded deployment for AI coding agents via the built-in JetBrains MCP server.

An AI agent can ask. Only what a human allowed can leave. What will be transferred is fixed in advance, in writing, and expires.

A plugin for PhpStorm and WebStorm that adds deployment tools to the IDE's built-in MCP server. Transfers run through the Deployment configurations already set up in the IDE, so the agent never sees SSH keys, passwords or tokens, and no separate SFTP client is involved.

What it guards against

  • The plan is built offline, fixed in writing and expires; what was confirmed is what is sent — content fingerprints are checked again before the upload.
  • Uploads are confirmed by a person, in a dialog inside the IDE that an agent cannot press. Only hosts you allow from that dialog, such as staging, may be confirmed in the agent's terminal instead; renaming a server or writing its IP address does not get around that.
  • Three trust modes can lower that barrier — Allow "don't ask again this session", Never show the IDE dialog and Auto-approve, never ask. All are off by default and live at the IDE level only, where an agent editing project files cannot switch them on. Even under Auto-approve, never ask the plan, the allowed paths, the file limit, the content fingerprints and the audit log still apply; only the confirmation is dropped.
  • The agent can be limited to certain servers and certain directories of the project.
  • Downloading from the server is off by default; uncommitted local work is never overwritten without a question, and .idea, .git, .claude and agent instruction files such as CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md are never a download target.
  • One operation per server at a time, and every transfer is written to an audit log.
  • What it does not control is named: the IDE's own automatic upload and other MCP tools that can reach a server.

MCP tools

ToolWhat it does
deployment_serversDeployment servers configured for the project. Never credentials.
deployment_planImmutable, expiring plan of local → remote paths. Built entirely offline — no connection, no credentials, nothing touched on the server.
deployment_executeUploads a plan, after the user confirms it. The caller cannot set confirmation.
deployment_statusState of a running operation — including which of the skipped files the IDE itself explained, and what that means for the copies on disk.
deployment_remote_changesWhat changed on the server: compares the server's tree with the project and returns the comparison, which is itself the download plan. Off by default.
deployment_pullDownloads a plan built by deployment_remote_changes, after the user confirms it. Off by default.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• When a confirmation dialog opens while the IDE is in the background — typically while you are working in the agent's terminal — the IDE's icon in the Dock or taskbar asks for attention until you switch to it, and a system notification names the server and the number of files. Before, the dialog could sit unseen behind the terminal while the agent waited for an answer. Nothing changes when the IDE is already in front.
  • The IDE-level settings page no longer scrolls sideways in a narrow Settings window: the label of the list of hosts confirmed in the agent's terminal now sits above the list.
  • Checked against PhpStorm 2026.3.

idea-plugin.name: Local AI Agent
idea-plugin.description:
Native Codex CLI and Claude Code workflows in IntelliJ IDEA, with zero reconfiguration when your CLI already works.

Local AI Agent connects the current IDEA project directly to locally installed coding agents, including Codex CLI and Claude Code. It preserves the Agent's native sessions, tool loop, authentication, model settings, project instructions, MCP servers, permission prompts, planning, and follow-up questions inside IDEA. There is no second API key, login, model, or MCP setup to recreate.

Native Agent capabilities

  • Stream replies, reasoning status, commands, file edits, MCP calls, and subagent activity.
  • Resume native CLI sessions and project-scoped conversation history.
  • Choose the Agent, model, reasoning effort, Plan Mode, and execution permission level.
  • Detect, configure, install, update, and restart supported local Agent CLIs from IDEA.

Voice input that stays in your draft

Click the microphone in the composer, speak, then stop recording to insert the recognized text at the draft cursor. Recording never sends a message automatically. Configure Tencent Cloud, SiliconFlow, or a compatible custom speech service with your own credentials; each provider's credentials are stored separately in the IDE Password Safe.

  • Add selected code, the current file, or a project-tree file to the draft without sending it.
  • Inspect turn diffs and open referenced project files in IDEA.
  • Follow the IDEA light or dark theme and switch between English and Chinese.

Local by default: the bundled service listens only on a random 127.0.0.1 port. Conversations and plugin settings stay on the local machine. Requests made by an Agent CLI follow that CLI's own configuration and provider terms. Optional voice input sends recorded audio directly to the speech provider selected by the user.

Requirements: IntelliJ IDEA 2024.1 or later with JCEF, plus at least one supported Agent CLI that is configured and signed in. Windows x64/ARM64 and macOS Apple Silicon/Intel are supported.

Resources: Documentation and source code · Report an issue · Privacy policy

中文

在 IntelliJ IDEA 中尽可能完整地还原 Codex CLI 和 Claude Code 的原生能力；本机 CLI 已可用时，安装后零配置接入。

Local AI Agent 将当前 IDEA 项目直接连接到本机安装的 Coding Agent，包括 Codex CLI 和 Claude Code。插件保留 Agent 原生的会话、工具循环、登录状态、 模型配置、项目指令、MCP、权限请求、Plan Mode 和追问交互，无需重复填写 API Key、 再次登录或重新配置模型与 MCP。

原生 Agent 能力

  • 实时展示回复、推理状态、命令执行、文件修改、MCP 调用和子 Agent 活动。
  • 恢复原生 CLI 会话，并按项目保存和继续历史对话。
  • 选择 Agent、模型、思考强度、Plan Mode 和执行权限。
  • 在 IDEA 内检测、配置、安装、更新和重启本机 Agent CLI。

不自动发送的语音输入

点击输入框麦克风开始录音，停止后将识别文字插入原光标位置，不会自动发送消息。可使用腾讯云、 硅基流动或兼容的自定义语音服务；填写自己的凭据后，各供应商凭据分别保存在 IDEA 密码保险箱。

  • 把选中代码、当前文件或项目树中的文件加入输入框，不会自动发送。
  • 查看每轮文件差异，并在 IDEA 中直接打开回复引用的项目文件。
  • 跟随 IDEA 深色/浅色主题，界面支持简体中文和英文。

本机优先：插件内置服务仅监听随机的 127.0.0.1 端口；会话和插件设置 保存在本机。Agent CLI 发出的请求遵循该 CLI 自身的配置与服务条款。可选语音输入只会把 录音直接发送给用户选择的语音供应商。

运行要求：IntelliJ IDEA 2024.1 或更高版本并带有 JCEF；至少安装、配置并登录一个 受支持的 Agent CLI。支持 Windows x64/ARM64 和 macOS Apple Silicon/Intel。

相关链接： 使用文档与源代码 · 提交问题 · 隐私政策

idea-plugin.name: CCoder (Claude Code Assistant)
idea-plugin.description:
Claude Code in a PyCharm tool window: chat against the project you are editing, see every file edit as a diff before it lands, and approve the commands that touch your machine.

CCoder runs the Claude Code CLI (claude) you already have installed — it is not another AI backend and ships no key of its own. It works on the project you have open: its files, its CLAUDE.md, its settings.

Working in the project

  • @ references files and the code you selected in the editor (both show as one-line tokens and expand when sent); # references project symbols such as classes and functions. Completion is fuzzy — cmprk finds ComposerMode.kt.
  • / opens slash commands and any preset prompts you already have.
  • Ctrl+V pastes a screenshot straight into the input box — click a thumbnail to open it full size.
  • Type while Claude is working and your message is queued, sent when the turn ends.

Changes you can see — and stop

  • Every file edit is shown as a diff before it is applied.
  • Commands that touch your machine (shell, writes outside the project) wait for your Allow or Deny.
  • Six permission modes, from read-only Plan and Auto-accept-edits to a classifier-driven Auto that judges each prompt and still asks when unsure.
  • Plan approvals are laid out as Markdown (tables included), in dialogs you can resize.
  • Running subagents and background commands can be stopped one by one (Agents popup — the small ■ at the end of a row). Only that task stops; the conversation goes on.

Sessions

  • Up to five sessions at once in one window; each has its own chip, with a status dot for running / waiting on you / idle.
  • Sessions are named after your first message; resume, rename or delete them from the list. Closing a tab that is still working asks first.

Bring your own model — choose the model and the thinking effort; model profiles point at your own gateway or endpoint.

Project configuration

  • MCP panel: read and edit the project's .mcp.json, with the live connection status of every server.
  • Hooks panel: read and edit hooks in the project's .claude/settings.json — nothing else in that file is touched.

Requirements

  • PyCharm 2026.1 or newer.
  • Claude Code CLI (claude) — not bundled; CCoder drives the copy you installed.
  • Node.js.
  • An Anthropic account, subscription or API key — whatever the CLI itself uses.

Notes

  • The plugin talks only to the CLI it launches; your code and prompts go where that CLI is configured to send them.
  • The interface language can be switched in the plugin's settings (gear icon in the tool window → General): follow the IDE language, Chinese, or English. Claude's replies follow your prompt's language.
  • Not affiliated with Anthropic. "Claude" and "Claude Code" are trademarks of Anthropic PBC.
  • MIT licensed. Source and issue tracker: github.com/princeyuaner/CCoder

中文

在 PyCharm 的工具窗口里跑 Claude Code：就着你正在编辑的项目提问，每次改文件都先给你看 diff，会动你机器的命令由你放行或拒绝。

CCoder 驱动的是你自己已经装好的 Claude Code CLI（claude）—— 它不是另一个 AI 后端，也不自带任何密钥。它就在你打开的那个项目里干活：项目里的文件、 它的 CLAUDE.md、它的设置。

在这个项目里干活

  • @ 引用文件，以及在编辑器里选中的代码（都显示成一行记号，发送时才展开）； # 引用项目里的类、函数等符号。补全是模糊的 —— 敲 cmprk 也能找到 ComposerMode.kt。
  • / 打开斜杠命令，以及你已经有的预置 prompt。
  • Ctrl+V 把截图贴进输入框，点缩略图能看大图。
  • Claude 干活时你照样能打字：消息排进队列，当前这轮一结束就发出去。

看得到、也拦得住的改动

  • 每次改文件都先给你看 diff。
  • 会动你机器的命令（shell、项目外的写入）由你放行或拒绝。
  • 六种权限模式，从只读的「仅规划」、「自动接受编辑」，到由模型逐条判定的 「自动判定」—— 拿不准的仍会询问。
  • 计划审批按 Markdown 排版（表格也是表格），框可以拉伸。
  • 在跑的子代理与后台命令可以逐个终止（「子代理」浮层 →「运行中」→ 行右端那颗 ■），停的只是那一个，聊天继续。

会话

  • 一个窗口里最多同时开 5 条会话；每条一颗胶囊，一颗状态点在跑 / 等你 / 空闲。
  • 会话名取你说的第一句；列表里可恢复、改名、删除。关掉还在干活的标签会先问一句。

自带模型 —— 选模型与思考档位；模型配置（profile）还能指向你自己的 网关或端点。

项目配置

  • MCP 面板：读写项目级 .mcp.json，每个 server 的连接状态实时可见。
  • hooks 面板：读写项目级 .claude/settings.json 里的 hooks —— 同文件别的内容一个字节不动。

需要什么

  • PyCharm 2026.1 或更新版本。
  • Claude Code CLI（claude）—— 不随插件分发， 驱动的是你已经装好的那份。
  • Node.js。
  • CLI 本身要的东西：Anthropic 账号 / 订阅 / API key。

说明

  • 界面语言可切（工具窗口右上角齿轮 → 通用）：跟随 IDE、中文、English，默认跟随 IDE。Claude 的回复跟着你 prompt 的语言走。
  • 插件只和它启动的那个 CLI 说话；你的代码与 prompt 去向由那个 CLI 的配置决定。
  • 与 Anthropic 无关；"Claude" 与 "Claude Code" 是 Anthropic PBC 的商标。
  • MIT 许可。源码与问题反馈： github.com/princeyuaner/CCoder

Costs are estimated from API price tables — not a bill. History is back-filled from your local Claude Code session files; the first scan takes a few seconds, and it updates incrementally after that.
